subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: Hello, when trying to log in using Google SSO today, I get stuck in a continuous redirect loop. After authenticating successfully with Google, I never actually reach the CloudDesk dashboard. Could you please look into this when you have some time?
resolution: Please clear your browser's cache and cookies specifically for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, try an incognito or private window or a different browser. We also recommend verifying your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: jira integration sync issues
body: the jira integration stopped working and i am getting JIRA-SYNC-403 errors in the logs. it seems like it cant find the projects or sync issues properly. can you assist?
resolution: This error typically indicates that the API token or user account used for the integration lacks the necessary permissions. Please verify that the configured user has both Browse Projects and Create Issues permissions within your Jira instance.

subject: Requesting plan downgrade
body: We have recently downsized our team and would like to look into downgrading our current enterprise plan. Please let us know the steps required to adjust our subscription tier accordingly. I appreciate your guidance on this matter.
resolution: You can initiate a downgrade by visiting the Billing section in the Admin Console and selecting Change Plan under Subscription Details. Please note that the change will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle, and we are unable to offer prorated refunds for the remaining time on your current plan.

subject: cant access billing before audit
body: getting auth-bill-402 in the billing section since v4.2 update and we have our security audit on friday. fix this please.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password if enabled or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Google SSO login failing with redirect loop
body: Our entire team is stuck in a redirect loop when trying to log in via Google SSO. We see the AUTH-SSO-302.1 error on our screens. This is completely blocking our workflow today. We need this fixed as soon as possible, please help.
resolution: Please clear your browser's cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com and attempt to log in again. If the issue persists, try accessing the dashboard in an incognito window or using a different browser. We have also verified that your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console appears correct on our end.

subject: Cannot update Company Name in settings
body: I am trying to update our company name in the admin console but the field is greyed out. We have a big demo scheduled for Tuesday and need our branding to be correct. I keep getting CD-AM-010. Any help would be great.
resolution: The Company Name field is linked to your billing profile, which is why it is read-only in that section. You will need to navigate to Admin Console > Subscription & Billing to update the Organization Name there. Once saved, the change will automatically sync to your Company Settings.

subject: Workspace ownership transfer failure
body: I have been working on our API integration and cleaning up some administrative tasks, which involved moving a workspace under a different user's authority. I tried to perform the transfer in the console, but the option is just greyed out, and I see a CD-AM-004 error message. I have been looking at our scripts all day, so I might be missing something obvious, but this seems like a bug. If you have time to point me in the right direction, that would be great.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to a user who is already a member or admin of that specific workspace. Please ensure the target user has been added to the workspace first. Once they are a member, you can successfully complete the transfer through the workspace settings.

subject: API 401 Unauthorized errors on requests
body: Hi team, our integrations are returning 401 Unauthorized responses with invalid token messages today. We appreciate your assistance in getting this sorted out soon.
resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your requests.

subject: Unable to update company name
body: I am attempting to update our company name in the Admin Console, but the field is read-only. I am getting error CD-AM-010 when I try to save changes. We would like to get this corrected within the next few days if possible. Please advise on how we can update this record.
resolution: Your company name is linked directly to your billing profile, which is why it appears as read-only. To update it, please navigate to Admin Console > Subscription & Billing and modify the Organization Name there. This will automatically propagate the change to your Company Settings.

subject: Slow loading times in large workspaces
body: Hello support team, we have noticed that when navigating to our workspace containing over ten thousand items, the page takes an excessive amount of time to load and often shows a blank screen or a continuous spinner. Thank you for providing such a great platform, and we would appreciate any advice on how to improve this loading time.
resolution: Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace and advise your team to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. We also suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones to improve performance. Additionally, please verify your browser console for any network errors if the issue continues.

subject: Payment failure notification received
body: I received a notice that our payment failed for our subscription. This is blocking our work and I would like to resolve it as soon as possible. Thank you for your help.
resolution: Please navigate to Admin Console > Billing > Payment Methods to update your card details or add a new one. Once updated, you can successfully retry the payment from the Invoices section.

subject: Switching to annual billing
body: I need to move our subscription from monthly to annual billing. The interface is throwing a BILL-PLAN-004 error when I attempt to change this. Please get this updated for us as soon as possible.
resolution: To update your billing cycle, please navigate to the Admin Console, go to Billing, then Subscription Details, and select Change Plan. From there, you can choose the annual option for your current subscription. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle, and any remaining credit will be prorated automatically.

subject: Existing API keys returning 401 Unauthorized
body: Our production systems stopped working an hour ago because our API keys are suddenly being rejected with 401 Unauthorized errors. We are seeing API-AUTH-401.4 codes throughout our logs. This is blocking our primary operations; please address this now.
resolution: Please verify the status of your API key in the API Keys section of the Admin Console. Check to see if it has been revoked or if it has reached its expiration date. You may need to generate a new key and update your application settings to restore service.

subject: MFA code not working on mobile
body: I am having a lot of trouble logging into the mobile app because my MFA code is not being accepted. I keep getting error code AUTH-MFA-401.2 and it is very frustrating. I have tried multiple times now without success. How can I get this fixed?
resolution: Please ensure that your mobile device's system time is set to synchronize automatically with the network time. If the issue continues, we recommend re-setting up the MFA connection for your account via the Security Settings page on the web app.

subject: Account locked out for user
body: One of our team members is locked out of their account after multiple failed login attempts. They are receiving the AUTH-LOCK-429.1 error when they try to sign in. Could you please assist in getting them back into the platform?
resolution: The user can wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire automatically. Alternatively, as an administrator, you can manually unlock their account by navigating to the Users section in the Admin Console and selecting the Unlock Account option.

subject: user activity report blank
body: hi there when i open the user activity report in the admin console the page loads but no data shows up at all. other reports work fine. whenever you have a moment can you take a look thanks so much.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering.

subject: Account locked after login failures
body: Users are seeing Account Locked messages after multiple login failures and cannot log in even with correct credentials. We are seeing AUTH-LOCK-429.1 errors across the board right now. Please resolve immediately.
resolution: Several administrators are reporting similar authentication lockouts at this time. You can instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: Desktop app keeps asking for login after update
body: Since updating to version 4.2 the desktop sync client logs me out constantly and says failed to refresh sso token. Every few minutes I have to log in again and it is completely blocking my work. Please provide a fix quickly.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to SSO token handling. Advise the user to perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client (uninstall, restart, then install). If the issue persists, the company's SSO administrator may need to review their IdP's token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret in CloudDesk Admin Console.

subject: Guest user unable to login
body: I changed a user's role from Member to Guest and now they cannot log in at all. They are getting an 'Insufficient Permissions' error. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: Guest users are restricted and only have access to specific workspaces to which they have been explicitly invited. Please check the Team Management section of your Admin Console to confirm if the user has active invitations to any shared workspaces. If they require broader access, you should change their role back to Member.

subject: SSO login broken for everyone
body: None of our employees can log into the system since this morning. We are getting an Invalid SSO Token error and we have a major client presentation at 5pm today. We really need this fixed right away because we cant get to any of our files.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format that requires an update to your configuration. Please re-configure your SSO integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Detailed steps are available in our v4.2 release notes.

subject: Issues with webhook deliveries
body: Hi there, we've been having some trouble with our webhooks lately. We keep seeing connection refused errors in the logs. Any tips on what might be causing this? Thanks so much for your time.
resolution: To resolve this, please check that your webhook URL in the Admin Console is configured correctly. You should also confirm that your external service is reachable from the public internet and that your firewall settings allow traffic from our current IP range as listed in our help documentation.

subject: Unable to transfer workspace ownership
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. I am trying to reassign our workspace to a colleague on our free plan, but the system keeps blocking me with error CD-AM-004. Could you please let me know how to resolve this when you have a moment? Thank you so much for your assistance.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a member or admin of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is added as a member of the workspace first, and then attempt the transfer via Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership.

subject: Request for nested group support in Azure AD SSO
body: Since upgrading to v4.2, we have been unable to map our nested Azure AD groups to our CloudDesk workspaces. This is a critical issue for our user provisioning process and we have a hard deadline to implement these permissions. We need to know if this functionality is supported or if there is a workaround immediately available.
resolution: Our current Azure AD integration in v4.2 supports direct group mapping but does not yet support nested group resolution. We are currently evaluating solutions for this, and you can track updates at roadmap.cloudesk.com/v4.2-enhancements/nested-azure-ad-groups. In the meantime, a potential workaround involves flattening your group structure in Azure AD.

subject: API 403 error when exporting data with admin scope
body: Hello CloudDesk team, I hope you are having a great week. We are currently trying to run our automated exports using an API key with the Admin scope on the data export endpoint, but it is returning a 403 permission denied error. We need to complete our payroll run tomorrow and would appreciate your help getting this sorted out soon. Thank you so much for your time and guidance.
resolution: Effective the date of the recent security update, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in Admin Console > API Management.

subject: high cpu usage from desktop sync client
body: desktop sync client is causing high cpu usage above 50 percent and memory issues even when idle. error code PERF-DSK-001. please help when you get a chance.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After reset, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: user activity report page is completely blank
body: hi support team, when i try to open the user activity report inside the admin console, the page loads but no data appears at all. it stays totally blank. all other reports are loading normally for me. please let me know how to fix this when you have a moment, thanks.
resolution: Hello. This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering.

subject: Intermittent file content fetch errors on Pro plan
body: Hello, our team reports that calls to the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint intermittently return a HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, especially for files stored in geographically diverse regions. Other API endpoints function normally. We wanted to report this so it can be scheduled for a fix soon.
resolution: This intermittent error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Data retention policy not purging items from trash bin
body: Hello Support, I hope this message finds you well. We configured a 30-day data retention policy for deleted files in our enterprise account, but we noticed that items in the trash bin remain visible and recoverable past that timeframe. This is blocking our internal compliance workflow, and we would appreciate your prompt help in resolving this issue. Thank you for your continued assistance.
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: API tokens invalid after v4.2 update
body: Our automated systems are failing with API-AUTH-401-V42 since we updated to v4.2. This is impacting our entire pipeline and we need a resolution immediately. Why are our existing tokens suddenly unauthorized?
resolution: With the release of v4.2, the API token format was updated to improve security. You must regenerate all of your API tokens from the API and Integrations section of your Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these newly generated tokens.

subject: Billing section inaccessible via SSO since update
body: Since the v4.2 update, our admins are getting an authentication error when trying to manage billing while logged in via SSO. The error code is AUTH-BILL-402 and it is preventing us from updating our payment method. This is blocking our finance operations and we need this fixed promptly.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token format, which can cause session conflicts with sensitive billing pages. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or temporarily log in using your direct email and password to access the billing section. We are currently investigating the SSO integration for these specific pages to restore full functionality.

subject: Questions regarding enterprise billing options
body: I have been with the company for about five years now, and we have grown significantly since we first signed up for the standard PRO plan. We are currently reviewing our quarterly budget, and I was wondering if we could move to a more consolidated annual invoicing schedule, as our finance team hates dealing with these individual credit card charges every month. Could you let me know if there are any options for that or for volume discounts?
resolution: For custom billing arrangements like annual invoicing or volume-based pricing, please reach out to our sales team at sales@cloudesk.com. They are best equipped to discuss your requirements and provide a tailored proposal that meets your company's needs.

subject: Mobile app login failing with network error
body: I cannot sign into the mobile app and keep getting a network error. My internet connection is working perfectly fine otherwise. I would appreciate your help in resolving this issue.
resolution: Please try force closing the application and checking your app store for any available updates. If the issue persists, try clearing the cache on Android or performing a fresh reinstall on your device. You may also want to verify the current server status on our public dashboard.

subject: admin console access issues
body: i am an admin but i get redirected to the user dashboard. seeing error ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. i need this fixed before our meeting tomorrow morning thank you.
resolution: Please confirm that your account profile has the correct permissions assigned in the Admin Console. You can verify this by checking Users > Manage User > Roles to ensure an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role is applied. If it is missing, please update the role accordingly.

subject: File previews showing blank page
body: Hello support team. We have noticed that previews for certain files like PDFs and PPTXs in the web app are showing a blank page or spinning indefinitely, though downloading them works fine. This is not urgent at all, but we wanted to report it. Thank you.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: New user receiving error on login
body: Hello, we invited a new staff member to our enterprise account today, but when they try to log in they get an AUTH-NF-404.1 error saying the user is not found. We have an onboarding session starting at 3pm today so we need this resolved.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: SSO login failing after v4.2 update
body: ALL OF OUR USERS ARE LOCKED OUT OF SSO! Since the v4.2 update, everyone gets an 'Invalid SSO Token' error. We are seeing the SSO_TOKEN_FORMAT_401 code. THIS IS A CRITICAL EMERGENCY. Fix this immediately!
resolution: The v4.2 release updated our SSO token format, which requires an update to your configuration. Please log into the Admin Console and re-download your SAML metadata or regenerate your OIDC client secret to align with the new requirements. Detailed instructions are available in our v4.2 release notes.

subject: Users locked out with invalid SSO token format error
body: This is completely unacceptable! Ever since your recent v4.2 update, none of our users can log in through Okta and they keep getting hit with error code CD-AM-003. Our entire workforce is completely blocked right now and we are losing business by the minute. Fix this immediately or escalate to a senior engineer right away!
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Please instruct your team to update their SSO application configuration in their IdP (Okta/Azure AD) to use the new token schema. Refer to the 'CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide' for specific instructions.

subject: Password reset email not received by user
body: Hello support team, one of our staff members requested a password reset via the login page but has not received the email in either their inbox or spam folder. We are on the Free plan and need this resolved promptly as it is blocking their daily work. Thank you very much for your time and help.
resolution: Hello! First, confirm the user's email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Advise the user to check their spam/junk folders. If still not found, ask them to whitelist 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for them via 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password'.

subject: API pagination limit parameter ignored
body: API calls using pagination parameters like limit and offset return fewer results than expected or completely ignore the limit parameter. We noticed API-PAGINATION-500 errors occurring intermittently. No rush on this, whenever you have a moment.
resolution: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Please ensure your API request correctly uses the 'limit' and 'offset' query parameters as specified in the CloudDesk API documentation. Please also note that there is a hard cap on the maximum 'limit' allowed per request, which is typically set to 1000 items.

subject: Search results incomplete for files
body: I am so annoyed because the search function is not working properly. It is not showing files that I know are in my folder. I keep getting error SEARCH-002. This makes it impossible to find my work.
resolution: This can happen if the search index is outdated. Try using specific search terms in quotes first, or log out and back in to trigger a re-indexing. If you still don't see your files, please send us the specific search terms you are using for further investigation.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card
body: I am reviewing our expenses and found a charge from CloudDesk that I cannot reconcile. It returned a BILL-CHG-010 error code when I tried to look up the invoice in the portal. Can you help me identify this transaction?
resolution: I would be happy to help you investigate that charge. Please provide the exact amount, the transaction date, and the last 4 digits of the credit card used. Once I have that information, I can cross-reference it with your billing history to clarify the charge for you.

subject: Audit logs missing external user details
body: We noticed that our audit logs only display the internal user who created a share link. The external recipient is nowhere to be found when they download files. We need to track who exactly is accessing our company data for security compliance. Is there a setting we missed, maybe AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS is involved here?
resolution: By default, shared links are anonymous, leading to the AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS log entry. To track specific external users, you must configure the share link to 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login'. Please note that this cannot be applied retroactively to existing links.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA code failing on mobile app
body: Hello. One of our users is unable to sign into the mobile app because the Google Authenticator MFA code is rejected or fails to refresh. We are seeing error AUTH-MFA-401.2 on their device screen. Please let us know how we can fix this login issue.
resolution: Advise the user to ensure their phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, guide them through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app's 'Security Settings' page.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in admin console
body: Hello Support Team, We noticed that some users' roles are incorrectly displayed in the Users & Permissions section of the admin console. Their actual permissions in workspaces are correct, but the display is wrong. This is not urgent since it's just a visual glitch, but we do have an internal security audit on Friday so it would be nice to have it looking right by then. Best regards.
resolution: Hello. This is a known UI display bug, and rest assured that the actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: Mobile app SSO login failure
body: Users are failing to log into the mobile app via Okta with attribute errors. We need this working for our field team. Please assist.
resolution: Please verify that the email, firstName, and lastName attributes in your Okta application settings for CloudDesk are mapped correctly. Ensure that the email field is designated as the unique identifier for the user profile.

subject: Unable to log in to account
body: One of our employees is locked out of their account. They are seeing an error code AUTH-LOCK-429.1 and cannot access their files. Please provide assistance as this is blocking their progress.
resolution: The account has been temporarily locked due to repeated login attempts. An administrator can resolve this by navigating to the Manage User section in the Admin Console and selecting the unlock option. If you prefer, the lockout will also automatically reset after 15 minutes.

subject: Okta SSO failing with Invalid SSO token format error
body: Our entire team is currently unable to access their accounts through Okta. We are seeing error AUTH-SSO-401.1 every time someone attempts to log in. This is causing a complete work stoppage across the office. We need a resolution immediately to restore access for our enterprise users. Please look into this right away.
resolution: We apologize for the interruption caused by our recent v4.2 update. Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata, as this is required due to the change in SSO token format. Let us know if you encounter any further issues.

subject: Audit logs missing suspicious login activity
body: hey there, we suspect some odd login activity but the audit logs only show successful logins. we need to see all attempts including failures to investigate a potential breach. we are getting the AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN error. please help, this is very important.
resolution: To view failed attempts and security-related anomalies, please navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events. The standard 'Login Activity' log is limited to successful sessions, whereas the Security Events log provides the granular detail you need for your audit. I also recommend enabling Login Anomaly Detection to receive automated alerts for future suspicious patterns.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental upgrade
body: Our account was upgraded to a higher tier by mistake. We did not intend to change our plan and would like a refund. Please let us know the process for this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that no premium features have been utilized yet. We will review your account status to determine eligibility.

subject: Payment failed notification
body: Hi there, I got an email saying our payment failed and now my team cannot access our stuff. It has been a busy week and I might have missed the renewal date. I see a BILL-PAY-002 error in the billing tab. Could you help me fix this asap?
resolution: You can resolve this by navigating to the Admin Console under Billing, then Payment Methods to update your card information. Please ensure the billing address is correct and matches what your bank has on file. Once updated, you can manually retry the payment in the Invoices section.

subject: trash bin files staying past 30 days retention
body: hey team our data retention policy is set to 30 days for deleted files but items in the trash bin are still there after a month and our compliance audit is tomorrow morning this needs urgent attention error RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Note that files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging unless specifically configured to purge Trash after a set time.

subject: need annual invoice setup
body: Hi there we are hoping to switch our account to an annual invoicing instead of credit card payment. Also wondering about volume discount options available for our team. Let us know what we need to do whenever you have a chance
resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the Enterprise Inquiry form on our website. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA codes rejected
body: Hello support, my Google Authenticator codes are not being accepted when I try to sign in, and sometimes they do not refresh properly. I am getting an AUTH-MFA-401.2 error code and it is quite annoying. Please help me resolve this when you have some time.
resolution: Advise the user to ensure their phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, guide them through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app's 'Security Settings' page.

subject: Cannot generate API key, getting permission error
body: I just got promoted to admin but I cannot generate an API key under security. It is greyed out and gives me error CD-AM-013. I really need to get this working so I can finish the integration setup.
resolution: Only users with the Super Admin role can generate API keys. Please check your current access level in Team Management, and if you aren't listed as a Super Admin, please have your team's primary account owner elevate your permissions.

subject: SSO login broken after v4.2 update
body: All enterprise users attempting to log in via SSO are currently failing with error CD-AM-003. This outage is blocking our entire workforce following the v4.2 deployment. We need an immediate fix to restore access.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Please instruct the customer to update their SSO application configuration in their IdP (Okta/Azure AD) to use the new token schema. Refer to the 'CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide' for specific instructions.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade
body: We upgraded our PRO plan by mistake earlier today. Please process a refund for the prorated difference.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility as soon as we receive this confirmation.

subject: Question about VAT on invoice
body: The tax rate on our latest invoice looks wrong compared to our business location. I think there is a BILL-TAX-006 issue here. No rush, just let me know when you can.
resolution: Please verify that your current billing address and tax ID are accurate within the Admin Console under the Billing section. If the information is already correct, please send us your company's full legal name and a valid tax exemption certificate. We will then perform a manual review to ensure your tax settings are properly adjusted.

subject: Slow public link download speeds
body: Recipients downloading files via public links are experiencing extremely slow speeds today. We received error code DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW. We have a major client audit on Friday and need this resolved promptly.
resolution: Hello. Please test download speeds using a different browser or network, and advise checking browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager if available or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Verify server region for the workspace.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed
body: Users from our secondary domain are unable to log in via Google SSO. We are getting an SSO-GOOGLE-403 error. Please update the configuration to allow this domain.
resolution: You need to update the allowed domains list in your Google SSO settings. Navigate to the SSO & Identity section in the Admin Console to add the missing domain to the permitted list.

subject: Very large workspace takes too long to load
body: Hello support. We have a workspace containing over ten thousand files, and loading it takes well over thirty seconds, often resulting in a blank screen. There is no rush on this, but we wanted to bring it to your attention.
resolution: Workspaces with extremely high item counts can experience loading delays. We recommend utilizing our search and filtering tools to narrow down the file view or splitting the contents across smaller workspaces to improve performance.

subject: Workspace search is hanging indefinitely
body: Hello, I am writing because searching for files in our main corporate workspace causes the search spinner to run forever without giving any results. This only happens in this specific workspace and it is completely blocking our team from finding financial documents needed for our strict corporate audit on Friday. Please help us fix this workspace search issue right away.
resolution: Investigate if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items (e.g., millions of files) or deeply nested folder structures. Advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches. Suggest optimizing the workspace structure if feasible. Report specific workspace ID to engineering for indexing review.

subject: error adding new team members
body: i keep getting a seat limit reached error when trying to add people, even though my dashboard says we have open seats. this is really annoying, please help. error code is cd-am-001.
resolution: It appears your pending invitations are currently counting toward your total seat limit. Please check the 'Invitations' section under Team Management in your Admin Console to review these requests. You can either revoke those older, unused invitations or upgrade your plan to increase your total seat capacity.

subject: Missing files when using search function
body: I am having trouble finding documents using the search bar in the web app. It returns incomplete results for files I know are there, and I am seeing error code SEARCH-002. This is not a major blocker for me, but I would appreciate a fix when possible.
resolution: This can sometimes be due to an outdated search index. Please try performing a more specific search using quotes for the exact phrase. If the issue persists, logging out and back in can trigger a re-indexing for your account.

subject: Workspace loading issues
body: Hello, we are having trouble accessing our primary project folder. It contains quite a lot of files and the page simply hangs for over 30 seconds, often showing a blank screen. It is really blocking our work, could you please take a look? We are seeing error code WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT and would appreciate your prompt help.
resolution: Workspaces with over 10,000 files can experience performance delays. I recommend breaking this into smaller workspaces or using the search and filter tools to narrow down your view.

subject: Google SSO login redirect loop
body: When we try to log in with Google, the page keep loading in a loop after we finish the sign in. We never arrive to the dashboard and the AUTH-SSO-302.1 code appear sometimes. It is very strange because it was working earlier today. Please help us fix this.
resolution: This usually stems from cached session data. Please clear your browser cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, or try logging in via an incognito window. Additionally, verify that your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console is still active.

subject: Okta SSO token error after update
body: Users with Okta SSO cannot log in, receiving Invalid SSO token format error. This started happening after the recent v4.2 update and is blocking our work.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: new user cant login error auth-nf-404.1
body: just invited someone to our team and they are getting an error when trying to sign in with their password error is auth-nf-404.1 no rush on this whenever you get a chance
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If the invitation is still pending, simply resend it. Also, check if they are attempting to log into the correct instance URL for your company account.

subject: Workspace loading forever
body: Hey team whenever i try to open our main workspace with lots of items it just spins forever and times out with WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT. Its taking over 30 seconds and showing a blank screen sometimes. No real rush on this since we can work on other things for now.
resolution: Hi there. We see you are experiencing loading delays due to large file counts in the affected workspace. We advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, and breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Please also verify your browser console for any network errors.

subject: Question regarding data retention policy
body: Hello, I hope you are having a wonderful day. We set up a 30-day retention policy for our files, but I noticed items in the Trash Bin remain there long after that period. We would appreciate your help in making sure these files are removed as expected.
resolution: Please verify your retention policy configuration under Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state, while files in the 'Trash Bin' are for user-initiated recovery and are not purged automatically unless you have specifically configured the trash-specific purge interval.

subject: TEAM INVITES FAILING WITH ERROR EMAIL-005
body: We are trying to onboard new team members for an audit on Friday and NONE of the invitation emails are being received! They just stay pending forever and its blocking our entire setup. We see error EMAIL-005. Fix this immediately please.
resolution: Please check your companys email spam and junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domains SPF and DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesks sending domains. Refer to our Email Delivery Troubleshooting guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries.

subject: google sso login issues for specific domains
body: We have users reporting that they cant login with google sso. It says Domain not allowed for some email addresses but others seem fine. Getting the SSO-GOOGLE-403 error here. Any idea how to fix this?
resolution: This behavior indicates that specific domains may not be authorized in your instance. Please navigate to the 'SSO & Identity' settings in the CloudDesk Admin Console and verify the 'Allowed Domains' list. Adding the missing domains there should restore access for those users.

subject: Intermittent API-500 errors when fetching file content
body: Hello, we are seeing many API-500 errors when using GET /files/{id}/content. This happens sometimes when we try to reach files in different regions. It is not always happening, but it is annoying. We would appreciate a fix soon. Thank you for your help.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Critical API 503 errors affecting production scripts API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503
body: Hello, multiple API endpoints are throwing 503 errors during peak traffic, throwing code API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503. This is breaking our production integrations and urgent action is required right away.
resolution: Investigate the customer's API usage patterns to identify if they are exceeding rate limits (check 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header). Advise implementing exponential backoff for retries. Confirm if there are any ongoing platform incidents via the CloudDesk status page. Escalate to engineering if rate limits are not being hit.

subject: Search results incomplete in web app
body: the search function is not showing all my files. i know they are there but they do not come up in results. i am seeing search-002 often. please fix this.
resolution: This can happen if the search index is slightly out of sync. Please try searching for an exact phrase in quotes, or log out and back in to trigger a re-index. If you still have trouble, please send us the specific terms and the file names you expect to see.

subject: Azure AD login error SSO-AZURE-400 on web app
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful day. Our team is currently blocked from accessing the web application due to an Azure AD error page showing code SSO-AZURE-400. Could you please provide some prompt help with this matter? Thank you so much for your assistance.
resolution: In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs' (replace 'yourcompany' with your actual subdomain).

subject: File previews failing to load in web app
body: We are experiencing an issue where previewing PDF and PPTX files results in a blank page or infinite spinning loader. Downloading the files works fine, but the in-app viewer is unusable for our team at the moment.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito or private browser window to rule out browser extensions.

subject: Too many useless email notifications
body: The current notification system is incredibly broad and my inbox is being flooded with alerts I do not need. I only want to be notified for mentions, not every single comment in our workspace. Can we get some more granular settings soon?
resolution: We understand that our current notification settings can be overwhelming. While you can manage general preferences in your profile, we invite you to detail your specific use cases on our feature request site so our team can prioritize improvements to notification granularity.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content
body: We are seeing intermittent HTTP 500 errors when calling the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. It seems to happen most often with files in different regions and is showing the API-500 error. This is causing significant issues for our file syncing and we need a fix as soon as possible.
resolution: We are currently investigating the root cause of this distributed storage retrieval error and will release a hotfix shortly. In the meantime, implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client should resolve these intermittent failures.

subject: User Activity report is blank in admin console
body: I am trying to run the User Activity report for our monthly audit but the page stays completely blank. I am seeing the error code REPORT-001 at the top of the screen. This is quite frustrating as I need to finalize our billing figures today. Please let me know how to resolve this quickly.
resolution: This behavior often indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before reloading the page. If the problem persists, ensure no browser extensions are interfering or try accessing the report via a different browser.

subject: Mobile app failing to load file previews
body: I am unable to preview any documents or images on the mobile app, which is a major issue because I have an audit on Friday. The app just errors out with MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL consistently. Please look into this.
resolution: Please ensure your mobile app is updated to the latest version and verify your device storage and network connection. You can also try clearing the application cache via your device settings. If you need to view a large file urgently, I recommend downloading it to your device first.

subject: Files not syncing after v4.2 desktop update
body: Since updating to version 4.2, my desktop sync client is no longer updating files, though they appear fine on the web app. I keep seeing error SYNC-001 whenever I try to force a manual sync. I need this working perfectly before our audit on Friday morning. Can you please advise on a fix?
resolution: Please uninstall the v4.2 desktop client and clear your local sync cache folder located in your AppData directory. Afterward, download and perform a clean install using the link found in your web app's Settings menu. This should resolve the SYNC-001 errors you are seeing.

subject: Excessive loading time for large workspaces
body: When opening workspaces with more than 10,000 files in the web app, the page frequently displays a blank screen for over thirty seconds. We are receiving WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT errors in our console logs. Please investigate this performance issue at your earliest convenience.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: webhook delivery failing
body: Hi support, our webhook endpoint is not receiving events and shows connection refused in the logs. We are on the pro plan and this started happening recently. Could you take a look when you have a spare moment thanks.
resolution: Please check the webhook endpoint URL in your Admin Console's Webhooks settings to ensure it is correct. Verify that your external service is accessible from the internet and allows incoming traffic from our IP range, as a number of customers are experiencing similar delivery issues today.

subject: User Activity report page loads completely blank
body: This is ridiculous. When I try to access the User Activity report in the admin console, the report page loads but no data is displayed, remaining completely blank. All of our other reports work fine, but this crucial one is broken. Please fix this REPORT-001 issue immediately.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue on the dashboard. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, and then attempt to access the report again. If the problem persists, try using a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering with the page.

subject: Data export endpoint returning permission denied
body: When calling the /v1/users/{userId}/data/export endpoint using an API key with the Admin scope, we receive a 403 error. This functionality worked as expected previously.
resolution: Please note that effective recently, the Admin API scope no longer includes Data Export permissions. You will need a new Data Steward API role for this endpoint, which can be generated in the Admin Console under API Management.

subject: File previews failing to load in web app
body: We are experiencing issues previewing PDF and PPTX files directly within the web app on our Pro plan. The preview viewer displays a blank page or a spinning loader indefinitely, although downloading the file works correctly. Error PREVIEW-006 appeared during our testing. Please advise on how to fix this.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

Is it possible to get a refund for this charge, as we havnt used any of the new features yet? Error code BILL-REF-005 appeared when I tried to fix it.
resolution: No problem at all, we can certainly look into that for you. Please confirm the exact date and time of the upgrade and verify that no Pro-tier features have been utilized. Once I have those details, I can review your account for a potential refund.

subject: okta sso broken after v4.2 update

resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

resolution: Hello. Please test download speeds using a different browser or network, and advise checking browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager if available or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Also, verify the server region for the workspace.

subject: SSO login page branding customization
body: We need to customize our SSO login page with company logos and colors. Please advise how to do this.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available. We recognize this as a valuable feature for many enterprises. Please add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding. We will notify you of any updates.

subject: Payment failed for subscription renewal
body: My subscription renewal failed, and I see a 'Payment Failed' status with error BILL-PAY-002. This is extremely frustrating as we need continuous access. Please help me resolve this immediately.
resolution: I apologize for the trouble. Please navigate to the Billing section in the Admin Console to update your credit card details, ensuring the address matches your bank records, and then retry the payment.

subject: Accidental Plan Upgrade Refund Request
body: hello billing team. our account on the free tier was accidentally upgraded and we would like a refund. error code BILL-REF-005 is referenced in our receipt. please let us know what steps are needed to process this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your eligibility.

I know you are busy, so I can wait, but this would really help our integration efforts. Just wanted to flag this request as we are seeing it come up more often.
resolution: We appreciate you sharing your requirements for more advanced activity tracking. Our current logs provide basic data, but you can submit your specific use cases to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This feedback helps our product team prioritize new reporting features effectively.

subject: Cannot add new team members
body: I am trying to add employees to our account, but I keep getting an error message stating the seat limit is reached. My subscription dashboard clearly shows we have three seats remaining. I am seeing code CD-AM-001 during the process, which is quite frustrating for our onboarding workflow.
resolution: Please check your Pending Invitations in the Team Management section of the Admin Console, as those count toward your total capacity. You can either revoke those pending invites to free up seats or upgrade your current plan to increase your team limit.

subject: Incorrect VAT rate applied to enterprise invoice BILL-TAX-006
body: Hello, Im writing from executive support regarding our enterprise billing. The tax rate applied to our latest invoice is incorrect for our registered location, showing error BILL-TAX-006. Please review our tax settings when you can.
resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID (if applicable) under 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information'. If these details are correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate (if applicable) for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: SSO Just-in-Time provisioning failing for new users
body: New users authenticating via our SSO provider are not being automatically provisioned inside CloudDesk, even though JIT provisioning is enabled in our configuration. We see error CD-AM-009 in our event monitoring. Please review and advise.
resolution: Please verify that your SSO Identity Provider is correctly sending the required user attributes like email, first_name, and last_name in the SAML or OIDC assertion. Additionally, ensure there are available seats in your CloudDesk subscription by checking Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings for any recent configuration errors.

subject: Workspace loading times are extremely slow
body: We are experiencing a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error when opening our main folder containing over 10,000 files. This makes our collaboration quite difficult, especially since we have an internal audit on Friday. We really appreciate your help in resolving this, as it seems to be affecting our entire team simultaneously. Thank you for your time.
resolution: It appears your workspace has exceeded the recommended file threshold for a single view. Please try using the search or filter features to narrow your focus, or consider splitting the directory into smaller workspaces for better performance. We are also reviewing the logs to identify why your browser is timing out.

subject: Switching to annual billing cycle
body: Hello, we want to move our subsciption from monthly to yearly payments to get the discount. Can you help us change this setting in our account? We keep getting error code BILL-PLAN-004 when we try to update it ourselves.
resolution: You can update your billing cycle by navigating to the Admin Console, selecting Billing, and then choosing Subscription Details. From there, click on Change Plan and select the annual option for your current tier. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle, and any remaining credit will be prorated.

subject: Okta SSO attribute mismatch
body: Users are unable to log in via SSO due to a mismatch error. We are seeing SSO-OKTA-403. Please assist as this is blocking work.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, verify that the 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Additionally, ensure that 'email' is set as the unique identifier.

subject: User Activity report is displaying blank page
body: I am trying to pull a User Activity report in the admin console for our monthly review. The report page loads, but no data appears and it stays completely blank. I am seeing the error code REPORT-001. I wanted to report this since we have noticed it is happening for our account today. Please let me know when this is resolved.
resolution: This behavior indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try using a different browser or disabling any active browser extensions.

subject: Deleted users still appearing in sharing dialogs
body: I deleted a few users yesterday but they are still showing up in my workspace share lists. I see error CD-AM-006 when I try to force refresh. Is this a system bug?
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as 'ghost' entries in historical share lists until the system purges them (typically within 24-48 hours) or until a workspace owner explicitly removes them from a share via 'Workspace Settings > Members'. This is expected behavior.

subject: Slow search results in specific workspace
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. When I search for files inside one of our specific workspaces on the web app, the spinner just keeps running indefinitely and it takes a very long time. It is not an urgent matter at all since we can still browse manually, but I wanted to report it. Thank you for all your hard work!
resolution: We can investigate if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items, such as millions of files or deeply nested folder structures. In the meantime, we advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches to speed up results. If feasible, consider optimizing your workspace structure and let us know the specific workspace ID so we can forward it to engineering for an indexing review.

subject: Incorrect tax rate on monthly invoice
body: Hello, I noticed our latest invoice has the wrong tax rate applied. We are tax exempt but the system keeps billing us for VAT. This is quite frustrating as it creates extra paperwork for me. Please resolve this issue.
resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID (if applicable) under 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information'. If these details are correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate (if applicable) for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: SSO login failing in desktop sync client
body: My team cannot log into the desktop sync client using our SSO credentials. The browser redirect happens, but the app just hangs and fails. We see error code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. This is blocking our work and we need a fix immediately.
resolution: Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version, which is v4.2.1 or newer. Check that your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a temporary workaround, please try logging in via email and password if your account allows.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with attribute error
body: We are getting an SSO-OKTA-403 error when trying to log in via Okta. The users are getting stuck after the redirect and it is currently blocking our morning workflow. Could you please investigate this immediately?
resolution: To fix this, please check your Okta application settings for CloudDesk. Verify that the 'email' and 'firstName'/'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped and ensure the 'email' field is set as the unique identifier. This should allow the authentication process to complete successfully.

subject: Desktop sync client high CPU usage
body: We notice that the CloudDesk desktop sync client is taking very high CPU usage above 50 percent and high memory even when nothing is syncing. This makes the office computers run a bit slow. Please let us know how to fix this when you have time.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First pause syncing from the client's tray icon, then go to Settings, Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database before resuming syncing.

subject: Unable to downgrade account billing
body: I am trying to downgrade our Enterprise plan but the interface is giving me a BILL-PLAN-011 error. I need this sorted out by our payroll run tomorrow as we have significantly reduced our team size. Please let me know what the holdup is.
resolution: You can process the downgrade by navigating to Admin Console, then Billing, and finally Subscription Details. Please note that while the change is effective immediately for your selection, the plan terms finalize at the end of your billing cycle. No prorated refunds are provided for switching tiers.

subject: Frequent SSO session expiration after update
body: Hello. Since we update to v4.2, many team members are logged out constantly. We receive SSO session expired message very often. This include error code SSO-REFRESH-401-V42. Please look into this.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how SSO tokens are refreshed. Please verify that your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have the refresh token policy enabled for a duration of at least 8 to 24 hours to resolve these frequent logouts.

subject: google sso login redirect loop on web app
body: users trying to sign in using google sso are getting stuck in an infinite redirect loop and never hit the dashboard. error code is AUTH-SSO-302.1. take a look whenever you get around to it, no major rush.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: api error 500 blocking our deployment
body: we are getting api-500 errors on our content calls. we have a deadline tomorrow morning and this is currently blocking us. please help.
resolution: We apologize for the disruption and are investigating the root cause of these distributed storage errors. Please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your code to handle these intermittent failures. A fix for this issue will be deployed in our next upcoming hotfix.

subject: Desktop client eating all CPU resources before our big client demo
body: Good morning team, I hope you are having a wonderful week so far. The weather here has been quite unpredictable lately, and speaking of unpredictable, our office coffee machine broke down this morning right before our team meeting about the upcoming quarterly review. More importantly, our pro desktop sync client is causing extremely high CPU usage consistently above fifty percent and massive memory consumption even when nothing is syncing. We have a major client demo scheduled for 5pm today and this computer lag is completely blocking our prep work. Error code PERF-DSK-001 is visible. Please help urgently.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After reset, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: Account locked after login attempts
body: My account is locked and I cannot access my files. I know my password is correct but it keeps failing. This is completely blocking my work for the day. Please unlock this for me.
resolution: It looks like your account was locked due to multiple failed login attempts. Please wait 15 minutes for the automated lockout to expire, or contact your company's administrator to manually unlock your account via the Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User'. This security measure helps protect your account from unauthorized access.

subject: Delayed or missing mobile app push notifications
body: We have noticed that push notifications for file changes and comments are not coming through promptly on the mobile app. They often arrive several minutes late or only appear once the application is opened.
resolution: Hello. Verify that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and the device's operating system settings. Check for any battery optimization settings on the device that might be restricting background app activity. Advise reinstalling the mobile app.

subject: Request for advanced user activity and download reports
body: Hello support team, we are currently on the Pro plan and looking for much more detailed audit logs that include specific file downloads, views, and collaboration actions. Could you please provide prompt assistance with accessing these enhanced reports for our compliance review?
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting, which will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: User role display bug in Admin Console
body: The admin console is incorrectly displaying roles for several users, showing Contributor instead of Manager. This is misleading for our internal tracking purposes, even though their actual access seems fine. I am seeing UI-ADMIN-003.
resolution: This is a known UI display glitch that does not impact actual system permissions. To resolve the display, please navigate to the user's profile, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the original role. A permanent fix for this visual bug is expected in our upcoming patch.

subject: API share workspace returning 403

resolution: Please verify that your API key has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled in the console. Additionally, the user associated with the key must be a direct member of the workspace. If it still fails, please send over the API key ID.

subject: Account lockout issue
body: Some of our users are seeing an AUTH-LOCK-429.1 message even when using the correct password. We would appreciate it if you could advise on how to resolve this. Thank you for your time.
resolution: Accounts usually unlock automatically after 15 minutes have passed. If you need immediate access, you can manually unlock the account by navigating to 'Users' and selecting 'Manage User' in the Admin Console.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card

resolution: To investigate this charge, please provide the exact dollar amount, the date it appeared, and the last four digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account history and provide an explanation for the transaction.

subject: Ghost entries for deleted users

resolution: Please note that deleted users may temporarily appear as ghost entries in historical sharing menus until the system completes its automated purge cycle. These entries typically clear within 24 to 48 hours, or you can manually remove them from the share list via your Workspace Settings.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy

I am reviewing our latest invoice and I noticed that the billed user count does not quite match the number of active users we have currently listed in our console. resolution: Please verify the Billing Date and Proration Period detailed on your invoice, as user count adjustments usually apply at the start of the next cycle. If you believe there is an error, please share your invoice ID and the current active user count with us. We will then perform a manual audit to ensure your billing is accurate.

subject: Seat limit reached error incorrectly shown

resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit, so you should either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.
