resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Request to switch to annual billing
body: I would like to change our subscription from monthly to annual billing to save on costs. We have a budget meeting coming up on Monday, so I would like to get this finalized soon. Error code BILL-PLAN-004.
resolution: You can easily switch your billing cycle by navigating to the Subscription Details page in your Admin Console. Selecting the annual plan will apply the new billing cycle starting at your next renewal date, and any remaining balance from your current month will be prorated automatically.

subject: Seat limit error when adding users
body: Hello, we are trying to add a couple of new team members today, but the system gives us a CD-AM-001 seat limit reached error. However, our subscription details clearly show we have spare seats left. No huge rush, just whenever you have a moment.
resolution: Please check the Pending Invitations count in Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations, as pending invites still count toward your total seat limit. You can either revoke any old pending invitations to free up spots or upgrade your subscription plan to increase your team's capacity.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade
body: I think I upgraded to the wrong plan by mistake. Can I please get a refund for the prorated difference? I am getting error BILL-REF-005 when trying to downgrade.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Unable to generate new API key for promoted admin
body: Hello, one of our newly promoted administrators is trying to generate an API key under Admin Console > Security > API Access, but the interface shows that they lack sufficient permissions. We noticed error code CD-AM-013 on their screen. It looks like many other accounts are encountering similar permission snags right now. Please let us know how to resolve this so our team can proceed with our integrations.
resolution: API Key generation requires the 'Super Admin' role. While the user may be an 'Admin', they might not have 'Super Admin' privileges. Confirm their role in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. If not 'Super Admin', the current Super Admin must generate the key for them or elevate their role.

subject: Search spinner spinning indefinitely
body: The search function in one of our specific workspaces is stalling out and just spinning forever. I do not see an error code, but the results never populate. It is not urgent, but it would be good to get it working eventually.
resolution: It is likely that your workspace has a very high volume of files or deeply nested folders. Try using more specific search keywords to narrow the results. If the delay continues, please provide the workspace ID so our engineering team can review the index.

subject: Incomplete search results in web app
body: I am experiencing issues where searching for files by name returns incomplete results. I know these files exist and have permission to see them. This is happening across my account. Please advise on how to fix this SEARCH-002 error.
resolution: This can sometimes be due to an outdated search index. Please try performing a more specific search using exact phrases in quotes. If the issue persists, log out and log back in to trigger a re-indexing for your account.

subject: need more storage space on free tier
body: we hit our storage limit way too fast on this free plan and honestly its getting ridiculous. can you just bump up our limit so we dont have to upgrade right now.
resolution: Thank you for your feedback regarding our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams, and we do not plan to increase free storage at this time. Please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

subject: error when renaming custom role in admin console
body: hello team im trying to setup a new custom role on our pro account and it keeps giving me code CD-AM-012 saying the name already exists even though i am sure ive never used it before. its not urgent at all since we are just organizing things for next month but if you could take a look when you have time that would be great thanks
resolution: Role names are case-insensitive and leading or trailing spaces are automatically trimmed by the system. There might be an existing role with a similar name or one that differs only by capitalization. Please check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Roles' thoroughly for any roles that might conflict.

subject: BILLING ACCESS BROKEN AFTER V4.2
body: WE CANNOT ACCESS OUR BILLING SECTION SINCE THE UPDATE! Every time we try to manage our payment methods via SSO, it throws an AUTH-BILL-402 error. This is completely blocking our financial operations and we need assistance immediately!
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Incorrect VAT applied to our invoice
body: I have been reviewing our monthly statements for a long time, and I noticed the tax calculation on our latest invoice seems wrong. My boss is asking why we are being charged this specific amount, and I have had a very long day dealing with other audits. I see the error code BILL-TAX-006 on the record. Please help us fix this as it is blocking our expense reporting.
resolution: Please double-check your billing address and tax ID information listed under the Billing section of the Admin Console. If those details are accurate, please send us your company's full legal name and your valid tax exemption certificate for a manual audit. We will review your tax settings once we receive this documentation.

subject: free tier storage limit increase request
body: hello there we love using cloudesk for our small team workspace but we keep hitting the free tier storage limit quickly. is there any way we could get a small storage boost without having to upgrade our plan right now. thanks so much for your help
resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time. Please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

subject: Session expired error on login
body: I am getting logged out immediately after reaching the dashboard. The error says AUTH-SESSION-401.5 and it is happening to everyone on my team. This is extremely frustrating for our development flow. Please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: Please clear all cookies and local storage associated with our domain in your browser settings. You should also verify that your system clock is set to the correct local time, as deviations can break our security tokens. If you use privacy extensions, try disabling them to see if they are blocking your session cookies.

subject: Mobile app preview failing
body: Good morning. As someone handling the billing and financial records here, I frequently check documents on the go using my phone. Lately, whenever I try to look at PDF or Word document previews in the mobile app, it just sits there loading forever or throws an error code MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL. It is not a huge deal right now since I can just look at things on my laptop later, but I figured I would report it anyway. Thanks.
resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version. Check the user's device storage and network connection. Advise clearing the mobile app's cache (via device settings). For very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: API file content endpoint returning 500 errors
body: Dear CloudDesk Support Team, we hope you are having a wonderful week. We are writing to report that our backend scripts calling the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint are intermittently throwing HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors, particularly for documents in diverse geographic regions. Everything else on the API is performing wonderfully. Could you please help us look into this so we can keep our sync jobs running smoothly?
resolution: Thank you for the kind message and for bringing this to our attention. This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are currently investigating the underlying root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Webhook signature verification failing for external service
body: Our endpoint is rejecting incoming CloudDesk webhooks with an HMAC verification failed message. We have a major client demo at 5pm today so getting this sorted out soon is important. The error code shown is WEBHOOK-SIGN-403.
resolution: Ensure the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the Webhook Secret configured in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify your signature verification algorithm matches CloudDesk's HMAC-SHA256.

subject: Expired session errors constantly on mobile after v4.2
body: Ever since the v4.2 update rolled out, our mobile app users are constantly being kicked out with an Expired Session error CD-AM-011. It happens multiple times a day and is driving everyone crazy. We need a proper fix for this session token issue immediately.
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to session management for improved security. Users should fully log out of the mobile app, clear their app cache or data if on Android or reinstall the app if on iOS, and then log back in to force a new, compatible session token.

subject: API 500 errors on file content calls
body: we are getting intermittent 500 errors when trying to get file content. it seems to happen mostly with our remote offices. it is blocking our work so please fix this.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error is related to distributed storage retrieval and can be mitigated by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API calls. Our engineering team is aware of this behavior and is currently working on a hotfix to improve stability for geographically diverse regions.

subject: Request for increased file version retention limits
body: Our team would like to request more granular control over file versions and an increase in the retention limits beyond the current 30-day and 100-version cap. Our engineering group frequently needs to reference older iterations of documents for compliance purposes. Please let us know if there is a way to configure this for enterprise accounts.
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding file versioning. The current limits are set to balance storage and performance. We recommend utilizing our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com to submit your specific requirements for enhanced versioning and vote on similar requests. This helps our product team understand the demand.

subject: Admin console users and groups page freezes
body: Hi there when I go into the Admin Console and click on Users and Groups it takes several minutes to load our full staff list. Filters and search are also responding very slowly today. Error code ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT is showing up sometimes. Hope you can help fix this soon.
resolution: Hello. We recommend using the 'Search' bar or applying specific filters like 'Status: Active' immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset. The system is optimized for filtered views on large datasets, and you can also navigate directly to a specific user via search if their email is known.

subject: Issues accessing billing settings with SSO
body: Dear support team, hope you are having a good week. We noticed that since the recent v4.2 upgrade, trying to view our invoices or update payment methods via SSO gives us an authentication failure in the billing portal. Whenever you have a moment, could you kindly advise how we can bypass this?
resolution: Hello. Thank you for reaching out to us. The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can occasionally cause session issues with sensitive billing operations, so please try logging out and back in directly with your email and password or clear your browser cache.

subject: Webhook delivery failed errors
body: Hello. Our external service is failing to receive webhooks from CloudDesk, showing connection refused in the logs. We are on the pro tier and would like to get this resolved soon.
resolution: Verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range (refer to documentation for current IPs).

subject: Severe typing lag in office documents
body: There is a massive COLLAB_LAG happening right now when multiple people type in docs together, taking like 5 seconds to update. Its really annoying during our editing sessions today, hope u can fix it soon.
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved and advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and applications, verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing, and clear browser cache for all users.

subject: User cant login after role change
body: Hi there, we recently changed a team members role to guest and now they cant log into the web application at all. They report seeing CD-AM-002 on the screen. Thank you so much for your assistance with this.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Cannot export audit logs over 90 days
body: I am trying to pull audit logs for the last six months, but the system keeps throwing the AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED error. It is frustrating that I cannot get this data in one go. No huge rush, but please let me know how to get the full report.
resolution: The Admin Console's built-in export tool is limited to 90-day intervals. For longer periods, please use our API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with your specified date range, or reach out to our support team if you require us to perform a manual data extraction for you.

subject: Request for expanded file versioning options
body: Hello support team, we have been thoroughly enjoying using the desktop sync client for our PRO workspace. However, our team would love to have more granular control and a higher limit for file versions beyond the standard 30-day or 100-version threshold. Could you please let us know if this is something on the horizon?
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding file versioning. The current limits are set to balance storage and performance. We recommend utilizing our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com to submit your specific requirements for enhanced versioning and vote on similar requests, which helps our product team understand the demand.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: Our new hires cannot log into CloudDesk using their corporate Google accounts. They keep getting a 'Domain not allowed' error code SSO-GOOGLE-403 when trying to authenticate. It is quite frustrating for the team. Any advice on how to fix this?
resolution: To resolve this, please go to the CloudDesk Admin Console and navigate to the 'SSO & Identity' settings. Under the Google SSO configuration, check the 'Allowed Domains' list. You will need to add any missing domains that are currently being blocked from logging in.

subject: cant find login activity for new countries
body: we noticed strange logins from overseas on our pro mobile app but the audit log only shows successful logins and misses everything else. error code AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN. please help us check this right away because our security is blocked.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses/locations are recorded in the 'Security Events' log, not 'Login Activity'. Navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events for this information. Enable 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic alerts.

subject: Security concern regarding API key permissions
body: I have found that an API key limited to read-only access is still allowed to delete users, which is a major concern. This behavior indicates an API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS issue. Could you please look into this promptly as it is blocking our secure deployment?
resolution: Please revoke the affected API key immediately via the Admin Console. You should investigate if the key was initially generated with broader permissions or if there is a configuration error in your process. We recommend you escalate this to your internal security team while we also review the scope enforcement.

subject: API keys suddenly returning authentication errors
body: Hello support, our automated scripts and system integrations have stopped working completely today because our existing API key is returning an API-AUTH-401.4 error. We are on the PRO plan and rely heavily on this connection for our daily office operations. The key was working fine yesterday, so this sudden failure is quite blocking for us. Could you please look into this promptly so we can resume our work?
resolution: Please verify your API key's status in the Admin Console under the API Keys section to check if it has expired or been revoked. We recommend regenerating a new API key if necessary and updating your application credentials. Let us know if you continue to experience issues after updating the key.

subject: Need longer public link expiration times
body: It is extremely frustrating that we cannot set our public file sharing links to stay active indefinitely or at least for a much longer duration. Our external partners constantly complain that links expire too quickly. Please let us know if this can be extended.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Missing branding on SSO login page
body: Hi there, I was just reviewing our workspace setup while grabbing my morning coffee and realized something rather curious about our login flow. When users are redirected to the SSO login page, the custom company logo and background image are not appearing, showing default CloudDesk branding instead with error code SSO-UI-200.2. There is no real rush on this since it is mostly cosmetic, but I wanted to drop a note so it can be looked into whenever your team has a spare moment.
resolution: Please guide your admin to the 'SSO & Branding' section in the Admin Console. Check if the custom branding assets like your logo and background are uploaded and saved correctly. We also advise clearing the browser cache for affected users to see the changes.

subject: mobile app crashes when uploading big files
body: Hi, whenever i try to upload files bigger than 1gb from the mobile app, it just crashes completely without any error message popping up. smaller files work fine though. this happens every single time on different devices and networks. hope you guys can fix this soon
resolution: Hello. This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Workspaces with many files wont load
body: I am so tired of waiting for my work folders to open. They just spin forever and then show a blank screen. This is happening for all my larger folders. Please fix this.
resolution: Large workspaces with over 10,000 files can cause performance delays. I recommend using our search and filter tools to narrow down your view, or splitting your large workspaces into smaller, more efficient ones.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership option greyed out
body: Hello. I am trying to transfer ownership of a workspace on our Enterprise account, but the option is greyed out and I receive the error Cannot transfer ownership to non-owner. Please let me know how to proceed.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: missing comments in my data download
body: hi there i hope you are having a nice week so far i wanted to let you know that i requested my gdpr data export earlier today since our office manager asked me to handle it before she left for her holiday we use the free version for our small team and i managed to find most things like files and folders but when i looked through the package it was throwing a gdpr_export_incomplete_comments error code and some comments i left on files and tasks are totally missing from the zip file we are not in a massive rush to get this fixed today since the audit isn't until next month but i wanted to check if you could help me find where those comments went thanks so much
resolution: The GDPR data export primarily covers files, folders, and direct user profile data. Comments on files and tasks are stored as activity metadata. To export comments, navigate to the specific file or task, open the activity tab, and use the export activity log option for that item.

subject: Assigned tickets missing from agent view
body: When we assign a helpdesk ticket to an agent, it completely disappears from their My Assigned Tickets view in the web app, though admins can still see it. This is throwing off our entire support workflow right now, so please help us fix this fast.
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: User Activity report blank
body: The User Activity report shows as blank when loaded. Other reports are fine. Error code REPORT-001 is appearing.
resolution: This is likely a temporary display issue. Please clear your browser's cache and cookies, or try accessing the report using a different browser to see if the data populates. If it remains blank, please let us know the specific date range you are attempting to view.

subject: Request for dark mode
body: Our team has been spending long hours in the web application and many are reporting significant eye strain. We have noticed others are having the same issue and are wondering if a dark mode will be added. Is there an ETA for a low-light interface option?
resolution: Thank you for reaching out with this feedback. We currently do not have a dark mode available for the web app, though we recognize it is a popular request. Please add your vote to the feature on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/dark-mode to help our team prioritize its development.

subject: Hardware-based MFA token support request
body: Our security team is asking if we can use YubiKeys or other hardware tokens for multi-factor authentication instead of just the app ones. Please let me know if this is available.
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: User activity report not loading
body: Hi there, i am trying to run our monthly user activity report but the page is just blank. I see a REPORT-001 error code in the console. Could you please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: desktop sync uploaded files without consent
body: the sync client pushed my local documents folder to the cloud without me asking. i have an audit on friday and this is a major privacy concern. it seems like a sync_client_unauthorized_upload issue. please explain why this happened.
resolution: The sync client only pushes folders that have been explicitly enabled in your settings. Please check your 'Synced Folders' list in the desktop application preferences to see if this path was accidentally selected. You can also disable the 'Auto-sync new shared folders' feature to prevent this in the future.

subject: API pagination limit and offset parameters ignored
body: Hello. We noticed that API calls using pagination parameters like limit and offset are returning unexpected result counts or ignoring the limit entirely. There is no rush on this, but please look into it when convenient.
resolution: Ensure your API request correctly uses the limit and offset query parameters as specified in the CloudDesk API documentation. Note that there might be a hard cap on the maximum limit allowed per request, such as 1000 items.

subject: Workspace loading issues with large file sets
body: When we try to access a workspace containing over 10,000 files, the page hangs for over 30 seconds before failing. It seems to be hitting a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT and we cannot see our files. Is there any way to improve the load speed for these folders?
resolution: Loading that volume of files can often lead to performance timeouts. I recommend using our search or filter options to narrow down the view, or breaking large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Please also check your browser console for any specific network errors that might be occurring during the load attempt.

subject: Billing API data inconsistencies
body: Ever since the v4.2 update, our usage reports via API have been inconsistent with the Admin Console. We are seeing an API-BILL-401 error. Please advise on why the data is not matching up.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 changed how certain usage metrics are calculated for legacy storage. Please ensure your query uses the updated aggregation parameters found in the v4.2 documentation. If you are still seeing a discrepancy, please share the specific API query and the report you are comparing it against.

subject: Google SSO login redirect loop issue
body: Hello support, some of our employees trying to log in using Google SSO are getting stuck in an infinite redirect loop after successfully authenticating with Google. They never actually reach the main CloudDesk dashboard. This is affecting our normal daily operations so we would appreciate it if someone could take a look at it soon.
resolution: Hello. Please instruct the affected users to clear their browser's cache and cookies specifically for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise them to try opening an incognito or private browsing window, or switch to a different browser. Additionally, please verify that your Google SSO configuration is correct in the Admin Console.

subject: mobile app mfa setup failing qr code scan
body: hello team, when we try to setup google authenticator mfa via the mobile app it fails with mfa-mob-002 right after scanning the qr code. email and password login is fine though. no huge rush since we can still log in on desktop for now, but please fix it eventually.
resolution: This is a known issue affecting the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise your users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app by navigating to Settings, Security, and then Multi-Factor Authentication. Once it is configured there, it will work seamlessly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: audit log export fails over 90 days
body: hi team my audit log export keeps failing when i try pulling a range greater than 90 days from the admin console it keeps throwing AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED and i really need this data for my work today please help
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: workspace search lag
body: searching files in one specific workspace takes forever and the spinner just keeps going forever. works fine everywhere else. workspace_search_lag is showing up in our internal logs. please look into this when you get a chance.
resolution: We investigated your workspace and noted it contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested folder structures. We advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches to improve performance. We have also reported the specific workspace ID to our engineering team for indexing review.

subject: Custom OAuth client secret mismatch error on API
body: Why is my custom integration completely broken right now?!?! I keep getting invalid_client and client_secret_mismatch errors when trying to obtain access tokens from the api. This is extremely frustrating and blocking all my dev work today. Fix this now please.
resolution: We apologize for the frustration. Please verify that the 'Client ID' and 'Client Secret' used in your custom application exactly match the credentials generated in the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'API & Integrations' -> 'OAuth Clients'. Pay close attention to case sensitivity and ensure there are no accidental trailing spaces.

subject: Deleted user still showing in workspace sharing
body: I have removed a person from the account but their name is still here in the sharing lists. It is quite annoying to see ghost entries. Is there a way to force this to disappear?
resolution: While these users no longer have access to your workspace, they may appear in historical share lists until the system automatically purges them within 48 hours. Alternatively, the workspace owner can manually remove the user from the sharing list within the Workspace Settings.

subject: audit log retention limit
body: hey team, we are trying to set our audit logs to 5 years for compliance in the admin console, but AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT is stopping us because 12 months is the max. let us know if we can change this when you get a chance.
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution such as Splunk or Sumo Logic via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. This is a known limitation and a feature request for extending native retention.

subject: api error on file downloads
body: getting api-500 errors when calling get files id content. our whole system is down and customers are complaining. fix this immediately please.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Too many emails, need granular control
body: I have been working on our internal integration and reviewing our team's workflow efficiency, which has been quite a project given the complexity of our folder structures and user permissions. I noticed that the current notification system sends alerts for every single comment, which is quite distracting and makes it hard to filter important mentions. Is there any way to toggle off comments while keeping mentions enabled? It seems others on my team are finding this flood of notifications equally unhelpful.
resolution: We appreciate your detailed feedback regarding notification volume. While our current settings are set at a profile level, we are actively looking to improve granularity. Please head over to our roadmap portal to detail your specific use cases so our team can better prioritize this feature.

subject: External File Share Audit Logs Lack Specific User Identity
body: Our company users frequently share files externally with clients, but our audit logs do not show which specific external user actually accessed or downloaded the shared file. We only see the internal user who created the share link logged in the system. We hit error code AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS when reviewing the access logs.
resolution: By default, external share links are generated anonymously. To properly track external user activity, ensure that share links are configured with either Require Email Verification or Require CloudDesk Login enabled, keeping in mind this cannot be applied retroactively to existing links.

subject: SSO login failing after update
body: Our users are seeing Invalid SSO Token errors since the update. We have a board demo at 5pm today and nobody can sign in. We are getting error code SSO_TOKEN_FORMAT_401. Fix this now.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format that requires an update to your configuration. Please log into the Admin Console and re-download your SAML metadata or re-generate your OIDC client secret to restore access. Detailed steps are available in the v4.2 release notes.

subject: Need PDF format for downloaded invoices
body: Hello. When trying to download an invoice from the Admin Console, the only available format is CSV. Our accounting department requires a PDF format for our records. Please advise how we can obtain PDF invoices.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: File previews not loading in web app
body: When attempting to preview certain file types like PDFs directly within the web app, the preview viewer shows a blank page or a spinning loader indefinitely. Downloading the file works correctly. Please look into this when you have a chance.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Google login broken for our executives
body: Our entire team is blocked from logging in with Google. We keep seeing SSO-GOOGLE-403 error on the login screen. This is hindering our work flow, can you fix this soon?
resolution: Please check the 'Allowed Domains' list under 'SSO & Identity' in your Admin Console. Ensure that the specific domains your executives are using are included in that list. This should resolve the access issue you are experiencing.

subject: Slow API response times on GET files
body: Hello, we noticed that specific API endpoints like GET /files and POST /upload are taking over 500ms to respond, which is causing severe delays in our downstream integrations. Error code API_RESPONSE_SLOW is appearing in our monitoring logs. We need this investigated and resolved soon.
resolution: Request specific API call examples (endpoint, request body, timestamps) from the customer. Advise optimizing API calls by using pagination and filtering parameters to reduce the dataset returned. Suggest caching frequently accessed data on their end. Escalate to engineering with provided logs for performance analysis.

subject: Unintentional plan upgrade refund request
body: Good morning, our billing department noticed an accidental upgrade on our account today, and we would like to request a refund for the prorated amount. Error code BILL-REF-005 was noted on our invoice history. Please review this when you have a chance so we can sort out our subscription status.
resolution: Hello. Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in Admin Console
body: Hello support team, I noticed that several users have the wrong role displayed in our admin console, specifically showing Contributor when they should be Managers. While their actual access seems fine, I am concerned about this as we have an internal audit coming up this Friday. Could you please assist in correcting this UI-ADMIN-003 display issue? Thanks for your help.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and the actual permissions are not affected. You can refresh the display by opening the user's profile, changing their role to something else, saving, and then switching it back to the correct role. We are working on a permanent fix for a future patch.

subject: Question regarding annual invoicing and billing options
body: Hi there, I hope you are having a pleasant week so far. I am writing from the finance department to discuss our account setup, as our accounting team generally prefers annual invoicing over credit card processing, and we were wondering what options might be available since we currently manage several vendor relationships and want to streamline our bookkeeping procedures going forward, especially given our projected growth over the next fiscal quarter.
resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please reach out to our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the Enterprise Inquiry form on our website. They will be happy to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: GET /files/{id}/content returning HTTP 500 error
body: Hello support team. We notice that calls to the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint intermittently return a HTTP 500 Internal Server Error with error code API-500. This happen mostly for files stored in geographically diverse regions. Other API endpoints function normally for us. We would like to have this fixed soon when possible.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Update purchase order number for future invoices
body: We need to add a new purchase order number to our upcoming billing cycles in the admin console. Could you please advise how our accounting team can update this?
resolution: Hello. You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices, though note this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: Desktop sync client not updating files
body: Ever since we updated to v4.2, my desktop sync client is not showing updates made in the web app. I am seeing the error code SYNC-001 frequently. This is blocking our workflow, so please help us resolve this quickly.
resolution: Please uninstall your current v4.2 desktop sync client and clear the local sync cache from your machine's AppData or Library folder. After clearing the cache, reinstall the client using the download link found in your web app's Settings menu.

subject: Billing API usage data inconsistent after v4.2
body: Since upgrading to v4.2, fetching usage reports via the billing API returns data that completely contradicts our Admin Console reports and past API responses. This API-BILL-401 discrepancy is causing confusion with our reporting. Please help us get this sorted out soon.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Please ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as outlined in the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, please provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for our review.

subject: Audit log export failing over 90 days
body: Hello, I am trying to pull our workspace audit logs for a date range spanning the last six months, but the export keeps getting truncated and fails with the error message AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. Could you advise how we can retrieve this historical data for our enterprise compliance review?
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Azure AD nested group mapping issue
body: I am very frustrated that we cannot map our nested groups from Azure AD after the v4.2 update. We really need this for our user provisioning to work correctly. Can you please prioritize this as it is blocking our onboarding?
resolution: The v4.2 update currently supports direct group mapping but does not support nested group resolution. We are tracking this request and you can add your specific use case to our roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/v4.2-enhancements/nested-azure-ad-groups. For now, a workaround is to flatten your group structure in Azure AD.

subject: Mobile app login error after role change
body: One of our office workers cannot log into the mobile app and sees the error message Account Suspended. Their role was recently changed to Guest. Please look into this promptly so they can resume their work.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: S3 Data Export failing after update
body: Our automated tenant-wide data export to AWS S3 has stopped working, returning an Invalid Credentials error. We have not changed any settings on our AWS side, but this started right after the v4.2 upgrade. We have a compliance audit this Friday, so we need this restored right away.
resolution: The v4.2 release enforces stricter IAM policy requirements for S3 integrations. Please ensure your AWS IAM policy includes the required permissions, such as 's3:GetBucketLocation', as detailed in our v4.2 S3 Integration Guide. Updating these policies should resolve the credential errors immediately.

subject: API key returning 401 Unauthorized suddenly
body: Hello support, since this morning our application is failing with error API-AUTH-401.4 when calling your REST API using our main production key. We have not changed anything on our end and it was working fine yesterday. This is blocking our primary deployment which has a hard deadline for the audit on Friday. Please look into this immediately.
resolution: Please verify your API key's status in the Admin Console under the API Keys section to check if it has expired or been revoked. If needed, please regenerate a new API key and update your application settings accordingly.

subject: Requesting more detailed user activity reports
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a productive week so far. While reviewing our workspace metrics this morning, I was thinking about how our department handles data governance and tracking across various projects. We often need to examine granular details such as specific file downloads, individual preview views, and other collaboration actions that go well beyond the standard audit logs currently available. Could we get more comprehensive reporting features built into the admin console soon?
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Constant session expired errors on web app
body: Hi support team, I am experiencing severe issues where my enterprise session terminates immediately upon logging in or navigating the web app dashboard. This error AUTH-SESSION-401.5 is extremely disruptive because we have a critical board audit starting tomorrow morning and our team cannot access any files. Please advise on a solution as soon as possible.
resolution: Please clear your browser's cookies and local storage specifically for cloudesk.com. Additionally, verify that no strict browser privacy extensions are interfering with session cookies and check that the system time on your device is accurate.

subject: Users not getting password reset emails
body: My employee requested a password reset but they are not receiving the email. We checked spam folders and nothing is there. We keep getting error CD-AM-008. Please help us get this fixed asap.
resolution: Please ensure the user's email address is correct in the Admin Console under Team Management. Ask the user to whitelist no-reply@cloudesk.com, and if the email still does not arrive, an admin can manually force a password reset for them directly from the user management screen.

subject: API AUTH-401.4 errors killing our production pipeline
body: My application is throwing API-AUTH-401.4 errors constantly. All of our integrations just stopped working this morning and we have critical client processes failing. I need to know why our valid keys are suddenly rejected. This is causing significant downtime and I need an immediate fix.
resolution: It appears your existing API keys may have been invalidated due to a recent platform security update. Please log into the Admin Console, check the API Keys section to see if your current key is listed as expired or revoked, and generate a new one if necessary. Once you update your application with the new key, your service should resume normal operation.

subject: Google SSO login loop
body: Our users are experiencing a redirect loop when trying to log in with Google SSO. They authenticate fine but never reach the dashboard. Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: This behavior is typically resolved by clearing your browser's cache and cookies for our domain. If the loop continues, please try accessing the site through an incognito window. We also recommend verifying your Google SSO settings within the Admin Console to ensure everything is synced correctly.

subject: User cannot log in after role change
body: We changed a user role to guest and now they get insufficient permissions when logging in. We need this fixed immediately.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: New member invites not being sent
body: We are trying to add people to our workspace but they dont get the invite email. It just stays in the pending status on the list. Is there a way to fix this quickly as we have new hires starting? We keep getting EMAIL-005 errors too.
resolution: Please check your company's spam or junk folders to see if the invitations were filtered out. You should also ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are correctly configured to authorize our sending domains. If the problem continues, please send us the specific email addresses affected so we can look into them for you.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop error
body: Users are reporting a persistent redirect loop when authenticating with Google SSO on the desktop app. We are receiving the AUTH-SSO-302.1 error code during the handshake process. Is there a known fix for this configuration issue?
resolution: Please advise your users to clear their browser cache and cookies specifically for 'cloudesk.com' to resolve the loop. If the issue remains, testing in an incognito window often helps isolate the problem, and you should also double-check your Google SSO settings within the Admin Console.

subject: User login failure after role change to guest
body: Hello, we recently changed a team member's role from Member to Guest in our Pro account. Now they report being unable to log in to the web application with an Insufficient Permissions error. Please advise on how to resolve this.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Need direct Microsoft Teams integration
body: We need a direct integration with Microsoft Teams to share files efficiently. It is currently blocking our team's workflow and we need a solution immediately. Please provide instructions on how to set this up.
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper direct integration is not yet available. Please vote for this feature or submit your specific requirements at our official roadmap portal. We prioritize new integrations based on the volume of customer feedback.

subject: Role name already exists error
body: Trying to create a custom role and getting CD-AM-012. Name is completely unique.
resolution: Role names are case-insensitive and leading/trailing spaces are trimmed. There might be an existing role with a similar name or one that differs only by capitalization. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Roles' thoroughly for any roles that might conflict.

subject: Slow API response times
body: We are seeing slow response times on GET /files and POST /upload calls. API_RESPONSE_SLOW is popping up in our logs, and it is causing major delays for our app. Please investigate.
resolution: To help us investigate, please provide specific examples of the slow API calls including timestamps and request bodies. In the meantime, ensure you are using pagination and filtering to reduce the payload size. We are also happy to assist with optimizing your data caching strategy.

subject: Inquiring about custom SSO login page branding
body: We have been enjoying the platform, but would love to customize our SSO login page with our corporate logo and brand colors to keep the experience consistent. Is this something currently supported in the admin console? Thank you for your help.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available. We recognize this as a valuable feature for many enterprises. Please add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding, and we will notify you of any updates.

subject: Audit log filter not working
body: I try to filter the audit logs but it is taking too long. Often it just timeout and nothing happens. I have been trying to look at history for the last three months but it does not load at all. I see the code AUDIT_LOG_FILTER_TIMEOUT very often.
resolution: Please try narrowing your search by selecting a smaller date range to improve performance. For specific user queries, the 'User Activity' report is much more efficient than the general logs.

subject: API 401 Unauthorized errors
body: We are getting API-AUTH-401 errors constantly and our service is down. We have a product demo at 5pm today and we need this fixed asap. Everything was working fine before. Help.
resolution: It looks like your current integration token may have become invalid due to recent updates. Please regenerate your API token via the API and Integrations section in the Admin Console. Once you update your code with the new token in the Authorization header, your connectivity will be restored.

subject: Slow workspace loading
body: Our main workspace with over 10,000 files is failing to load properly. We are frequently seeing a white screen and a workspace_load_timeout error. This has become quite tedious for our team to navigate. Do you have any suggestions on how to improve this?
resolution: Workspaces with such a high volume of items can struggle to render all at once. We recommend using the search and filter tools to narrow down your view, or splitting the content into smaller, more manageable workspaces. Please also check your browser console to see if any network errors are triggered during the load.

subject: Serious lag while editing documents
body: We are seeing significant lag when multiple people are in the same doc. Changes are taking seconds to appear and cursors are jumping around. It is making it hard to work together. COLLAB_LAG is being reported by our users.
resolution: To improve performance, please ensure all collaborators have a stable internet connection and try closing unnecessary browser tabs. If the lag persists with a large group, I recommend testing with fewer concurrent editors to isolate the network bottleneck. Clearing your browser cache may also help with sync latency.

subject: GET files content returning 500 errors
body: Our integration is failing because calls to GET /files/{id}/content are intermittently throwing HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, specifically for geographically diverse files. Other endpoints work fine. We have a major client demo at 5pm today so this is critical. We see error API-500 constantly.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Data retention policy not deleting trashed files
body: Our 30-day retention policy is configured, but deleted files remain visible in the Trash Bin indefinitely. Please fix RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED.
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: Mobile app document preview issues
body: I am experiencing slow load times and the MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL error when trying to look at documents in the mobile app. It is not a major issue as I can view them on my laptop, but I wanted to report it. Let me know if you need any device details.
resolution: Please ensure your mobile app is fully updated to the latest version. You might also try clearing the app cache in your device settings or checking your network connection. For larger files, we recommend downloading the document directly to your device to ensure a smooth viewing experience.

subject: Google SSO login redirect loop
body: Hello, our team members attempting to log in with Google SSO are currently stuck in a redirect loop after authenticating, failing to reach the CloudDesk dashboard. Many users on our Pro plan are experiencing this blockage at the moment. We see error code AUTH-SSO-302.1 on the browser network tab. Please let us know how to resolve this.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Seat limit error when adding teammates on Pro
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. While trying to add a couple of new office staff members to our Pro workspace today, I received a persistent message stating that our seat limit has been reached. However, when I check our subscription details, it clearly shows we still have three open seats available. Could you please look into why this discrepancy is happening? We are in no particular rush, so please take your time, and thank you so much for your kind assistance.
resolution: Hello! Thank you for reaching out to us. To resolve this error CD-AM-001, please verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Please note that pending invitations count towards your seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Desktop client automatically uploading files without my permission
body: Hi there, I noticed the desktop sync client started moving things from my Documents folder into CloudDesk. I never selected this folder for syncing and I am concerned about my privacy. It is showing error code SYNC_CLIENT_UNAUTHORIZED_UPLOAD. Could you please help me get this turned off soon? Thanks for your help.
resolution: The desktop sync client only syncs folders explicitly configured by you or your IT department. Please open your sync client settings, select 'Synced Folders,' and verify that this folder wasn't accidentally added. You should also ensure that 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is disabled if you prefer manual control.

subject: API calls returning 404 not found error
body: Our integration is currently failing because API calls to our resource endpoints are returning a 404 Not Found error with code API-NOTFOUND-404, even though all resource IDs are verified as correct. This is completely blocking our automated data sync right before our mandatory system audit on Friday. We urgently need a resolution for this today.
resolution: Please verify your API endpoint path and HTTP method against the latest CloudDesk API documentation. Ensure that the resource ID, such as the folder ID, is valid and properly accessible to the specific permissions assigned to your API token.

subject: request to downgrade pro subscription plan
body: We would like to request a plan downgrade for our company. Our team size has decreased significantly, and we no longer require the full Pro tier feature set. Please advise on the steps to adjust our billing plan to a lower tier.
resolution: You can manage your subscription by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Please select your desired tier to initiate the downgrade. Note that this change will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle, and we are unable to provide prorated refunds for the remaining time.

subject: Need to update PO number for invoices
body: We need to update the purchase order number that appears on our future invoices for internal accounting purposes. We keep getting an error code BILL-PO-008 when we try to change it ourselves. Could you assist us in getting this updated for our upcoming billing cycle?
resolution: You can update your PO number by navigating to Admin Console, Billing, Billing Information and editing the Purchase Order Number field. Please note that these changes will apply to all future invoices, but cannot be applied retroactively to bills already generated.

subject: Okta SSO broken invalid token format error
body: Since the v42 update, all our users attempting to log in via Okta SSO are blocked with an Invalid SSO token format message. This is a critical issue affecting our entire company access. We need this resolved immediately.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This step is required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in the v42 update.

subject: Audit log missing suspicious foreign login attempts!
body: I need to review recent logins from unfamiliar countries for a security audit, but AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN is hiding everything except successful standard logins. This is completely unacceptable and blocking our compliance review. Fix this immediately!
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses or locations are actually recorded in the Security Events log rather than Login Activity. You can find this information by navigating to Admin Console, then Security and Compliance, and finally Security Events. We also recommend enabling Login Anomaly Detection for automatic alerts.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: I am working on an integration and noticed that our latest invoice reflects a user count that does not match our current active users. I suspect this might be related to error code BILL-INV-001. Could you please help me understand how this is calculated? I appreciate your assistance.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: User login failure due to insufficient permissions
body: A team member was recently changed to a Guest role and is now unable to log in to the web application. They are seeing an error message stating Insufficient Permissions, error CD-AM-002. Please resolve this immediately.
resolution: Guest users can only access workspaces they have been explicitly invited to. Please check the Admin Console under Team Management to verify the user's role and their active invitations. If they require full access, you will need to update their role back to Member.

subject: Mobile previews are totally broken right now
body: I cannot view any PDF or DOCX files on my phone app because it throws error MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL every single time! This is extremely annoying and frankly ridiculous given what we pay for enterprise. No rush since I can use my laptop later, but fix it eventually.
resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version. Check the user's device storage and network connection. Advise clearing the mobile app's cache (via device settings). For very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: Users being forced to re-authenticate constantly
body: Since the v4.2 upgrade, our users are constantly being logged out and forced to re-authenticate via SSO. The error SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 is popping up all day and it is making our team very angry. We need this fixed now!
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how we handle SSO token refreshes. Please check your IdP application settings for CloudDesk and ensure a 'Refresh Token' policy is enabled with a duration of at least 8-24 hours. This configuration change will stop the premature session expiration you are currently experiencing.

subject: SSO login timeout since v4.2 update
body: Everyone is experiencing huge delays with SSO login, often timing out with SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2. We have a major deadline on Friday and this is killing our productivity. Please address this now.
resolution: The delays are caused by the v4.2 SSO token format shift. Please have your admin re-save the SSO configuration in the Admin Console to refresh your certificates. Additionally, clearing browser cache and cookies for your users should resolve the lingering timeout issues.

subject: Google SSO login failing with redirect loop
body: We are getting constant redirect loops when trying to sign in with Google. Our whole team is locked out and we have a major audit due this Friday. Please look into this as soon as possible, I am seeing error code AUTH-SSO-302.1 repeatedly.
resolution: This behavior is often resolved by clearing your browser cache and cookies for cloudesk.com. If the issue persists, please try accessing the dashboard in an incognito window or using a different browser. Our team has verified that the Google SSO configuration remains stable on our end.

subject: Need PDF invoice, only CSV available
body: I need to download our recent invoice as a PDF, but the Admin Console only offers a CSV export. This is causing an issue with our records. Please fix this.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is currently unavailable for certain older invoices due to a recent system migration. Please provide the invoice ID you are looking for, and we will be happy to manually generate the PDF and email it to you.

subject: Blank User Activity report
body: I tried to check the User Activity report in the admin console and the page just stays completely blank. Other reports load fine, but this one is empty with error REPORT-001. This is extremely annoying when I am trying to finish my tasks. I don't need it fixed right this second, but it is very frustrating.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again, or try using a different browser if the problem persists.

subject: 403 error on data export endpoint
body: Hello CloudDesk Team, We hope you are having a great week. We noticed today that using an API key with the Admin scope on the /v1/users/{userId}/data/export endpoint is returning a 403 Permission Denied error code API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED. This was working fine previously. We have an important company audit on Friday so we would love to get this sorted out soon. Thank you for your continued support!
resolution: Hello. Please note that effective recently, the Admin API scope no longer includes Data Export permissions, and a new Data Steward API role is required for this endpoint. You can generate a new API key with the Data Steward role in Admin Console > API Management to resolve this error before your audit.

subject: Webhook delivery failure errors
body: Why are our webhooks suddenly throwing errors all over the place? We are seeing delivery failed connection refused messages in the logs and it is driving me crazy. Nothing on our end has changed and this really needs to start working properly soon.
resolution: Verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range (refer to documentation for current IPs).

subject: Mobile app giving network error on stable connection
body: Hello support. We are unable to log into the mobile app on our devices, receiving a generic network error even with a stable internet connection. We are on the free plan and tested across multiple cellular and wifi networks. Please let us know when this can be looked at.
resolution: Hello. Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache or reinstalling, and verify server status on our status page.

subject: Request for extending public sharing link expiration limits
body: We need the ability to create public sharing links that either never expire or have significantly longer expiration limits. The current maximum duration is too restrictive for our current workflows.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Intermittent HTTP 500 errors on GET /files/{id}/content
body: We are experiencing intermittent HTTP 500 errors when fetching file content through your API. This is happening across different regions and is blocking our integration pipeline. Could you please investigate the cause? I would appreciate a prompt response as this is currently stalling our development.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are currently investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a permanent fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: Hello, when trying to view the User Activity report inside the admin console today, the page loads with no data and remains completely blank. Other reporting sections are working normally. No rush on this since we can wait.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If still blank, please provide the exact date range you are trying to view.

subject: Cannot remove workspace user error code CD-AM-014
body: I am trying to remove someone from our team workspace and it keeps giving me an error message saying they are the owner. This makes no sense because I am also an admin. Please let me know how to fix this so I can clean up our list.
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace. The ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign.

subject: Critical Login Failure with Okta SSO
body: Since the v4.2 update, our entire team is blocked from logging in with an 'Invalid Token Format' error, code AUTH-402. We have a major investor demo at 5pm today and this is a total disaster. Why did the platform break during an update? We need an urgent fix to regain access immediately.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console. They need to ensure the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values found in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide in your Admin Console.

subject: Workspace loading times are completely unacceptable!
body: I cannot believe how slow the web app has become lately when I try to open our main directory. Every time I click into a workspace with many files, the page takes an excessive amount of time to load, often displaying a blank screen or a spinner for over 30 seconds. I am seeing error code WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT every single time! This is extremely frustrating for our administration team and needs to be looked into.
resolution: We apologize for the frustration caused by the slow loading times in large workspaces. Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace and advise your team to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. We also suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones, and verifying the browser console for any network errors.

subject: External share audit logs lack specific user identity
body: Hello, our company users share documents externally with clients quite often, but our audit logs do not show which specific external user actually accessed or downloaded the files. It only displays the internal team member who created the share link, which is completely unhelpful for our security audits. Please fix this flaw so we can track external access properly.
resolution: Hello. By default, external share links are anonymous. To track external user activity, the share link must be configured with 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login'. This setting ensures the external user's identity is captured in the audit logs, though this cannot be retroactively applied to existing anonymous links.

subject: MISSING SEARCH RESULTS FOR KNOWN DOCUMENTS
body: When I use the keyword search feature in the web app to find specific files and folders on our Enterprise account, the results are incomplete and missing important documents that definitely exist and that I have full permission to view. It is not a major emergency since we know where the files are stored, but it would be great to get it working properly whenever you get a chance.
resolution: This behavior can sometimes be caused by an outdated search index for your account. Please try performing a more specific search using exact phrases enclosed in quotes. If the issue persists, logging out and back in can trigger a re-indexing process for your account.

subject: Incorrect user names in activity log
body: I noticed the workspace activity log is showing wrong users for file edits. Its attributing actions to admins when our regular staff made the changes. This is causing confusion for our project tracking and we are seeing AUDIT-004 errors in the logs. Could you check why this is happening?
resolution: This is a known display glitch that occurs when contributors and administrators are active in the same workspace simultaneously. Please be assured that your underlying audit data remains correct and secure. For a more accurate audit trail, we recommend cross-referencing these actions against the global audit log found in your Admin Console.

subject: Switching plan to annual
body: Hi there we want to switch our billing to annual to save some cash. I tried to do it in the console but got error BILL-PLAN-004. Can you help us with this?
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please navigate to Admin Console, then Billing, then Subscription Details, and finally Change Plan. Simply select the annual option for your current plan. The adjustment will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any remaining credit will be prorated.

subject: Need offline document editing in mobile app urgently
body: Hello Support, our field team is currently on the Free plan and they are completely blocked because they cannot edit documents offline within the mobile app while traveling. Changes fail to sync once internet is restored. Many of our team members are hitting this exact roadblock right now. Please help us resolve this promptly so our work can continue.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: Google SSO 'Domain not allowed' error
body: Users from our 'partnerdomain.com' are unable to log in via Google SSO. Other domains work fine. They are getting a 'Domain not allowed' error. Could you please look into this promptly? We use SSO-GOOGLE-403.
resolution: For users experiencing 'Domain not allowed' errors with Google SSO, please navigate to the CloudDesk Admin Console. In the 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, check the 'Allowed Domains' list and ensure that 'partnerdomain.com' is added to the list of permitted domains.

subject: Workspace activity log showing wrong user names AUDIT-004
body: This is ridiculous. In our workspace activity log, file actions like edits and moves are constantly attributed to an admin instead of the regular contractors who actually did them. We are seeing error AUDIT-004 flashing constantly. Fix this display bug ASAP.
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct. This is a known bug we are addressing. For accurate audit, cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: Seat limit error despite available space
body: I am attempting to add a new team member, but I keep getting a 'Seat limit reached' error message, specifically CD-AM-001. My subscription details clearly indicate that we have available seats remaining. This is not urgent, so please take your time, but I would like to get this cleared up when you have a moment.
resolution: Please verify your 'Pending Invitations' count within the Team Management section of the Admin Console. Pending invitations count against your total seat limit, so you may need to revoke older invites or upgrade your plan to increase capacity. Thank you for your patience while we looked into this.

subject: Desktop sync stuck on connecting
