resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. To restore your access, please go to the Admin Console, navigate to the Billing section, and settle the outstanding invoice. Service will be automatically reactivated within 15 minutes once your payment is successfully processed.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in admin console
body: Some of our users show the wrong role in the Users and Permissions section. Their actual access is fine, but the display is mixed up. Error code UI-ADMIN-003 appeared.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and the actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: User having login issues
body: A user I moved to guest role is getting an error when they try to login. They see something about insufficient permissions. Could you please help me get them back in? Thanks.
resolution: When a user is set to Guest, they lose their default workspace access and can only view files where they are explicitly invited. Please verify their role in the Admin Console and check their active workspace invitations. If they need to access general resources, you should change their role back to Member.

subject: User invitation stuck as pending
body: I sent an invitation to a new hire but they are still showing as 'Pending Invitation' in the console. They cannot log in to access the shared folders. Can you fix this?
resolution: This can happen if there is a delay in the invitation process or if the email domain isn't set for auto-join. Please ask the user to attempt logging in directly with their email and password. If that fails, please revoke the current invitation and send a fresh one from the Team Management section.

subject: Okta SSO Login Broken After v4.2 Update
body: Since the v4.2 update rolled out, none of our PRO users can log in through Okta SSO. We keep getting redirected back to the login page with the error code AUTH-402. This is completely blocking our entire finance team from accessing our accounts. Please fix this immediately as our operations are halted.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console. They need to ensure the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide, which is accessible in the admin console under Settings -> SSO & Authentication -> Okta Configuration.

subject: account locked error

resolution: You can either wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or have an administrator manually unlock your account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: audit logs timeout when filtering

resolution: Hello. We apologize for the trouble with the audit logs timing out. We advise the administrator to narrow down the filter criteria as much as possible, starting with smaller date ranges. For specific user activity, please use the 'User Activity' report in the 'Reports' section, which is optimized for single-user queries. If extensive historical data is needed, we suggest exporting the full log and filtering locally.

resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Need access to private workspace for audit

resolution: By default, private workspaces are inaccessible even to administrators for enhanced privacy. An admin can only gain temporary access by initiating a 'Workspace Access Request' through Admin Console > Users > [User Profile] > Workspaces. This action generates an audit log entry and requires the user to be notified (if active) or a compliance officer override (if inactive/terminated).

resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on an individual basis. Please provide the exact date and time the upgrade occurred, and confirm that you have not utilized any features exclusive to the new tier. Once you provide these details, we will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade

resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that no features specific to the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will then review your account for refund eligibility.

subject: Cannot add new team members

You can revoke any old pending invitations to free up space or upgrade your plan to increase your capacity.

subject: Invite emails not being received by new users

resolution: Please have your users check their spam folders to see if the invitations were filtered there. You should also ensure your organization's SPF/DKIM records are updated to include our sending domains as specified in our delivery guide. If they still do not receive them, send us the specific email addresses and we will investigate further.

subject: Mobile app keeps files cached after logout

Whenever you have a chance, please let us know how to handle this.
resolution: The mobile app caches files for offline access. To manually clear the cache, go to Settings within the CloudDesk mobile app, then Storage and select Clear Cached Files. For automatic clearing, enable the Clear cache on logout option in that same menu.

For specific user activity, use the User Activity report in the Reports section, which is optimized for single-user queries. If extensive historical data is needed, suggest exporting the full log and filtering locally.

subject: Password reset emails not being received

resolution: We understand this is frustrating. Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Also, check if your domain is configured with an approved email sender list; if so, please ensure 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' is added to your allowlist. If the issue persists, you can manually trigger a password reset for the user from the Admin Console.

subject: Cannot remove user from workspace
body: I am getting CD-AM-014 when trying to remove a staff member! I need this done before our big client demo at 5pm today! Why is the system blocking me?
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the designated owner. You must first transfer ownership to another member by navigating to Admin Console, Workspaces, selecting the workspace, and using the Transfer Ownership tool.

subject: Cannot create new custom role name
body: I am trying to add a new role for our team, but the system keeps throwing a CD-AM-012 error saying the name already exists. I have checked my list multiple times and I am positive that this name is not taken. Could you please look into why the system thinks this is a duplicate? No rush on this, just wanted to flag it.
resolution: Role names in our system are case-insensitive and leading or trailing spaces are automatically trimmed. Please double-check your role list for any existing entries that might be a match when ignoring case. You likely have a role that is already effectively identical.

subject: Increase audit log retention period
body: I NEED TO SET OUR AUDIT LOG RETENTION TO 5 YEARS. THE CURRENT SYSTEM LIMITS ME TO 12 MONTHS AND GIVES AN AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT ERROR. THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE FOR OUR COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS. PLEASE FIX THIS IMMEDIATELY.
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is currently 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution, such as Splunk or Sumo Logic, via our API or SFTP export feature. This is currently noted as a feature request for extending native retention.

subject: Seat limit reached error incorrectly appearing
body: We received error code CD-AM-001 when adding users. Subscription shows available seats. Fix this.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: deleted files still visible past retention period
body: hello we set our data retention to 30 days for trash items but files are still showing up after a month. retention policy not being enforced correctly for enterprise workspace.
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: Request for increased file version retention limits

resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding file versioning. The current limits are set to balance storage and performance, and we recommend utilizing our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com to submit your specific requirements for enhanced versioning and vote on similar requests so our product team understands the demand.

resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app under 'Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication', and it will then work for both web and mobile logins.

Confirming their access level there should resolve the PERM-WS-403.4 error.

resolution: Please test download speeds using a different browser or network to rule out local interference. For very large files, we recommend using the Desktop Sync client, which provides more robust transfer, or checking if browser extensions are slowing down the process.

The system is optimized for filtered views on large datasets, and you can navigate directly to a specific user via search if their email is known.

If the problem persists, try using a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If it's still blank, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: Azure AD SSO reply URL mismatch error
body: Hello. After configuring our credentials, users are being redirected to an Azure AD error page showing a reply URL mismatch when attempting to log in via SSO. Please provide guidance on how to fix this configuration.
resolution: In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs' (replace 'yourcompany' with your actual subdomain).

subject: Payment failed notice for subscription
body: Our automated renewal failed for our subscription. I see the 'Payment Failed' status and a BILL-PAY-002 error code. We have a major investor demo at 5pm today and need full access. Please let me know how to fix this immediately.
resolution: Please navigate to the Admin Console under Billing to update your payment method or confirm your billing address matches your bank records. Once corrected, you can manually retry the payment for the BILL-PAY-002 invoice. This will restore your access for your upcoming demo.

subject: DATA RETENTION POLICY BROKEN TRASH BIN FILES NOT DELETING
body: THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE! We set up a strict 30-day data retention policy for deleted files in our enterprise account, but files are still sitting in the Trash Bin and remain fully recoverable long after 30 days have passed. We are facing a severe compliance violation if this isn't enforced immediately. Fix this bug right now!
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: accidental plan upgrade refund request
body: Hello, our team account was accidentally upgraded to a higher tier plan and we would like to request a refund for the charge. The billing error code BILL-REF-005 was noted on our end. Please let us know what details you need to process this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account for eligibility.

subject: how do i change my subscription plan
body: Hi i need to move us down to a cheaper plan since we have fewer people now. The BILL-PLAN-011 error kept popping up when I looked around. Can you tell me how to do this.
resolution: You can change your subscription by going to the Admin Console, then navigating to Billing, and selecting Subscription Details. From there, click on 'Change Plan' to select a lower tier. Please note that the downgrade will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle, and we do not provide prorated refunds for the remaining time on your current plan.

subject: Password reset emails not arriving
body: my team members are trying to reset their passwords but they never receive the email. i have checked spam folders and nothing is there, but other system emails seem to arrive fine. i am seeing error AUTH-PR-200.1 on my end. please look into why this is happening.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Check if the user's domain is configured with an approved email sender list. If not, advise adding 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to their allowlist. Manually trigger a password reset from the Admin Console if necessary.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in admin console
body: The admin console is showing the wrong roles for several users, displaying Contributor instead of Manager. The actual permissions seem fine within the workspaces, but the UI is incorrect. We are seeing the UI-ADMIN-003 error code. Please let us know when this can be corrected.
resolution: This is a known cosmetic bug that does not impact actual system permissions. To fix the display, go to the user's profile in the admin console, change their role, save, and then change it back to the correct setting. A permanent patch for this display issue is currently in development.

subject: accidental plan upgrade refund
body: i accidentally upgraded to the pro plan and need a refund for the charge i saw error code bill-ref-005 earlier today is this possible to fix. thank you.
resolution: We handle refund requests for accidental upgrades on a case-by-case basis. Please confirm the exact date and time of the upgrade and ensure that no premium features have been utilized on the account yet. Once we have those details, we will review your request for eligibility.

subject: URGENT: Requesting YubiKey and hardware MFA support
body: Our security department is extremely frustrated that CloudDesk still does not support hardware-based MFA tokens like YubiKey. Software-only options do not meet our compliance requirements anymore, and this limitation is becoming a major blocker for our organization.
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Workspace loading timeout on large directories
body: When navigating to workspaces containing more than 10,000 items, the page consistently throws a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT and hangs on a blank screen for over 30 seconds. This is disrupting our automated integrations right now. Please investigate this widespread performance degradation.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: Security breach concern - logs incomplete
body: I am looking at our login activity logs because I suspect unauthorized access, but I cannot see any failed attempts or unusual geographic login data. This is critical as we have a security compliance deadline on Friday and need to account for all activity. Why are these logs only showing successful logins?
resolution: Failed login attempts and unusual IP locations are tracked in the 'Security Events' log rather than the standard 'Login Activity' tab. Please check Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events for this information and consider enabling 'Login Anomaly Detection' for future alerts.

subject: Google SSO login redirect loop is keeping users out
body: Hello, our employees are having a terrible time trying to log into the web app using Google SSO this morning. After completing the Google authentication steps, the browser just gets stuck in an endless redirect loop and never reaches the main dashboard. Some users mentioned seeing error code AUTH-SSO-302.1 briefly flash on the screen. Please help us get this straightened out so everyone can get back to work.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Invoice user count mismatch before audit
body: Hi team, our latest invoice reflects a user count that doesnt match our active users in cloudesk. We are seeing bill-inv-001 errors and need this corrected before our financial audit on Friday so we arent overcharged.
resolution: Please check the Billing Date and Proration Period on your invoice prior to Friday's audit. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Cannot enable MFA on my phone
body: I have been using CloudDesk for a while now and I really love the interface, especially the new color scheme you added recently. I was trying to make my account more secure by setting up the Google Authenticator app on my phone, but after I scan the QR code it just throws a message saying Failed to register MFA device. It is a bit frustrating because I just wanted to be extra safe. How can I get this fixed so I can finish the setup?
resolution: We are aware of a registration issue occurring within the mobile app's MFA flow. To complete your setup, please navigate to 'Settings' then 'Security' within the CloudDesk web app and configure MFA there. Once registered on the web, your device will be correctly synced for use with both mobile and web logins.

subject: Incorrect tax rate on monthly invoice
body: Greetings. As an external consultant who handles various administrative setups for our firm, I was reviewing our recent statements while drinking my morning coffee, and I noticed that the tax or VAT rate applied to our invoice seems slightly off based on our registered business location and tax exemption status. Please let me know what we need to update.
resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID if applicable under 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information'. If these details are correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: cannot delete workspace
body: I am unable to delete a workspace due to error CD-AM-007. It claims active integrations are detected. Please resolve this as soon as possible.
resolution: To delete a workspace, you must first disconnect all active third-party integrations. Please go to Workspace Settings > Integrations, remove any connected services, and then attempt the deletion again.

subject: user activity report blank
body: hi there my user activity report page is totally blank when I try to open it in the admin console. I am seeing report-001 error code. we have our weekly office review meeting at 3pm today and I really need to pull those numbers before then. thanks
resolution: Hello. This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If it is still blank, please provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Seat limit reached error incorrectly appearing
body: An admin user attempting to add new team members receives an error message 'Seat limit reached' despite available seats showing clearly in subscription details. We are seeing error code CD-AM-001 when attempting this action. No immediate rush, but we would love to know why this discrepancy is occurring.
resolution: Please verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit, which triggers this code. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Okta SSO user attribute mismatch error
body: We are seeing the SSO-OKTA-403 error when trying to log in via Okta. The system is throwing a mismatch error after the redirection, preventing our team from accessing their accounts. We would appreciate it if you could help us resolve this configuration issue when you have a chance.
resolution: This indicates that the user attributes provided by your identity provider are not being mapped correctly to our system. Please check your Okta application settings to verify that 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' are mapped to the correct CloudDesk profile fields. Ensure that the 'email' field is configured as the unique identifier.

subject: Incorrect tax rate on our invoice
body: The tax rate on our recent invoice seems wrong. The system applied the wrong amount for our region. Here is error code BILL-TAX-006. Let me know what you need to fix this.
resolution: Please verify that your registered billing address and tax ID are current in the Billing Information section of your Admin Console. If those details are accurate, please send us your full legal name and tax exemption certificate for a manual audit of your account's tax settings.

subject: API calls failing with 401 Unauthorized
body: Hello support, thank you for your help in advance. Our automated integration is suddenly receiving API-AUTH-401.4 errors on valid API keys. This is blocking our deployment pipeline and we have a major release scheduled for tomorrow morning. Prompt assistance would be greatly appreciated.
resolution: Please verify the API key's status in the Admin Console under the 'API Keys' section to check if it has expired or been revoked. We advise generating a new API key if necessary and updating your application configuration immediately.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: Our account was accidentally upgraded to a paid tier and we would like to request a refund for the prorated amount as soon as possible. Error code BILL-REF-005 was shown during the transition. Thank you for your assistance with this matter.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your eligibility.

subject: SSO provisioning not working for new users
body: New users are not being automatically created when they log in via SSO. We have JIT provisioning enabled but it is failing with error CD-AM-009. We need this resolved promptly.
resolution: Please verify that your Identity Provider is correctly passing the required user attributes like email and name in the SAML assertion. You should also ensure that you have available seats remaining in your subscription plan. Please check the SSO settings in your Admin Console to confirm your current configuration.

subject: High CPU usage on desktop app
body: Hello, I noticed the CloudDesk sync client is consistently using over 50% CPU even when idle. This is causing significant slowdowns for our staff, and we have a major presentation demo at 5pm today. Could you please help us optimize this?
resolution: The client may be stuck in a re-indexing loop. Please pause the syncing, then go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database' before resuming the sync to clear the issue.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: We accidentally upgraded our subscription tier and would like a refund for this change. Please process this as soon as possible. We have not used any of the new features.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are assessed on an individual basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade so we can verify that no features were utilized and review your account for eligibility.

subject: Missing branding options on sso page
body: i am trying to customize the login page with our company logo and colors but i dont see any options for this in the admin console. honestly this is pretty annoying for a pro account. when can we expect this to be added.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available. We recognize this as a valuable feature for many enterprises. Please add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding. We will notify you of any updates.

subject: Incorrect user in activity log
body: The activity log is attributing file edits to administrators instead of the actual users. I am seeing AUDIT-004 in the system. Please fix this.
resolution: This is a known display glitch where actions by contributors are misattributed while an administrator is active; the underlying audit trail remains accurate. We are currently working on a fix for this interface issue. For a precise history, please reference the global audit log within your Admin Console.

subject: Unrecognized charge on account
body: We noticed a charge from CloudDesk on our credit card statement that we cannot reconcile with our expected billing. It is important that we get this cleared up as it is currently holding up our monthly budget review. Could you please help us investigate this charge? We see the code BILL-CHG-010 associated with this transaction.
resolution: I would be happy to help you verify this transaction. Please provide the exact amount, the date the charge appeared, and the last 4 digits of the credit card used. Once I have those details, I will compare them against your billing history to identify the charge.

subject: Google SSO login redirect loop issue
body: Hello team, thank you for your continued support. Several users attempting to log in via Google SSO are getting trapped in a continuous redirect loop and never reach the dashboard. We would appreciate your help in looking into this when you have a moment.
resolution: Please instruct the affected users to clear their browser cache and cookies for cloudesk.com. If the issue persists, advise them to try a private browsing window or an alternate browser, and we can also review your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Desktop Sync stopped working after password change
body: I changed my account password earlier today, and now the Desktop Sync client refuses to work. It keeps telling me 'Authentication Failed' and I am seeing error code CD-AM-015. This is incredibly frustrating as I cannot sync my project files. Please help me get this resolved quickly.
resolution: After updating your password, the Desktop Sync client often requires a fresh authentication session. Please open the Sync application settings, select the option to log out or disconnect your account, and then sign back in with your new password.

subject: Extend audit log retention beyond 12 months
body: Hello, we are trying to update our compliance settings in the admin console to keep audit logs for five years instead of one, but the menu stops at twelve months. We noticed error code AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT when attempting to force a change via configuration. There is no urgency for this update, but we wanted to log the request.
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution (e.g., Splunk, Sumo Logic) via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. This is a feature request for extending native retention.

subject: user activity report is blank
body: hi, when i try to open the user activity report in the admin console it just loads a blank page with error report-001. everything else seems to work fine. please check when you have a moment.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Azure AD nested group mapping request for v4.2
body: Following our recent upgrade to v4.2, we are trying to map nested groups from Azure AD to CloudDesk workspaces for user provisioning. We need this functionality enabled promptly to unblock our setup.
resolution: Following the SSO token format change in v4.2, our current Azure AD SSO integration supports direct group mapping but not nested group resolution. We are aware of this limitation and are evaluating solutions on our roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/v4.2-enhancements/nested-azure-ad-groups. A potential workaround in the meantime involves flattening your Azure AD groups.

subject: switch to annual billing please
body: we love using the platform and would like to switch our pro subscription from monthly to annual billing. error code BILL-PLAN-004 appeared earlier when we looked at it. take your time getting back to us.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: Requesting a native Microsoft Teams integration
body: Our development team is looking to streamline our workflow by integrating CloudDesk directly into Microsoft Teams. We would like to be able to share files and collaborate on documents without leaving the Teams interface. Is this something your team has on the roadmap for the web app? I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this potential development.
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper, direct integration is not yet available. Please vote for this integration or add your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams. We are constantly evaluating new integrations based on customer demand.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Hi there, I have a Zap set up to notify us of new file uploads, but it hasn't been working lately. I'm not getting any alerts in Slack when files are added. It seems like the trigger just isn't catching the events. Can you help me look into this?
resolution: Please go into your Zapier dashboard and perform a re-test on the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh the connection. Ensure that the account integrated has the necessary permissions to view those file events. You may also want to verify the activity in your CloudDesk audit logs.

subject: SESSION EXPIRED LOOP ON WEB APP
body: Every time I log into CloudDesk today, I am immediately kicked out with error code AUTH-SESSION-401.5. I cannot even view my dashboard before it happens again. Please look into this when you get a chance.
resolution: Hello. Please clear your browser's cookies and local storage for 'cloudesk.com' to resolve this session issue. Also, check if you have strict privacy settings or browser extensions interfering with cookies, and verify the system time on your device.

subject: WE NEED GRANULAR CONTROL OVER NOTIFICATIONS
body: Hello! The current notification settings on our Pro plan are far too broad and driving our IT team crazy with unnecessary alerts. We desperately need more granular control so we can choose to only be notified for direct mentions instead of every single comment in a workspace. Please update this feature soon!
resolution: We hear your feedback regarding notification preferences. Currently, you can adjust general notification settings in your profile. For more granular control over what triggers your alerts, please outline your specific notification scenarios and preferences at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications, which helps our product team prioritize future improvements.

subject: Workspace loading forever with large files
body: Hi my workspace wont load at all when I open folders with lots of documents. It just shows a blank screen and spins for over 30 seconds before crashing. Please fix this soon its driving me crazy.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: Hello, I am reviewing our latest bill and noticed an error code BILL-INV-001. The user count listed does not match our current active headcount in the portal. Thanks for your assistance in reviewing this.
resolution: Please check the proration and billing cycle details on your invoice, as changes are often applied at the start of the next period. If the numbers still don't align, please provide your invoice ID and current user count so I can manually review this for you.

subject: activity log showing wrong users
body: hey, noticed in our workspace that file edits are attributed to admins when they were actually done by regular users. audit-004 is appearing in the logs. is this something you can fix?
resolution: We are aware of a display glitch where actions by 'Contributor' roles appear incorrectly in the activity feed when an admin is active. Please be assured the underlying audit trail remains accurate. For precise logs, you can cross-reference the activity in your main Admin Console audit log while we work on a fix for this display issue.

subject: Accidental upgrade refund request
body: Dear support, our team accidentally clicked the upgrade button on our workspace earlier today. We meant to stay on the free plan for now. Could we please request a refund for this transaction under error code BILL-REF-005? Thank you so much for your assistance.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Account locked and cannot login
body: My account is showing AUTH-LOCK-429.1 and I cant get in even with the right pass. I have a major demo at 5pm today and this is a disaster. Please unlock me so I can prep.
resolution: I understand the time pressure for your demo today. Please wait 15 minutes for the automatic lockout to expire, or ask your company administrator to manually unlock your account through the Users section of the Admin Console.

subject: PDF and PPTX previews are not loading
body: I am experiencing an issue where file previews for PDFs and PowerPoints are failing to render, showing a blank page or spinning loader indefinitely. I see the error code PREVIEW-006 when this happens. I can download the files without issue, but the preview function is currently broken for my team. Please let me know how to resolve this.
resolution: This behavior is often linked to temporary issues with our rendering service or browser caching. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies first, then test in an incognito window. If the issue persists with specific files, ensure they are not corrupted or password-protected.

subject: Workspace invites not arriving
body: I have been adding new team members to our workspace, but they are not receiving the invitation emails. The status remains pending for all of them. Is there an issue with your mail servers on your end?
resolution: Please have your users check their spam filters first to ensure our messages aren't being blocked. You should also verify that your domain's SPF and DKIM records are correctly set up for our sending addresses. If you continue to experience this, please send us the specific email addresses, and we will check our delivery logs.

subject: Missing comments in GDPR data export
body: We performed a GDPR data export for a departing user and noticed that comments made on files are missing from the package. Could you please explain how to include them?
resolution: The GDPR data export primarily covers files, folders, and direct user profile data. Comments on files and tasks are stored as activity metadata. To export comments, navigate to the specific file or task, open the 'Activity' tab, and use the 'Export Activity Log' option for that item. There is no single bulk export for all user comments across the platform.

subject: SSO login broken after update
body: We cant log in with Okta anymore because we keep getting Invalid SSO token format error. This is stopping our whole team from working right now and we need this fixed immediately. Please help us get back in asap.
resolution: We recently updated our token format in v4.2, which requires an update to your configuration. Please re-upload your IDP metadata within the CloudDesk Admin Console to restore access.

subject: users showing wrong roles in console
body: hey just noticed some users have the wrong role label in the admin console like contributor instead of manager. their access is fine though so it is not a big deal. just wanted to flag ui-admin-003 for when you have time.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and the actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: Agent cannot see assigned tickets
body: My team member cannot see tickets assigned to them in the helpdesk view. This is blocking support operations. Please fix.
resolution: This is often caused by a browser cache issue affecting permission propagation. Have the agent clear their browser cache and cookies before logging in again. If the ticket remains invisible, an admin should re-assign it to another user and then back to the original agent to refresh the visibility.

subject: Storage limit increase on free tier
body: hello we are hitting our storage limit on the free tier rather quickly since our team is growing. is there any way we can get an increase on the free storage without having to move to a paid plan right now thanks
resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time. Please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

subject: automated s3 export failing
body: my s3 bucket export is broken since the v4.2 upgrade and it keeps saying invalid credentials. i havent changed anything on the aws side. this is stopping my work and i need a fix now.
resolution: The v4.2 release implemented stricter IAM policy requirements for S3. Your current policy is likely missing the necessary 's3:GetBucketLocation' permission. Please update your AWS IAM role according to our new S3 Integration Guide to resolve the credential error.

subject: Session Expired keeping logging me out
body: Every time I log into the dashboard this morning it kicks me right back out with session expired. Error code AUTH-SESSION-401.5 is showing up sometimes too. Its getting really annoying since I need to check our files.
resolution: Please clear your browser's cookies and local storage for 'cloudesk.com'. Check if you have strict privacy settings or browser extensions that might be interfering with session cookies, and verify the system time on your device.

subject: Constant Session Expired errors on mobile
body: Every time I open the mobile app and try to check my workspace, I get an AUTH-SESSION-401.5 error. It logs me out immediately and I cannot see anything. It is quite a nuisance, can you help?
resolution: This issue is often caused by stale data stored in your app's cache. Please try clearing the cookies and local storage for CloudDesk within your browser or app settings. If the problem persists, ensure your device's system time is correctly synchronized.

subject: Extremely slow download speeds for shared files
body: Our entire department is experiencing painfully slow download speeds when trying to pull workspace files right now. The DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW error has appeared multiple times and our clients are waiting on these deliverables for a critical afternoon presentation starting in just one hour! We need this fixed immediately please.
resolution: We apologize for the severe disruption during your urgent presentation prep. Please test download speeds using a different browser or network, and check for any browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, we recommend the recipient use a download manager or share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade refund request
body: Our account was upgraded to a paid plan by mistake. I see error code BILL-REF-005. Please process a refund for this change.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership option greyed out
body: Hello support, I am attempting to transfer ownership of our corporate workspace to another colleague but the option remains greyed out with error CD-AM-004. This is quite frustrating as we need to restructure our admin team. Please let me know how to resolve this when you have a moment.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a Member or Admin of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not add them first then attempt the transfer via Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership.

subject: SSO-AZURE-400 error when trying to log in
body: Every single one of my employees is being redirected to an Azure error page! We keep seeing the SSO-AZURE-400 error and no one can reach their workspace. This is totally unacceptable. Fix this right now!
resolution: This error occurs when the configuration is mismatched. In your Azure AD application registration, please ensure the 'Reply URL' is set exactly to https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs. Replacing the placeholder with your actual subdomain should resolve the SSO-AZURE-400 error.

subject: Large file uploads timing out
body: We noticed that uploading files larger than 1GB takes a very long time and frequently stalls or results in a timeout error. Thank you for looking into this whenever you have a chance.
resolution: Advise customer to check their internet connection speed. For files over 500MB, recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads, as it supports resumable transfers. Verify if the issue persists across different browsers. If on Wi-Fi, suggest trying a wired connection.

subject: Billing API reporting inconsistent usage data
body: Since we moved to v4.2, our billing api calls are returning data that does not match what we see in the admin console. I keep seeing API-BILL-401 when I try to reconcile the reports. Could you look into why the storage usage numbers are so different now?
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as per the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, please provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for review.

subject: cant transfer workspace ownership
body: Hi there, I am trying to hand over a workspace to another colleague but the transfer option is greyed out. I keep getting an error saying Cannot transfer ownership to non-owner. I would appreciate it if you could guide me on how to fix this soon. Thanks a lot.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace, and if not, add them first. Then you can successfully attempt the transfer via Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership.

subject: SSO login loading indefinitely after update
body: Hi there, ever since the recent platform update, our team has been experiencing extremely long loading times when logging in via our identity provider. We often encounter a timeout or error code SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2. We would be very grateful for some prompt assistance with this workflow blocker.
resolution: This issue is often related to the v42 sso token format change. Advise the admin to re-save their sso configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta verify the Application Sign On URL format and clear browser cache and cookies for affected users.

subject: Missing offline editing feature in mobile app
body: My team needs to edit documents offline within the mobile app. It is currently blocking our remote productivity. Please advise on when this will be enabled.
resolution: Currently, our mobile app only supports offline viewing of starred files, not offline editing. We recognize the importance of this for mobile productivity and encourage you to submit a feature request or vote for it at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to assist in our prioritization.

subject: Permission denied error on shared enterprise workspace
body: Im trying to open a shared workspace for our department projects but keep getting a PERM-WS-403.4 error message. Im certain my enterprise account has the right access, so this is quite annoying. Please check on this when you have a moment.
resolution: An administrator needs to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check 'Members' or 'Permissions' and ensure the user is correctly assigned with appropriate access rights.

subject: Need more detailed user activity reports

For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting to help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Seat limit error
body: im getting a seat limit reached error cd-am-001 even though my dashboard says i have open spots. this seems to be happening to all my admins right now.
resolution: Please check the 'Pending Invitations' section under Team Management in your Admin Console. Often, outstanding invitations count toward your total seat limit even if they haven't been accepted yet. You can resolve this by either revoking those pending invites or upgrading your subscription plan to expand your capacity.

subject: Cannot add new team members - 'Seat limit reached' error!
body: I'm trying to add new members to our team, but the system keeps giving me an error saying 'Seat limit reached' (CD-AM-001)! Our subscription details clearly show that we have available seats. This is very frustrating as we need these new team members to start immediately.
resolution: The 'Seat limit reached' error often occurs when you have pending invitations that are counting towards your total seat limit. Please check the 'Pending Invitations' count in your 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' section. You can either revoke any old, unaccepted invitations or upgrade your plan to increase your overall seat capacity.

subject: need offline editing on mobile app

resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We completely understand the value of this feature for your productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: API GET /files/{id}/content intermittently returning 500

resolution: The intermittent 500 error for the 'GET /files/{id}/content' endpoint can be mitigated by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are actively investigating the underlying cause related to distributed storage retrieval and anticipate deploying a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or use a different browser to ensure no extensions are interfering, and let us know the specific date range if it remains blank.

resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

resolution: Please update your desktop sync client to the latest version, v4.2.1 or newer, to resolve this authentication issue. Verify that your default web browser is properly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a temporary workaround, you can log in using your standard email and password if your account doesn't strictly enforce SSO.

resolution: Please confirm that your API key has the correct scopes and permissions assigned for the specific endpoints you are targeting. An administrator can verify these settings within the Admin Console under API Keys and Manage Key Permissions. Let us know if you still encounter the error after verifying your scope configuration.

resolution: Please try testing the download speeds using a different web browser or network to rule out local interference. If you are using browser extensions, they might be throttling the connection. For significantly large files, we recommend using our Desktop Sync client for more robust transfer capabilities.

resolution: Please clear the browser cookies and local storage associated with CloudDesk. Additionally, check for any strict browser extensions or privacy settings that might be disrupting your active session.

They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide (accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration').

subject: Custom OAuth token generation returning invalid_client
body: Hello, our custom OAuth 2.0 application is failing to obtain access tokens today, returning invalid_client and client_secret_mismatch errors. We are seeing error code OAUTH-AUTH-401. Please review this when you have time.
resolution: Please verify that the 'Client ID' and 'Client Secret' used in your custom application exactly match the credentials generated in the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'API & Integrations' -> 'OAuth Clients'. Pay close attention to case sensitivity and any extra spaces.

body: Hello, we recently changed a user from a Member to a Guest role. They are now reporting that they cannot log in to the web application due to permission errors. We would appreciate it if you could advise on how to resolve this when you have a moment. Thank you.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they have been explicitly invited to. Check Admin Console > Team Management > Users to confirm the user's current role and verify their workspace invitations.

resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID (if applicable) under 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information'. If these details are correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate (if applicable) for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: Request for Microsoft Teams integration
body: We are looking into ways to better integrate our file sharing workflows with Microsoft Teams. Many of our staff are asking for a direct way to view and collaborate on files without leaving the Teams interface. Is there any plan to build a native integration for this soon?
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Teams, a deeper direct integration is not yet available. Please vote for this feature on our public roadmap page. We evaluate new integration requests based on direct customer demand.

resolution: This issue where agents cannot see assigned tickets is often related to a caching problem with their permissions. Please ask the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If the issue persists, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save the change, and then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: API key returns unauthorized error

resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: External user details missing in audit logs

resolution: By default, external share links are anonymous. To track external user activity, the share link must be configured with 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login' when created, which ensures the external user's identity is captured in the audit logs. Please note this cannot be retroactively applied to existing anonymous links.

subject: Workspace loading issues

resolution: Large file counts can indeed impact initial page load performance. I recommend using the search or filtering tools to find specific files rather than loading the entire folder view. If the workspace is very large, splitting the content into smaller folders will also significantly improve responsiveness.

subject: Mobile app failing to preview docs

resolution: Please ensure your mobile app is updated to the latest version and verify that your device has sufficient storage and a stable network connection. You may also want to try clearing the app's cache in your device settings. If you are dealing with a particularly large file, downloading it directly is the best alternative.

subject: API OAuth 2.0 connection failing

subject: Invitation emails not arriving

subject: Jira integration sync failures and permission errors

resolution: Ensure the Jira API token or user configured for the CloudDesk integration has 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance.

subject: seat limit error

resolution: The seat limit error is likely triggered by existing pending invitations that occupy space in your current subscription. Please navigate to 'Team Management' > 'Invitations' in your Admin Console to clear out any old or unnecessary pending invites. Once cleared, you should be able to provision your new users as expected.

resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Desktop Sync using high CPU and memory resources

resolution: This behavior often occurs if there are a high number of pending changes or very large files currently being processed. We recommend that you pause the sync, restart your computer, and then resume the process to clear any stuck tasks. If the resource usage remains high, you might consider disabling sync for non-essential folders or checking to ensure your antivirus software is not creating a conflict.

subject: Just-in-Time Provisioning not working for new users

resolution: This usually indicates a temporary data retrieval snag. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or try accessing the report in a different browser. If it still doesn't appear, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to view.

resolution: Due to the SSO token format changes in version 4.2, your current configuration needs to be refreshed. Please update your SSO settings in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your identity provider metadata.

resolution: After a password change, the Desktop Sync client often requires re-authentication. You should then log back in using your new password to resume syncing.
