resolution: This error is occurring because of a change in our SSO token format in v4.2. Please log into your CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your Identity Provider metadata to update the configuration.

subject: Issue transferring workspace ownership
body: I am trying to transfer ownership of one of our workspaces, but the system keeps throwing the CD-AM-004 error. It says I cannot transfer to a non-owner, which is confusing because I am an admin. Could you kindly look into this for me? Thanks.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to a user who is already a member or administrator of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is added to the workspace first. Once they are a member, you should be able to complete the transfer via Admin Console, Workspaces, and then the Settings menu.

subject: Desktop sync client stuck on indexing
body: Hi, I have noticed that the sync client on several of our machines seems to be stuck in an infinite 'Indexing' loop. It is not updating any files in our shared folders, though it does not show any specific error messages. I appreciate your help in getting this sorted out so our team can stay in sync.
resolution: Please start by restarting your Desktop Sync client to refresh the connection. If the status remains stuck, go to the Advanced settings menu and select 'Clear Cache' to remove any corrupted temporary data. Should that fail to resolve the issue, a clean reinstall of the application is recommended after securing your local files.

subject: Slow API responses on GET endpoints
body: We are experiencing significant performance degradation with specific API endpoints like GET /files and POST /upload taking well over 500ms to respond. This is delaying our automated data pipelines and impacting our workflows. We need prompt assistance to get response times back to normal.
resolution: Please provide specific API call examples including endpoints, request bodies, and timestamps so we can investigate. In the meantime, ensure you are optimizing your requests by using pagination and filtering parameters to limit dataset sizes.

subject: Need to downgrade subscription plan tier
body: Good morning. We need to downgrade our CloudDesk enterprise subscription to a lower tier because our team size has decreased recently. We are seeing error BILL-PLAN-011 when attempting this. Please assist so we can wrap this up before our internal budget review meeting tomorrow afternoon.
resolution: Hello. To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan' and select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time.

subject: Updating PO number for billing
body: Hello, I am looking to add a purchase order number to our future invoices. I noticed error BILL-PO-008 when attempting to save this. Could you please guide me on where to update this info?
resolution: You can update your PO number by going to Admin Console, Billing, then Billing Information. Locate the Purchase Order Number field to enter your details; note that this applies to future invoices only.

subject: User Activity report page is blank
body: When I go to admin console to look at report for user activity, it showing nothing. Is just blank page and I see REPORT-001 error code. I try to refresh but still same thing. Can you help?
resolution: This blank page usually points to a temporary data retrieval conflict. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, or try using a different web browser. If it still doesn't load, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to pull.

subject: Slack channel notifications missing
body: CloudDesk file share notifications are not appearing in our configured Slack channel at all. This is extremely annoying and wasting our time. No immediate rush to fix since we can check the app directly.
resolution: Check the Slack integration settings in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app has permission to post in that channel within Slack.

subject: Need Microsoft Teams integration
body: Our team uses teams for everything and it is difficult to share files back and forth. Do you guys have an integration for this yet? We need to be able to collaborate within our channels quickly. Looking forward to your reply.
resolution: While we currently allow users to share direct links to CloudDesk files within Teams, a deep integration is not yet available. Please share your specific requirements or vote for this feature at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams. We prioritize our development based on customer demand, so your input is highly valued.

subject: API 500 errors on GET files content endpoint
body: We are experiencing significant issues with the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint, which keeps returning HTTP 500 API-500 errors. This is blocking our file syncing workflows and causing delays in production. Please assist as this is affecting multiple parts of our application.
resolution: This intermittent server error is often related to data retrieval across distributed storage regions. We recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client while we work on a permanent fix. We are currently investigating the root cause and will deploy a hotfix soon.

subject: Extremely slow download speeds for shared links
body: Why are our shared downloads so incredibly slow today?! Every time clients try to download from our pro workspace, the speed crawls to a halt with DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW. This is ridiculous and needs to be fixed soon.
resolution: Test download speeds using a different browser or network. Advise checking browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager if available or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Verify server region for the workspace.

subject: Azure AD SSO login failing
body: Users are unable to log in via Azure AD SSO and receiving error AUTH-SSO-403.2. This is critical as we have a payroll run tomorrow morning and our team cannot access the system. Please help immediately.
resolution: Your Azure AD administrator needs to verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped in your enterprise application settings. You can find detailed instructions in our Azure AD SSO configuration guide linked on our support portal.

subject: Mobile app freezing on large workspaces
body: When I try to open a workspace with many files in the mobile app, it just shows a blank screen forever. It seems to hit a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT eventually. It is very difficult to access our files on the go.
resolution: Please check the file counts in the affected workspace, as they may be exceeding our optimal load limit. We suggest using the search or filter options to narrow down your view, or breaking large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Please also check your console for any network errors that might be occurring.

subject: new user login error
body: new user trying to log in but getting AUTH-NF-404.1 error. seems like a lot of people are having issues getting into the app right now. can you fix this?
resolution: Please check the Admin Console to verify the user's email address and ensure the invitation was sent and accepted. If the invitation hasn't been accepted yet, please resend it. Additionally, confirm that the user is attempting to log in via the correct instance URL for your company.

subject: API workspace sharing failing with API-403
body: We are getting API-403 errors when using the API to add users to workspaces. This is blocking our deployment and we have a major client demo at 5pm today. We are a large enterprise account and this is severely impacting our onboarding workflow. Please assist immediately.
resolution: Please ensure the API key you are using has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope explicitly enabled. Additionally, the user associated with that key must be a direct member of the workspace you are trying to share, rather than a member via a group. If these settings are correct and the issue persists, please provide the specific API key ID and workspace ID for further review.

subject: Cannot add team members due to seat limit error
body: I am trying to add new staff to our team but I keep getting a CD-AM-001 error saying the seat limit is reached. Our subscription details clearly show we have plenty of open seats. This is very frustrating as we need to onboard these people today.
resolution: The seat limit error is likely caused by pending invitations that have not been accepted yet, as these count toward your total. Please check the Invitations section in your Admin Console to revoke any old, unused invites. Once you clear those out, you will be able to add your new team members.

subject: Looking for older invoices past 12 months
body: Hello, thank you for all the help you provide. I am currently trying to view and download some invoices older than 12 months in the invoices section of the admin console for our free account, but I cannot locate them. There is no urgency to this request at all, but I would appreciate it if you could assist whenever you have a free moment.
resolution: the admin console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months. for older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or id you are looking for, and we will gladly retrieve it for you from our archives.

subject: billing api data inconsistent
body: ive noticed the usage reports from the api are not matching the dashboard since the update. seeing api-bill-401 errors for some calls. seems like the data aggregation is off.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated. Please ensure you are using the correct date range and parameters as per our updated documentation. If discrepancies persist, send over the exact API query and a screenshot of the dashboard report for further review.

subject: Issues with file preview rendering
body: We are experiencing PREVIEW-006 errors when trying to preview PDFs in the web app, with many files showing only a blank screen or a loading spinner. We need this resolved before our client audit this Friday, as it is currently hindering our workflow. Downloading works fine, but we need the viewer to function properly. Thanks.
resolution: This behavior often stems from temporary rendering service issues or browser-specific caching. Please start by clearing your browser's cache and cookies, or test the preview in an incognito window to rule out extension conflicts. Additionally, ensure the files you are trying to view are not password-protected.

subject: Missing file access events in audit logs
body: Hello! I am trying to track down some file view and share events for a team member, but the audit search results aren't showing everything I expect. I keep seeing AUDIT_LOG_MISSING_ACCESS_EVENT when I run these queries. Could you please help me understand why these entries are missing? Thank you for your time.
resolution: To find these entries, ensure you are filtering by the specific user email and the 'File Access' and 'File Share' event types. Please note that internal workspace views are not captured in the audit log; you will need to check the individual file's activity feed for those specific actions. We have confirmed this is a common observation currently and these steps should resolve your search.

subject: Private workspace access blocked for audit
body: I cannot access a user workspace for a compliance audit because the system returns PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED. We are on the PRO plan. Please help me fix this immediately.
resolution: By default, private workspaces are inaccessible even to administrators for enhanced privacy. An admin can only gain temporary access by initiating a 'Workspace Access Request' through Admin Console > Users > [User Profile] > Workspaces. This action generates an audit log entry and requires the user to be notified (if active) or a compliance officer override (if inactive/terminated).

subject: Files not syncing after update!
body: SINCE UPDATING TO V4.2 NOTHING IS SYNCING. My desktop client is completely empty even though all my files are in the web app. I keep seeing SYNC-001 pop up and I am losing my mind. FIX THIS NOW.
resolution: Please uninstall the current v4.2 desktop sync client and clear the local cache folder from your system files. Once the old data is cleared, download and install the latest client directly from the Settings menu in the web app. This should restore connectivity and properly sync your files.

subject: api key generation greyed out
body: Hi support, our newly promoted admin is trying to generate a new API key under Admin Console > Security > API Access but the option is completely greyed out. We are seeing error CD-AM-013. No rush on this, whenever you get a chance to check it out would be great.
resolution: API Key generation requires the 'Super Admin' role. While your user may be an 'Admin', they might not have 'Super Admin' privileges. Please confirm their role in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' and elevate their role if necessary.

subject: Deleted user still appearing in share dialogs
body: I deleted a user account but they still show up in the sharing lists. Is this normal? It is slightly annoying to see them there. Thanks for your help.
resolution: When a user is deleted, their access is removed instantly, but their name may persist as a temporary entry in historical share lists. The system typically purges these names within 24 to 48 hours. Alternatively, a workspace owner can manually remove the entry via the Workspace Settings.

subject: Okta SSO users getting invalid token format error
body: Hi there, right after the v4.2 update, our users trying to log in through Okta SSO are getting thrown back to the login page with an AUTH-402 error. Email and password logins are completely fine. We need this fixed urgently as it impacts all company users.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console by ensuring the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: API tokens returning 401 legacy token format error
body: Hi team, since upgrading to v4.2 our existing API integrations are failing with API-AUTH-401-V42 legacy_token_format errors. We have a major client demo at 5pm today and all our automated deployment scripts are broken. We urgently need a resolution to get our tokens working right now.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Search spinner runs forever in specific workspace
body: Hi Support, when searching for files or folders within a particular workspace, the search results take an extremely long time to appear or the search spinner runs indefinitely. This happens only in specific workspaces, not globally across our account. We noticed the error code WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG during these attempts. Could you please look into this?
resolution: This usually happens if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested folder structures. We advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches to narrow down results. Please report the specific workspace ID to our engineering team for an indexing review if it continues.

subject: api tokens broken after update
body: everything is broken since v4.2. my api tokens are returning 401 unauthorized with legacy_token_format. my users are complaining and this is a disaster, please fix now.
resolution: With the release of v4.2, we updated our API token format. You will need to regenerate your tokens within the API & Integrations section of the Admin Console. Please update your applications to utilize these new tokens to restore your integration's functionality.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: I noticed that our latest invoice lists more active users than we actually have on our subscription. I am seeing a BILL-INV-001 error when trying to reconcile the numbers. Could you please clarify why this billing discrepancy occurred?
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: UNAUTHORIZED UPGRADE - REFUND NEEDED NOW
body: I just saw a charge on our credit card for an upgrade we did NOT authorize! This is completely unacceptable. We are still on the free plan and I keep seeing BILL-REF-005 when I look at the console. Fix this immediately!
resolution: I understand your frustration regarding the unexpected charge. We handle refund requests on a case-by-case basis, so please confirm that no premium features have been used since the upgrade occurred. Once you provide the date of the transaction, we will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Guest role login failure
body: After changing a user to guest they cannot log in. They are seeing an insufficient permissions error, specifically CD-AM-002. I need this resolved before our audit on Friday as we are currently blocked.
resolution: Guest users are restricted to shared workspaces they are specifically invited to. Please verify their workspace access in the Admin Console or upgrade their role back to Member. This should restore their standard login access immediately.

subject: Okta SSO login broken after update
body: Users cannot log in via Okta SSO and get an Invalid Token Format error since the v4.2 update. Email logins work fine. We need this fixed immediately.
resolution: Hello. This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide, accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration'.

subject: MOBILE APP WONT LOAD AT ALL
body: I keep getting a generic Network Error on the mobile app even though my internet is totally fine! This has been happening all morning and it is driving me nuts. It is not super urgent since I am at my desk anyway, but it would be nice if it worked eventually. Please fix this bug!
resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache or data on Android, or reinstalling the app on iOS or Android. You can also verify current server status on our status page.

subject: Lag during simultaneous document editing
body: When several developers are editing a CloudDesk Office document together, we experience a noticeable lag of a few seconds before changes show up. The collaborative cursor positions are also updating quite slowly. Error code is COLLAB_LAG. Thanks for looking into this.
resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved in the session and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs or background applications and clearing the browser cache. Let us know if the issue persists when fewer users are editing simultaneously.

subject: INCORRECT ROLES DISPLAYED IN ADMIN CONSOLE
body: Hi there! I was just checking the Users and Permissions section on our free plan today, and I noticed that some of my users are showing up as Contributor instead of Manager. Their actual workspace permissions seem to be totally fine, but the display is completely wrong. This UI-ADMIN-003 glitch isn't urgent at all since nobody's actual access is broken, but it would be nice if it gets fixed eventually.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and rest assured the actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, please navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix for this display issue will be released in our upcoming patch.

subject: need to downgrade plan please
body: i am trying to change our subscription tier because we have fewer people now. every time i go to settings i keep seeing BILL-PLAN-011 and it wont let me do it. can you help fix this when you have a moment.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Zapier trigger for file upload not firing
body: Hello, I am trying to connect CloudDesk with Zapier, but the trigger for new file uploads is not working. I keep getting a ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 error when testing the step. Could you please help me understand why this is happening?
resolution: To resolve this, please go into your Zapier account and re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh the connection. Make sure the account you have linked has the necessary permissions to access these events. You can also verify the event is being captured by checking the audit logs in your CloudDesk dashboard.

subject: new user getting user not found error
body: hi there thank you for your support a new person on our team tried logging in with their email and password but got auth-nf-404.1 error code can you please check this out
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Support for YubiKey and hardware MFA tokens
body: Dear CloudDesk support team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. Our executive team on the PRO plan was wondering if there are any plans to support physical hardware-based multi-factor authentication tokens like YubiKeys alongside the current authenticator app options. Thank you very much for your time and assistance with this inquiry.
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Webhook delivery failing for our system
body: Good morning. Our external billing service is not receiving any webhooks from CloudDesk, and the logs show connection refused errors. We have our monthly audit on Friday, so this is critical and blocking our compliance checks. Please assist promptly.
resolution: Hello. Please verify your webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console under Webhooks settings. Confirm that your external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range as listed in our documentation.

subject: Request for new file upload webhook in API
body: Hello, we are currently trying to integrate CloudDesk with our internal systems and need a webhook event that triggers upon a new file upload to a specified workspace. Many developers are running into this exact limitation right now while building custom workflows. This is blocking our development pipeline and we need a prompt answer.
resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including desired payload, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements. This helps us assess demand and design.

subject: Cannot add new seats to enterprise account
body: I am trying to add several new team members to our enterprise workspace today, but the system keeps throwing the CD-AM-001 error stating our seat limit is reached. However, our subscription details clearly show we have plenty of open seats available. This is extremely frustrating as we need to onboard staff immediately. Please resolve this as soon as possible.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Custom OAuth client secret mismatch
body: Custom OAuth 2.0 applications are failing to obtain access tokens today, returning invalid_client errors. This is blocking our integration development work and we need prompt assistance to resolve the issue.
resolution: Verify that the 'Client ID' and 'Client Secret' used in your custom application exactly match the credentials generated in the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'API & Integrations' -> 'OAuth Clients'. Pay close attention to case sensitivity and any extra spaces.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card
body: I see a charge from CloudDesk on my statement that I don't recognize. This is very frustrating as we cannot reconcile our billing with this unexpected amount. Why are we getting hit with this?
resolution: To investigate this charge, please send us the exact amount, the date of the transaction, and the last four digits of the card used. We will compare this with your billing history to identify the source of the charge. We are here to help resolve any confusion.

subject: CRITICAL SECURITY BREACH API KEY BYPASS
body: My integration just showed me that a read-only api key is deleting users!!! This is insane and completely insecure. I keep getting API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS errors or it just executes anyway. You need to fix this right now because we are losing data.
resolution: Please immediately revoke that compromised API key through your Admin Console under API Management. We are investigating a potential scope misconfiguration and have escalated this to our security team. If you continue to see unauthorized actions after generating a new key, please let us know so we can investigate further.

subject: Intermittent errors when accessing file content via API
body: Hello, thank you for all your help. We are seeing an API-500 error when trying to fetch file contents. It seems to happen randomly. We would really appreciate your assistance in getting this resolved.
resolution: We are currently working on a fix for this storage retrieval issue. In the meantime, please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your application. This should smooth out the intermittent failures.

subject: Desktop sync creating duplicate files
body: I am very frustrated because the sync client keeps flagging files as conflicts when I have not edited them. These SYNC-003 errors are creating dozens of duplicates every day. Please help me resolve this issue as it is making it impossible to manage our documents.
resolution: These conflicts are typically caused by network instability or interference from local security software. Please try disabling your firewall or antivirus temporarily to see if the syncing stabilizes. If that resolves the issue, please add CloudDesk to your security software's whitelist.

subject: Too many notifications!
body: I am being spammed by every single comment update in my workspaces! I need granular control so I only get notified for mentions. This system is currently unusable for my daily workflow.
resolution: We understand your frustration with the current notification volume. Please submit your specific preferences at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications so our team can prioritize these granular controls.

subject: More detailed user activity reports
body: Hi there. I was wondering if it's possible to get more detailed reports on user activity, like downloads and views, beyond standard audit logs. No rush on this since we are on the free plan and can wait. Thanks.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Error creating custom role
body: Trying to add a new role but keep getting a CD-AM-012 error saying the name exists when it doesnt. I have double checked my list and it is unique. Please let me know if there is a glitch in the system.
resolution: Role names are case-insensitive and leading/trailing spaces are trimmed. There might be an existing role with a similar name or one that differs only by capitalization. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Roles' thoroughly for any roles that might conflict.

subject: high cpu from cloudesk sync app
body: hi there, the cloudesk sync process is using over 50 percent cpu constantly even when idle. thanks for looking into this when you can.
resolution: Check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed. Advise user to pause sync, restart their computer, then resume sync. If persistent, suggest disabling sync for non-critical folders or temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks. Check for conflicting antivirus software.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade refund request
body: We upgraded our Pro plan by mistake today. We need a refund for the prorated difference right away. Error code BILL-REF-005 was shown.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Need offline document editing support on mobile
body: Our team is extremely frustrated that users cannot edit documents offline within the mobile app and sync changes later. This is currently blocking our field agents from working productively without an internet connection. Please provide a solution immediately.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: Critical API 503 errors during peak hours
body: We are experiencing severe disruptions with multiple API endpoints returning HTTP 503 errors. This is heavily impacting our production scripts and user integrations during peak hours. We encountered API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 and need an immediate solution.
resolution: Investigate the customer's API usage patterns to identify if they are exceeding rate limits (check 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header). Advise implementing exponential backoff for retries. Confirm if there are any ongoing platform incidents via the CloudDesk status page. Escalate to engineering if rate limits are not being hit.

subject: api export permission denied error urgent payroll run
body: hi team we are getting a 403 permission denied error when using an admin api key to call the export endpoint. we have our payroll run tomorrow morning and this is completely blocking us. please help us fix api_403_permission_denied as soon as possible, thanks so much!
resolution: Effective June 1st, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Please generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in Admin Console > API Management to proceed with your payroll export.

subject: Okta SSO Login Error After Update
body: Hello, our users utilizing Okta SSO are currently unable to log in to the web app, receiving an 'Invalid SSO token format' error with code AUTH-SSO-401.1. This started immediately following the recent v4.2 update, and we urgently need this resolved to restore access for our staff.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This configuration update is required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: Slow download speeds
body: Were seeing very slow file downloads lately, getting error code DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW in some cases. The transfer rate is way below what we expect for our network. Is there any setting we should look at? No hurry.
resolution: We recommend testing your download speeds from a different browser or network to rule out local interference. If you are handling very large files, using our Desktop Sync client provides a more robust transfer method than the web browser. Please also verify that you are not running browser extensions that might throttle download traffic.

subject: Previewer stuck on blank page
body: File previews for PDFs and PPTX files are just spinning or showing blank pages. Downloading works, but the viewer is broken. Please investigate.
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by browser extensions or cache issues. Please try viewing the file in an incognito window to see if an extension is interfering. If the problem persists for specific files, ensure they are not corrupted or password-protected, as these features are not supported by the previewer.

subject: STOP CREATING CONFLICT FILES EVERY SINGLE MINUTE
body: Your desktop sync client is driving me insane with all these fake conflict warnings! Every time I save a document it flags it as conflict SYNC-003 and makes useless duplicate files like filename (Conflict 2023-10-27).docx even though nobody else touched the file. Fix this bug immediately!
resolution: Hello. This issue typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus and firewall software interfering with the sync process on your machine. Please temporarily disable your antivirus or firewall and try syncing again to test. If successful, be sure to add CloudDesk to your security software's whitelist, and ensure your internet connection remains stable.

subject: API calls failing with 403 error on Enterprise plan
body: Our new integration using the CloudDesk REST API is failing to make any calls, receiving a Client Not Authorized error even though we are using a valid API key. We keep seeing error code API-AUTH-403.5 in our logs. This is severely blocking our development team right now. Please provide prompt assistance so we can resume our work.
resolution: Please confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes and permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: Workspace timeout errors blocking our work
body: our enterprise workspace with over 10k items wont load at all in the admin console and keeps throwing WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT. its taking over 30 seconds and showing blank screens. we have a payroll run tomorrow so this is super critical and needs urgent attention right now!!!
resolution: We recognize the critical nature of your payroll run tomorrow and are addressing this surge in timeout reports. Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace, use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, and break up very large workspaces into smaller ones. Additionally, please verify your browser console for any network errors.

subject: audit log retention limit
body: hi, i am trying to set the audit log retention to 5 years but the console wont let me go past 12 months. is there a way to increase this limit? AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT error.
resolution: The native retention period in the Admin Console is currently capped at 12 months. For longer compliance needs, we recommend using our API or SFTP export feature to ship logs to an external SIEM solution like Splunk or Sumo Logic.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with attribute mismatch error
body: Users attempting to log into CloudDesk via Okta SSO are encountering a failure right after redirection. The login page displays 'User attribute mismatch' and error code SSO-OKTA-403. Please look into this configuration issue.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, verify that the 'email' and 'firstName' / 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Ensure 'email' is set as the unique identifier.

subject: User cannot log in after role change
body: After changing a colleague from Member to Guest role, they are seeing error CD-AM-002 and cannot log in. They need to access their files for a project. Please tell me how to restore their access as soon as possible.
resolution: Guest users only have access to specific shared workspaces they have been invited to. Please check the Admin Console to see if the user has active invitations to the workspaces they need. If they require full platform access, you will need to change their role back to Member.

subject: Unable to delete workspace
body: Im trying to delete a workspace but the system says Active Integrations Detected and it wont let me finish the task. Error is CD-AM-007. Its extremely annoying that I cant just remove the workspace and move on.
resolution: To successfully delete a workspace, you must first manually disconnect every active integration like Slack or Jira within that workspace's settings. Once you have navigated to Workspace Settings and removed all linked integrations, the delete button will function as expected.

subject: Jira integration sync issues
body: The Jira integration is failing with JIRA-SYNC-403 error. Nothing is syncing properly. We have a big demo at 5pm today and need this fixed fast. Please look into why projects arent showing up.
resolution: Ensure the Jira API token or user configured for the CloudDesk integration has 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance. If the error persists after verifying these permissions, please let us know.

subject: sso token error after update urgent
body: HELP US NOW! after pushing the v4.2 update this morning all our users logging in through okta and azure ad are completely locked out with cd-am-003 and invalid sso token format errors! none of our team members can access any files or workspaces right now and it is completely breaking our workflow. fix this immediately please!
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Please instruct the customer to update their SSO application configuration in their IdP to use the new token schema. Refer to the CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide for specific instructions.

subject: Requesting detailed user activity reports beyond audit logs
body: Hello, our finance team is reviewing our analytics capabilities on the PRO plan. We are asking for more detailed reports on user activity, such as file downloads, views, and specific collaboration actions, beyond the current audit logs. No immediate rush on this.
resolution: Hello. We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting to help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Okta SSO login failing after update
body: Our users are completely unable to access the platform via Okta following the recent v4.2 update. They are receiving an AUTH-SSO-401.1 error. This is a critical issue affecting our entire company and we need an immediate resolution.
resolution: Because of the SSO token format changes in our v4.2 release, you must update your configuration. Please re-upload your IDP metadata within the CloudDesk Admin Console. This should restore access for your users immediately.

subject: Cannot remove user from workspace
body: Hello, I am trying to remove a user from a workspace through the Admin Console. However, I am receiving an error message, CD-AM-014, stating that the user is an owner and cannot be removed. Could you please advise on the correct procedure to remove this user? Thank you for your help.
resolution: You are correct, a user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently designated as the owner. To proceed with the removal, the workspace ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace. You can do this by navigating to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign the ownership.

subject: Cannot access private workspace
body: I am the administrator and need to access a user's workspace for a mandatory compliance audit. However, the system is blocking my access with a PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED message. I need this access granted immediately to fulfill my requirements. How can I bypass this?
resolution: Private workspaces are protected by default to ensure privacy, even from administrators. To gain access, you must initiate a formal Workspace Access Request via the user profile in the Admin Console. This process will trigger an audit log and require the necessary compliance approval.

subject: okta sso login error
body: our team is getting an SSO-OKTA-403 error when trying to sign in. we have an important client demo at 5pm today and nobody can get into the app. please help us fix this right away.
resolution: This error typically indicates a configuration issue between your identity provider and our platform. Please verify that the email, firstName, and lastName attributes are correctly mapped to our user profile fields within your Okta settings. Specifically, ensure that the email attribute is configured as the unique identifier.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: When I try to access the User Activity report in the admin console, the page loads but no data is displayed. Other reports on our PRO plan are working fine. Could you please check this out?
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering.

subject: Large file uploads keep stalling and timing out
body: I am trying to upload several large project files, but the progress bar just freezes and eventually I get the UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_504 error. This is completely unacceptable as we need these assets moved today! Why is the upload process so unstable for files over 1GB? Please look into this right away.
resolution: Please check your internet connection speed to ensure it is stable. For files over 500MB, we recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads, as it supports resumable transfers. If you are on Wi-Fi, try using a wired connection or switching browsers to see if the issue persists.

subject: Update purchase order number on future invoices
body: We need to update the purchase order number for our account as we have a payroll run tomorrow that requires the correct accounting info. Could you please assist us in updating our billing settings? Thank you for your help.
resolution: You can update this information yourself by going to the Admin Console, selecting Billing, and then clicking on Billing Information. Simply locate the Purchase Order Number field to save your changes, which will reflect on all future invoices. Please note that this cannot be applied retroactively to invoices that have already been generated.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: One of my staff members requested a password reset, but they are not receiving the reset email. I have checked our spam folder and it is not there. Please look into why the system is not sending these notifications as expected.
resolution: First, confirm the user's email address is correct in the Admin Console under Team Management and Users. If they still haven't received it, ask them to whitelist no-reply@cloudesk.com, or you can force a password reset for them directly from the Admin Console.

subject: Payment failed for subscription renewal
body: Our credit card was declined and now our renewal has failed, giving us a BILL-PAY-002 error. This is blocking our access to core features and is very frustrating. We need this fixed right away to avoid any disruption in our workspace services.
resolution: Please navigate to the Billing section in your Admin Console and select Payment Methods to update your credit card details. Ensure the billing information is perfectly aligned with your bank's records. Once updated, you can manually trigger the payment retry from your Invoices section.

subject: Password reset email is not arriving
body: I am trying to trigger a password reset for my account but I never receive the email. I checked my spam and junk folders multiple times. I am getting other notifications from your service just fine, but this specific email simply does not arrive. I see the error code AUTH-PR-200.1 whenever I click the button. Please let me know how to get this fixed as I need to continue my work.
resolution: It appears our system is experiencing a high volume of mail delivery delays. Please verify your domain allows emails from our sender address by adding 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to your allowlist. If you still do not receive the link, I can manually trigger a reset for your account from our Admin Console.

subject: Need better reporting tools!
body: I am very frustrated with the lack of detailed activity logs in the admin console. I need to see exactly who downloaded or viewed specific files, and the current logs are useless! When will you add better reporting to this platform?
resolution: We understand that our current audit logs might not meet your specific business requirements. We are actively collecting feedback on this, so please post your specific use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com. This allows our product team to prioritize features that are most valuable to our users.

subject: Mobile app MFA registration failing
body: Hi team, while setting up multi-factor authentication via our mobile app, we encounter the MFA-MOB-002 error right after scanning the QR code. Email and password logins are functioning normally, but we cannot complete the MFA configuration step. We would appreciate it if this could be looked into soon.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise your users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app by navigating to Settings, then Security, and Multi-Factor Authentication. Once configured there, it will function properly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Urgent API token issues after v4.2
body: Hello, we are seeing many API-AUTH-401-V42 errors since the v4.2 update. Our entire integration is down and we have a major client deadline in two hours. Could you please help us restore access as soon as possible? We appreciate your quick attention to this.
resolution: Due to the v4.2 update, the format for API tokens has changed. You will need to regenerate all your existing API tokens from the Admin Console's 'API & Integrations' section. Once generated, please update your application configuration to use these new tokens.

subject: Invalid API key errors affecting workspace integrations
body: Hello, our development scripts are currently receiving 401 Unauthorized errors when using our established API keys. This is blocking our current project deployment, so I would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. Thank you.
resolution: Verify the API key's status in the Admin Console ('API Keys' section). Check if it has expired or been revoked. Advise the user to regenerate a new API key if necessary and update their application.

subject: Missing older invoices in admin console
body: Good day to the support crew, while sitting here reviewing our quarterly expenses and sipping my morning tea, I tried to access some older invoices from more than a year ago in the desktop sync client admin console interface, but nothing older than twelve months seems to load properly and we keep getting BILL-INV-003 codes. We are currently on the free tier evaluating your enterprise features. There is zero rush on this whatsoever since our tax filing deadline is months away, but whenever someone gets a spare moment, could you point me in the right direction?
resolution: The Admin Console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months. For older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you are looking for, and we will retrieve it for you from our archives.

subject: Failed to register MFA device on mobile app
body: Hello support team, we are trying to set up Google Authenticator via the mobile app but keep getting the failed to register MFA device error after scanning the QR code. We have a major security audit on Friday and really need this working promptly. Thank you so much for your help.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise your users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app under 'Settings' > 'Security' > 'Multi-Factor Authentication'. Once set up there, it will work seamlessly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: API 429 rate limit errors
body: we are getting constant 429 rate limit errors during our peak traffic times. it is really frustrating because our sync jobs are failing left and right. can you look at why the API-RATE-429 error is triggering so easily for us? we need this resolved quickly.
resolution: Implement exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client. Review your application's API usage patterns and consider optimizing calls or requesting a rate limit increase via support if justified by legitimate use cases.

subject: User invitation status stuck at pending
body: We sent an invite to a new team member, but their status is stuck on Pending Invitation in the console. They cannot access the dashboard to start working. We are seeing error code CD-AM-005 when they try to sign in. Please let me know how we can fix this.
resolution: This issue is often related to domain auto-join settings or a synchronization delay. Please try having the user log in directly with their email and the password they set. If that fails, please revoke the invitation in the Admin Console and send a fresh one to reset the status.

subject: Account locked out unexpectedly
body: Hello, one of our executives is seeing an Account Locked message after multiple login failures despite entering the correct credentials. They cannot access their workspace at all and this is urgent as we have board materials to review. We are seeing error code AUTH-LOCK-429.1 on the screen. Please assist promptly.
resolution: You can either wait 15 minutes for the automated lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account right now via the CloudDesk Admin Console by navigating to 'Users' and selecting 'Manage User' followed by 'Unlock Account'.

subject: Incorrect role display in admin console
body: Hello CloudDesk support team, I hope you are having a wonderful day. While reviewing our user management dashboard today, I noticed that several team members have incorrect roles displayed next to their names, such as showing as Contributor instead of Manager. Their actual workspace permissions are working fine, but the admin console UI-ADMIN-003 display is definitely mixed up. Thank you for your assistance with this minor detail.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and the actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: Google SSO domain error for specific users
body: We are having trouble getting our external consultants onto our workspace. Users from specific domains cannot log in via Google SSO and receive a domain not allowed error. This is causing unnecessary friction and I would like it sorted out soon.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, please check the 'Allowed Domains' list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: New user getting user not found error
body: hey we added a new developer to our pro workspace but when they try to login with email and password it says user not found. error code AUTH-NF-404.1 appeared on their screen. no rush at all on this since they can start next week
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Google SSO blocking particular domains
body: Hello. Users from specific domains cannot log in using Google SSO on our free tier, getting a domain not allowed response. There is no rush on this, but please review when you have time.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console under SSO and Identity settings for Google SSO, please check the Allowed Domains list. Adding any missing domains there will allow those users to log in successfully through Google SSO.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade refund request
body: Hi there! I accidentally clicked the upgrade button earlier today and I was hoping you could help me get a refund for that. I really appreciate your help with this request. Let me know what you need from my side.
resolution: We can certainly look into this for you, as refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Could you please confirm the exact date and time of the upgrade and verify that you haven't used any of the premium features? We will review your account details as soon as you reply.

subject: Mobile app crashes on large file uploads
body: Every time I upload files over 1GB, the app crashes immediately without any error logs. We have an important audit on Friday and need these files uploaded today. Error code CRASH-MOB-001 is appearing. We need this resolved as soon as possible.
resolution: We are currently experiencing a known memory management issue affecting large file uploads on our mobile application. As a workaround, please use the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client to upload these files until the fix is deployed. Our team is working on an optimization for a future update to handle these larger files.

subject: Slack channel not receiving file share notifications
body: Hello, we noticed that file share notifications are not showing up in our configured Slack channel for our PRO account. Error code SLACK-NOTIFY-500 is showing up in our logs. No rush on this, as we can check it whenever you have a moment.
resolution: Please check the Slack integration settings in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app has the necessary permissions to post in that channel within Slack.

subject: need annual invoicing option
body: why cant i change our billing to annual invoice on this free account. your system forces credit card and it is driving me crazy. fix this payment feature or add the option whenever you have time.
resolution: For custom enterprise billing arrangements, annual invoicing, and tailored payment terms, please reach out to our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or submit the Enterprise Inquiry form on our website. They will gladly discuss your account requirements and set up a customized plan.

subject: MFA codes not working on mobile
body: MY MFA CODES ARENT WORKING AND I AM LOCKED OUT. AUTH-MFA-401.2 IS SHOWING UP. PLEASE FIX THIS RIGHT NOW.
resolution: Please ensure your phone's time is set to synchronize automatically with the network time. If the issue continues, you should reset your MFA configuration through the Security Settings page on our web application.

subject: API Integration Not Working - Client Not Authorized
body: I'm extremely frustrated. Our new integration with CloudDesk using your REST API is completely blocked. Every single API call we make returns a 'Client Not Authorized' or a 403 Forbidden error. We've double-checked the API key, and it's definitely valid. This is critically impacting our workflow and we need a resolution immediately. What is going on? The error code we are seeing is API-AUTH-403.5. Please help promptly.
resolution: We understand this is frustrating. The 'Client Not Authorized' error, often seen as API-AUTH-403.5, indicates an issue with the permissions assigned to your API key. Please have an administrator log into the Admin Console, navigate to 'API Keys', and then 'Manage Key Permissions' for the key in question. Ensure that all the necessary scopes and permissions are assigned for the specific API endpoints your integration is attempting to access.

subject: Public link expiration limits
body: We need to set public sharing links to last much longer than they currently do. Is there any way to make them never expire? Thanks for your time.
resolution: Our current security standards limit the maximum duration for public links to protect your data. While we cannot offer an indefinite expiration option at this time, you can visit our roadmap page to submit a request for longer durations. For permanent access needs, we recommend inviting users directly into your workspace instead.

subject: Plan downgrade request for enterprise account
body: Hello. We need to downgrade our subscription plan to a lower tier due to a reduction in our team size. We encountered error code BILL-PLAN-011 while navigating the portal. There is no immediate rush for this request.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: Our account was accidentally upgraded to a higher plan level earlier this week. We have not made use of any of the new features. Please let us know the process for receiving a refund for this transaction.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Need PDF format for invoices
body: I am currently trying to download our monthly statements from the Admin Console, but only CSV files are available. We require PDF copies for our accounting records. Could you please update the system or provide the PDFs directly?
resolution: PDF generation for certain legacy invoices is currently unavailable due to a recent system migration. Please send over the specific invoice IDs you require, and our team will generate those PDF documents and email them to you directly.

subject: Requesting webhook for file uploads
body: We need a way to get a notification when a new file is uploaded to our workspaces. Currently we have to poll the system which is inefficient. Is there any way to trigger a webhook for this event? This is blocking our integration work, so please assist.
resolution: Thank you for the request. While our API supports polling, we do not have a direct webhook for new file uploads at this time. Please submit a detailed proposal of your requirements to our roadmap portal at roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so we can review this for future development.

subject: customize sso login page branding
body: Hi, our IT team is trying to find where we can upload our company logo and branding colors for the SSO login page. We want a more cohesive experience for our users. We are on the pro plan and hope this can be updated soon.
resolution: Hello. Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available. We recognize this as a valuable feature for many enterprises. Please add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding. We will notify you of any updates.

subject: Assistance needed with v4.2 SSO login
body: Hello, our team is encountering the AUTH-SSO-401.1 error when using Okta SSO after the recent update. This is hindering our progress, and we have a strict payroll run deadline tomorrow. I would appreciate your prompt assistance in resolving this token format issue.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the latest IDP metadata. This step is required due to the change in SSO token format introduced in the v4.2 release.

subject: Mobile MFA login failing
body: I am trying to log into the mobile app but my MFA code is consistently rejected. I keep seeing the error code AUTH-MFA-401.2 on my screen. This is causing a lot of frustration for my team members who cannot access their work. Can you look into why this is happening?
resolution: Please ensure your phone's time settings are synchronized with the network. If that does not work, you should remove and re-add your MFA device via the Security Settings page on our web dashboard.

subject: New user login error
body: A new user is unable to log in and receives a User Not Found error. They are seeing AUTH-NF-404.1. Could you check if their account was created correctly?
resolution: Please verify in your Admin Console that the invitation was successfully sent and subsequently accepted by the user. If they have not accepted it, please resend the invitation and ensure they are attempting to log in via the correct instance URL.

subject: Password reset email not received
body: One of our team members is unable to log in and requested a password reset. They have not received the reset email, and it is not in their spam folder. Other emails from CloudDesk are coming through fine. The error code is AUTH-PR-200.1. Please help us resolve this.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Check if the user's domain is configured with an approved email sender list. If not, advise adding 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to their allowlist. Manually trigger a password reset from the Admin Console if necessary.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop blocking access
body: We are experiencing a constant redirect loop when attempting to log in with Google SSO, receiving the error AUTH-SSO-302.1. This is a critical blocker as we have a major client demo at 5pm today and our team cannot access their files. Could you please provide a prompt resolution to this issue?
resolution: This behavior is often resolved by clearing your browser cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com. If that does not work, please attempt to log in using an incognito window or an alternate browser to bypass any local storage conflicts.

subject: Need PDF version of invoices
body: Currently the admin console only allows us to export invoices in CSV format. We require a PDF version for our accounting records, but I am unable to locate an option for this. I saw error BILL-INV-009 when I tried to look for a different export button.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: need api for workspace creation
body: we need an api endpoint to create workspaces. our current onboarding process is manual and slow. please add this feature for automation.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to our SSO token handling, but an API endpoint for programmatic workspace creation is not yet available. You can currently manage workspaces via the Admin Console. Please submit your detailed requirements for this API endpoint to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements/workspace-creation-api.

subject: Slack notifications not working for our team
body: Hi there, I hope everyone is having a pleasant Tuesday morning. As I was grabbing a cup of coffee and chatting with Sarah from marketing about our upcoming company retreat in Ohio, I realized our file share notifications are not posting to our Slack channel. We are on the pro tier and this started happening recently, so please let me know whenever you have time to look into it.
resolution: Please check the Slack integration settings in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app still has permission to post in that channel within Slack.

subject: s3 export issue
body: our s3 data export is failing with error s3_export_credentials_401 after the 4.2 upgrade. credentials have not been changed on our end. can you look into this?
resolution: The v4.2 release requires updated IAM permissions for S3 integrations. Please ensure your AWS policy includes the 's3:GetBucketLocation' permission to comply with these new requirements. Following the updated S3 Integration Guide should resolve this credential error.

subject: critical login failure after v4.2 update
body: We are experiencing a major outage with our Okta integration since the update. All users are getting the AUTH-SSO-401.1 error and cannot log in. This is critical as we have an all-hands meeting in two hours and nobody can access their workspace. Please help.
resolution: The recent v4.2 update introduced changes to the SSO token format that require a configuration update on your end. Please update your SSO integration settings in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata. This should restore connectivity for all your users immediately.

subject: Workspace ownership transfer greyed out error
body: Hello, we are attempting to transfer ownership of a workspace in the enterprise admin console, but the option is greyed out and gives an error about non-owner. Many users are hitting this at the same moment right now. There is no urgency for this request, take your time.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: s3 export credentials failing
body: Our automated S3 exports are failing with S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401. I have double-checked everything and nothing on the AWS side has changed since the update. This is very frustrating to deal with.
resolution: The v4.2 update requires additional permissions for S3 integrations. You likely need to update your AWS IAM policy to include the new required permissions, such as s3:GetBucketLocation. Please review the v4.2 S3 Integration Guide to update your policy settings.

subject: api error 500 on file content
body: getting api-500 errors periodically on the file content endpoint. looks like it happens mostly with remote files. any fix?
resolution: We are currently investigating a root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a permanent fix in an upcoming hotfix. In the meantime, you can resolve these intermittent 500 errors by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. Thank you for your patience.

subject: Okta login broken with error AUTH-402
body: Good morning, I hope you are having a wonderful week so far over there at support. Last week we had our office bake sale and everyone really enjoyed the brownies, but ever since this morning when I tried to log into CloudDesk using our Okta credentials, it just refreshes the page and gives me an Invalid Token Format error code AUTH-402. Our entire team cannot access anything right now and it is an absolute disaster for our daily operations.
resolution: Hello. This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide, accessible in the admin console under Settings -> SSO & Authentication -> Okta Configuration.

subject: Invoice user count mismatch BILL-INV-001
body: Good morning. Our latest Pro invoice reflects a user count that does not match our current active users, showing error BILL-INV-001. We have our payroll run tomorrow and need this billing discrepancy resolved. Thank you for your prompt assistance.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these details, please provide your invoice ID and current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Mobile app keeps asking for login
body: Hi, I am having trouble with the mobile app. Every time I open it, I am told my session has expired. Could you please look into this?
resolution: With the recent v4.2 release, we updated our session management to improve security. Please log out of the mobile app completely, reinstall it to clear the old cache, and log back in to establish a new compatible session.

subject: redirect loop on google sso
body: I cant log in with my google account! i get stuck in a loop and never see my dashboard. this is very frustrating and i need this working NOW.
resolution: I am sorry for the trouble; please start by clearing the cache and cookies for our domain in your browser settings. If the redirect loop persists, please try accessing your account via an incognito window or a different browser. We should also verify that your Google SSO configuration is still valid within your Admin Console.

subject: API calls failing with 500 errors
body: Our integration is breaking because the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint is returning API-500 errors intermittently. This is happening specifically for files in different regions and it is causing our app to hang. We have a major demo at 5pm today and this is a blocker for our team. We need this resolved immediately to avoid a failed presentation.
resolution: We are aware of this issue regarding distributed storage and are working on a hotfix. In the meantime, the best way to handle these intermittent errors is to implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. This will ensure your application gracefully handles the temporary server-side latency.

subject: Blank User Activity report in admin console
body: Hello, when I try to open the User Activity report in the admin console the page loads but no data appears at all. The other reports seem to be working normally. Could you please check on this when you have time?
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try using a different browser or let us know the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: User invitation link not working
body: Hello, I sent an invite to my new colleague, but he says he clicked the link and he is still listed as Pending Invitation in the console. He cannot log in at all. I see error code CD-AM-005. Could you please check this out?
resolution: This happens when there is a delay in account provisioning. Please ask your user to try logging in directly using the credentials they established. If that fails, please revoke the invitation in the Admin Console and send a fresh one to trigger the sync.

subject: Desktop sync client login failed
body: Desktop client not logging in through SSO. Browser redirect works but then I get DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 error. Please fix this, it is blocking our team.
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to version 4.2.1 or newer to support the updated token format. If the issue persists, check that your default browser is correctly configured for the redirect, or try using email/password login as a temporary workaround.

subject: Need help exporting older audit logs
body: Hi there, I hope you are having a wonderful Tuesday. As the executive assistant here, I was just looking at our enterprise workspace settings while drinking my morning coffee and realized I needed to pull some historical records for compliance. When I attempted to export our audit logs via the Admin Console for a date range greater than 90 days, it failed. There is no major rush on this since we are just archiving for next quarter, but I wanted to mention it.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint /v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE] with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Desktop Sync client stuck on indexing indefinitely

subject: Need more detailed user activity logs

resolution: We appreciate you sharing your requirements for enhanced reporting. While our current logs provide standard tracking, we are always looking to improve our analytics. subject: Desktop Sync stuck on indexing

If the issue persists, we recommend performing a clean reinstall of the application, ensuring you have backed up any locally modified files first.

subject: Frequent SSO session timeouts after update

resolution: The v4.2 release updated our token refresh mechanism. Please check your IdP application settings to ensure that the Refresh Token policy is enabled and set to a duration of at least 8 to 24 hours. This should prevent the premature session expirations your team is experiencing.

subject: Workspace search is lagging
body: Hi, I noticed that searching within some workspaces is very slow lately. It seems like WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG is affecting quite a few users right now. I appreciate your help looking into why these specific workspaces are not indexing correctly.
resolution: This can happen if a workspace contains millions of files or deeply nested folders. Please try using more specific keywords or path-based searches to improve performance. If the issue persists, please send us the specific workspace ID so our engineering team can review the index status.

subject: api calls failing with 403 forbidden

resolution: Please confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes and permissions assigned for the specific endpoints you are calling. An administrator can review and adjust these settings in the Admin Console under API Keys and Manage Key Permissions.

subject: Files failing to render properly in the web app preview viewer

resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Downgrading subscription plan

resolution: You can process your plan change directly through the Admin Console under 'Billing' and 'Subscription Details'. Please be aware that your new plan tier will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle, and we are unable to offer prorated refunds for the remainder of your current term.

subject: Webhook delivery failed connection refused error

resolution: Please verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range (refer to documentation for current IPs).

subject: API requests failing with 401 Unauthorized after v4.2 update

resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: doc editing is lagging
body: the office documents are very slow when we edit together. it shows collab_lag and it is painful. please fix.
resolution: Please ensure all collaborators have a stable internet connection and try closing any unnecessary browser tabs. You should also have your team clear their browser cache. Verifying if the performance improves with fewer active editors can also help identify if local network congestion is the cause.

subject: SSO login failing in desktop sync client

resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, suggest logging in via email/password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: High CPU usage by CloudDeskSync.exe
body: CloudDesk Sync is consuming over 50 percent CPU while idle. Please look into this.
resolution: Check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed. Advise user to pause sync, restart their computer, then resume sync. If persistent, suggest disabling sync for non-critical folders or temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks. Check for conflicting antivirus software.

subject: Previewer showing blank page

subject: Switching to annual billing

Once there, choose the option to change your plan to annual. This update will apply at the start of your next billing cycle, and any remaining monthly credit will be prorated automatically.

subject: Billing section failing via SSO

resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please confirm if you have utilized any of the Enterprise features, and provide the exact timestamp of the upgrade so we can verify your eligibility. We will review your account status once that is confirmed.

subject: GDPR export missing file comments

resolution: The standard GDPR data export primarily covers files, folders, and direct user profile data. Comments on files and tasks are stored separately as activity metadata, so to export those comments you need to navigate to the specific file or task, open the 'Activity' tab, and use the 'Export Activity Log' option for that item.

subject: Unintentional plan upgrade - requesting refund

resolution: I am sorry for the frustration regarding your account status.
