Once provided, we will review your account for refund eligibility.

Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Need detailed user activity tracking and reports
body: Our team management requires deeper visibility into user actions, specifically file downloads, views, and collaboration events, which are missing from the current audit logs. It is frustrating that we cannot pull comprehensive usage metrics for our team. We would appreciate it if you could provide more robust reporting options.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Constant SSO Re-authentication in Desktop Sync v4.2
body: Hello, following the recent update to CloudDesk Desktop Sync client v4.2, users logging in via SSO are being repeatedly forced to re-authenticate throughout the day. The client logs indicate a SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 error. Could you please provide assistance with this workflow disruption as soon as possible?
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to SSO token handling. Advise the user to perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client (uninstall, restart, then install). If the issue persists, the company's SSO administrator may need to review their IdP's token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret in CloudDesk Admin Console.

subject: Webhook delivery failure alerts
body: Hello, I am noticing that our automated systems are not receiving data from CloudDesk. We see an error stating that the connection was refused. Could you look into this for us? We would be so grateful for any help in getting this resolved.
resolution: Please verify your webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console. You should also confirm that your external service is accessible from the internet and that your firewall is configured to allow incoming connections from the CloudDesk IP range listed in our documentation.

subject: Error adding team members
body: I am trying to add new people to our team but keep getting a CD-AM-001 error saying the seat limit is reached. We definitely have available seats shown in our subscription dashboard. Any help would be appreciated.
resolution: Please check your 'Pending Invitations' list in the Admin Console. These pending requests count toward your seat limit even if the user hasn't joined yet; revoking those old invitations should free up the capacity you need.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: Hey, I keep trying to pull the User Activity report but it just loads as a white screen. It is showing REPORT-001 and I cannot see any data at all. This is really holding up my reporting work. Please fix this soon.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, please try a different browser or provide the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in admin console
body: Hello Support, we noticed today that some users roles are showing up as Contributor instead of Manager in the Users and Permissions section. Their actual workspace permissions are fine, but the UI is showing the wrong text. Since we have an external audit on Friday, we need this cleaned up soon. We are seeing error UI-ADMIN-003.
resolution: Hello. This is a known UI display bug that is currently affecting several accounts, though your actual user permissions remain fully intact. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user profile in the admin console, change their role to something else, save it, and then change it back to the correct role. A permanent patch for this display issue will be released shortly.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Hello, I am trying to reset my password on the web app but the email never arrives in my inbox or spam folder. I am seeing error code CD-AM-008 when I attempt to trigger the reset. Could you please assist me with this? I need to get back into my account to handle some urgent tasks. Thank you for your help.
resolution: Please have your team admin verify that your email address is correctly listed in the Team Management section of the console. Also, kindly add no-reply@cloudesk.com to your email whitelist to ensure delivery. If you still don't receive it, your administrator can manually trigger a password reset for you directly from their dashboard.

subject: Mobile app keeps prompting for login
body: Hello, users on our mobile app are constantly getting logged out with an expired session message cd-am-011. This started right after the v4.2 update. It is not urgent at all, just wanted to report it when you have a moment.
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to session management for improved security. Users should fully log out of the mobile app, clear their app cache/data (if on Android) or reinstall the app (if on iOS), and then log back in. This will force a new, compatible session token.

subject: API 403 error when sharing workspaces
body: our automated script is failing when it tries to run POST /workspaces/{id}/share. we keep getting an API-403 error. the api key has manager roles so it should work. plz fix this fast as it is stopping our provisioning.
resolution: Please ensure that the API key has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled in your settings. Additionally, the user linked to that API key must be a direct member of the workspace you are attempting to share. If the API-403 error continues, please send us the API key ID and the specific workspace ID for further troubleshooting.

subject: Desktop sync SSO login fails with generic error
body: This is extremely frustrating! Every time I try to log into the desktop sync client using our company SSO on our pro plan, the browser redirects successfully but the app just sits there unauthenticated and displays a generic login failed message. We are trying to get work done and this is completely blocking us right now. Error code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 keeps appearing. We need this resolved immediately.
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, suggest logging in via email/password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: Azure AD SSO login failing
body: I am unable to log in via Azure AD, and I keep getting an AUTH-SSO-403.2 error regarding missing attributes. This is completely blocking my access and I need this resolved today. Can you please advise on what attributes are missing?
resolution: This error occurs when your Azure AD claims are not properly mapped to our system requirements. Please ensure that both the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly configured in your Azure enterprise application settings as detailed in our configuration documentation.

subject: SSO session expired errors forcing constant re-authentication after v4.2
body: Ever since the v4.2 update, our staff using Okta and Azure AD are being intermittently logged out throughout the day with an SSO session expired message. We are encountering error SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 repeatedly. Many colleagues across other companies are hitting this at the same moment. This is disrupting our workflow and we request prompt assistance.
resolution: v4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta/Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration (e.g., 8-24 hours) to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: I am reviewing our latest invoice and the user count is completely wrong. It is significantly higher than what we currently have active in the system. I need this corrected immediately as it affects our budget planning. Please explain why this is happening.
resolution: Please check the Billing Date and Proration Period on your invoice, as user count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: getting 403 on share workspace api call
body: hi we keep getting an api-403 error when trying to post to the share workspace endpoint. my api user has manager permissions for the workspace. can you help us with this right now as we are blocked?
resolution: Please confirm that your API key has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Also, ensure the user associated with that key is a direct member of the workspace, not just a member through a group. If it still fails, send us the API key ID and the specific workspace ID for review.

subject: Detailed audit and user activity reports needed
body: Hello, our management team is looking to pull more detailed reports on user activity within the workspace, such as specific file downloads, views, and collaboration actions beyond what the standard audit logs currently provide. We are on the pro plan and would like this addressed when possible. Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: MFA setup error on mobile

resolution: We are currently addressing a known issue with MFA registration within the mobile app. To bypass this, please complete your MFA setup through the CloudDesk web portal by going to Settings and then Security. After you finalize the setup there, your credentials will sync and work seamlessly for your mobile app access.

subject: SSO login timeout after v4.2 update error SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2

We are tracking this under error code SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2. This is critical because we have a mandatory company-wide audit starting this Friday morning and staff cannot log in.
resolution: This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Please re-save your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the Application Sign On URL format, and have affected users clear their browser cache and cookies.

subject: Network Error blocking mobile app access entirely
body: I am completely unable to log into the enterprise mobile app right now on iOS and Android devices, receiving a generic 'Network Error' with code MOBILE-NET-500.1 despite having a perfectly stable internet connection. This is ridiculous and blocking our team out of nowhere, though we aren't in an immediate rush to fix it today.
resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache/data (Android) or reinstalling the app (iOS/Android). Verify server status on our status page.

subject: New user receiving User Not Found error
body: A newly invited user attempts to log in with their email and password but receives an User Not Found error. The error code is AUTH-NF-404.1. Please advise.
resolution: Hello. Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Okta SSO attribute mismatch issue
body: We are getting an SSO-OKTA-403 error during the login flow. It appears there is an attribute mismatch occurring after the Okta redirection. Can you advise on the expected schema requirements?
resolution: Please check your Okta application settings to ensure that the email, firstName, and lastName attributes are mapped correctly to the CloudDesk user profile fields. It is essential that the email field is configured as the unique identifier for the integration to function properly.

subject: Need to update purchase order number for future invoices
body: Greetings support team, thank you for your ongoing assistance. We would like to add a new purchase order number to our upcoming billing cycles for accounting purposes. Everything is running smoothly otherwise, but our finance department requested this update. Thank you for your help.
resolution: You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: Need PDF invoices
body: The Admin Console only allows me to download invoices in CSV format. I need a PDF copy for our accounting department. Please provide the PDF.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is currently unavailable for some of our older records due to a system migration. Please reply with the specific invoice IDs you require, and we will manually generate those PDFs and email them to you directly.

subject: Admin console user report showing no data
body: I try to look at the User Activity report, but it is just empty and white. It keep saying REPORT-001 in the console logs. I am very frustrated because I need to check these logs for my daily maintenance task.
resolution: This blank page issue is usually caused by browser-side data caching. Please clear your cache and cookies and try accessing the report again. If it remains empty, test in a different browser or verify that your extensions are not blocking the script.

subject: User Activity report page is completely blank
body: When I open User Activity in admin console the page load but show zero data at all, very annoying. Other report pages work good. Error code REPORT-001 appear sometimes. Many people seem to have this problem right now. Please fix when you can.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Data Export API returns unexpected permission denied error
body: Hello Support, our API key with Admin scope is suddenly returning API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED when we call the /v1/users/{userId}/data/export endpoint. This worked fine until today and our integration is currently failing. Please advise.
resolution: Effective October 12, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in Admin Console > API Management.

subject: Failed to register MFA device in mobile app
body: Hello Support, we are experiencing an issue on our Enterprise mobile application where scanning the QR code for MFA results in a Failed to register MFA device error. Regular password login is fine. Thank you for looking into this for us.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app under Settings, Security, and Multi-Factor Authentication, after which it will work seamlessly across both web and mobile.

subject: Okta SSO login failure blocking executives

resolution: Please advise your team to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This update is required due to a change in the SSO token format in version 4.2.

subject: Data export endpoint not working
body: Hi there, I am trying to export user data but im getting a 403 permission denied error. It was working just fine last week, and now it is broken. I hope you can fix this soon, thank you!
resolution: We recently updated our security scopes, and the 'Admin' role no longer covers data exports. You will need to generate a new API key assigned with the 'Data Steward' role to regain access to this endpoint.

subject: Okta sso broken error AUTH-SSO-401.1
body: our team cannot log in using okta. we keep getting an error code AUTH-SSO-401.1. need this resolved fast because payroll run is tomorrow.
resolution: This error stems from the v4.2 update, which changed our SSO token format. Please go to your CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata to refresh the configuration. This should immediately resolve the login issues for your team.

subject: Account locked out error preventing administrator login

resolution: Hello. The user can wait 15 minutes for the automated security lockout to expire. Alternatively, an administrator can manually unlock the account right now via the CloudDesk Admin Console by navigating to Users -> Manage User -> Unlock Account.

subject: Seat limit reached error

resolution: It appears that pending invitations are currently consuming your available seat capacity. Please check the 'Pending Invitations' section within your Admin Console under Team Management. You can either revoke those older, unused invitations or upgrade your plan to increase your total seat limit.

subject: password reset email not arriving
body: Requested a password reset via the login page but the email never arrived in the inbox or spam. Error code CD-AM-014 was not seen, but we need this fixed promptly to access our finance reports.
resolution: First, confirm the user's email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Advise the user to check their spam/junk folders. If still not found, ask them to whitelist 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for them via 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password'.

subject: Audit log export failing for long date ranges
body: I am trying to export audit logs but it keeps failing with an AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED error when I select a date range over 90 days. This is very frustrating as I need the full year for our internal review. What is the workaround?
resolution: The direct export feature in the Admin Console is limited to 90-day intervals for performance reasons. For longer durations, please use the '/v1/audit/export' API endpoint with a pagination script to pull the full data set. If you are unable to use the API, please contact our support team to request a manual data extract.

subject: assigned tickets not showing

resolution: This issue is often related to a caching problem with agent permissions. Please advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If the problem persists, an administrator can try re-assigning the ticket to a different agent, saving, and then re-assigning it back to the original agent.

subject: Cannot add new users due to seat limit error
body: I am trying to add a team member but i keep getting an error saying the seat limit is reached. i have checked our subscription and we have space. i am getting the CD-AM-001 error code. no major rush, just get to it when you can.
resolution: Please navigate to your Admin Console under Team Management and check your pending invitations. These invitations reserve seats against your limit, which is likely why you cannot add new members. You can either revoke those pending invites or upgrade your plan to add more capacity.

subject: need api for workspaces
body: hey with the new 4.2 update we really need an api endpoint to make workspaces automatically for client onboarding. doing this manually takes forever and it would be great if you could add it soon. thanks.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to our SSO token handling, but an API endpoint for programmatic workspace creation is not yet available. You can currently manage workspaces via the Admin Console. Please submit your detailed requirements for this API endpoint to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements/workspace-creation-api. This helps us understand the demand for automation.

subject: audit logs for external shares are useless
body: hi, i'm trying to track who downloaded files from external shares but the audit logs only show the internal user who created the link. it's completely anonymous for external users and i have an audit on friday. this is really frustrating, how can i fix this? audit_external_share_anonymous
resolution: By default, external share links are anonymous. To ensure external user activity is captured in audit logs, you must configure the share link with either 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login' when creating it. This setting identifies the external user. Unfortunately, this cannot be retroactively applied to existing anonymous links.

subject: Audit log attributing actions to wrong users

resolution: This is a known display issue where actions by 'Contributor' roles appear incorrectly if an admin is simultaneously active. The core audit trail remains accurate, but in the meantime, please refer to the global audit log in the Admin Console for definitive verification.

subject: Cannot transfer ownership to non-owner
body: I am trying to transfer ownership of a workspace in the web app, but the option is greyed out. We are getting a message saying cannot transfer ownership to non-owner with code CD-AM-004.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: Users from our newly acquired domain are getting a 'Domain not allowed' error when trying to use Google SSO. This is causing friction for our users. Please check why this specific domain is blocked.
resolution: It appears the new domain has not been added to your authorized list yet. Please navigate to the 'SSO & Identity' section of your Admin Console and add the new domain to your 'Allowed Domains' list. This will permit your users to authenticate via Google successfully.

subject: User Activity report page is blank

resolution: This page is currently failing to load due to a temporary data retrieval conflict. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, then try accessing the report again. If it remains blank, please try using a different browser or disabling any extensions that might be interfering with the page rendering.

subject: WORKSPACE LOADING IS TOTALLY BROKEN
body: Navigating to any workspace with over 10,000 files is causing the browser to hang indefinitely. I get the WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error constantly! We cannot work like this, please address this performance bottleneck immediately.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. We advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, or breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Please also verify your browser console for any network errors.

subject: Intermittent HTTP 500 errors on file content endpoint

It seems to happen specifically when we try to pull files from certain global storage regions. We really appreciate your help in resolving this, as it is impacting our operations. Thank you for your time.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval is a known issue we are currently addressing with an upcoming hotfix. In the meantime, implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client will resolve these transient failures. We appreciate your patience while our engineering team completes the permanent fix.

subject: High CPU and memory usage

resolution: This behavior often occurs if the client is caught in an internal re-indexing loop. Please pause your sync, navigate to Settings then Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database. Once completed, you may resume syncing, but please let us know if the high resource usage persists.

subject: File preview failing

resolution: This is often caused by browser cache issues or extensions interfering with the rendering service. Please try clearing your cache or opening the file in an incognito window. Ensure the file itself is not password-protected or corrupted, as that can also prevent the preview from loading.

Numerous customers are experiencing sudden API auth drops right now. This is a critical emergency affecting our live revenue streams and we need immediate assistance.
resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your requests.

resolution: This can occasionally happen due to an outdated search index on your account. Try executing a more specific query using exact phrases in quotes, or log out and log back in to trigger an automatic re-index of your files.

resolution: Please verify that the user is marked as Inactive in your Admin Console. If they are already inactive, please provide the request ID and the user's email so I can check the status of the background job.

resolution: To investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, the transaction date, and the last 4 digits of the card used. Once we have these details, we will cross-reference them with your account billing history and provide an explanation. We are here to help clear this up for you.

subject: Admin console extremely slow loading users

resolution: Our console is currently optimized for filtered views when handling large datasets. We suggest using the search bar or applying specific filters, such as Status: Active, immediately upon loading the page to reduce the number of entries retrieved. If you need to manage a specific person, searching directly by their email is the fastest way to access their profile.

resolution: Verify the API key's status in the Admin Console ('API Keys' section). Check if it has expired or been revoked. Advise the user to regenerate a new API key if necessary and update their application.

resolution: Verify that the 'Client ID' and 'Client Secret' used in your custom application exactly match the credentials generated in the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'API & Integrations' -> 'OAuth Clients'. Pay close attention to case sensitivity and any extra spaces.

subject: Critical API auth failure following v4.2 upgrade

This is an absolute emergency affecting all revenue streams and active users. We require an immediate fix or workaround right now.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

resolution: Please check your Okta application settings for CloudDesk and verify that the 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to our profile fields. Ensure that 'email' is designated as the unique identifier to resolve this mismatch.

resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's current registration flow. Please advise your users to configure their MFA settings through the CloudDesk web app under Settings and Security instead. Once completed there, it will sync and work seamlessly for both web and mobile logins.

resolution: This lag is usually related to network latency across your team's connections. Please ensure all collaborators have a stable internet connection and try closing any unnecessary browser tabs or heavy applications. If the problem persists, clearing your browser cache may help improve the synchronization performance.

resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

resolution: With the v4.2 release, we have updated the required API token format for security reasons. You will need to regenerate all existing API tokens directly from the API & Integrations section of your Admin Console. Please update your applications to utilize these newly generated tokens to restore connectivity.

We keep seeing an error that says SSO session expired, and sometimes the code SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 pops up on the screen. It is making it very difficult to get any work done today. Could you please look into this as soon as possible?
resolution: This behavior is related to the updated token refresh logic in our v4.2 release. To resolve this, please check your Okta or Azure AD application settings to ensure that the refresh token policy is enabled for CloudDesk. We recommend setting the duration to at least 8 hours to prevent these premature disconnections.

subject: API intermittent 500 errors
body: The GET /files/{id}/content endpoint is throwing an API-500 error constantly for our files in different regions. This is blocking our integration work. We need this resolved as soon as possible. What is causing these errors?
resolution: We are currently addressing the root cause related to distributed storage, but in the meantime, please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your code. This will handle the intermittent failures and stabilize your integration.

subject: user activity report blank
body: hi there when i try to view the user activity report in the admin console the page loads but it's completely blank other reports are working fine i'd really appreciate it if you could look into this for us thanks
resolution: Thanks for reaching out! This sounds like a temporary data retrieval issue. Could you please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then try accessing the 'User Activity' report again? If the problem persists, try using a different browser or check for any browser extensions that might be interfering. If it's still blank after that, please let us know the specific date range you're trying to view.

subject: Mobile app MFA setup not working
body: My team is having trouble setting up MFA in the mobile app. It gives error MFA-MOB-002 after scanning the QR code. We can login with passwords fine but cant turn on MFA. Just wanted to report this.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please have your users complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app in Settings under the Security tab. Once configured there, it will work correctly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Granular permissions for shared folders
body: Users want more granular control over permissions within shared folders, such as view-only with ability to comment or upload-only. Please let us know when this is available.
resolution: We understand the need for more granular permission controls. Currently, our permissions are applied at the folder level. Please submit your specific requirements for advanced granular permissions at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions. This will help us design the most effective solution.

subject: Frequent file conflicts on desktop sync
body: Our team is seeing excessive conflict files being generated when syncing. We are not editing these documents at the same time, yet SYNC-003 is appearing constantly. We need a resolution for this soon as it is creating unnecessary clutter.
resolution: This issue is often triggered by security software interfering with our sync service. Please try disabling your firewall or antivirus temporarily to see if the conflict errors stop. If that resolves the problem, ensure you add CloudDesk to your security software's whitelist.

subject: google sso redirect loop preventing dashboard access
body: hi team, our enterprise users are completely stuck in a redirect loop after authenticating with google sso. auth-sso-302.1 keeps appearing and nobody can reach the dashboard. please fix this soon.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Cannot create custom role because name already exists
body: Hi, im trying to set up a new custom role in the admin panel and keep getting cd-am-012 role name already exists even tho the name is completely unique. Super annoying bug honestly. No rush on this tho since we are just testing.
resolution: Hello. Please note that role names are case-insensitive and leading or trailing spaces are automatically trimmed by the system. Check your Admin Console under Team Management and Roles thoroughly to ensure there are no existing roles that might conflict or differ only by capitalization.

subject: High CPU usage on desktop client
body: The desktop sync client is consuming over 50% CPU even when idle. This is causing significant performance issues during our payroll run tomorrow. Please provide a solution promptly as we are seeing PERF-DSK-001 errors.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After reset, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: Audit log filters timing out on large date ranges
body: Hello, when applying filters by user and date range in the Admin Console audit logs section, it takes forever and results in a timeout error. Many users are dealing with this right now and it is extremely frustrating. However, we can wait for a fix since there is no real urgency on our end.
resolution: we advise the administrator to narrow down the filter criteria as much as possible, starting with smaller date ranges. for specific user activity, use the user activity report in the reports section, which is optimized for single-user queries. if extensive historical data is needed, we suggest exporting the full log and filtering locally.

subject: incorrect user roles in admin console ui
body: hey some users roles look wrong in the users and permissions section like showing contributor instead of manager. actual workspace permissions are fine but ui-admin-003 is showing. we have a major internal audit on friday so please advise.
resolution: Hello. This is a known UI display bug and actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again.

subject: slack notifications not working
body: notifications for file shares aren't pushing to our slack channel. i am seeing a SLACK-NOTIFY-500 error in the logs. any idea why?
resolution: Please check your Slack integration settings within the Admin Console to confirm the correct channel is selected. Ensure that the CloudDesk Slack application has the necessary permissions to post messages in that specific channel. Verifying these settings should re-establish the connection.

subject: SSO branding not showing up
body: Our custom logo is missing from the SSO page. It shows default branding instead. We have a big presentation on Friday and need this fixed. The error SSO-UI-200.2 is appearing.
resolution: Please check the 'SSO & Branding' section in your Admin Console to ensure your custom logo and background images are still uploaded and saved correctly. After verifying the assets are in place, please ask your users to clear their browser cache to remove the SSO-UI-200.2 error. This should restore your company branding on the login page.

subject: Webhook delivery failure
body: We are seeing WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 errors in our logs, indicating connection refused. Can you look into why our external service isn't receiving our webhooks? We'd like to get this resolved soon.
resolution: Please check your webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console to ensure it is configured correctly. Additionally, verify that your firewall is not blocking connections and that your server is configured to accept traffic from CloudDesk's IP range.

subject: CACHED FILES NOT DELETED ON LOGOUT ON MOBILE
body: HELLO SUPPORT TEAM. I NOTICED THAT FILES OPENED IN THE MOBILE APP REMAIN CACHED ON THE DEVICE EVEN AFTER LOGGING OUT AND THERE IS NO VISIBLE CLEAR CACHE OPTION WHICH IS A HUGE PRIVACY CONCERN IF A PHONE IS LOST WITH ERROR MOBILE_APP_CACHE_PERSISTENCE. MANY OF USERS ARE HITTING THIS AT THE SAME MOMENT RIGHT NOW. NO RUSH THOUGH AS IT CAN WAIT.
resolution: The mobile app caches files for offline access. To manually clear the cache, go to 'Settings' within the CloudDesk mobile app, then 'Storage' and select 'Clear Cached Files'. For automatic clearing on logout, enable 'Clear cache on logout' in the same settings menu. This setting is off by default.

subject: Requesting more detailed user activity reports
body: Our IT team is looking for more granular data than what is currently available in the basic audit logs. We would love to see reports covering specific downloads and user interaction actions. Thank you for considering this request.
resolution: We appreciate you sharing your interest in more robust reporting tools. Our current audit logs are limited, so we encourage you to outline your specific reporting needs on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This feedback is essential for our analytics team as they prioritize future platform improvements.

subject: Need to update our PO number for invoices
body: Hi, I need to update the PO number on our account for future billing cycles. I am seeing error BILL-PO-008 when trying to edit the field in our settings. Could you let me know the proper way to change this?
resolution: You can update this by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information'. Simply enter the new PO number in the designated field and save your changes. Note that this will apply to all invoices generated moving forward but will not retroactively change previously issued documents.

subject: Permission denied on shared workspace
body: A user on our free plan is getting a 403 error when trying to access a specific workspace. There is no major rush on this since they can wait a bit.
resolution: An administrator needs to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check 'Members' or 'Permissions' and ensure the user is correctly assigned with appropriate access rights.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful week so far. I was just talking to our regional director about the upcoming quarterly review next Tuesday, and she mentioned we need all our automated workflows running smoothly before the audit on Friday. We use your Pro plan and the API heavily for our operations. Lately, our Zap configured with the new file uploaded trigger has completely stopped working and throws error ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404. It appears several users are facing this identical trigger delay at this exact moment. We have a major presentation tomorrow morning, so I would really appreciate getting this resolved soon.
resolution: In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. Check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: Critical API key scope bypass vulnerability
body: We discovered that an API key generated with a read-only files scope is still able to execute delete user operations. This API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS is a severe security issue for our organization. We have a major security audit on Friday and this must be resolved immediately to ensure compliance.
resolution: Please revoke the compromised API key immediately in Admin Console > API Management. Investigate if the key was mistakenly generated with broader permissions initially or if there's an internal process misconfiguration. We acknowledge this is a critical security vulnerability and will escalate to engineering if revocation does not resolve the issue or if the scope bypass persists.

subject: Inquiry regarding custom enterprise billing options
body: We are currently using the free version of CloudDesk and are really enjoying the platform's features. As our team expands, we are looking into custom invoicing options instead of the standard credit card approach. Do you have a process for requesting a volume-based discount? We have encountered a BILL-FEAT-013 code while looking at upgrade options, so I thought I would reach out.
resolution: For tailored billing arrangements like annual invoicing or volume discounts, please reach out to our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com. You can also submit an inquiry through the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website to receive a custom proposal that fits your company's needs.

subject: Need custom annual invoicing and billing terms
body: Hello support. As an IT administrator on the pro plan, I am frustrated to find that we cannot set up annual invoicing or volume-based discounts directly through the self-serve portal. We are encountering error code BILL-FEAT-013 while trying to modify our payment terms. Please adjust our account when you have a moment.
resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal for your organization.

subject: Google SSO domain error
body: Hello, some of our users are seeing a 'Domain not allowed' message when trying to use Google SSO. Error code SSO-GOOGLE-403. I would appreciate your help whenever you have a moment.
resolution: This happens when a domain is not yet authorized in your account. Please log into your Admin Console, navigate to 'SSO & Identity' settings, and add the missing domains to your 'Allowed Domains' list.

subject: API returning 401 unauthorized errors
body: My scripts are currently failing with API-AUTH-401 errors. It seems like the tokens are suddenly rejected even though they were working fine yesterday. Please let me know how to resolve this.
resolution: It appears your existing tokens are no longer valid for current requests. Please regenerate your API token within the 'API & Integrations' area of the Admin Console. Make sure to use the new token in your 'Authorization: Bearer' header.

subject: GDPR export missing data
body: i did a gdpr export for one of my users but some comments are missing. i got the error gdpr_export_incomplete_comments in the log. i need to know how to get the rest of this.
resolution: The standard GDPR export covers your files and core profile data, but comment history is handled as separate activity metadata. To retrieve those, please visit the Activity tab on the specific files or tasks and use the individual export log feature. We do not currently offer a single bulk export for all comments across the entire platform.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA code rejected on desktop sync
body: Hello, one of our users is attempting to log in, but the MFA code from their Google Authenticator app is not accepted and does not appear to refresh. We see error code AUTH-MFA-401.2. Please help us get this sorted out soon.
resolution: Advise the user to ensure their phone time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, guide them through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app Security Settings page.

subject: Large file uploads failing with UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_504
body: Large files over 1GB are failing to upload and consistently timing out in the web app. The progress bar keeps stalling halfway through. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: Please check your internet connection speed. For files over 500MB, we recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads, as it supports resumable transfers. Also, verify if the issue persists across different browsers or if switching to a wired connection helps.

subject: Okta SSO login failing
body: Our team cannot log in via Okta anymore and we see an Invalid SSO token format error. We are trying to work but this is blocking us. Thank you for your assistance with this.
resolution: This is due to the authentication changes in our v4.2 update. Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your identity provider's metadata to ensure compatibility with the new token format.

subject: Webhook HMAC verification failed error
body: Our external service is rejecting incoming webhooks with code WEBHOOK-SIGN-403 because the signature verification is failing. Please provide guidance on this promptly as it is blocking our automated workflows.
resolution: Ensure the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the 'Webhook Secret' configured in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify your signature verification algorithm matches CloudDesk's (HMAC-SHA256).

subject: Urgent: Okta SSO access blocked for all users
body: We are unable to log into CloudDesk this morning following the recent platform update. My team has a strict audit deadline on Friday, and this disruption is preventing us from completing our work. The system is returning an 'Invalid SSO token format' error for everyone. Please assist us as soon as possible.
resolution: We are sorry for the trouble this update has caused. You must update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata to accommodate the new v4.2 token format. This step should resolve the login errors immediately.

subject: Switching subscription to annual billing
body: I have been trying to find where to switch our monthly plan to annual billing to get the discount, but the interface is very confusing. Please just tell me how to do it or change it for us.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' > 'Billing' > 'Subscription Details' > 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: Missing offline editing for mobile app
body: The app is so frustrating because I cant edit docs while offline. When I lose service, my changes just dont save and then I lose all my work. Can you fix this so it syncs up when I get connection back?
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with invalid token format
body: Hi support. Following the v4.2 update, our team members using Okta SSO can no longer log into the web app, receiving an invalid SSO token format error. This is actively blocking our employees from accessing their workspaces. Please investigate and assist with this urgently.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: api returning 401 unauthorized errors
body: Our automated systems are currently failing to connect to the platform. We are seeing frequent API-AUTH-401 errors when attempting to authenticate our integration. This is blocking our primary workflow. Could you please provide guidance on resolving this promptly?
resolution: It appears your existing authentication credentials have been invalidated. Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Once generated, ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your API requests.

subject: Desktop app high cpu usage error PERF-DSK-001
body: Hello, I am reaching out from our finance department. Lately, our enterprise users are experiencing constant high cpu and memory consumption from the desktop sync client, even when idle. This is showing error code PERF-DSK-001 on multiple machines and slowing down our finance workflows. Please look into this soon.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After reset, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: Password reset email not arriving for executive team member
body: Hi there team, I am writing on behalf of our leadership group because we are trying to access important files before our executive board meeting and audit review at 3pm today. Our director requested a password reset earlier but never received the email despite checking the spam folder thoroughly, even though other platform notifications arrive fine. We are seeing error code AUTH-PR-200.1 and really need this sorted out quickly to avoid delays.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and check if your company domain requires an approved email sender list. If so, advise your IT team to add no-reply@cloudesk.com to the allowlist, and we can also manually trigger a password reset directly from the Admin Console if needed.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: Hello, our team manager accidentally upgraded our free plan earlier today. We would like to request a refund for this transaction as it was not intended. Please let us know the next steps to resolve this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Need custom billing and annual invoicing setup
body: Hi support we need a custom billing arrangement like annual invoicing instead of credit card and some specific payment terms. Standard plans do not cover our volume discount needs. Let us know how to set this up when you have a moment.
resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: REFUND REQUEST FOR WRONG PLAN UPGRADE!
body: I was trying to test an API feature and the system upgraded our entire billing plan by mistake. I need this reversed and a refund issued immediately. I have not used any of the premium features. Please process this, error code BILL-REF-005.
resolution: We handle refund requests for accidental upgrades on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the transaction so we can verify that no premium features were utilized. Once confirmed, we will process the eligible refund.

subject: getting error when trying to download file content
body: hello team hope you are having a good day. some of our developers mentioned that calls to get files content are failing randomly with an error code API-500. it seems to happen mostly for documents stored in other regions. can someone please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Audit log export failing for date ranges over 90 days
body: Good morning, I tried to export our audit logs through the Admin Console for a date range covering the last four months, but the download failed immediately with an error message stating that the export range limit was exceeded. This AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED restriction is quite frustrating for our administrative reporting on the free tier, and we hope this can be addressed.
resolution: The Admin Console direct audit log export tool is indeed limited to a maximum of 90 days at a time. For longer historical periods, please use our API endpoint at v1/audit/export with your specific start and end dates using a pagination script. Alternatively, you can contact our support team to request a manual data pull if API access is not feasible for you.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with AUTH-402 error
body: Since the v4.2 update, our team is unable to sign in to the web app using Okta. We are consistently receiving an Invalid Token Format error, specifically code AUTH-402. This is currently blocking our entire department from accessing shared files. Please let us know how to resolve this promptly.
resolution: This issue is caused by the updated SSO token handling in v4.2. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk integration within your Okta console to match the new Audience URI and SAML URL values found in our v4.2 configuration guide under Settings in the Admin Console.

subject: Terrible lag when editing documents together!
body: When my team is working on a shared document at the same time, typing is super slow and cursors take forever to move. It is very annoying and slowing us down. Please fix this collab lag soon.
resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We also recommend having users close unnecessary browser tabs and clear their browser cache if the issue continues.

subject: Issue transferring workspace ownership
body: I am trying to transfer ownership of a workspace to a colleague, but the option is greyed out. I keep seeing CD-AM-004 when I try to save. Is there a limitation on who can become an owner?
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to someone who is already a member or administrator of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is added to the workspace first. Once they are a member, you can successfully complete the transfer through the 'Admin Console > Workspaces > Settings' menu.

subject: Subscription renewal payment failed
body: Our credit card payment failed for the subscription renewal and we are getting the BILL-PAY-002 error message. I have checked with the bank and everything is fine on their end. Please help us get this resolved so we do not lose access.
resolution: Please log in to the Admin Console and check your saved payment methods under the Billing tab. Make sure the billing address on file matches exactly what is registered with your bank. Once you have updated or re-entered the card details, you can manually trigger the payment retry from your invoices page.

subject: Password reset email not received by executive
body: Dear CloudDesk Support, one of our key executives requested a password reset but never received the email, despite checking their spam folder. We are receiving other system notifications just fine, but this specific AUTH-PR-200.1 issue is halting their work. We have an executive board meeting demo at 5 PM today and urgently need this sorted out.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and check if your corporate domain has an approved sender list. If necessary, ensure 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' is added to your allowlist, and we can also manually trigger a password reset from our end if needed.

subject: PDF and PPTX files showing blank page in web viewer
body: When trying to preview certain PDF and PPTX documents directly inside the web application, the preview viewer just shows a spinning loader indefinitely or renders a blank page. Downloading the files works fine. Could we get some assistance with this when possible?
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, and if that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito window to rule out extensions.

subject: Offline document editing in mobile app
body: Hello, I am writing to ask if there is a way to edit documents offline within the mobile app and have the changes sync once my internet connection is restored. As an executive assistant traveling frequently, this functionality would be very helpful for my daily workflow. Please let me know if this is currently supported on our PRO plan.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: My account is suspended and I cannot work
body: My access was suddenly revoked and the web app says CD-AM-002. I was a Member yesterday and now I am locked out completely. This is blocking my entire department. I need you to fix this immediately!
resolution: It appears your role was recently changed to Guest, which limits access to shared workspaces only. Please check the Admin Console under Team Management to verify your current role status. We recommend having your administrator update your role back to Member to restore full web application access.

subject: Critical SSO login failure
body: Our entire team is locked out of the system after the latest update. We are seeing AUTH-SSO-401.1 and cannot get any work done. We need this addressed right away as it is impacting all our active projects.
resolution: We understand the urgency of this login issue. Because of the v4.2 token format changes, you must re-upload your Identity Provider metadata in the Admin Console to restore access. Please perform this update as soon as possible to resolve the authentication error.

subject: API permission denied on user data export
body: Hello, our system uses an API key with the Admin scope to call the user data export endpoint, but today it started returning a 403 permission denied error. There is no major rush on this since we only run weekly exports, but we wanted to check why this suddenly stopped working. Thank you for your help.
resolution: Effective on the recent date of change, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Please generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role under Admin Console > API Management.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: My Zapier integration is not picking up new file uploads. I am getting ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 in the logs. We have an audit on Friday and need this data moved over. Please advise.
resolution: Please try refreshing your connection within the Zapier settings to re-authenticate the trigger. Verify that the account connected has the necessary permissions to access these events, and you can check your CloudDesk audit logs to confirm the event was registered.

subject: Need more detailed user activity reports
body: Our office is looking for better reporting on file downloads and specific collaboration actions. The current audit logs are not detailed enough for our management team. Do you have a plan to add these features soon?
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced activity reporting. Since our current logs are limited, please head over to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting to detail your specific use cases. Your feedback helps our analytics team prioritize future updates.

subject: blank page when previewing files in web app
body: hello team. when users try to preview pdf and pptx files inside the web app the viewer shows a blank page or spinning loader with error PREVIEW-006. downloading works fine. want it fixed when possible.
resolution: Hello! This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito or private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it is not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Customizing the SSO login page
body: Hello. We would like to know if it is possible to add our company logo and custom branding colors to the SSO login page. We can wait for a reply as this is not pressing.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available. We recognize this as a valuable feature for many enterprises. Please add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding. We will notify you of any updates.

subject: Custom branding missing on SSO page
body: Good morning team, we noticed that when users are redirected to our SSO login screen, our company logo and background image are missing. It is just showing the default CloudDesk branding instead, with error code SSO-UI-200.2 appearing in our console. Take your time looking into this as it is not urgent, but we would love to have our custom branding back when convenient.
resolution: Guide the admin to the 'SSO & Branding' section in the Admin Console. Check if the custom branding assets (logo, background) are uploaded and saved correctly. Advise clearing browser cache for affected users.

subject: google sso login redirect loop
body: we are stuck in a redirect loop when trying to log in with google sso. it never reaches the dashboard. please look into this.
resolution: Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com, then attempt to log in again. If that does not work, try using an incognito window or a different browser to rule out extension conflicts. You may also want to verify your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Cannot update company name in console
body: I am trying to change our company name in the settings, but the field is currently read-only. I am seeing error CD-AM-010 when I try to save. This is quite frustrating as we need to update our branding. Could you please advise?
resolution: The company name is currently linked to your billing profile, which is why the field appears locked in basic settings. You must navigate to Admin Console > Subscription & Billing to update the Organization Name there. Once that is saved, the new name will automatically update across your account.

subject: SSO login loop on desktop sync app
body: Hello support, I have problem with login on desktop app using SSO. Browser opens and redirects back, but sync client still show login failed error and I cannot access my synced folders. This is blocking my work today and I need prompt help to fix this issue as soon as possible please.
resolution: Hello. Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version, v4.2.1 or newer, to resolve error DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. Please also check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, you can try logging in via email and password if SSO is not strictly enforced by your admin.

subject: Password reset email not arriving in user inbox
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a good week. One of our developers requested a password reset, but the email never arrived, even after checking the spam folder and confirming other notification emails come through successfully. We have a normal development sprint timeline so there is no immediate rush, but we would love to get this looked at when you have a moment. Thank you for your help.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Check if the user's domain is configured with an approved email sender list. If not, advise adding 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to their allowlist. Manually trigger a password reset from the Admin Console if necessary.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade refund request
body: Our account was accidentally upgraded to the PRO plan yesterday due to a misclick in the dashboard. We would like to request a refund for this transaction as it was unintended. Let me know what details you need.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Login failed for desktop client with SSO
body: I am so incredibly frustrated! I'm trying to log into the desktop sync client using our company's single sign-on, but it just keeps failing. The browser redirects like it's supposed to, but then the client never authenticates. I just get a generic 'Login Failed' message. I need to access my files, and this is completely blocking my work. subject: Cannot remove user from workspace

Note that policies apply strictly to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files currently residing in the 'Trash Bin' remain subject to user-initiated recovery and are not automatically purged by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge the Trash after a set number of days.
