It is showing default cloudesk branding instead for everyone in our office. We see error code SSO-UI-200.2 on screen. Please let me know how to fix this when you have time.
resolution: To resolve the branding issue, please navigate to the 'SSO & Branding' section within your Admin Console. Verify that your custom logo and background assets are correctly uploaded and saved. Once confirmed, have your affected users clear their browser cache and the correct branding will appear.

subject: Mobile app giving network error on iOS
body: I cannot log into the mobile app at all right now and keep getting a generic network error despite having full internet connectivity. The error code shown is MOBILE-NET-500.1. It seems a bunch of people are experiencing this same glitch today. No rush on this since we can use the desktop version for now, but please look into it when you have a chance.
resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache/data (Android) or reinstalling the app (iOS/Android). Verify server status on our status page.

subject: Unable to preview files, error PREVIEW-006
body: We are currently unable to preview any PDF or PPTX files in our web account. We keep seeing error PREVIEW-006 and the screen just loads forever. This is quite problematic because we have an internal audit scheduled for Friday and need to review these documents. Could you please look into this right away?
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies first, or test this in an incognito window to rule out extension conflicts. If you still see the error, please confirm if the specific files are password-protected.

subject: Billing section failing with authentication error after update
body: Hello support, since the v4.2 release our IT admins encounter authentication issues when managing billing. Other functions work fine but updating payment methods throws an error specifically in the billing console. Please assist us promptly.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: User Activity report not showing data
body: hi there, the user activity report page is loading fine in the admin console, but it remains completely blank. other reports work well.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and attempting to access the report again, or try a different browser to ensure no extensions are interfering.

subject: Okta SSO broken after update
body: Hi, none of our team members using Okta SSO can log into the web app anymore since this morning. We keep getting an invalid SSO token format error, specifically code AUTH-SSO-401.1. This is a critical blocker for our contractors who need access immediately. Please investigate and fix this right away.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: password reset email not received
body: i requested a password reset but the email never arrived even in my spam. i have the error code cd-am-008. i need this fixed to get back to work today.
resolution: Please have an administrator verify the email address in Team Management. If the email is correct, ask the user to whitelist no-reply@cloudesk.com, or have an admin manually trigger a password reset for them.

subject: Audit log retention limit stuck at twelve months
body: I am trying to set the audit log retention period in the Admin Console to more than 1 year for compliance purposes, but I found that the maximum selectable value is only 12 months. There is no option to extend this further. We need to retain records for 5 years.
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution (e.g., Splunk, Sumo Logic) via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. This is a FEATURE_REQUEST for extending native retention.

subject: Storage limit is too small
body: Our small team is constantly running out of storage space on the free plan. We really cannot afford to upgrade right now but we need more room for our project files. Can you please increase our storage limit?
resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time, so please consider our paid plans for expanded storage.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA code rejected
body: Hello, one of our users is unable to log in because their Google Authenticator app codes are consistently being rejected by the system, and the tokens do not seem to be syncing correctly. Could you advise on how to resolve this authentication issue?
resolution: Advise the user to ensure their phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, guide them through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app's 'Security Settings' page.

subject: Desktop sync creating endless conflict files!
body: Hello Support, the desktop sync client is constantly flagging files as Conflict even when nobody else is editing them! This creates tons of unnecessary duplicate files like filename (Conflict 2023-10-27).docx and is driving our finance team crazy with SYNC-003 errors. Please help us sort this out soon.
resolution: We are currently investigating a surge in reports regarding unexpected sync conflicts. This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus and firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus or firewall, test syncing again, and add CloudDesk to your security whitelist if successful while ensuring your network is stable.

subject: Noticeable lag during collaborative document editing
body: When multiple users are editing a CloudDesk Office document simultaneously, there is noticeable lag of several seconds between typing and seeing changes reflected for other collaborators. Cursor positions update slowly too. This COLLAB_LAG issue is quite frustrating for our team, though we can manage for now.
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved. Advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs/applications. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document. Clear browser cache for all users.

subject: Sync client creating duplicate conflict files
body: Good afternoon. I hope you are having a pleasant week. As an external contractor helping out with document management on the free tier, I have noticed that the desktop sync client keeps flagging files as conflicts even when nobody else is editing them, which leaves us with extra copies named like filename (Conflict 2023-10-27).docx. It is not urgent and I can wait, but I wanted to report it since a lot of files are piling up.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus and firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your security software and try syncing again, and if successful, add CloudDesk to your software's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable to prevent future false conflicts.

subject: Data retention policy not working
body: We set a 30-day retention policy but files are staying in the trash bin forever. I am seeing error code RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED and this is a significant compliance issue for us. Please address this urgently.
resolution: Please verify that the retention policy is correctly configured for Deleted Files in the Data Retention section of the Admin Console. Policies apply to files in the Permanently Deleted state; files in the Trash Bin are subject to user-initiated recovery unless specifically configured to purge the Trash after a certain time.

subject: Azure ad nested groups mapping problem after upgrade
body: Ever since we updated to v4.2 our azure ad integration wont let us map nested groups for workspace user provisioning. This is really slowing down our financial department setup and causing headaches. Can you tell us how to fix this soon
resolution: Following the SSO token format change in v4.2, our current Azure AD SSO integration supports direct group mapping but not nested group resolution. We are aware of this limitation and are evaluating solutions. Please add your use case to roadmap.cloudesk.com/v4.2-enhancements/nested-azure-ad-groups. A potential workaround might involve flattening your Azure AD groups.

subject: need ms teams integration
body: hey is there a way to integrate with teams yet. its a struggle to copy paste links all day. seeing errors when trying to bridge the two. hope you guys can add this soon.
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a native direct integration is not yet available. Please visit roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams to add your requirements or vote for this feature. We evaluate new integration requests based on feedback from our developer community.

subject: Unrecognized charge on our corporate billing statement
body: Hello support team, we noticed a line item charge from CloudDesk on our credit card statement that we cannot quite reconcile with our expected ENTERPRISE plan billing. Could you please take a look at this for us when you have a moment? We truly appreciate your assistance in clarifying this transaction.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide full details on the charge.

subject: need more detailed audit reports
body: our current audit logs are too basic for our needs. we need to see specific download and view actions for users. is there a way to get more granular data?
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic tracking, but for more advanced capabilities, please describe your specific use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This helps our analytics team prioritize your requirements.

subject: User Activity report page is blank
body: Hi team, when I try to open the User Activity report in the admin console on our pro plan, the page loads completely blank. All other reports seem to work fine. No huge rush on this, just wanted to report it.
resolution: This blank screen typically points to a temporary data retrieval hitch in the reporting module. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, or try loading the page in an alternate browser to bypass any extension interference; if it remains blank, let us know the exact date range you are trying to view.

subject: Incorrect VAT rate on our monthly invoice
body: Dear CloudDesk support team, I hope this message finds you well. We noticed that the tax rate applied to our recent invoice seems incorrect based on our registered business location. Thank you so much for your assistance with this billing matter.
resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID (if applicable) under 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information'. If these details are correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate (if applicable) for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: Account locked after failed login attempts
body: Hi, one of our staff members is seeing an account locked message after entering their password incorrectly a few times. They are now using the correct credentials but still cannot log in. Please help us unlock their account when you get a chance.
resolution: Instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under Users, then Manage User, and selecting Unlock Account.

subject: Existing API key returning 401 unauthorized error
body: Hi there, one of our existing API keys is suddenly throwing a 401 unauthorized error even though it was working fine yesterday. No major rush since we are just testing, but please let us know what's going on.
resolution: Verify the API key's status in the Admin Console ('API Keys' section). Check if it has expired or been revoked. Advise the user to regenerate a new API key if necessary and update their application.

subject: Mobile app keeps logging me out
body: Since the recent 4.2 update, I am seeing CD-AM-011 errors on my mobile device constantly. It forces me to log in again every few hours, which is quite disruptive to my workflow. Is there a fix for this?
resolution: The v4.2 update included enhanced security for session management. Please log out of the mobile app completely, reinstall it to ensure a clean state, and log back in to generate a new compatible session token.

subject: api keys stopped working
body: hey my app stopped working today and keeps saying api-auth-401.4. i checked the key and it looks fine on my end. can you please look into this as soon as possible, it is really disrupting our reporting.
resolution: It appears your API key may have reached a status where it is no longer accepted by our system. Please check the API Keys section of your Admin Console to confirm if the key has expired. If it has, simply generate a new key and update your application settings to resolve this.

subject: Critical API auth error
body: Our integration is failing with an API-AUTH-401 error, and all our automated services are currently down. We have a hard deadline for a payroll run tomorrow morning and this is blocking everything. Please help us get this resolved as soon as possible.
resolution: Please regenerate your API token by visiting the API & Integrations section within the Admin Console. Once you have the new token, ensure it is correctly formatted in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your API requests. This should resolve the unauthorized access issues you are experiencing.

subject: audit log missing failed or suspicious logins
body: we suspect a security breach because of weird login locations on our free plan but they are not showing up in the login activity audit log. we need to see all attempts immediately.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses or locations are recorded in the Security Events log, not Login Activity. Navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events for this information and enable Login Anomaly Detection for automatic alerts.

subject: Jira integration setup failing to sync projects
body: Hello, our Jira integration setup is failing to sync projects or create issues. The CloudDesk integration logs show a Jira API permission denied error. Please look into this when possible.
resolution: Hello. Please ensure that the Jira API token or specific user configured for the CloudDesk integration has both 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions granted for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance.

subject: MFA codes not working on mobile
body: The Google Authenticator codes are not being accepted. I have an important audit on Friday, so I need this resolved. The app shows AUTH-MFA-401.2.
resolution: Please ensure your phone's clock is set to sync automatically with the network. If that doesn't work, you can reset your MFA setup through the 'Security Settings' page on the web app.

subject: Audit log retention limit to 12 months only
body: hi team we need to set audit log retention to 5 yrs for compliance but the max value is stuck at 12 mos with AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT. is there a way to increase this natively
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is indeed 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution like Splunk or Sumo Logic using our API or SFTP export feature.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade refund request
body: We accidentally upgraded our plan through the API and need a refund for the charge immediately. This is blocking our internal billing reconciliations.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account.

subject: sso token error after 4.2 update
body: Hello, ever since the v4.2 update our okta sso users cant log in anymore. they are getting invalid sso token format errors with code AUTH-SSO-401.1. we have a critical client presentation in one hour and nobody can get into the system. please fix this asap.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Workspace activity log showing incorrect user for file actions
body: Hello CloudDesk team, we noticed in the workspace activity log that certain file actions are attributed to the wrong user, often an administrator, even when a regular user performed them. We are on the pro plan and see error code AUDIT-004. Thank you so much for your help.
resolution: This is a known display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with contributor roles when an administrator is active in the same workspace, though the underlying audit trail is correct. For an accurate audit in the meantime, please cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console while our team addresses this bug.

subject: Lag during simultaneous document editing
body: Hi there! We noticed today that when multiple people are editing a CloudDesk Office document together, there is a delay of several seconds before typing shows up for others. Thank you for your help with this whenever you have a moment.
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved. Advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs/applications. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document. Clear browser cache for all users.

subject: CloudDeskSync.exe high CPU and memory usage
body: We are observing severe performance degradation on multiple free tier machines where the CloudDesk Sync process exceeds fifty percent CPU and two gigabytes of memory while completely idle. This is heavily impacting our daily IT operations and needs prompt attention. Error code SYNC_HIGH_RESOURCE_USAGE has been logged across workstations. Please advise immediately.
resolution: Check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed. Advise user to pause sync, restart their computer, then resume sync. If persistent, suggest disabling sync for non-critical folders or temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks. Check for conflicting antivirus software.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: Hello. I am writing because when attempting to log in using Google SSO today, I get stuck in a redirect loop and never reach the dashboard. The error code is AUTH-SSO-302.1. It is not urgent since I can wait, but wanted to report it.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: CRITICAL: Offline document editing missing from mobile app
body: We desperately need the ability to edit documents offline within the mobile app and have those changes sync automatically once internet connectivity returns. Our field teams are constantly blocked by this limitation right now. Please add this feature immediately.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: Files not syncing after v4.2 update
body: Since the update to 4.2 my desktop sync client has stopped working. Files added in the web app dont show up on my machine. No error messages but just not syncing SYNC-001 is popping up. Please fix.
resolution: This is a known issue after the v4.2 upgrade. Please uninstall your current client, delete the sync cache folder in your local AppData or Library directory, and perform a fresh install from the web app. This should clear the SYNC-001 error and restore connectivity.

subject: New REST API integration failing with 403 Forbidden
body: Hello, we are attempting to set up a new integration using your REST API under our free plan, but every request fails with an API-AUTH-403.5 client not authorized error. We have verified our API key is active, so we are quite frustrated by this roadblock. Please assist us in getting this connection established.
resolution: Confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes/permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: Account locked out with AUTH-LOCK-429.1 error
body: We are experiencing a widespread issue where users are unable to sign in to the web app despite using the correct credentials. They are receiving an Account Locked message accompanied by error code AUTH-LOCK-429.1. This is currently blocking our team's workflow entirely. Could you please provide instructions on how to resolve this as soon as possible?
resolution: Please have an administrator navigate to the Admin Console under Users and select Manage User to manually unlock the affected accounts. Alternatively, users can wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire automatically. We apologize for the disruption.

subject: Workspace invite emails not arriving
body: We are trying to invite new team members to our workspace but they are not receiving the invitation emails at all. The status shows as Pending and we have a major client audit on Friday so we need this working fast.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam and junk folders first. If not found there, ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for required DNS entries.

subject: Webhook delivery issues
body: Our webhooks are failing with a WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 error. Please look into this as we are not receiving any event notifications in our system.
resolution: Please verify the endpoint URL you have configured in your Webhooks settings. Ensure your external server is accessible from the public internet and that your firewall is configured to allow incoming traffic from the CloudDesk IP range as outlined in our technical documentation.

subject: New REST API integration returning client error
body: Our new integration using the CloudDesk REST API wont work at all and keeps throwing a 403 Forbidden error even though our API key is valid. Its extremely frustrating that nothing is connecting right now when we need it finished today. Please look into this promptly so we can get past this blocker.
resolution: Please confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes and permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: Account suspended due to payment issue
body: Dear support team, we noticed a suspension banner and an overdue payment notice regarding error BILL-SUSP-007. All users are currently locked out right before our payroll run tomorrow morning, so your immediate assistance is greatly appreciated.
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Invoices' and paying the overdue invoice. Once payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: Slow loading times for large workspaces
body: Hello! We have noticed that workspaces with over 10,000 items take quite a while to load and sometimes display a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT spinner. It is not an urgent matter for us since we can wait, but I wanted to report it as our team is seeing similar delays. Thank you for your hard work.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade refund request
body: I am extremely frustrated as our team account was accidentally upgraded to a paid plan today. This was not authorized and is causing issues with our internal budget processing, with the error BILL-REF-005 showing on the invoice. Can you please cancel this and issue a refund immediately?
resolution: We handle accidental upgrade refunds on a case-by-case basis. To proceed, please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that no features from the new plan have been used. Once verified, we will review your account for a potential refund.

subject: Okta SSO login error AUTH-SSO-401.1 after v4.2 update
body: Users attempting to log in via Okta SSO are encountering AUTH-SSO-401.1 and the invalid SSO token format error following the v4.2 update. This is blocking our entire team from accessing their workspaces. Please provide prompt assistance.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This step is required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in the v4.2 release.

subject: User cannot login after role change
body: I recently changed a user from Member to Guest and now they cant get into the app at all. They get an error saying Insufficient Permissions, code CD-AM-002. Is there something else I need to do to make this work? I need to get this sorted out quickly.
resolution: Guest users have restricted access and must be explicitly invited to specific workspaces. Please check the 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' section to confirm the role assignment. You can either ensure they have an active invitation to a workspace or update their role back to 'Member' if they require full account access.

subject: Change billing from monthly to annual
body: Hi, I'd like to change our subscription from monthly to annual billing to take advantage of the discount. Can you help me with this or tell me how to do it?
resolution: You can easily switch your billing cycle from monthly to annual through your Admin Console. Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' and then select 'Change Plan'. Choose the annual option for your current plan. The change will be applied at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: Critical API scope bypass security vulnerability
body: An API key with read-only scope is executing delete operations. This is a severe security issue that must be addressed immediately under API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS.
resolution: Revoke the compromised API key immediately in Admin Console > API Management. Investigate if the key was mistakenly generated with broader permissions initially or if there's an internal process misconfiguration. Acknowledge this is a critical security vulnerability and escalate to engineering if revocation does not resolve the issue or if the scope bypass persists.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: Hello, our account was unintentionally upgraded to the higher tier yesterday. Could we please request a review for a refund on this transaction? Thank you very much for your assistance.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account for eligibility.

subject: Switch subscription to annual billing
body: Hello team, we would like to switch our subscription from monthly to annual billing to take advantage of annual discounts. We need this sorted before our financial audit on Friday. Please let us know how to proceed.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to Admin Console > Billing > Subscription Details > Change Plan. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: user login access issue
body: I am working on the payroll run for tomorrow morning, but one of our team members is locked out. We changed their role to guest yesterday, and now they see the cd-am-002 error code when trying to log in. It is very stressful because we have a lot of work to finish by the deadline. Can you help us resolve this today?
resolution: Guest users are restricted and can only access workspaces they have been explicitly invited to. You should check the user's current role in the Admin Console under Team Management to verify if they have active invitations to the necessary workspaces. If the user requires full access to your environment, please change their role back to Member or Admin.

subject: New user getting login error
body: A new hire cannot log in and gets AUTH-NF-404.1 every time. I am annoyed because this happens every time we onboard someone. Can you fix this?
resolution: Please verify the email address used for the user's account in the Admin Console to ensure there are no typos. Confirm the invitation was sent and that the user has successfully accepted it. If they still cannot log in, please ensure they are attempting to sign into the correct instance URL for your organization.

subject: Newly invited user getting User Not Found error
body: One of our new hires tried to log in today but received an error message stating 'User Not Found'. We have verified their email address on our end. Is there a known issue with the login service right now? I am seeing error code AUTH-NF-404.1 on their screen.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, try resending the invitation and ensure the user is accessing the correct instance URL.

subject: Cannot delete workspace due to active integrations
body: I am trying to delete a workspace but the system says there are active integrations. It mentions error CD-AM-007. How do I remove these?
resolution: To successfully delete a workspace, you must first remove all linked integrations such as Slack or Zapier. Please go to the workspace settings menu and select the integrations tab to disable them individually. Once those are cleared, you will be able to proceed with the deletion.

subject: accidental plan upgrade refund
body: hey i noticed my account was upgraded to pro by mistake and i need a refund for the charge please let me know what you need
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Okta SSO login broken since v4.2 update
body: We cant log into our accounts anymore since the update. Its giving us an Invalid Token Format error and its blocking all our work. Fix this asap please.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token handling requirements. Please have your IT administrator update the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL in your Okta console to match the new v4.2 configuration guide found in your Admin Console settings.

subject: API key scope bypass security vulnerability
body: We found a critical issue where our restricted read-only API key was able to delete users on our free account. This security bypass is completely unacceptable and exposes us to massive risk. We need this fixed immediately before any further data is compromised.
resolution: Revoke the compromised API key immediately in Admin Console > API Management. Investigate if the key was mistakenly generated with broader permissions initially or if there's an internal process misconfiguration. Acknowledge this is a critical security vulnerability and escalate to engineering if revocation does not resolve the issue or if the scope bypass persists.

subject: User Not Found error for newly invited user
body: Hello support, we recently invited a new developer to join our team workspace, but when they attempt to log in using their credentials, they receive AUTH-NF-404.1. We would appreciate your assistance in getting their account recognized properly.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: sso session expired errors after update
body: our team keeps getting logged out with sso session expired messages since yesterday. we use okta and azure ad on our pro plan and people have to sign in constantly now. please fix this asap as it is blocking our work.
resolution: v4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta/Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: Google login not working for our team
body: Hi, our staff cant login using google sso. Its giving a 'Domain not allowed' error code SSO-GOOGLE-403. Can you take a look when you have a moment thanks.
resolution: Please navigate to the SSO & Identity section of your Admin Console. You will need to check your Allowed Domains list and ensure the affected domains are added there to permit Google SSO access.

subject: API failure preventing workspace creation for our afternoon demo
body: We are getting an API-403 error whenever we try to share a workspace via our scripts. Our team lead has the Manager role, and we need this resolved by 5pm today for a client demo. This is completely blocking our workflow. Please look into why our POST calls are being rejected.
resolution: Please ensure the API key you are using has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Additionally, the user associated with that key must be a direct member of the target workspace rather than having access only through a group. If these settings are correct and you still see the API-403 error, please send over the API key ID and workspace ID for our investigation.

subject: New member invites not arriving
body: We have a major audit this Friday and need to get our new team members onboarded. The invites we send out stay in a pending state and users are reporting that the emails are never received. We are seeing EMAIL-005 in our logs, and I am concerned about missing our deadline. Please investigate why these invitations are stuck.
resolution: Please have the affected users check their spam or junk folders first. You should also ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains by checking our Email Delivery Troubleshooting guide. If you still see issues, please send us the specific email addresses for a manual investigation.

subject: Search performance issues in specific workspaces
body: I have noticed that searching for files in some of our larger workspaces is extremely slow or causes the loading spinner to hang indefinitely. It specifically mentions WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG in the browser console. It is not an urgent matter, but it would be helpful if you could look into it when you have a moment.
resolution: These search delays often occur if a workspace contains a massive number of files or extremely deep folder nesting. We suggest using more specific search terms or path filters to help the system index the results faster. subject: deleted user still showing in workspaces
body: hey support we deleted a user account yesterday but their name still pop up in workspace sharing dialogs. we noticed error code CD-AM-006 on some screens. no real hurry on this since its just a minor visual thing
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as 'ghost' entries in historical share lists until the system purges them (typically within 24-48 hours) or until a workspace owner explicitly removes them from a share via 'Workspace Settings > Members'. This is expected behavior.

subject: Subscription Renewal Failed Due to Declined Card
body: Our automatic subscription renewal recently failed because of a declined credit card on file. We received the automated payment failure notification and currently see a Payment Failed status along with error code BILL-PAY-002 in the billing section. This is currently blocking our admin tasks, so we require prompt assistance.
resolution: Please navigate to the Admin Console under Billing and then Payment Methods to update your credit card details or add a valid replacement. Ensure your billing address matches the card on file with your bank, and you can then manually retry the pending payment from the Invoices section.

subject: Admin Console Access Denied Error
body: Whenever I try to log into the Admin Console, I am immediately redirected to the standard user dashboard or given an Access Denied message. I need this resolved because I am an administrator and cannot manage my users. The error code shown is ADMIN-AUTH-403.3.
resolution: Please confirm the user's role in the Admin Console via Users > Manage User > Roles. Ensure they have an Admin or Super Admin role assigned to them, and update their role if it is currently set to standard user.

subject: Need file upload webhooks for our api integration
body: We are trying to build an auto-processing pipeline but the api doesnt have a webhook for new file uploads. This is really slowing down our dev work. Can you add this feature soon?
resolution: Thank you for reaching out regarding our API functionality. While we currently only support polling for file changes, we are constantly looking to improve our services. Please submit a detailed proposal of your requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so our engineering team can review it.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade refund request
body: Dear support team, we accidentally upgraded our plan to Pro due to a misclick in the desktop sync client. We have a payroll run tomorrow and urgently request a refund for this upgrade before it creates accounting issues. Thank you very much for your prompt help.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account for eligibility.

subject: Urgent: Okta SSO logins failing
body: Our entire team is currently blocked from accessing CloudDesk via Okta. Users are receiving an 'Invalid SSO token format' error, which includes code AUTH-SSO-401.1. Given that this is impacting all our employees, could you please look into this as a matter of urgency?
resolution: We have identified that the v4.2 update changed the SSO token format. Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata. This should restore access for your users immediately.

subject: Just-in-time provisioning not working
body: We have Just-in-Time provisioning enabled, but new users are not being automatically added to our CloudDesk account when they sign in via SSO. We are receiving error code CD-AM-009 during the process. Could you please investigate why this automation is failing?
resolution: Please verify that your Identity Provider is correctly sending the required user attributes like email and name in the assertion. Ensure that you have enough available seats in your subscription to accommodate these new users. You can also review the 'SSO Settings' in your Admin Console for any recent configuration errors.

subject: New user cannot login
body: Hello, I invite a new colleague to our workspace but she gets User Not Found error when she try to log in. I see error code AUTH-NF-404.1 on her screen. Maybe I do something wrong? Thank you for help with this.
resolution: Please verify the email address you entered for your colleague within the Admin Console. Ensure that the invitation was actually sent and that she has clicked the link to accept it. If the invite is pending, you may want to resend it to ensure she is authenticated against the correct instance.

subject: Need better folder permssions
body: Hi, we are trying to set up our file sharing but we need to restrict some users to view-only or comment-only access in subfolders. Right now we only have basic options and it is making our workflow difficult. Is there any way to change this because we really need more granular control for our project team.
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding the need for more granular permission controls. Currently, our system handles access at the folder level. Please submit your detailed requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions so our product team can review your specific use case.

subject: 403 error on data export API endpoint
body: I am getting an API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED error when calling the export data endpoint with my Admin key. This process has been working fine for months until today. Could you please look into why the scope permissions are suddenly failing for my account?
resolution: As of the latest update, the Admin API scope no longer includes Data Export permissions. You will need to assign the new Data Steward role to your API key. Please generate a new key with this specific scope in the Admin Console under API Management.

subject: Desktop Sync client stuck syncing forever
body: Our finance team relies on CloudDesk but the desktop icon has been stuck on 'Indexing' for hours with SYNC_STATUS_STUCK showing in the logs. Files are not updating and it is critical for our monthly reporting today. We appreciate your immediate attention to this.
resolution: Please restart the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache by going to 'Settings' > 'Advanced' > 'Clear Cache'. If the problem remains, you may need to perform a full reinstall of the client after backing up your local unsynced files.

subject: Invitation emails not arriving to invited members
body: Hi team, thanks for your help. When we invite folks to our workspace, the emails never show up and they stay stuck as pending. No real rush on this though.
resolution: Kindly check the spam and junk folders of the affected email accounts first. If they are still missing, verify that your email domain has proper SPF and DKIM records configured to accept mail from our sending servers.

subject: Incorrect user attribution in activity log
body: Hello support, thank you for your great platform. I noticed that in our workspace activity log, certain file actions are attributed to the wrong user, often an administrator, even when a regular user performed the action. AUDIT-004 is displayed. No rush on this, but we appreciate your help whenever convenient.
resolution: Hello! This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct. This is a known bug we are addressing. For accurate audit, cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: Question regarding Jira integration setup
body: Hello CloudDesk support team, we are currently trying to connect our Jira workspace from the admin-console on our PRO plan. Unfortunately, it is throwing an error and won't sync our projects. No rush at all, but we would appreciate your guidance whenever convenient.
resolution: Ensure the Jira API token or user configured for the CloudDesk integration has 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance.

subject: Request for video conferencing integration
body: We really need direct video conferencing integration in our workspaces to coordinate our remote team. It is extremely frustrating that this is not available yet. When will you add this?
resolution: Currently, we focus on file and project collaboration, but you can share meeting links directly within your workspace comments. For new features, please submit your request to our roadmap portal, which helps us gauge demand for future integrations.

subject: Enhanced user activity reporting request
body: Good morning, We are looking for more detailed reports on user activity, specifically regarding file downloads, views, and collaborative actions within CloudDesk. The current audit logs provide basic information, but our compliance team requires a deeper level of insight. Could you provide options or a timeline for this?
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on API content endpoint
body: Our integration is failing because the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint is returning random 500 errors. It is happening mostly when we try to fetch files from different regions. This is blocking our primary workflow. What is going on?
resolution: We are currently investigating a root cause related to distributed storage retrieval. In the meantime, please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your client to handle these intermittent errors while we prepare a hotfix.

subject: Unable to download invoices in PDF format from Admin Console
body: Hello, when attempting to download our billing invoices from the Admin Console, the system only provides a CSV format. Our accounting department specifically requires PDF files for our monthly financial records. Please advise on how we can access the PDF versions.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: incorrect vat on invoice
body: our latest invoice has the wrong vat rate applied. this is very frustrating as our tax exemption status is already on file. please look into this bill-tax-006 error as soon as you can.
resolution: I apologize for the frustration regarding your invoice. Please verify that your billing address and tax ID are current under the 'Billing Information' tab in your Admin Console. If those details are accurate, please send us your company's full legal name and your tax exemption certificate so we can manually review and correct your settings.

subject: Seat limit reached error when adding members
body: Hello, I am attempting to add new team members to our free workspace, but I keep receiving a seat limit reached error. However, our subscription details show that we still have available seats. Please advise.
resolution: Please verify the Pending Invitations count in Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Need longer expiration for public shared links
body: It is frustrating that our shared links keep expiring so quickly. We really need a way to set them for much longer durations or even never. The current limits are hindering our workflow, and I have heard other teams are struggling with this too. Do you have any plans to allow longer link lifetimes?
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is enforced based on our security best practices. While we do not currently support 'never expire' links, we are considering extending the maximum duration. Please share your specific use cases at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration so our team can evaluate this.

subject: MFA setup on mobile is broken
body: Hey, we are trying to set up mfa on our iphones but keep getting error MFA-MOB-002 after scanning the code. Could you look into this when you have a chance? thanks.
resolution: This is a known limitation with the current mobile app registration flow. Please have your users complete the MFA configuration through the web app under Settings and Security instead. Once enabled there, it will work seamlessly across both your web and mobile sessions.

subject: MFA failing before our big client audit tomorrow
body: I cannot log into my mobile app because the MFA code from Google Authenticator is completely rejected with error AUTH-MFA-401.2. We have a strict security audit on Friday and I need this fixed immediately to avoid severe compliance delays.
resolution: Please advise the user to ensure their phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, we can guide them through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app's Security Settings page.

subject: frequent re-authentication on desktop sync
body: hi, after the 4.2 update our team is constanty being logged out of the desktop sync app. we see an SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 error. this is really slowing us down, could you please help us fix this as soon as possible?
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how SSO tokens are handled, which may require a clean state for your client. Please perform a full uninstall, restart your machine, and reinstall the latest version of the Desktop Sync client. If the problem continues, have your SSO administrator verify the token lifetime settings or regenerate the application secret in the Admin Console.

subject: API folder files returning 404
body: Good morning. Our scripts are receiving a 404 error when hitting the folders files endpoint even though the IDs are totally correct. This API-NOTFOUND-404 behavior is extremely frustrating.
resolution: Verify the API endpoint path and HTTP method against the latest CloudDesk API documentation. Ensure the resource ID (e.g., folder ID) is valid and accessible to the API token's permissions.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: Our account was upgraded to the PRO plan yesterday by mistake. We need this corrected before our payroll run tomorrow as our budget is strictly monitored. Please reverse this charge and issue a refund. We have not used any new features. We encountered error code BILL-REF-005 when trying to view the billing details. Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. Once we verify this, we will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Desktop Sync client is stuck
body: Hello, our team is really enjoying the platform, but the desktop sync client has been stuck on 'Indexing' for a while now. We are seeing error code SYNC_STATUS_STUCK and it is blocking our current project work. Could you please help us get this syncing again promptly? Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: Instruct user to restart the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache: go to 'Settings' > 'Advanced' > 'Clear Cache'. If still unresolved, suggest a full reinstall of the client after backing up local unsynced files.

subject: Want to change subscription from monthly to annual billing
body: Hello, I want to change our subscription from monthly to annual billing. We wish to take advantage of the annual discount. Please tell me how I can do this. It is important for us to save money. I am getting error BILL-PLAN-004.
resolution: To switch your billing cycle from monthly to annual, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details'. From there, select 'Change Plan' and choose the annual option for your current subscription. The change will be applied at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: Inquiry regarding custom annual billing arrangements
body: As a growing organization on the PRO plan, we are interested in discussing alternative billing terms, specifically annual invoicing and volume-based discounts. Could you let us know what options are available for our account? We look forward to your response at your convenience.
resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the Enterprise Inquiry form on our website. Our sales representatives will be happy to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: Permission Denied error when exporting data via API
body: Hello, our system is using an API key with Admin scope to call the /v1/users/{userId}/data/export endpoint, but it is returning a 403 Permission Denied error. This feature was working fine until recently. Please let us know how to resolve this.
resolution: Effective recently, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Please generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in Admin Console > API Management.

subject: incorrect user roles shown in admin panel
body: The roles in the admin console are showing up wrong. Some managers are listed as contributors. UI-ADMIN-003 error maybe? Im super frustrated because we have a security audit on Friday and I need this to look right.
resolution: This is a known UI display issue and does not impact your actual workspace permissions. To force a refresh of the role display, locate the user's profile in the Admin Console, change their role to a different one, save, then revert it back to the original setting. We are working on a permanent fix for this display bug.

subject: sync client creating constant conflict files
body: the desktop sync client keeps flagging files as conflict even when nobody else is editing them and its creating annoying duplicate files everywhere. not super urgent since we can delete them manually but pretty annoying.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again, and add CloudDesk to your whitelist if successful. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: User role change causing login issues
body: After changing a staff member from Member to Guest, they are reporting an 'Account Suspended' error when logging into the web app, which also shows code CD-AM-002. This is impacting our current project timeline. Could you help us restore their access?
resolution: Guest users only have access to specific workspaces they have been invited to, which is likely why they cannot log in fully. Please check the Team Management settings to confirm their role and ensure they have invitations to the necessary workspaces. If they require full access, please update their role back to Member.

subject: SSO login failing after update
body: All of our users are unable to access their accounts this morning following the v4.2 release. We are receiving an Invalid SSO Token Format error. We need this resolved right now as it is impacting our entire company's workflow.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format that requires an update to your configuration. Please update your SSO application settings in your identity provider to align with the new token schema. Refer to the CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide for the exact configuration requirements.

subject: Unable to edit company name in settings
body: Hello Support, I am trying to update our company name in the Admin Console under Company Settings, but the field appears to be read-only and changes will not save. We are undergoing a corporate audit on Friday, so having our official name correct is critical by then. Please assist at your earliest convenience.
resolution: The 'Company Name' is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the 'Organization Name' there. This change will propagate to the Company Settings.

subject: Desktop Sync SSO refresh issues
body: Since updating to the v4.2 client, our team is prompted to log in almost every hour. The client logs report SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 repeatedly. We have a payroll run tomorrow and the team needs consistent access to the shared folders. Can you help?
resolution: The v4.2 release updated how the sync client handles SSO tokens. Please perform a clean reinstallation by uninstalling the current client, restarting your machine, and installing the latest version. If the problem continues, your SSO administrator may need to regenerate the application's client secret in the CloudDesk Admin Console.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on API
body: We are consistently seeing API-500 errors when calling the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. It seems to happen most frequently for files hosted in specific geographic regions. We need this addressed as it is impacting our core platform functions.
resolution: We are currently investigating the root cause of these errors related to our distributed storage retrieval. In the meantime, we recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client to handle these intermittent failures. We plan to deploy a permanent fix in our next scheduled hotfix.

subject: Unrecognized charge on billing statement
body: We noticed a charge on our recent credit card statement from CloudDesk that we cannot reconcile. It is causing issues with our internal expense reporting. Could you please provide details on what this charge is for so we can resolve this promptly? I am seeing error code BILL-CHG-010.
resolution: I would be happy to help clarify this charge for you. Please provide the exact amount, the date of the transaction, and the last 4 digits of the card used. Once I have those details, I will pull your billing history and investigate the source of the charge.

subject: Admin can't generate API key
body: I recently promoted a colleague to admin but they cannot make an API key for the integration, it is all greyed out. We are getting CD-AM-013. I have been with the company for five years and we just need this key for the new sync process. Could you please check this out when you have a moment.
resolution: API key generation is a privilege reserved for the Super Admin role. Even if a user is an Admin, they will not see this option unless their specific role is set to Super Admin. Please confirm their permissions in the user management section and elevate them if necessary.

subject: Issues with REST API authentication for enterprise app
body: My development team has been working on a new integration for our enterprise deployment, and we have been reviewing the documentation extensively to ensure we are following the correct headers for our API calls. Despite our efforts to verify the endpoint configuration and our authentication handshake, we are consistently receiving a 403 Forbidden error with code API-AUTH-403.5. We were wondering if there might be a global configuration issue or if I am missing a specific permission setting. Could you please assist us in debugging this issue?
resolution: The issue is likely due to the API key missing the required scopes for the specific endpoints you are calling. Please have an administrator log into the Admin Console and check the permissions for your API key under 'Manage Key Permissions'. Once the correct scopes are enabled, your requests should proceed normally.

subject: Unrecognized charge on card
body: Hello team i noticed a strange charge on my statement today error code BILL-CHG-010 appeared when looking at my dashboard too. Could you please look into this for us when you have a moment thanks.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Workspace invitation emails not being received
body: Hello, when our admins invite new members to a workspace today, the emails are not arriving and the status stays as pending. We have a major client demo at 5pm today and need these users added immediately. We are seeing error code email-005 on our end.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Role display mismatch in admin console
body: While reviewing our user roster and preparing some internal documentation for our custom API integrations, I checked the Users and Permissions section. Some user roles like Contributor are displaying incorrectly as Manager despite the actual permissions in workspaces being correct. This seems to be a minor glitch with code UI-ADMIN-003. No immediate rush on this, as it is just a visual thing and can wait.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again.

subject: Want to switch to annual billing
body: I am trying to change our billing to annual to save some money but I cannot find the option. It is annoying that this isn't clearer in the interface. Can you point me in the right direction when you have a moment?
resolution: To update your billing cycle, go to the Admin Console and navigate to Billing, then Subscription Details. Select the option to change your plan and choose the annual billing term. This will take effect on your next renewal date, and any remaining credit from your current month will be prorated automatically.

subject: Slow user list loading in admin console
body: Navigating to the Users and Groups section in the admin console takes an extremely long time to load our entire directory. Since our organization has thousands of users, searching and applying filters also feels quite sluggish. We would appreciate it if the team could look into optimizing this response time when you have a moment.
resolution: Advise using the 'Search' bar or applying specific filters (e.g., 'Status: Active') immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset. The system is optimized for filtered views on large datasets. Suggest navigating directly to a specific user via search if their email is known.

subject: MFA setup failing on mobile
body: I cannot finish setting up my MFA because the mobile app keeps showing the MFA-MOB-002 error when I scan the QR code. I just want to secure my account. Looking forward to your assistance.
resolution: We are aware of this issue regarding the mobile MFA registration flow. As a workaround, please complete the MFA setup process through the CloudDesk web app by going to Settings and then Security. Once you have configured it there, it will be fully operational for both your web and mobile logins.

subject: Can we customize the SSO login page branding
body: we really need to add our company logo and brand colors to the SSO login page for our users. its so frustrating that we are stuck with the default look. no rush on this at all since we can wait for future updates
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available, but we recognize this as a valuable feature. Please add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding, and we will notify you of updates.

subject: need ms teams integration now
body: Hi team we need a direct microsoft teams integration for our pro web app workspace right away. Our engineers cant easily share files inside channels without jumping through hoops. Plz let us know when this is ready since its blocking our daily comms.
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper, direct integration is not yet available. Please vote for this integration or add your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams. We are constantly evaluating new integrations based on customer demand.

subject: api returning unauthorized token errors
body: our api calls are failing with 401 unauthorized and an expired_token message. error code API-AUTH-401 is showing up constantly. please help us fix this right away so we can continue our development work.
resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your requests.

subject: Audit log export failure over 90 days
body: Hi support, I am trying to export audit logs from the admin console for a date range greater than 90 days, but the export keeps failing and is truncated. I see the error message 'Export range limit exceeded (90 days maximum).' and error code AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. No rush on this, but please look into it when you have a moment.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: zapier trigger not firing for new uploads
body: Hi, our zapier integration isnt working at all today. the zap configured with the new file uploaded trigger is completely dead and not firing when we add new files. error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 keeps popping up in tests. this is super annoying, please fix it.
resolution: Hello. In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. Check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: Need to extend audit log retention beyond 12 months
body: I am trying to set our compliance policy for audit log retention, but I am hitting error AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT. The console caps the setting at 12 months, but we have a requirement to store logs for at least 5 years. Is there any way to override this natively?
resolution: The maximum native retention in the console is 12 months. For longer requirements, we recommend exporting your logs via our API or SFTP feature to an external SIEM solution like Splunk.

subject: accidental plan upgrade refund request
body: we upgraded by mistake and need a refund for the pro plan. error code is bill-ref-005. can you please reverse this charge for us as soon as possible?
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility right away.

subject: invitation emails not sending out to new users
body: we are trying to onboard devs using the web app but the invite emails are not going through at all and just stay pending. seeing error EMAIL-005. looks like a lot of other teams are dealing with this same email delivery glitch right now. please fix this soon.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: deleted user still appearing
body: I recently deleted a user account but their name still shows up in our workspace sharing lists. I wanted to make sure I didnt do something wrong. Thank you for your help.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access, but they may remain as entries in historical share lists until the system purges them or they are manually removed. This is expected behavior, though you can manually clear them from individual shares via 'Workspace Settings > Members'.

subject: Need to update our purchase order number for upcoming invoices
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. We need to add a new purchase order number to our future invoices for accounting purposes, and we are encountering error code BILL-PO-008. We are preparing for our quarterly financial audit on Friday and need this sorted out soon. Thank you so much for your assistance!
resolution: Hello! You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: Issues sharing workspace via API
body: We are currently unable to add new users to workspaces using the POST /workspaces/{id}/share endpoint. Our integration is returning a HTTP 403 Forbidden error, which is preventing our team from scaling workspace access. This is happening across multiple accounts right now. I have confirmed that the API key has Manager status, but we are still hitting API-403 errors.
resolution: Please verify that the API key in use has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled in your dashboard. Additionally, ensure the user associated with that key is a direct member of the workspace, rather than only having access through a group. If these settings are correct, please send us the specific API key ID and the workspace ID so we can investigate further.

subject: Incorrect user attribution in workspace activity log
body: Hello. We noticed that in the workspace activity log, certain file actions performed by regular contributors are being attributed to an administrator instead. We see error AUDIT-004 associated with this. No rush on this, just bringing it to your attention.
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct. This is a known bug we are addressing. For accurate audit, cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: oauth token failure blocking demo
body: hi team, our custom oauth 20 app is failing to obtain access tokens and returning client_secret_mismatch with code OAUTH-AUTH-401. this is critical because we have a major client demo at 5pm today and all our pro users are affected. please help asap
resolution: Hello. Please verify that the Client ID and Client Secret used in your custom application exactly match the credentials generated in the CloudDesk Admin Console under API & Integrations -> OAuth Clients. Pay close attention to case sensitivity and any extra spaces.

subject: Cannot export audit logs over 90 days
body: We have an external audit on Friday and I need to pull logs for the last 6 months. I keep getting AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED when I try to run the report. We have to have this data by tomorrow or we will fail our compliance check. Please help.
resolution: The Admin Console export tool is limited to 90 days of data. To pull a longer range, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with your specified start and end dates. If you are unable to use the API, let us know and we can discuss a manual data pull.

subject: LARGE FILE UPLOADS KEEP TIMING OUT
body: Every time we try to upload files over 1GB into the web app, the progress bar stalls and we get UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_504 errors. This is completely unacceptable and is halting our deliverables. Please get this fixed soon.
resolution: Advise customer to check their internet connection speed. For files over 500MB, recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads, as it supports resumable transfers. Verify if the issue persists across different browsers. If on Wi-Fi, suggest trying a wired connection.

subject: Password reset emails not received
body: We have users who are not receiving their password reset emails. We have confirmed they are not in the spam folder, and other system notifications are arriving just fine. We are seeing error AUTH-PR-200.1 on our end. Any suggestions?
resolution: Please verify that the user's email address is correctly entered in the Admin Console. You should also ensure that your domain's allowlist includes 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to prevent delivery blocks. If the issue continues, I can manually trigger a reset for those specific users from my end.

subject: New user gets user not found error
body: Hello, we added a new team member today but when they try to log in they get an user not found error. Thanks for looking into this.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Request for offline editing in mobile app
body: Our field technicians require the ability to edit documents while offline. Currently, the lack of this feature is blocking our team's progress significantly. Can you please enable this functionality in the mobile app?
resolution: While we currently support offline viewing for starred files, the ability to edit documents while disconnected is not yet available in the mobile app. We recognize how critical this is for mobile productivity and would encourage you to submit your request at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile. Your input helps us prioritize this feature for future updates.

subject: Request for Microsoft Teams integration
body: We are currently using CloudDesk for our file storage and need a direct integration with Microsoft Teams to improve our workflow. Many of our users are asking for this feature specifically. Is there a timeline for when this might be available?
resolution: While you can currently share CloudDesk file links directly in Teams, we do not have a deep, native integration yet. Please submit your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams so our product team can account for your needs while we evaluate new integrations based on user demand.

subject: Azure AD login error
body: My team is currently unable to log in to the web app using our usual Azure credentials. resolution: It appears your Azure AD claims might need re-mapping to ensure compatibility with our platform. Please have your IT administrator verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly configured in the CloudDesk application settings within Azure. You can find detailed instructions in our Azure AD configuration guide.

subject: Desktop sync client creating too many conflict files

resolution: These conflicts are often caused by security software interfering with our sync process or by network instability. We recommend whitelisting the CloudDesk application in your firewall or antivirus settings. Additionally, ensuring your network connection is stable will help prevent these unnecessary duplicate files.

subject: API key security vulnerability

resolution: Please revoke the affected API key immediately via the Admin Console's API Management section. Investigate if the key was created with improper permissions initially. We have escalated this to engineering to ensure the scope restriction is functioning correctly across our platform.

subject: User Activity report is blank

resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, please try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering.

subject: Jira integration sync issues

resolution: This error usually indicates that the account used for the integration lacks the necessary permissions. Please ensure that the Jira user configured in CloudDesk has both 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions enabled for those specific projects. Once those roles are updated in Jira, the sync should resume.

resolution: We are currently experiencing a brief email delivery delay affecting some automated messages. Please check if your domain has 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' added to your sender allowlist. If the issue continues, I can manually trigger a password reset for your account from our end.

subject: API token returning 401 unauthorized errors

resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your requests.

subject: CloudDesk Zapier trigger not firing

resolution: To fix this, please re-test the trigger step inside your Zapier editor to refresh the connection to your account. Additionally, verify that the account you connected has the appropriate permissions for the workspace you are monitoring. If it continues to fail, you can check your audit logs to ensure the event is successfully registering.

resolution: Please instruct the affected users to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito or private window and verify that your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console is correct.
