resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk application integration in the Okta console by ensuring the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values in our v4.2 configuration guide.

subject: Accidental Pro plan upgrade and refund request BILL-REF-005

resolution: Hello. Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. Once confirmed, we will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Workspace with 10k+ files takes too long to load

resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: User locked out after role change to guest

resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: API access failing after v4.2

resolution: With the v4.2 update, the API token format has been changed to increase security. You must regenerate all of your API tokens by navigating to the API and Integrations section of your Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new tokens as soon as possible.

resolution: This is likely a caching issue regarding agent permissions. Please have the affected user clear their browser cache and cookies before logging back in. If the ticket still doesn't appear, have an administrator re-assign the ticket to another user and then immediately back to the original agent to refresh the display.

resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. resolution: Please update your SSO configuration within the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata. This step is mandatory due to the SSO token format changes introduced in the v4.2 release.

If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: transfer workspace ownership error

resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a member or admin of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is already a member of the workspace. If they are not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership.

subject: API tokens returning 401 after v4.2 update

subject: Jira integration failing to sync

resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is enforced for security best practices. While we do not have plans to offer a 'never expire' option, we are considering extending the maximum duration. Please share your specific use case on our roadmap site so we can better understand your needs.

resolution: To improve performance, try narrowing your filter criteria or using smaller date ranges. You can also use the User Activity report for single-user queries as it is much faster. If you need a large amount of historical data, it is best to export the full log and filter the file locally.

resolution: Currently, CloudDesk focuses on file sharing and project collaboration. While we don't have built-in video conferencing, you can easily share meeting links within comments. For a direct integration with specific video conferencing platforms, please submit your request at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing.

subject: Need to downgrade subscription plan immediately
body: Hello support team, I am trying to downgrade our CloudDesk subscription plan to a lower tier because our team size has shrunk significantly. However, when I try to complete the change, I keep running into error BILL-PLAN-011. We have a major budget review meeting tomorrow morning, so I need this sorted out as soon as possible. Thank you.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

resolution: Please verify that your webhook endpoint URL is correctly configured in the Admin Console. Ensure your external service is publicly accessible and that your firewall settings permit connections from CloudDesk's IP range, which you can find in our documentation.

If you continue to loop, try using an incognito window or verify your Google SSO settings in our Admin Console.

resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

resolution: Let's check your role assignments by navigating to Users and then Manage User Roles in the Admin Console. Please ensure your account has either the Admin or Super Admin role assigned properly. If it shows incorrectly, update the role and try accessing the console again.

subject: Permissions issue with folder sharing
body: Hi, I have been working here for years and we really enjoy the product. I was talking to the marketing team about their coffee machine preference when I realized we need better permissions. Can we get view-only but with comments allowed? The current setup is a bit rigid for our workflow. Thanks so much.
resolution: We understand that you need more granular control over shared folders. Currently, our system applies permissions at the root folder level. Please submit your specific feature requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions so our product team can review your request for future updates.

subject: Desktop sync keeps creating unnecessary conflict files
body: Hello, our team has noticed that the desktop sync client is frequently flagging files as conflict even when no concurrent edits have taken place. This results in duplicate documents being generated automatically throughout our folders. It is a bit inconvenient for our executive workflows on the free plan, so we would appreciate it if this could be looked into when possible.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus and firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your security software and try syncing again to see if it resolves. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus or firewall whitelist, and ensure your network connection remains stable.

subject: SSO login failing with invalid token error
body: Since the recent update, all of our users attempting to log in via Okta are receiving an Invalid SSO Token Format error code CD-AM-003. This is blocking our entire organization and needs immediate escalation and resolution.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Please instruct the customer to update their SSO application configuration in their IdP (Okta/Azure AD) to use the new token schema. Refer to the 'CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide' for specific instructions.

subject: Requesting nested group support for Azure AD
body: Following the v4.2 update, our team needs the ability to map nested groups from Azure AD to our CloudDesk workspaces. Currently, we can only see top-level groups, which disrupts our provisioning flow. We would appreciate a fix for this soon.
resolution: With the v4.2 SSO updates, our Azure AD integration currently supports direct group mapping but does not support nested group resolution. We are tracking this request and recommend adding your specific use case to our roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/v4.2-enhancements/nested-azure-ad-groups. In the meantime, flattening your Azure AD groups may serve as a functional workaround.

subject: Jira integration setup failing
body: Our Jira integration setup is failing to sync projects and create issues, showing Jira API permission denied in the logs.
resolution: Ensure the Jira API token or user configured for the CloudDesk integration has 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance.

subject: API key returning unauthorized error
body: Hello, API calls using an existing API key return a 401 Unauthorized or Invalid API Key error. The key was working previously. This is blocking our integration work so we need prompt assistance please. We see error API-AUTH-401.4.
resolution: Verify the API key's status in the Admin Console under the 'API Keys' section. Check if it has expired or been revoked. Advise the user to regenerate a new API key if necessary and update their application.

subject: Lag while editing documents together
body: When we have multiple people in a doc, it lags so much. The cursors move really slow and typing takes seconds to show up. It is making it hard for our team to work in real time. We noticed this happens with COLLAB_LAG often.
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs or applications to free up resources. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document and try clearing the browser cache for all users.

subject: Incorrect user attribution in workspace activity logs
body: It is very annoying that routine file edits and moves performed by regular contributors are consistently being attributed to administrators in the workspace activity log. This makes tracking changes very difficult, though it is not urgent.
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct. This is a known bug we are addressing. For accurate audit, cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: API 403 Forbidden error with valid key
body: Hello Support, a new integration using the CloudDesk REST API on our Pro plan is failing to make any calls, receiving a Client Not Authorized error with code API-AUTH-403.5, even though we are passing a valid API key. Many of our developers are hitting this at the same moment right now. Please provide prompt help so we can unblock our pipeline.
resolution: Confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes/permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: Workspace invitation emails not being received
body: Hello. Team members are not receiving their invitation emails when we invite them to a workspace. The status shows as pending and no bounce-backs are reported. We would appreciate it if you could look into this soon.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam and junk folders first. If the emails are still not found, ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are properly configured to allow messages from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries, or provide the affected email addresses for manual investigation.

subject: Desktop Sync client is stuck on syncing files
body: My desktop app shows 'Connecting' and just stays there forever. It is not updating any of my files on my laptop. I see the code SYNC_STATUS_STUCK appearing when I hover over the icon. I need this working soon for my daily tasks. Thanks for your help.
resolution: Please start by restarting your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If that doesn't resolve it, try going to Settings, then Advanced, and select Clear Cache. If you still see the error, please back up any local unsynced files and perform a full reinstall of the application.

subject: Seat limit reached error despite available seats
body: When attempting to add new team members to our account, we receive an error message stating that the seat limit has been reached, even though our subscription details clearly show available seats remaining. We have a board meeting at 2pm today and need this resolved promptly.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' as pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Inquiry about plan downgrade process
body: We need to downgrade our subscription to a lower tier since our team size has decreased. How can I manage this in the console? I saw an error code BILL-PLAN-011 when I tried earlier. No rush on this.
resolution: You can initiate a downgrade by going to the Admin Console, then Billing, and selecting Subscription Details. From there, select Change Plan to pick your new tier. Note that the change takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle, and we do not offer prorated refunds for unused time.

subject: Incorrect user role display in console
body: I noticed an issue today where the admin console shows users as Contributors even when they are set as Managers. This happened after our last sync, and the error code UI-ADMIN-003 appeared. Everything works fine in the actual workspaces, so it is just a visual thing. Just wanted to bring it to your attention whenever you have a chance.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and your actual permissions remain intact. You can refresh the display by changing the user's role to something else and then back again in their profile settings, which will fix the view until our next patch.

subject: SSO BROKEN AFTER 4.2 UPDATE!!!
body: WHAT IS GOING ON WITH SSO?! AFTER THE 4.2 UPDATE, NONE OF OUR USERS CAN LOG IN VIA OKTA. WE ARE GETTING 'INVALID SSO TOKEN FORMAT' ERRORS. THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE AND IS CAUSING SIGNIFICANT DISRUPTION TO OUR OPERATIONS. WE NEED THIS FIXED IMMEDIATELY!
resolution: I understand the critical nature of this issue. To resolve the 'Invalid SSO token format' error after the v4.2 update, please go to your CloudDesk Admin Console. You will need to re-upload your IDP metadata within your existing SSO configuration. This step is necessary due to changes in the SSO token format introduced in the latest version.

subject: Mobile app login error
body: The mobile app is returning a Network Error on login. Connection is stable. Please investigate why this is happening. I see error code MOBILE-NET-500.1.
resolution: Please force close your app and check for the latest version in the app store. If the issue persists, try clearing your app's cache or reinstalling the app entirely. You should also check our status page to rule out any current server-side disruptions.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: When I try to open the User Activity report in the admin console, the page loads but no data appears at all. Error code REPORT-001. All other reports are working normally.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering with the page.

subject: Account suspended error
body: Our account is suspended with code BILL-SUSP-007. We have an overdue payment notice. Please reactivate access immediately so our development work can continue.
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. Please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to the Billing section under Invoices in the Admin Console. Once the payment is processed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: desktop sync client fails to complete sso login
body: Our team is encountering a loop during the desktop sync login process. The browser authentication completes, but the client remains stuck on the login screen. We are seeing error code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. This is currently preventing our staff from syncing their files.
resolution: Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to version v4.2.1 or newer. We also recommend checking that the user's default browser is configured to properly process SSO redirects. As a temporary workaround, users can sign in using their email and password if SSO is not strictly enforced.

subject: Helpdesk tickets not appearing for assigned agent
body: Hello, I am having trouble viewing tickets assigned to me. They appear for admins but are missing from my personal queue. I keep seeing HELPDESK-007 errors when I refresh the page. This is quite urgent for our workflow. Thank you for your help.
resolution: This is likely a caching issue regarding your permissions. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, then sign back in. If the issue remains, have an administrator re-assign the ticket to someone else, save it, and then assign it back to your account.

subject: invite emails not sending
body: We are having trouble with workspace invites. Our users arnt geting the emails at all. Its been a few hours now. Is there a known issue with the system?
resolution: Check your spam or junk folders to see if the messages were caught there. If not, verify that your SPF and DKIM records are correctly set up to permit our sending domains. You can refer to our Email Delivery Troubleshooting guide, or send us the affected addresses for further help.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on GET files content API endpoint
body: We are developing an integration using your REST API on our pro plan and experiencing frustrating issues. Calls to the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint intermittently return a HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, particularly when accessing files stored in geographically diverse regions. All other API endpoints work fine, but this specific call throws error API-500 frequently. Please help us get this sorted out soon.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Account suspended unexpectedly
body: Our account is showing as suspended in the Admin Console, error code BILL-SUSP-007. We need this restored immediately to avoid further business impact. Please advise on the next steps.
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an outstanding balance on an overdue invoice. You can restore your access by logging into the Admin Console and navigating to Billing to settle the balance. Your service will be automatically reactivated within 15 minutes of payment confirmation.

subject: API intermittent rate limiting
body: Our integration is experiencing intermittent 429 errors during peak usage hours. We are hitting the API-RATE-429 limit frequently now. We need to know the best way to handle these spikes moving forward.
resolution: To handle these spikes, please implement exponential backoff and retry logic within your API client. If your business needs consistently exceed the current threshold, please review your usage patterns to optimize unnecessary calls. If you believe your volume is justified, feel free to submit a request for a rate limit increase.

subject: Webhook delivery failed connection refused errors
body: Hi CloudDesk team, we noticed in our admin console webhook logs that our configured webhooks are failing to deliver to our external service, displaying errors like 'Delivery failed: Connection refused'. We appreciate your help in looking into this matter when you have a chance.
resolution: Verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range (refer to documentation for current IPs).

subject: large file uploads timing out constantly
body: hey team files over 1gb are taking forever and throwing upload_timeout_504 errors. progress bar just freezes halfway through. hope we can get this sorted soon thanks
resolution: Advise customer to check their internet connection speed. For files over 500MB, recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads, as it supports resumable transfers. Verify if the issue persists across different browsers. If on Wi-Fi, suggest trying a wired connection.

subject: API endpoints returning 503 errors
body: Our automated scripts are failing because the API is returning 503 errors frequently. This is blocking our integration syncs. Are there current issues or rate limits being applied? Please investigate this as a priority.
resolution: Please check your 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' headers to confirm if your integration is hitting our rate limits. If you are not exceeding limits, we recommend implementing an exponential backoff strategy in your scripts to handle momentary spikes in traffic. If the 503 errors continue, please provide some example request timestamps so we can escalate to our engineering team.

subject: Billing SSO error
body: Since updating, I cannot access invoices or update payment methods via SSO. It throws an error every single time. We need this fixed promptly.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: CRITICAL: Multiple API endpoints returning 503 errors
body: URGENT! Multiple API endpoints are returning HTTP 503 errors during peak hours, breaking all our automated scripts and integrations. We are seeing API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 constantly. Many users are hitting this at the same moment right now. We require an immediate fix for this production outage!
resolution: Investigate the customer's API usage patterns to identify if they are exceeding rate limits (check 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header). Advise implementing exponential backoff for retries. Confirm if there are any ongoing platform incidents via the CloudDesk status page. Escalate to engineering if rate limits are not being hit.

subject: Constant session expired errors on mobile app
body: Since the v4.2 update, our users are getting CD-AM-011 errors and being logged out repeatedly. It is very frustrating that the app is no longer stable for our users. Please provide a solution for this issue.
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to session management for improved security. Please have your users fully log out of the mobile app, clear their app cache or data, and then log back in. This process will force the creation of a new, compatible session token for the current version.

subject: desktop sync not working after v4.2 update
body: files in web portal not showing in sync app. seeing error sync-001. please advise on fix.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located in your AppData or Library folders. Reinstall the client from the download link in your web app's 'Settings' section to resolve this behavior.

subject: Question about team invitation status in console
body: Greetings support team, I hope you are having a pleasant week so far despite the weather being somewhat unpredictable lately. I am an external contractor helping out with some design tasks, and a colleague sent me an invitation link last Tuesday. I clicked it right away after finishing my morning coffee, but when I check my user status in the Admin Console it still says Pending Invitation and I cannot log in. There is no major rush on this since I am not needed until next week, but I wanted to get it sorted out eventually.
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Please try logging in directly with your email and the password you set, or we can revoke the invitation in the Admin Console and send a new one.

subject: Billing API reporting inconsistent data
body: Since upgrading to v4.2, the data returned from our billing API calls does not match what we see in the Admin Console. This API-BILL-401 error is causing confusion in our reporting. Could you verify if there were changes to how this data is calculated?
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage. Please ensure that your API queries are using the updated date range and parameter structures defined in our new documentation. If the discrepancies remain, send us the specific query and a screenshot of the Admin Console report so we can investigate.

subject: mobile app crashes uploading large files
body: app crashes every time we try uploading files larger than 1gb from ios and android. smaller files work fine. error code CRASH-MOB-001. need this fixed for our field team working today.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile devices. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client while our development team works on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Subscription renewal payment failed
body: Hello support, our automatic subscription renewal failed due to a declined card. We received the notification and see the payment failed status in billing. Thank you for your assistance with this pro plan issue.
resolution: Hello. Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one, ensuring the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: Workspace loading issues
body: My workspace with many files is not loading at all. It just spins for 30 seconds and then goes blank. I am getting the WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error. Please fix this.
resolution: When a workspace contains over 10,000 items, loading times can be affected. We recommend splitting your files into smaller workspaces or using our search and filter tools to locate specific items more quickly.

subject: Requesting more detailed user activity reports
body: I am writing to inquire if there are plans to expand the current reporting capabilities within the Admin Console. While our team appreciates the current functionality, we need more visibility into file downloads and specific user collaboration actions to meet internal compliance standards. Is there any way to access these logs right now?
resolution: We appreciate you reaching out regarding our reporting features. Please submit your specific requirements and use cases to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting so our analytics team can better prioritize these improvements.

subject: sso login not working after update
body: hi we are getting an sso-azure-400 error when trying to log into our dashboard. it seems like everyone on the team is blocked right now and we need this to work asap. please help us fix this since we have a lot of stuff to do today.
resolution: It looks like you need to update your Reply URL in your Azure AD application registration to match our new format. Please ensure the Assertion Consumer Service URL is set to https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs, replacing yourcompany with your specific subdomain. This should resolve the error immediately.

subject: Cannot log in with Okta after update
body: Hello, we are currently unable to access our accounts via Okta following the recent v4.2 update. Our users are receiving the error message AUTH-SSO-401.1 every time they attempt to sign in. Could you please look into this as soon as possible, as it is blocking our team's daily tasks? Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the v4.2 update. To resolve this, please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata file. This action is necessary because we updated the SSO token format in the latest release.

subject: Request for file upload webhook integration
body: Our development team is currently looking to integrate CloudDesk into our internal system. We would like to request a webhook event that triggers immediately whenever a new file is uploaded to a specific workspace. Please let us know if this functionality is on the roadmap or if there is an existing way to achieve this.
resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including desired payload, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so we can assess demand.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade refund request
body: Hi there my account was somehow upgraded to pro by mistake and i am very annoyed about this unrequested charge. Please process a refund for the prorated difference right away referencing code BILL-REF-005. Let me know when this is sorted out.
resolution: Hello. Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Webhook HMAC signature verification failing
body: Our backend is rejecting your webhooks because of an invalid signature. We are seeing WEBHOOK-SIGN-403 in our logs. We have double-checked our implementation, but it seems like something changed on your end. This is breaking our integration.
resolution: Please confirm that the secret token used on your receiving end is an exact match for the 'Webhook Secret' currently configured in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Additionally, ensure that your verification algorithm is set to HMAC-SHA256 to align with our security standards. Verifying these matches should resolve the signature rejection.

subject: API pagination parameters returning unexpected results
body: We noticed that when making requests to the API using pagination parameters like limit and offset, fewer results than expected are returned, or the limit parameter is ignored. This is not blocking anything critical on our end right now, so we can wait for a standard review whenever you have a chance.
resolution: Ensure your API request correctly uses the 'limit' and 'offset' query parameters as specified in the CloudDesk API documentation. Note that there might be a hard cap on the maximum 'limit' allowed per request (e.g., 1000 items).

subject: API broken after update
body: our production sync is failing with API-AUTH-401-V42 error. your new 4.2 update broke our legacy_token_format. we need this fixed now.
resolution: The API token format was updated in the v4.2 release for better security. You will need to regenerate all existing API tokens directly from the API & Integrations section in your Admin Console. Please update your application to use these new tokens immediately to restore service.

subject: Desktop sync client stuck on connecting
body: Hi team, we appreciate all the great tools CloudDesk provides. Right now, our desktop sync client is stuck showing indexing indefinitely and files are not syncing. We are seeing error code SYNC_STATUS_STUCK and this is blocking our engineering work. Could you please provide some prompt help?
resolution: Hello! Thank you for reaching out. Please try to restart your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache by going to 'Settings', then 'Advanced', and clicking 'Clear Cache'. If it is still unresolved, we suggest a full reinstall of the client after backing up any local unsynced files.

subject: SWITCHING TO ANNUAL BILLING NOW
body: I AM TIRED OF THE MONTHLY BILLING PLAN AND I NEED TO SWITCH TO ANNUAL IMMEDIATELY! I SEE A BILL-PLAN-004 ERROR WHENEVER I TRY TO ACCESS THE BILLING TAB! PLEASE FIX THIS SO WE CAN GET OUR DISCOUNT!
resolution: You can change your billing cycle by navigating to the Admin Console, then selecting Billing, and finally Subscription Details. From there, select the annual option for your current plan. This change will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle, and we will automatically prorate any remaining credit from your current month.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade refund request

resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Files not syncing after v4.2 update
body: I hope you are having a nice day, I am currently working on preparing several documents for our board meeting tomorrow morning. Since the recent v4.2 update, I noticed that my files in the web app are not showing up on my computer at all. I have a very important presentation at 5pm today and this is causing a major problem. Is there something I can do to fix this sync issue, maybe with error SYNC-001?
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk (Windows) or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk (macOS). Reinstall the client from the download link in your web app's 'Settings' -> 'Desktop Sync' section.

subject: Invalid SSO Token error affecting all users
body: Hello Support. Ever since the v4.2 update deployed, none of our team members can log in using SSO, receiving an Invalid SSO Token error. Regular email and password login works fine, but our company policy mandates SSO usage. We need this urgent blocking issue addressed right away.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format that requires administrators to re-configure their SSO integration. Please go to the CloudDesk Admin Console to re-download the updated SAML metadata or re-generate the OIDC client secret. Refer to the v4.2 release notes for detailed step-by-step instructions.

subject: API returning 404 for valid folder IDs

resolution: Please double-check that your endpoint path and HTTP method match the latest version of our API documentation. Additionally, ensure the folder ID you are requesting is actually accessible based on the permissions tied to your specific API token. If the issue continues, feel free to send over a sample request ID.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Hello support team. We have a Zap set up with a CloudDesk trigger for new file uploads, but it is currently not firing at all. We are seeing error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 when testing the connection. Please let us know how to resolve this. Thank you.
resolution: In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. Check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: Audit log search results missing file access events

resolution: Please ensure you have selected the correct filters for both the user email and the specific event types. Note that 'View' events are only logged for public links or external shares, while internal workspace views will not appear in the main audit log. You can find internal views by checking the individual activity feed on the specific file itself.

subject: Payment processing error on billing sso

resolution: Investigate if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items (e.g., millions of files) or deeply nested folder structures. Advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches. Suggest optimizing the workspace structure if feasible. Report specific workspace ID to engineering for indexing review.

resolution: Please check your spam folders, and ensure your SPF/DKIM records are updated to allow CloudDesk mail. If you still don't receive them, please send us the affected email addresses so we can investigate the delivery logs for the EMAIL-005 issue manually.

resolution: Please clear your browser's cookies and local storage related to our site, which should reset your active session properly. Also, ensure your system clock is accurate, as discrepancies can cause authentication timeouts.

subject: Mobile app document preview failing before audit
body: Hi there, we are having trouble previewing PDFs and docs on the mobile app today. It keeps saying could not load preview. We have a major audit on Friday, so we need to review these files urgently. Please let me know how to fix this soon, thanks!
resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version. Check the user's device storage and network connection. Advise clearing the mobile app's cache via device settings. For very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: Helpdesk tickets not appearing for agent
body: My team is encountering HELPDESK-007 where assigned tickets disappear from the view in the web app. This is blocking our support operations and needs a prompt fix. Could you assist us in restoring visibility for the affected agents?
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: api calls to folders returning 404
body: getting api-notfound-404 errors when calling the folder files endpoint. checking the ids and they look fine to me. is there a glitch on your end today? please let me know.
resolution: Please double-check your API endpoint path and ensure your HTTP methods align with our current documentation. Verify that the resource IDs you are querying have appropriate permissions linked to your API token.

resolution: In Zapier, please re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. Check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: OKTA SSO IS COMPLETELY BROKEN FIX NOW

resolution: We apologize for the disruption to your team. This issue is tied to our recent v4.2 update which changed the SSO token format. Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata to restore access.

subject: Audit log export failing for ranges over 90 days
body: I am trying to pull our compliance audit logs for the last six months through the Admin Console, but the export completely fails every single time. It keeps throwing the AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED error and mentioning a 90 days maximum limit. This is extremely frustrating because we need these exact records for an upcoming internal review. Please advise how we can retrieve logs spanning a longer timeframe.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Need PDF invoices instead of CSV
body: I am trying to download my invoices from the admin portal, but only CSV is available. We require PDF versions for our bookkeeping records. I would appreciate it if you could assist me with this.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is currently unavailable for older records due to a system migration. Please provide us with the specific invoice IDs you require, and we will manually generate the PDFs and email them to you.

subject: Cannot log in after role change
body: One of our developers got locked out of the web application after their role was modified, and now they keep seeing error code CD-AM-002. This is extremely frustrating since we are in the middle of an important integration and need prompt help.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Invitation emails not arriving
body: I am trying to invite new members to our team but they are not getting the emails. The status just stays as pending forever. This is extremely annoying and slowing down our onboarding process. Why is this happening?
resolution: First, please have your users check their spam or junk folders for the invitation. If the emails are missing, verify that your domain's SPF and DKIM records are correctly configured to trust CloudDesk's sending servers. You can find the required DNS entries in our Email Delivery Troubleshooting guide within the admin console.

subject: SSO login failing after update
body: Since the 4.2 update, our team members using Okta are failing to sign in. They are getting an error about an invalid SSO token format, and we see AUTH-SSO-401.1. We need this fixed as soon as possible because our staff cannot access their files.
resolution: This is due to the recent changes to the SSO token format in the v4.2 update. Please update your SSO configuration by re-uploading your identity provider metadata within the Admin Console to restore access for your users.

subject: Unable to modify company name in company settings
body: Hello support, we are trying to update our legal company name under Admin Console > Company Settings, but the field appears to be read-only and will not save our changes. We would appreciate it if you could look into this at your normal convenience. Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: The 'Company Name' is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the 'Organization Name' there. This change will propagate to the Company Settings.

subject: Issues with staying logged into my account
body: Hello, I am having trouble staying signed in to the web app today. Every time I get to the dashboard, it immediately kicks me out with an AUTH-SESSION-401.5 error. I really appreciate your help with this when you have a moment, as it's not a huge rush for me.
resolution: Please try clearing your browser cookies and local storage specifically for cloudesk.com. It is also worth checking if you have any strict privacy extensions active that might be blocking our session cookies. Lastly, ensure your device's system time is set to be automatically synchronized.

subject: Web app preview not working blank screen

Downloading the files works fine so they are not broken. This is really blocking our team, we have a big client demo at 5pm today and need to share these docs. Error code is PREVIEW-006. Please help promptly.
resolution: This issue can be caused by temporary problems with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering. First, please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out any browser extensions. If the problem is specific to a particular file, please ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Requesting to downgrade our subscription plan

resolution: You can downgrade your plan by navigating to the Admin Console, then selecting Billing, and choosing Change Plan under Subscription Details. Please note that the new tier will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle, and we do not issue prorated refunds for these changes.

subject: OKTA SSO BROKEN AFTER 4.2 UPDATE HELP NOW

FIX THIS IMMEDIATELY OR OUR ENTIRE OPERATION WILL COME TO A COMPLETE HALT TODAY!
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise the customer's IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide (accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration').

subject: Experiencing 403 Forbidden errors when sharing workspaces via REST API
body: Hello Support Team, I am currently working on developing a custom synchronization tool using your public REST API. While testing our endpoints, specifically the POST /workspaces/{id}/share route, we keep encountering unexpected HTTP 403 Forbidden responses. This occurs even though the API key in question is associated with a user who holds the explicit 'Manager' role within that specific workspace. We would appreciate it if you could investigate this behavior when you have a moment.
resolution: Ensure the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Also, the user associated with the API key must be a direct member of the workspace being shared, not just via a group. If the issue persists, please provide the API key ID and workspace ID for further review.

subject: Intermittent API 500 errors

This is causing significant delays in our deployment, so could you please prioritize a fix for this?
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are actively investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: Users getting stuck in redirect loop with Google SSO. AUTH-SSO-302.1.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

resolution: Hello! This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Need to downgrade subscription

resolution: You can change your plan by navigating to the Billing section of the Admin Console. Please select your desired tier from the Change Plan menu. Note that changes take effect at the end of the current cycle, and we do not offer prorated refunds for downgrades.

resolution: An administrator on your account needs to verify the user's specific access rights for that workspace. Please navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check the 'Members' section, and ensure their permissions are correctly configured. This should resolve the access error you are seeing.

Please ensure no VPNs are active and attempt the transaction again in about 30 minutes. If it continues to fail, you may want to contact your bank to verify there are no blocks on CloudDesk transactions.

resolution: This behavior is typically caused by a browser cache conflict. Please have the affected agent clear their browser's cache and cookies before logging back in. If the issue persists, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to another user and then back to the original agent to refresh the permission link.

resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version v4.2.1 or newer. Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a temporary workaround, you can suggest logging in via email/password if SSO is not strictly enforced.

subject: Permission Denied error when opening shared workspace

subject: Desktop sync failing after password change

resolution: After a password change, the Desktop Sync client often requires re-authentication. Please open the Desktop Sync application, click on 'Settings' or the 'CloudDesk' icon in your system tray, and select 'Log Out' or 'Disconnect Account'. You can then log back in using your new password.

subject: AWS S3 automated data export failing after v4.2
body: Our scheduled tenant export to Amazon S3 is throwing invalid credentials errors since we upgraded to v4.2, and our keys have definitely not been modified. We are hitting error S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401 and this is blocking our daily compliance reporting required for an audit tomorrow morning. We urgently need assistance with this failure.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the S3 integration to enforce stricter IAM policy requirements. Your existing IAM user/role policy might be missing a required permission (e.g., 's3:GetBucketLocation'). Update your AWS IAM policy for the CloudDesk integration to match the new requirements outlined in the v4.2 S3 Integration Guide.

resolution: I apologize for the frustration. Please double-check your Slack integration settings in the Admin Console to ensure the correct workspace and channel are linked. Additionally, confirm that the CloudDesk app has been granted permission to post in that channel directly within your Slack workspace settings.

subject: Mobile app MFA registration failure

resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise your users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app by navigating to Settings, then Security, and selecting Multi-Factor Authentication. Once configured there, it will work correctly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Mobile app keeps cached files after logout
body: Files opened in the mobile app remain cached on devices even after logging out. This poses a serious security risk for us. Please advise how to clear this cache automatically.
resolution: Hello. The mobile app caches files for offline access. To manually clear the cache, go to 'Settings' within the CloudDesk mobile app, then 'Storage' and select 'Clear Cached Files'. For automatic clearing on logout, enable 'Clear cache on logout' in the same settings menu. This setting is off by default.

subject: Cannot extend audit log retention past 12 months
body: we need audit logs for five years for compliance and the admin console only lets us select 12 months maximum with error AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT. please let us know how to fix this so we can comply with our internal policies.
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is indeed 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution using our API or SFTP export feature.

subject: Password reset email not arriving

resolution: We verified your email address in the Admin Console. Please check if your domain is configured with an approved email sender list, and advise adding no-reply@cloudesk.com to your allowlist. I have also manually triggered a password reset for you.

subject: Workspace ownership transfer greyed out in enterprise settings
body: Dear support team, as we continue to restructure our internal development departments and adjust our integration parameters across various cloud instances, I attempted to reassign a primary workspace ownership earlier this morning, but noticed the interface option was completely greyed out with an error message stating that transfer to a non-owner is prohibited, which brought me here to check on the proper procedure when you have a moment.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace, add them first if necessary, and then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Payment failure for subscription renewal
body: Hello, I received a notification that our subscription renewal failed with a BILL-PAY-002 error. We need to keep our services running without interruption. Could you please help us resolve this payment issue as soon as possible? Thank you.
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: Unrecognized charge on billing statement
body: Our accounting department identified a charge on our credit card statement from CloudDesk that does not match our current subscription tier. We have logged error code BILL-CHG-010 regarding this discrepancy. Please provide a breakdown of this charge.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Unable to delete workspace due to error
body: I am trying to remove a workspace but I get error CD-AM-007 saying there are active integrations. I am not sure where to check these. Please advise.
resolution: Before a workspace can be deleted, you must disconnect all active integrations linked to it, such as Slack or Jira. Please navigate to the Workspace Settings and click on the Integrations tab to remove all listed connections. Once you have cleared these, you will be able to proceed with the deletion.

resolution: This issue is often related to browser cache or specific rendering service interruptions. Please start by clearing your browser's cache and cookies, then try opening the preview in an incognito window to rule out any extension conflicts. If the problem persists for a specific file, please double-check that the document is not corrupted or password-protected.

Once they are a member, you can navigate to Admin Console, Workspaces, select the workspace, and then transfer ownership in the settings.

You can find the list of required IPs in our official integration documentation.
