body: The CloudDesk Desktop Sync client icon has been showing as connecting or indexing indefinitely since this morning. Files are not syncing to or from the local folder, and no specific error message is displayed in the UI. We are seeing the error code SYNC_STATUS_STUCK in our logs. This is blocking our work on the free plan, so we would appreciate your prompt help.
resolution: Please try restarting your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache by navigating to 'Settings', then 'Advanced', and selecting 'Clear Cache'. If it is still unresolved, you may need to perform a full reinstall of the client after ensuring any local unsynced files are safely backed up.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: Hello support team. Some of our users are encountering the AUTH-SSO-302.1 error when trying to access the web app via Google SSO today. There is no rush on this since we have alternative access methods, but please look into it whenever you have a moment.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: mobile app crashes uploading large files
body: app crashes every time i try uploading anything over a gigabyte from my phone. smaller files work fine. please fix.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Seat limit error when adding users
body: I am trying to add new team members but I keep getting a 'Seat limit reached' error, code CD-AM-001. Our subscription details clearly show we have available seats. This is very frustrating as I need to onboard these people today. Please advise.
resolution: The seat limit is likely being affected by outstanding invites that haven't been accepted yet. Please check your 'Pending Invitations' in the Team Management section of the Admin Console. You can revoke those pending invites to free up seats or upgrade if you genuinely need more capacity.

subject: seat limit error when adding users
body: hey team, gettingcd-am-001 when trying to add new people to our workspace. subscription details say we still have open seats left on our pro plan. no rush at all, just wanted to report it whenever someone has a minute.
resolution: Please check the Pending Invitations count under Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations, as pending invites still count toward your active seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations to free up spots or upgrade your plan to increase your seat capacity.

subject: Yubikey MFA request for desktop sync
body: Need hardware token MFA for desktop sync clients. Please advise.
resolution: Hello. CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Slow download speeds for shared workspace files
body: When collaborators download files from a workspace via the web app, the download speed is noticeably slower than expected based on their internet connection. There is no major rush, but it would be nice to have it looked at eventually.
resolution: Test download speeds using a different browser or network. Advise checking browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager if available or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Verify server region for the workspace.

subject: API requests failing with legacy token format after v4.2
body: After upgrading to v4.2, our production script integration started throwing a 401 Unauthorized error with the legacy_token_format message. We need this resolved immediately as it is halting our automated workflows.
resolution: With the release of v4.2, the API token format was updated for enhanced security, resulting in the API-AUTH-401-V42 error code. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Please update your external applications to use these newly generated tokens right away.

subject: Plan downgrade request
body: Hello CloudDesk team, we are looking into adjusting our enterprise subscription plan due to a reorganization and reduced team size. We would like to understand the process for moving to a lower tier when our schedule permits.
resolution: Hello. To downgrade your plan, navigate to Admin Console, then Billing, Subscription Details, and Change Plan, where you can select your desired lower tier. Please note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Unrecognized charge on billing statement
body: Hello, I am reviewing our financial statements and noticed a charge from CloudDesk that we cannot reconcile. Could you please provide clarification on this transaction? Thank you.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Unnecessary file conflict errors
body: Our team is seeing excessive 'Conflict' files created in our workspaces despite no actual concurrent edits. It is cluttering our folder structures significantly. Is there any way to prevent these phantom conflicts?
resolution: These conflicts are often triggered by aggressive antivirus or firewall software blocking the sync process. Please try temporarily disabling your security software to test, and if that helps, add CloudDesk to your whitelist.

subject: Subscription renewal failed due to payment error
body: Our automatic subscription renewal has failed due to a declined credit card. We received the notification and see a payment failed status in the billing section. We need this fixed immediately to avoid service interruption for our users.
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank so the transaction clears. You can then retry the payment directly from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: 403 Forbidden on workspace sharing API
body: Our integration script is failing when making POST requests to share a workspace with a new user. The API is returning an HTTP 403 Forbidden error with code API-403, even though the API key user holds the Manager role and has sufficient global permissions. This is blocking our user onboarding workflow, so we would appreciate your prompt help.
resolution: Please ensure the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Additionally, verify that the user associated with the API key is a direct member of the workspace being shared and not just a member via a group.

subject: Custom annual invoicing requirements
body: We need annual invoicing terms for our account.
resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Requested password reset for API integration account but email never arrived. Checked spam folders and other system notifications are coming through fine. Please fix.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Check if the user's domain is configured with an approved email sender list. If not, advise adding 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to their allowlist. Manually trigger a password reset from the Admin Console if necessary.

subject: custom branding missing on sso login
body: our custom company logo and background wont show up on the sso login page its just showing default clouddesk branding instead. sso-ui-200.2 error is showing up sometimes too. not a huge rush but annoying
resolution: Guide the admin to the SSO and Branding section in the Admin Console. Check if the custom branding assets are uploaded and saved correctly, and advise clearing browser cache for affected users.

subject: workspace page takes forever to load
body: hey team when i navigate to a workspace with many files over 10000 items the page takes an excessive amount of time to load and shows a blank screen for over 30 seconds. getting workspace_load_timeout errors. please help when you can thanks
resolution: Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace. We advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, and suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Please also verify your browser console for any network errors.

subject: Cannot remove user because they are an owner
body: This is ridiculous! I am trying to remove a user from our workspace on our enterprise plan and it keeps throwing code CD-AM-014 saying they are an owner. I need them out of our system immediately. Many admins are hitting this at the same moment right now. Please tell me how to fix this right away.
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace. The ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign.

subject: Assigned helpdesk tickets missing from view
body: Good morning, our support agents cannot see tickets assigned to them in the My Assigned Tickets view despite having proper permissions. We have a heavy queue today and this is blocking our workflow, so prompt help would be greatly appreciated. Thank you for looking into this.
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, and then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: Webhook delivery issues
body: We have been reviewing our financial reporting logs and noticed some discrepancies. While looking into why our systems aren't syncing, I checked the admin console and saw repeated errors regarding our webhook configurations. It seems we are getting error code WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 consistently. Can you assist in getting these back online?
resolution: Please verify your webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and ensure your firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: Our users are experiencing a persistent redirect loop when attempting to sign in via Google SSO. They never reach the dashboard after authenticating. We are seeing AUTH-SSO-302.1. Please investigate.
resolution: Please instruct your users to clear their browser cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, which usually resolves this redirect behavior. If the problem persists, suggest trying an incognito browser window. Additionally, please verify that your Google SSO configuration within the Admin Console remains active and correctly set.

subject: Blank User Activity report page in admin console
body: This is extremely frustrating. Every time I open the admin console to check the User Activity report, the page stays completely blank with error code REPORT-001. All other reports load fine, and this is unacceptable. Please fix this soon.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering.

subject: Cannot access billing portal with SSO
body: Since the update to v4.2, I am failing to see our invoices or update payment info when logged in via SSO. It gives me AUTH-BILL-402 and will not let me proceed. This is important to our finance department, can you help soon?
resolution: The v4.2 release updated our SSO token format, which is causing this session conflict. Please try clearing your browser cache or logging in with a standard email and password to manage billing until this is fully resolved. We are currently looking into the SSO integration for billing modules.

subject: Payment processing error on SSO login
body: Since the v4.2 release our admins cannot access the billing portal via SSO, receiving authentication failed messages instead. We need to update our payment method promptly so please assist us with this workflow issue.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: mobile app login not working
body: hi there i keep getting a mobile-net-500.1 error when trying to log into the app on my phone. my internet is totally fine but it just wont let me in. any help you could provide would be much appreciated. thanks for your time.
resolution: Please try force closing the application completely and checking for any pending updates in the App Store or Google Play. If the error persists, I recommend clearing your app data or reinstalling the application to resolve the connection issue. You can also monitor our status page to ensure there are no ongoing service disruptions.

subject: Cannot remove owner from workspace
body: I am trying to clean up our workspaces but I cannot remove a user because of error CD-AM-014! This is absolutely ridiculous that I can't manage my own workspace members. I need to be able to remove this person immediately. Fix this issue now!
resolution: The system prevents the removal of a workspace owner as a safeguard. You must first transfer the ownership of the workspace to another member through the workspace settings. Once the transfer is complete, you will be able to remove the original owner.

subject: user deletion stuck
body: deletion requests are stuck in pending for days. no email notification. fix this soon.
resolution: Please ensure the user is set to Inactive status, as active users will keep the deletion request in a queued state. If they are already inactive and the request is still pending after 48 hours, please provide the specific user email and deletion ID so we can investigate the background process.

subject: Lag while editing documents
body: the web app is having major delays when my team is editing docs together. cursor is slow and typing is not showing up instantly for others. seems like there is some COLLAB_LAG happening.
resolution: This issue often stems from network latency during collaborative sessions. Please ensure all users have a stable internet connection and try clearing your browser cache. Closing unnecessary browser tabs can also help improve performance.

subject: Unrecognized charge on our credit card statement
body: I am reviewing our monthly expenses and found a charge from CloudDesk that I do not recognize. I am seeing error code BILL-CHG-010 when checking my account dashboard. Could you please look into this immediately as I need to finalize our books for the quarter?
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop issue
body: Our team is stuck in a redirect loop when trying to sign in via Google. We have a live demo at 5pm today and this is completely unacceptable! This AUTH-SSO-302.1 error is preventing everyone from working. Fix this immediately!
resolution: Please have your users clear their browser cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com, as this often resolves the redirect cycle. If that does not work, try using an incognito window or a different browser to bypass cached data. We also recommend verifying your current Google SSO configuration settings in the Admin Console.

subject: Seat limit reached error when adding team members
body: Hello support team, I am trying to add a couple of new teammates to our pro workspace but keep getting blocked by a seat limit message even though we have plenty of open seats left. We are seeing error code CD-AM-001 on the admin panel. Thank you so much for looking into this for us.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Audit log retention period limit
body: Hello, I am trying to set the audit log retention period in the Admin Console to 5 years for compliance, but I found that the maximum selectable value is 12 months with no option to extend. Please let me know how to configure this when you have time.
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution such as Splunk or Sumo Logic via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally.

subject: Unable to transfer workspace ownership to team member
body: Hello support team, I am attempting to transfer workspace ownership in the admin console but the option is unavailable and throwing error CD-AM-004. Could you please guide me on how to resolve this when you have a moment? Thank you so much for your help.
resolution: Hello. Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already an active member or admin of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is already a member, and then attempt the transfer via Admin Console, Workspaces, Settings, and Transfer Ownership.

subject: User Activity report page loads completely blank
body: When I try to open the User Activity report in the admin console, the page just stays completely blank with REPORT-001 showing up while other reports work fine. It is very annoying when basic admin tools do not load correctly. Please fix this soon when you have a moment.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue, so please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering.

subject: Cannot access shared workspace with 403 error
body: This is completely unacceptable as we have our executive audit meeting starting at 2pm today. When I log in I get error PERM-WS-403.4 and a permission denied message for our core financial workspace. Fix this immediately.
resolution: An administrator needs to verify your permissions for that specific workspace. Navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check 'Members' or 'Permissions', and ensure you are correctly assigned with appropriate access rights.

subject: API pagination parameters ignored
body: I am trying to fetch data but the API keeps returning all records regardless of the limit I set. I am seeing API-PAGINATION-500 errors occasionally too. It feels like the pagination logic is completely broken in the current release. No major hurry on this, just wanted to flag it.
resolution: Please double-check that your API calls are correctly formatting the limit and offset query parameters per our developer documentation. Also, keep in mind that there is a hard cap of 1000 items per request, so if your limit exceeds that, the request may behave unexpectedly. If you stay within these parameters, the pagination should function correctly.

subject: API returning 401 unauthorized errors
body: Hello Support, our automated API calls are suddenly returning 401 Unauthorized with invalid_token or expired_token errors. This is affecting our free plan integrations and blocking our development tasks. We would appreciate your prompt assistance in resolving this matter.
resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your requests.

subject: Mobile app network error
body: Our mobile users are receiving MOBILE-NET-500.1 errors on iOS and Android. This needs to be resolved before our big company audit on Friday.
resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache/data (Android) or reinstalling the app (iOS/Android). Verify server status on our status page.

subject: Desktop sync creating unnecessary file conflicts
body: The sync client is flagging files as conflicts even when no one else is editing them. It keeps creating duplicates like 'filename (Conflict 2023-10-27).docx' which is cluttering our drives. We see error code SYNC-003. When you have a moment, please advise.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: api tokens returning 401 after v4.2
body: hi our api calls are suddenly failing with api-auth-401-v42 and legacy_token_format after updating to v4.2 we need this fixed asap for our pipeline
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: External share logs missing download user details
body: Hi, when we share files externally, the audit logs only show our internal user who created the link rather than the actual external person who opened it. we are seeing AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS in our logs. no rush on this, just wanted to check how it works
resolution: By default, external share links are anonymous. To track external user activity, the share link must be configured with Require Email Verification or Require CloudDesk Login, which ensures the external user's identity is captured in the audit logs. Note that this cannot be retroactively applied to existing anonymous links.

subject: desktop sync high cpu memory usage
body: hey team noticed our CloudDeskSync.exe process is eating up a lot of cpu and memory even when idle it's over 50% cpu and 2gb memory in task manager making other apps slow can you help us figure out why this is happening thanks
resolution: Thanks for letting us know! High resource usage can sometimes occur if there's a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed. We recommend pausing sync through the desktop client, restarting your computer, and then resuming sync. If the issue persists, consider disabling sync for non-critical folders or temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks. Also, ensure your antivirus software isn't conflicting with the sync client.

subject: Google SSO domain access issues
body: We are experiencing issues with our Google SSO integration. Our users are receiving an SSO-GOOGLE-403 error when attempting to log in. This seems isolated to specific domains under our account. Could you look into why these are being blocked?
resolution: Please navigate to the SSO & Identity section of your CloudDesk Admin Console. Check the Allowed Domains list to ensure all necessary domains are currently permitted. If any are missing, simply add them to the list to restore access.

subject: Desktop sync client not showing files
body: Since updating to v4.2, files are not appearing in the desktop sync client despite being visible on the web. This is critical as our team has a hard deadline this afternoon. We are seeing error SYNC-001. Please help us resolve this immediately.
resolution: Please uninstall the v4.2 desktop sync client and clear your local sync cache folder. Afterward, reinstall the application using the download link found in your web app's settings under Desktop Sync. This should correctly re-establish the connection to your files.

subject: SSO login failing after update
body: Since the recent update, users logging in through our identity provider are getting an invalid token format error. We need prompt help to resolve this blocking issue as soon as possible.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Please instruct the customer to update their SSO application configuration in their IdP (Okta/Azure AD) to use the new token schema. Refer to the 'CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide' for specific instructions.

subject: Inadvertent plan upgrade and refund request
body: Hello support team, I am writing to let you know that our company account was unintentionally upgraded to a different tier earlier this week while we were navigating the enterprise dashboard. We would like to request a refund for the prorated difference as soon as possible. Thank you for looking into this matter for us.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Inconsistent billing data via API after v4.2 update
body: We noticed that our billing reports fetched via the API do not match what we see in the Admin Console since we moved to v4.2. The numbers seem quite off lately. I suspect the API-BILL-401 error might be related. We are in no rush, but appreciate your help when you can.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated. Ensure you are using the correct date range and parameters as per our latest documentation. If discrepancies persist, please send the specific query and the report for our review.

subject: Request for more granular notification settings
body: I appreciate the work your team puts into CloudDesk. I find the current notification settings to be a bit overwhelming as I receive alerts for everything. It would be great to have the ability to toggle notifications only for specific actions like mentions. Thank you for your consideration.
resolution: Thank you for your feedback regarding notification controls. You can currently manage general settings in your profile, but for more granular options, please share your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications so our product team can prioritize this.

subject: Mobile app cache persistence concerns
body: I noticed that opened files remain cached on my phone after logging out. Is there any way to clear this out for privacy?
resolution: The mobile app caches files for offline access by design. To manually remove them, go to Settings within the CloudDesk mobile app, select Storage, and choose Clear Cached Files. To clear cached data automatically on logout, enable the toggle for clearing cache on logout in that same settings menu.

subject: Blank User Activity report
body: Hello, I am trying to view the User Activity report in the admin console but the page is completely blank. All the other reports are working fine for me. It is pretty annoying when things do not load properly, though I am not in a huge rush to see it.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: api error 403 on workspace share
body: hi we are getting api-403 errors when trying to share a workspace via the post api even though the user has manager roles. we really need this to be resolved so our automation can function properly. thanks for your help.
resolution: Please ensure the API key used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled in your console. Additionally, note that the user associated with that key must be a direct member of the workspace, rather than just belonging to a group. If the issue persists, please send us the API key ID and the affected workspace ID for further investigation.

subject: File version retention limit increase request
body: We would like to inquire about extending our file version history beyond the current 30-day limit and 100 version caps for our enterprise workspace sync clients. There is no urgency for this, but we wanted to check our options for the future.
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding file versioning. The current limits are set to balance storage and performance. We recommend utilizing our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com to submit your specific requirements for enhanced versioning and vote on similar requests, helping our product team understand customer demand.

subject: Password reset emails not arriving
body: Our team needs to access the platform before the payroll run tomorrow, but password reset emails are not being delivered. We checked spam folders and nothing is there. This is urgent.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm if your domain allows 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. If your domain has an approved sender list, please ensure our address is added to it. I can also manually trigger a password reset for you if you provide the affected user's email.

subject: cant get a pdf invoice

resolution: We are currently experiencing issues with PDF invoice generation due to a recent migration. Please provide the invoice IDs you require, and our team will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Desktop Sync client stuck on indexing files
body: Our enterprise sync client is showing SYNC_STATUS_STUCK indefinitely and no files are moving to the server. This is a critical issue that is blocking our team from accessing updated project files. Please look into this as soon as possible.
resolution: Please restart your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client to refresh the connection. If the status remains stuck, go to Settings, then Advanced, and select Clear Cache. If the issue continues, perform a full reinstallation of the client after backing up any locally pending files.

subject: Invited user stuck on Pending Invitation status
body: Hello, we invited a new colleague to our workspace, but their status in the admin console is still showing as Pending Invitation. They clicked the invite link, yet they still cannot log in to access any files. Can you help us figure out why this is happening?
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set (if any). If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and send a new one.

subject: New user still pending invitation
body: I sent an invite to a new team member, but they are still showing as pending in the console. They cannot get in, and I see a CD-AM-005 error when I check their status. Is there any way to fix this so they can start working?
resolution: This status can occur if the user's email domain isn't configured for auto-join or if there is a minor synchronization delay. Please ask the user to attempt a direct login with their email address. If that fails, please navigate to Admin Console, Team Management, and Invitations to revoke the current invite and send a fresh one.

subject: Request to switch to annual billing
body: We would like to switch our current plan to annual billing to take advantage of the discount. Please update our billing cycle accordingly.
resolution: You can change your billing cycle by navigating to the Subscription Details section in the Admin Console. Select the annual option, and the change will be applied at the start of your next cycle.

subject: Locked out of Admin Console
body: I am trying to log into the Admin Console to review our monthly spend and I keep getting redirected or hit with error ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. This is quite frustrating because I need to check our billing statements today. Please sort this out as soon as possible.
resolution: Please check your role in the Admin Console by navigating to 'Users' and then 'Manage User' to review your assigned roles. Ensure that you have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned to your account. If it is currently set otherwise, we can update your permissions so you can access the panel.

subject: Audit log export range limit
body: Hello, we tried exporting audit records spanning more than three months from the admin dashboard and received an error stating that the range is exceeded. There is no rush on this, but we would appreciate guidance on how to pull longer historical logs when time permits.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Unauthorized access to my local files
body: I am shocked to find that the desktop sync client started uploading my personal documents without me asking. This is a severe privacy breach for our company. My work is currently blocked while I sort through this. Please investigate this unauthorized sync immediately.
resolution: The sync client only processes folders you have explicitly designated. Please check your 'Synced Folders' settings to ensure no local directories were accidentally enabled. You may also want to disable the 'Auto-sync new shared folders' feature to prevent this in the future.

subject: High CPU usage from desktop sync client
body: The CloudDesk desktop sync client is causing high CPU usage consistently above 50% and significant memory consumption on our office machines, even when no active syncing is occurring. This is slowing down the computers considerably. We would appreciate it if you could look into this issue soon.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After reset, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: Blank User Activity Report in Admin Console
body: Hello, when attempting to view the User Activity report on our Pro plan admin console, the page loads completely blank while all other reports function normally. We would appreciate it if this could be looked into when convenient. Thank you so much for your help.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Free tier storage limit
body: Our small team on the free tier has quickly reached the storage limit. We were wondering if there's any possibility of increasing our storage capacity without needing to upgrade to a paid plan at this time. It would be very helpful for our current projects.
resolution: Thank you for your feedback regarding our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. At this time, we do not plan to increase the storage for the free tier. Please consider exploring our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features that might better suit your team's needs.

subject: API requests failing with 401 Unauthorized API-AUTH-401.4
body: Hello support team, our pro account API calls are suddenly returning a 401 Unauthorized error with code API-AUTH-401.4. This key was working fine previously. Please help us get this sorted out soon.
resolution: Verify the API key's status in the Admin Console ('API Keys' section). Check if it has expired or been revoked. Advise the user to regenerate a new API key if necessary and update their application.

subject: Mobile app keeps asking for login after update
body: Since the v4.2 update, our team members are frequently getting booted from the mobile app with a CD-AM-011 error. It seems like the sessions are expiring way too fast. Could you look into this when you have a moment?
resolution: The v4.2 update included important changes to session management to increase security for all users.
