subject: API integration failing - 403 Forbidden - API-AUTH-403.5
body: Our new integration using the CloudDesk REST API is failing to make any calls. We're consistently receiving a 'Client Not Authorized' or 403 Forbidden error, even though we are using a valid API key. This is blocking our payroll run which needs to happen by tomorrow morning. Please assist promptly.
resolution: To resolve this, please confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes/permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: Account locked despite correct credentials
body: I am currently unable to access my account after receiving an 'Account Locked' message. I am positive my credentials are correct, yet I am completely blocked. This is hindering our work and we need it resolved immediately. We see error code AUTH-LOCK-429.1 appearing. Could you please unlock this for us right away?
resolution: Our security policy locks accounts after multiple failed attempts. You can simply wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire automatically. Alternatively, an administrator can manually unlock your account by navigating to the Admin Console under Users, selecting Manage User, and clicking Unlock Account.

subject: deleted user still showing in share dialogs
body: deleted a user but their name is still showing up in sharing lists. error code cd-am-006. please fix soon.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as 'ghost' entries in historical share lists until the system purges them (typically within 24-48 hours) or until a workspace owner explicitly removes them from a share via 'Workspace Settings > Members'. This is expected behavior.

subject: Too many conflict files in sync
body: We are having issues where the desktop sync client creates duplicate files with 'Conflict' in the name even when no one else is editing them. It is causing a lot of clutter in our shared folders. Is there a way to stop this behavior?
resolution: This behavior is typically caused by network instability or security software interfering with the sync process. We recommend temporarily disabling your firewall or antivirus to see if the conflict errors stop. If they do, please add CloudDesk to your software's whitelist and ensure your network connection remains stable.

subject: unintended plan upgrade charge
body: hi support our account got upgraded to a paid plan by mistake and we need a refund for it. we didnt mean to change our subscription at all. please look into this when you have a moment thanks.
resolution: Hello. Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account for eligibility.

subject: Missing failed login attempts in audit log
body: We have an executive board audit on Friday and I cannot find failed login attempts in the audit log. Only successful logins are visible and we suspect a breach. Error AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN is present. This is critically urgent for our revenue and compliance audit deadline.
resolution: Hello. Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses/locations are recorded in the 'Security Events' log, not 'Login Activity'. Navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events for this information. Enable 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic alerts.

subject: google sso redirect loop on login
body: Hi team when logging in with google sso users get stuck in a redirect loop and never reach the dashboard we are seeing code AUTH-SSO-302.1 please advise
resolution: To resolve this, please instruct the affected users to clear their browser's cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com. If the issue continues, advise them to try an incognito window or switch to a different browser while we investigate further. Additionally, please double-check your Google SSO settings inside the Admin Console.

subject: Okta SSO login attribute mismatch error
body: Hello, thank you for your assistance. We are trying to set up logins and getting SSO-OKTA-403 right after Okta redirection. This is currently blocking our team from accessing the web app on our free plan, so prompt help would be greatly appreciated.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, please verify that the 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to the CloudDesk user profile fields. Additionally, ensure that 'email' is explicitly set as the unique identifier for user matching.

subject: ACCOUNT LOCKED OUT - URGENT HELP NEEDED
body: My team is receiving AUTH-LOCK-429.1 errors and cannot access their accounts at all. We have an important payroll run tomorrow morning and this is absolutely critical. Fix this right now!
resolution: We are sorry for the trouble. Affected users will be automatically unlocked after 15 minutes, or you can manually unlock the specific accounts immediately through the Users section of your Admin Console.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership to user
body: Hello, I am trying to transfer ownership of a workspace to a colleague, but the option is greyed out. I am receiving error CD-AM-004 when I try to proceed. Any advice on how to fix this would be appreciated.
resolution: The transfer option is only available for users who are already members of that specific workspace. Please ensure the colleague has been added to the workspace first. Once they are a member, you can successfully transfer ownership via the Admin Console under the workspace settings.

subject: Cannot remove user from workspace
body: Hi team, I am trying to delete a user from our workspace in the admin console. I keep getting an error message CD-AM-014 saying the user cannot be removed. Please advise how to proceed so I can clean up our directory.
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace. The ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign.

subject: Admin console access redirected improperly
body: Good afternoon, I hope your week is going well. I was trying to check our billing statements and user allocations earlier while reviewing our quarterly software expenses, and when I attempted to access the Admin Console from my phone, I was redirected to the standard user dashboard or received an access denied message with error code ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. It is not an emergency by any means, but I would appreciate it if someone could investigate this when convenient.
resolution: Please confirm the user's role in the Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Roles'. Ensure they have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned, and update their role if it was changed.

subject: webhooks failing, need help now
body: our webhooks are failing with error WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500. we have a big audit on friday and need these logs working. can you help us get this fixed immediately?
resolution: Verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range (refer to documentation for current IPs).

subject: Update purchase order number on future invoices
body: Good morning, we need to add a new purchase order number to our future invoices for accounting and billing purposes. The error code BILL-PO-008 was mentioned in a previous notice. There is no rush on this update, whenever you have a moment.
resolution: You can add or update your PO number by going to Admin Console, then Billing, and Billing Information, and locating the Purchase Order Number field. Changes made here will apply automatically to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: desktop sync app login loop with sso
body: Hi team, we are having trouble logging into the desktop sync client using sso today. the browser redirects fine but the client stays unauthenticated or shows login failed with error DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. can you please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version v4.2.1 or newer. Check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, you can try logging in via email and password if SSO is not strictly enforced for your account.

subject: search results are missing documents
body: so we have been using the platform for a few months now and have accumulated quite a few project files, but the search feature seems to be missing things lately. we really need to find these documents quickly for a meeting tomorrow. it is giving the SEARCH-002 error sometimes too. can you fix this?
resolution: Your search index may be outdated. Please try using a more specific query in quotes; if that fails, logging out and back in will force a re-index of your account.

subject: Privacy concern regarding file uploads
body: I have discovered that the desktop sync client has uploaded files from my personal 'Documents' folder without my permission. I am quite concerned about this breach of privacy. I noticed the error code SYNC_CLIENT_UNAUTHORIZED_UPLOAD appearing in the background process. Could you explain why this happened?
resolution: The desktop client only syncs directories that have been explicitly flagged for synchronization. Please check your client settings under the 'Synced Folders' tab to verify which paths are currently active. If this was an unintended sync, you can disable the folder or contact your IT department if the sync policy was pushed via an admin profile.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report in the admin console and the page just stays completely blank. Other reports are loading fine so I know the system is working. Please look into this report-001 issue when you have a moment.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Storage limit is too small
body: We hit our storage cap almost immediately on the free tier and need it increased right now! It is ridiculous that a developer integrating the API has to deal with this restriction when we are just testing your platform. Please fix this so we can keep working without paying you yet.
resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time. Please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

subject: Invitation emails not received by new members
body: hello, when we invite new members to a workspace the invitation emails are not being received by them and show as pending with error code email-005. there are no bounce backs. this isn't super urgent, just wanted to check on it when you have a bit of time.
resolution: please check your company's email spam or junk folders first. if not found, ensure your email domain's spf and dkim records are configured to allow emails from cloudesk's sending domains by referring to our email delivery troubleshooting guide in the admin console. if the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Downgrading subscription plan
body: We need to downgrade our subscription as we have reduced our team size significantly. Please process this request as soon as you can.
resolution: To downgrade, go to your Billing settings in the Admin Console and select the desired tier. Note that the change will take effect at the end of your current cycle, and we do not offer prorated refunds.

subject: Card details invalid error during update
body: Hello, thank you for your support. We are trying to add a new company credit card to our free workspace, but error BILL-PAY-012 keeps appearing even though all numbers and the CVV are correct. We need assistance promptly to update our payment method.
resolution: This error can happen due to temporary gateway issues or strict issuer restrictions. Please turn off any active VPNs and try submitting the card again after thirty minutes, or try an alternative card if the problem persists.

subject: Seat limit reached error incorrectly showing
body: Hello, I am trying to add a couple of new team members to our workspace, but the system keeps throwing a Seat limit reached error code CD-AM-001. However, our subscription details clearly show we still have available seats left. This is a bit frustrating since we need to onboard staff today, though I can wait a little bit for a fix.
resolution: Please verify your 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations', as pending invitations count towards your total seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: API requests receiving 403 Forbidden error
body: Good afternoon, our new integration using the CloudDesk REST API is failing to make any calls and is receiving a 403 Forbidden error, despite using a valid API key. This is blocking our upcoming deployment scheduled for our payroll run tomorrow. Could you please provide prompt assistance with error API-AUTH-403.5?
resolution: Hello! Please confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes and permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints you are calling. An administrator can review and adjust these API key scopes directly in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: Webhooks failing with connection error
body: We have noticed our webhooks are failing with a 'Connection refused' error. This started recently and is affecting our automated workflows. The logs show error code WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 for most attempts. Please let us know how to resolve this.
resolution: Please verify your webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Ensure your external service is running, accessible from the public internet, and that your firewall is configured to allow incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range.

subject: WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT on large workspaces
body: We are consistently hitting a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT when trying to access directories with over 10,000 files. The web app simply hangs on a blank screen for over 30 seconds. Is there a known fix or a recommended way to optimize these views?
resolution: This behavior often occurs when loading a very high volume of files simultaneously. We recommend using our search or filter tools to narrow your view or breaking the workspace down into smaller sub-directories. Please also check your browser console for any persistent network errors.

subject: Issue with mobile MFA registration
body: While testing the mobile app integration, I encountered an error when attempting to configure MFA after scanning the QR code. The app returns MFA-MOB-002, preventing the device from registering correctly. Are there known issues with the mobile registration flow?
resolution: You have encountered a known issue with the mobile MFA registration process. Please complete the setup via the CloudDesk web app settings under Security instead. Once configured successfully on the web, it will immediately work for your mobile app logins as well.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop on desktop sync client
body: Hello, when attempting to log in to the desktop sync client using Google SSO, users are stuck in an infinite redirect loop and never reach the dashboard. Please let us know how to resolve this looping issue.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Workspace loading times are too slow
body: Navigating to workspaces with over 10,000 files is causing the app to hang for over 30 seconds. We are getting a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error on the client side. This is really hindering our API-driven workflows.
resolution: Loading very large workspaces can cause performance degradation; we suggest splitting those files into smaller, more manageable workspaces. You can also use our search and filter options to minimize the number of items loaded at once. Please check your browser console for any specific network errors that might be occurring during the load.

subject: Azure AD SSO login error
body: We are getting an error whenever our users try to sign in with SSO. It says there is a Reply URL mismatch, error SSO-AZURE-400. Could you please look into this as soon as possible, as our staff cannot work?
resolution: You need to update your Azure AD application registration settings for CloudDesk. Please ensure the Reply URL is set exactly to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs', making sure to replace the placeholder with your specific company subdomain.

subject: Mobile app network error
body: I cannot access my files via the mobile app because of the MOBILE-NET-500.1 error. I have a stable internet connection, but it won't load anything. I really need to get into these documents for my payroll run tomorrow.
resolution: Please force close the mobile app and check for updates in your device's app store. If the issue persists, please clear the app cache or perform a fresh reinstall to reset the connection.

subject: External user audit logs missing data
body: Hi there, I noticed that when my team shares files externally, we cannot see who actually opens them in the audit logs. It only shows our own employee. This is a bit frustrating because we need to see the external parties for compliance. Is there a way to fix this soon?
resolution: By default, shared links are anonymous, which is why you see the AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS status. To capture visitor identity, you must enable 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login' when creating the share link. Please note that this change will only apply to new links generated moving forward.

subject: MFA codes not working on mobile app
body: My Google Authenticator codes are not being accepted when I try to sign into the mobile app. I keep seeing error AUTH-MFA-401.2 and I absolutely have to access these files for a payroll run tomorrow morning. Please help me fix this immediately.
resolution: Please ensure your phone's time is set to synchronize automatically with your network's time, as time drift often causes MFA codes to fail. If that doesn't work, please log in through our web app and reset your MFA settings under the Security tab. This will allow you to re-link your device and restore access.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report, but the page is completely empty. I keep seeing error REPORT-001 every time I try to load it. This is incredibly frustrating as I need to audit our usage records today! Please fix this immediately.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering, and let us know the date range you are trying to view.

subject: admin api key getting permission denied error
body: our api key with admin scope is receiving a 403 permission denied error on the data export endpoint. this was working fine yesterday. please advise.
resolution: Hello. Effective recently, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Please generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in Admin Console > API Management.

subject: Frequent 429 rate limit errors
body: We are getting API-RATE-429 errors quite often when using your service. It seems to happen whenever we have a busy period. We can wait for a fix, but it would be nice to have this smoothed out.
resolution: We recommend implementing exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client to handle these responses gracefully. Additionally, review your application's API usage patterns to see if calls can be optimized. If your usage is legitimate and exceeds current thresholds, feel free to contact us to request a rate limit increase.

subject: Exporting audit logs for over 90 days
body: I attempted to pull audit logs for the last six months but received error AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. Is there a way to export these records for longer periods?
resolution: The Admin Console export limit is 90 days. For longer periods, please use our API endpoint /v1/audit/export with your desired date range, or reach out to us if you need assistance with a manual data pull.

subject: want to change to annual billing plan
body: Hi, we want to switch our subscription from monthly to annual billing to take advantage of annual discounts on our pro plan. We keep getting error code BILL-PLAN-004 when trying to find the option. No rush since our cycle has time left, but please help.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to the Admin Console, navigate to Billing, Subscription Details, and click Change Plan. Select the annual option for your current plan so it takes effect at the start of your next billing period with any unused monthly credit prorated.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Password reset emails are not coming through. Checked spam already. Other mail works.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and check if the user's domain is configured with an approved email sender list. If not, advise adding no-reply@cloudesk.com to their allowlist. You can also manually trigger a password reset from the Admin Console if necessary.

subject: Request for Microsoft Teams app
body: Hello, our organization is looking for a direct integration with Microsoft Teams to share CloudDesk files. Please let us know if this is on the product roadmap.
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper, direct integration is not yet available. Please vote for this integration or add your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams. We are constantly evaluating new integrations based on customer demand.

subject: MFA code rejection in mobile app
body: Hello, I am having trouble with the mobile app today. It keeps rejecting my MFA codes, and the error AUTH-MFA-401.2 is displayed. I would appreciate your help in resolving this when you have a moment.
resolution: Please ensure your phone's clock is set to sync automatically with network time, as even a small drift can cause codes to fail. If that does not work, you can re-configure your MFA settings by visiting the 'Security Settings' page in the web app.

subject: Payment failure error BILL-PAY-002
body: Our PRO subscription renewal failed today. I see error code BILL-PAY-002 in the billing portal and we need this resolved immediately to avoid service interruption. Could you please assist in processing this payment?
resolution: Please navigate to Admin Console, then Billing, then Payment Methods to update your credit card details. Ensure the billing address matches your bank records. Once updated, you can retry the payment from the Invoices section.

subject: Need more file versions for upcoming audit
body: Hi, we love using CloudDesk for our files. We have an audit on Friday and really need to retain more file versions than the current limit allows. Is there any way to increase this for us? Thanks for your time.
resolution: We appreciate the feedback regarding your versioning needs. Our current limits are designed to balance performance and storage, but you can submit this as a formal request at roadmap.cloudesk.com. This allows our product team to track demand and prioritize future enhancements.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: Hi there. When I go to the User Activity report page it loads but no data shows up. Its just a blank screen. Ive tried to look at other reports and those seem fine though. Any help would be appreciated.
resolution: This appears to be a temporary data retrieval issue. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, then try accessing the report again. If it remains blank, please let us know which specific date range you are attempting to view.

subject: AUDIT LOG EXPORT FAILED OVER 90 DAYS
body: TRYING TO EXPORT AUDIT LOGS FOR MORE THAN NINETY DAYS GIVES ME A STUPID ERROR MESSAGE ABOUT EXPORT RANGE LIMIT EXCEEDED. TAKE YOUR TIME GETTING BACK TO ME AS IT IS NOT PRESSING.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days by design. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script. You can also contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible for your team.

subject: Incorrect tax rate applied to invoice
body: The tax rate on my latest invoice is completely wrong for my business location. I keep seeing error BILL-TAX-006 when I look at the tax breakdown. Please fix this calculation asap.
resolution: Please verify that your billing address and tax ID are entered correctly under the Billing section of the Admin Console. If those fields are already correct, please send us your company's full legal name, registered address, and a copy of your tax exemption certificate. We will then perform a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: Request refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: Dear support team, thank you for your wonderful service. Unfortunately, our account was accidentally upgraded, and we would like to request a refund for the charge under BILL-REF-005. We appreciate your assistance with this matter whenever you have time.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Desktop client creating unnecessary conflict files
body: Our team is seeing a lot of SYNC-003 errors where the client flags files as conflicts even when no other edits were made. This results in many duplicate files being generated. Is there a way to prevent these false flags?
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or security software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus or firewall and try syncing again, then add CloudDesk to your whitelist if that works. Also, ensure your network connection remains stable.

subject: Frequent file conflicts on desktop sync
body: Dear support, the desktop sync client is frequently flagging files as conflict even when there are no concurrent edits. This creates duplicate files with sync-003 errors and we need this resolved before our big client audit on Friday.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again before Friday's audit. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist and ensure your connection is stable.

subject: Existing API key returning 401 Unauthorized
body: Hello CloudDesk support team, I hope you are doing well today. We are suddenly experiencing a 401 Unauthorized error with the API-AUTH-401.4 code when using an API key that was working perfectly yesterday. We would greatly appreciate your prompt assistance in helping us get this resolved so our contractor integrations can resume.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out and for your patience. Please verify the API key's status in the Admin Console under the 'API Keys' section to check if it has expired or been revoked. We advise generating a new API key if necessary and promptly updating your application with it.

subject: Trouble logging in with authenticator app
body: I have been using the desktop client for a long time and usually it works perfectly, but today I am having a bit of a struggle. I recently updated my operating system and also had a busy morning with meetings, and now my Google Authenticator codes are not being accepted when I try to sync. I keep seeing AUTH-MFA-401.2 pop up. Could you help me get back to work when you have a moment?
resolution: This error often occurs when there is a time drift between your device and our servers. Please ensure your phone's clock is set to sync automatically with the network time. If that does not resolve the issue, you can re-set up MFA for your account through the 'Security Settings' page in the web app.

subject: Google SSO Redirect Loop Issue
body: Hello support. Several of our finance users are experiencing authentication issues when logging in via Google SSO. They get stuck in an endless redirect loop after entering their credentials and never reach the dashboard, encountering error AUTH-SSO-302.1. We can wait for a resolution, but please look into it when possible.
resolution: Please instruct the affected users to clear their browser cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com. If the issue persists, advise them to try an incognito window or a different browser while we verify your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Wanting to change our subscription plan to lower tier
body: Hello, I am writing to ask how we can move our account to a lower subscription tier. Our team size has decreased recently and we no longer need all the features we have. Sometimes we see code BILL-PLAN-011 when looking around. Please let me know the steps when you have time.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Adding users failing due to seat limit error
body: I am writing to you today because I am attempting to add a few new people to our team, but it keeps giving me the CD-AM-001 error. I have been with this company for quite a while now, and we have always enjoyed using your services for our daily operations, but this is causing a minor holdup in our onboarding flow. I checked our subscription details, and it clearly shows we have available seats remaining. Could you help me look into why this is happening?
resolution: The error occurs because your 'Pending Invitations' are counting against your total seat limit. Please navigate to 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and revoke any old or unused invitations. Once cleared, you should be able to add your new team members without issue.

subject: NEED PDF INVOICES NOW ERROR BILL-INV-009
body: I have been trying to download our invoices for the month but the system only gives me CSV files! We require PDF format for our records and this is extremely frustrating. I am seeing error code BILL-INV-009 when I click the export button. Please fix this quickly so I can finish my reports.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Incorrect names in activity logs
body: I noticed that some file actions in our workspace activity log are showing the wrong names. It seems like a regular user's actions are being attributed to an admin instead, and I see a note about AUDIT-004. It is not causing any major problems, but it would be great to get it fixed.
resolution: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. This is a known display issue where actions by 'Contributor' roles are misattributed when an admin is active in the same space. Your audit data remains accurate, and you can verify the correct logs by checking the global audit report in the Admin Console.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error on PRO plan
body: Hello support team. We are currently experiencing an issue where users from specific domains cannot log in via Google SSO and instead receive a Domain not allowed error. We are on the PRO plan and this is quite disruptive to our workflow. Please look into this SSO-GOOGLE-403 error as soon as possible.
resolution: To resolve this, please head into the CloudDesk Admin Console's SSO & Identity settings for Google SSO and check your Allowed Domains list. Simply add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO, and your users will be able to sign in successfully.

subject: Desktop Sync client constantly asks me to log back in
body: Since we updated to v4.2, my desktop sync client keeps logging me out. Every time it happens, I see the error code SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 in the logs. It is becoming quite a nuisance to re-authenticate multiple times a day. Please let me know how to stop this from happening.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how SSO tokens are handled, which is likely causing your sync client to drop the connection. Please perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client by uninstalling it, restarting your machine, and installing the latest version. If you continue to see the SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 error, your IT team may need to adjust the token lifetime settings in your IdP configuration.

subject: need to change subscription plan
body: so we have been building out our internal rest api integration using our free account and testing various endpoints all morning while drinking our third cup of coffee and looking at our budget spreadsheet which is quite a mess honestly since the team shrank so much lately and we realized we really need to drop down to a cheaper tier because we dont use half these features anyway error code BILL-PLAN-011 let me know how to do it thanks
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Subscription renewal payment failed notification
body: We received an automated email indicating that our automatic subscription renewal failed due to a declined credit card on our enterprise account. The admin console currently displays a payment failed status. Please let us know how to update our billing details and reprocess the invoice.
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank, and you can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: WE NEED SSO LOGIN PAGE BRANDING CUSTOMIZATION NOW
body: As an external contractor managing this workspace, our admins urgently wish to customize the SSO login page with our company logo and branding colors for a more cohesive user experience! Why is there no straightforward option for this in the platform? We need this addressed soon.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available. We recognize this as a valuable feature for many enterprises, and we invite you to add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding.

subject: Desktop sync icon stuck connecting
body: Hello support team, the Desktop Sync client icon has been showing as connecting or indexing indefinitely for us. Files are unfortunately not syncing to or from the local folder, and there is no specific error message shown in the UI. We would greatly appreciate your prompt assistance with this matter.
resolution: Please restart the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache by going to 'Settings' > 'Advanced' > 'Clear Cache'. If it remains unresolved, we suggest performing a full reinstall of the client after backing up any local unsynced files.

subject: Payment failed and subscription renewal blocked
body: Our automatic subscription renewal on the Pro plan just failed because of a declined credit card. We are currently seeing error BILL-PAY-002 in the admin console. It seems many customers are hitting this exact same payment processing glitch right now. We need prompt help to resolve this as it is blocking our team's work.
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: Workspace loading issues with large file counts
body: Hello support team, when I navigate to our main enterprise workspace containing over 10,000 files in the web app, the page takes an excessive amount of time to load. It often displays a blank screen or a spinner for well over 30 seconds, occasionally throwing WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT. Could you please look into this whenever you have a moment?
resolution: We are currently seeing a high volume of reports regarding large file counts in workspaces. Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace and advise users to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. We also suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones, and verifying the browser console for any network errors.

subject: Desktop sync client causing high CPU and memory usage
body: Hello support team, we are experiencing a critical issue where the CloudDeskSync process is consuming over 50 percent CPU and more than 2GB of memory even when completely idle. This is heavily impacting our workstations and needs urgent attention today.
resolution: Please check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files currently being processed. We advise pausing the sync, restarting your computer, and then resuming sync. If this persists, try temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks or checking for conflicting antivirus software.

subject: API tokens failing after v4.2 update
body: Hi, we are suddenly receiving 401 Unauthorized errors with 'legacy_token_format' since updating to v4.2. This is critical as our entire production integration is currently down. Could you please assist us with this error code API-AUTH-401-V42 as soon as possible?
resolution: With the move to v4.2, the API token format has been updated to improve security. You will need to regenerate all existing API tokens through the API and Integrations section in your Admin Console. Please update your application configurations to use these new tokens immediately to restore your connection.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: Thank you for the help with our account recently. I noticed our latest invoice shows a user count that doesn't match our active roster, referencing error BILL-INV-001. We would appreciate it if you could look into this for us.
resolution: Please verify the billing date and proration period listed on your invoice. User count changes generally take effect at the start of your next billing cycle, or are prorated if requested mid-cycle. If you still see a discrepancy, please send us the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Desktop sync SSO login returning generic error
body: Hello support team, when attempting to log into the desktop sync client using SSO, the browser redirects successfully, but the client remains unauthenticated and displays a generic login failed message. We would greatly appreciate your prompt help in resolving this blocker so our team can access their files.
resolution: Hello! Please ensure that your desktop sync client is updated to the latest version, v4.2.1 or newer. Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects, and as a temporary workaround, you can try logging in via standard email and password if SSO enforcement allows.

subject: Desktop sync failing after password reset
body: Hi there, I recently changed my account password through the web interface as per our security protocol. However, my desktop application is now throwing authentication errors and won't sync any files. Could you advise?
resolution: After a password change, the Desktop Sync client requires you to re-authenticate manually. Please open the sync application, access the settings menu or system tray icon, select disconnect or log out, and then sign back in using your new credentials.

subject: Slow file download speeds for collaborators
body: Hello CloudDesk team. We have noticed that when our collaborators download files from a workspace, the download speed is significantly slower than expected based on their internet connection. Everything else is running smoothly, but large file transfers are taking much longer than normal. Thank you for your help in looking into this.
resolution: Test download speeds using a different browser or network. Advise checking browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager if available or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Verify server region for the workspace.

subject: Cannot access shared workspace
body: One of my coworkers is trying to open a shared workspace but gets a permission denied error. It shows PERM-WS-403.4 on the screen. We really need access to those files when you have a moment to check. Thanks.
resolution: It looks like there is a mismatch in the user's current permissions for that area. An administrator will need to check the workspace members list in the Admin Console to ensure the user is assigned the correct access level.

subject: Billing section login error
body: Hi there, thank you for your help. Since the update, I get a Payment Processing Error when accessing billing. It seems to be an AUTH-BILL-402 issue. Any help would be appreciated.
resolution: The v4.2 release update can sometimes cause session issues with billing; please try logging out and back in using direct email/password or clearing your browser cache. If the issue persists, please use a direct login method for the billing section while we investigate the SSO integration.

subject: API key option greyed out
body: I am trying to generate a key for our api but the option is greyed out. Getting error CD-AM-013. My role is admin. Please advise.
resolution: API key generation requires the 'Super Admin' role. While you are an Admin, you likely lack the 'Super Admin' permissions. Please have your current Super Admin generate the key for you or elevate your account status in Team Management.

subject: Unauthorized file upload to workspace
body: Our team observed that the CloudDesk desktop sync client automatically uploaded files from local 'Documents' folders without our permission. This has raised privacy concerns for our staff who handle sensitive data, as we saw the error code SYNC_CLIENT_UNAUTHORIZED_UPLOAD. Could you please clarify why this occurred and how we can prevent it from happening again?
resolution: The desktop sync client only targets folders explicitly selected in your sync settings. Please review your 'Synced Folders' list to ensure no unintended paths were enabled, and verify that 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is set to your preferred configuration. If you did not authorize these selections, please double-check your current client settings.

subject: feature request: offline document editing
body: we really need to be able to edit docs while offline in the mobile app. right now it only lets us view starred files. syncing changes later would be a huge help for our team on the move.
resolution: Thank you for the suggestion regarding mobile productivity. While we currently only support offline viewing, we are looking into offline editing capabilities. Please add your vote to the request at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile so we can track the interest for this feature.

subject: Critical: Okta SSO Login Failure After v4.2 Update
body: Our finance team is entirely blocked from accessing the web application this morning following the recent v4.2 update. Users attempting to authenticate via Okta are met with error code AUTH-SSO-401.1 stating an invalid token format. Please resolve this immediately as it is severely impacting our operations.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in the v4.2 release.

subject: search hanging in workspace
body: hi there, search is taking forever in one specific workspace. i keep getting WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG. any tips?
resolution: It is likely that the workspace contains an exceptionally high number of files or deeply nested folders. Try using more specific search terms or path-based filtering to narrow the scope. If the search remains slow, please provide the specific workspace ID so our engineering team can review its indexing status.

subject: Blank user activity report
body: The User Activity report page is loading but shows absolutely no data, just a blank white screen. All other reports seem to be functioning as expected. Could you please investigate why this specific report is failing?
resolution: This is likely a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or try accessing the report from a different browser to rule out extension conflicts. If it remains blank, let us know which date range you are attempting to pull.

subject: Audit log retention period limit
body: Hello, I am trying to set our audit log retention period in the Admin Console to five years for company compliance, but the maximum option I can find is only twelve months. Please let me know how we can extend this when you have time.
resolution: Hello. The maximum configurable audit log retention directly within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution such as Splunk or Sumo Logic via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally.

subject: Cannot create custom role, 'Role name already exists'
body: I'm trying to create a new custom role, but I keep getting an error that says 'Role name already exists,' even though the name I'm using appears to be unique. I've double-checked, and I don't see another role with this exact name. Can you assist?
resolution: Thank you for reaching out. The 'Role name already exists' error can sometimes occur due to case-insensitivity or leading/trailing spaces in role names. Please check your 'Admin Console > Team Management > Roles' section thoroughly for any existing roles that might have a similar name, differing only by capitalization or an accidental space. The system trims spaces and disregards case when checking for uniqueness.

subject: Lag when editing documents together
body: Hello! We really love using CloudDesk for our team. Lately, when multiple users are editing an Office document simultaneously in the web app, there is noticeable lag between typing and seeing changes reflected for other collaborators, along with COLLAB_LAG errors. We would appreciate it if this could be looked into soon.
resolution: We are aware that many customers are hitting this issue right now. Please check network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure all users have a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and applications, verifying if the issue persists if fewer users are editing, and clearing browser cache for all users.

subject: Mobile app session issues blocking our workflow
body: We have an audit on Friday and our team is struggling because the mobile app keeps logging them out with an Expired Session error. We noticed the CD-AM-011 code frequently. Is there any way to fix this quickly so we can stay on schedule?
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to session management for improved security. Please have your users fully log out of the mobile app, clear their app cache or reinstall the application, and then log back in to force a new, compatible session token.

subject: Google SSO login failing for specific domains
body: We are extremely frustrated that our users are getting blocked by an SSO-GOOGLE-403 error. Only certain domains are failing while others work fine. We need this working immediately as our staff cannot access their files.
resolution: It appears the issue is related to your domain configuration in the Admin Console. Please navigate to 'SSO & Identity' and check the 'Allowed Domains' list under your Google SSO settings. You will need to add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google to restore access for those users.

subject: cant login since v4.2 update failing
body: Every single one of us is locked out right now with endless loading screens and token parse errors after authenticating! This is completely unacceptable and hurting our business operations right this second fix this immediately!
resolution: This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Advise the admin to re-save their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the 'Application Sign On URL' format. Clear browser cache and cookies for affected users.

subject: API TOKENS BROKEN WITH 401 ERROR AFTER V4.2
body: THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE! Since upgrading to v4.2, ALL of our existing API integrations are returning 401 Unauthorized with a legacy_token_format error (API-AUTH-401-V42). Our production environment is completely down right now and revenue is severely impacted. Fix this immediately or escalate to a manager!
resolution: With the v4.2 release, the API token format was updated for enhanced security. You must regenerate all of your API tokens directly from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console and update your connected applications to use these new credentials.

subject: folder files endpoint returning 404
body: Hello, getting API-NOTFOUND-404 on some calls to the /folders/{id}/files path. The id looks correct on our end. Just wanted to let you know when you have a spare moment, no rush.
resolution: Verify the API endpoint path and HTTP method against the latest CloudDesk API documentation. Ensure the resource ID (e.g., folder ID) is valid and accessible to the API token's permissions.

subject: New users not provisioning automatically via SSO
body: Hi, why arent new users getting provisioned automatically when they log in through SSO. We have Just in Time Provisioning turned on in the console but its just failing for everyone today. Please fix this soon.
resolution: Verify that your SSO Identity Provider (IdP) is correctly sending the required user attributes (email, first_name, last_name) in the SAML/OIDC assertion. Also, ensure there are available seats in your CloudDesk subscription. Check 'Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings' for any recent configuration changes or errors.

subject: Slow download speeds from shared links
body: We are noticing that file downloads are significantly slower than our connection allows. It is affecting our productivity, as waiting for files is taking much longer than expected. Can you look into this?
resolution: To troubleshoot this, please test the download from a different browser or network. If you are handling large files, I recommend using our Desktop Sync client, which provides more reliable and faster transfer speeds compared to web browser downloads.

subject: SSO login hanging and throwing errors
body: The v4.2 update broke our SSO login flow. It just hangs and then we get a SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2 error. Our team cant login at all and its completely blocking our development work. Please look into this right away.
resolution: This issue is related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Please re-save your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console to re-generate the necessary internal certificates. Also, ensure you clear your browser cache and cookies for the affected users.

subject: Desktop app stuck indexing
body: Our desktop sync client is stuck showing 'Indexing' and no files are updating. This is blocking our team's workflow and needs to be resolved promptly. Please advise.
resolution: Please restart the Desktop Sync client. If that does not work, go to Settings > Advanced and clear the application cache to resolve the synchronization hang.

subject: BLANK USER ACTIVITY REPORT IN ADMIN CONSOLE
body: Why is the User Activity report completely blank when I try to open it?! Every other report in the admin console loads fine, but this specific page remains empty and throws REPORT-001. We need to review team engagement metrics soon, so please look into this.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Need better activity reports
body: The current audit logs are very limited and do not provide the detail I need. I am unable to track specific file downloads or collaboration actions effectively. This is quite frustrating as I need to monitor project activity for my team.
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding the need for more granular reporting. Please share your specific use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting so our team can prioritize these features for future updates.

subject: payment failed for subscription
body: hey there, our automatic subscription renewal failed because of a declined credit card. i got the email and see payment failed status in billing. can you help when you get a chance?
resolution: Please navigate to Admin Console, then Billing, and open Payment Methods to update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment directly from the Invoices section.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Hello support team. We have an enterprise integration setup where a CloudDesk trigger for a new file upload is not working properly. We noticed the error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 in our logs. Could you please look into this when you have a moment?
resolution: In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. Check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: large file uploads timing out
body: hi there files are taking forever to upload and timing out when they are over 1gb. the progress bar keeps stalling and i see upload_timeout_504. could you please help us out quickly
resolution: We are receiving several reports regarding upload timeouts right now. Please check your internet connection speed. For files over 500MB, we strongly recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads, as it supports resumable transfers.

subject: Unable to delete workspace error CD-AM-007
body: I am trying to remove an old workspace but it keeps failing with error code CD-AM-007. I checked the settings but everything seems standard. Please let me know how to proceed so we can clean up our account.
resolution: To delete this workspace, you must first disconnect all active integrations like Slack or Jira linked to it. Please go to Workspace Settings and remove any integrations listed there. Once these are cleared, the deletion should process without further errors.

subject: Unable to access private workspace for audit
body: I need to access a user's workspace for a compliance audit but the system is blocking me with a PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED message. This is critical for our review. Please assist.
resolution: By default, private workspaces are inaccessible even to administrators for enhanced privacy. You can gain temporary access by initiating a 'Workspace Access Request' through the Admin Console under Users, then the User Profile, and finally Workspaces. This action generates an audit log entry and will require a compliance officer override if the user is inactive.

subject: Webhook delivery failing due to signature error
body: Our integration is broken because of a WEBHOOK-SIGN-403 error. The external service is rejecting everything due to invalid HMAC signatures. We need this fixed pronto.
resolution: Please confirm that your receiving service is using the exact same 'Webhook Secret' found in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Additionally, ensure your signature verification algorithm is set to HMAC-SHA256 to match our implementation. This should stop the signature rejection and allow your webhooks to process correctly.

subject: Files not syncing to desktop app
body: Hi there. Since the recent v4.2 update the desktop client isnt showing any new files i add from the web. I dont see any error codes but its really blocking my workflow. I need this working asap. Hope you can help.
resolution: It appears the local sync database needs a refresh following the v4.2 update. Please uninstall the desktop client, delete the cache folder in your AppData or Application Support directory, and reinstall the application. This should resolve the synchronization issues you are experiencing.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on GET files endpoint
body: Hello, our automated integrations are failing because calls to the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint intermittently return a HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, especially for files stored across different global regions. Other API routes work fine. We are seeing a high volume of these API-500 failures right now across multiple regions. Please advise.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are actively investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval across regional nodes and will deploy a permanent fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: API failure after v4.2 update
body: We are experiencing a total system outage with our automated scripts because of the API-AUTH-401-V42 error occurring after your recent v4.2 update. This is affecting all of our live production services and we need an immediate solution to restore our connectivity. Why was this not flagged as a breaking change?
resolution: We apologize for the disruption. The v4.2 release included an update to the authentication token format, requiring all existing tokens to be regenerated. Please head to the API & Integrations section of your Admin Console to issue new tokens for your applications.

subject: Unrecognized charge on company credit card
body: We noticed a charge on our credit card statement from CloudDesk that we do not recognize and cannot reconcile with our billing records. Error code BILL-CHG-010 was referenced in our internal review of the statement. Could you please look into this and clarify the charges?
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Search results incomplete in web app
body: When I search for specific terms in the web app, the results are missing documents I know are there. For example, if I search for 'Q4 Budget', it doesn't show me the document I uploaded last week. This isn't super urgent, but it's annoying.
resolution: This issue can sometimes be due to an outdated search index. Please try performing a more specific search using exact phrases in quotes. If the problem persists, log out and then log back into your account, as this can trigger a re-indexing. If you still have trouble, please provide the specific search terms and expected results for further investigation.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade refund request
body: Hello, I believe our account was upgraded by mistake. We would like to request a refund for this charge. Thank you so much for your time and help.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: I accidentally upgraded our account to the wrong tier earlier today. I am extremely frustrated that it was so easy to trigger this without a confirmation. I see a BILL-REF-005 error, and I need this corrected immediately. Can you please process a refund for the prorated difference?
resolution: We can certainly look into this for you. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that you have not utilized any features from the new plan yet. We will then review your account to see if you are eligible for a refund.

subject: Okta SSO integration is broken
body: We are getting constant errors trying to log in via Okta. Every time we redirect, we get a message saying SSO-OKTA-403 user attribute mismatch. This is completely blocking our workflow. Please look into this right away.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, please verify that the 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to the CloudDesk user profile fields. It is also important to ensure 'email' is set as the unique identifier.

subject: Mobile app file previews not loading
body: Previews for PDFs are failing on our mobile app with MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL. It is quite annoying when trying to view files on the go. Could you look into this?
resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version and try clearing the app's cache via your device settings. If you are dealing with very large files, please download the file directly to your device for viewing. Checking your network connection can also help resolve slow load times.

subject: Seat limit error
body: I try adding new staff but it say seat limit reached. I check and we have seats available. It show CD-AM-001 error. Please fix.
resolution: Please verify your Pending Invitations count by navigating to Admin Console, Team Management, and then Invitations. These pending invites count towards your total seat limit even if they haven't been accepted yet. You can either revoke those older pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase your capacity.

subject: User activity report shows no data
body: I went to pull a report for user activity today, but the page is just blank. I see the code REPORT-001 appearing on the screen. It is only this specific report that is having trouble. Please let me know what I should do.
resolution: This is often caused by a temporary browser data conflict. Please try clearing your cache and cookies, or attempt to open the report in a different browser. If the page remains blank, please provide the specific date range you are attempting to view so we can investigate further.

subject: Audit log export range limit issue
body: I am trying to export audit logs via the Admin Console for a date range greater than 90 days on our PRO account, but the export fails and shows the error message Export range limit exceeded (90 days maximum). Please advise on how we can retrieve older logs.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is indeed limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint /v1/audit/export with your start and end ISO dates along with a pagination script, or contact support for a manual data pull.

subject: Request for Extended File Versioning Limits
body: Hello support team. We are currently utilizing the desktop sync client and find the existing 30-day limit and 100-version cap too restrictive for our development workflows. Many teams on our end are currently bumping into this same limitation right now. Could we please request an increase or more granular control over retained file versions?
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding file versioning. The current limits are set to balance storage and performance. We recommend utilizing our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com to submit your specific requirements for enhanced versioning and vote on similar requests. This helps our product team understand the demand.

subject: Missing webhook for file uploads in API
body: We are currently trying to build out an integration with our internal tooling and desperately need a webhook that triggers when a file is uploaded to a folder. It is incredibly frustrating that this basic capability is missing while everyone else is scrambling to build custom polling scripts. When will this feature be added to the public API?
resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including your desired payload structure, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so our engineering team can assess demand.

subject: API requests failing with legacy token format error after v4.2 update
body: Hello support team, thank you for your hard work on the platform. After upgrading to v4.2, our existing API tokens that worked previously now return 401 Unauthorized with a legacy_token_format error message and error code API-AUTH-401-V42. This is currently blocking our automated reporting workflows, so we would greatly appreciate your prompt assistance.
resolution: With the v4.2 release, the API token format was updated for security. You must regenerate all of your API tokens directly from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console and update your connected applications to use these new credentials.

subject: google sso redirect loop on login
body: Hi support team, some of our team members are getting stuck in a strange redirect loop right after authenticating with google sso. they authenticate successfully on google's page but never reach the dashboard. it triggers auth-sso-302.1 for them. no major rush since only a couple people are affected right now, but would appreciate a look when you have a moment. thanks!
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for cloudesk.com. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito or private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Google SSO login failing for specific domains
body: We are currently experiencing issues where some of our contractors cannot log in using Google SSO. They keep receiving an SSO-GOOGLE-403 error when they try to access their workspace. Other domains within our organization are working perfectly fine, so it seems to be limited to these specific addresses. Please let me know what needs to be changed.
resolution: This error occurs when a domain is not included in your allowed list. Please navigate to the SSO & Identity settings in your Admin Console and ensure the affected domains are added to the list of permitted domains for Google SSO.

subject: invite emails not arriving
body: invites i send to new workspace members never show up in their inbox and the status stays pending. i am seeing error code EMAIL-005. can you help me get these to go through.
resolution: Please have your users check their spam folders first to ensure the invites are not being caught there. You may also need to check your domain's SPF and DKIM records against our troubleshooting guide. If the emails are still not delivered, please provide the affected email addresses for a manual investigation.

subject: API requests failing with 403 Forbidden
body: We are currently integrating the CloudDesk API into our internal workflow, but we are stuck. All our calls are returning an API-AUTH-403.5 error, and our system is unable to authenticate even though we are using a valid API key. We have a live demo at 5 PM today and this block is making it impossible to prepare. Please fix this quickly as it seems like a widespread issue on your end.
resolution: It appears the API key currently in use lacks the necessary permissions for the endpoints you are calling. Please have your administrator navigate to Admin Console > API Keys to review and verify that the correct scopes are enabled for that key. Once the permissions are updated, your requests should proceed without further issues.

subject: Request for longer public link expiration times
body: We would like to know if it is possible to set public sharing links to never expire or have a much longer duration. There is no urgency for this request.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is enforced for security best practices, and while we do not plan to offer a never-expire option, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please submit your specific use case for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration, or consider inviting users directly to a workspace for permanent sharing.

subject: Slack notifications not working
body: Our file share notifications are failing to post to our Slack channel. We have checked the settings, but nothing is coming through, and we see error code SLACK-NOTIFY-500. This is very frustrating as we rely on these alerts to track project updates. Please let us know how to fix this.
resolution: Please double-check your Slack integration settings within the Admin Console to ensure the correct workspace and channel are linked. Additionally, verify that the CloudDesk app has been granted the necessary permissions to post messages in your Slack channel. This usually resolves the connection failure.

subject: Sync client creating unnecessary conflict files before audit
body: Hello support, our finance team is facing constant sync conflicts creating duplicate files with error SYNC-003, even though no one else is editing them. We have our big financial audit on Friday morning, so we really need this resolved soon to avoid confusion. Thank you for your wonderful help!
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus or firewall and try syncing again, and if successful, add CloudDesk to your security software's whitelist while also ensuring your network connection is stable.

subject: CRITICAL: Okta SSO token error locking out enterprise users
body: Our entire organization is currently locked out of CloudDesk following the recent v4.2 update. Users attempting to log in via Okta SSO are encountering the AUTH-SSO-401.1 error code with an invalid SSO token format message. This is a severe blocker affecting our revenue operations and executive team. We require an immediate fix for this emergency.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in the SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Desktop sync client not updating files
body: After the recent update to v4.2, my desktop sync client is failing to pull new files that are added to the web app. I see SYNC-001 popping up in my logs periodically. Everything is visible on the web and mobile, but the local machine remains stuck on old data. Is there a known fix for this sync issue?
resolution: This behavior can occur following the v4.2 update if there is a conflict in the local sync cache. Please uninstall the client, manually delete the local sync folder from your AppData or Library directory, and perform a clean reinstallation. This should resolve the communication issue with our servers.

subject: Data retention policy not working
body: Our 30-day retention policy is completely ignored. I can still see files in the trash bin from over two months ago! This is a massive compliance issue for us and it needs to be fixed immediately.
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: API integration failing with 403 error
body: Our new integration is failing to make any calls to the REST API, resulting in a 403 Forbidden error. We are using a valid key, but getting API-AUTH-403.5. We need this working today as it is blocking our dev pipeline.
resolution: Please confirm that your API key has the correct scopes assigned for the endpoints you are hitting. An administrator can review and update these permissions under the 'API Keys' section of the Admin Console.

subject: Admin console access issue

resolution: Thank you for your feature request! Dark Mode for the CloudDesk web app is a popular suggestion, though we currently do not have it available. Please vote for this feature on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/dark-mode to help us prioritize it.

subject: Helpdesk tickets missing from My Assigned Tickets view

resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: files not syncing after 4.2 update
body: since the move to 4.2 our files are not updating on the desktop client. no error messages are showing, but the local data is stale. we are seeing sync-001 in the logs. any idea how to fix this?
resolution: This usually indicates a conflict with the local cache following the v4.2 upgrade. Please perform a clean reinstallation by uninstalling the application, manually deleting the local CloudDesk cache folder, and then downloading a fresh version of the sync client from our website.

subject: billing section not working since update
body: cant access billing to update my card details. getting error auth-bill-402 since the last update. please assist ASAP.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated our SSO token format, which can cause intermittent issues with billing pages. Please try logging out and back in directly with your email and password, or clear your browser cache. If the problem continues, using a non-SSO login for billing tasks is the recommended workaround.

subject: User cannot log in after role change
body: Dear support, we recently changed one of our team member's role to Guest, and now they are reporting that they cannot log in to the web application due to insufficient permissions. Could you kindly guide us on how to restore their access properly? Thank you very much.
resolution: Hello. Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Please check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm their role and active workspace invitations, or change their role back to 'Member'.

subject: MFA setup error on mobile
body: I am trying to setup MFA on the mobile app using my authenticator, but I keep getting an error code MFA-MOB-002 after scanning the QR code. Everything else works fine. No rush on this, just wanted to report it.
resolution: There is currently a known limitation with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. To resolve this, please perform the MFA setup through the CloudDesk web app settings instead. Once you complete the setup there, it will be active and functioning for both your web and mobile logins.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing for new file uploads
body: Hi team, I am using a Zapier integration to monitor new files in our CloudDesk account, but it seems to have stopped working recently. I keep seeing ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 in my logs when the trigger fails. I would appreciate it if you could help me look into this. Thanks for your time.
resolution: To resolve this, please re-test your CloudDesk trigger step within Zapier to refresh the connection. Ensure your account has the correct permissions to access these events. You can also verify the event logs directly within your CloudDesk dashboard.

subject: Pending Invitation status persists
body: I am currently integrating your API and trying to get our team members onboarded. A user clicked the invite link, but their status is stuck at Pending Invitation. They cannot log in at all. I am receiving a CD-AM-005 error when checking the status via the API.
resolution: This issue typically occurs if the user's email domain isn't set for auto-join or if the invitation process was interrupted. Please try having the user log in directly with their email and password. If that fails, please revoke the invitation in the Admin Console and send a fresh one.

subject: google sso login loop

resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: User Not Found on new login
body: A newly invited user is trying to log in with email and password but gets an user not found error code AUTH-NF-404.1. No rush on this.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console to confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If they haven't accepted it yet, you can resend the invitation, and make sure they are logging into the correct instance URL if your company uses multiple accounts.

subject: workspace loading very slow with many files

resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: Okta SSO login issues
