resolution: You will need to update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console to accommodate the token format changes introduced in version 4.2. Simply re-upload your IDP metadata to resolve this authentication error.

subject: Critical API service unavailable errors during peak hours

resolution: Investigate the customer's API usage patterns to identify if they are exceeding rate limits (check 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header). Advise implementing exponential backoff for retries. Confirm if there are any ongoing platform incidents via the CloudDesk status page. Escalate to engineering if rate limits are not being hit.

subject: Cannot add team members due to seat limit
body: I am trying to add new team members but I keep getting a 'Seat limit reached' error, code CD-AM-001. My subscription details clearly show we have seats available. Can you please look into this?
resolution: Please check the 'Pending Invitations' section under Admin Console > Team Management. Pending invitations do count against your seat total. You can either revoke those older invitations or upgrade your plan to increase your capacity.

subject: Accidental Plan Upgrade Refund Request
body: Our account was accidentally upgraded to a paid plan due to a misclick and we need a refund immediately. This was completely unintentional and we haven't even used any paid features. Please process this refund for us right away.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Files not appearing in desktop sync
body: Files updated in web are not showing in the v4.2 desktop app. I see the SYNC-001 error occasionally. Please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: Please uninstall your current v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local cache located in your AppData or Library folder depending on your OS. Once that is done, perform a clean reinstall using the download link found in the Desktop Sync section of your web settings.

subject: Need more file version retention options
body: hi, our it team wants to know if we can get higher file version limits than the current 30 day 100 version cap in the sync client. many users are asking for this right now. take your time getting back to us since its not urgent
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding file versioning and understand the current limits are set to balance storage and performance. We recommend utilizing our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com to submit your specific requirements for enhanced versioning and vote on similar requests.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on API file endpoint
body: We are getting intermittent 500 internal server errors when calling the file content endpoint. It seems to be happening mostly for files in different regions. This is blocking our integration work and we need a solution. The error code is API-500.
resolution: The intermittent errors are related to distributed storage retrieval times. We recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your code to handle these transient failures. We are also working on a hotfix to improve backend stability for these requests.

subject: Error scanning QR code for mobile MFA
body: Hi there, im trying to set up mfa with google authenticator on my phone but it keeps giving me a failed to register mfa device error. everything else works fine for now so theres no real rush on this. thanks for any help
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app by going to Settings, then Security, and selecting Multi-Factor Authentication. Once configured there, it will function properly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Okta SSO broken after update with AUTH-402
body: Our staff cannot log in using Okta SSO today. Every attempt throws an Invalid Token Format error code AUTH-402 right back to the login page. This started right after the v4.2 platform update. Please help us resolve this promptly as our team is locked out.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise the customer's IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide (accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration').

subject: Okta SSO broken after v4.2 update with Invalid Token Format
body: Following the recent v4.2 platform update, all our users attempting to log in via Okta SSO are immediately bounced back to the login page with an Invalid Token Format error. We are on the FREE tier and this is heavily impacting our workflow. We need this addressed immediately.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console. They need to verify that the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values found under Settings > SSO & Authentication > Okta Configuration.

subject: legacy token format error on api after v42
body: Hi there, hope youre having a good day. since updating to v4.2, all of our api calls are failing with api-auth-401-v42 and a legacy_token_format message. this is breaking our entire integration and blocking our users right now, so any prompt assistance would be greatly appreciated thanks!
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console, and then update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: SSO session expired messages after the v4.2 update
body: Ever since the new update, which I assume is the v4.2 one, our team has been complaining that they are getting kicked out of the system constantly. They keep seeing the SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 error message. Its really annoying because everyone is constantly logging back in all day long. Hope you can look at this soon.
resolution: This issue relates to the new session management in v4.2. Please check your IdP configuration and ensure that the 'Refresh Token' policy is enabled and set for a duration between 8 and 24 hours to prevent the SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 error.

subject: Need to downgrade our plan immediately
body: Our team size has shrunk and we need to downgrade our subscription ASAP! I am seeing BILL-PLAN-011 when I try to change our tier. Why is this so difficult? I want this handled right now.
resolution: You can process your plan change by navigating to the Subscription Details page within the Billing section of your Admin Console. Please note that the change will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to ensure no disruption to your services. Unfortunately, we do not issue prorated refunds for the remaining time on the higher tier.

subject: need offline mobile editing support
body: It is completely unacceptable that our mobile workforce cannot edit documents without an active internet connection. This is blocking our productivity and causing significant frustration for our team. Why is this not a standard feature yet?
resolution: Currently, the mobile app only supports offline viewing for starred files. We understand how critical offline editing is for your workflow, and I encourage you to submit your request at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile so our product team can prioritize it.

subject: Azure AD SSO login redirect issue
body: Hello team, I hope you are having a good day. We are setting up SSO and users are hitting an Azure AD error page with a reply URL mismatch after attempting to log in. We have a major audit on Friday and would appreciate your guidance on this soon.
resolution: In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs' (replacing 'yourcompany' with your actual subdomain).

subject: MOBILE APP CRASHING ON UPLOADS

resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is currently working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Files remain on device after logging out
body: The app keeps files on my phone even after I log out. This is a big privacy risk. I do not see any option to clear the cache. Please fix this.
resolution: The mobile app caches files so you can access them offline. You can manually remove these by going to Settings in the app, tapping Storage, and selecting Clear Cached Files. You should also enable the 'Clear cache on logout' setting in that same menu to ensure this happens automatically in the future.

subject: audit log export not working
body: tried to get logs for the last six months but i keep getting AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED message. is there a way to get data beyond 90 days? thanks.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: User Activity report page is completely blank

resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering, and let us know the date range you are trying to view.

subject: NEED PDF INVOICES NOW

resolution: PDF generation for certain legacy invoices is currently unavailable due to a recent migration. Please send us the specific invoice IDs you require and we will manually generate and email the PDFs to you.

subject: CRITICAL: Intermittent 500 Errors on File Content API

resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are currently investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: User login issue after role change
body: I changed a user to Guest and now they cannot log in. They report seeing a CD-AM-002 error. Please advise.
resolution: Guest users require active invitations to specific shared workspaces to gain access. Please verify their status in the 'Users' tab of the Admin Console and ensure they have been invited to the necessary workspaces. If they require broader access, you can revert their role to 'Member'.

They arrive minutes late or only when I open the app, which is causing us to miss important updates. Could you please look into this MOBILE_NOTIFICATION_DELAY issue?
resolution: Please check both the CloudDesk app settings and your phone's system settings to ensure push notifications are fully enabled. Also, check for battery optimization settings that might restrict background activity. If that does not help, I recommend performing a fresh reinstall of the mobile application.

resolution: While you can currently share links to CloudDesk files in Teams, a direct native integration is not yet available. Please vote for this feature or add your requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams. We are actively evaluating new integrations based on user demand.

subject: Cannot access shared workspace with PERM-WS-403.4 error

resolution: Please have your administrator verify the permissions for that specific workspace within the Admin Console. Navigate to the Members section to ensure the affected users have the correct access rights assigned. This should restore their ability to enter the workspace.

Investigate if the key was initially generated with broader permissions or if there is a process misconfiguration. To proceed, please provide the exact date and time the upgrade occurred and confirm that no features from the new plan have been utilized. We will review your account status for refund eligibility once we receive that information.

resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version. Check the user's device storage and network connection. Advise clearing the mobile app's cache (via device settings). For very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

resolution: This error usually indicates that your API key lacks the necessary scopes for the specific endpoints you are calling. An administrator will need to log into the Admin Console, navigate to API Keys, and ensure the correct permissions are assigned to your key.

resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved. Advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs/applications. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document. Clear browser cache for all users.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade refund request urgently needed

resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account for eligibility.

Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

resolution: Hello. The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Delayed mobile push notifications
body: Push notifications on the mobile app are arriving very late or only when the app is opened. Please investigate when convenient.
resolution: Verify that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and the device's operating system settings. Check for any battery optimization settings on the device that might be restricting background app activity. Advise reinstalling the mobile app.

subject: Workspace invitation emails not sending

resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Login problem after update with SSO token
body: Hello support team, I hope you are doing well today. Since yesterday we have big trouble because all our people cannot login via Okta SSO and getting timeout errors after authentication. Please help us to fix this critical problem immediately as many users are blocked from working.
resolution: This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Advise the admin to re-save their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the 'Application Sign On URL' format. Clear browser cache and cookies for affected users.

subject: Invalid SSO Token error after v4.2 update blocking team logins

resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Admins must re-configure their SSO integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Refer to the v4.2 release notes for detailed steps.

subject: Lag during collaborative document editing

resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure they have a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and verifying if the issue persists with fewer concurrent users. Finally, having users clear their browser cache can often resolve these synchronization delays.

subject: jira sync failing

resolution: Please ensure that the Jira API token or the specific user configured for the CloudDesk integration has 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions enabled for the relevant projects within your Jira instance. This permission level is required for the sync to function correctly.

subject: Missing files in web app search results

resolution: This can sometimes be due to an outdated search index. Please try performing a more specific search using exact phrases in quotes. If the issue persists, log out and log back in, which can trigger a re-indexing for your account. If still unresolved, provide specific search terms and expected results for investigation.

subject: Inconsistent usage reports from billing API
body: Since we upgraded to v4.2, we are seeing discrepancies when fetching usage reports via the billing API. Our developers are seeing error code API-BILL-401 during these calls. The data returned by the API does not match what we see in our Admin Console report. Could you please investigate why this is occurring?
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Please ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as per the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for review.

subject: Request for new file upload webhook event
body: Dear CloudDesk support team, I hope this message finds you well. Our development team is currently working on internal system integrations using your REST API on our pro plan. We are in urgent need of a webhook event that triggers immediately upon a new file upload to a specified workspace or folder to keep our databases synchronized. This is currently blocking our core development milestone, so prompt help would be greatly appreciated. Thank you so much for your time and dedication.
resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including desired payload, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements. This helps us assess demand and design.

subject: Request for longer public link expiration

resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we do not plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration if you provide your specific use cases at our roadmap portal. For permanent sharing needs, we recommend inviting users directly to your workspace.

subject: File previews are broken right now

We are getting error code PREVIEW-006 on multiple machines. Please help us get this sorted out soon.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Question regarding an unrecognized charge on our statement

resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Search feature is completely broken

resolution: This may be caused by an outdated search index for your workspace. Please try using exact phrases in quotes first, or log out and back in to trigger a re-index. If you still cannot find your documents, please send us the specific search terms you used.

subject: Account Locked error blocking login
body: One of our finance users is seeing an Account Locked message after multiple login failures and cannot log in even with correct credentials. The error code is AUTH-LOCK-429.1. We need prompt help to resolve this as it is currently blocking their work.
resolution: You can wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: API requests failing with 403 error
body: Our new integration is failing to connect to the API. We keep getting 403 Forbidden errors even though our key is valid. We have a live demo at 5pm today and need this fixed now. API-AUTH-403.5 is the error code.
resolution: Please confirm that your API key has the correct scopes assigned for the specific endpoints you are calling. You can review and adjust these permissions in the Admin Console under the API Keys section. Let me know if you are still unable to connect after verifying those settings.

subject: Google SSO login issues
body: I had a busy morning today with several client meetings, and after grabbing a quick cup of coffee, I sat down to get back to work on our projects. However, when I try to log into CloudDesk using our Google SSO credentials, I find myself stuck in a never-ending redirect loop. I never actually reach the dashboard, and I am seeing an AUTH-SSO-302.1 error code. I have plenty of other things to do, but I wanted to report this whenever your team has a spare minute to look into it.
resolution: It sounds like there may be a cache conflict causing the redirect loop. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, or test the login in an incognito window. If the AUTH-SSO-302.1 error continues, please verify that your Google SSO configuration is still correctly set up within the Admin Console.

subject: SSO login issues after recent update
body: Hello support team, thank you for all your hard work. After the recent v4.2 update, our users logging in via Okta are unable to access CloudDesk and are receiving an Invalid SSO Token Format message. This is important and blocking our team's daily work, so we would appreciate your prompt assistance.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Please instruct the customer to update their SSO application configuration in their IdP (Okta/Azure AD) to use the new token schema. Refer to the 'CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide' for specific instructions.

subject: webhook signature errors
body: our service is rejecting webhooks with hmac verification failed. is this due to WEBHOOK-SIGN-403? we need this for our integration to work properly.
resolution: Please confirm that the secret token used on your receiving end is an exact match for the Webhook Secret listed in your Admin Console. Also, ensure your verification logic is set to use the HMAC-SHA256 algorithm. Let me know if the verification continues to fail after verifying those settings.

subject: Audit log export range limit error
body: Hello, I am trying to export our audit logs for a six-month period from the Admin Console, but it fails with an export range limit error. We need these reports ready for our compliance review by Friday.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull.

subject: Payment failed for renewal
body: I received an email about a billing failure. My dashboard shows a BILL-PAY-002 status. I need this fixed today so my team's access is not interrupted.
resolution: Please log in to the Admin Console and update your credit card information under the Payment Methods tab. Once you have saved valid details, you can retry the payment via the Invoices section.

subject: Feature request for new file upload webhooks
body: Hello, our team is really loving the platform, but we are missing a specific feature for our integration. We are looking for a webhook that triggers every time a new file is uploaded to a specific folder. This would help us automate our sync process significantly. Can you let us know if this is on the roadmap?
resolution: Thank you for the suggestion! We currently support polling, but a direct webhook for file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a feature request with your desired payload details at roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so our engineering team can review it for future development.

subject: Unable to login as new user
body: I am a new contractor and I received an invitation, but I cannot log in. The system says user not found. Please assist.
resolution: Please ensure you have accepted the invitation sent to your email address and that your account is correctly provisioned in the Admin Console. Also, double-check that you are using the specific company instance URL provided in your invite email.

subject: Assigned Helpdesk Tickets Missing From Agent View
body: When a helpdesk ticket is assigned to a specific agent, that agent cannot see the ticket in their My Assigned Tickets view within the web app. The ticket remains fully visible to administrators and other agents with broader permissions. We encountered error code HELPDESK-007 while checking the routing behavior.
resolution: This is typically caused by a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser cache and cookies before logging back into CloudDesk, or alternatively, have an administrator re-assign the ticket to a different agent and then back to the original one to refresh the view.

subject: Switch to annual billing
body: I need to change our subscription from monthly to annual to get the discount. The interface is throwing error code bill-plan-004. Please advise.
resolution: You can update your billing cycle by navigating to Admin Console, then Billing, and finally Subscription Details. Select Change Plan and choose the annual option. Your new billing cycle will begin at the start of your next period with any applicable proration applied.

subject: CRITICAL: API key scope bypass vulnerability
body: I have been reviewing our internal security protocols and noticed that our read-only API keys are currently able to delete users, which is a major security flaw. I noticed the error code API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS and we need this fixed before our production deployment this afternoon. It is urgent because our automated system handles sensitive data.
resolution: Please revoke the affected API key in your Admin Console immediately. This is a priority issue, so if revoking the key and investigating the initial scope configuration does not resolve the behavior, please contact us for an emergency escalation to our engineering team.

subject: Desktop client stuck on connecting status
body: Hello, our desktop sync client icon has been showing connecting indefinitely since this morning. Files are not syncing locally and no specific error message is displayed. Please provide prompt help as our staff needs access to these shared folders.
resolution: Please instruct the user to restart the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache by going to Settings, Advanced, and selecting Clear Cache. If still unresolved, suggest a full reinstall of the client after backing up local unsynced files.

subject: API rate limit errors during peak hours
body: Hi team, we have been noticing that our API calls occasionally return 429 Too Many Requests errors when our usage spikes during the day. We love the platform and just wanted to check what we should do to smooth this out, thanks so much!
resolution: Hello! We recommend implementing exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client to gracefully handle traffic spikes. You should also review your application's API usage patterns to consider optimizing calls or requesting a rate limit increase via support if justified by legitimate use cases.

subject: GOOGLE SSO REDIRECT LOOP IS HAPPENING AGAIN
body: Hi team, we are encountering the AUTH-SSO-302.1 error on our enterprise account where users trying to log in with Google SSO are completely trapped in a redirect loop after authentication. They never make it to the dashboard! We would appreciate it if you could investigate this soon so our staff can log in properly.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: API tokens failing with legacy_token_format error
body: Ever since the v4.2 update, all our existing API tokens are completely broken and returning 401 Unauthorized with legacy_token_format. This is causing critical failures across our main production systems right now! We are encountering error API-AUTH-401-V42 and need this resolved immediately.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console and update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: App crashes uploading large files before 5pm demo
body: Whenever we attempt to upload files larger than 1GB from the mobile app, the application crashes completely without generating an error message. This happens consistently across all devices and is currently blocking our preparation for a critical executive demo scheduled for 5pm today. Please escalate this immediately.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Desktop sync client not updating files
body: My desktop sync client is completely broken since the 4.2 update! Files are showing in the web app, but they refuse to sync to my computer. There is no error message, just total failure. This is sabotaging our work and I need a fix right now.
resolution: Please uninstall your current v4.2 desktop sync client and clear the local cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk on Windows or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk on macOS. After clearing these folders, download and install the latest version of the client from the Settings, Desktop Sync section of the web app.

subject: Audit log export failing for long date ranges
body: I am trying to pull audit logs for the last six months but the system keeps throwing an error about the range limit. This is preventing me from finishing my quarterly reports on time. It is annoying that I cannot get this data in one go! I hope you can fix this soon.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use our API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with a pagination script to pull the data. Alternatively, I can request a manual data pull for you if your team cannot access the API.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error for specific company domain
body: This is ridiculous. Users from our newly acquired subsidiary domain cant log into CloudDesk using Google SSO anymore. They keep getting a domain not allowed error code sso-google-403 even though our main domain works fine. Fix this whenever you can.
resolution: Hello. In the CloudDesk Admin Console's SSO & Identity settings for Google SSO, check the Allowed Domains list and add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: Mobile app network error preventing our audit prep
body: Greetings support team, I hope this message finds you well. I am trying to access our files through the mobile application to prep for our financial audit on Friday, but I keep running into a generic connection failure despite having full bars. It seems like a bunch of users are running into this exact obstacle right now across various devices. We really need this functional as soon as possible so we can verify the compliance documents before our deadline tomorrow morning. Thank you in advance for your help.
resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache/data (Android) or reinstalling the app (iOS/Android). Verify server status on our status page.

subject: INCONSISTENT BILLING DATA IN API
body: SINCE THE V4.2 UPGRADE THE BILLING API DATA IS COMPLETELY WRONG! THE API-BILL-401 ERROR KEEPS POPPING UP AND THE USAGE REPORTS DONT MATCH MY CONSOLE. THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how certain metrics are aggregated for legacy storage types. Please confirm you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as specified in the updated documentation. If the numbers still do not align, please send us the exact query and a screenshot of your Admin Console report.

subject: Desktop Sync is stuck on connecting
body: The desktop sync client icon on my computer shows connecting or indexing indefinitely without displaying any error message. Files are simply not syncing to or from the local folder at all. I would appreciate it if this could be looked into soon.
resolution: Please instruct the user to restart the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache by going to Settings > Advanced > Clear Cache. If it remains unresolved, a full reinstall of the client after backing up local unsynced files is recommended.

subject: Slow performance in Users & Groups tab
body: The Users & Groups page in the admin console is taking several minutes to load because we have thousands of users. We are seeing an ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT error quite frequently today. Is there a way to speed up this loading time?
resolution: Please try using the search bar or applying specific filters like Status: Active immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset. The system is optimized for filtered views when handling large datasets. If you know the specific user's email, navigating to them via search is the fastest method.

subject: CRITICAL: Okta SSO failing after v4.2 update
body: Our entire company is unable to sign in via Okta due to an invalid token format error. This is causing significant disruption to our operations and needs an immediate fix. The error code AUTH-SSO-401.1 is appearing for everyone. Thank you for your urgent assistance.
resolution: Due to the SSO token format changes in version 4.2, you must re-upload your IDP metadata in the CloudDesk Admin Console. This will update your configuration to match the new requirements. Please complete this step to restore access for your users.

subject: User Activity report page is blank
body: I am currently trying to run the User Activity report in the admin console, but the page loads and remains completely empty. I have tried this multiple times today without success. It seems like a potential bug as other reports are functioning correctly. Any advice would be appreciated.
resolution: We are aware that some users are seeing empty pages on that specific report right now due to a data retrieval error. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, or test it in a different browser window. If you still see a blank page, please let me know which date range you are trying to pull.

subject: Okta SSO integration failing after v4.2 update
body: We have been using CloudDesk for our entire enterprise infrastructure for quite a while now. I spent the morning reviewing our server logs and double-checking our network security protocols just to be sure nothing on our end was causing this unexpected outage. Unfortunately, our team is unable to log in via Okta today, and we are seeing AUTH-SSO-401.1 errors everywhere. It seems like a systemic issue affecting our entire department. Could you please look into this as soon as possible so we can get back to work?
resolution: Because of the SSO token format change in our v4.2 update, you will need to refresh your integration. Please go to the CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata to update the configuration. This should resolve the login errors immediately.

subject: more detailed reporting needed
body: hey there, we love the product but the current audit logs are a bit thin. could you add reports for file downloads and views? thanks for your help.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in getting more detailed user activity reporting. While our audit logs cover the basics, we would love to learn more about your specific needs. Please share your detailed use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting so our analytics team can look into it.

subject: Refund request for accidental plan upgrade
body: Our account was upgraded to a higher plan by accident last week. I would like to request a refund for this change as it was not intended. Could you please look into BILL-REF-005 and see if we can get our money back?
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are reviewed on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time the upgrade occurred and confirm that you have not utilized any features exclusive to the upgraded plan so we can verify your eligibility.

subject: CloudDeskSync.exe high CPU and memory usage
body: We have noticed that the CloudDesk Desktop Sync process is consistently consuming over 50 percent CPU and more than 2GB of memory on our team machines, even when completely idle. This is impacting system performance across our Enterprise deployment. Please provide a prompt resolution to this resource issue.
resolution: Check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed. Advise user to pause sync, restart their computer, then resume sync. If persistent, suggest disabling sync for non-critical folders or temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks. Check for conflicting antivirus software.

subject: SSO session expiring constantly
body: Users are being forced to re-authenticate constantly with sso-refresh-401-v42. Please advise.
resolution: v4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta or Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: Workspace search lagging indefinitely
body: Hello dear support team, thank you for always providing wonderful service. We noticed that when searching for files inside one specific workspace on our free account, the search spinner runs forever and never shows results. There is no major rush since we are not using that workspace heavily today, but we wanted to flag it for you whenever you have time. Thank you so much!
resolution: Investigate if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items (e.g., millions of files) or deeply nested folder structures. Advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches. Suggest optimizing the workspace structure if feasible. Report specific workspace ID to engineering for indexing review.

subject: Admin console slow to load users
body: The Users and Groups page is taking several minutes to load because we have thousands of users. We are seeing error code ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT. Is there a way to make this run faster?
resolution: The interface is optimized for filtered views, so we suggest applying a specific filter or using the search bar as soon as you open the page. This prevents the system from attempting to load the entire dataset at once. You can also search directly for a user by email to skip the long list view.

subject: Audit logs slow loading
body: Hi there, I am having trouble pulling logs. When I try to run a filter for dates, the screen just hangs and eventually says AUDIT_LOG_FILTER_TIMEOUT. It seems like the system is struggling today with these queries. Is there a better way to do this? Thanks for the help.
resolution: We understand this is frustrating. To improve performance, please try narrowing your date ranges or using the 'User Activity' report for single-user queries instead of the global log. If you need extensive historical data, it is best to export the full log and filter the file locally on your machine.

subject: Wrong user attribution in activity logs
body: I noticed that file actions in our workspace are being attributed to an admin instead of the actual user who performed them. It seems to happen consistently across our team. Should I be concerned about the audit accuracy? Thanks.
resolution: This display glitch occurs when a contributor and an administrator are active in the same workspace simultaneously. Rest assured, the underlying audit trail remains accurate. For precise verification, please cross-reference these actions against the global audit log found in your Admin Console.

subject: API calls returning 401 unauthorized errors unexpectedly
body: Hello, our automated scripts are suddenly failing today with API-AUTH-401.4 errors even though the API key worked fine yesterday. This is blocking our core data sync process, so we would appreciate your prompt assistance in resolving this authorization failure.
resolution: Verify the API key's status in the Admin Console ('API Keys' section). Check if it has expired or been revoked. Advise the user to regenerate a new API key if necessary and update their application.

subject: Desktop client creating unnecessary file conflicts
body: We are experiencing an issue where files are repeatedly flagged as conflicts despite no active concurrent edits occurring. The application is generating numerous duplicate files with the SYNC-003 error code attached. Please advise on how to resolve this as it is impacting our workspace organization.
resolution: This behavior usually stems from network instability or security software interfering with our sync process. Please try temporarily disabling your firewall or antivirus to see if that resolves the issue. If the files sync correctly, you should add CloudDesk to your security software's whitelist.

subject: Bad lag when typing in documents
body: hey cloud desk support, why is the document editing so slow right now. when my team types something it takes ages to show up for others and cursors are freezing up everywhere. we are just on the free plan but this is driving us crazy. please fix this soon.
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure all users have a stable internet connection. We recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and applications to free up resources. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document simultaneously, and try clearing your browser cache.

subject: Mobile app keeps logging users out
body: I am very frustrated because our team is being logged out of the mobile app constantly after the v4.2 update. We keep seeing CD-AM-011 errors every time we try to access our files. It is making it very difficult to stay updated while traveling. Can you look into why the session management seems broken?
resolution: The v4.2 update included important security changes for session management. Please have your users fully log out of the mobile app, clear their cache or reinstall the application entirely, and log back in. This process forces the creation of a new, compatible session token.

subject: Webhooks failing with connection errors
body: We are experiencing a sudden spike in errors when our external service attempts to receive webhooks from CloudDesk. The logs are showing WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500, indicating the connection is being refused or the URL is invalid. Our infrastructure team has checked our side, and it appears the traffic is not reaching our endpoint. Could you look into this?
resolution: Please verify your webhook endpoint URL within the Admin Console settings. Ensure your service is reachable from the public internet and that your firewall is configured to allow incoming requests from the CloudDesk IP range listed in our documentation.

subject: Audit log export failing for 90 days
body: Hi team, im trying to export our audit logs through the admin console for the past six months and it keeps throwing AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED error. we have a compliance audit on friday morning and i need these records pulled immediately. please fix this right away so we can finish our prep.
resolution: Hello. The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Cannot log in with Okta after update
body: My team is completely locked out of their accounts because the Okta login keeps throwing an Invalid Token Format error. We have a board meeting in two hours and this is causing a massive disruption. We keep seeing AUTH-402 on every attempt. Why would an update break our existing SSO integration?
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console to ensure the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values found in our configuration guide.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: The User Activity report in the admin console is failing to load any data. I am seeing error code REPORT-001. I need to pull these logs for our internal security check.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Accidental Plan Upgrade Refund Request
body: Hello, our account was recently upgraded to a paid tier unintentionally and we are requesting a refund for the prorated difference. Please review this transaction so we can revert back to our previous status.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account for eligibility.

subject: Unable to generate API key for upcoming audit
body: Hi team, I am trying to set up our integration before our compliance audit on Friday, but I am completely blocked. The option to generate an API key under Admin Console > Security > API Access is totally greyed out and gives me an insufficient permissions error. I need this resolved immediately to get our systems connected on time.
resolution: API Key generation requires the 'Super Admin' role. While the user may be an 'Admin', they might not have 'Super Admin' privileges. Confirm their role in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. If not 'Super Admin', the current Super Admin must generate the key for them or elevate their role.

subject: Need offline editing feature on mobile app
body: Hello there! Our team relies heavily on the mobile app while traveling, but we keep running into trouble because we cannot edit documents offline and sync them later. This is heavily blocking our fieldwork today and we would deeply appreciate a prompt response to help us get around this hurdle.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: api key unauthorized error
body: our api keys are returning 401 errors suddenly. we have a demo at 5pm today and this is breaking everything. please help us fix this api-auth-401.4 error right now.
resolution: Please check your API key status in the Admin Console under the 'API Keys' section to ensure it has not expired or been revoked. If the key is showing as invalid, you will need to regenerate a new key and update your application settings to restore access before your deadline.

subject: Jira integration sync issues
body: Hello CloudDesk Support, our Jira integration setup is failing to sync projects and create issues. The integration logs show a JIRA-SYNC-403 error. Could you please help us figure out what permissions are missing so we can get this running?
resolution: Ensure the Jira API token or user configured for the CloudDesk integration has 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance.

subject: Intermittent 429 errors
body: Our systems are getting API-RATE-429 errors all the time now. Its really annoying during peak hours. Fix this pls.
resolution: To resolve this, please implement exponential backoff and retry logic within your API client. You should also review your current usage patterns to see if you can optimize those calls, or let us know if you need to request a formal rate limit increase.

subject: Workspace loading timeout on large folders
body: when navigating to a workspace with more than 10000 items the page takes forever to load and often shows a blank screen or spinner for over 30 seconds. we have a major audit on Friday so we need this resolved quickly. error code WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT appears in the console.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: New user invitation status stuck at pending
body: A colleague of mine was invited to our workspace, but their status is stuck as Pending Invitation in the console. They cannot get in, and we are seeing code CD-AM-005. No rush on this, but could you advise on what to do when you have a moment?
resolution: This can sometimes occur if there is a delay in the invite process or a domain configuration issue. Please have the user try logging in directly with their email and password, and if that fails, simply revoke the current invite and send a new one from the Team Management page.

subject: Webhooks not delivering to our server
body: Our webhooks aint working. Logs show WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 connection refused. We checked our server and it seems fine, but CloudDesk cant reach it. Can you check why this is happening?
resolution: Please double-check the endpoint URL provided in your 'Webhooks' settings. Ensure your external server is accessible from the internet and that your firewall is configured to allow incoming traffic from CloudDesk's IP range.

subject: Inquiry regarding custom enterprise billing options
body: We are currently on the Enterprise plan but need to discuss different billing arrangements like annual invoicing and volume discounts. Our finance team mentioned a BILL-FEAT-013 code, but I am not sure what that means for us. We would like to look into a custom proposal when you have a moment.
resolution: For custom billing arrangements and enterprise-level pricing, please reach out to our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com. You may also use the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website to share your specific requirements. They will be happy to prepare a tailored proposal for your company.

subject: API endpoints are responding very slowly

We are seeing the error code API_RESPONSE_SLOW popping up constantly alongside these delays. This is completely blocking our daily office operations and causing major downstream application issues. Could you please look into this promptly and help us get our workflows back on track?
resolution: Thank you for reaching out and sharing the details regarding the API_RESPONSE_SLOW error. To help us investigate, please provide specific API call examples including the endpoint, request body, and timestamps. We also advise optimizing your API calls by using pagination and filtering parameters to reduce the dataset returned, and suggesting caching frequently accessed data on your end. I have gone ahead and escalated this to our engineering team with your logs for a thorough performance analysis.

subject: Add a Dark Mode option please
body: I have been working on our API integration for several hours today. The bright white screen is causing significant eye strain in my office. I really need a dark mode option to make this tolerable. Do you have any plans to add this in the near future?
resolution: Thank you for your feature request! Dark Mode for the CloudDesk web app is a popular suggestion. We currently do not have a dark mode available, but please vote for this feature on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/dark-mode to help us prioritize it.

subject: API access failure
body: Our new integration stopped working. We get 403 Forbidden errors with code API-AUTH-403.5. We have an important audit on Friday, so this needs to be fixed immediately.
resolution: Please confirm that your API key is configured with the necessary scopes to access these specific endpoints. You can review and adjust these permissions directly in the Admin Console under the API Keys section.

subject: Okta SSO user attribute mismatch
body: Hi there. Users can't log in via Okta SSO. They are getting 'User attribute mismatch' after Okta redirection. This is a critical issue for us, we have a major client demo tomorrow morning and everyone needs access. SSO-OKTA-403.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, please verify that the 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to their corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. It is essential to ensure that the 'email' attribute is set as the unique identifier.

subject: Mobile app network error
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful day. Recently I have been unable to access the mobile app because it keeps showing a generic network error even though my connection is completely fine. There is no major rush on this since I mostly use desktop, but I would appreciate your help whenever you have a chance.
resolution: Please force close the app, check for app updates in your respective app store, and try again. If it persists, try clearing the app's cache and data on Android or reinstalling the app on iOS or Android. You can also verify our current server status on our status page.

subject: User Activity report page is blank

resolution: This indicates a temporary retrieval conflict that many users are seeing today. Please clear your browser's cache and cookies before reloading the page. If the issue persists, try accessing it via a different browser or confirm no extensions are blocking the data load; if you still see a blank screen, please send over the specific date range you require.

subject: User Activity report page is blank
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report, but the page is completely blank despite loading the UI. This is ridiculous as I need this data for my review. I am seeing error code REPORT-001 at the top of the screen. Fix this please.
resolution: This is likely a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before attempting to access the report again. If the issue persists, kindly try a different browser or let us know the specific date range you are attempting to view.

subject: Intermittent API 500 errors blocking file access
body: Our development team is encountering frequent API-500 errors when attempting to call GET /files/{id}/content. This is significantly impeding our workflow, particularly for assets stored in remote regions. We are on the PRO plan and expect a much higher level of reliability from your service. Please look into this promptly.
resolution: We apologize for the disruption. You can work around these 500 errors by adding a retry mechanism with exponential backoff to your API client. Our engineering team is currently investigating the root cause regarding distributed storage and will release a permanent fix soon.

subject: API 500 error critical failure
body: We are getting API-500 errors on GET /files/{id}/content requests. We have a product demo at 5pm today and this is a total blocker. Fix this immediately.
