body: The Audit Logs section keeps timing out when I try to run a filter. It is just too slow. Is there a way to make this faster? I am getting AUDIT_LOG_FILTER_TIMEOUT.
resolution: Our logs are currently seeing high volume, so please try narrowing your filter criteria, particularly by using a smaller date range. For specific user queries, the dedicated User Activity report is much more efficient. If you need historical data, I recommend exporting the full log to filter it locally.

subject: User Activity report is totally blank
body: Good day to you, I am writing because earlier this morning while trying to check some administrative details for our workspace, I attempted to open the User Activity report in the admin console. Interestingly enough, all the other analytics and logs load completely fine, but this specific report page loads up and remains completely blank without showing any data at all, displaying error REPORT-001. We would appreciate it if this could be looked into when convenient.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue on the dashboard. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering with the page scripts.

subject: Request for more detailed audit reporting
body: We are currently happy with CloudDesk, but our compliance team is asking for more granular reports on user activity. We need to see more than just basic login data, such as specific view times and detailed download history. Are there any plans to expand the reporting features soon?
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding enhanced reporting. While our current logs provide basic activity tracking, we encourage you to post your specific use cases to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com. This allows our analytics team to better understand your requirements for future development.

subject: MFA setup failure on mobile app
body: Hello support team, I am writing to you today regarding an issue our team members are facing when trying to secure their accounts on mobile devices. As part of our company's updated security compliance policies, we are requiring everyone to set up multi-factor authentication using authenticator apps like Google Authenticator. However, whenever staff attempt to scan the QR code and complete the setup directly inside the mobile application, they run into an error stating that the device registration failed. Standard email and password login still functions fine, but we really need MFA enabled for everyone. Please advise on how we can get past this hurdle.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise your users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app by navigating to 'Settings', then 'Security', and selecting 'Multi-Factor Authentication'. Once configured there, it will work seamlessly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Missing comments in GDPR data export
body: Hello, we recently performed a GDPR data export for one of our departing users. While most of their profile data and files came through correctly, we noticed that some comments they left on specific tasks were missing. Whenever your team has time, could you let us know if we missed a setting?
resolution: The GDPR data export primarily covers files, folders, and direct user profile data. Comments on files and tasks are stored as activity metadata. To export those comments, navigate to the specific file or task, open the Activity tab, and use the Export Activity Log option for that item.

subject: Cannot delete old workspace
body: I am trying to clean up our admin console by deleting an old workspace, but I keep getting an error CD-AM-007 about 'Active Integrations Detected'. The system won't let me proceed. How can I remove these integrations?
resolution: To delete a workspace, you must first disconnect any active integrations such as Slack or Jira. Please navigate to 'Workspace Settings > Integrations' for that specific workspace, disable all listed integrations, and then you will be able to delete the workspace.

subject: large file upload issues
body: hey im trying to upload some big video files over 1gb and it just keeps stalling. i keep seeing the UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_504 message and the progress bar gets stuck. any advice on this?
resolution: For files larger than 500MB, we recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client instead of the web browser, as it supports resumable transfers. Please ensure you have a stable internet connection while uploading. If the issue persists, switching to a wired connection can also help avoid these timeout errors.

subject: API 404 error on folder lookup
body: We are consistently receiving API-NOTFOUND-404 when querying the /folders/{id}/files endpoint. We have double-checked the folder IDs and they are definitely correct. Please investigate why these resources are not being found.
resolution: Please verify that the resource ID and HTTP method you are using align with the latest CloudDesk API documentation. Also, ensure your API token has the necessary permissions to access that specific folder path.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Hi there my zap with the CloudDesk trigger New File Uploaded isnt firing at all today. This is error ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 and we really need it working because we have a demo at 5pm today. Can you look into this when you get a second thanks
resolution: Hello! In Zapier, please re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure that the specific CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events, and check your CloudDesk audit logs to confirm the expected events are registering.

subject: Lag in document collaboration
body: We have noticed significant lag when multiple users are editing the same CloudDesk Office document. The cursors are jumping and there is a delay of several seconds before updates appear. We are seeing COLLAB_LAG frequently. Is there anything we can do to improve the performance of these shared sessions?
resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and clearing the browser cache to improve sync speeds. Let us know if the delay persists with fewer concurrent users.

subject: Azure AD login issues for our team
body: Hello, our employees are unable to sign in via Azure AD this morning. They are reporting a User profile incomplete error, specifically code AUTH-SSO-403.2. This is blocking critical work for our department. Could you please assist us in resolving this promptly?
resolution: It appears the required attributes are not being passed from Azure AD. Please have your Azure administrator verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped within your CloudDesk enterprise application settings.

subject: API key scope bypass vulnerability
body: We discovered that an API key generated with a strict read-only files scope is currently able to execute user deletion commands and other administrative tasks. This API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS is a severe security issue for our organization. Please provide prompt guidance on how to contain this risk.
resolution: Please revoke the compromised API key immediately in Admin Console > API Management. Investigate if the key was mistakenly generated with broader permissions initially, and let us know if the scope bypass persists so we can escalate to engineering.

subject: Desktop sync client not updating files after v4.2 update
body: Hello support, since updating our desktop sync client to version 4.2 today, any files we add or modify in the web app are failing to appear or update in our desktop sync client, showing error code SYNC-001. Everything looks fine when checking through the web and mobile apps, but this desktop issue is severely blocking our team's workflow. Could you please help us resolve this promptly?
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk (Windows) or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk (macOS). Reinstall the client from the download link in your web app's 'Settings' -> 'Desktop Sync' section.

subject: API tokens failing after update
body: After the v4.2 update all our API calls are returning 401 errors. It says legacy_token_format and is breaking our automation. Need a fix now.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced a new security format for all API tokens. You will need to regenerate your tokens via the API & Integrations section of your Admin Console. Please update your local applications to utilize these new credentials to restore connectivity.

subject: MFA code not working on mobile app
body: My teams having trouble logging in on their phones. The google authenticator code is not being accepted or refreshing right. We have a big presentation demo at 5pm today and this is blocking everyone. We keep seeing AUTH-MFA-401.2 and need this fixed quick.
resolution: Please ensure your phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time, as this is the most common cause for MFA sync issues. If the problem persists, you can reset the MFA configuration for your account via the Security Settings page on our web app. This should restore your access in time for your demo.

subject: API key returning unauthorized error
body: Our integration is receiving API-AUTH-401.4 errors with our active API key. We need this fixed promptly to restore our automated workflows.
resolution: Please verify your API key's status in the Admin Console under the API Keys section to check if it has expired or been revoked. We advise generating a new API key if necessary and updating your application configuration.

subject: Desktop sync client failing to refresh SSO token
body: After updating to CloudDesk Desktop Sync client v4.2, our team members logging in via SSO are frequently prompted to re-authenticate. The client logs show the SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 error. This is blocking our daily work on our PRO plan, and we would appreciate prompt assistance.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to SSO token handling. Advise the user to perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client by uninstalling, restarting, then reinstalling. If the issue persists, your company's SSO administrator may need to review their IdP's token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret in the Admin Console.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Hello, I am noticing that our Zapier trigger for new file uploads has stopped firing recently. It seems to be hitting error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404. Could you please look into this whenever you have a chance? Thank you.
resolution: In Zapier, please re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. You may also want to check our audit logs to see if the event was captured.

subject: Users randomly logged out after v4.2 upgrade
body: Hello team. Users logged in via Okta or Azure AD SSO are intermittently logged out or forced to re-authenticate frequently after the v4.2 upgrade, receiving SSO session expired messages. We appreciate all your hard work on this platform and would love to get this sorted out when you have a moment.
resolution: v4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta/Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration (e.g., 8-24 hours) to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: User data deletion request stuck on pending status
body: We initiated a user data deletion request from the Admin Console over two days ago, but the status remains stuck as pending and no confirmation email arrived. This is blocking our internal compliance workflow, so we need prompt assistance with this matter.
resolution: Hello. Verify the user's status is 'Inactive' before requesting deletion. If the user is active, the deletion will be queued. If inactive and still pending, check System Status page for background job processing issues. If no issues, provide the user's email and deletion request ID for investigation.

subject: Google SSO login redirect loop blocking us
body: Our team cannot access the platform at all today because every time we try to log in via Google SSO, we get stuck in an endless redirect loop. We are seeing error code AUTH-SSO-302.1 on our end. This is completely blocking our work right before our major client demo scheduled for 5pm today! Please look into this immediately and provide a fix.
resolution: Please clear your browser's cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito or private browsing window, or use a different browser. Also, please verify that your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console is completely up to date.

subject: Mobile app crashing on large file uploads
body: We are trying to upload videos over 1GB via the mobile app, but it crashes every time with error CRASH-MOB-001. We have a client demo at 5pm today and we really need these files uploaded. Please let us know if there is a way to fix this quickly.
resolution: This behavior is a known memory management issue affecting large file uploads on our mobile application. As a workaround, please use the CloudDesk web app or our desktop sync client to upload these files, as they can handle larger sizes. Our team is actively working on an optimization for a future app release to resolve this.

subject: Desktop sync client SSO login failing
body: When attempting to log into the desktop sync client using SSO, the browser redirects successfully but the client remains unauthenticated with error DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. This is blocking our team members from syncing local files. Please provide a prompt resolution.
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, suggest logging in via email/password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: api 403 permission denied on export
body: hey, an api key with admin scope is used to call the data export endpoint, but it returns a 403 error. this worked prior to today. we have an audit on friday so please help us urgently. error code API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED.
resolution: Effective [Date of change], the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in Admin Console > API Management.

subject: Mobile app keeps logging me out
body: Since the last update, the mobile app keeps asking for a login every time I open it. It displays an Expired Session error and CD-AM-011. Can you help fix this?
resolution: Our v4.2 update changed how sessions are handled for better security. Please fully log out, clear your app data or reinstall the app, and log back in to establish a new, compatible session.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: One of my team members is trying to reset their password, but they are not receiving the email. We have checked all spam folders and have confirmed other CloudDesk emails arrive fine. We are seeing error code AUTH-PR-200.1. Please help as this is blocking their work.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console to ensure it is correct. You may also want to ensure that 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' is added to your organization's allowlist to prevent filtering. If the issue persists, I can manually trigger a password reset for that specific user.

subject: unable to transfer workspace ownership error cd-am-004
body: im trying to transfer workspace ownership in the admin console but the option is greyed out and i get cd-am-004. we have a payroll run tomorrow so please help when you can.
resolution: We are aware that multiple administrators are encountering this ownership transfer message today. Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace, add them first, and then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Admin console user list taking forever
body: Navigating to 'Users & Groups' in the admin console takes several minutes to load the full user list. Filters and search also respond slowly. This is quite annoying when trying to manage developer tokens.
resolution: We are receiving multiple reports about slow user list rendering. We advise using the 'Search' bar or applying specific filters like 'Status: Active' immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset. The system is optimized for filtered views on large datasets, and you can also navigate directly to a specific user via search if their email is known.

subject: Invoice user count mismatch
body: Hello, our latest enterprise invoice reflects a user count that does not match our current active users in CloudDesk, with error code BILL-INV-001. We wanted to bring this to your attention when you have a moment, as there is no major urgency.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: need annual invoicing instead of card
body: getting error BILL-FEAT-013 when trying to change payment terms. we need to switch to annual invoicing instead of monthly credit card charges because our finance team requires it. can you help us with this setup.
resolution: For custom billing arrangements like annual invoicing, please reach out to our sales team at sales@cloudesk.com. You can also submit an Enterprise Inquiry form on our website to receive a tailored proposal for your needs.

subject: data retention policy not working for deleted files
body: we set up a 30-day retention policy for our team but files are still appearing in the trash bin after 30 days. this is blocking our cleanup work and we really need a fix. getting error code RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED on our end. thanks for the prompt help.
resolution: Please verify your configuration under Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Note that standard retention policies apply to files marked as permanently deleted; files in the trash bin are subject to user-initiated recovery unless you have specifically configured the policy to purge the trash folder after a set duration.

subject: Desktop sync SSO login failed
body: Can't log into desktop sync client via SSO. Browser redirects, but client says 'Login Failed'. DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Also, check that your default web browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a temporary measure, you may be able to log in using your email and password if SSO isn't strictly enforced for your account.

subject: SSO login failing with invalid token error
body: Getting SSO_TOKEN_FORMAT_401 errors since the v4.2 update. Our team cannot log in and we have a major client presentation at 5pm today. Please help us fix this as soon as possible.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated our SSO token requirements. Your admins must re-configure the integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by either re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating your OIDC client secret.

subject: MFA setup failing on mobile app
body: Hello, we noticed an issue where users attempting to set up MFA via the mobile app encounter an error after scanning the QR code. Email and password logins are working fine, but we wanted to get this configured when you have a moment. Thank you for your continued support.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app by navigating to 'Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'. Once set up there, it will work seamlessly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Billing section access error after recent update
body: Thank you for the recent v4.2 update. Unfortunately, our admins are getting an AUTH-BILL-402 error whenever they try to view invoices or update payment info. We appreciate your hard work and look forward to your guidance.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, or try logging in directly via email and password if enabled. If the issue persists, let us know so we can further investigate your specific SSO configuration.

subject: Requesting additional storage for free tier
body: Our small team has hit the storage limit on our current plan. We would like to request an increase to our capacity without upgrading to a paid subscription. Is this possible?
resolution: Thank you for your feedback regarding our storage limits. The current thresholds are designed to provide a stable starter experience for smaller teams, and we are not planning to increase storage on the free tier. We encourage you to review our paid plans if you require expanded storage and additional collaboration features.

subject: Desktop sync client high cpu usage
body: Our team is noticing high CPU and memory usage from the sync client, even when idle. We are seeing PERF-DSK-001 in our monitoring. We would appreciate any guidance on how to optimize this.
resolution: This can occur if the client is caught in a re-indexing loop. Please pause syncing from the tray icon, navigate to Settings, Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database. Once that is complete, you can resume syncing.

subject: Security risk: API key scope bypass
body: We discovered that an API key limited to 'read-only' is currently able to delete users, which is a major security concern. This API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS vulnerability is unacceptable for our production environment. We need this fixed immediately, as it is a critical threat to our data.
resolution: Please revoke the compromised API key immediately in the Admin Console under API Management. Investigate whether the key was mistakenly generated with broader permissions initially or if there's an internal configuration issue. If the scope bypass persists after revocation, please let us know so we can escalate this to our engineering team.

subject: jira integration failing to sync projects
body: our jira integration is broken and will not sync projects or create issues. getting project not found errors and JIRA-SYNC-403 in the logs. we need prompt help with this blocking problem right now.
resolution: Please ensure the Jira API token or user configured for the CloudDesk integration has Browse Projects and Create Issues permissions for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: Our latest bill seems wrong and it is very frustrating because I have to explain this to accounting. The user count on the invoice does not match our current internal numbers. Can you please correct this BILL-INV-001 error?
resolution: Please review your invoice's billing date and proration details, as changes often apply to the next cycle. If the count still appears incorrect, kindly provide your invoice ID and current user count so we can perform a manual investigation.

subject: Cannot access Admin Console, getting 403 error
body: I am unable to access the Admin Console and am instead being redirected to the standard user dashboard. I am seeing ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. This is blocking our audit preparation for tomorrow, so could you please assist as soon as possible?
resolution: This behavior suggests a permissions mismatch within your profile. Please check the 'Users' section in the Admin Console to confirm your assigned role is set to 'Admin' or 'Super Admin'. If your role is currently set to a standard user, please have another administrator update your access level.

subject: Users locked out with invalid sso token
body: Hello team, after the recent v4.2 update, all our users trying to log in via azure ad sso are getting an invalid sso token error. direct email logins work fine though. please let us know how to fix this authentication issue when you get a chance.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Admins must re-configure their SSO integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Refer to the v4.2 release notes for detailed steps.

subject: Desktop client using way too much CPU
body: My team is reporting the CloudDesk client is hogging all our RAM and CPU, consistently over 50 percent even when idle. We keep seeing error code PERF-DSK-001 pop up and it is killing our productivity. We have a payroll run scheduled for tomorrow morning and need this fixed so we can finish our work. Please help us out right now.
resolution: This behavior often occurs if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. Please pause syncing from the tray icon, navigate to Settings, choose Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database. Once that finishes, you can resume syncing. If it continues to spike, please check for an excessive number of small files in your synced folders.

subject: desktop app running super slow
body: hello support team thank you for your hard work. my computer has been lagging a lot lately because the clouddesk sync app is using over 50 percent cpu and lots of memory even when nothing is syncing. I noticed perf-dsk-001 on my screen earlier. hope you can help me sort this out soon
resolution: Hi there! Thank you for reaching out. This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After the reset completes, resume syncing. If the issue persists, please check if there are very large numbers of small files in your synced folders.

subject: SSO login failing with invalid token format
body: Users attempting to log in via Okta SSO are redirected back to the login page with an error. This started immediately after the v4.2 platform update. Email and password login works correctly.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console, ensuring the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: Request for more detailed user reports
body: We are currently looking for more depth in our audit logs, specifically regarding file downloads and granular collaboration actions. It would be very helpful if we could pull these insights from the admin console. Thanks for your time.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced reporting. Please post your specific use cases and requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com, as this direct feedback helps our analytics team prioritize the features our customers need most.

subject: Webhooks failing with delivery errors
body: Our integration is failing to receive webhooks consistently, with logs showing connection refused errors. I have verified our endpoint is active. Are there known issues affecting webhook delivery right now?
resolution: Please confirm the webhook endpoint URL is correctly configured in your Admin Console and ensure your firewall is set to allow incoming traffic from CloudDesk’s specific IP range. You can find the list of required IPs in our official technical documentation.

subject: Okta SSO broken after update with error AUTH-402
body: Hi there, users trying to log in via Okta SSO are getting redirected right back to the login page with an Invalid Token Format error code AUTH-402. This started happening immediately after the v4.2 platform update rolled out. Password logins work fine, but our staff needs SSO restored immediately to access their files.
resolution: Hello. This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console by ensuring the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide found under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration'.

subject: Lag during simultaneous document editing
body: When several of us work together on a CloudDesk Office document at the same time, we notice a bit of lag between typing and seeing the changes. It is not causing any major disruption for us right now, but we wanted to mention it. Thank you for providing such a wonderful collaboration platform!
resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and clearing your browser cache if the issue persists.

subject: Unintentional upgrade charge
body: I am extremely angry that our account was upgraded without my authorization. I am requesting a full refund for this error. We saw BILL-REF-005. Please handle this.
resolution: We review refund requests for accidental upgrades on a case-by-case basis. To assist you further, please provide the exact date of the upgrade and verify that none of the features associated with the higher tier have been used.

subject: New user login issue
body: Hello support team, a newly invited colleague is attempting to log in with their credentials but keeps hitting an error. Thank you so much for your assistance with this matter.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with invalid token format
body: Hello, since the recent v4.2 update, our entire staff using Okta SSO is completely locked out of the web app. Users are seeing the error AUTH-SSO-401.1 when attempting to sign in. This is heavily impacting our daily operations right now as dozens of employees cannot access their workspaces. We need a solution immediately to restore access for everyone.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Request for branded SSO login page
body: Our company would love the ability to add our logo and corporate colors to the SSO login screen. It would provide a much better experience for our employees when they sign in. Do you have any plans to support this customization? Thank you for your time.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available, but we understand this is a valuable feature for many enterprises. Please add your specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding so our team can track interest.

subject: Need PDF invoice, only CSV available
body: I am trying to download an invoice from the Admin Console. The only format available is CSV, but I need a PDF for our accounting records. Could you please help me get this invoice in PDF format?
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a system migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s). We will then manually generate and email the PDF invoices to you as quickly as possible.

subject: Intermittent 429 errors during API usage
body: We are seeing intermittent 429 errors when our service communicates with CloudDesk. It seems to happen during our peak hours and we keep seeing API-RATE-429 in our logs. We can wait for a solution but would appreciate some guidance on how to handle this better on our side.
resolution: To resolve the API-RATE-429 errors, please implement exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client. Additionally, review your application's usage patterns to optimize unnecessary calls. If your legitimate business needs require a higher threshold, we can discuss a rate limit increase.

subject: cannot add new team members
body: trying to add some new folks but it says seat limit reached even though we have space left. seeing cd-am-001 error. any ideas?
resolution: Please check your pending invitations count under Admin Console, Team Management, and then Invitations. Note that pending invitations do count toward your total seat limit. You can either revoke any old, unused invitations or upgrade your plan to increase your capacity.

subject: Invitations not reaching new users
body: I have been trying to invite new members to our workspace, but they are not receiving the emails. The status remains pending. Is there a known issue with email delivery right now?
resolution: Please check your company's email spam or junk folders first. You should also ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured to allow emails from our sending domains. If the problem persists, please send us the specific email addresses of the affected users for a manual investigation.

subject: User login issue after role change
body: A staff member recently had their role updated to Guest and is now unable to access their account, receiving an 'Account Suspended' error. They keep seeing the error code CD-AM-002. This is currently blocking them from accessing their files. Please advise on how we can restore their access.
resolution: Guest users are restricted to accessing only the specific workspaces they have been invited to. Please check the Admin Console under Team Management to confirm their role. If they require broader access, you will need to update their role back to Member or Admin.

subject: Need api endpoint for workspace creation
body: with the v4.2 release changes, we are wondering if there is a new api endpoint to create workspaces automatically. no rush on this at all, just planning ahead for onboarding.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to our SSO token handling, but an API endpoint for programmatic workspace creation is not yet available. You can currently manage workspaces via the Admin Console. Please submit your detailed requirements for this API endpoint to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements/workspace-creation-api. This helps us understand the demand for automation.

subject: Google SSO domain access issues
body: We are getting an SSO-GOOGLE-403 error for specific email domains when trying to authenticate via Google. It seems like the system is rejecting valid domains that were previously allowed. Could you please investigate why these specific domains are suddenly blocked?
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console under SSO and Identity settings, please check your Allowed Domains list. It appears some domains may have been removed or not correctly saved, so please add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in admin console
body: Good morning, we noticed that some of our user roles are displaying incorrectly as Contributor instead of Manager within the Users and Permissions section. While their actual workspace permissions are completely fine, we have a major client audit on Friday and need the interface to reflect the correct titles. Thank you so much for your help.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and the actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: Google SSO login failing for specific company domains
body: Hello, I hope you are having a productive week. We have noticed that our users from several sub-domains are getting a 'Domain not allowed' error when trying to use Google SSO. It seems like the system is rejecting them despite our global settings. Do you know if there is a way to adjust this on our end? Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: To resolve this, please log into your CloudDesk Admin Console and navigate to the SSO & Identity settings for Google. Ensure that all required domains are explicitly included in your 'Allowed Domains' list. This should clear the restriction for those users immediately.

subject: azure ad sso profile incomplete error blocking audit
body: users logging in via azure ad are getting user profile incomplete errors and failing to login! we have a major audit happening on friday and this is completely blocking our team. fix this immediately please
resolution: Please guide your Azure AD administrator to verify that the emailaddress and displayname claims are correctly mapped in the enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. You can find detailed instructions and steps by reviewing our official Azure AD SSO configuration guide.

subject: mobile app leaves cached files everywhere
body: hey support team files opened in the mobile app stay cached on the phone even after logging out or closing the app which is a major privacy worry if a device gets lost mobile_app_cache_persistence error is showing up and i dont see any clear cache option anywhere please fix this soon
resolution: The mobile app caches files for offline access. To manually clear the cache, go to 'Settings' within the CloudDesk mobile app, then 'Storage' and select 'Clear Cached Files'. For automatic clearing on logout, enable 'Clear cache on logout' in the same settings menu. This setting is off by default.

subject: Google SSO login failing for specific domains
body: Hello, we are attempting to onboard some new contractors using Google SSO but we are running into an issue. Users from certain domains are getting a 'Domain not allowed' error, though our primary domain works fine. We are seeing error code SSO-GOOGLE-403 in the logs. We would appreciate it if you could help us resolve this when you have a moment.
resolution: To resolve this, please log into the CloudDesk Admin Console and navigate to 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google. Ensure that all the domains you want to permit are added to the 'Allowed Domains' list. Once those are added, your users should be able to authenticate without issue.

subject: Invited user stuck in pending status
body: Hello, a user received an invitation, clicked the link, but their status in the Admin Console remains Pending Invitation and they cannot log in. There is no major urgency for this matter.
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set (if any). If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and send a new one.

subject: Mobile app network error
body: Getting generic network error on mobile app. Internet is stable. Error code is MOBILE-NET-500.1.
resolution: Hello! Please advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache or data on Android, or reinstalling the app on iOS or Android. You can also verify server status on our official status page.

subject: api token not working after update
body: all our api calls are returning 401 unauthorized errors with a legacy_token_format message after the v4.2 update. this is critical as our entire revenue pipeline is halted right now. we saw the API-AUTH-401-V42 error and need to know how to fix this fast.
resolution: With the v4.2 release, the underlying format for our API tokens has changed for security reasons. You will need to generate new tokens via the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Please update your production environment to use these new tokens immediately to restore service.

subject: Data retention policy is not working
body: Hello, my name is Alex, I am from the finance department. We have configured a data retention policy for 30 days for deleted files. But when I check the Trash Bin, the files are still there and can be recovered even after 30 days. This is important for our compliance. Can you please check why the policy is not enforced? The error code I am seeing is RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED. We need this fixed soon.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out, Alex. We understand your concern regarding the data retention policy. The retention policies for deleted files apply to items in a 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files still visible in the 'Trash Bin' are recoverable by users and are not automatically purged by the general retention policy unless a specific policy is set to purge the Trash Bin after a certain number of days. Please review your settings under Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention to ensure the policy for the Trash Bin is configured as intended. If you need further assistance, please let us know.

subject: User invitation stuck in pending status
body: We sent an invite to a new hire but they are still showing as 'Pending Invitation' in the admin console. I am worried they might have missed the email or encountered a bug. Thank you for your assistance with this.
resolution: This can sometimes occur due to a sync delay or configuration settings. Please ask the user to attempt a direct login, or revoke the existing invite and send a fresh one from the team management portal.

subject: FILES STAY CACHED ON MOBILE APP AFTER LOGOUT
body: files opened in the mobile app remain cached on the device even after logging out or closing the app! this causes serious privacy concerns if a phone gets lost and there is no clear cache option visible anywhere. error code MOBILE_APP_CACHE_PERSISTENCE is showing up. take your time looking into this.
resolution: The mobile app caches files for offline access by design. To manually clear the cache, go to 'Settings' within the CloudDesk mobile app, then 'Storage' and select 'Clear Cached Files'. For automatic clearing on logout, enable 'Clear cache on logout' in that same settings menu.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Our Zap configured to monitor new file uploads has stopped firing. I suspect an issue with the CloudDesk API as I am seeing ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 in the Zapier history. This is currently blocking our automated workflow. Please assist.
resolution: Please go into Zapier and re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh the connection. Ensure that the account linked in Zapier has the correct permissions to see these events. You may also want to check our audit logs to confirm that the trigger event was recorded.

subject: Critical Okta SSO Error blocking board audit
body: Hi team, all Okta users are locked out with invalid sso token format and error code AUTH-SSO-401.1 following the v4.2 update. This is a massive issue because our external financial audit starts at 9am tomorrow morning and our executives cannot access any documents.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration immediately in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to the change in the SSO token format implemented in v4.2, which should instantly restore access for your Okta users.

subject: User accounts locked unexpectedly
body: Several of my users are reporting that their accounts are locked. Even with the correct password, they get the AUTH-LOCK-429.1 error. Could you please let me know the best way to handle this so my team can get back to work?
resolution: Users are typically locked for 15 minutes following multiple failed login attempts. As an administrator, you can manually unlock any account immediately by going to the Users section in the Admin Console and selecting Unlock Account for the affected user.

subject: Offline document editing in mobile app
body: Our field team frequently requests the ability to edit documents offline within the mobile app and have changes sync once internet connectivity returns. Right now they cannot make any edits without an active connection. Please let us know if this functionality is on the roadmap and when we might expect it.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: Requesting advanced user activity reports
body: Hello team, I am writing to inquire about more detailed reports on user activity beyond what our current audit logs show. We would like to track specific file downloads views and collaboration actions for our pro plan. We are in no particular rush and this can wait for a future update.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: mobile app preview is not working
body: the preview for files in the mobile app is not loading and showing MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL. i need this working before our demo at 5pm today. thanks for the help.
resolution: Please ensure your mobile app is updated to the latest version and check your network connection. You may also want to clear the app's cache through your device settings. If you are dealing with very large files, I suggest downloading them to your device first.

subject: Request for new file upload webhook in API
body: Hello finance team here. We are currently building out integrations with our internal systems using your API on our PRO plan. We would like to request a new webhook event that triggers whenever a file is uploaded to a specified workspace or folder. Many developers are hitting this exact requirement right now as we expand automation. Please let us know if this can be added soon.
resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including desired payload, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements. This helps us assess demand and design.

subject: Storage limit is too low for my team
body: I am managing a PRO team on CloudDesk and we are hitting the storage ceiling constantly. It is very frustrating to constantly have to delete files just to keep working. Can you please increase our allocation without forcing us to upgrade our subscription tier immediately? I have time to wait for a response, but this really hinders our productivity.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out regarding your storage usage. Our current PRO limits are structured to balance performance across our infrastructure. We are unable to provide manual storage increases at this time, but I recommend reviewing our plans to see which tier better fits your current data volume.

subject: Constant SSO re-authentication prompts in Desktop Sync client
body: Good afternoon. I am writing to report a recurring inconvenience we have been experiencing ever since our organization updated to the v4.2 Desktop Sync client. Users who log in via SSO are being repeatedly asked to re-authenticate multiple times a day, which is disrupting our workflow. The desktop client log files keep showing 'Failed to refresh SSO token' and error SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2. We would appreciate it if your engineering team could investigate this behavior and provide a stable fix soon.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to SSO token handling. Advise the user to perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client (uninstall, restart, then install). If the issue persists, the company's SSO administrator may need to review their IdP's token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret in CloudDesk Admin Console.

subject: Export audit logs failing for date range
body: I am trying to export audit logs but it keeps failing because of the 90-day limit. The error says AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. Is there a way to pull more than 90 days of logs at once?
resolution: The Admin Console interface is strictly limited to 90-day exports. For larger data sets, you should use our API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with a pagination script to pull the records. If you do not have developer resources for this, let us know and we can provide a manual export.

subject: Adding team members failing with CD-AM-001 error
body: I am trying to onboard new developers via the API, but I keep getting the CD-AM-001 error. My dashboard says I have plenty of seats left, so this makes no sense! Please fix this because it is holding up our deployment.
resolution: It appears your seat count is being impacted by outstanding invitations. Please check the 'Team Management > Invitations' section in your Admin Console and revoke any pending invites that are no longer needed, which will free up your seat allocation.

subject: Request for Enhanced User Activity Reports
body: Hi there! I hope you are having a wonderful day. Our development team is currently integrating more deeply with CloudDesk, and we were wondering if there are any plans to expand the admin audit logs. We would love to see more granular reporting on file downloads, specific views, and collaboration actions. Thank you so much for your time and help!
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Frequent sync conflicts appearing in desktop client
body: Our team is seeing a lot of duplicate files created by the desktop sync client. It happens even when no one else is editing the files. I suspect it might be a SYNC-003 issue, as others have mentioned it. Please let me know how we can stop these unnecessary conflicts.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: Google SSO login failing with redirect loop
body: Hello, our team is currently stuck in a login redirect loop when attempting to use Google SSO. We are seeing error AUTH-SSO-302.1 consistently. We have a major demo at 5pm today, so we would appreciate any help you can provide to resolve this. Thank you for your time.
resolution: It appears your browser cache is conflicting with our authentication service. Please clear your cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, or try accessing the dashboard via an incognito window. If the issue persists, we recommend re-verifying your Google SSO configuration within the Admin Console.

subject: file previews loading infinitely or blank
body: hey team PDFs and PPTX files are showing blank pages or infinite spinners when previewed in the web app PREVIEW-006 error downloading them works fine though take your time getting back to me no big hurry
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito or private browser window to rule out conflicting extensions.

subject: Slow workspace loading times
body: Good morning. When opening large workspaces with more than ten thousand items in the admin console, the page takes a very long time to load. There is no immediate rush for a fix.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: Hardware MFA support request
body: Hi team, we were wondering if you plan to support hardware-based mfa tokens like yubikey for enterprise security compliance. no real rush on this feature request.
resolution: Hello. CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa, as we prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Desktop sync client automatically uploaded local documents
body: Hello support team, we noticed that the desktop sync client unexpectedly uploaded files from local user directories without explicit authorization. We want to ensure compliance and are referencing error code sync_client_unauthorized_upload. Thank you for your prompt assistance with this matter.
resolution: The desktop sync client only syncs folders explicitly configured by the user or pre-configured by an admin. Check the sync client settings for 'Synced Folders' and verify no unintended folders were selected. Ensure 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is disabled if not desired. If an admin-mandated sync, contact your internal IT.

subject: document collaboration lag
body: Hi there! We have noticed some noticeable lag when editing documents together. It is not urgent at all, just wanted to report it as things take a few seconds to update.
resolution: We recommend checking the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensuring everyone has a stable internet connection. Having users close unnecessary browser tabs or applications can also help reduce latency during simultaneous editing.

subject: Unable to view older invoices for audit
body: We need to access invoices older than 12 months in the Admin Console for an audit on Friday, but they are not showing up. Please assist as soon as possible so we can meet our compliance deadline.
resolution: The Admin Console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months. For older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you are looking for, and we will retrieve it for you from our archives.

subject: workspace share api returning 403 forbidden
body: Hi team, thanks for your help with this. When we call POST workspaces id share with an api key that has the Manager role, we keep getting a 403 error. Hope you can help us figure out whats wrong.
resolution: Please ensure that the API key being used has the Manage Workspaces scope enabled. Additionally, the user associated with that API key must be a direct member of the workspace being shared, rather than just belonging to a group. If the issue persists, please provide your API key ID and workspace ID for further review.

subject: incorrect user roles in admin console
body: users roles are showing up wrong in the console. some are marked as contributor when they should be manager. i keep seeing ui-admin-003 every time i try to save changes. fix this fast.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and your actual permissions remain unchanged. To refresh the view, navigate to the user profile, update the role to something else, save it, and then revert it back to the original role. We are working on a permanent fix for the next release.

subject: Requesting direct video conferencing integration
body: Our team uses CloudDesk for all our collaboration, but we are missing a direct video conferencing integration. We need this to streamline our workflows immediately. Do you have plans to add Zoom or Google Meet support?
resolution: Currently, CloudDesk focuses on file sharing and project collaboration. While we don't have built-in video conferencing, you can easily share meeting links within comments. For a direct integration with specific video conferencing platforms, please submit your request and preferred tools at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing. This helps us assess demand for future partnerships.

subject: Webhook delivery failed with connection refused error
body: Hello support team, I noticed today that our automated finance webhooks are failing with a connection refused message under code WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500. This is currently blocking our internal reporting workflows and causing quite a few issues for us. Could you please provide some prompt help on this matter? We truly appreciate your assistance.
resolution: Hello. Please verify the webhook endpoint URL in your Admin Console under the Webhooks settings. Confirm that your external service is currently running and accessible from the public internet, and ensure its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's official IP range.

subject: Mobile notifications are delayed
body: I am not getting mobile alerts for comments or file updates until I open the app. It is very frustrating to miss these updates while on the go. Is there a setting I missed?
resolution: Please check that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk app settings and your phone's system settings. You should also ensure your device's battery optimization settings are not restricting the app's background activity, or try reinstalling the app to reset the notification service.

subject: Intermittent HTTP 500 errors on GET files content endpoint
body: Hello support team, we are currently experiencing frequent API-500 errors when attempting to retrieve file contents through the API. This is heavily blocking our development workflow right now. Could you please provide some prompt help with this issue?
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: SSO session expired errors after v4.2 update
body: Ever since the v4.2 update, our team members logging in via Okta and Azure AD are constantly being kicked out with an sso session expired message. This error code SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 keeps popping up all morning. It is heavily blocking our daily operations, so we would appreciate prompt assistance.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta and Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a Refresh Token policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration, such as 8 to 24 hours, to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: Billing access failure after v4.2 update
body: I am trying to update our payment method but get an AUTH-BILL-402 error when logging in via SSO. All other admin tools are working fine, but I cannot reach the billing section. Could you help me fix this, as I need to update the card details today?
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and then logging back in using your email and password, or clearing your browser cache. If the issue persists, please use a direct login method for billing management while we investigate the SSO integration.

subject: Previewing files in web app is broken
body: Whenever I try to open a pdf or pptx file in the browser it just shows a blank screen or spins forever. Im getting the PREVIEW-006 error every time. Downloading the file works fine, but viewing them inline is not working at all today.
resolution: This is likely caused by a temporary disruption in our rendering service or a browser-specific conflict. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, or try viewing the file in an incognito window to rule out extension interference. If the issue is isolated to a single file, please ensure the document is not password-protected.

subject: API 403 Forbidden error
body: Our integration is failing with a 403 Forbidden error. We are receiving API-AUTH-403.5 and cannot make any calls. We need this working immediately. Please assist.
resolution: This error indicates that your API key may lack the required permissions for the endpoints you are calling. Please log into the Admin Console and visit the API Keys section to review and adjust the scopes assigned to your specific key. Ensure all necessary permissions are enabled for your integration.

subject: unauthorized sync of local documents folder
body: the desktop client uploaded my local documents folder without me asking. i need this stopped before my compliance review on friday. is this a known bug?
resolution: The desktop sync client only syncs folders explicitly configured by the user or pre-configured by an admin. Please check your sync client settings for Synced Folders and verify that no unintended folders were selected. You should also ensure that Auto-sync new shared folders is disabled if that is not your preference.

subject: Unrecognized credit card charge BILL-CHG-010 blocking our demo
body: We noticed an unknown charge on our statement with code BILL-CHG-010. This is blocking our financial review and we have a major demo at 5pm today, so we need a prompt reply.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Trouble logging in with Google
body: Hello, some of our staff are reporting that they cannot log in to their accounts today. They are seeing an SSO-GOOGLE-403 error message on the screen. We appreciate your help in getting this sorted out for us. Thank you for your time.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out. Please check the Allowed Domains list within your Admin Console under the SSO & Identity settings. You likely need to add the affected domains to your permitted list to allow these users to sign in again.

subject: Files not syncing to desktop after update
body: Hello, ever since I updated to v4.2, my desktop app isn't showing any new files. The files appear fine on the web, but my sync-001 error isn't appearing, it just sits there. I really need this fixed to keep up with my project. Thanks so much for your help.
resolution: To resolve this, please uninstall your current v4.2 sync client and clear the local cache folder. On Windows, you can find this in your AppData directory, or in the Library folder on macOS. Once cleared, please reinstall the client directly from your web app settings page.

subject: Constant file conflicts in desktop sync
body: The desktop sync client frequently flags files as Conflict even when no concurrent edits have occurred. This leads to duplicate files being created unnecessarily. We have a payroll run tomorrow and need this fixed.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus or firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus and firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your security software's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: Blank User Activity report page
body: When I navigate to the User Activity report in the admin console, the page loads but stays completely empty. I am getting error code REPORT-001. Other reports are loading fine, so it is just this one. Please let me know how to get the data to populate.
resolution: This behavior is often caused by a temporary data retrieval error. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, then reload the page to see if the data populates. If it remains blank, please let us know the specific date range you are attempting to view so we can investigate further.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Hi there, our automated Zaps connected to CloudDesk have completely stopped working today. The new file uploaded trigger is not firing at all and we keep encountering error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404. I would appreciate it if someone could take a look at this soon so we can resume our workflows.
resolution: In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. Check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: SSO LOGIN IS BROKEN FOR EVERYONE
body: Ever since the update to v4.2, our team cannot log in through Okta! We keep getting an 'Invalid Token Format' error when trying to access the site. This is a total nightmare and our staff cannot get any work done today. PLEASE FIX THIS IMMEDIATELY.
resolution: This is due to updated token requirements in our v4.2 release. Your IT administrator needs to update the Okta integration settings to match the new Audience URI and SAML URL provided in the Admin Console under 'SSO & Authentication'. Once those endpoints are updated in Okta, your team will be able to log in again.

subject: Azure AD SSO reply URL mismatch error
body: Users are redirected to an Azure AD error page after attempting to log in via SSO or getting the SSO-AZURE-400 error. This is completely blocking our enterprise login process today.
resolution: We are currently addressing a surge of Azure AD login configuration inquiries. In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs', making sure to replace 'yourcompany' with your actual subdomain.

subject: Critical API service unavailable errors impacting production automated scripts
body: Good day, I am writing to report an urgent platform issue where multiple API endpoints are returning HTTP 503 errors during our peak business hours while we process a very high volume of automated requests. As our team relies heavily on these scheduled data pipelines for critical daily operations and strict client-facing reporting deadlines, this sudden interruption is severely impacting our revenue and blocking our developers. We have already checked our local network configuration and confirmed that the payload structures are correct, but the API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 errors persist continuously across all test environments. We urgently require your engineering team to investigate this server-side outage immediately and provide a prompt resolution before our next batch run fails.
resolution: Please investigate your API usage patterns to identify if you are exceeding rate limits by checking the X-RateLimit-Remaining header. We advise implementing exponential backoff for your retries to handle peak load gracefully. You can also confirm if there are any ongoing platform incidents via the CloudDesk status page, and we will escalate this to engineering if rate limits are not being hit.

subject: Billing page error
body: Billing section failing with error AUTH-BILL-402. Need access now for invoices. Please fix.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format, which can cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and back in using your email/password or clearing your browser cache. If the issue persists, please use a direct email/password login for billing management until we finalize our investigation.

subject: Search results missing files
body: I am having trouble finding some of our project documents when using the search bar. Some files just don't show up in the results despite being in the folders. I keep seeing SEARCH-002 errors popping up. Is there a way to force a re-index?
resolution: This is often caused by a stale search index. Please try using quotes for an exact phrase search, or log out and back in to trigger a refresh. If you are still missing files, send us the specific search terms so we can investigate.

subject: API connection failing with authentication error
body: Our integration is suddenly failing with an API-AUTH-401.4 error, even though these keys worked fine yesterday. I am not sure why the authorization is being rejected now. Could you check if something has changed on your end?
resolution: Please check the status of your API key in the Admin Console under the 'API Keys' section to ensure it hasn't expired or been revoked. If the key looks correct but still fails, I recommend regenerating a new API key and updating your application configuration to restore service.

subject: Billing authentication error after recent update
body: Hello support team, ever since the v4.2 update, I am unable to access our billing section while logged in via SSO. It keeps throwing a Payment Processing Error with code AUTH-BILL-402 whenever I try to update our payment details. Could you please help us resolve this promptly as our renewal is coming up?
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email and password, or clear your browser cache and cookies.

subject: Switching to annual billing
body: we want to change our subscription to annual to get the discount before our budget cycle ends tomorrow. please let me know how to do this as i see a BILL-PLAN-004 error when trying.
resolution: You can change your billing cycle by navigating to the Admin Console, then Billing, and selecting Subscription Details. Click on 'Change Plan' and select the annual option for your current subscription. The changes will be applied at the start of your next billing cycle, with any remaining credit prorated accordingly.

subject: workspace invites not sending
body: invited new members to workspace on our pro plan but they are not getting the emails. invites stuck as pending. error EMAIL-005 shown. fix pls.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Updating purchase order number for future invoices
body: Hello CloudDesk team! I hope you are having a wonderful week. We would like to add a new purchase order number to our account so it appears on all of our future billing statements. Please let us know how we can accomplish this. Thank you so much for your time and assistance.
resolution: You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: Large workspace taking too long to load
body: When opening our archive workspace which contains over 10,000 files, the page hangs and displays a blank screen for more than 30 seconds. WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT is triggered frequently.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace and advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. We also suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones and verifying your browser console for network errors.

subject: Need more detailed user activity reports please
body: Our PRO plan team requires deeper audit details on file downloads and specific actions. We need this sorted out soon.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Mobile app crashes instantly when uploading large files
body: Hello, we are experiencing a critical blocker where the mobile app crashes completely without any error message whenever we try to upload files larger than 1GB. Smaller documents upload without issue, but large project archives trigger an immediate crash across multiple devices and networks. It appears that several other users are encountering this exact memory failure simultaneously right now. We urgently need a fix or a reliable workaround for this issue so our field teams can submit their deliverables.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Okta SSO broken after v4.2 update
