To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Invoices' and paying the overdue invoice. Once payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: Request for enhanced user activity reporting
body: Hello support team, we are wondering if admins can get more detailed reports on user activity like file downloads, views, and specific collaboration actions beyond the current audit logs. Thank you for your continued help with our platform.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking, but for more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting to help our analytics team.

subject: Extremely slow loading times in large workspaces
body: When navigating to a workspace that contains over ten thousand files, the interface takes a very long time to load and shows a blank screen for quite a while. There is no urgency on our side since we can still access things eventually, but a fix would be nice.
resolution: This behavior typically occurs due to large file counts in the affected workspace. We advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, or breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. We checked the console and recommend optimizing the folder layout.

subject: Okta SSO Login failing
body: SSO broken after v4.2 update. Users seeing AUTH-SSO-401.1 error. Company cant work, fix this now.
resolution: We recently updated our token format in v4.2 which requires an adjustment. Please navigate to the Admin Console and re-upload your Identity Provider metadata to resolve the authentication error.

subject: User Activity report page is blank
body: I am trying to run a user activity report but the page is just white. It is very frustrating because I cannot track our usage. I keep seeing REPORT-001 when I try to load it.
resolution: It looks like you are encountering a temporary data retrieval error. Please clear your browser's cache and cookies, then try loading the report again. If the report remains blank, please try using a different browser to see if an extension is interfering with the request.

subject: Missing suspicious login records in audit log
body: We notice unusual login patterns from foreign countries, but standard audit logs only show successful logins. We urgently need to see all attempts because of potential security breaches. Please check this critical issue immediately.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses/locations are recorded in the 'Security Events' log, not 'Login Activity'. Navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events for this information. Enable 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic alerts.

subject: Wrong roles shown in Users and Permissions
body: I am writing to report that the admin console is incorrectly displaying several users as Contributors instead of their actual Manager roles. Although their workspace permissions are functioning properly, the UI is misleading. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and your users' actual permissions remain completely unaffected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again.

subject: Okta SSO integration is broken after update
body: Since the v4.2 update, our Okta SSO integration is throwing an Invalid SSO token format error, code AUTH-SSO-401.1. This is currently blocking our internal authentication workflow. Please provide a fix as soon as possible.
resolution: Due to the update in the SSO token format in v4.2, you will need to update your SSO configuration. Please re-upload your IDP metadata within the CloudDesk Admin Console to resolve this.

subject: new people cant log in via sso
body: Hi our new employees are not getting their accounts automatically created when they try logging in via SSO. We see error CD-AM-009. Please fix this soon.
resolution: Please verify that your Identity Provider is correctly sending the required user attributes like email and name in your SAML assertion. Additionally, ensure you have sufficient available seats in your subscription plan. You can review your current SSO configuration in the Admin Console under Security settings.

subject: oauth token generation broken error invalid client
body: our custom oauth 2.0 applications are failing to obtain access tokens right now and returning invalid client or client_secret_mismatch errors. we are getting code OAUTH-AUTH-401 and we have a major stakeholder demo at 5pm today so this is urgent and breaking our integration completely. please fix this immediately.
resolution: Please verify that the 'Client ID' and 'Client Secret' used in your custom application exactly match the credentials generated in the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'API & Integrations' -> 'OAuth Clients'. Please pay close attention to case sensitivity and make sure there are no accidental extra spaces in your configuration.

subject: User Activity report page is blank
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report for our end-of-week review, but the page is just loading as blank white space. This is a major blocker for us because I have an audit on Friday and I need this data. I see error code REPORT-001 in the browser console. Please help me fix this quickly.
resolution: This behavior typically points to a localized browser issue preventing the data from rendering correctly. Please try clearing your cache and cookies, or opening the console in an Incognito window to rule out extension conflicts. If you still see a blank page, let us know exactly which date range you are attempting to query so we can investigate further.

subject: Audit log export failing for long ranges
body: I am trying to pull audit logs for a six-month period but receive the audit_export_range_exceeded error. Is there a way to get this full report? Thank you for your help.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with a pagination script to pull the data. Please let us know if you need further assistance with the API calls.

subject: Okta SSO login failing after update
body: After v4.2 update, our users cant sign in. They get AUTH-SSO-401.1 error for invalid token format. We need this working immediately as no one can get into the portal.
resolution: This is due to the SSO token format change in v4.2. You need to log into the CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata to update the configuration. This should fix the authentication errors immediately.

subject: incorrect user attribution in activity log
body: I have noticed that our workspace activity logs are attributing file moves and edits to the wrong users, often showing an administrator instead of the person who actually performed the action. This is causing some confusion for our team. I am seeing the audit-004 error code in the logs as well. Is there a way to fix this display issue?
resolution: This is a known display glitch currently affecting actions by Contributor-level users when an administrator is also active in the workspace. Please be assured that the underlying audit trail remains accurate. For the most precise information, you can cross-reference the workspace logs with the global audit log available in your Admin Console.

subject: New user login 'User Not Found' AUTH-NF-404.1
body: A newly invited user is trying to log in with their email and password but keeps getting an 'User Not Found' error. We've checked the email address and it seems correct. This isn't a critical issue, but it's preventing them from starting work. The error code is AUTH-NF-404.1. Could you please look into this for us?
resolution: Thank you for reaching out. The 'User Not Found' error, often seen as AUTH-NF-404.1, typically occurs when an invitation hasn't been accepted or the email is mistyped. Please verify the user's email address in your Admin Console. You can also confirm if the invitation was successfully sent and accepted. If not, resending the invitation should resolve the issue, ensuring they log in with the correct credentials.

subject: ACCOUNT LOCKED PLEASE HELP
body: I have been trying to log in for an hour and it keeps telling me my account is locked! I have the right password but AUTH-LOCK-429.1 keeps popping up. I need access to these files immediately.
resolution: I am sorry for the frustration. Your account will automatically unlock after 15 minutes of inactivity, or your company admin can manually clear this status from the 'Manage User' section in the Admin Console.

subject: Seat limit reached error incorrectly blocking team additions
body: Hello support team, I am writing as the IT administrator for our Enterprise account. We are currently trying to onboard a new batch of employees, but the admin console is throwing error CD-AM-001 stating that our seat limit has been reached. However, our subscription dashboard explicitly displays that we have numerous seats still available for use. This discrepancy is completely unacceptable for an enterprise tier, so please look into it.
resolution: Hello. To resolve this error, please verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Please note that pending invitations count towards your seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: deleted files still visible in trash bin past 30 days
body: Hi, I am writing because we set up our system to delete things after thirty days but it seems like files in the trash bin are visible and recoverable way beyond that limit. We need this fixed promtly as we have an audit coming up soon and our data retention policy RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED is causing a lot of confusion for the team. Thanks.
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: File previews showing blank pages
body: Hello, we are encountering an issue where users trying to preview PDF and PPTX files directly within the web app see a blank page, an infinite spinning loader, or corrupted rendering, accompanied by error PREVIEW-006. Downloading the files works properly, but we have a major client contract review meeting in one hour and need the inline previews working immediately.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, or try viewing the preview in an incognito window to rule out browser extensions interfering with the viewer.

subject: mobile app is extremely slow loading files
body: every time i open a workspace with lots of files the app just sits there spinning for over 30 seconds. i keep seeing WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT and it is making it impossible to get work done on the go. fix this please.
resolution: Large file counts can impact mobile loading performance. We recommend using the search or filter features to narrow your view rather than loading the entire workspace. You might also consider splitting very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable collections.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Hello support. One of our team managers on our PRO plan requested a password reset, but the email never arrived. We checked the spam folders thoroughly, and other platform emails come through fine. Could you look into why this is happening?
resolution: We verified the email address in your Admin Console. Please check if your domain is configured with an approved email sender list, and if not, advise adding no-reply@cloudesk.com to your allowlist. We have also manually triggered a password reset for this user from the backend.

subject: Frequent SSO logout issues after upgrade
body: Since the v4.2 update, our users are being kicked out of their sessions constantly. They keep getting the 'SSO session expired' message while working. This is blocking our developers and requires an immediate fix. The error code we keep seeing is SSO-REFRESH-401-V42.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how sessions are refreshed for SSO providers. Please check your Okta or Azure AD application settings to ensure that 'Refresh Token' policies are enabled. Configuring a session duration of 8 to 24 hours should prevent these premature logouts.

subject: API 503 errors on our integration
body: our automated scripts are failing with API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 errors during peak hours. this is causing major issues with our billing sync and we need this fixed immediately. please help.
resolution: Please check your X-RateLimit-Remaining header to ensure you aren't exceeding our capacity. We recommend implementing exponential backoff for your retries, and you can monitor our status page for any platform issues.

subject: Issue renaming a role in the admin panel
body: Hello! I am trying to rename a custom role in my dashboard, but it keeps telling me the name already exists. I have checked my list multiple times and it does not seem to be there. I am not in a huge rush, but I would love some help whenever you have a moment. Thank you for your time!
resolution: Role names are case-insensitive and leading or trailing spaces are automatically trimmed by our system. Please check your roles list again for any entry that might match the name even with slightly different capitalization. If you still see the error, let us know.

subject: Mobile app preview failing for documents before client demo
body: Hello, when attempting to preview documents like PDF or DOCX in the mobile app, the preview takes a long time to load or displays an error saying MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL. We have a major client demo at 5pm today and need to show these files on mobile. Thank you very much for your help!
resolution: Please ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version and check your device storage and network connection. Advise clearing the mobile app's cache via device settings, and for very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: workspace load timeout on large folders
body: opening workspaces with over 10000 files just spins forever and times out with workspace load timeout. fix this please
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: API calls failing with 401 error
body: WHY are all my api requests suddenly failing with invalid_token errors?! We are just on the free plan but this is completely disrupting our workflow today! Error code is API-AUTH-401. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your requests.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: I am trying to log into the web app using my Google account but I get stuck in a loop after I authenticate. It never actually takes me to the dashboard. I see the error AUTH-SSO-302.1 on the screen. Any help would be appreciated.
resolution: Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com. If the loop continues, try using a private browsing window to log in. We also recommend double-checking your Google SSO configuration within the Admin Console.

subject: Critical SSO token error affecting all users
body: Following the v4.2 update today, all of our users attempting to log in via SSO are receiving the SSO_TOKEN_FORMAT_401 invalid token error. Direct email and password authentication is working, but our entire company relies on SSO. This is an urgent production outage affecting our revenue operations and we need an immediate fix.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Admins must re-configure their SSO integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Refer to the v4.2 release notes for detailed steps.

subject: audit log issues
body: we think we have a security issue but the login activity logs dont show anything suspicious. the logs only show successes and i get error audit_log_incomplete_login. we need to see all login attempts from new countries right now.
resolution: Our system separates standard login history from security-related events. Please navigate to Admin Console, Security & Compliance, and then Security Events to view failed attempts and logins from new IP addresses. You can also enable Login Anomaly Detection there for future alerts.

subject: Desktop sync failing after password reset
body: I changed my password on the web site this morning. Now the desktop app says Authentication Failed and shows CD-AM-015. How do I get my files to sync again?
resolution: Your desktop client requires a fresh authentication after a password change. Please open the app's system tray menu, select Log Out to disconnect your account, and then sign back in using your new credentials.

subject: api returning 503 errors during peak hours
body: multiple endpoints are failing with API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 and breaking our production deployment right now. fix this immediately please
resolution: hello. we are investigating your api usage patterns to check if you are exceeding rate limits and suggest implementing exponential backoff for retries. please confirm ongoing platform status via our status page while we look into this.

subject: USERS LOGGED OUT CONSTANTLY WITH SSO REFRESH 401 V42 ERROR
body: EVER SINCE THE V42 UPGRADE, OUR ENTERPRISE USERS USING AZURE AD AND OKTA SSO ARE BEING FORCED TO RE-AUTHENTICATE CONSTANTLY WITH SSO-REFRESH-401-V42. THIS IS COMPLETELY BLOCKING OUR WORKFLOWS AND WE NEED THIS FIXED IMMEDIATELY!
resolution: v4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta and Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a Refresh Token policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration of 8 to 24 hours to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with token error after v4.2 update
body: Hello support, since updating our platform to v4.2, users attempting to log in through Okta SSO are redirected back to the login page with an invalid token format error. Email and password logins are unaffected and work normally. This is blocking our daily operations, so we would appreciate prompt assistance with error code AUTH-402.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling introduced in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console by ensuring the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide, which is accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration'.

subject: URGENT okta sso broken invalid token format v42
body: Hi team, I am an external contractor helping this company manage their infrastructure, and nobody with Okta SSO can log in right now because they are getting invalid sso token format errors ever since the recent v42 update rolled out. This is a critical emergency blocking our entire workforce from accessing files right before a hard deadline today, so we need immediate assistance please!
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Google SSO not logging in
body: We are experiencing a redirect loop when attempting to log in via Google SSO. It just bounces back to the login screen after authentication. I am seeing error AUTH-SSO-302.1 in the console. Please investigate this when you have a moment.
resolution: Please clear your browser's cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com and try logging in again. If the loop continues, try using an incognito window to verify if it is an extension issue. You should also double-check your Google SSO configuration within the Admin Console.

subject: payment failed error on billing page
body: hi there, our auto renewal failed because of a declined card and now we see a payment failed status. we are getting error code BILL-PAY-002 in the billing portal. this is blocking our work and we need prompt help getting our payment method updated.
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: Accidental upgrade charge refund request
body: i am very angry because our account got upgraded by mistake and now we are billed unexpectedly. BILL-REF-005 error or whatever happened is frustrating. give us our money back for this accidental upgrade immediately.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility upon receiving this information.

subject: Admin Console access denied
body: Hello, when trying to access the Admin Console as an administrator, I am redirected to the standard user dashboard or receive an access denied message. Error code ADMIN-AUTH-403.3 is showing up. Could we look into this soon?
resolution: Please confirm the user's role in the Admin Console by going to Users, then Manage User, and checking Roles. Ensure they have an Admin or Super Admin role assigned to their account. If not, update their role accordingly to restore access.

subject: Cannot delete workspace due to error
body: Hello, I am trying to remove an old workspace, but I keep getting an error message saying 'Active Integrations Detected'. I've checked the settings and I am not sure what is still running. Could you please assist me with this CD-AM-007 error? We would like to have this cleaned up soon.
resolution: Before a workspace can be fully deleted, you must disconnect all active integrations like Slack or Jira linked to it. You can do this by navigating to Workspace Settings > Integrations and disabling all active services. Once those are removed, the delete function will work as expected.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA code failing on mobile app
body: Hello support team, I am currently unable to log into the mobile application because the MFA code generated by my Google Authenticator app is not being accepted. I am seeing error code AUTH-MFA-401.2 when attempting to authenticate. Thank you for your time and assistance in looking into this.
resolution: Hello. Please advise the user to ensure their phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, guide them through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app's 'Security Settings' page.

subject: Unrecognized charge on billing statement
body: We see a stray charge on our account statement. Please help us reconcile this as soon as possible.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Too many email notifications
body: The current email notification system is a bit overwhelming for my team. We are getting alerts for every single comment and would prefer to only be notified for mentions. Is there a way to make this more specific?
resolution: We appreciate your feedback on our notification settings. For more granular control, please submit your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications so our product team can consider it for future updates.

subject: Azure AD SSO login fails for some users
body: Hi, we're having problems with some users trying to log in via Azure AD SSO. They get an error saying 'User profile incomplete' or 'Missing required attributes', AUTH-SSO-403.2. It's preventing them from logging in completely. What should we do?
resolution: The 'User profile incomplete' or 'Missing required attributes' error during Azure AD SSO login indicates that certain user attributes are not being passed correctly. Please have your Azure AD administrator verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped in the enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. Our Azure AD SSO configuration guide (link provided in our documentation) can offer more detailed steps if needed.

subject: Invalid SSO Token Format error after update
body: Ever since the recent v4.2 update, our team is unable to log in via our SSO provider. We keep seeing an Invalid SSO Token Format error, specifically error code CD-AM-003. We really enjoy using CloudDesk and would appreciate your help getting our team back in as soon as possible.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Please update your SSO application configuration within your identity provider to use the new token schema. You can find detailed steps in our CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide.

subject: Missing past invoices from previous years
body: Hello there, I hope you are having a pleasant week so far. I am writing to you today because I was sitting at my desk going through some old paperwork with my morning coffee, and I realized I need to check something on our financial records from a couple of years ago. Our team has been using CloudDesk for our enterprise collaboration needs for quite some time now, and generally everything runs smoothly without any fuss. However, when I went into the Admin Console to pull up some statements from more than a year ago, I noticed I could not find them anywhere in the invoice section. I am not in any major rush for this since we are just doing some routine year-end filing, but I wanted to reach out and see where those might be hiding. Thanks so much for your help with this little administrative task.
resolution: Hello! The Admin Console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months. For older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you are looking for, and we will retrieve it for you from our archives.

subject: api error 403 when sharing workspace
body: hi, our automated script keeps getting a HTTP 403 Forbidden error on POST /workspaces/{id}/share. the api key user definitely has the Manager role and global permissions. can you look into this urgently as it's blocking our onboarding pipeline today.
resolution: Hello. Ensure the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Also, the user associated with the API key must be a direct member of the workspace being shared, not just via a group. If the issue persists, provide the API key ID and workspace ID for further review.

subject: Okta SSO attribute mismatch errors
body: Our users are unable to access the web app using Okta. The error message reports a user attribute mismatch after redirection. We are seeing SSO-OKTA-403 codes. We need this fixed as soon as possible as it is preventing our team from working.
resolution: You need to verify your Okta application settings for CloudDesk. Ensure that the email, firstName, and lastName attributes are correctly mapped to our profile fields, and confirm that the email field is designated as the unique identifier.

subject: Desktop app SSO login failing with DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3
body: When I try to login to desktop sync client using SSO, browser redirect correctly but client just showing generic Login Failed error with code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. Many people in my department getting same thing right now. Please help us fix this promptly as we cannot access synced files.
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to the latest version v4.2.1 or newer. Check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, you can also try logging in via email and password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: Push notifications are severely delayed
body: The mobile app notifications are not arriving on time. Sometimes they take 10 minutes or they don't show up at all unless I open the app. The error is MOBILE_NOTIFICATION_DELAY. It is really frustrating to deal with this.
resolution: Please verify that push notifications are enabled in both the app settings and your device's system settings. You should also check for any battery optimization settings that might restrict background activity. I recommend reinstalling the mobile app if the delay persists.

subject: Large file uploads consistently timing out
body: We are trying to upload several large project files exceeding 1GB, but the web interface progress bar stalls and eventually displays UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_504. This is happening frequently today for my team. Could you please look into this?
resolution: Please check your internet connection speed to ensure stability. For files over 500MB, we recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads, as it supports resumable transfers. If the issue persists, please try a wired connection or a different web browser.

subject: hardware mfa yubikey support
body: hi we need hardware mfa tokens like yubikey for security compliance. let us know if thats possible now. no rush on this.
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Critical: SSO login broken after v4.2 update
body: Our whole team is blocked from logging in via Okta. We are seeing 'Invalid SSO token format' errors everywhere since the update. This is critical as no one can access files. The error code is AUTH-SSO-401.1. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced changes to the SSO token structure which requires a configuration refresh. Please update your SSO settings in the Admin Console by re-uploading your identity provider metadata. This will align your configuration with the new token requirements.

subject: Account suspended unexpectedly, need immediate fix
body: Our account has been locked and none of our users can log in due to BILL-SUSP-007. There is an Account Suspended banner in the Admin Console and we urgently need this resolved before our team meeting in twenty minutes.
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to Admin Console, then Billing, then Invoices, and paying the overdue invoice. Once payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: Mobile app network error
body: Cannot log into the mobile app, receiving a generic Network Error even with a stable internet connection. MOBILE-NET-500.1 is showing up. There is no rush to fix this.
resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache or data and reinstalling the app. Verify server status on our status page.

subject: API calls failing with 401 unauthorized
body: our automated backend scripts are suddenly getting 401 Unauthorized responses with invalid_token errors starting this morning. we need this resolved as our integration pipeline is currently blocked.
resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the Authorization Bearer header of your requests.

subject: Need better activity reports for Friday audit
body: We have an audit on Friday and I really need more detail on file downloads and views. Currently the audit logs are too basic for what I need to report. Can you provide a more detailed export please?
resolution: We understand your need for more granular data for your upcoming audit. Currently, our system provides standard audit logs, but we are actively collecting feedback on advanced reporting requirements. Please post your specific use cases to our public roadmap so our analytics team can prioritize these features.

subject: user stuck on pending invitation
body: my user is stuck on pending invitation status even after clicking the link. it is showing cd-am-005. this is really annoying can you fix it.
resolution: This can happen if there is a delay in the invitation processing or if the email domain isn't set for auto-join. Please ask the user to attempt a direct login with the password they set. If that fails, please revoke the current invitation in the 'Admin Console' and send a fresh one.

subject: Cannot access invoices older than one year
body: I am trying to pull our invoices from the last two years for an upcoming audit we have on Friday. The console only shows me the last 12 months, and I am unable to view anything older. Please help me get these records as soon as possible, as I am under a strict deadline for this audit.
resolution: The Admin Console is currently limited to displaying invoices from the previous 12 months. Please reply with the specific invoice dates or IDs you require for your audit, and our team will retrieve them from our archives for you.

subject: need to update po number for billing
body: hi there we need to update our purchase order number for future enterprise invoices to keep our accounting department happy error code is BILL-PO-008 just wondering where we can change this in the admin console thanks a lot
resolution: You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: WHERE IS THE SSO LOGIN PAGE BRANDING OPTION
body: WE DESPERATELY NEED TO CUSTOMIZE OUR SSO LOGIN PAGE WITH OUR COMPANY LOGO AND COLORS. IT IS UNACCEPTABLE THAT THIS BASIC FEATURE IS MISSING FROM THE ADMIN CONSOLE. MANY OTHER ENTERPRISE CUSTOMERS ARE COMPLAINING ABOUT THIS RIGHT NOW TOO. PLEASE ADD THIS OPTION SOON.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available. We recognize this as a valuable feature for many enterprises. Please add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding. We will notify you of any updates.

subject: Requesting longer expiration for public sharing links
body: Our team has noticed that public sharing links currently have a very strict expiration limit. We would like the ability to set these to never expire or at least extend the duration significantly for our long-term projects. Are there any plans to implement this feature in the near future?
resolution: Our current link expiration policies are designed for security, but we understand this can be a limitation for certain workflows. Please head over to our roadmap page at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration to share your specific use case. resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering, and if it is still blank, please provide the exact date range you are trying to view.

resolution: We are aware of this memory limitation regarding large file uploads on mobile devices. As a workaround, please use the CloudDesk web app or desktop client to upload files larger than 1GB. Our team is currently prioritizing an optimization to fix this behavior in an upcoming mobile release.

resolution: The mobile app caches files by default to allow for offline access. You can manually clear this data by navigating to Settings, then Storage, and selecting Clear Cached Files. Additionally, you can enable the Clear cache on logout setting within that same menu to ensure your data is removed automatically when you sign out.

resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This step is strictly required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: custom branding missing on sso login page

subject: Zapier trigger not firing

resolution: Thank you for reporting this. A Zapier trigger not firing, often seen with ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404, can sometimes be resolved by re-testing the connection. Please go into Zapier and re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Also, ensure that the CloudDesk account linked in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. You can also check the CloudDesk audit logs for the expected 'New File Uploaded' event to confirm it's occurring on our side.

resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

resolution: This behavior is typically caused by a browser-side caching issue with user permissions. Ask the affected agents to clear their browser cache and log back in to refresh their session. If the tickets remain hidden, an admin can unassign and reassign the ticket to trigger a visibility refresh.

subject: cannot login to mobile app

resolution: Please try force-closing the application and checking your app store for any pending updates. If the issue remains, clearing the app cache on Android or reinstalling the application on your device usually resolves these connectivity hiccups. Please also check our status page to ensure all services are currently running normally.

resolution: Could you please provide specific API call examples, including the exact endpoint, request body, and timestamps? I have escalated this to our engineering team with your logs for a detailed performance analysis.

If that does not work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save the change, and then re-assign it back to the original agent.

resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and clearing your browser cache. Please verify if the lag improves when fewer users are editing the document simultaneously.

resolution: The GDPR data export primarily covers files, folders, and direct user profile data, while comments on files and tasks are stored as activity metadata. To export comments, navigate to the specific file or task, open the activity tab, and use the export activity log option for that item, as there is no single bulk export for all user comments across the platform.

subject: Webhook signature verification failing across our system
body: We are currently experiencing severe issues with our external service rejecting your webhooks because of an invalid signature, yielding a persistent HMAC verification failed error. resolution: Ensure the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the Webhook Secret configured in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Additionally, verify that your signature verification algorithm matches CloudDesk's standard HMAC-SHA256.

subject: API requests returning client not authorized error
body: Our new integration using the CloudDesk REST API is failing to make any calls, receiving a 403 Forbidden error. We are using a valid API key on our PRO plan. Any help would be appreciated.
resolution: Confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes and permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

resolution: Large file counts can indeed impact browser performance. Please also check your browser console for any network errors that might be occurring during the load.

If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

resolution: We are aware of this issue with MFA registration in our mobile app. Please have your boss log into the CloudDesk web app instead and navigate to Settings then Security to complete the MFA setup. Once it is configured on the web, it will work perfectly on her mobile device as well.

subject: Seat limit reached error during team addition

resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to our SSO token handling, but an API endpoint for programmatic workspace creation is not yet available. This helps us understand the demand for automation.

subject: sso session expired again and again

resolution: The v4.2 update changed SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta and Azure AD, please ensure your IdP application settings for CloudDesk have a refresh token policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration, such as 8 to 24 hours, to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: Need longer expiration for public sharing links

resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set to maintain security best practices. Please submit your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com, and for permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Invoice user count mismatch issue

User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Inconsistent data in billing API reports

resolution: The v4.2 release updated how certain usage metrics are aggregated. Please verify that your API queries are using the correct date ranges and parameters as outlined in our updated documentation, and let us know if you still see discrepancies.

subject: Unable to remove user from workspace due to error

The system says they cannot be removed, and I keep seeing CD-AM-014 whenever I try. It is quite frustrating to deal with these hurdles during a standard administrative task. Can you advise on why this is happening?
resolution: The user cannot be removed because they are currently set as the owner of that workspace. You must transfer ownership to another member within the Admin Console under the workspace settings menu before you will be able to delete their account.

subject: SSO branding is missing

resolution: Please navigate to the SSO & Branding section within your Admin Console to ensure your assets are saved correctly. It is possible your browser has cached the old page, so please try clearing your cache. This should restore the correct company branding.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error

resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, check the 'Allowed Domains' list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: Public sharing link expiration limit is too restrictive

resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: JIRA INTEGRATION BROKEN AGAIN
body: Dammit, our Jira integration setup keeps failing with JIRA-SYNC-403 and project not found errors in the logs! We need this working properly soon to keep track of our engineering tickets.
resolution: Ensure the Jira API token or user configured for the CloudDesk integration has 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance.

subject: Large file uploads stalling and timing out
body: Hello support, we are experiencing repeated upload timeouts when trying to push files over 1GB through the web app. The progress bar freezes near the end and eventually throws an UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_504. We need this sorted before our client demo at 5pm today.
resolution: Please check your internet connection speed and consider a wired connection if you are currently on Wi-Fi. For large files over 500MB, we recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client since it supports resumable transfers. Also, please verify whether the issue persists across different browsers.

subject: Tax rate on invoice is wrong
body: The tax rate applied to our latest invoice is incorrect for our business location. I am seeing BILL-TAX-006 when I try to update our profile. Please have someone correct our tax settings.
resolution: Please first double-check your billing address and tax ID in the Billing Information section of the Admin Console. If those fields are accurate, please reply with your company's full legal name and tax exemption certificate. We will then conduct a manual review to update your tax status.

subject: API pagination parameters seem ignored
body: Hello dear support team, hope you are having a wonderful day. We noticed that some of our mobile app API calls using pagination parameters like limit and offset are returning fewer results than expected or ignoring the limit entirely. There is no major rush on our end as we are just testing, but whenever you have time please check it out. Thank you so much.
resolution: Hello! Thank you for your kind message. Please ensure your API request correctly uses the 'limit' and 'offset' query parameters as specified in the CloudDesk API documentation. Note that there might be a hard cap on the maximum 'limit' allowed per request, typically up to 1000 items.

subject: unrecognized charge on my statement please help
body: i noticed a weird charge from clouddesk on our card statement showing error BILL-CHG-010. we are on the free plan and shouldnt be getting billed at all. please look into this right now as we need it sorted out promptly
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Need offline mobile editing capabilities
body: It is incredibly frustrating that our team cannot edit documents offline in the mobile app. We lose so much productivity when traveling. Why is this not a standard feature yet?
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: GDPR data export missing comments
body: Hello. As part of our routine compliance checks, our admin performed a GDPR data export for a user, but the generated data package is missing some comments the user made on specific files or tasks. Other profile and file data seems complete. We have an upcoming compliance review on Friday, so please let us know how to capture those missing comments.
resolution: The GDPR data export primarily covers files, folders, and direct user profile data. Comments on files and tasks are stored as activity metadata. To export comments, navigate to the specific file/task, open the 'Activity' tab, and use the 'Export Activity Log' option for that item. There is no single bulk export for all user comments across the platform.

subject: How can I downgrade my subscription plan
body: I try to change the plan but it is not working and I see BILL-PLAN-011. Our team is much smaller now and we don't need this expensive tier. I want to change this immediately.
resolution: To downgrade, go to 'Admin Console' > 'Billing' > 'Subscription Details' and select your new plan. Note that this change takes effect at the end of your current cycle and we do not provide prorated refunds.

subject: Missing older invoices in Admin Console
body: Hello, I am trying to locate and download some invoices from more than a year ago in the Invoices section of the Admin Console, but they are not visible. Could you point me in the right direction?
resolution: The Admin Console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months. For older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you are looking for, and we will retrieve it for you from our archives.

subject: User Activity report is not loading data
body: I hope you are having a productive week so far, as I know how busy support teams can get with tickets. I have checked the other reports and they appear to be functioning correctly, but for some reason this specific one just won't show anything. Could you investigate this for me? I am seeing REPORT-001 when I try to load it.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, or attempt to access the report using a different browser. If the issue persists, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: Desktop Sync client fails SSO login

resolution: Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a temporary workaround, you can log in via email/password if SSO is not enforced for your account.

subject: Okta SSO broken after v4.2 update

resolution: The issue you are encountering is due to the SSO token format change introduced in v4.2. Please log into the CloudDesk Admin Console and update your SSO configuration by re-uploading your IDP metadata. This will re-establish the connection and allow your users to log in successfully.

subject: Incorrect VAT rate on recent invoice

If these details are correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate (if applicable) for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: Slow document previews in mobile app
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful day. When I try to look at documents or images in the mobile app, it takes forever or throws MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL. Take your time looking into this as it is not urgent at all, but I appreciate any help.
resolution: Please ensure your mobile app is updated to the latest release and check your device storage and network connection. You can try clearing the mobile app's cache via your device settings to speed up loading times. For very large files, we recommend downloading the file directly before attempting to view it.

subject: requesting more detailed activity reports

resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding the need for more granular audit data. Since our current logs are limited, I encourage you to post your specific use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. Our team reviews these requests directly when planning future updates to our analytics features.

resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Custom branding not showing on SSO page
body: The custom branding we set up is not appearing on the SSO login page. It just shows the default CloudDesk logo and background instead. This is very frustrating as we need our company identity consistent. Are there any known issues with this?
resolution: Guide the admin to the 'SSO & Branding' section in the Admin Console. Check if the custom branding assets (logo, background) are uploaded and saved correctly. Advise clearing browser cache for affected users.

subject: Deleted user still visible in workspace sharing dialogs
body: I deleted a user account yesterday, but their name and email still appear in the sharing dialogs for various workspaces. This is very frustrating as we expect immediate removal from all lists. CD-AM-006 is showing up in our audits. Not an emergency, but please explain why this happens.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as ghost entries in historical share lists until the system purges them, which typically happens within 24 to 48 hours. Alternatively, a workspace owner can explicitly remove them from a share via Workspace Settings > Members.

subject: Unable to add credit card for payment
body: I am trying to update our payment method in the admin console, but the system keeps throwing an 'Invalid Card Details' error. All the information, including the CVV and expiry date, is correct on my end. I am getting error code BILL-PAY-012 when I try to save. Could you please look into this so we can settle our balance?
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again after 30 minutes. If the issue persists, try using a different card or contact your bank to ensure there are no blocks on transactions with CloudDesk.

subject: Urgent offline editing missing on mobile app
body: Our team cannot edit docs offline in the mobile app and sync later when connected. this is causing massive workflow blockages for our field staff right now. we need this fixed ASAP as our whole operation depends on it.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: MFA setup error on mobile app after scanning QR

resolution: Hello! This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Google SSO domain access issues
body: I am beyond frustrated that our team members are suddenly blocked from logging in with their work email. Users from specific sub-domains keep getting a 'Domain not allowed' error, and we are seeing SSO-GOOGLE-403 in the logs. resolution: This error occurs when a domain is not explicitly listed in your security settings. Please navigate to the SSO & Identity section within your Admin Console and ensure all required domains are included in the Allowed Domains list for Google SSO. Adding these domains should immediately restore access for your users.

subject: Issues with file previews in the web app
body: I am trying to review our quarterly reports, but the preview viewer is just showing a blank page or a spinning loader. I keep seeing error PREVIEW-006. Downloading the files works, but this is a major interruption to my workflow. Could you please look into this?
resolution: This is likely caused by a temporary issue with our rendering service. Please try clearing your browser's cache or opening the file in an incognito window to rule out extension conflicts. If the file is not corrupted, this should restore normal preview functionality.

subject: File share notifications missing in Slack
body: Good morning, CloudDesk file share notifications are not appearing in our configured Slack channel at all. We are seeing error SLACK-NOTIFY-500 in our logs. It is quite frustrating that this integration stopped working. Take your time getting back to us as this is not pressing.
resolution: Please check the Slack integration settings in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app has proper permission to post in that channel within Slack.

subject: Desktop sync client SSO login failing

We are seeing DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 in the logs. This is blocking our team right now, so please look into this promptly.
resolution: Hello. Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to version v4.2.1 or newer, as this resolves several enterprise authentication issues. Additionally, check that the user's default operating system browser is correctly configured to handle custom protocol redirects back to the app. As a temporary workaround if SSO remains blocked, users can log in using their direct email and password.

subject: Urgent User Deletion Request Stuck in Pending
body: We initiated a user data deletion request from the Admin Console under our enterprise account, but the status has been stuck on Pending for over 48 hours without any confirmation email. We are facing a strict compliance audit deadline and this delay is completely unacceptable. Please resolve this immediately as it impacts our operations.
resolution: First, verify that the target user's status is set to 'Inactive', because active users will keep the deletion request queued. If the user is already inactive and you are hitting this widespread queue delay affecting multiple accounts right now, please provide the user's email and deletion request ID so our engineers can force-process it.

subject: Request for more granular permissions
body: We love the platform but have a need for more granular permission controls like view-only with comments or upload-only for specific sub-folders. Is this something you are planning to add soon? Thank you for your help.
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding more specific permission settings. Please submit your detailed requirements through our roadmap portal at roadmap.cloudesk.com, as this information is vital for our product team to design the best solution.

subject: Cannot export audit logs over 90 days
body: I am trying to pull an audit report for the last four months to review some activity, but the system keeps throwing the AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED error. It seems to truncate anything beyond 90 days. Can you help me get the full data for my report?
resolution: The Admin Console's direct export tool is limited to 90 days of data. To retrieve longer periods, please use the API endpoint /v1/audit/export with a pagination script. If you are unable to use the API, let us know and we can facilitate a manual data pull for you.

subject: Unable to add new team members
body: We are currently trying to onboard new hires, but the admin console is throwing a 'Seat limit reached' error despite our dashboard showing we have space. It mentions CD-AM-001. Could you verify our current usage when convenient?
resolution: Please check your 'Pending Invitations' in the Team Management tab, as those count toward your total limit. You can either revoke those older invites or upgrade your subscription to add more capacity.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: The user count listed on our latest billing statement does not match our actual active user numbers. We are just checking this over at our convenience. No rush on a reply.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Guest user login failure
body: A user set to Guest status cannot log in to the web app. They report seeing an insufficient permissions error. We need them back in the system immediately.
resolution: Guest users are restricted to specific shared workspaces. Please check the Team Management section to verify if the user has active invitations to the necessary workspaces. If they require full system access, you should update their role to Member or Admin.

subject: Cannot register MFA device on mobile app
body: Hello support team, I am trying to configure Google Authenticator on my phone but it keeps failing with error code MFA-MOB-002 right after scanning the QR code. This is quite frustrating because our enterprise security policy requires this, yet password login works fine. Please let us know when this can be sorted out.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: HMAC verification failing on webhooks
body: Our integrations are failing with WEBHOOK-SIGN-403 errors and we have an audit this Friday! We cannot have these webhooks failing during this time. FIX THIS NOW!
resolution: This error occurs when the signing secret does not match between our systems. Please ensure the secret in your receiving service is identical to the one in your Admin Console. Additionally, confirm that your system is using the HMAC-SHA256 algorithm to verify the signature.

subject: Slow API response times on GET and POST requests
body: Our integration is experiencing heavy delays because endpoints like GET /files are taking over 500ms to respond. This error API_RESPONSE_SLOW is causing timeouts in our pipeline. We need this addressed.
resolution: Please provide specific API call examples including the endpoint, request body, and timestamps so we can investigate. We advise optimizing your API calls by using pagination and filtering parameters to reduce the dataset returned, and suggest caching frequently accessed data on your end.

subject: Mobile app showing network error
body: I have been unable to log into the mobile app all morning due to a generic network error. My internet connection is perfectly fine otherwise. I would appreciate it if you could look into this issue for me when you have a moment.
resolution: Please try force-closing the app and checking for any available updates in the app store. If the issue persists, try clearing the app cache on Android or reinstalling the application on iOS. You can also verify our current service status on our dedicated website.

subject: GETTING HTTP 403 WHEN SHARING WORKSPACES VIA API
body: WE ARE GETTING AN HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN ERROR WHEN MAKING API CALLS TO SHARE A WORKSPACE WITH A NEW USER USING POST /workspaces/{id}/share. THE API-403 ERROR HAPPENS EVEN THOUGH OUR KEY HAS MANAGER PRIVILEGES AND FULL PERMISSIONS. THIS IS COMPLETELY BLOCKING OUR PROD WORKFLOWS AND WE NEED IT FIXED NOW!
resolution: Please ensure that the API key being used has the Manage Workspaces scope explicitly enabled. Additionally, verify that the user associated with the API key is a direct member of the workspace being shared, rather than only having access via a group. If the issue persists, please provide your API key ID and the workspace ID for further review.

subject: Okta SSO Login failing with Invalid Token Format

Email and password work, but our security policy requires SSO. Please fix this immediately as it is blocking our entire engineering department.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide, accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration'.

subject: Users keep getting logged out
body: Since the last update, our users keep getting kicked out of their sessions and forced to sign back in repeatedly. This SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 error is causing a lot of frustration for our employees. We need this stable as soon as possible.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced changes to our SSO token refresh mechanisms. Please ensure your IdP settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a duration of at least 8 to 24 hours to keep sessions active.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content API
body: We are observing intermittent HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses when calling the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. This happens most often when accessing files in different regions. This error is causing failures in our background processes. Please advise on a fix.
resolution: This behavior is often related to latency in distributed storage retrieval. We recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your application to handle these intermittent failures. Our team is working on a permanent fix to be included in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Incomplete login activity logs

Could you please look into this promptly?
resolution: You can find failed login attempts and access from new locations by navigating to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events. The standard 'Login Activity' log is currently limited to successful sessions, which is a known pattern right now. I recommend enabling 'Login Anomaly Detection' in the same menu to receive automatic alerts for future suspicious activity.

resolution: Please verify that the API key being utilized has the necessary scopes and permissions enabled for the endpoints you are calling. An administrator can review and modify these permissions in the Admin Console under API Keys. Let us know if you still encounter access issues after verification.

subject: Incorrect users shown in activity log

resolution: This is a known display issue where actions by contributors are misattributed when an administrator is active in the same workspace. Please rest assured the underlying audit trail remains accurate. You can verify specific actions by checking the global audit log in your Admin Console.

subject: File previews showing blank page in web app
body: When opening certain PDF and PPTX files directly inside the web app, the preview viewer shows a blank page or spins indefinitely. Downloading the file works fine. Please check this rendering issue.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Assigned helpdesk tickets not visible in agent view

resolution: This is often caused by a temporary caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, and then log back into CloudDesk. If that does not work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save the change, and then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: Okta SSO failing with Invalid Token Format

resolution: The v4.2 update changed how tokens are handled, which triggered your AUTH-402 error. Please update your Okta integration settings by matching the new Audience URI and Assertion Consumer Service URL found in your Admin Console under the SSO & Authentication section.

subject: Missing branding on SSO page
body: I AM NOT HAPPY! Our company login page is showing the default CloudDesk logo instead of ours. IT LOOKS VERY UNPROFESSIONAL! Please get this fixed ASAP as we cannot have our branding missing like this. SSO-UI-200.2 error is showing up sometimes too.
resolution: Please navigate to the SSO & Branding section within your Admin Console to ensure your custom logo and background assets are saved correctly. It is also possible that your browser is caching the older version of the page, so please try clearing your cache to see if the changes reflect. Let us know if the branding fails to render after these steps.

subject: Constant expired session errors on mobile app
body: Since the 4.2 update, our mobile users are being kicked out constantly with the error code CD-AM-011. It is impacting productivity because everyone has to keep logging back in every hour. Please resolve this.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how we handle session security. Please have your users log out completely and clear their app cache or reinstall the app to force a new, compatible session token.

subject: need to add po number to invoices

resolution: You can add your PO number by navigating to the Billing Information section under the Admin Console. Please note that while this will appear on all future invoices, it cannot be applied to invoices that have already been generated.

subject: SSO Login Failure - Critical Access Issue

resolution: The recent update to version 4.2 introduced a change in the SSO token format, which requires an update to your configuration. Please log into the CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata. This process will resolve the token format error and restore your team's access.

subject: cant create custom role name already exists error

resolution: Role names are case-insensitive and leading/trailing spaces are trimmed. There might be an existing role with a similar name or one that differs only by capitalization. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Roles' thoroughly for any roles that might conflict.

subject: Need to downgrade subscription plan

resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Workspace invites are not being received

resolution: Please have your team check their spam folders to start. If they still don't see them, verify that your domain's SPF and DKIM records are updated to include our sending domains. You can find the specific DNS requirements in our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide.

subject: API endpoints are taking over 500ms to respond

resolution: Could you please provide some specific examples of these slow calls, including the request body and timestamps? In the meantime, I recommend using pagination and filtering parameters to reduce the payload size and caching frequently used data on your end. I will escalate this to our engineering team to investigate the latency.

subject: jira sync failing with error

These permissions must be explicitly granted for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance to allow for proper synchronization.

Please try using the search or filter options to narrow down your view, or consider splitting the files into smaller, more manageable workspaces. Also, check your browser console for any underlying network errors.

subject: audit log showing wrong user on edits AUDIT-004

resolution: Hello. This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with Contributor roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct. This is a known bug we are addressing. For accurate audit, cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: API tokens not working after v4.2 update
body: Ever since we updated to v4.2 our integration script broke. we get an error API-AUTH-401-V42 saying legacy_token_format. need to fix this quick, our sync is failing.
resolution: With the v4.2 update, the API token format has been changed. You will need to regenerate your API tokens from the API & Integrations section of your Admin Console and update your application to use the new credentials.

subject: Mobile app crashes on file upload
body: We are experiencing consistent crashes when uploading files larger than 1GB from our mobile devices. We see error code CRASH-MOB-001 during these attempts. resolution: This is a known issue regarding memory management when handling very large file uploads on mobile. subject: nobody is getting their invites email-005 error

Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: mobile app keeps logging me out with cd-am-011

resolution: With the v4.2 update, the API token format was updated for security and performance. You must regenerate all API tokens from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console immediately. Please update your backend applications to use these new tokens right away.

If that is not an option, clearing your browser cache might help while our team investigates the SSO billing integration.

subject: New user stuck in pending status

Please navigate to 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations', revoke the current pending invite, and then send a new one. Once the user receives the new invitation, they should be able to complete their registration.

resolution: Please navigate to the SSO and Branding section in your Admin Console to verify if your custom branding assets, including the logo and background, are uploaded and saved correctly. Once checked, we advise clearing the browser cache for any affected users so the new assets can load properly.

subject: Request for file upload webhook event in API

resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including desired payload, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements. This helps us assess demand and design.

subject: files recoverable after 30 day policy

resolution: Please note that the retention policy applies specifically to files that have been 'Permanently Deleted'. Files currently sitting in the 'Trash Bin' are held for user-initiated recovery and are not subject to the automatic purge policy unless you specifically configure your settings to auto-empty the trash after a set period. Please check your settings in Security & Compliance to ensure the trash auto-purge is enabled.

subject: Unable to change my subscription plan

resolution: To downgrade, please navigate to Admin Console, then Billing, and select Subscription Details to change your plan. Please note that the change will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle, and we do not issue prorated refunds for these shifts.

resolution: We appreciate you sharing your interest in more advanced reporting capabilities. This feedback is essential for our analytics team as they prioritize future updates.

Note that the Trash Bin is meant for user-initiated recovery and is only purged automatically if you have explicitly configured a separate Trash retention limit.

resolution: Confirm the user's role in the Admin Console ('Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Roles'). Ensure they have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned. If not, update their role.

You should also check that no browser extensions are blocking our required session data.

resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are currently investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

This is expected behavior.

Please check the 'Users' section in the Admin Console to verify their role and ensure they have active invitations to the necessary workspaces. If they require full access to the platform, you will need to change their role back to 'Member'.

resolution: Hello. Thank you for letting us know about the collaboration lag. Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and applications, verifying if the issue persists if fewer users are editing, and clearing the browser cache for all users.

subject: cannot change company name in admin console

resolution: The 'Company Name' is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details by navigating to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and updating the 'Organization Name' there. This change will then propagate to the Company Settings automatically.

resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there is a temporary delay. Please ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set during the invitation process. If the issue persists, simply revoke the invitation in Admin Console, Team Management, Invitations and send a new one.

subject: User locked out after role change
body: We recently changed a user's role from Member to Guest, and now they cannot access the web application at all, receiving an Insufficient Permissions message. This is causing confusion for our team, so please let us know how to fix it.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

This feedback is essential for our analytics team to prioritize future improvements.

resolution: Please check if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested folder structures. If the issue persists, please report the specific workspace ID to us so our engineering team can perform an indexing review.

subject: Cannot delete workspace due to integrations

resolution: To delete the workspace, you must first disconnect any active integrations such as Slack, Jira, or Zapier. Please navigate to the 'Workspace Settings' section, open the 'Integrations' tab, and disable every listed integration. Once all connections have been removed, you will be able to proceed with the deletion of the workspace.
