resolution: Please check your company's email spam or junk folders first as a precaution. If they are not there, ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured to allow emails from our sending domains; you can find the required DNS entries in our Email Delivery Troubleshooting guide. If the issue persists, please send us the email addresses of the affected users so we can investigate further.

subject: Workspace sharing API returning unexpected HTTP 403 error
body: Hi there, I am trying to share a workspace with a new team member using our API endpoint POST /workspaces/{id}/share, but it keeps failing with a frustrating API-403 error. My API key has the Manager role and sufficient global permissions, yet nothing is working. Please help me resolve this immediately as my work is completely blocked.
resolution: Hello. Please ensure the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled in your settings. Additionally, the user associated with that API key must be a direct member of the workspace being shared, rather than just accessing it via a group. If the issue persists, please provide your API key ID and workspace ID for further review.

Please confirm your role in Admin Console > Team Management > Users, and if you are not a Super Admin, your current Super Admin must generate the key for you or elevate your role.

Please pause the sync process, restart your computer to clear the memory, and then resume the sync. If it continues, ensure that you do not have any conflicting antivirus software and consider pausing sync during your most resource-intensive work hours.

resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or security software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus or firewall to see if the syncing stabilizes. If the issue resolves, ensure you whitelist CloudDesk in your security software settings.

subject: Error removing workspace user

resolution: Hello. A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace. The ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace by navigating to Admin Console, then Workspaces, selecting your Workspace Name, Settings, and finally Transfer Ownership to reassign.

subject: user activity report blank

resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue on your local session. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, then attempt to access the report again. If the problem continues, please try a different browser or ensure no extensions are interfering with the page load.

subject: Billing section failing after SSO login

As a temporary workaround, please try logging into the console using your standard email and password instead of SSO. If that does not work, clearing your browser cache and cookies should resolve the session conflict.

Please open your desktop client, navigate to settings, and select the option to log out or disconnect your account. Once done, you can sign back in with your new credentials to resume syncing.

resolution: Hello. Please verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations', as pending invitations count towards your overall seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Intermittent HTTP 500 errors on GET files endpoint
body: Hi, our backend developers are seeing intermittent HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses when calling the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint, particularly for files stored in geographically diverse regions. Other endpoints are fine but this is blocking our release pipeline. Please look into this promptly.
resolution: Hello. This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: api endpoints returning 503 errors during peak hours
body: multiple api endpoints are throwing api_service_unavailable_503 errors right now during high volume requests. this is completely breaking our automated scripts and needs prompt help.
resolution: Investigate the customer's API usage patterns to identify if they are exceeding rate limits by checking the X-RateLimit-Remaining header. Advise implementing exponential backoff for retries. Confirm if there are any ongoing platform incidents via the CloudDesk status page. Escalate to engineering if rate limits are not being hit.

subject: Stuck in google sso loop on desktop sync
body: Hi team, our users keep getting stuck in a redirect loop right after authenticating with google sso today. We never actually reach the dashboard on our pro app and it is very annoying. The error code shown is AUTH-SSO-302.1. Please fix this soon.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: API Key Scope Bypass Vulnerability
body: Dear support, we have discovered that a restricted API key with read-only file scopes is successfully executing user deletion requests, completely bypassing its permission boundaries. This is a severe security flaw affecting our environment. We urgently require this to be addressed immediately under error code API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS. Thank you for your prompt attention.
resolution: Revoke the compromised API key immediately in Admin Console > API Management. Investigate if the key was mistakenly generated with broader permissions initially or if there's an internal process misconfiguration. Acknowledge this is a critical security vulnerability and escalate to engineering if revocation does not resolve the issue or if the scope bypass persists.

subject: Okta SSO login failure after update
body: Dear support, our users with Okta SSO cannot log in and are receiving the Invalid SSO token format error code AUTH-SSO-401.1. This happened right after the recent v4.2 update and is critically impacting our revenue operations immediately. Thank you so much for your prompt attention.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content retrieval
body: I am beyond frustrated that our developers keep running into the API-500 error when calling the file content endpoint. This seems to happen randomly, but especially with larger files. We need this fixed promptly, as it is stopping our production team from accessing necessary project data.
resolution: We are working on a fix for this intermittent API-500 error related to distributed storage. In the meantime, please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client, which should resolve the immediate blocking behavior.

subject: Subscription renewal payment failed
body: My account is showing a payment failed status. I see error BILL-PAY-002 in the admin console. Could you help me get this back on track?
resolution: Please navigate to the Billing section within your Admin Console to update or refresh your payment method. Ensure your billing address is correct, then attempt to retry the payment via the Invoices tab.

subject: Cannot update Company Name in Settings
body: I am trying to correct our company name in the settings page, but the field is read-only. I encountered error CD-AM-010 when I tried to save the changes. Please advise on how to update this.
resolution: The 'Company Name' is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the 'Organization Name' there. This change will propagate to the Company Settings.

subject: Detailed user activity reports request
body: Hello team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. We are looking for more detailed reports on user activity, specifically regarding file downloads, views, and collaboration actions, which go beyond our current audit logs. Thank you so much for your assistance, take your time getting back to me.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting to help our analytics team.

subject: Lag while editing documents collaboratively
body: When multiple members of our team edit a CloudDesk Office document at the same time, we experience significant lag. There is a delay of several seconds between typing and seeing the updates appear for others. This is happening right now and displaying error code COLLAB_LAG. Please let us know how this can be addressed.
resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. Recommend that users close unnecessary browser tabs or applications to free up resources. Verify if the issue persists when fewer users are editing the document simultaneously, and have all affected users clear their browser cache.

subject: need more detailed reports on user activity please
body: Hello team, we are looking to get more detailed reports on user activity such as file downloads and views beyond what the current audit logs show. Many of our admins are asking for this information right now. Could you let us know when this might be available? Thanks for your help.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: App crash uploading large files
body: Hi. The mobile app crashes without an error message every time I try uploading files larger than 1GB. We have a major client demo at 5pm today and this is blocking our final prep. Please advise.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Cannot manage billing with SSO
body: Since the v4.2 update, I keep getting an AUTH-BILL-402 error whenever I try to update our payment method while logged in with SSO. Everything else works fine, but I cannot reach the billing section. It is a bit inconvenient for our finance team right now.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed the SSO token format, which can interfere with specific billing sessions. Please try logging out and logging back in using your direct email and password if available, or clear your browser cache. If the issue persists, please use a direct login for billing tasks while we investigate the SSO integration further.

subject: Slow load times on workspaces with many files
body: Hello support, when navigating to a workspace with over 10,000 files, the page takes an excessive amount of time to load and often displays a blank screen or a spinner for more than 30 seconds. Many customers are hitting this at the same moment right now. Whenever you have a chance to look into this, please let us know.
resolution: Thank you for reporting this performance behavior with large directories. Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace and advise users to utilize the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. We also suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones and verifying the browser console for any network errors.

subject: workspace invite emails not sending
body: when we invite new folks to the workspace the emails arent going through at all. error code EMAIL-005 keeps popping up and they just stay pending in the list. can someone please fix this soon.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Desktop files not syncing since v4.2 update
body: Since the update to version 4.2, my desktop files are no longer updating, even though everything looks correct on the web. I see error code SYNC-001 intermittently. We have a major audit this Friday, so I would really appreciate your prompt assistance to get this resolved.
resolution: It appears the update caused a cache conflict for many users. Please uninstall the current sync client and remove the local sync cache from your machine's AppData or Application Support folder. Once cleared, perform a fresh installation using the download link in your web app settings to restore full functionality.

subject: Requesting ability to customize SSO login page branding
body: Hello. I have been working with our IT department to streamline our workspace and noticed some things about the login page. We have been using your product for a while, and it is generally quite good, though I have been meaning to ask about branding options. Is it possible to upload our company logo and change the colors on the SSO login page? I think it would help our users feel more comfortable. Thanks for your time.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently supported in our platform. We understand this is a desired feature for a cohesive user experience, so please add your vote and requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding. We will notify you if this becomes available in the future.

subject: audit logs missing external user details for shares
body: our audit logs are showing anonymous access for external share links instead of capturing the actual external user info. we only see our internal creator. please advise.
resolution: By default, external share links are anonymous. To track external user activity, the share link must be configured with 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login'. This setting ensures the external user's identity is captured in the audit logs. This cannot be retroactively applied to existing anonymous links.

subject: Missing file access events in audit log search
body: I cannot find specific file views and downloads in the audit log search. The results are incomplete and it is quite frustrating.
resolution: Ensure correct filters are applied (User Email, Event Type 'File Access', 'File Share'). Note that 'View' events are only logged for public links or external shares, not internal workspace views. For internal views, check the file's individual activity feed.

subject: Admin Console Access Denied Error
body: Our finance director is currently trying to access the Admin Console to review some settings, but they are being redirected to the standard dashboard with an Access Denied message. There is no major rush on this as they can look later this week, but please look into it when you have a moment.
resolution: Confirm the user's role in the Admin Console ('Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Roles'). Ensure they have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned. If not, update their role.

subject: Billing section failing for SSO admins
body: I have been working with your API and webhooks for several months now to automate our internal provisioning, and I must say the platform is quite robust. Recently, I have been trying to update our payment method within the admin console. Since the v4.2 update, whenever I try to access the billing section while logged in via our SSO provider, I receive an AUTH-BILL-402 error. It seems isolated to this specific section.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: api stoped working after update v4.2
body: Hi our systems are showing error API-AUTH-401-V42 since the update. All our automated scripts are down and we need this fixed now for our enterprise operations. Please let us know how to fix this asap.
resolution: With the v4.2 release, the API token format was updated. You will need to regenerate all your API tokens from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console and update your applications to use these new credentials.

subject: Requesting video conferencing integration
body: We love using CloudDesk for our daily collaboration, but many teams here have been asking if we can directly integrate tools like Zoom or Google Meet into our workspaces. Thanks so much for your help with this important feature request that would really help streamline our day.
resolution: Currently, CloudDesk focuses on file sharing and project collaboration. While we don't have built-in video conferencing, you can easily share meeting links within comments. For a direct integration with specific video conferencing platforms, please submit your request and preferred tools at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing to help us assess demand for future partnerships.

subject: Unable to update company name in settings
body: Hello, thank you for your continued help. I attempted to change our Company Name in Admin Console > Company Settings, but the field appears to be read-only or changes are not saved, showing error code CD-AM-010. There is no urgency for this, but whenever you have a moment, please let me know how we can adjust this.
resolution: The 'Company Name' is tied directly to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details by navigating to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and updating the 'Organization Name' there, which will then propagate to the Company Settings.

subject: Failed to register MFA device on mobile app
body: Hello, we are completely blocked because users cannot set up Google Authenticator on the mobile app, receiving the error MFA-MOB-002 after scanning the QR code. We have a major company-wide audit on Friday and need this resolved immediately. Please help us fix this right away.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app under Settings, Security, and Multi-Factor Authentication. Once set up there, it will work seamlessly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Too many conflict files created by sync client
body: Hi, my desktop sync client keeps making duplicate files labeled as conflict, even when nobody else is editing them. It happens all the time now and clutters our folders. Let me know what can be done whenever you have time.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: missing login history entries in admin console
body: hi team we noticed some weird login locations in our company but when i check the audit log for login activity i only see successful logins and nothing else error code AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN is showing up could you please look into this quickly since security is a huge concern for us right now thanks
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses/locations are recorded in the 'Security Events' log, not 'Login Activity'. Navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events for this information. Enable 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic alerts.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: Hello, I am trying to pull the User Activity report from the admin console but it is showing no data at all. All other reports seem to load correctly. I am seeing a REPORT-001 error code on the page. Could you please assist?
resolution: This behavior is usually caused by a temporary data retrieval issue or cached browser data. Please clear your browser's cache and cookies, then try accessing the report again. If the issue remains, please try using a different browser or provide the specific date range you are attempting to view.

subject: webhook signature errors
body: our service is rejecting cloudesk webhooks with a hmac verification failed message. this is blocking our internal data sync and we need it fixed asap. getting error code webhook-sign-403 constantly.
resolution: Please verify that the secret token used by your receiving service is an exact match for the Webhook Secret found in your Admin Console. Additionally, ensure your verification logic is strictly using the HMAC-SHA256 algorithm as required by our platform.

subject: CANNOT LOG IN AFTER UPDATE! INVALID SSO TOKEN FORMAT!
body: After the v4.2 update, our users with Okta SSO CANNOT LOG IN AT ALL! They are all getting an 'Invalid SSO token format' error, specifically AUTH-SSO-401.1. This is absolutely critical for our operations; we have many users affected and work is grinding to a halt! What is going on?! We need this fixed IMMEDIATELY!
resolution: We understand this is causing significant disruption. The 'Invalid SSO token format' error is occurring because of a change in the SSO token format in v4.2. To resolve this, please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your Identity Provider (IdP) metadata. This should allow your Okta SSO users to log in successfully.

subject: Expired session issues on mobile
body: Since the update, our staff keeps getting logged out with CD-AM-011 and it is causing major disruption. We have a board presentation tomorrow and need the mobile app to be reliable. We would appreciate a prompt fix for these expired session errors.
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to session management for improved security. Users should fully log out of the mobile app, clear their app cache/data (if on Android) or reinstall the app (if on iOS), and then log back in. This will force a new, compatible session token.

subject: JIT provisioning failing for new SSO users
body: WHAT IS GOING ON?! New users logging in via SSO are NOT being automatically provisioned in CloudDesk, even though Just-in-Time Provisioning is fully enabled in our settings! Many customers are hitting this at the same moment right now and it is completely grinding our onboarding to a halt. Fix this right now!
resolution: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this provisioning issue has caused. Please verify that your SSO Identity Provider (IdP) is correctly sending the required user attributes like email, first_name, and last_name in the SAML/OIDC assertion. Additionally, ensure there are available seats in your CloudDesk subscription and check 'Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings' for any recent configuration changes or errors.

subject: User cannot log in after role change
body: We changed a user from Member to Guest and now they cannot log in to the web app. They get an error saying Account Suspended, and I see CD-AM-002 in our logs. Could you please help us resolve this promptly?
resolution: Guest users are restricted and only have access to specific shared workspaces they have been invited to. Please check the user's status in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm they have active invitations to those workspaces. If they require full access, you will need to switch their role back to 'Member'.

subject: Invited user stuck in pending status
body: One of our team members accepted their invitation link yesterday, but their status in the Admin Console is still stuck as Pending Invitation. They cannot access the workspace at all. Please help us get this sorted out.
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join or if there's a slight delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and password, or revoke and resend the invitation from the Admin Console.

subject: Billing section failing after SSO login in v4.2
body: Since upgrading to v4.2, our admin users logging in via SSO encounter a 'Payment Processing Error' specifically when trying to access the billing section to update payment methods, even though general admin features work fine. We need prompt help resolving this as it is blocking our finance operations.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Invalid Card Details error when adding payment method
body: Hello, I am trying to add a new credit card to our account as a payment method, but the admin console keeps returning an 'Invalid Card Details' error. We have verified that the card number, expiry date, and CVV are all completely correct. Please look into this when you have a moment so we can update our billing information.
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again after 30 minutes. If the issue persists, try using a different card or contact your bank to ensure there are no blocks on transactions with CloudDesk. You may also try contacting us with the full error message for further investigation.

subject: how to downgrade subscription plan errror bill plan 011
body: we need to downgrade our subscription plan because our team size shrunk. tried doing it in admin console and hit error BILL-PLAN-011. everyone is complaining about this same billing issue today. takes forever and very frustrating
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: need better notification controls
body: hi team, our notification settings seem way too broad right now. people are getting flooded with emails for every single comment instead of just direct mentions. can we get more granular control over this soon please
resolution: We hear your feedback regarding notification preferences. Currently, you can adjust general notification settings in your profile, but for more granular control, please outline your specific notification scenarios and preferences at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications to help us prioritize improvements.

subject: Critical: Subscription renewal payment failed
body: We received an alert about a BILL-PAY-002 error regarding our subscription renewal. If this isn't resolved today, we lose access to our account and projects. Please help us fix this payment issue immediately.
resolution: To resolve the payment failure, please log in to the Admin Console, go to Billing, and verify your payment method details. Once you have updated your card or ensured the billing information is accurate, you can manually trigger a retry of the payment from the Invoices section.

subject: Webhooks failing to deliver
body: Our webhooks are currently failing with the WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 error code. The logs indicate the connection is being refused by our endpoint. I need you to look into this at your convenience.
resolution: Please verify that your endpoint URL is correctly entered in the Admin Console. Ensure your service is publicly reachable and that your firewall is configured to allow incoming traffic from CloudDesk's IP range.

subject: api integration broken after v4.2
body: our api integration is completely down after the v4.2 update. we are getting api-auth-401-v42 and legacy_token_format errors. this is critical and blocking all production work.
resolution: With the v4.2 update, our API token format has been changed for security reasons. You will need to regenerate your API tokens within the API & Integrations section of your Admin Console. Please update your local applications to utilize these new tokens immediately to restore your connection.

subject: Sync client not updating
body: Our desktop sync is completely broken after the v4.2 update. Files are stuck and not syncing. This is blocking our finance team. We need this fixed now.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client and clear your local sync cache files. Once cleared, please reinstall the latest client from the 'Desktop Sync' section in your web app settings.

subject: Intermittent API 500 errors on file content
body: We are experiencing intermittent API-500 errors when hitting the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. This is blocking our integration deployment, which is a significant issue for our current development cycle. We need this resolved promptly to ensure our services remain functional. Could you please look into this?
resolution: The intermittent 500 errors you are seeing are likely related to distributed storage retrieval. We recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client as an immediate workaround. We are currently working on a permanent fix to be included in our next hotfix release.

subject: getting logged out constantly after update
body: ever since the v4.2 update our office staff keep getting kicked out of cloudesk with sso session expired messages. users have to keep signing back in all day long. please fix this soon
resolution: v4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta/Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration (e.g., 8-24 hours) to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: desktop app CPU usage is way too high
body: fix this fast the desktop sync client is taking over 50 percent cpu and freezing our machines even when nothing is syncing. tons of users are dealing with this terrible perf-dsk-001 lag right now. please help us sort it out soon.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After reset, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: okta sso login error
body: users getting user attribute mismatch errors after redirect from okta. seeing sso-okta-403 when trying to access the web app. we are blocked right now so could you look into this fast.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, please verify that the 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to our profile fields. Ensure that the 'email' attribute is selected as the unique identifier for the user.

subject: cant download old invoices error BILL-INV-003
body: Hi team, im trying to pull records for last year in the admin console and keep getting billing error BILL-INV-003. Why cant I view or download invoices older than 12 months here? This is ridiculous.
resolution: The Admin Console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months. For older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you are looking for, and we will retrieve it for you from our archives.

subject: mfa setup fails on mobile
body: scanning qr code for mfa gives failed to register device error. please help when u can.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Workspace loading forever or blank screen
body: Hi support when we open our main workspace with lots of files it just spins forever or shows a blank page. We get a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error sometimes. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: OAuth 2.0 apps failing with client_secret_mismatch
body: Our engineering team cannot get our custom OAuth 2.0 integrations to generate access tokens, and they keep throwing an OAUTH-AUTH-401 error. This is completely halting our internal workflow automation and needs your prompt attention today. Please advise on how to resolve this mismatch.
resolution: Verify that the 'Client ID' and 'Client Secret' used in your custom application exactly match the credentials generated in the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'API & Integrations' -> 'OAuth Clients'. Pay close attention to case sensitivity and any extra spaces.

subject: Desktop client failing to sync files
body: Since the v4.2 update, our desktop sync client is failing to reflect changes made in the web app. We are seeing error code SYNC-001 intermittently. Everything looks fine on the web and mobile, so it is definitely a client-side issue. Please advise on how to get this syncing again.
resolution: Please uninstall your current v4.2 desktop sync client and clear the local cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk on Windows or the equivalent library folder on macOS. Once cleared, please perform a fresh reinstall using the download link found in your web app's Settings menu.

subject: Sync client login failing after password change
body: I recently updated my password via the website, but now the desktop sync client is rejecting my credentials. It keeps showing the error CD-AM-015 and will not sync my local files. It is very frustrating to have to manually upload everything.
resolution: Since you updated your password, your desktop client needs to be re-authenticated to establish a new session. Please go to the CloudDesk icon in your system tray, select Log Out, and then log back in using your new credentials.

subject: Newly invited user getting user not found error
body: Hello support team. We recently invited a new member to our workspace, but upon trying to log in with their email and password, they are greeted with an unexpected error message. Thank you for your time in looking into this whenever you have a moment.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If the status is still pending, try resending the invitation. Also, ensure they are logging into the correct instance URL if your company operates multiple accounts.

subject: Issue transferring workspace ownership
body: Hi, I am attempting to transfer ownership of a workspace to a teammate, but the option is greyed out. I received the error CD-AM-004. Could you please advise on the correct procedure for this? I want to ensure we have the right owner set by the end of the week.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to a user who is already a member of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient has been added to the workspace first. Once they are a member, you can navigate to Admin Console > Workspaces > Settings > Transfer Ownership to complete the process.

subject: Subscription renewal failed due to declined card
body: Hello, our automatic subscription renewal just failed with code BILL-PAY-002, and we see a payment failed warning in the billing section of our admin console. This is blocking our team's access to key project workspaces today. Please assist us in updating our payment method so we can resume normal work promptly.
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: uploads failing for large files
body: i cant get any of my large files to upload it just stalls and then i get error UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_504. its taking forever and then just fails. can someone look at this.
resolution: I apologize for the frustration with your uploads. For files over 500MB, we highly recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client, as it supports resumable transfers that are much more reliable than the web browser. Please also verify your network stability and try a wired connection if possible.

subject: Incorrect VAT rate applied to our invoice
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a great week. We noticed that the tax rate on our latest invoice does not match our current business location and registered tax status. Could you please take a look at this when you have a moment? We appreciate your help in getting our billing details corrected.
resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID (if applicable) under 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information'. If these details are correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate (if applicable) for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: Mobile app file preview loading failure
body: Hello, I wanted to report that document previews in the mobile app are taking extremely long to load or failing completely. It is not urgent since I can view them on my desktop, but it would be nice to have it working when traveling. We are on the pro plan. Thanks.
resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version and check your device storage and network connection. Try clearing the mobile app cache via your device settings. For very large files, we suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content endpoint
body: Hi there, our devs are seeing some 500 errors when calling the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. It seems to happen mostly with files in other regions, which is a bit weird. This is blocking our integration work, so any help would be appreciated. We see API-500 pop up quite often. Thanks for looking into this!
resolution: We are currently investigating a root cause related to distributed storage retrieval. In the meantime, please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client, which should resolve these intermittent errors until our hotfix is deployed.

subject: user activity report is completely blank
body: report-001 showing up when opening user activity report in admin console. page loads with no data at all.
resolution: this typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again, or try a different browser if the problem persists.

subject: account locked error on login

resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions, please contact our sales team at sales@cloudesk.com. They can discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal for annual invoicing.

Due to these shifts, we need to reduce our current plan level, as we are seeing billing code BILL-PLAN-011 and need to align our costs. Could you assist with the process?
resolution: To downgrade your subscription, please navigate to Admin Console > Billing > Subscription Details and select Change Plan. Please note that the transition will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid any service disruptions. We do not provide prorated refunds for the remaining time on higher-tier plans.

subject: Okta SSO login failing
body: Hello, we are seeing Invalid SSO token format errors since the last update. Could you please help us get this sorted out? Thanks for your time.
resolution: This is likely due to the SSO token format change in v4.2. Please update your SSO configuration in the Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata, which should restore normal access for your users.

subject: Desktop Sync client stuck on 'Connecting'
body: Our Desktop Sync client is showing 'Connecting' indefinitely. Files are not syncing in either direction. There are no error messages in the client interface. We need this resolved promptly as it's blocking our file access.
resolution: Please try restarting your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the 'Connecting' status persists, navigate to 'Settings' > 'Advanced' within the client and select 'Clear Cache'. If the problem remains after these steps, a full reinstallation of the client may be necessary after backing up any locally unsynced files.

subject: Billing authentication failed error after v4.2 update
body: Since updating to version 4.2, our admin users are encountering a Payment Processing Error in the billing section when logging in through SSO. Other admin functions work fine, but viewing invoices is currently impossible. Please look into this authentication issue.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Audit log retention period limit
body: Hello, I am trying to set our audit log retention period in the Admin Console to 5 years for our company compliance requirements. However, the maximum selectable value only goes up to 12 months with the error code AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT. Please let me know how we can extend this.
resolution: Hello! The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For your longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution such as Splunk or Sumo Logic via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. Let us know if you need any guidance setting that up.

subject: Critical API 500 Errors on File Content Endpoint
body: We are getting constant API-500 errors on GET /files/{id}/content right before our major client demo at 3 PM today. This is completely breaking our integration and affecting all our active users. We need this resolved immediately because revenue and deliverables are directly on the line.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: System is very slow and lagging
body: I have been sitting here waiting for files to load all morning, and my coffee is long gone, but things are still spinning. It is quite a shame because the office has been so busy lately, especially with the new printer install, but the app seems to just be stuck. Our team is really struggling with the integration latency, seeing API_RESPONSE_SLOW constantly. Can you please look into why the API is dragging behind today?
resolution: To investigate this performance issue, please provide specific examples of the API calls you are making, including the endpoints, request bodies, and timestamps. We recommend optimizing your calls by utilizing pagination and filtering parameters to reduce the volume of data retrieved. We can also look into caching frequently accessed data on your end while our engineering team reviews your logs.

subject: Issues with new REST API integration
body: Hello, we are currently setting up a new internal integration using the CloudDesk REST API. Unfortunately, all our requests are failing with a 403 Forbidden error despite us using a valid API key. We are seeing the error code API-AUTH-403.5 in our logs. We would appreciate any guidance you can provide to get this resolved.
resolution: It appears the API key requires specific permissions to access these endpoints. Please have your administrator check the Admin Console under 'API Keys' and ensure the correct scopes are assigned to your key. Once the permissions are updated, your integration should be able to authenticate successfully.

subject: Delayed or missing push notifications on mobile
body: Our team has noticed that notifications for comments and file changes are not arriving on time. We are seeing the MOBILE_NOTIFICATION_DELAY status frequently. It makes it very difficult to stay updated on project progress while away from our desks.
resolution: Please confirm that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and your device's system settings. Additionally, check if your device has battery optimization enabled, as this can restrict background activity. Reinstalling the app often clears up these delivery issues.

subject: user delete pending forever
body: started a user data deletion request from the admin console and its been stuck in pending for over 48 hours now. absolutely no confirmation email either. getting error USER_DELETE_PENDING. fix this whenever.
resolution: Verify the user's status is 'Inactive' before requesting deletion. If the user is active, the deletion will be queued. If inactive and still pending, check System Status page for background job processing issues. If no issues, provide the user's email and deletion request ID for investigation.

subject: User locked out after role change
body: This is ridiculous. We changed one of our user's roles from Member to Guest, and now they cannot log in to the web application at all. They are seeing an Account Suspended error code CD-AM-002 and it is completely blocking their work today. We need this fixed immediately.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Need more granular folder permissions
body: This is extremely frustrating. Our team requires view-only access with commenting enabled for specific sub-folders, but your system does not allow this. We are blocked on this project until we can restrict user capabilities more effectively. Can you provide a solution immediately?
resolution: We understand that your current workflow is blocked. Our permissions are currently set at the root folder level, but we would love your input on this. Please share your detailed requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions so we can improve this for you.

subject: API calls returning 404 Not Found
body: I'm so frustrated! I'm trying to use your API to get files from a folder, but every time I call /folders/{id}/files, it just says 404 Not Found. The ID is definitely correct, I've double-checked it. What's going on? I need this fixed soon.
resolution: Please verify the API endpoint path and HTTP method against the latest CloudDesk API documentation. Additionally, ensure that the resource ID (e.g., folder ID) you are using is valid and that your API token has the necessary permissions to access it.

subject: Need PDF invoice format through API
body: Hello support team, I am working on our API integration and noticed that pulling billing records only yields CSV files. Our accounting department strictly requires PDF formats for our records. Is there a parameter we are missing to pull PDFs instead?
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: sso login broken after update
body: hi we are having a major issue with logging into clouddesk today using our sso since the update. it just spins forever and times out or gives me error code SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2. we have a big executive demo at 5pm today and nobody can access the shared files. please help urgently.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token format, which is likely causing this delay. Please go to your Admin Console and re-save your SSO configuration to force a regeneration of your internal certificates. If the problem continues, please clear your browser cache and cookies, as that often helps refresh the session.

subject: User list taking forever to load
body: Every time I go to the Users and Groups page in the admin console, it just hangs there for several minutes before loading anything. My team is getting annoyed with the ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT error that pops up regularly now. I know we have a lot of users, but it never used to take this long. Is there any way to make this run faster?
resolution: For larger organizations, we recommend using the search bar or applying specific filters like Status: Active as soon as you load the page to reduce the initial dataset. The system is optimized for these filtered views. If you are looking for a specific person, navigating directly to them via the search bar is the most efficient method.

subject: Workspace invitation emails not being received
body: New team members are not getting our workspace invitation emails, though they show as pending. We checked our spam filters, but nothing is there. We would be grateful for any guidance you can provide.
resolution: Please ensure your domain's SPF and DKIM records are correctly configured to permit emails from our sending domains. You can find the specific DNS entries needed in our troubleshooting guide within the Admin Console. Let me know if you need me to manually investigate specific addresses.

subject: JIT provisioning not working
body: hi, we have JIT provisioning enabled but new users are not being created automatically. we are getting error CD-AM-009. this is blocking our new hires from getting started, so could you please help us fix this?
resolution: Please verify that your Identity Provider is correctly sending the required user attributes like email and name in the assertion. You should also double-check that you have enough available seats in your subscription. Finally, please review your Admin Console under Security and SSO settings to ensure no configurations were modified recently.

subject: Workspace loading times are extremely slow on large folders
body: When navigating to our main workspace with more than 10000 items, the page takes an excessive amount of time to load and often displays a blank screen. We keep getting a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error when trying to access our PRO workspace files. Could you please look into why this is happening?
resolution: Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace and advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. We suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones to avoid performance issues. Please also verify your browser console for any network errors.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed
body: We have some users from specific domains which cannot log in via Google SSO. Other domains work, but these particular ones are getting a 'Domain not allowed' error, or just failing. This is making difficult for some of our team members. We need this resolved. The error code is SSO-GOOGLE-403.
resolution: We understand this is causing difficulty for your team. The 'Domain not allowed' error, often seen as SSO-GOOGLE-403, typically means that specific domains haven't been added to your permitted list. Please have an administrator log into the CloudDesk Admin Console and navigate to the 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO. From there, check the 'Allowed Domains' list and ensure that all the domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO are included.

subject: Unrecognized charge on billing statement
body: I am reviewing our account and found a charge from CloudDesk that we cannot reconcile. I see BILL-CHG-010 listed on the statement. Could you please clarify this charge for us?
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, the date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. Once we have this information, we will cross-reference it with your account's billing history and provide you with a detailed breakdown.

subject: API returning 503 errors during peak hours
body: Multiple API endpoints are returning HTTP 503 errors during peak hours while we run our automated scripts and high volume requests. This is affecting our operations severely and we need immediate assistance to restore normal functionality.
resolution: Investigate the customer's API usage patterns to identify if they are exceeding rate limits (check 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header). Advise implementing exponential backoff for retries. Confirm if there are any ongoing platform incidents via the CloudDesk status page. Escalate to engineering if rate limits are not being hit.

subject: invoice user count incorrect
body: hi there, the latest invoice shows a user count that doesnt match our actual active users. it says bill-inv-001. can you please look into this right away as it is holding up our payment processing.
resolution: Please double-check the proration details on your invoice, as changes are often applied at the start of a new cycle. If the count still seems incorrect after verifying your active user list, please send me your invoice ID for a manual audit.

subject: API tokens broken after 4.2 upgrade! URGENT!
body: What in the world happened with the v4.2 upgrade?! All our existing API tokens are suddenly returning 401 Unauthorized errors with 'legacy_token_format'. This is absolutely CRITICAL! Our integrations are down, and it's impacting a huge part of our operations! We need an immediate fix for error API-AUTH-401-V42!
resolution: With the v4.2 release, the API token format was updated for enhanced security. To resolve this, you must regenerate all your API tokens. Please navigate to the 'API & Integrations' section in your Admin Console to generate new tokens and update your applications accordingly. This will restore functionality to your integrations.

subject: API access failing after v4.2 update
body: Since the update, all our API calls are failing with a 401 Unauthorized error. Every single request is returning API-AUTH-401-V42. This is a critical issue that is breaking our entire production integration and we need an immediate fix.
resolution: With the release of version 4.2, the API token format was updated for security reasons. You must navigate to the API & Integrations section of the Admin Console and regenerate your tokens. Please update your applications with these new credentials to restore connectivity.

subject: heavy lag when multiple people edit documents
body: hey when we have like 4 people typing in the cloudesk office doc at the same time there is a huge lag of several seconds before anyone sees the changes. cursor positions are super slow too and error COLLAB_LAG pops up. no rush on this since we are done with today writing but please fix it by next week.
resolution: Hello. This behavior is typically linked to network latency for the collaborators involved. Please ensure all participating users have a stable internet connection and recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs or background applications. If the problem continues, clear your browser cache and check if performance improves with fewer simultaneous editors.

subject: Slow workspace loading for large directories
body: Hello, I hope you are having a wonderful day. We have noticed that workspaces with over 10,000 files are triggering a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT, often leaving the screen blank for quite a while. We aren't in a hurry to fix this, but wanted to bring it to your attention as it seems to be happening to everyone here. Thank you for your help.
resolution: When working with very large file counts, we recommend using our search and filtering tools to narrow down the displayed items. Additionally, breaking larger workspaces into smaller, more specific ones will improve performance. Please check your browser console for any persistent network errors if the issue continues.

subject: mfa code failing on mobile app
body: my google authenticator code is not being accepted by the mobile app and i keep getting auth-mfa-401.2. we have an important client demo at 5pm today and i cannot access my workspace files. please help me fix this right now.
resolution: Please ensure your phone's clock is synchronized automatically with network time. If the problem continues, you can re-set up MFA for your account through the web app's Security Settings page.

subject: INCORRECT ROLE DISPLAY IN CONSOLE!
body: I am looking at my admin dashboard and the roles are all wrong! It says some people are contributors when they are actually managers. This is very confusing and needs to be addressed!
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and does not affect actual permissions. You can temporarily correct the display by toggling the user's role to something else and back again. We are working on a permanent fix for the next patch.

subject: Files not syncing in desktop client after v4.2 update
body: hi there, ever since updating to v4.2, files added in the web app are not appearing in the desktop sync client. there are no error messages shown anywhere. we need this fixed promptly as it is blocking our team collaboration.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk (Windows) or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk (macOS). Reinstall the client from the download link in your web app's 'Settings' -> 'Desktop Sync' section.

subject: Critical issue with SSO login
body: Hi, we are having a realy big problem with our Okta login. All of our staff are getting an 'Invalid SSO token format' error and we have a major client demo at 5pm today. We need this fixed asap because we cannot access any files. Please let me know how to fix this error AUTH-SSO-401.1.
resolution: The v4.2 update includes a new SSO token format, which requires a quick update to your configuration. Please log in to the CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata file to refresh your settings. This should resolve the login errors for your team immediately.

subject: mobile notifications are very late
body: hey, the push notifications on my phone are coming in super late or not at all until i open the app. its causing us to miss updates. can you look into this, mobile_notification_delay is what i see.
resolution: Please check your device's operating system settings to ensure battery optimization is not restricting our app's background activity. You should also verify that notifications are properly enabled within the CloudDesk mobile settings. If the issue persists, please try reinstalling the app.

subject: Okta SSO login failure after recent update
body: As I was reviewing our monthly software expenditures and trying to access our accounting workspace this morning, I noticed our team cannot log in. We use Okta for authentication, and users are getting an Invalid SSO token format error with code AUTH-SSO-401.1. This started happening right after the v4.2 update rolled out. Since we need to process our invoices today, could you please look into this promptly?
resolution: We apologize for the inconvenience. Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata, which is required due to a change in the SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Web app files not showing in desktop client
body: Files added or modified in the web app are not appearing in our desktop sync client after updating to v4.2. No error messages appear, and everything looks correct in the web app. This is blocking our daily work and we need prompt help.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at the user's AppData folder on Windows or Application Support on macOS. Afterward, reinstall the client using the download link found in your web app's Desktop Sync settings section.

subject: Desktop client not syncing files after update
body: I am reaching out regarding a very pressing issue where files added or modified in the web application are completely failing to appear or update in our desktop sync client, which was just updated to version 4.2. Interestingly, there are no error messages displayed anywhere in the client interface, and the files appear correctly when checked in both the web app and mobile app. We have a major executive board presentation relying on these synchronized files at 3:00 PM today, so we urgently need a fix for this sync failure.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk on Windows or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk on macOS. Once cleared, reinstall the client from the download link found in your web app's Settings -> Desktop Sync section.

subject: Redirect loop when trying to login with Google
body: Hello, I am writing because I am having trouble accessing my dashboard today. I go to the login page, select Google, it verifies me, and then it just bounces back and forth in a loop. I have tried waiting, I even grabbed some coffee, but it never reaches the dashboard. AUTH-SSO-302.1 keeps appearing in my browser console. Can you please help me get in?
resolution: This redirect loop is often caused by stale browser authentication data. Please clear your browser's cache and cookies specifically for 'cloudesk.com'. If that does not work, try using an incognito window, which will help us determine if a browser extension is interfering with the SSO handshake.

subject: Login failing for all users with Azure AD
body: Hello, our team is getting a user profile incomplete error when trying to log in via Azure AD. Nobody can get into the portal right now, which is causing a backup in our workflow. It says AUTH-SSO-403.2. Please let us know how to fix this.
resolution: Please have your Azure AD administrator verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped in the enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. You can find detailed steps in our Azure AD SSO configuration guide linked on our help page.

subject: API 404 Not Found on valid folder endpoint
body: Our API calls to folders files are returning 404 Not Found even though the ID is completely correct. This is blocking our development team right now. Please look into why this resource is missing.
resolution: Verify the API endpoint path and HTTP method against the latest CloudDesk API documentation. Ensure the resource ID is valid and accessible to the API token's permissions.

subject: Slow workspace loading times with large file counts
body: Hello team, we have been using our pro workspace extensively and noticed that folders with over 10,000 items take forever to load. Sometimes it just shows a blank screen for more than thirty seconds. We love using CloudDesk and appreciate any advice you have on this.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: User Activity report is totally blank
body: Hi team, im trying to pull the User Activity report on our pro plan admin console and its just showing a blank page report-001 error keeps popping up. This is happening right now and really blocking my workflow as a developer integrating the api. Can you check whats going on.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, please provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: New members not getting invite emails
body: I have been inviting new staff to our workspace but they never get the email. The status just sits at pending and I dont see any bounce messages. Is there something I am missing? Thanks for your support.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. Ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains by checking our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Password reset email not received
body: One of our team members requested a password reset through the login page today, but the email never arrived in their inbox or spam. We are seeing error CD-AM-008 and need this resolved promptly as it is blocking their work.
resolution: First, confirm the user's email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Advise the user to check their spam/junk folders. If still not found, ask them to whitelist 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for them via 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password'.

subject: Wrong user names showing on file action logs
body: I noticed that recent file edits and moves in our workspace activity log are showing the wrong names. It keeps attributing regular employee actions to our main administrator instead. We need this corrected for our records.
resolution: This is a known display glitch that typically affects actions performed by users with Contributor roles when an admin is active in the same workspace. Be assured the underlying audit trail is correct, and you can cross-reference the global admin console audit log for accuracy while we work on a fix.

subject: Requesting support for hardware MFA tokens
body: Our security department is currently auditing our tools and has requested that we enable hardware-based MFA tokens like YubiKey. Does CloudDesk have a timeline for supporting these devices in the admin console? We would like to implement this as soon as possible.
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification, but we recognize the importance of hardware token support. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize new security features based on customer demand.

subject: Public sharing link expiration limits are too short
body: Hello, why on earth cant we make public links never expire?? The current limit is ridiculous and keeps breaking our external client portals. We need permanent sharing options ASAP.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Desktop Sync client stuck on indexing
body: Our desktop application is stuck on indexing and none of our files are syncing. This is a critical issue as we cannot share documents. Please let us know how to fix this sync status.
resolution: Please start by restarting your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the application continues to hang, try clearing your application cache under Settings > Advanced. If the problem remains, a clean reinstall of the client should resolve the indexing issue.

subject: user activity report page is totally blank
body: why is the user activity report completely empty when i open it in the admin console. REPORT-001 is showing up and i need to see this data soon for our weekly review
resolution: This behavior typically indicates a temporary data retrieval glitch. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempt to access the report page again. If the problem persists, please try a different browser or let us know the exact date range you are trying to view.

subject: Need to add PO number to invoices
body: I need to add a purchase order number for our future billing statements. Where can I update this in the system?
resolution: You can update your billing details by navigating to the Admin Console, then selecting Billing, and updating the Purchase Order Number field. Please note that this will apply to all future invoices, but cannot be applied to invoices that have already been generated.

subject: granular notification controls request
body: hey team, we love the platform but the current notification options are way too broad. we want to stop getting alerts for every single comment and only get notified for mentions. hope you can look into adding this soon, thanks.
resolution: We hear your feedback regarding notification preferences. Currently, you can adjust general notification settings in your profile. For more granular control, please outline your specific notification scenarios and preferences at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications. This helps us prioritize improvements.

subject: Need more detailed user activity reports
body: We are currently unable to track specific file downloads and views with the standard audit logs. Do you have a plan to provide more granular user activity reporting? We need this for our compliance tracking.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced reporting, and while our audit logs provide basic tracking, we are looking for feedback on advanced features. Please share your specific requirements and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting.

subject: Cannot add users to team
body: System says seat limit reached when trying to add members. Subscription page shows seats are available. Error CD-AM-001. Please fix.
resolution: Please navigate to the Pending Invitations section in the Admin Console. You likely have old invitations that are consuming your available seats. Revoking these pending invites will free up the capacity for your new team members.

subject: Missing files in web app search results
body: Hello, I am getting very frustrated with the web app because searching for exact keywords in folder names and documents is not showing files that I know definitely exist. SEARCH-002 or whatever is going on is missing important documents right in my workspace. Please fix this search problem soon.
resolution: This can sometimes be due to an outdated search index. Please try performing a more specific search, such as using exact phrases in quotes. If the issue persists, log out and log back in to trigger a re-indexing for your account, and provide specific search terms if still unresolved.

subject: Delayed updates during simultaneous document editing
body: Hello, our team has noticed a noticeable lag of several seconds between typing and seeing changes reflected when multiple users edit a CloudDesk Office document simultaneously. Cursor positions also update quite slowly. We would appreciate it if this could be looked into when convenient.
resolution: Please check network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure that all users maintain a stable internet connection. We recommend closing unnecessary browser applications and checking if the issue improves when fewer users edit the document concurrently. Additionally, clearing your browser cache can help improve synchronization.

subject: assigned tickets not showing up for agents
body: hey team, im integrating the api and hitting error helpdesk-007 right now. when a helpdesk ticket is assigned to an agent, they cannot see it in their my assigned tickets view in the web app. it works fine for admins though. please help us out asap since this is blocking our work.
resolution: this is often a caching issue with agent permissions. advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into clouddesk. if that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: user activity report is blank
body: the user activity report is not showing any data at all when i try to run it. i have an important audit on friday and need this data by then. this report-001 error is very frustrating because i need to verify usage now.
resolution: This issue is often caused by a temporary data retrieval conflict in the browser. Please try clearing your cache and cookies, or attempt to view the report in a different browser. If the page remains blank, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to view so we can investigate further.

subject: Unable to update our company name in the admin console settings
body: Hi there, I hope this message finds you well. I was recently reviewing our account details and noticed that our company name has a slight typo from when we first set it up last year, so I went into the Admin Console under Company Settings to fix it, but I noticed the field appears to be completely read-only and any changes I try to make are not being saved, which is slightly inconvenient as we prepare our documents, though it is not causing an immediate outage for our team.
resolution: Hello. The 'Company Name' field is tied directly to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details by navigating to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and updating the 'Organization Name' there, which will automatically propagate the change to your Company Settings.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card
body: Hello, thank you for your help. I noticed an unexpected charge on our credit card statement and I am unable to reconcile it with our billing records. Could you please assist me in identifying this transaction?
resolution: I would be happy to look into this for you. Please reply with the exact amount, the date of the charge, and the last four digits of the card used so we can cross-reference it with your account.

subject: Okta SSO attribute mismatch errors
body: MY USERS ARE LOCKED OUT AGAIN. We are getting 'User attribute mismatch' errors after Okta redirects us to the login page. This is blocking our entire team and we have a payroll run tomorrow morning! How could you let this happen? Fix it immediately!
resolution: This error occurs when the data being sent from Okta does not map correctly to the required fields in our system. Please check your Okta application settings for CloudDesk and ensure the 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped. Specifically, confirm that 'email' is designated as the unique identifier.

subject: Slow download speeds from public links
body: We are consistently seeing very poor download speeds when our team members access files shared via public links or workspace folders. It makes collaboration nearly impossible when a simple document takes ten minutes to download. We are seeing error DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW frequently. Can you please check if there is an issue with the file servers?
resolution: I understand the frustration caused by slow download speeds. Please test your connection using a different browser or network to rule out local interference, or consider using our Desktop Sync client for more robust transfers. If the problem persists, please let us know so we can investigate the specific server region associated with your workspace.

subject: update po number for invoices
body: Hi, i need to add a new purchase order number to our upcoming invoices. the system is throwing BILL-PO-008. no rush on this, just whenever you have a moment.
resolution: You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: API requests failing with 401 Unauthorized
