subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Our users are not getting password reset emails, and I see code AUTH-PR-200.1. We have checked spam folders and nothing is there. We have an audit on Friday and need this fixed now.
resolution: Please verify that the user's email address is correct in the Admin Console and check if your domain has an approved sender list. If so, ensure that 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' is added to your allowlist to prevent delivery issues. I can also manually trigger a password reset for the user from our end if you provide their email address.

subject: Okta sso broken after 4.2 update
body: ever since the v4.2 update this morning, nobody can log in through okta sso anymore. it keeps redirecting back to the login screen and showing AUTH-402. this is completely blocking our entire team from working today and we need someone to fix it right away.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console by ensuring the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values provided in our configuration guide.

subject: admin users list takes forever to load
body: hey support the admin console is taking like 10 minutes just to load our user list and search is totally frozen. getting ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT errors constantly. no huge rush since we can wait but please look into it.
resolution: Hello. We recommend using the search bar or applying specific filters such as status active immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset size. The system is heavily optimized for filtered views when handling very large corporate datasets.

subject: need better reports for user activity
body: we need more detail on file downloads and user actions than what the current logs show. is there a way to get a more granular report for our admins? thanks.
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding the need for more detailed activity reports. Since our current logs are limited, please add your specific requirements and use cases to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will allow our engineering team to better understand your needs.

subject: Cannot export audit logs for longer than 90 days
body: I am trying to pull our audit logs for the last six months for our quarterly compliance check. Every time I hit export, the system stops and tells me I have hit an export range limit exceeded (90 days maximum) error. This is incredibly frustrating because I have work to finish and this limitation is preventing me from doing my job. Please fix this immediately so I can download my data! I really do not have time for these system bottlenecks.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is currently limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use our API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script to retrieve the data. Alternatively, if your team does not have API access, please let me know and I can arrange for a manual data pull.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing for new file uploads
body: Hello support team. A Zap configured with a CloudDesk trigger is currently not firing when files are uploaded on our PRO plan. Error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 is present. No rush on this, whenever you have time.
resolution: In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access monitored events, and check our audit logs for the expected event.

subject: Invoice user count is wrong, BILL-INV-001
body: My invoice BILL-INV-001 shows wrong number of users. It does not match my current CloudDesk active users list. Please correct this.
resolution: Please verify the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' listed on your invoice. User count discrepancies are often due to when changes are processed within the billing cycle. If the totals remain incorrect after your review, please send us the invoice ID and your current active user count for manual verification.

subject: Invalid SSO Token error after v4.2 update
body: Hello, since updating to v4.2, our users attempting to log in via SSO using Azure AD receive an 'Invalid SSO Token' error. We noticed that direct email and password login works fine, but this issue affects all SSO-enabled tenants across our organization. Could you please provide assistance with this urgent authentication blocker?
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Admins must re-configure their SSO integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Refer to the v4.2 release notes for detailed steps.

subject: User role change causing login failure and permission errors
body: Dear support, we recently adjusted one of our team member roles, and now they encounter an account suspended message when trying to use the web app. Could you please assist us in resolving this access block promptly?
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Workspace loading times are extremely slow
body: Workspaces with many files are timing out with WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT. It takes over 30 seconds to load. We can wait for a fix, but please let us know when it is addressed.
resolution: Large workspaces with over 10,000 files can impact load times significantly. We recommend using our search and filter tools to manage your view, or splitting the workspace into smaller, distinct folders. Please also check your browser console for any specific network performance errors.

subject: Desktop sync client not updating files
body: After the latest update to v4.2, my desktop sync client is no longer reflecting changes made in the web app. There are no error messages visible, but the files are definitely not syncing. Could you help me troubleshoot this?
resolution: This behavior often occurs after an update and can be resolved by a clean reinstall. Please uninstall the CloudDesk client, delete the local sync cache folder in your AppData or Library directory, and then reinstall using the latest version from your web app settings. This will force a fresh sync of your files.

subject: Request for longer public sharing link expiration
body: Our enterprise team requires the ability to set public sharing links to never expire or to have a significantly longer duration than the current maximum. This will streamline our external document sharing workflows. Please advise if this configuration is possible on our plan.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we do not plan to offer a never expire option, we can consider extending the maximum duration based on customer feedback. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration, and for permanent sharing in the meantime, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Password reset emails not arriving for users
body: Our users are attempting to reset their passwords via the login page, but the reset email with error code CD-AM-008 is not arriving in any inboxes or spam folders. This issue is severely impacting our workflow as many customers are hitting this at the same moment right now. We urgently need this email delivery pipeline restored.
resolution: First, confirm the user's email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Advise the user to check their spam/junk folders. If still not found, ask them to whitelist 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for them via 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password'.

subject: Zapier triggers not firing correctly
body: My Zapier integration is completely broken and my team is losing data because the New File Uploaded trigger is not firing! This is unacceptable and needs to be resolved immediately. I keep seeing ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 whenever I try to look at the logs.
resolution: To fix this, please re-test the trigger step inside your Zapier dashboard to refresh the connection to your account. Please also verify that the CloudDesk account linked to Zapier has the correct permissions to access the files you are monitoring.

subject: New user login failing with user not found
body: We invited a new team member today and they are unable to log in using their email and password. They are receiving the AUTH-NF-404.1 error message when attempting access.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console to confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If the status is pending, please resend the invitation and ensure they are using the correct company instance URL.

subject: Blank User Activity report page
body: Why is the User Activity report completely blank today?! We are facing code REPORT-001 and I have a major client audit on Friday morning, so I need this fixed immediately. Many of our team members are experiencing this exact issue right now and we cannot pull our compliance metrics.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering, and please provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: API stopped working after update
body: Our internal integration is totaly broken today. We are getting API-AUTH-401-V42 errors everywhere, and its blocking our teams progress. I really need to get this sorted out fast because everything was working fine yesterday before the 4.2 update.
resolution: With the v4.2 release, the API token format was updated to improve security. You must regenerate all your existing API tokens from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new tokens to restore connectivity.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Hi team, our new file uploaded zap is not triggering today. We have a major client demo at 5pm today and need this workflow running. Error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 is showing up in our logs. Thanks for looking into this.
resolution: In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. Check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: Delayed push notifications on mobile devices
body: Hello support team, we have noticed that push notifications for comments and file changes on the mobile app are arriving several minutes late or not appearing until the app is actively opened. We would appreciate your assistance in resolving this notification delay. Thank you.
resolution: Verify that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and the device's operating system settings. Check for any battery optimization settings on the device that might be restricting background app activity. Advise reinstalling the mobile app.

subject: session expiring immediately
body: every time i log in i get immediately logged out. it says 'session expired' or i can't even get past the dashboard before it boots me. this is super annoying and slows things down. auth-session-401.5. what's going on
resolution: Apologies for the inconvenience this is causing. This issue often relates to browser settings or local data. Please try clearing your browser's cookies and local storage specifically for 'cloudesk.com'. Also, check if you have any strict privacy settings or browser extensions that might be interfering with session cookies. Lastly, verifying your device's system time is accurate can sometimes resolve session issues.

subject: Document collaboration latency issues
body: Hi there, we have been experiencing COLLAB_LAG while working on documents together in the web app. It makes it quite difficult to coordinate edits in real time. Thank you for your assistance with this.
resolution: We apologize for the frustration. Please check that all collaborators have a stable connection and try closing any unnecessary browser tabs. Verifying the issue with fewer active editors can also help us narrow down the cause.

subject: Desktop Sync client stuck on indexing
body: MY DESKTOP SYNC ICON HAS BEEN STUCK ON INDEXING ALL MORNING! NO FILES ARE SYNCING AT ALL AND I SEE THE SYNC_STATUS_STUCK ERROR. WE HAVE A CRITICAL CLIENT DEMO AT 5 PM TODAY AND NEED THIS RESOLVED NOW. PLEASE HELP!
resolution: Please restart the Desktop Sync client immediately. If the status remains stuck, go to Settings, then Advanced, and clear the application cache. If that fails to clear the status, we recommend performing a full reinstall of the client after backing up your local files.

subject: Desktop Sync client keeps asking to re-authenticate
body: Since updating to the 4.2 Desktop Sync client, my team is constantly being asked to re-authenticate, even though we use SSO. The logs are showing the SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 error repeatedly. It is becoming very frustrating to have to log in multiple times a day. Please let us know how to fix this sync issue.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to SSO token handling. Please perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client by uninstalling, restarting your machine, and installing again. If the issue persists, your SSO administrator may need to review the IdP's token lifetime settings or regenerate the client secret in the Admin Console.

subject: password reset email not arriving
body: users cant reset passwords, the email never arrives. checked spam already. this is happening to multiple people right now. auth-pr-200.1
resolution: Please verify that the user's email address is correctly entered in the Admin Console. Also, ensure that your domain's email filter has 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' on the approved sender list. If the emails are still not arriving, I can manually trigger a password reset for these users from our backend.

subject: Data retention policy not working for trash
body: I configured a 30-day retention policy for our files, yet the files in the 'Trash Bin' are remaining visible and recoverable well past that window. This is highly frustrating as we need to ensure compliance with our internal policies. Is there a reason why the system is not enforcing this?
resolution: Please verify your retention settings under the Security and Compliance tab in the Admin Console. Note that retention policies primarily target files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state, while the 'Trash Bin' is generally reserved for user-initiated recovery. If you need the Trash Bin itself to purge automatically, ensure that specific setting is enabled in your configuration.

subject: Requesting API for workspace management
body: We are looking for an API endpoint that allows us to programmatically create and configure workspaces for new clients. Doing this manually for every onboarding is becoming quite tedious for our office staff. Is this functionality available, or is it on the roadmap?
resolution: While we introduced changes to token handling in v4.2, an API endpoint for automated workspace creation is not currently available. Please submit your detailed requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements/workspace-creation-api so we can better understand the demand for this feature.

subject: Intermittent errors when fetching file content
body: Hello support team, we noticed that calling the file content endpoint sometimes returns an unexpected API-500 error for documents in certain regions. Thank you for your hard time looking into this whenever you have a moment.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Slack notifications not appearing
body: Our file share notifications have stopped posting to Slack. The logs show SLACK-NOTIFY-500. Can you look into why this integration stopped working?
resolution: Please review your Slack integration settings in the Admin Console to ensure the correct channel is selected. Additionally, verify that the CloudDesk Slack app still maintains the necessary permissions to post messages in your configured channel.

subject: Billing page payment error after v42
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a great week. Ever since the recent v42 release, I have been seeing a Payment Processing Error in the billing section when trying to review our invoices, though the rest of the admin console works fine. We are on the Pro plan and I see error code AUTH-BILL-402 on my screen. Please let me know when you can look into this, thank you so much for your help.
resolution: The v42 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Cannot export audit logs for long date range
body: I need to export our audit logs for the last six months for a compliance audit on Friday, but the system keeps throwing the error AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. It seems the UI is capped at 90 days. This is blocking our audit preparation and I need a way to get this data by the end of the week. Please advise.
resolution: The Admin Console interface is currently limited to 90-day exports for performance reasons. To retrieve data beyond this range, you will need to use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with a pagination script. If you are unable to use the API, please let me know and I can arrange a manual data pull for you.

subject: Cannot delete workspace due to active integrations
body: I am trying to remove an old workspace from our account, but the system keeps throwing the CD-AM-007 error regarding active integrations. Could you let me know how to bypass this or clear them out so the deletion can proceed?
resolution: Before a workspace can be deleted, all active integrations (e.g., Slack, Jira, Zapier) linked to that specific workspace must be disconnected. Navigate to 'Workspace Settings > Integrations' for the affected workspace and disable/remove all listed integrations, then retry deletion.

subject: Desktop sync app fails SSO login with DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3
body: Hello support team, when our staff tries signing into the desktop sync client via SSO, the browser redirects fine but the app stays unauthenticated with a generic login failed message. We are seeing error DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 on our PRO workspace. Any prompt assistance would be greatly appreciated!
resolution: Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version, v4.2.1 or newer. Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle custom protocol redirects for SSO. As a workaround until your environment is fully aligned, you may log in via email and password.

subject: Microsoft Teams direct integration availability request
body: Hello, our enterprise organization is currently evaluating our daily communication tools. We would like to know if CloudDesk plans to offer a native direct integration with Microsoft Teams for file sharing and collaboration. Many of our departments frequently ask for this capability to streamline their daily workflows.
resolution: Hello. While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper, direct integration is not yet available. Please vote for this integration or add your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams as we continuously evaluate new features.

subject: api endpoints returning 503 errors
body: our automated scripts are failing because multiple api endpoints are returning http 503 service unavailable errors right now during peak hours please look into this quickly
resolution: Investigate the customer's API usage patterns to identify if they are exceeding rate limits (check 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header). Advise implementing exponential backoff for retries. Confirm if there are any ongoing platform incidents via the CloudDesk status page. Escalate to engineering if rate limits are not being hit.

subject: Critical: Okta SSO token error
body: Users are unable to log in via Okta due to an 'Invalid SSO token format' error following the v4.2 update. We have a major audit occurring on Friday and this is blocking access for our entire staff. We need a resolution immediately to ensure compliance.
resolution: Due to the SSO token format changes introduced in v4.2, your current configuration requires an update. Please log into the CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata to refresh the integration. This will restore access for your users immediately.

subject: Missing invoices older than 12 months
body: I am trying to pull our billing history from the Admin Console, but I cannot see any invoices older than a year. I am encountering error BILL-INV-003 whenever I try to query the archives. Is there a different portal where I can access these historical documents?
resolution: The Admin Console displays invoice history for the previous 12 months. If you require documents older than that, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you need. I will be happy to retrieve those from our archives and email them to you directly.

subject: Need to update purchase order number
body: I am the IT admin here and I have been looking for where to input a new PO number for our account. I have searched the settings but could not find the place to add this. Please let me know how I can do this for future billing cycles.
resolution: You can update your PO number by navigating to the Admin Console, selecting 'Billing', and then clicking 'Billing Information'. You will find a field there to enter the Purchase Order Number, which will then apply to all upcoming invoices. Please be aware that this cannot be applied to invoices that have already been generated.

subject: Desktop app flagging false file conflicts
body: Hi there, we are seeing many SYNC-003 errors where the client flags files as conflicts even when no one else is working on them. It creates a lot of extra duplicate files and it is quite annoying. Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: This behavior is often caused by local network instability or interference from third-party security software. Please try temporarily disabling your antivirus or firewall to see if the sync errors cease. If that works, please whitelist CloudDesk in your security software settings to prevent future conflicts.

subject: DESKTOP SYNC HIGH CPU USAGE
body: CloudDeskSync.exe is consuming over 50 percent CPU and more than 2GB of memory even when completely idle! This is severely impacting our systems and blocking our work right now. We need this fixed immediately.
resolution: Please check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed by the client. We advise pausing sync, restarting your computer, and then resuming sync. If the behavior persists, suggest disabling sync for non-critical folders or temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks, and check for any conflicting antivirus software.

subject: Okta SSO login broken after update
body: Hi our team cant sign in at all with okta we keep getting invalid sso token format error auth-sso-401.1 please help asap as we have a deadline today and nobody can access their files.
resolution: I apologize for the disruption. Because we updated our SSO token format in v4.2, you will need to re-upload your IDP metadata within the CloudDesk Admin Console. Once the new metadata is applied, your users should be able to authenticate through Okta without further issues.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA failing on mobile
body: Good day. Several of us are unable to sign into the mobile app using our Google Authenticator codes today. The verification keeps failing unexpectedly. Please advise on how to resolve this soon.
resolution: Please make sure your phone's clock is synchronized automatically with network time, as even a small drift causes token rejection. If the problem continues, you can reset your MFA configuration through the security settings in the web app.

subject: Switching billing to annual plan
body: Hello, we would like to move our PRO subscription from monthly billing to annual billing to take advantage of the discount. Let me know what steps are required on our end to make this change happen.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership
body: I am trying to transfer ownership of a workspace in the admin console but the button is greyed out. I am receiving error CD-AM-004 every time I try to finalize the change. Can you help me move this workspace to the correct owner?
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to someone who is already a member or administrator of that specific workspace. Please ensure the user you are transferring to has already been added to the workspace. Once they are a member, you can successfully complete the transfer through the Admin Console settings.

subject: Custom logo missing on SSO page
body: Hello friends, when our users are redirected to the SSO login page, the custom company logo and background image are not appearing, showing default CloudDesk branding instead. We noticed error code SSO-UI-200.2 in our console. Take your time to reply as this is not urgent.
resolution: Please guide the admin to the 'SSO & Branding' section in the Admin Console. Check if the custom branding assets like the logo and background are uploaded and saved correctly, and advise clearing the browser cache for affected users.

subject: Notification settings are too broad and noisy
body: I am honestly getting quite tired of receiving an email for every single comment made in our shared folders. It is filling up my inbox and making it impossible to find relevant project updates. Can we please have the option to only be notified when someone mentions us specifically? This constant noise is quite frustrating.
resolution: We hear your feedback regarding notification preferences. Currently, you can adjust general notification settings in your profile. For more granular control, please outline your specific notification scenarios and preferences at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications. This helps us prioritize improvements.

subject: Private workspace access restriction during audit
body: Hello support, I am assisting with a compliance review and need to inspect a specific user's private workspace. The admin-console prevents access and cites PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED. Please advise how we can retrieve this data.
resolution: By default, private workspaces are inaccessible even to administrators for enhanced privacy. An admin can only gain temporary access by initiating a 'Workspace Access Request' through Admin Console > Users > [User Profile] > Workspaces. This action generates an audit log entry and requires the user to be notified if active or a compliance officer override if inactive.

subject: deleted user still showing up in workspace shares
body: hey support, i deleted a user yesterday but their name and email are still showing up in the sharing dialogs for various workspaces. error code CD-AM-006 popped up earlier too. no huge rush on this since it is mostly just a visual thing, whenever you get around to it is fine.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as 'ghost' entries in historical share lists until the system purges them (typically within 24-48 hours) or until a workspace owner explicitly removes them from a share via 'Workspace Settings > Members'. This is expected behavior.

subject: New user getting user not found error on login
body: We invited a new team member today, but when they try to log into the web app, they keep getting hit with an error. This is ridiculous and blocking their onboarding. Please fix this soon.
resolution: Please verify the invited user's email address inside the Admin Console to ensure they were added correctly. Confirm whether they accepted the invitation or need it resent, and make sure they are using your company's correct instance URL.

subject: Seat limit error for new team members
body: I am trying to add a new person to our account but the system says the seat limit is reached. The dashboard shows we have available seats. Error code is CD-AM-001.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations', as these count towards your seat limit. You can revoke any old pending invitations to free up space for new team members. Alternatively, you may need to upgrade your plan to increase your total seat capacity.

subject: audit log retention max 12 months
body: Hello, I need to change audit log retention period to 5 years for our company compliance. Maximum selectable value in admin console is only 12 months. Please tell me how to make it longer, no rush on this.
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution such as Splunk or Sumo Logic via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. This is currently a feature request for extending native retention.

subject: google sso loop
body: my users are stuck in a redirect loop using google sso. we never reach the dashboard. seen error AUTH-SSO-302.1. please fix this.
resolution: Please have your users clear their browser cookies and cache for the cloudesk.com domain to resolve this loop. If the issue continues, they should try using an incognito window or a different web browser. You may also want to double-check your Google SSO settings in the Admin Console to ensure everything is configured correctly.

subject: Requesting a plan downgrade
body: Our team size has decreased recently and we no longer require our current subscription tier. I would like to downgrade our account to a lower plan to better match our needs. Please let me know how to proceed with this change.
resolution: To downgrade, please navigate to the Admin Console, then go to Billing, Subscription Details, and finally Change Plan. Note that changes take effect at the end of your current cycle to avoid service disruption, and we do not issue prorated refunds for unused time.

subject: Custom branding missing on SSO page
body: Hello when users go to the sso login page they just see the default branding instead of our custom logo and background. not a huge deal right now since everything works fine just wanted to report it when you have a moment.
resolution: Please go to the 'SSO & Branding' section in your Admin Console to verify that your custom branding assets like your logo and background are properly uploaded and saved. Once confirmed, advise your users to clear their browser cache so the new UI assets can load correctly.

subject: Intermittent SSO session expiry during workday
body: Ever since the recent upgrade, our team members logged in via Azure AD are intermittently logged out or forced to re-authenticate with an SSO session expired message. We are receiving the SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 error code. We have a major audit on Friday and need this resolved promptly.
resolution: We have received multiple reports of this behavior following recent system updates. Version 4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta and Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration of 8 to 24 hours to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: Incorrect role display in admin console
body: I noticed today while reviewing our team settings that several of our users have incorrect roles shown in the admin console. For instance, some of our managers are mistakenly tagged as contributors in the user management section. This error code UI-ADMIN-003 keeps appearing when I hover over the details. Their actual workspace permissions seem fine, but this mismatched display is really annoying. Take your time looking into this whenever you can.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug. The actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: SSO login failing after v4.2 update
body: Hello, our team is unable to log into the platform this morning since the latest update. We keep seeing an error saying Invalid SSO Token Format. This is blocking our access entirely. Could you please help us resolve this? We appreciate your time and support.
resolution: The recent v4.2 update changed our SSO token format. Please update your Identity Provider configuration to use the new token schema as outlined in our v4.2 SSO Migration Guide. This should resolve the error and restore access for your users.

subject: cant remove workspace user error code
body: hey team im trying to take a user out of a workspace in the admin console but it keeps throwing cd am 014 saying they are an owner. can you help me fix this when you get a chance thanks
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace. The ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign.

subject: Incorrect tax rate applied to our latest invoice
body: Our finance department noticed that the tax rate on our recent invoice looks wrong. It does not seem to match our business location. Can you guys look into this for us? Error code BILL-TAX-006 appeared on the statement.
resolution: We are currently reviewing tax settings for several accounts to ensure compliance. Please verify your billing address and tax ID under the 'Billing' tab in your Admin Console. If everything is correct there, send over your company's legal name and a tax exemption certificate so I can manually correct the settings.

subject: Desktop sync client stuck on indexing
body: The desktop sync client is showing that it is indexing indefinitely. Files are not moving at all. This is blocking our team's work as we cannot access shared files. I need this fixed as soon as possible.
resolution: Please restart the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client to see if it clears the state. If the issue persists, go to 'Settings' > 'Advanced' and select 'Clear Cache'. If the sync still does not resume, please back up any unsynced local files and perform a full reinstall of the client.

subject: SSO login failure on desktop sync client
body: Hi, some of our users are reporting a DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 error when trying to authenticate the desktop client via SSO. It just shows a failed message after the browser redirect. Any help would be great, thanks.
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, suggest logging in via email/password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: blank user activity report page
body: hi there so ive been meaning to reach out about this for a little bit now ever since Tuesday morning when we upgraded our network switches and updated some local dns settings across our office, but the user activity report in the admin console just loads a completely blank page while all other reports work fine. error code is report-001. let me know what you think.

resolution: This is a caching error impacting the display of permissions in your browser. Please have your agents clear their cache and cookies, then log back in. If that fails, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to another user and then back to the original agent to resolve the issue.

subject: URGENT my assigned tickets not showing up HELPDESK-007
body: This is a disaster, our entire support team cant see tickets assigned to them. The web app shows nothing in the 'My Assigned Tickets' view for several of us. This started happening just now and it's blocking all our work. We need this fixed immediately, we are seeing error code HELPDESK-007. What is going on???
resolution: We understand this is critical and are working to resolve it. This often relates to a temporary caching issue with agent permissions. Please have the affected agent clear their browser's cache and cookies and then log back into CloudDesk. If the issue persists, an administrator can try re-assigning the ticket to a different agent, saving the change, and then re-assigning it back to the original agent.

subject: Tickets assigned to me are not appearing in my queue.

We recommend that the affected agent clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log out and back into CloudDesk. If the problem continues, an administrator can try reassigning the ticket to another agent and then back to the original agent.

subject: Assigned tickets disappear from 'My Assigned Tickets' view

The recommended first step is for the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies and then sign back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't resolve it, having an administrator reassign the ticket to another agent and then back to the original agent should correct the visibility.

If the tickets remain hidden, an administrator can fix this by reassigning the ticket to another agent, saving the change, and then reassigning it back to the original agent.

subject: Unable to generate API keys
body: Hello, our new admin is unable to generate an API key as the option is greyed out. We are seeing the CD-AM-013 error message when trying to access that section. We would appreciate your help in getting this resolved so they can manage our integrations.
resolution: API key generation is a privilege reserved for the Super Admin role. Please verify your colleague's permissions in the Team Management section of the Admin Console. If they do not have Super Admin status, you will need to elevate their role or have a current Super Admin generate the key on their behalf.

subject: API calls returning 403 Forbidden errors
body: We are suddenly receiving 403 Forbidden errors for our new API integration, despite having a valid key. We are seeing API-AUTH-403.5 errors in our logs. This is critical because we have a demo at 5pm today and need this resolved immediately. Thank you for your help.
resolution: Please verify that your API key has the necessary scopes and permissions assigned for the specific endpoints you are accessing. An administrator can review and update these scopes directly in the Admin Console under the API Keys section. This should restore your access in time for your demo.

subject: Azure AD SSO login failing with profile error
body: Good morning, our users attempting to log in via Azure AD SSO on our free plan are encountering the error AUTH-SSO-403.2 stating that the user profile is incomplete or missing required attributes. This is critically urgent because we have an executive payroll run tomorrow and staff cannot access their workspaces. Please help us resolve this immediately.
resolution: Hello. To fix this login issue, please guide your Azure AD administrator to verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped in the enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. You can find detailed steps in our Azure AD SSO configuration guide at https://docs.cloudesk.com/sso-azure.

subject: Azure AD SSO configuration error
body: Our users are seeing a Reply URL mismatch error when trying to sign in through Azure AD. This is currently blocking our finance team from accessing their files. We would appreciate your prompt help in resolving this SSO-AZURE-400 error.
resolution: This error typically occurs when the redirect URI in your identity provider does not match our requirements. Please check your Azure AD application registration and ensure the Reply URL is correctly set to https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs, replacing yourcompany with your specific subdomain.

subject: Updating purchase order number on future invoices
body: Hello, our accounting department needs to update the purchase order number for our upcoming billing cycles. We are seeing error code bill-po-008 when trying to locate the field. Please let us know how to adjust this.
resolution: You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: Need detailed activity reports for audit
body: I am struggling to find granular activity data like specific file downloads and views. Our team has an audit on Friday and I am currently unable to provide the necessary logs to show user actions. This is incredibly frustrating as the current interface does not offer enough detail. Can you provide a more comprehensive report or export tool right now?
resolution: I understand the urgency of your audit preparation. While our current audit logs provide basic tracking, we do not have an advanced reporting feature at this time. Please detail your specific reporting needs on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting so our analytics team can evaluate this for future updates.

subject: Incorrect tax rate on invoice bill-tax-006

resolution: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. To address the incorrect tax rate, please verify your billing address and tax ID (if applicable) within the Admin Console under 'Billing' > 'Billing Information'. If these details are already correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and a valid tax exemption certificate (if applicable) for a manual review of your tax settings and invoice adjustment.

subject: Mobile app network error blocking our executive demo
body: Our team cannot log into the iOS and Android mobile applications today, constantly receiving a generic network error despite having a completely stable connection. We are seeing error code MOBILE-NET-500.1 on all devices. This is currently blocking our preparation for a major executive demo scheduled at 5 PM today. We understand a number of users are experiencing similar trouble right now.
resolution: Please force close the app, check for app updates in your respective app store, and try again. If it persists, try clearing the app's cache or reinstalling the app. You can also verify our server status on our status page.

subject: invoice user count mismatch bill inv 001
body: Hi support, just noticed that our latest invoice has the wrong active user count listed on it, resulting in a billing discrepancy under error code BILL-INV-001. Apparently a few other teams noticed similar billing line item quirks on their accounts today too. Could you take a look at our subscription records when you have a moment so we can get the charges squared away properly. Thanks.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Need direct video conferencing integration
body: We really need a way to link Zoom or Google Meet directly inside our workspaces. The current file sharing works, but we cannot trigger calls, which blocks our team collaboration. Why is this not supported yet? We need this handled as soon as possible.
resolution: While we currently focus on file sharing, you can easily drop meeting links directly into comments. To help us prioritize future development, please submit your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing. This helps our team assess the demand for these integrations.

subject: Web app changes not appearing in desktop sync client
body: After updating our PRO desktop sync client to version 4.2, files modified in the web app fail to show up locally. Mobile app and web app show the latest files fine, but the desktop client remains outdated with error SYNC-001. Please let us know how to fix this when convenient.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk (Windows) or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk (macOS). Reinstall the client from the download link in your web app's 'Settings' -> 'Desktop Sync' section.

subject: user activity report page is blank
body: hello team, when i try to load the user activity report in the admin console, the page stays totally blank. i have a security audit on friday and need to pull this data. thanks so much for your help
resolution: Hello! This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If it is still blank, please provide the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: Mobile login failing with network error
body: Hello, thank you for your help. Im currently unable to log into the mobile app, it keeps giving me a network error even though my wifi is good. I appreciate your assistance with this.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out. Please force close the application and check for any available updates in the app store. If the issue persists, try reinstalling the app to clear out any cached data, and verify our server status page to ensure all services are operating normally.

subject: sso login page branding is missing
body: sso-ui-200.2 error on our login page where the custom branding is totally gone. it just shows the default clouddesk logo now. we have a big demo at 5pm today and really need it to look professional.
resolution: Please navigate to the SSO & Branding section within your Admin Console to verify that your custom logo and background assets are still active. If they appear correct, we recommend having your users clear their browser cache, which often resolves this display issue.

subject: New user login error
body: I invited a new team member to our account, but they keep seeing an 'User Not Found' error when they try to sign in. It is very frustrating because we need them working today. They received the error code AUTH-NF-404.1. Please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: Please check the user's email address in your Admin Console to confirm the status of the invitation. If the invite was never accepted, you should resend it. Additionally, ensure the user is attempting to sign into the correct workspace URL for your organization.

subject: Update invoice purchase order number
body: Need to update our PO number for future billing invoices. Please provide instructions.
resolution: Hello. You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership in admin console
body: I am trying to transfer ownership of one of our company workspaces to another colleague, but the button is greyed out. We are getting an error stating that we cannot transfer ownership to a non-owner. Please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: Hi there. Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is already added to the workspace, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Critical security flaw with API key permissions
body: We discovered that our read-only API keys have full administrative permissions, which is a major security risk. This API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS issue allows us to delete users despite the restricted scope. We need an immediate fix as this is a high-risk situation.
resolution: Please revoke the affected API key immediately via the Admin Console under API Management. We suggest investigating whether the key was incorrectly provisioned or if there is a misconfiguration in your internal process. This is a critical matter, so please let us know if the issue persists after key revocation so we can escalate it to engineering.

subject: Automated S3 data export failing after v4.2 update
body: We recently upgraded to v4.2 and our automated S3 exports are failing with an S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401 error. Our AWS credentials remain unchanged, so I am quite confused. This is blocking our daily backups and we would appreciate your prompt assistance to resolve this. Thank you for your help.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced stricter IAM requirements, which is why your exports are failing. Please update your AWS IAM policy to include the new 's3:GetBucketLocation' permission as detailed in our latest integration guide. This should resolve the authentication error immediately.

subject: sso session expired repeatedly
body: users keep getting kicked out with sso session expired error sso-refresh-401-v42 since the update. it is causing a lot of downtime today. please look into this quickly.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how we handle SSO token refreshes. Please ensure your IdP settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy active with a duration of 8 to 24 hours to prevent your users from being logged out prematurely.

subject: High CPU usage by CloudDesk Sync
body: I noticed our office computers are running very slow because the sync client is using way too much memory. It looks like it is hitting the SYNC_HIGH_RESOURCE_USAGE limit on several machines. Thank you for your help looking into this.
resolution: This can happen if there are many pending changes or large files being processed. Please pause the sync, restart your computer, and then resume to see if usage stabilizes. You may also want to temporarily pause sync during intensive tasks or check your antivirus settings for conflicts.

subject: Retention policy not deleting trash bin items
body: Our 30-day retention policy is completely ignored by the system! I can see files in the trash bin that are months old, and RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED keeps appearing in my logs. We need this fixed immediately for compliance reasons.
resolution: Please verify your retention policy settings in the Security & Compliance section, as policies typically target 'Permanently Deleted' files. Files currently in the 'Trash Bin' are considered recoverable by the user and are not automatically purged by the retention policy unless a specific 'Auto-Empty Trash' duration is also set.

subject: API requests failing with 401 Unauthorized
body: Our integration scripts are currently receiving 401 Unauthorized responses with an invalid token message on our free tier. We are seeing error code API-AUTH-401 across multiple requests. This is blocking our data sync workflows, so we appreciate your prompt help.
resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your requests.

subject: API resource calls returning 404
body: I am getting 404 errors when calling the files endpoint even with valid IDs. I have a demo at 5pm today, so if you could take a look I would appreciate it. Everything else seems fine.
resolution: Please verify that your API endpoint path and HTTP method strictly match the latest CloudDesk documentation. You should also confirm that the API token has sufficient permissions to access that specific folder ID. If you continue to receive 404s after checking the documentation, please send over the specific request you are attempting.

subject: SSO login failing for all users
body: Our entire team is currently unable to access their accounts via Okta. They are all receiving an 'Invalid Token Format' error when attempting to log in. This is a critical issue as it is preventing us from accessing our files during business hours. Please help us resolve this immediately.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise the customer's IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide, which is accessible in the admin console under Settings -> SSO & Authentication -> Okta Configuration.

subject: Workspace invitation emails not arriving

resolution: Please check your company's email spam and junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured properly to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries, and provide affected email addresses for manual investigation if needed.

resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: desktop sync failing to refresh sso token after v42 update

Please advise the user to perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client by uninstalling, restarting the machine, and then installing it again. If the issue persists, your company's SSO administrator may need to review the IdP's token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret in the CloudDesk Admin Console.

resolution: This is likely a caching issue regarding your agent permissions. Please ask the affected agent to clear their browser cache and cookies before logging back in. If the ticket still does not appear, have an administrator re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save the change, and then assign it back to the original person.

subject: Desktop sync creating many duplicate files

resolution: This issue is commonly caused by aggressive antivirus settings or unstable network connections blocking the sync process. Try turning off your firewall or antivirus temporarily to see if the files sync properly. If that solves it, ensure you whitelist the CloudDesk application in your security settings.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: Our users are currently experiencing an issue where they are stuck in a redirect loop after authenticating with Google SSO. This behavior prevents them from reaching the dashboard. Several users have reported seeing AUTH-SSO-302.1 during the process. Could you please look into this?
resolution: Please instruct your users to clear their browser cache and cookies for our domain. If the problem continues, have them attempt access via an incognito window or a different browser. We also recommend verifying your Google SSO configuration within the Admin Console.

subject: Invalid SSO token format on web app

resolution: You need to update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This update is necessary due to a change in the SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Request for sub-folder permission controls

Please submit your specific requirements for advanced granular permissions at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions. This will help us design the most effective solution.

subject: Existing API key returning unauthorized error

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content downloads

resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Google SSO login failing with domain error

subject: Okta SSO failing with AUTH-402 error

If the problem persists, please check your browser console for any specific network errors so we can investigate further.

resolution: Please verify that the Client ID and Secret in your application exactly match the credentials listed in the Admin Console under API & Integrations. Ensure there are no trailing spaces or case-sensitivity issues, as these are common causes for the invalid_client error.

subject: Billing section failing for SSO admins

resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token format, which is interfering with billing section sessions. Please try clearing your browser cache or logging in with your direct email credentials to access these settings. We are investigating a permanent fix for SSO billing access.

subject: Frequent logouts via SSO after 4.2 upgrade

resolution: The v4.2 update changed how we handle session tokens. Please update your Okta or Azure AD settings to ensure the 'Refresh Token' policy is enabled with a duration of at least 8 to 24 hours. This will prevent the premature session expiration issues you are reporting.

subject: Webhooks failing to deliver

You must also verify that your external service is reachable from the public internet and that your firewall permits incoming traffic from our IP range. Please consult our documentation for the most recent IP addresses.

subject: User data deletion request stuck in pending status

We are seeing code USER_DELETE_PENDING. Many other admins are reporting this right now. Please help us fix this as it blocks our compliance tasks.
resolution: Verify the user's status is 'Inactive' before requesting deletion. If the user is active, the deletion will be queued. If inactive and still pending, check System Status page for background job processing issues. If no issues, provide the user's email and deletion request ID for investigation.
