subject: cloudesk desktop sync high cpu usage
body: Hi support, the desktop sync client is causing high cpu usage consistently above 50% and significant memory consumption even when no active syncing is occurring. this slows down our computer quite a bit. we have a payroll run tomorrow so please let me know when you can.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to Settings, select Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database. After the reset completes, resume syncing, and let us know if the resource consumption normalizes.

subject: Severe collaborative editing lag in CloudDesk Office docs
body: We are experiencing terrible performance issues when multiple users edit a CloudDesk Office document simultaneously! There is a multi-second lag between typing and seeing changes reflected, and cursor positions update extremely slowly. COLLAB_LAG is ruining our productivity and we need this investigated.
resolution: Hello. Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and applications to free up system memory, as well as clearing the browser cache. Let us know if the issue persists when fewer users are editing simultaneously.

subject: New user unable to log in
body: I invited a team member earlier, but they are receiving an AUTH-NF-404.1 error when trying to access their account. It seems like the system does not recognize their email address at all. Please let us know how to fix this so they can start working.
resolution: Please check the Admin Console to ensure the invitation was sent to the correct email address and that it has been accepted. If the status is pending, you may need to resend the invite. Additionally, verify that the user is attempting to sign in through your specific company instance URL.

subject: Okta SSO login broken after v4.2 update
body: Users are unable to log in using Okta SSO after the recent v4.2 update. They are receiving an 'Invalid SSO token format' error. This is preventing our team from accessing CloudDesk and is highly disruptive. Please provide assistance promptly as this is blocking our work. Error code is AUTH-SSO-401.1.
resolution: The 'Invalid SSO token format' error after the v4.2 update is due to a change in our SSO token format. To resolve this, an administrator needs to update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This will ensure your Okta SSO integrates correctly with the new token format.

subject: Extremely slow download speeds across all shared links
body: Our team has noticed that downloading files from public links and workspaces is dragging at a tiny fraction of our actual connection speed today. It is taking forever to pull down invoices and reports on our PRO plan. I am seeing error code DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW on some transfers. We would appreciate it if this could be looked into soon.
resolution: We recommend testing download speeds using a different browser or network to isolate the cause. Please check if any browser extensions might be interfering with downloads. For very large files, your recipients can use our Desktop Sync client, which offers much more robust transfers than the web app.

subject: Lag during collaborative editing
body: Collaborators are seeing major lag while editing docs together. We have a big demo at 5pm today and this is making the document unusable. Pls fix the lag.
resolution: Please ensure all collaborators have a stable network connection and try closing any unnecessary browser tabs to free up resources. It may also help to clear the browser cache for everyone involved. If the performance remains slow, try reducing the number of active editors on the document simultaneously.

subject: API calls returning unauthorized error
body: Our free tier integration is completely broken because every single api call is throwing 401 Unauthorized with an invalid token message. We checked our headers and everything looks correct on our end. This is blocking our developers right now so please look into it urgently
resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your requests.

subject: Google SSO login failing for specific domain
body: We have an important demo at 5pm today, and users from our subsidiary domain are getting a domain not allowed error when using Google SSO. Other domains are working correctly, but this one is failing. Could you help us resolve this before our deadline?
resolution: It appears the domain needs to be explicitly whitelisted in your console. Please navigate to SSO & Identity settings within the Admin Console and add the affected domain to your list of allowed domains. Once saved, those users should be able to authenticate successfully.

subject: role display discrepancy in admin console
body: I have been working on our API integration to sync users, and while testing our permissions schema, I noticed a UI-ADMIN-003 error regarding user roles. The backend permissions are working perfectly fine, but the admin console incorrectly shows contributors as managers. It is strange because my script works, but the visual interface is not updating correctly.
resolution: This is a known UI display issue and your actual permissions remain secure. You can temporarily fix the display by toggling the user's role to a different setting and back again in the admin console. A permanent fix for this visual bug is coming in our next patch.

subject: SSO login failing for all users
body: Our entire company cannot log in via Okta right now. We are receiving AUTH-402 errors. This is critical as no one can access their work files. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: This issue is due to a recent change in SSO token handling included in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They must ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide, available in your Admin Console.

subject: Need PDF format for downloaded invoices
body: Hello, when trying to download an invoice from the Admin Console, the only available format is CSV. Our accounting department requires a PDF for our records. Many users are hitting this at the same moment right now. Could you let us know when PDF downloads will be available?
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on GET file content endpoint
body: Our production environment is failing with 500 errors when fetching file content. This is blocking our deployment and we need a fix. Please look into this API-500 issue immediately.
resolution: We are currently investigating a root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix shortly. In the meantime, please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your client to mitigate these intermittent failures.

subject: Cannot add new users due to seat limit error
body: I am trying to add new team members but I keep getting a CD-AM-001 error saying the seat limit is reached. Our subscription details clearly show we have plenty of open seats left. This is incredibly frustrating as I have new hires waiting to start. Can someone look into this right now?
resolution: The seat limit error often occurs because of pending invitations that haven't been accepted yet. Please navigate to Team Management and check your pending invitations, as these count toward your total limit. You can revoke older pending invites to free up seats.

subject: Cannot add team members seat limit error
body: I am trying to add new staff members for our quarterly audit on Friday, but I keep getting the CD-AM-001 error saying our seat limit is reached even though our subscription details clearly show open seats. It is extremely annoying that simple tasks fail like this. No huge rush since audit prep is ongoing, but please take a look when you can.
resolution: Please verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations', as pending invitations count towards your seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: mfa code not working
body: hello, the mfa code from my google authenticator isnt being accepted anymore. i keep getting error auth-mfa-401.2. thank you for your help.
resolution: This usually happens when the time on your phone is slightly out of sync with the network. Please ensure your device is set to update its time automatically. If that doesn't fix it, you can reset your MFA settings through the Security section of your account on the web app.

subject: Audit log filters are timing out
body: I am working on integrating our internal systems and was trying to pull some data from your logs to verify my mappings. It seems like the Admin Console filters are constantly timing out when I select a broad date range, which is problematic since I am trying to correlate several events. I don't need this fixed immediately, but I wanted to mention it. I keep seeing an AUDIT_LOG_FILTER_TIMEOUT error message.
resolution: Please try narrowing your search by using much smaller date ranges to prevent the query from timing out. If you need to analyze specific user activity, I recommend using the dedicated 'User Activity' report, which is optimized for those queries. For large historical data sets, exporting the full log to process locally is the most effective approach.

subject: Invite emails not arriving
body: Hello, it seems our new users arent receiving the invite emails we send out. They show as 'Pending' in the dashboard, error code EMAIL-005. Its not a huge rush, but we would appreciate it if you could help us get this sorted.
resolution: Please start by having your users check their spam and junk folders. You should also ensure your domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured correctly to allow CloudDesk emails; details are in our Email Delivery Troubleshooting guide. If this doesn't help, please send us the affected email addresses for further review.

subject: How do we downgrade our subscription plan
body: Why is it so difficult to find the billing settings to downgrade our account? We've been trying to reduce our plan tier due to budget cuts and keep running into BILL-PLAN-011. Fix this system or tell us how to do it immediately.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Okta SSO broken on mobile app
body: Good morning support team. As you may know, our company relies heavily on secure authentication protocols, and we recently transitioned our entire infrastructure to Okta last quarter after a lengthy security audit. However, since the latest mobile app update, our users cannot log in and are getting AUTH-SSO-401.1 with an invalid token format message. We have executive board meetings starting in thirty minutes and mobile access is completely halted, so we urgently need this resolved right now.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This step is required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: Audit log missing failed logins and suspicious ips
body: we are seeing strange login attempts from new countries in our telemetry but when i check the standard Login Activity audit log nothing is there it only shows successful logins and the code is AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN. we need this investigated right now as our security is compromised
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses or locations are actually recorded in the Security Events log rather than the Login Activity tab. You can find this information by navigating to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events. We also recommend enabling Login Anomaly Detection for automatic alerts moving forward.

subject: audit logs missing external user info
body: The audit logs are failing to show who specifically is downloading files from our external share links. It only shows our internal users. This is useless for tracking and I need to know how to fix this.
resolution: By default, external share links are anonymous, which is why individual identity is not captured. To track specific external users, you must configure your share links to 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login'. Please note that this change will only apply to new share links, as the identity requirement cannot be applied retroactively to existing links.

subject: Change monthly to yearly plan
body: I want to change billing from month to year to save money. Can I do this inside the console? I see error BILL-PLAN-004 when I try.
resolution: You can update your billing cycle by navigating to Admin Console, then Billing, and finally Subscription Details. From there, select Change Plan and choose the annual option. Any remaining credit from your current monthly cycle will be prorated automatically.

subject: API 500 errors on file retrieval
body: Our developers are seeing intermittent API-500 errors when calling the GET content endpoint. This is really slowing us down and blocking our work for our regional teams. It is extremely frustrating given how much we depend on this. Can you check why this is failing?
resolution: We are aware of this intermittent issue regarding distributed storage retrieval and are currently preparing a fix. In the meantime, we recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. This should help manage these temporary server errors until our hotfix is deployed.

subject: Critical failure logging in with Okta SSO after version upgrade
body: Hello finance team here reviewing our quarterly software subscriptions while sipping my morning coffee and double-checking our budget spreadsheets for the upcoming board meeting next Tuesday. We recently updated our environment to version 4.2 and now none of our corporate team members can access the web app using Okta SSO. The screen just refreshes and throws an error code AUTH-SSO-401.1 blocking our entire financial reporting workflow. We need this fixed immediately since payroll processing depends on this tool today.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This step is required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in the v4.2 release.

subject: Login failure after role change to Guest
body: Hi there, thank you for your help. One of our contractors had their role changed to Guest earlier today, and now they cannot log in to the web app anymore. They keep seeing an Account Suspended message. It is not an urgent crisis since they have other tasks, but I would appreciate it if we could get this sorted out soon.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Feature Request: Longer public link expiration
body: Your current public sharing links expire way too fast. We need the option to set them for much longer durations or just have them never expire. It is a major pain to keep regenerating links for our partners.
resolution: The current expiration limits are in place to adhere to security best practices. While we do not have a 'never expire' option currently, we are looking into extending the maximum allowed duration. Please share your specific use case at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration, or consider inviting your partners directly to the workspace for permanent access.

subject: Search results lag in specific workspace
body: Hello, we are noticing that searching for files in one of our particular workspaces results in an infinite spinner. This does not happen globally across other workspaces. We are on the free tier and integrating via the API.
resolution: Investigate if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items (e.g., millions of files) or deeply nested folder structures. Advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches. Suggest optimizing the workspace structure if feasible. Report specific workspace ID to engineering for indexing review.

subject: Okta SSO broken after update
body: Hi support, ever since the v4.2 update rolled out, our Okta SSO login has stopped working entirely. We are encountering an error stating that the SSO token format is invalid when attempting to access the web app. This is blocking our contractors from getting any work done today, so we need a prompt fix.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: Hello, users from one of our specific subsidiary domains are unable to log in via Google SSO, receiving a Domain not allowed error. Other domains in our organization authenticate fine. There is no major rush on this issue, but we would like it reviewed when convenient.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, check the 'Allowed Domains' list. You will need to add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: Switching our subscription to annual billing
body: I am trying to move our team from the monthly plan to annual billing to take advantage of the discount. I keep running into error BILL-PLAN-004 when I try to update this. I really need this settled before our finance team runs the payroll tomorrow. Please let me know how I can process this change.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: need more free storage
body: hello we keep hitting our storage limit on the free plan is there any way you can give us more space without making us pay
resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time. Please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

subject: Incorrect user roles shown in admin console
body: We noticed that several user roles are displayed incorrectly under the Users & Permissions section in the admin console. For instance, contributors are showing up as managers even though their actual workspace permissions are correct. This refers to error code UI-ADMIN-003. Please advise.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and the actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: payment failed alert on account
body: our enterprise automatic renewal failed because of a declined card and now we see a payment failed status in billing with error code BILL-PAY-002 please help us sort this out soon
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: Frequent SSO logouts after v4.2 upgrade
body: Hello support, since updating to v4.2, our users logged in via Azure AD SSO are intermittently logged out or forced to re-authenticate frequently with SSO-REFRESH-401-V42. This is blocking our daily work, so we would appreciate prompt assistance. Thank you!
resolution: Hello! Version 4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta or Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration, such as 8-24 hours, to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: Request for storage limit increase
body: Good day to the CloudDesk team. Our small office team has really been enjoying using the platform for our daily collaboration, but we are running up against our storage limit quite quickly. We were wondering if it might be possible to get a small increase to our storage allotment without having to move to a paid tier just yet. Thank you so much for your time and help.
resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time, so please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

subject: offline document editing on mobile
body: hello we really need our team to be able to edit documents offline within the mobile app and sync changes later when connected again right now it only lets us view starred files and it is slowing us down please help us resolve this soon
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: New admin cannot generate API key
body: Hello support, our newly promoted administrator is unable to generate an API key via Admin Console > Security > API Access. The option is greyed out and an Insufficient Permissions error occurs. Could you please help us resolve this promptly so they can proceed with the integration?
resolution: API Key generation requires the Super Admin role. While the user may be an Admin, they might not have Super Admin privileges. Please confirm their role in Admin Console > Team Management > Users, and have the current Super Admin generate the key for them or elevate their role.

subject: Locked out after role change to guest
body: Yesterday we changed a team members role to guest in our free workspace. Now they cannot login to the web app and keep seeing an insufficient permissions error code CD-AM-002. Please look into this when you can.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Mobile app failing to connect with NETWORK ERROR
body: I have been unable to log into the CloudDesk mobile app all day. I keep seeing MOBILE-NET-500.1 whenever I try to sign in, even though my Wi-Fi is perfectly fine. It is really frustrating as I need access while traveling. Please let me know what is going on.
resolution: We are sorry for the trouble. Please try force closing the app and checking your app store for any available updates. If that does not work, clearing your app cache on Android or reinstalling the app on iOS should resolve the connection error.

subject: Desktop client SSO login fails completely before our audit
body: We are facing a critical blocker as users try to log into the desktop sync client using SSO today. The browser completes the redirect successfully, but the client remains unauthenticated and displays a generic login failed message with error DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. We have an external security audit starting tomorrow morning at 9 AM and must have our team synced and logged in by then. Please escalate this immediately.
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version, v4.2.1 or newer. Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As an immediate workaround for your audit preparation, suggest logging in via email and password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: Wrong active user count on our enterprise invoice BILL-INV-001
body: our latest enterprise invoice shows way more users then we actually have active right now. please fix this before accounting pays it. error BILL-INV-001
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Okta SSO token format error after v4.2 update
body: Hello, ever since the v4.2 platform update, all of our users attempting to log in via Okta SSO are redirected back to the login page with an 'Invalid Token Format' error code AUTH-402. This is critically blocking our operations because we have a mandatory client audit starting this afternoon at 2 PM. Many customers are hitting this at the same moment right now. Please resolve this immediately.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide, which is accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration'.

subject: request for hardware mfa yubikey support
body: hi team our security department is asking if the admin-console supports hardware mfa tokens like yubikeys yet. we would love to implement this eventually when possible thanks
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Error when setting up MFA on mobile app
body: I am trying to set up Google Authenticator through the mobile app but I keep getting an error saying failed to register mfa device after scanning the code. I see code MFA-MOB-002. Is there a way to fix this?
resolution: There is a known issue with the MFA registration flow on our mobile app. Please configure your multi-factor authentication through the CloudDesk web app under Settings and Security instead. Once completed there, it will sync correctly and work for your mobile sessions.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: Hi, some of our staff are unable to login using google sso. They just get stuck in a redirect loop after authenticating and never reach the dashboard. I see the error code AUTH-SSO-302.1 on their screens. Is there something we should change on our end?
resolution: This redirect loop is often resolved by clearing your browser cache and cookies specifically for CloudDesk. If the issue remains, please try an incognito window or confirm your Google SSO settings in the Admin Console are fully up to date.

subject: Requesting webhook for file uploads
body: We need a way to know when a file is uploaded to our workspace automatically. Our current system needs to trigger an action immediately when a user finishes a upload. Can you add a webhook for this?
resolution: Currently, our API supports polling for changes but does not feature a direct webhook for new uploads. Please submit a request for this functionality at roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so our team can evaluate the demand and design.

subject: Desktop sync client stuck on connecting status
body: Hello team, while reviewing our network infrastructure logs and updating local firewall rules across our office workstations today, I noticed our local desktop sync application has been stuck on connecting indefinitely without any progress. This is currently blocking our daily file transfers and needs prompt attention. Please let us know how to fix this sync issue.
resolution: Please restart your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache by going to Settings > Advanced > Clear Cache, and if it remains unresolved, perform a full reinstall after backing up any local unsynced files.

subject: Updating purchase order number on invoices
body: I need to update our PO number for future billing cycles. Could you let me know where I can change this in the admin console? I am seeing code BILL-PO-008 when I try to find the setting. Thanks.
resolution: You can update your PO number by navigating to the Admin Console, then Billing, and finally Billing Information. Locate the Purchase Order Number field to save your changes, which will apply to all future invoices. Please note that this change cannot be applied to invoices that have already been generated.

subject: google authenticator mfa code rejected
body: hi there, my mfa code from google authenticator is not working on the mobile app for our pro account and error auth-mfa-401.2 keeps showing up. i have a critical client demo at 5pm today so prompt help is really appreciated.
resolution: Please ensure your phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, we can guide you through re-setting up MFA for your account via the web app's Security Settings page.

subject: api errors crashing our scripts
body: our api requests are failing with error API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 constantly. this is stopping our automated workflows right now on our free account. please look into this quickly.
resolution: We have investigated your API usage patterns and noticed high request volumes. Please ensure you are monitoring the 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header and implement exponential backoff for your retries. Our engineering team is also monitoring the status page for any broader platform disruptions.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content
body: Our developers are seeing intermittent API-500 errors when fetching file content, especially for files in different regions. It is very frustrating to deal with these random failures. Please advise on how to stop this.
resolution: We are currently working on a fix for this storage retrieval issue to be included in our next hotfix. In the meantime, the best workaround is to implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. This should mitigate the impact of these intermittent errors.

subject: Need granular sub-folder permissions urgently
body: We urgently require more granular control over permissions within shared folders, such as view-only with ability to comment or upload-only for specific sub-folders. Our current external workflow is completely blocked by the lack of these precise access controls, and we need a solution immediately.
resolution: Hello. We understand the need for more granular permission controls, which are currently applied at the folder level. Please submit your specific requirements for advanced granular permissions at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions.

subject: Switching enterprise billing cycle to annual
body: Hi team, I am writing on behalf of our enterprise account to request a change in our subscription billing. We would like to switch our subscription from monthly to annual billing to take advantage of annual discounts. There is no rush on this, as we can wait until the next cycle if needed. Let me know what steps are required on our end.
resolution: Hello. To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: API 403 error when sharing workspaces
body: I am getting an API-403 error when trying to POST /workspaces/{id}/share. I have the manager role but it still fails. Need a fix asap as this is blocking our project.
resolution: Please verify that the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope specifically enabled. Also, ensure the user associated with that API key is a direct member of the workspace, rather than just belonging to a group. If this does not resolve the access issue, please provide the API key ID and workspace ID for further investigation.

subject: Desktop sync client not showing new web app files
body: Ever since the v4.2 desktop client update, files I add or modify in the web app refuse to appear in my desktop sync folder. There are no error messages anywhere, but it is extremely frustrating since everything looks fine in the browser and mobile app.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk on Windows or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk on macOS. Once cleared, reinstall the client using the download link found in your web app's Settings under the Desktop Sync section.

subject: Session expired error popping up constantly
body: I am so tired of this happening today because every time I log in, I am immediately logged out with a session expired message, or I cannot navigate past the dashboard before being logged out again! This is completely blocking my workflow on the free plan and I am very frustrated with this behavior. Please look into this session issue whenever possible.
resolution: Please instruct the user to clear their browser's cookies and local storage for cloudesk.com. Also check if they have strict privacy settings or browser extensions that might be interfering with session cookies, and verify the system time on their device.

subject: MFA registration failing on mobile
body: I am trying to set up MFA on my mobile device, but I keep getting an error after scanning the QR code. It says failed to register mfa device. It is quite frustrating, can you please help me get this sorted out soon?
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. To complete your setup, please navigate to the Security settings in the CloudDesk web app; once configured there, your MFA will function correctly across both web and mobile platforms.

subject: New user account not found error during login
body: One of our new hires is attempting to log in, but they keep getting a 'User Not Found' error, code AUTH-NF-404.1. We invited them yesterday and they confirmed they are using the correct credentials. It is quite annoying that their account isn't appearing as expected. Can you help us fix this?
resolution: Please double-check the email address you used to invite the user within the Admin Console. Confirm that the invitation was successfully sent and verify if the user has accepted it yet. If not, you may want to resend the invitation and ensure they are navigating to the specific instance URL for your company.

subject: CloudDesk Sync high resource usage
body: Our team is reporting that CloudDeskSync.exe is consuming over 2GB of memory on multiple machines. It is staying at high utilization even when the application is idle. This is blocking our staff from completing their tasks. We need a prompt solution for this sync_high_resource_usage issue.
resolution: Please check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files currently being processed by the client. We recommend pausing the sync, restarting the machine, and then resuming the process. If the issue persists, please temporarily pause sync during intensive tasks or ensure no antivirus software is actively scanning the sync directory.

subject: blank user activity report page
body: hi, when i open the user activity report in the admin console the page loads but remains totally blank. all other reports are showing data fine. report-001 error code is not appearing, it just sits there. please advise when you have a moment.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again, or try a different browser if the problem persists.

subject: Microsoft Teams integration inquiry

subject: Workspace loading issues

Please also check your browser console to ensure there are no specific network errors occurring during the load attempt.
