resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Okta SSO not functioning post v4.2
body: We are encountering an 'Invalid Token Format' error when attempting to log in via Okta SSO, which started immediately after the v4.2 platform release. All our users are facing this same issue, making it impossible to access the platform through Okta. Email/password logins are unaffected. Can you assist with this urgently?
resolution: We're sorry for the disruption caused by the Okta SSO login failure. This is due to SSO token handling adjustments in v4.2. Your IT administrator should update the CloudDesk application configuration in Okta, specifically by ensuring the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values detailed in the v4.2 SSO guide. This guide is available within your CloudDesk admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication'.

subject: Okta login broken - invalid token
body: Since the v4.2 update, our Okta SSO logins are failing. They redirect back to the login page with an 'Invalid Token Format' error. This is blocking my ability to work. Please provide a prompt solution.
resolution: We've identified the cause of the 'Invalid Token Format' error with Okta SSO after the v4.2 update. Your IT administrator should reconfigure the CloudDesk application within Okta. Please ensure they update the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' in Okta to match the values specified in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide, accessible via your admin console's 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' section.

subject: Slow performance in Admin Console user list
body: Navigating to the Users & Groups section takes several minutes to load because of our scale. Even searching for specific users is triggering ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT errors frequently. It is not an emergency, but it does impact our management efficiency.
resolution: We recommend applying filters, such as 'Status: Active', or using the search bar immediately when the page loads to narrow the dataset. The system is optimized for filtered views, so searching by email directly will be much faster for you.

subject: Lag during collaborative document editing
body: We have noticed a persistent lag when multiple users are editing a CloudDesk Office document at the same time. The cursor updates are slow and typing latency often reaches several seconds. This COLLAB_LAG error is making real-time collaboration difficult for our team.
resolution: Please ensure all collaborators have a stable internet connection and are not running unnecessary applications or browser tabs that might increase latency. If the issue persists, try clearing the browser cache for everyone involved in the document session.

subject: Invited user getting User Not Found on login
body: A newly invited user attempts to log in with their email and password but receives a User Not Found error. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm whether the invitation was sent and successfully accepted. If not, try resending the invitation. Please also check that the user is attempting to log into the correct instance URL if your organization has multiple accounts.

subject: API pagination limit parameter issue
body: Hello, we noticed that our automated scripts using pagination parameters like limit and offset are returning fewer results than expected or ignoring the limit parameter entirely. We are on the Pro plan and saw error code API-PAGINATION-500 on one of our recent test calls. There is no urgency on this, as we can wait for the next update.
resolution: Hello. Please ensure your API request correctly uses the 'limit' and 'offset' query parameters as specified in the CloudDesk API documentation. Note that there might be a hard cap on the maximum 'limit' allowed per request, typically set to 1000 items.

subject: accidental upgrade refund
body: i think i clicked the wrong button and upgraded our account by accident. can you help me get a refund for this? the reference code i saw is BILL-REF-005. we really need to stick to the free plan for now.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Requesting more detailed user activity reports
body: We need more granular reports on user activity, like specific file views or downloads, that go beyond the standard audit logs. Is this something that can be added? Let me know the best way to request this feature.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced reporting. Our current logs focus on basic tracking, so for advanced needs, please submit your specific use cases to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This helps our team prioritize the features that matter most to you.

subject: New user receiving User Not Found error on mobile app
body: We recently invited a new team member and they cannot log into the mobile app, getting error AUTH-NF-404.1. This is quite frustrating as we are trying to onboard staff for our upcoming project. Please look into this when you can.
resolution: Hello. Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Audit log search performance issues
body: Searching our audit logs is taking a very long time and often times out with AUDIT_LOG_FILTER_TIMEOUT. We need a more efficient way to filter our logs.
resolution: Please try narrowing your search by using shorter date ranges or specific users. If you need a large amount of historical data, I recommend exporting the full log and filtering it in a spreadsheet tool.

subject: API requests failing with 401 error
body: All of our automated scripts stopped working after the recent update. We are getting a 'legacy_token_format' error when calling the API, even though these tokens worked fine yesterday. This is blocking our entire workflow. Please help us fix this API-AUTH-401-V42 error immediately.
resolution: With the release of v4.2, we have implemented a new API token format for improved security. You will need to regenerate your API tokens via the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Once you update your scripts with these new keys, the connectivity should be restored.

subject: Issues adding new team members to our workspace subscription
body: Dear support, I hope you are having a pleasant week so far. I am currently helping out as an external contractor to manage the team roster on our free tier plan. While reviewing the subscription details earlier this afternoon, I noticed that we technically have a few available seats left. However, whenever I try to invite a new colleague to join us, the system pops up with the CD-AM-001 error and says seat limit reached. I wanted to reach out and see if you could help clarify why this discrepancy is happening.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: New users not provisioning via SSO
body: Hello, we have 'Just-in-Time Provisioning' enabled in our SSO settings, but new hires are not appearing in our CloudDesk user list automatically. We are receiving CD-AM-009 errors when attempting to authenticate new staff. Could you please investigate why this is happening? Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: Please verify that your Identity Provider is correctly passing the mandatory user attributes like email and name in your SAML assertion. You should also confirm there are enough available seats in your current subscription. Finally, please double-check the SSO settings page in your Admin Console for any misconfigurations.

subject: Switching subscription to annual billing
body: I am looking to update our current monthly subscription to an annual plan to save on costs. When I attempt to make this change in the admin console I receive error BILL-PLAN-004. Please let me know how to proceed.
resolution: To update your billing cycle, please navigate to Admin Console, then Billing, and select Subscription Details to change your plan. Choosing the annual option will apply the change at the start of your next billing cycle, with any remaining credit prorated accordingly.

subject: okta sso is completely broken
body: our team cannot log in using okta after the update. users are seeing an invalid sso token format error, and some logs show AUTH-SSO-401.1. this is blocking all access for our organization and we need a fix immediately.
resolution: Due to the SSO token format changes in version 4.2, your current configuration needs to be refreshed. Please go to the CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your identity provider metadata. This will update the token handling for your organization and restore access for your users.

subject: Slack notifications not showing up in channel
body: Why are our file share notifications still not showing up in our designated Slack channel on our pro workspace? We set everything up correctly days ago and nothing is coming through. This is extremely annoying and wasting our time. Take a look when you have a free moment.
resolution: Check the Slack integration settings in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app has permission to post in that channel within Slack.

subject: Admin console access denied for contractor
body: Hi, i am trying to access the admin console to finish up the workspace setup for the audit on Friday, but it keeps redirecting me or showing access denied. error is ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. please let me know what needs to be changed.
resolution: Confirm the user's role in the Admin Console ('Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Roles'). Ensure they have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned. If not, update their role.

subject: Desktop client creating constant duplicate files
body: The desktop sync client is incorrectly flagging files as conflicts even when nobody else is working on them. This creates a mess of duplicate files like filename (Conflict 2023-10-27).docx. This SYNC-003 error is making it difficult to manage our project files.
resolution: This usually happens due to network instability or security software interfering with our sync process. Please try temporarily disabling your antivirus or firewall to see if the conflicts cease. If that resolves it, be sure to add CloudDesk to your security software's whitelist.

subject: Azure AD nested group mapping needed
body: After upgrading to v4.2, we need the ability to map nested groups from Azure AD to CloudDesk workspaces for user provisioning. This is important and blocking our deployment. Please advise on how to set this up immediately.
resolution: Following the SSO token format change in v4.2, our current Azure AD SSO integration supports direct group mapping but not nested group resolution. We are aware of this limitation and are evaluating solutions. Please add your use case to roadmap.cloudesk.com/v4.2-enhancements/nested-azure-ad-groups. A potential workaround might involve flattening your Azure AD groups.

subject: API-403 error preventing workspace sharing
body: Hello, I am currently facing an API-403 error when calling POST /workspaces/{id}/share. Our team has a critical product demo at 5pm today and this is blocking our setup. My API user has the Manager role, but it keeps failing. Could you please assist with this as soon as possible? Thank you for your time.
resolution: Please ensure the API key you are using has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Additionally, the user associated with that key must be a direct member of the workspace, rather than inheriting access via a group. If this does not resolve the error, please send over the API key ID and workspace ID for our investigation.

subject: cannot delete workspace
body: i am trying to clean up my dashboard because we have way too many old projects from last year and i have some tea brewing on the stove but anyway the delete button gives me cd-am-007. it seems like a common issue right now for my colleagues too. i just want to tidy up.
resolution: Before you can delete a workspace, you must disconnect all active integrations linked to it. Please navigate to Workspace Settings and remove any connections like Slack or Jira. Once all integrations are disabled, you will be able to successfully delete the workspace.

subject: Desktop Sync app stuck on Indexing
body: I hope you are having a nice day. My desktop sync client has been stuck on Indexing for a while now, and none of my new files are appearing in the shared folders. It seems like a lot of our team is experiencing this SYNC_STATUS_STUCK behavior. Thank you for your help.
resolution: Please try restarting the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client first. If the status remains stuck, navigate to Settings, select Advanced, and choose Clear Cache to resolve the indexing delay. Should the problem persist, we recommend performing a full reinstall of the application after backing up any local, unsynced changes.

subject: Cannot access shared workspace with error PERM-WS-403.4
body: I am able to log into the web app using my developer account on the free tier, but I cannot open a specific shared workspace. I keep getting error PERM-WS-403.4. It looks like a few other people are experiencing this same unexpected permission block right now. Please let me know how to fix this whenever you have a chance, there is no rush.
resolution: An administrator needs to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check 'Members' or 'Permissions' and ensure the user is correctly assigned with appropriate access rights.

subject: Unable to update company name before payroll run
body: I am trying to change our Company Name in Admin Console settings, but the field is completely read-only and changes will not save. We are seeing error CD-AM-010. This is urgent because we have our payroll run tomorrow and all company details must be accurate.
resolution: The Company Name is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details by navigating to Admin Console > Subscription & Billing and updating the Organization Name there, which will propagate to the Company Settings.

subject: WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error on large workspaces
body: Hi my workspace is not loading at all. It keeps spinning for minutes until it fails with WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT. This is super frustrating because I need to get into these files now and it just shows a blank screen every time! Please look into this when you have a chance as it has been happening all morning.
resolution: It appears your workspace has exceeded 10,000 items, which is causing the load delay. Please try using the search or filter features to narrow your view, or consider splitting the workspace into smaller folders. If you continue to see the WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error, please let us know so we can investigate further.

subject: google sso login redirect loop
body: My team is stuck in a redirect loop when trying to login via google. It keeps bouncing back to the login page. Any idea whats happening with this?
resolution: Please instruct your users to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com' to resolve this. If the issue persists, advise them to try an incognito window or a different browser. We also recommend verifying your current Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Workspace with many files loads slowly
body: when opening workspaces with over 10000 items the page times out and shows a spinner for a very long time. we arent in a huge hurry since we can still access things eventually, but wanted to report it.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, and suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones while checking the browser console for any network errors.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental upgrade
body: We accidentally upgraded our plan earlier today and would like to request a refund. We meant to stay on the free tier and haven't used any of the paid features yet. We appreciate your assistance with this correction.
resolution: We can certainly review your account for a potential refund on this accidental upgrade. Please provide the exact date and time the charge occurred, and confirm that no paid features have been accessed by your team. Once we verify these details, we will determine your eligibility.

subject: Desktop sync client not updating files after v4.2
body: Files added in the web app are not appearing in our desktop sync client since the v4.2 update. There are no error messages shown. Please look into this.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk on Windows or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk on macOS. Afterward, reinstall the client using the download link found in your web app's Settings under the Desktop Sync section.

subject: App crash with large files
body: Uploading files over 1GB on mobile causes an immediate crash with error code CRASH-MOB-001. Please fix this soon.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please use the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client for files over 1GB. Our team is working on an update to resolve this.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error for specific users
body: We are encountering SSO-GOOGLE-403 errors when users from our newly acquired subsidiary domain attempt to log in via Google SSO. This is urgent because we have an important client demo at 5 PM today and those team members cannot access their workspaces. Please resolve this domain restriction immediately.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, check the 'Allowed Domains' list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO so those users can access their workspaces.

subject: Data export failing with 403 error on API
body: We are trying to use an API key with the Admin scope to call the user data export endpoint, but it keeps returning a 403 Permission Denied error. This exact integration was working fine until recently. Please help us fix this as it is disrupting our data pipeline.
resolution: Effective October 12, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in Admin Console > API Management.

subject: Refund request for accidental Enterprise plan upgrade
body: We accidentally upgraded our account to the Enterprise plan and need a refund. We have a financial audit on Friday and need our billing records cleaned up immediately. I am seeing error code BILL-REF-005 on the invoice page. Please process this refund as soon as possible as it is blocking our internal expense reporting.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled individually. Please confirm the exact time of the upgrade and that you have not utilized any Enterprise-specific features so we can assess your eligibility.

subject: api errors hitting our production scripts
body: Hi team, we are getting a lot of API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 errors while running our daily batches. It seems like the system is struggling during our peak processing times. Could you please look into this for us? Thanks for your help.
resolution: It looks like your integration is hitting our rate limits. Please implement an exponential backoff strategy in your scripts to handle these retries gracefully. You can monitor your remaining requests using the X-RateLimit-Remaining header in our API responses.

subject: Seat limit reached error incorrectly blocking new team members
body: Hello support, I am trying to add new team members in the admin console, but the system keeps throwing a CD-AM-001 error saying 'Seat limit reached'. However, our subscription details clearly show we have plenty of open seats available! Many customers are hitting this at the same moment right now, and it is completely blocking our department from bringing on our new hires. We need this fixed right away.
resolution: We apologize for the frustration caused by the seat limit error. Please verify the 'Pending Invitations' count under 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations', as pending invitations count toward your total seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Failed to register MFA device on mobile app
body: Hello, some of our office staff are trying to set up Google Authenticator on their mobile app, but they keep getting the failed to register MFA device error after scanning the QR code. Password login works fine, but they cannot finish setting up MFA on mobile. Please let us know how to fix this.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app by navigating to 'Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'. Once configured there, it will work seamlessly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: User Activity report not loading data
body: The User Activity report in the admin console is completely blank. I keep hitting a REPORT-001 error when I try to load it. I have an important audit this Friday and need this data immediately. Please help.
resolution: This usually points to a transient issue with data retrieval. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, then try loading the report again in a fresh session. If it remains blank, try a different browser to rule out extension interference and let me know if it persists.

subject: API returning 503 Service Unavailable errors
body: Our automated scripts are failing during high traffic with API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 errors. We really appreciate your help in getting this resolved, as it is currently stopping our daily workflows. Is there a way to prevent these interruptions during peak hours?
resolution: It looks like your volume might be hitting our rate limits. Please check the X-RateLimit-Remaining header in your responses and consider implementing exponential backoff in your scripts. If you are well within your limits, please let me know so I can investigate further.

subject: API endpoints returning 503 errors
body: Our automated scripts are failing with API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 errors. We need this addressed as soon as possible. Please look into it.
resolution: Please check your 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' headers to see if your request volume is exceeding our limits. If you are hitting limits, please implement an exponential backoff strategy in your scripts; otherwise, please check our status page for any ongoing platform incidents.

subject: Users randomly getting logged out after v4.2 update
body: Our team uses CloudDesk for our daily internal documentation and file sharing. Since the recent v4.2 update, many of us are being logged out unexpectedly, often seeing an SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 error. It is quite frustrating because I have to constantly re-authenticate, which disrupts our workflow significantly. Could you look into this immediately and let me know why this is happening?
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how SSO tokens are refreshed. Please ensure your Identity Provider settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled with a duration of 8 to 24 hours to resolve these premature expirations.

subject: Assistance needed with plan downgrade options
body: Good morning, our team has recently downsized and we would like to know how to downgrade our CloudDesk subscription plan to a more suitable tier. We have loved using the platform so far and just need to adjust our billing moving forward. Thank you for your guidance on this.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Audit log export truncated over 90 days
body: Thank you for the wonderful tool. We tried to export audit logs via the Admin Console for a range greater than 90 days, but received an Export range limit exceeded error. We have a compliance audit on Friday and need this data soon.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: password reset email not arriving
body: I am trying to reset my password, but I am not receiving the email despite checking my spam folder repeatedly. This AUTH-PR-200.1 error is becoming quite frustrating as I have work to finish. I am receiving other notifications from your system just fine, so it is clearly isolated to the reset flow.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and ensure that 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' is added to your domain's allowlist. If the issue persists, I can manually trigger a password reset email for you from our end.

subject: Duplicate conflict files appearing in desktop sync client
body: We are noticing that the desktop client is generating duplicate files with a conflict tag even though no one else is editing these documents. It is causing quite a bit of clutter in our shared folders. There is no specific error code appearing on my end. Could you please let us know how to prevent these unnecessary files from being created?
resolution: This behavior is often caused by security software interfering with our sync process. Please try temporarily disabling your antivirus or firewall to see if the syncing stabilizes. If it does, make sure to add CloudDesk to your security whitelist to prevent future conflicts.

subject: Cannot update Company Name
body: Hi, I am trying to update the company name in our settings but the field is read-only. I am the admin on the account, so I expected to be able to change this. Thanks for your help.
resolution: The company name is linked directly to your subscription and billing profile. You need to update the organization name within the Subscription & Billing tab of the Admin Console. Once you update it there, it will automatically sync to your Company Settings.

subject: Invalid card details error when updating billing
body: I am trying to update our payment method, but the system keeps throwing an Invalid Card Details error. I have confirmed the information is correct with the bank, but the payment still fails. It is very frustrating to deal with this repeatedly.
resolution: Temporary issues with payment gateways or bank security blocks can cause this behavior, so please try again after 30 minutes with any VPNs disabled. If the error continues, we recommend trying a different card or contacting your bank to ensure there is no block on transactions with CloudDesk. You can also provide the full error message if you need us to investigate further.

subject: Seat limit error when adding new members
body: I cant add new members to my team because it keeps saying seat limit reached. But the subscription page says I still have seats available. Im getting error CD-AM-001. Any ideas why?
resolution: This error usually happens because pending invitations are consuming your available seats. Please check the 'Pending Invitations' section within your team management console and revoke any old or unused invites. Once those seats are freed, you should be able to add new members without issue.

subject: API TOKENS BROKEN WITH 401 UNAUTHORIZED
body: EVERY SINGLE ONE OF OUR PRODUCTION API INTEGRATIONS HAS SUDDENLY STOPPED WORKING AFTER THE V4.2 RELEASE! We keep receiving API-AUTH-401-V42 and legacy_token_format errors across all automated endpoints. This is a severe emergency halting our core business operations and data synchronization processes right now. Fix this immediately!
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Desktop client SSO login failed
body: Hello CloudDesk Support team, we have many users who cannot log into the desktop sync client using SSO. The browser redirects, but the client shows 'Login Failed'. This is very urgent for us, as we have a presentation this afternoon at 3 PM and need access to files. Error code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3.
resolution: Please ensure that your desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Additionally, verify that the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a temporary workaround, users can try logging in via email and password if SSO is not strictly enforced in your settings.

subject: CANNOT TRANSFER WORKSPACE OWNERSHIP
body: Hi there! I am trying to transfer workspace ownership to another team member and I keep getting error CD-AM-004 saying I cannot transfer ownership to a non-owner, which makes zero sense! Fix this stupid bug whenever you get around to it.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Unable to transfer workspace ownership to another user
body: Hello CloudDesk team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. An administrator on our team is trying to transfer workspace ownership to a colleague, but the option is greyed out or shows an error message stating the transfer cannot be completed. We want to prepare everything cleanly before our quarterly review next week. Thank you very much for your kind help with this configuration.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: new user cannot login
body: i invited a new user and they try to login but the system says user not found. i check the dashboard and they are there as a member. not sure why they cant login? help with AUTH-NF-404.1.
resolution: Please verify that the user is attempting to log in through the correct instance URL for your account. If the information is correct, ensure the invitation was properly accepted from their email. If the issue persists, try removing the user from the workspace and resending the invitation.

subject: Audit logs timing out during search
body: I am attempting to pull audit logs for our team, but the system keeps timing out when I apply filters for long date ranges. This is affecting my ability to perform regular security reviews. I am receiving the error code AUDIT_LOG_FILTER_TIMEOUT. Please advise when you are able.
resolution: We recommend narrowing down your filter criteria, particularly by using shorter date ranges. For specific user activity, please use the 'User Activity' report, which is optimized for those queries. If you require extensive historical data, you can export the full log to filter it locally.

subject: Azure AD login error AUTH-SSO-403.2
body: I am managing the billing for our company and noticed our users are unable to log in via Azure AD this morning. They keep getting an AUTH-SSO-403.2 error message about incomplete profiles. We use this for all our internal tools and this is really blocking everyone from working today. Can you please look into why this is failing so we can get back on track?
resolution: Please have your Azure AD administrator verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped within the enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. You can find detailed steps in our Azure AD SSO configuration guide available in our knowledge base. This should resolve the profile attribute issues.

subject: S3 data export failing after upgrade
body: Since the v4.2 update, our automated data export to our AWS S3 bucket has stopped working. We are receiving an S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401 error, and it is crucial we fix this before our internal audit on Friday. We haven't changed our credentials, so we are quite confused why this is happening now.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced stricter IAM policy requirements for S3 integrations. Your existing IAM policy likely needs the 's3:GetBucketLocation' permission to function correctly with our updated export tool. Please review the v4.2 S3 Integration Guide to update your AWS permissions accordingly.

subject: GDPR export missing file comments
body: I am working through our GDPR compliance requirements and noticed that my recent data export is missing comments made on specific files. It seems like the core data is there, but the contextual notes are gone. Is there a way to include these, as this is currently affecting our audit process?
resolution: The current GDPR export tool is designed to capture core file and folder structures, while comments are stored as activity metadata. You can access these comments by visiting the activity log of the specific file or task in question. We do not currently have a single bulk export feature for all user comments across the platform.

subject: storage limit reached again
body: this is so annoying. we keep hitting the storage limit and i cant add any more files. why is the free plan so tiny. i keep seeing error code n/a everywhere. can you just bump up our space without making us pay?
resolution: I appreciate your feedback regarding our current storage limits. Our free tier is designed for starters, and we do not have plans to increase storage capacity for those accounts. Please consider our paid plans if your team requires more space for your projects.

subject: Desktop Sync client stuck on indexing!
body: Our whole team is having issues with the sync client. It just stays at indexing or connecting forever and we arent getting our files. We are seeing a SYNC_STATUS_STUCK error. Please help us fix this now, we have deadlines to meet.
resolution: Please try restarting your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client first. If that doesn't work, go to Settings, then Advanced, and select Clear Cache. If the files still aren't syncing, please back up any local changes and perform a full reinstall of the application.

subject: new user stuck pending
body: sent invite to new hire but their status is still pending invitation and they cant login at all error code CD-AM-005 no rush though
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set (if any). If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and send a new one.

subject: Unable to switch to annual billing
body: I am trying to move our account to an annual plan to save on costs, but the system keeps throwing the BILL-PLAN-004 error. It is quite annoying that I cannot manage my own subscription settings. I have a moment to wait, but please look into this when you have a chance.
resolution: I apologize for the frustration with the billing portal. To switch your cycle, navigate to the Admin Console, go to Billing, then Subscription Details, and select Change Plan. From there, you can select the annual option and the system will handle the proration for your account automatically at the start of the next cycle.

subject: Billing page error after logging in via SSO
body: Good morning. Since the recent v4.2 update, our office staff cannot access the billing section in the admin console when logged in via SSO. We keep getting an authentication and payment processing error, even though other admin settings work properly. This is blocking our accounting work today, so your prompt help would be greatly appreciated.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: API Integration Failing - Client Not Authorized
body: We are setting up a new integration using the CloudDesk REST API, but all our API calls are failing. We're consistently receiving a 'Client Not Authorized' or 403 Forbidden error, specifically API-AUTH-403.5, even though we are using what we believe is a valid API key. This is blocking our integration work. Could you please look into this?
resolution: The 'Client Not Authorized' or 403 Forbidden error typically indicates that the API key being used does not have the necessary scopes or permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints you are calling. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'. Please ensure the key has all required permissions for your integration.

subject: API tokens returning 401 Unauthorized after v4.2 update
body: Hello support team, ever since we updated to v4.2, all of our previously working Pro plan API tokens are throwing a 401 Unauthorized with the legacy_token_format error. We are experiencing critical failures across multiple backend services and revenue is directly affected. Could you please provide immediate assistance with this urgent matter?
resolution: Thank you for contacting us regarding the critical disruption after the v4.2 update, where the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications promptly to use these newly generated tokens.

subject: API authorization failing after v4.2 update
body: Our automated scripts are failing with a 401 Unauthorized error after our transition to v4.2. The error message specifically mentions 'legacy_token_format'. This is currently blocking our backend services from syncing data. Can you provide a fix for this as soon as possible?
resolution: The API token format was updated in v4.2 for improved security. You will need to regenerate all existing API tokens from the API & Integrations section in your Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new tokens to restore your service connectivity.

subject: Unable to edit Company Name in Admin Console
body: I am trying to update our company name before our internal audit on Friday but the field is locked. I am getting error CD-AM-010. I need this resolved promptly please.
resolution: The company name field is read-only because it is linked to your billing profile. To update this, please navigate to Admin Console > Subscription & Billing and change the Organization Name there. Once saved, the name will automatically update in your Company Settings.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Greetings, I am writing to you today regarding an issue with our account credentials management. As you know, maintaining secure access is very important for our finance operations, especially since we work with sensitive vendor invoices and payroll data across multiple platforms. One of our team members requested a password reset earlier this morning, but the verification email has failed to arrive in their inbox or spam folder. We already confirmed that regular notifications from CloudDesk are coming through without any problems. Could you please look into why this specific message was not delivered? There is no major rush on this since they remembered their password eventually, but it would be good to understand for the future.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Check if the user's domain is configured with an approved email sender list. If not, advise adding 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to their allowlist. Manually trigger a password reset from the Admin Console if necessary.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA failing to login
body: Our assistant is having trouble with the login process. The MFA code from the Google Authenticator app is not being accepted by the system, often giving AUTH-MFA-401.2. Could you help us resolve this issue?
resolution: Please ensure your phone's time is set to synchronize automatically with network time. If this does not resolve the login error, you may need to re-set up MFA by navigating to the Security Settings in your web account.

subject: need more storage on free plan
body: hi we are hitting our storage limit very fast and wondering if we can get an increase on the free tier since our team is growing a bit
resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time. Please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in admin console
body: hey team, noticed a minor display glitch in the users & permissions section of the admin console where contributor roles show up as manager instead. ui-admin-003 is what we see. actual workspace permissions are fine though, so no real rush on this one.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug. The actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: User invitation status stuck
body: I sent an invite to a new hire but they are still showing as Pending Invitation in the console. They cant log in at all. I see CD-AM-005. Can you help?
resolution: This delay often occurs if the email domain isn't fully set for auto-join or if the invitation signal was interrupted. Please ask the user to attempt a direct login with their email address; if that fails, revoke the current invitation in the Team Management section and send a fresh one. This should clear the CD-AM-005 error and allow them to complete the setup.

subject: Incorrect tax rate on invoice
body: Hi, the tax amount on our last bill looks wrong. We are based in a tax exempt region but the system applied full vat. I keep seeing BILL-TAX-006 on the invoice page. Could you fix this please?
resolution: Please double-check that your tax ID and billing address are entered correctly under the Billing section of your Admin Console. If those details are accurate, please send us your legal business name and a copy of your tax exemption certificate for a manual review.

subject: System failure: Our custom integration is down for today
body: I am trying to run our automated payroll system but keep getting an OAUTH-AUTH-401 error. Everything was working fine yesterday, but now it says client_secret_mismatch. We have a hard deadline to finish payroll by tomorrow and this is completely blocking our workflow. Please help us fix this immediately.
resolution: Please verify that the 'Client ID' and 'Client Secret' in your application match exactly what is shown in your Admin Console under 'API & Integrations'. These values are case-sensitive, so ensure there are no trailing spaces included when you copy them over.

subject: Password reset email not received
body: I am writing because one of our main project leads is unable to log in to get the final documents for our client demo at 5pm today. We have requested a password reset multiple times, but the email never arrives in their inbox or spam. We really need this fixed because the demo is our biggest opportunity this quarter. I have checked the user settings and everything looks fine, but the system just won't send the link. The error code is CD-AM-008.
resolution: Please confirm the user's email address is active in your Admin Console. Ask the user to check their junk folders and ensure they have whitelisted no-reply@cloudesk.com. If the email still does not arrive, an admin can manually trigger a password reset for them directly through the User management menu.

subject: Downgrade subscription plan request
body: Hello, we wish to downgrade our CloudDesk subscription plan to a lower tier due to reduced team size and feature needs. No rush on this, whenever you have time.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: New user having trouble logging in with email and password
body: Good afternoon, I am writing to you today regarding a user we just invited to our workspace on the free tier. We went through the usual onboarding steps, but when they tried to log in using their credentials this morning, they were greeted by an unexpected error. It seems lots of people are experiencing similar authentication hiccups today, and we keep seeing AUTH-NF-404.1 on their screen. We would like to get this sorted out soon, though there is no massive rush.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in your Admin Console to ensure it was entered correctly. Confirm whether the invitation was successfully sent and accepted by them, and resend the invitation if necessary. Additionally, check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if your organization maintains multiple accounts.

subject: Mobile app notifications delayed
body: Push notifications are not coming through on mobile. Often arrive late or not at all until I open the app.
resolution: Please ensure that push notifications are enabled in both your CloudDesk mobile app settings and your device's operating system settings. Additionally, check for any battery optimization settings on your device that might be restricting background app activity. If the issue persists, reinstalling the mobile app may help.

subject: ANNOYING NOTIFICATION OVERLOAD FIX THIS
body: The current notifications are completely useless because they spam us for every single comment instead of just direct mentions! We need granular control over these alerts immediately.
resolution: We hear your feedback regarding notification preferences. Currently, you can adjust general settings in your profile, but for more granular control, please outline your specific scenarios at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error for specific users
body: Hello, we noticed that users from a couple of our newly added corporate domains cannot log in via Google SSO and receive a Domain not allowed message. Other domains on our FREE tier are working as expected. Could you kindly advise how we can resolve this when you have a moment?
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's SSO & Identity settings for Google SSO, check the Allowed Domains list. Simply add any missing domains that should be permitted to authenticate through Google SSO to restore access for your users.

subject: API key scope bypass allowing unauthorized actions
body: Hi team we noticed that our restricted api key is able to delete users even though it only has file read permissions. this is a major security flaw for us. please help fix this quickly as it is blocking our work.
resolution: Please revoke the compromised API key immediately by navigating to Admin Console > API Management. We are currently investigating why certain restricted keys permitted broader actions, but revoking and regenerating the key will secure your account. Let us know if the scope bypass persists after rotation so we can escalate to engineering.

subject: Slow workspace loading for large folders
body: We have a few workspaces with over 10,000 files and they are becoming unusable. It takes forever to load, and I often see WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT before the screen eventually goes blank. Is there a way to improve this performance?
resolution: To improve loading times for large workspaces, we suggest using our search or filter tools to narrow down your view. For optimal performance, we also recommend breaking exceptionally large workspaces into smaller, more manageable collections of files.

subject: Invitation emails not arriving to new members
body: We are trying to add new staff to our workspace, but they never get the invite emails. Everything shows as pending on our end. Is there an issue with the system sending these out? We are seeing the EMAIL-005 error code.
resolution: Please check the spam folders of the invited users first to ensure the messages were not filtered. You should also verify that your domain's SPF and DKIM records are correctly set up for CloudDesk, as detailed in our Admin Console documentation. If you still have trouble, please send us the specific email addresses of the users who did not receive their invites.

subject: storage limit increase request
body: hey there our small team on the free tier is hitting the storage limit really fast can we get an increase on our storage without having to upgrade to a paid plan thanks
resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time, but please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

subject: API permission denied issue
body: Hi there, I am getting a 403 error when calling the export endpoint with my admin key. It was working yesterday but suddenly stopped today. Any help would be appreciated, thanks for your time.
resolution: As of our recent update, the Admin API scope no longer includes data export permissions. You will need to generate a new API key assigned to the Data Steward role. Please update your integration to use this new credential to restore access.

subject: Audit log export range limit issue
body: So I was trying to export some logs earlier while grabbing a cup of coffee and thinking about our database architecture and the weather outside which is quite nice actually when the admin user attempted to export audit logs via Admin Console for a date range greater than 90 days, but the export fails or is truncated. The error message said Export range limit exceeded 90 days maximum and sometimes shows AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. No rush on this.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with invalid token format
body: Hi Support, our team members cannot log in using Okta SSO after the latest update, encountering the error code AUTH-SSO-401.1. We are experiencing a wave of login failures across the platform at this exact moment. This is critical because we have an executive board meeting starting in thirty minutes and everyone is locked out.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Need more detailed user activity reports please
body: Hi team we are looking for deeper insights into user activity like file downloads and views in the admin console. The standard audit logs dont give us enough detail for our internal compliance reviews. Is there a way to pull this data right now? Thanks.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Request for advanced user activity auditing

resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking, but for more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific needs on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting.

subject: Mobile app crashes when uploading large files over 1GB

Smaller files work fine, but this specific issue with error code CRASH-MOB-001 is blocking our fieldwork operations and we urgently need a fix. Thank you very much for your prompt attention to this matter.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Invalid card details error on payment
body: Thank you for the great software! I am trying to update my billing info but it keeps telling me my credit card details are invalid, error BILL-PAY-012. I have double-checked everything and the info is definitely correct. I appreciate any help you can provide.
resolution: This can happen due to a temporary gateway issue or specific security restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again in 30 minutes; otherwise, try a different card or contact your bank to verify there are no blocks on CloudDesk transactions.

subject: Unable to export audit logs beyond 90 days
body: I am trying to pull an audit report for the last four months, but the system keeps throwing an error: AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. It seems like the console is enforcing a 90-day limit that we previously did not encounter. Please let me know how I can get the full data set.
resolution: The direct export feature in the console is indeed capped at 90 days. To pull a larger range, you can use our API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with your specified date parameters. If you aren't set up for API access, just let me know the date range you need and I can generate a manual export for you.

subject: Prolonged SSO loading times after v4.2 update
body: Dear support team, users attempting to log in via SSO experience prolonged loading times after authentication with their IdP, sometimes resulting in a timeout or a failed to retrieve token error. This started right after the v4.2 release and we are seeing SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2 across our enterprise tenant. We urgently request your assistance to resolve this login blocker.
resolution: This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Please re-save your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the 'Application Sign On URL' format, and clear browser cache and cookies for affected users.

subject: deleted user still showing up in sharing dialogs
body: Hi there. An administrator on our free account deleted a user last week, but their name and email still appear in the sharing dialogs for various workspaces. We are seeing error code CD-AM-006 on some admin screens related to this. Please let us know how to clear this out when you have a moment.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as 'ghost' entries in historical share lists until the system purges them, which typically takes within 24 to 48 hours. Alternatively, they will disappear once a workspace owner explicitly removes them from a share via 'Workspace Settings > Members'. This is expected system behavior.

subject: Frequent SSO logouts after update
body: Since upgrading to v4.2, our team is constantly being logged out with an 'SSO session expired' message. This is blocking our work and causing significant frustration. We are seeing error code SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 consistently. Please provide a solution promptly as this is impacting our operations.
resolution: v4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta/Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration (e.g., 8-24 hours) to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: accidental upgrade charge please refund NOW
body: we accidentally upgraded our free plan and need our money back!! bill-ref-005 keeps showing on the invoice page. fix this and issue a refund please.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Switching subscription to annual billing
body: I would like to change our monthly subscription to an annual one to get the discount. I tried using the console but kept seeing error BILL-PLAN-004. Can you help us get this switched over? Thanks for your time.
resolution: To update your billing cycle, please navigate to the Admin Console, then go to Billing, and select Subscription Details to find the Change Plan option. Once you select the annual billing toggle for your current plan, the change will take effect at the start of your next billing period. Any remaining credit from your current monthly cycle will be automatically prorated.

subject: File previews are broken
body: I am unable to preview any PDFs or PPTX files in the web app. It just shows a spinning loader indefinitely and I get the PREVIEW-006 error code. This is stopping me from reviewing documents for my project, so please help.
resolution: This is often due to a browser cache issue or a temporary rendering service hiccup. Please try clearing your cache or opening the site in an incognito window, and verify the file is not password-protected.

subject: Slow performance in Users & Groups
body: Loading the user list in the admin console is taking several minutes. This makes managing our large team very difficult. Thank you for looking into this.
resolution: The system performance is optimized when using the search bar or applying status filters to narrow down the dataset. Rather than loading the full list, please try filtering by 'Active' users or searching for specific emails. This will significantly reduce load times for your large account.

subject: Requesting PDF versions of invoices
body: I am currently trying to pull our monthly billing records from the Admin Console. It seems only CSV is available for download at the moment. We really need these in PDF for our compliance records. Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is currently unavailable for some records due to a recent system migration. If you provide the specific invoice IDs you require, we can manually generate the PDF files and email them to you directly. We appreciate your patience while we work on restoring the automatic export feature.

resolution: Please check that your current API key has the correct scopes assigned for the endpoints you are attempting to access. You can review and adjust these permissions directly in the Admin Console under the API Keys section.

subject: account locked error after multiple attempts

resolution: Instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

resolution: We understand your frustration regarding the current notification preferences. You can adjust basic settings in your profile, but for more granular control, please outline your specific notification scenarios at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications. This feedback directly helps our product team prioritize these improvements.

resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: User Activity report is loading blank

resolution: This usually indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, or try accessing the report from a different browser to rule out extension interference. If the page remains blank, please provide the specific date range you are attempting to view.

subject: Activity log showing incorrect usernames for file edits

resolution: This is a known display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is active in the workspace, though the underlying audit trail remains correct. For an accurate audit right now, please cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console while our engineering team addresses the bug.

subject: CONSTANTLY LOGGING OUT! Session Expired message!
body: I log in, and immediately, or sometimes after just a minute, I get logged out with a 'Session Expired' message! I can't even get past the dashboard before it happens again. This is incredibly frustrating! What is going on?! The error is AUTH-SESSION-401.5!
resolution: We understand this is extremely frustrating. The 'Session Expired' message, often seen with AUTH-SESSION-401.5, usually indicates an issue with browser data or settings. Please clear your browser's cookies and local storage specifically for 'cloudesk.com'. Also, check if you have any strict privacy settings or browser extensions that might be interfering with how session cookies are handled. Finally, please verify that your device's system time is correctly synchronized.

subject: Okta SSO login issue after v4.2 update - AUTH-402
body: Users attempting to log in via Okta SSO are being redirected back to the login page with an 'Invalid Token Format' error. This started occurring immediately after the v4.2 platform update. Email/password login works correctly, but we rely heavily on SSO. Please advise on how to fix this, as it's preventing many of our staff from accessing files.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide (accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration').

subject: api error on get files
body: our developers are getting API-500 errors when fetching file content. please fix this now as it is blocking us.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Intermittent HTTP 500 errors on file content API
body: We are consistently seeing API-500 errors when fetching file content through the API. This seems to happen mostly with files in regional storage. We need this resolved quickly to keep our integration running.
resolution: We are currently investigating the root cause regarding distributed storage retrieval. In the meantime, we recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. A permanent fix will be included in our next scheduled hotfix.

resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is currently limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script. If you are unable to use the API, please let us know so we can coordinate a manual data pull for you.

subject: Billing section failing with SSO login

resolution: The recent SSO token format changes are causing a conflict with our billing portal's authentication. Please try clearing your browser cookies or logging in using your direct email/password for this specific task. We are investigating the SSO handshake for billing management to ensure a permanent fix.

subject: cant remove workspace owner error
body: Hi there hope youre having a good week. Im trying to remove a user from a workspace but it wont let me and says they are an owner. Error code is CD-AM-014. Could you let me know how to fix this when you have a moment, thank you so much.
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace. The ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign.

subject: API share workspace error

resolution: Please confirm that your API key has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled and that the user associated with the key is a direct member of the workspace. If this remains unresolved, kindly provide the specific API key and workspace ID so I can investigate further.

resolution: Please verify that the user's email address is correctly entered in the Admin Console under Team Management. Ask the user to check their spam filters and consider whitelisting no-reply@cloudesk.com. If the email still doesn't arrive, you can manually trigger a password reset for them directly from the Admin Console user management screen.

subject: Desktop client SSO issue: login failed

resolution: To resolve this, please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Also, confirm that the default browser on the affected machines is correctly configured for SSO redirects. As a temporary measure, users can attempt to log in using their email and password if your SSO policy permits this.

resolution: Please verify your API key's current status inside the Admin Console under the API Keys section to check if it has recently expired or been revoked. If needed, you can regenerate a new API key right there and update your application settings with the new value.

subject: Pending user deletion request not processing
body: We initiated a user data deletion request from the Admin Console on our enterprise plan, but the status remains pending for over 48 hours and no confirmation email was received. We encountered error code USER_DELETE_PENDING. This is blocking our administrative workflow and requires prompt assistance.
resolution: Please verify that the user's status is set to 'Inactive' before requesting deletion, as active users will cause the deletion to remain queued. If the user is inactive and still pending, check the System Status page for any background job processing issues, and let us know if you need further investigation.

subject: SSO login failing specifically on billing management
body: Ever since the v4.2 release, our admin users encounter authentication errors when trying to access the billing section via SSO, while all other admin functions work perfectly. We are on the Enterprise tier and need this resolved for our upcoming financial reviews. Please let us know what steps are required to fix this session issue.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email and password if enabled, or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email and password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Unable to update credit card info - BILL-PAY-012
body: I am trying to update our billing details in the admin console, but the system keeps throwing an Invalid Card Details error. I have confirmed all numbers and the CVV are accurate, yet we see error code BILL-PAY-012 every time we save. This is preventing us from finalizing our payment. We would truly appreciate your prompt help in looking into this.
resolution: This can happen due to temporary gateway issues or card issuer restrictions. Please ensure you do not have a VPN active and try again after 30 minutes. If the problem continues, please try a different card or contact your bank to verify there are no transaction blocks on our service.

subject: Webhook delivery issues
body: Hello, we have noticed some of our webhooks are failing with a connection refused error. I believe this might be related to the recent platform update. Could you please check why our external service is no longer receiving these? Thanks for your help.
resolution: Please verify that your webhook endpoint URL is correctly configured and publicly accessible. You may need to update your firewall to allow incoming traffic from our current IP range, which you can find in our technical documentation.

subject: API authentication failing
body: Our new integration is failing with a 403 Forbidden error, labeled as API-AUTH-403.5. We have a live demo at 5pm today and this is currently blocking our entire deployment. Please assist immediately.
resolution: This error typically indicates that your API key lacks the required scopes for the endpoints you are calling. An administrator should log into the Admin Console to review the key permissions and ensure all necessary scopes are enabled for this integration.

subject: custom branding missing on sso login page
body: when our users hit the sso login page our custom company logo and background are completely gone showing default clouddesk branding instead. its pretty annoying and looks unprofessional for our pro workspace. no huge rush to fix right this second but please look into it soon.
resolution: Guide the admin to the 'SSO & Branding' section in the Admin Console. Check if the custom branding assets (logo, background) are uploaded and saved correctly. Advise clearing browser cache for affected users.

subject: Desktop app SSO redirect issue
body: Thank you for the recent updates. We are noticing that when users try to log into the desktop client, the browser redirect happens but the app doesn't sign them in. We occasionally see a DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 code. Any advice would be appreciated.
resolution: Please verify that your desktop sync client has been updated to version 4.2.1 or higher to ensure compatibility with recent SSO changes. Additionally, check that your default browser is correctly configured to handle these authentication callbacks. If the problem persists, users can temporarily authenticate via email and password as a workaround while we investigate further.

subject: SLACK-NOTIFY-500 file share alerts not working
body: file share notifications arent showing up in slack at all. getting SLACK-NOTIFY-500 errors in our logs. no rush on this since we can check manually for now.
resolution: Check the Slack integration settings in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app has permission to post in that channel within Slack.

subject: API intermittent 500 error on file downloads
body: I am writing to report an issue with the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. We are seeing API-500 errors occurring periodically when our systems try to fetch files. This seems to happen more frequently for our European branch data. Could you please look into this as it is blocking our automated backup processes?
resolution: This intermittent error can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Unable to generate API key
body: I was recently promoted to admin, but I am unable to generate an API key. The option is greyed out under Security. I see error code CD-AM-013 when I hover over it. Thank you for your help whenever you have a moment.
resolution: Generating API keys requires the specific 'Super Admin' role. Please have your current Super Admin verify your permissions in the Team Management section. If you do not have those privileges, they will need to either elevate your account or generate the key for you.

subject: Requesting more storage for free team
body: We love the product but we are hitting our storage limits on our free tier team. We were wondering if there is any way to get more space without moving to a paid plan. Just let me know what the options are.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out regarding your storage usage. Our current limits are set to provide a consistent experience, and we do not offer storage increases for the free tier at this time. We would encourage you to review our paid plans which provide significantly more storage and advanced collaboration tools.

subject: cant download pdf invoices only csv

subject: Permission denied on shared workspace
body: Hello support team. A user is able to log in successfully but encounters PERM-WS-403.4 when trying to access a specific shared workspace. Please advise how we can fix their permissions.
resolution: An administrator needs to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check 'Members' or 'Permissions' and ensure the user is correctly assigned with appropriate access rights.

subject: cant preview my files online

Please clear your browser's cookies and cache, or try opening the preview in an incognito window to see if an extension is interfering. Also, ensure your files are not password-protected, as that can prevent the preview from generating.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: Hello, I noticed our latest bill shows a higher user count than we actually have. We checked bill-inv-001 and it seems inconsistent with our active team roster. Could you please look into this whenever you have a moment? Thanks for your assistance.
resolution: Please check the billing date and proration period listed on your invoice, as user count changes are usually applied at the start of your next billing cycle. If you still see a discrepancy after reviewing those details, please send over your invoice ID and current active user count for a manual audit.

subject: Google SSO login loop
body: Our team is encountering a recurring redirect loop when attempting to log in via Google SSO. After authenticating with Google, we are never redirected to the dashboard. Several of our users are reporting error code AUTH-SSO-302.1. Could you please look into this?
resolution: Please instruct your users to clear their browser's cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com. If the issue persists, they should attempt to log in using an incognito window or an alternative browser. We also recommend verifying your Google SSO configuration settings in the Admin Console.

subject: Webhook delivery failure alerts

resolution: Please verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range by referring to our documentation for current IPs.

subject: Critical: SSO login broken for all users
body: Our entire team is locked out due to Invalid SSO Token errors following the update. This is a business-critical issue that needs resolution now. The SSO_TOKEN_FORMAT_401 error is appearing for everyone. Fix this immediately.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Administrators must re-configure the SSO integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Please refer to the v4.2 release notes for the detailed steps to restore access.

subject: Desktop Sync is stuck indexing files
body: The desktop client is showing SYNC_STATUS_STUCK and it is not uploading any of my latest changes. This is a real problem because I have a crucial presentation for a prospect at 5pm today. Could you help me get this resolved as quickly as possible?
resolution: Please start by restarting your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If that does not resolve the SYNC_STATUS_STUCK error, navigate to 'Settings' > 'Advanced' and clear your application cache. If you are still having trouble before your demo, you may need to back up your local files and perform a clean reinstallation of the application.

subject: Desktop client causing extreme CPU and memory spikes
body: Since the latest update, the sync client is consistently consuming over 50 percent CPU and massive memory even when sitting idle. This is freezing up several machines in our office and destroying battery life. We are getting error code PERF-DSK-001 on the diagnostic logs. Please fix this soon.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon, then go to Settings, Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database before resuming syncing.

subject: Desktop client wont authenticate with SSO
body: Hi there, im having trouble logging into the sync app. The browser opens but then it just says Login Failed. Could you please help us out as this is blocking our project delivery.
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to at least version v4.2.1. Verify that your default web browser is set up correctly to handle the redirect, or you may try using email and password authentication if your account allows. Let us know if the issue persists after updating.

subject: Cannot set audit log retention past 12 months
body: Hello, I am trying to configure our audit log retention period to 5 years for our company compliance requirements. However, the maximum selectable value in the admin console is only 12 months. Please let us know how we can extend this.
resolution: Hello. The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution (e.g., Splunk, Sumo Logic) via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. This is a feature request for extending native retention.

subject: billing api data inconsistent after update
