The numbers dont match up at all and its causing some minor confusion. We see error code API-BILL-401 sometimes. Let me know when you can look at this.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as per the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, please provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for review.

subject: Incorrect user attribution in activity logs

Its super weird because they were just moving folders around the main dir, and I keep seeing AUDIT-004. Hope you can fix this soon.
resolution: This is a known display glitch where actions by 'Contributor' roles are misattributed when an admin is active in the same space. Please rest assured the underlying audit trail remains accurate, and you can verify the true author by cross-referencing the global audit log in the admin console. We are working on a permanent fix for this display error.

subject: Azure AD nested group mapping failing for audit tomorrow
body: since the v42 update we cant map nested groups from azure ad to clouddesk workspaces for user provisioning. we have an audit on friday and this is completely blocking our user management on our ENTERPRISE plan. fix this right now.
resolution: Following the SSO token format change in v4.2, our current Azure AD SSO integration supports direct group mapping but not nested group resolution. We are aware of this limitation and are evaluating solutions. Please add your use case to our roadmap page, and note that a potential workaround might involve flattening your Azure AD groups.

subject: Accidental upgrade refund request

resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account for eligibility.

resolution: This issue is likely caused by a temporary data retrieval snag. Please clear your browser's cache and cookies before attempting to load the report again. If it remains blank, please try a different browser or confirm if any extensions might be blocking the page.

Thank you for your continued great service, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts on this.
resolution: Hello. We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. For more advanced reporting capabilities beyond our basic audit logs, please describe your specific use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting.

subject: Cannot delete workspace due to active integrations
body: We are trying to delete a workspace on our Enterprise account, but we keep getting an Active Integrations Detected error CD-AM-007. We have an executive audit on Friday and really need this cleaned up soon. Please help us resolve this error.
resolution: Before a workspace can be deleted, all active integrations (e.g., Slack, Jira, Zapier) linked to that specific workspace must be disconnected. Navigate to 'Workspace Settings > Integrations' for the affected workspace and disable/remove all listed integrations, then retry deletion.

subject: Okta SSO broken with invalid token format
body: Our entire team cannot log in through Okta SSO after the v4.2 update this morning! Every attempt redirects back to the login page with an invalid token format error. Email and password login works, but we need our SSO fixed immediately because this is blocking all our work.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2 which triggers the AUTH-402 error. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values found in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: Deleted files staying in trash past 30 days
body: We set up a strict 30-day data retention policy for deleted files, but things in the trash bin are still visible and recoverable way past 30 days. We are getting the RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED error message and need this fixed right away to comply with our internal governance.
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: Unrecognized charge on our corporate credit card

This is holding up our entire accounting reconciliation process which must be finished by tomorrow morning for the payroll run. Please explain error code BILL-CHG-010 immediately so I can clear this before my deadline.
resolution: To investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, the transaction date, and the last 4 digits of the card used. Our billing team will then cross-reference these details with your account history to resolve this for you.

subject: Blank User Activity Report in Admin Console
body: Hello support team, whenever I try to open the User Activity report in the admin console, the page just loads blank. All other reports seem to be working fine. It is a bit annoying, though no real rush since I can check it later this week.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering before reaching back out.

subject: Webhook HMAC verification failed error
body: External service rejects CloudDesk webhooks due to invalid signature reporting HMAC verification failed. Please help us fix this error immediately as our workflows are blocked.
resolution: Ensure the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the 'Webhook Secret' configured in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify your signature verification algorithm matches CloudDesk's (HMAC-SHA256).

subject: Unable to update company name in settings
body: The company name field in the admin console is read-only and will not save our updates. Please advise.
resolution: The Company Name is tied directly to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details by navigating to Admin Console > Subscription & Billing and updating the Organization Name there. This change will then automatically propagate to your Company Settings.

subject: Google SSO domain restriction failing for new users
body: Hello Support, users belonging to our contractor domains are experiencing login failures with the SSO-GOOGLE-403 error when attempting to authenticate via Google SSO. Primary company domains authenticate without issue. Please let us know what adjustments are needed on our account.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's SSO & Identity settings for Google SSO, check the Allowed Domains list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership to nonowner
body: Good morning. As I was going through my morning coffee routine and preparing the weekly executive board packets while waiting for our regional directors to submit their quarterly slides, I noticed a roadblock. I am trying to transfer ownership of a workspace and the option is greyed out. We are getting the error CD-AM-004. This is blocking our administrative workflow, so prompt help is greatly appreciated.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop on login

resolution: Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, as this often resolves the redirect loop. If the issue persists, try accessing your dashboard in an incognito window or using a different browser. We also recommend verifying your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console to ensure everything is set up correctly.

resolution: This often occurs if a workspace contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested structures. Please try using more specific keywords to narrow your search. If the issue persists, please provide the specific workspace ID so we can have our engineering team review the indexing.

resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: New SSO users not auto provisioning CD-AM-009
body: Hello! We recently enabled Just-in-Time Provisioning for our SSO setup, but new users logging in are not being provisioned automatically. We are seeing error code CD-AM-009 in our logs. Please help us resolve this blocker as soon as possible, thank you!
resolution: Verify that your SSO Identity Provider (IdP) is correctly sending the required user attributes (email, first_name, last_name) in the SAML/OIDC assertion. Also, ensure there are available seats in your CloudDesk subscription. Check 'Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings' for any recent configuration changes or errors.

subject: Mobile app file cache not clearing on logout
body: I am concerned about data privacy because files opened in the mobile app remain on the device after logging out. There is no visible option to purge these files, and I am seeing the MOBILE_APP_CACHE_PERSISTENCE error. How can we ensure these documents are deleted once a user leaves the app?
resolution: The mobile app caches files locally to facilitate offline access. You can manually clear this data by visiting Settings within the CloudDesk app, selecting Storage, and then Clear Cached Files. Additionally, you should enable the Clear cache on logout option in that same menu to ensure data is removed automatically in the future.

subject: Google SSO login loop

resolution: This redirect issue is usually resolved by clearing your browser's cache and cookies for our site. If that does not work, please attempt to log in using an incognito window or a different browser. You may also want to verify that your SSO configuration is correctly updated in your Admin Console.

subject: Suspicious logins not appearing in audit logs

We are seeing error code AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN and I need to know where these are hiding. Please assist immediately as this is a security priority.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses are recorded in the Security Events log, not the standard Login Activity log. Please navigate to Admin Console, then Security & Compliance, and finally Security Events to view this information. We also recommend enabling Login Anomaly Detection for automatic alerts.

resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. subject: sso login stopped working
body: All our users are unable to log in with SSO. We keep getting the Invalid SSO Token error. Fix this now.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced a new SSO token format. You must go into the Admin Console and re-configure your SSO integration by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Please refer to our v4.2 release notes for the full steps.

subject: ACCOUNT SUSPENDED - UNABLE TO ACCESS WORKSPACE
body: Our entire team is completely locked out of CloudDesk today! An Account Suspended banner is visible in the Admin Console and we received some notice about an overdue payment. We tried to process it but encountered error BILL-SUSP-007. This is blocking our core operations right now, so please fix this immediately and restore our access!
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Invoices' and paying the overdue invoice. Once payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: Incorrect user attribution in workspace activity log
body: Good day to the CloudDesk team. We noticed in our enterprise workspace activity log that certain file actions like edits and moves are attributed to the wrong user, often an administrator, even when a regular contributor performed the action. It is not pressing, but we would love to see it sorted out eventually. Thank you for all your hard work!
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with Contributor roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct, and this is a known bug we are actively addressing. For accurate audit tracking, please cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: Cant download PDF invoice
body: Hi, I try to get my invoice but the system only gives me a CSV file. I really need a PDF for my accounting records. I am seeing code BILL-INV-009. Thanks for looking at this.
resolution: We are currently experiencing a migration that affects PDF generation for certain invoices. Please send over the invoice IDs you are looking for, and our team will manually generate and email the PDFs to you directly.

subject: Okta SSO failing after v4.2 update, AUTH-402
body: Our entire team is currently locked out of CloudDesk since the v4.2 update this morning. Every time we attempt to log in via Okta, we are met with an 'Invalid Token Format' error, specifically AUTH-402. This is completely unacceptable as our business operations are at a standstill. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: This issue is caused by a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk integration in your Okta console. Ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' are updated to match the new values found in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: Slack notifications failing constantly
body: Hello support, I am really tired of our file share updates failing to show up in Slack. We keep getting the SLACK-NOTIFY-500 error today and nobody knows why. Can someone please look into this whenever you have a moment?
resolution: Please check the Slack integration settings in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app has permission to post in that channel.

subject: SSO branding not showing
body: Our custom logo and background images are not appearing on the SSO login page. It currently shows the default CloudDesk branding instead of our own. We would love to have our branding active for our users. Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: Please navigate to the 'SSO & Branding' section in the Admin Console. Double-check that your custom logo and background assets are uploaded and saved correctly. After saving, you may need to clear your browser cache to see the updated branding.

subject: Infinite redirect loop when logging in with Google SSO
body: Hi there, I am trying to access my account using Google SSO and after completing the authentication step with Google, my browser just gets stuck in a continuous redirect loop and never loads the actual dashboard. I noticed error AUTH-SSO-302.1 on the screen. It is not urgent at all since I am just reviewing old invoices, but whenever you have a chance to look at it, that would be wonderful.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out regarding the Google SSO loop. Please instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, and if the issue persists, try an incognito window or a different browser. We also advise verifying the Google SSO configuration settings directly in your Admin Console.

subject: Granular permissions request for shared folders
body: Our finance team requires more granular control over permissions within shared folders, specifically view-only with the ability to comment or upload-only for specific sub-folders. This is currently blocking our workflow and we request prompt help with this.
resolution: We understand the need for more granular permission controls. Currently, our permissions are applied at the folder level. Please submit your specific requirements for advanced granular permissions at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions. This will help us design the most effective solution.

subject: URGENT NEED PDF INVOICE
body: I am trying to download my invoices from the admin console but it only gives me CSV files. I need PDF versions for my audit records immediately! This is very inconvenient and I need this resolved.
resolution: I understand the need for proper PDF documentation. Due to a recent migration, PDF generation for some older invoices is temporarily unavailable. Please send us the specific invoice IDs you require, and we will manually generate and email them to you.

subject: API 500 errors on file content retrieval
body: Our integration is failing with API-500 errors when calling the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. This is blocking our deployment. When can you fix this?
resolution: We are aware of some intermittent issues with distributed storage retrieval that cause these 500 errors. We recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client as an immediate workaround. Our team is working on a permanent fix to be included in our next hotfix release.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card
body: I am looking at our corporate credit card statement and there is a charge from CloudDesk that does not match our expectations. I suspect there might be an issue with error BILL-CHG-010. Can you please help me understand this transaction?
resolution: To help us investigate this charge, please provide the exact amount, the date it appeared, and the last four digits of the card used. We will cross-reference these details against your billing history and provide a breakdown of the transaction.

subject: Session expired constantly
body: I am being logged out immediately after logging in. The screen says session expired, and I see code auth-session-401.5. I cannot get any work done.
resolution: Please clear your browser's cookies and local storage for 'cloudesk.com'. Also, ensure that your system time is accurate and check if any browser extensions are interfering with session cookies.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership option greyed out
body: Hello, as an external contractor managing a workspace on our free plan, I am attempting to transfer ownership of a workspace, but the option is greyed out and I receive an error saying cannot transfer ownership to non-owner. We want this fixed soon when possible. Thank you.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a member or admin of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace first, and if not, add them before attempting the transfer via Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership.

subject: cant access admin console
body: as an administrator I am unable to open the Admin Console and keep getting redirected to the normal user dashboard. I noticed error code ADMIN-AUTH-403.3 on the screen. kindly fix this when you can.
resolution: We are aware that several users are encountering navigation redirects at the moment. Please confirm the user's role in the Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Roles' to ensure they have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned, and update their role if it was changed.

subject: API tokens failing with 401 error
body: Since the v4.2 upgrade, our existing API tokens are returning a 401 unauthorized status with a legacy_token_format error. This is a critical issue for us because we have a product demo at 5pm today that relies on these integrations. We need this resolved immediately to avoid a service outage.
resolution: The API token format was updated in version 4.2 for security improvements. You must regenerate your API tokens via the Admin Console under the API & Integrations section and update your application settings to use these new tokens.

subject: GDPR export missing user comments
body: I am performing a routine GDPR data export for one of our Enterprise users, but I noticed the resulting package is missing all comments the user left on various tasks and files. The rest of the profile data appears complete, but we need these comments to fulfill the request. We keep seeing the error code GDPR_EXPORT_INCOMPLETE_COMMENTS when we run these. Could you please look into why this content is being excluded from the export?
resolution: The current GDPR export tool is designed to capture core profile data and files rather than granular metadata like comments. To retrieve these, please go to the specific files or tasks in question, open the Activity tab, and use the Export Activity Log feature for each one individually. Unfortunately, there is no system-wide bulk export for comments at this time.

subject: Request for video conferencing tool integration
body: Our team uses CloudDesk daily for collaboration, but we find it difficult to switch between apps for meetings. Are there any plans to integrate tools like Zoom or Google Meet directly into the workspace?
resolution: We currently focus our platform on file sharing and project collaboration rather than built-in video conferencing. You can currently share meeting links directly in your project comments. Please submit your tool request at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing so our product team can track this demand.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy review
body: Hello, our latest Enterprise invoice reflects a user count that does not match our current active user metrics in CloudDesk, resulting in BILL-INV-001 related billing concerns. Please review this when you have a moment.
resolution: Please check the billing date and proration period on your invoice, as user count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle or prorated if a mid-cycle change was processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these details, please provide your invoice ID and current active user count for a manual review.

subject: cannot download invoice as pdf
body: trying to pull my billing records but the console only gives me csv. i need the pdf version for my bookkeeping. getting error code bill-inv-009 right now. any help appreciated.
resolution: pdf invoice generation is currently limited for certain records due to a system migration. please send over the specific invoice ids you require, and we will manually generate and email the pdfs to you.

subject: New user login error
body: I invited a new staff member to our team, but they are getting an 'User Not Found' error when trying to sign in. They are using their email and a set password, but they keep hitting AUTH-NF-404.1. This is quite frustrating as we need them onboarded immediately. Can you help me resolve this?
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console to ensure it matches their login. Confirm the invitation was sent and that the user has accepted it. If they still cannot log in, double-check that they are using the correct instance URL for your account.

subject: Search functionality returning incomplete results
body: I have noticed that searching for files in the web app frequently omits relevant documents. Even when I know the exact name of a file, the search results do not show it. I am seeing error SEARCH-002. Please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: This is often caused by an outdated search index. Please try using exact quotes for your search terms or log out and back in to trigger a re-index of your account. If the problem continues, send me a list of the missing files so we can investigate further.

subject: SSO logins broken after 4.2 update
body: We are dead in the water after the 4.2 release. None of our developers can sign in via our IdP because we keep hitting CD-AM-003. This is a complete blocker for our engineering team and needs an immediate fix. Please tell us how to resolve this authentication failure right now.
resolution: The v4.2 update implemented a new security token format for SSO. You must update your IdP configuration to match the updated schema. Please review the 'CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide' in our documentation to adjust your settings accordingly.

subject: Missing Microsoft Teams integration
body: My team is very upset that there is no Microsoft Teams integration. We need to share our files directly inside our channels. This is blocking our daily work and we need a solution now. When will this be available?
resolution: We understand this feature is important for your workflow. While a direct, deep integration is not currently available, you can share links to files directly in Teams. Please add your requirements to our roadmap page at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams so our team can prioritize this.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: Our enterprise account was upgraded unintentionally to a higher tier, and we are requesting a refund for the prorated difference. We see error BILL-REF-005. Many users are hitting this at the same moment right now. Please process this refund as soon as possible.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Slack notifications not appearing
body: Slack notifications are not sending for file shares. We keep getting SLACK-NOTIFY-500 errors in our logs. Please look into this.
resolution: Please verify your Slack integration settings within the Admin Console. Make sure the correct workspace and channel are linked and that the CloudDesk app has the necessary posting permissions in Slack.

subject: Helpdesk tickets not appearing for agents
body: I am beyond frustrated because assigned tickets are simply not showing up in the My Assigned Tickets view. This error, HELPDESK-007, is completely stalling our support team's workflow. We need this fixed right now as our queue is backing up significantly. Please assist immediately.
resolution: This behavior is typically caused by a caching issue regarding agent permissions. Please have the affected agent clear their browser cache and cookies, then sign back into CloudDesk. If the issue persists, try re-assigning the ticket to a different user and then back to the original agent to refresh the view.

subject: Google SSO login redirect loop error
body: Users are stuck in a redirect loop after logging in with google sso. they never reach the dashboard and it just keeps refreshing. please fix this soon
resolution: Please instruct the affected users to clear their browser's cache and cookies specifically for cloudesk.com. If the issue persists, advise them to try an incognito or private browsing window, and verify that your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console is correct.

subject: sso login broken after update
body: our okta sso users can't log in after v4.2 update. they see 'invalid sso token format'. we need this fixed now, major disruption.
resolution: To address the 'Invalid SSO token format' error for Okta users following the v4.2 update, please re-upload your IDP metadata within the CloudDesk Admin Console. This action will update your SSO configuration to align with the new token format.

subject: cant export audit logs past 90 days
body: hi, when trying to export audit logs from the admin console for a date range over 90 days it fails every time with export range limit exceeded 90 days maximum. please let us know how to fix this when you can.
resolution: Hello. The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script.

subject: Seat limit error when adding members
body: Hello, I am attempting to add new team members to our workspace, but the system keeps throwing a seat limit reached error. However, our subscription details clearly show we have open seats available. We are encountering error code CD-AM-001. No immediate rush on this, but please look into it when convenient.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: System keeps logging me out immediately
body: I am trying to get my work done but I keep getting kicked off the dashboard! Every time I log in, the screen refreshes and shows me a session expired message, error AUTH-SESSION-401.5. This is incredibly frustrating as it is blocking all of my tasks today. Can you please help me get this resolved promptly?
resolution: Please try clearing your browser's cookies and local storage specifically for cloudesk.com. Check that your browser isn't using strict privacy settings or extensions that might block session cookies. Also, verify that your computer's system time is set correctly, as an incorrect clock often causes this error.

subject: Issue with audit log export
body: Thank you for the support on our previous tickets. I am having trouble exporting audit logs for the last six months. It stops me and says AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. Is there a way to pull this data?
resolution: The Admin Console's interface is currently limited to a 90-day export range. To pull logs for longer periods, please use our API endpoint at '/v1/audit/export' with your specified start and end dates. If you are unable to use the API for this, please let us know and we can assist with a manual data extract.

subject: Billing API Usage Data Inconsistencies Since v4.2 Upgrade
body: Greetings. As a developer currently integrating your platform, I wanted to point out that we have been testing various API endpoints including storage and API calls, and we noticed some strange behaviors. Since updating our integration to version 4.2, the data returned by the billing API endpoint has been quite inconsistent when compared against our Admin Console reports or previous API calls, and we also saw error code API-BILL-401 briefly. There is no rush on this since we are just in a staging environment, but I wanted to make sure it gets looked at eventually while we continue writing our integration tests.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as per the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, please provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for review.

subject: switch to annual billing
body: hi, we want to change our subscription to annual billing now. BILL-PLAN-004 error came up when i tried to look at it earlier. thanks
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: get files content endpoint returning 500 error
body: getting api-500 errors on GET /files/{id}/content intermittently. mostly happens for files in different regions. fix this quickly.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Need view only folder permissions
body: It is extremely frustrating that we cannot set upload-only or comment-only access on sub-folders. This lack of control is holding back our departmental projects today. Please advise.
resolution: We understand the need for more granular permission controls, though our current permissions are strictly applied at the folder level. Please submit your exact requirements for advanced granular permissions at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions to help our team design the best solution.

subject: MFA registration failing on mobile app
body: Hello everyone, hope you are having a nice day. I wanted to mention that before trying to set this up, I checked our network settings and made sure our Wi-Fi was running properly, and we also restarted our phones twice just to be thorough. When users attempt to enable or set up MFA via the mobile app, they encounter an error 'Failed to register MFA device' after scanning the QR code, with code MFA-MOB-002. Email and password login works fine, but MFA cannot be configured. Please assist when possible.
resolution: Hello! This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Admin Console Access Denied Error
body: I am trying to log into the Admin Console to manage my team, but I keep getting hit with an ADMIN-AUTH-403.3 error. It keeps redirecting me to the standard user dashboard instead of the admin area. This is quite annoying as I need to adjust some settings today. Could someone take a look at this?
resolution: Please check your user role by navigating to Users and then Manage User within the Admin Console. It is likely that your account needs to have the Admin or Super Admin role assigned to access those specific features. Once you verify or update your permissions, you should be able to log in without issue.

subject: User role display bug
body: I noticed some of our users show as Contributor in the admin UI, even though they should be Managers. I saw UI-ADMIN-003 when I was poking around. Everything works fine, just looks weird.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug, and your actual permissions remain unaffected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix for this display issue will be included in the next patch.

subject: cannot export audit logs
body: trying to pull logs for 6 months but it keeps failing. i get an error saying audit_export_range_exceeded. can you help me get these files?
resolution: The direct export feature in the Admin Console is limited to a 90-day window. To retrieve records for a longer duration, please use our API endpoint for audit exports with a pagination script. If you need assistance with this, feel free to reach out for a manual data pull.

subject: api broken after v42 upgrade

resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Make sure to update your applications to use these new tokens immediately.

subject: Seat limit reached error when adding users

resolution: Verify the pending invitations count under your team management settings, as pending invitations count toward your seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

resolution: An administrator needs to verify your access rights for that specific workspace by navigating to the Permissions tab in the Admin Console. Please ensure your account is correctly mapped to the project so you can access the files before your demo. Let us know if you need further help.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental subscription charge
body: I am very frustrated because our account was upgraded unintentionally. I see a BILL-REF-005 error, and I would like a refund for this erroneous charge. Please process this as soon as possible.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are reviewed on a case-by-case basis. To proceed, please provide the exact date and time the upgrade occurred and confirm that your team has not utilized any of the upgraded features. We will review your account and get back to you shortly.

resolution: Please instruct the user to clear their browser's cookies and local storage for cloudesk.com. You should also check if they have strict privacy settings or browser extensions that might be interfering with session cookies, and verify the correct system time on their device.

When I navigate to the billing section, I see only a CSV option despite needing a formal document for our records. I keep seeing error BILL-INV-009 when I refresh the page. Could you help me obtain a PDF version instead?
resolution: PDF invoice generation is currently unavailable for certain accounts due to a system migration. Please provide the invoice IDs you require, and our team will manually generate those PDFs and email them to you directly.

body: Since the v4.2 update, our staff cannot log in using our SSO provider. We keep getting an 'Invalid SSO Token' error, specifically SSO_TOKEN_FORMAT_401. This is currently blocking our entire department from accessing their work files. Please provide a fix immediately.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated our security protocols and requires a refresh of your SSO configuration. Please log into the Admin Console and either re-download your SAML metadata or regenerate your OIDC secret. Detailed steps for this process are available in our latest release notes.

subject: Critical API failure after system update
body: Hello office support, after upgrading to v4.2, existing API tokens that worked previously now return 401 Unauthorized with a legacy token format error. This is a critical issue affecting our core workflows and revenue generation, so we need a fix immediately to restore our integrations.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications immediately to use these new tokens.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade and refund request

resolution: We handle refund requests for accidental upgrades on a case-by-case basis. Please confirm the exact date and time of the upgrade and ensure no features from the new plan were utilized so we can review your eligibility.

subject: Payment failed for subscription renewal
body: Hello, we recently received a notification that our automatic subscription renewal failed because of a declined credit card on our Pro plan. When checking our billing section, the status shows as payment failed. Could you please let us know how we can update our payment method and clear this up when you have a moment?
resolution: Thank you for reaching out to us. Please navigate to 'Admin Console', then 'Billing', and select 'Payment Methods' to update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank, and you can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: desktop client creating duplicate conflict files
body: Hello, our team is experiencing issues with the desktop sync client frequently flagging files as conflict even though no concurrent edits were made. We are seeing error SYNC-003 across several workstations. This is blocking our team's work, so please assist promptly.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with invalid token error

resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: API key returning 401 Unauthorized
body: My application is receiving an API-AUTH-401.4 error when using our existing API key. It was working fine yesterday and we haven't changed anything in our code. Can you verify if the key is still valid?
resolution: Please log into the Admin Console and check the 'API Keys' section to ensure your key has not expired or been accidentally revoked. If the key is listed as inactive, you will need to generate a new one and update your application configuration to restore access.

subject: Jira sync errors
body: Our Jira integration isnt working properly. The logs keep showing JIRA-SYNC-403, and our projects wont sync up. Its affecting our tracking, so could you take a look?
resolution: Please ensure the Jira API token or the user account configured for the CloudDesk integration has 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions. These permissions must be enabled for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance.

subject: Seat limit error despite availability
body: I am being told we reached our seat limit when I try to add new users, but our dashboard clearly shows we have room. This is unacceptable and needs to be resolved quickly. I saw error code CD-AM-001 during the attempt.
resolution: Please check the 'Pending Invitations' section within the Team Management menu. These pending invites count against your total seat capacity even if the users have not accepted yet. You can revoke those old invitations to free up space, or upgrade your plan to increase your total seat limit.

subject: Permission Denied error accessing workspace

resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Okta SSO Login Broken After Update

resolution: This is happening because of a change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2. Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. Once re-uploaded, your users should be able to log in successfully.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Hello support team, I am trying to request a password reset via the login page for my account, but I have not received the reset email in either my inbox or spam folder. We are seeing error code CD-AM-008 on our end. This is blocking our work and I would appreciate prompt help with this issue. Thank you.
resolution: Hello. First, please confirm your email address is correct and active in Admin Console > Team Management > Users. Also, ensure you check your spam and junk folders, and consider whitelisting no-reply@cloudesk.com. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for you directly via Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password.

subject: Team members not getting invite emails
body: Hi there, I am trying to add some new folks to our workspace but the invite emails are not being delivered. The status says Pending but nothing shows up in their inbox and there are no bounce backs. I think we are seeing error code EMAIL-005. Let us know when you have a moment to take a look.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries.

subject: API endpoints returning 503 errors during peak hours
body: As I was preparing the quarterly financial summaries for our executive committee this morning while also coordinating travel schedules, I noticed our automated scripts are failing. Multiple API endpoints are returning HTTP 503 errors and error code API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 during peak hours. This is impacting our operations severely and we need this resolved immediately to avoid critical business delays.
resolution: We are currently investigating your API usage patterns to identify if you are exceeding rate limits by checking the 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header. We advise implementing exponential backoff for retries and confirming if there are any ongoing platform incidents via our status page. We will escalate to engineering if rate limits are not being hit.

subject: Missing password reset emails for enterprise users
