body: The User Activity report page remains completely blank when opened in the admin console. Other reports load fine.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Constant session expiration errors
body: I am unable to stay logged into the web app for more than a few seconds. I keep getting a 'Session Expired' message, which corresponds to error AUTH-SESSION-401.5. It is extremely frustrating as I cannot finish my daily reports.
resolution: This is often caused by browser settings or extensions interfering with your session cookies. Please clear your browser cookies and local storage for cloudesk.com, and verify that your system time is correctly synchronized on your device.

subject: Need direct Microsoft Teams integration urgently
body: Why is there still no native Microsoft Teams integration in CloudDesk? Our entire engineering team is struggling to collaborate without direct file syncing inside Teams channels. We need this functionality to streamline our daily workflows right now.
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper, direct integration is not yet available. Please vote for this integration or add your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams as we continuously evaluate new features based on customer demand.

subject: ACCIDENTAL PLAN UPGRADE REFUND REQUEST
body: Hi there, my team account somehow got bumped up to the Pro tier by accident and I need this reversed immediately. BILL-REF-005 keeps showing up on my billing page. Can I please get my money back for this since we didn't even mean to switch plans? Let me know whenever you have time to look at this.
resolution: We understand this situation can be frustrating. Please note that refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Kindly provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. Once we have this information, we will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Update purchase order number for billing
body: I need to update the purchase order number on our account for upcoming invoices. Can you tell me where I can change that? Thank you.
resolution: You can easily update this by going to the Admin Console, clicking on Billing, and then opening the Billing Information tab. Locate the Purchase Order Number field to save your changes, which will apply to all future invoices.

subject: Security risk with API key scopes
body: I have discovered that an API key with read-only scope is currently able to delete users from our workspace. This is a major security vulnerability and we are seeing API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS errors when testing limits. Please advise on how to restrict these permissions immediately.
resolution: Please revoke that API key immediately within the Admin Console under API Management. We are currently investigating this scope bypass issue; please verify if there was a configuration error when the key was created. If the issue persists after generating a new key, please let us know so we can escalate to engineering.

subject: user not found error on new invite
body: hi a newly invited user attempts to log in with their email and password but receives an user not found error with code auth-nf-404.1 please let us know how to fix this when you have a moment thanks
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If it was not accepted, resend the invitation. Also check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if your company has multiple accounts.

subject: Desktop Sync Client SSO Authentication Failure
body: Hello, our users are unable to sign into the desktop sync client via SSO; the browser redirection completes successfully, but the client fails to authenticate and displays a generic login failed message with code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. This is blocking several team members and we require prompt assistance.
resolution: Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version v4.2.1 or newer. Verify that the default browser on affected machines is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects, and use email and password login as a workaround if SSO is not mandatory.

subject: SSO Login Redirecting to Azure AD Error
body: Hello support team, our office is trying to log in using Azure AD on our Pro plan, but users keep getting redirected to an error page or a reply url mismatch message. We have our company-wide client presentation at 5 PM today, so we would greatly appreciate it if this could be looked into soon. Thank you so much for your help!
resolution: In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs' (replace 'yourcompany' with your actual subdomain).

subject: Account suspended, need help restoring access
body: Hello, our team is unable to access their files and we see a BILL-SUSP-007 banner in our console. I believe we might have a missed payment notification. Could you please assist us in getting this resolved as soon as possible so my team can get back to work?
resolution: Your account access was restricted due to an outstanding balance. Please navigate to 'Admin Console' then 'Billing' to settle the overdue invoice. Once the payment is processed, your service will automatically resume within 15 minutes.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card statement BILL-CHG-010
body: Hello, I am reviewing our billing department records and noticed an unexpected charge from CloudDesk on our credit card statement with the code BILL-CHG-010. We cannot reconcile this amount with our expected billing schedule for our Pro plan. Please help us figure out what this transaction corresponds to.
resolution: Hello. To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. Once we receive these details, we will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide a full explanation.

subject: Extremely slow download speeds
body: I am beyond frustrated with the download performance here. Files are taking forever to finish, and it is hindering our ability to get work done on time. I keep seeing DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW messages popping up. When will this be addressed?
resolution: We recommend testing your connection with a different browser or network to rule out local interference. If you are handling very large files, using the Desktop Sync client provides a much more robust transfer experience than the web interface. Please let us know which server region you are using so we can verify if there is any localized latency.

subject: Access Denied in Admin Console
body: I am currently trying to manage some user accounts but the system is blocking my access. Even though I am a contractor with admin rights, I keep getting redirected or seeing error ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. There is no rush on this, just let me know when you can look into it.
resolution: I have looked into your account and suggest verifying your current access level under the Users tab in the Admin Console. Please confirm that your profile is specifically assigned the Admin or Super Admin role to ensure proper access permissions.

subject: Billing section login failing
body: Whenever I try to access the billing page as an admin I get a Payment Processing Error. It seems to happen since the v4.2 update when using our SSO credentials. We need to update our payment method before the end of the week. AUTH-BILL-402 is the code showing up.
resolution: The v4.2 update modified our SSO token format, which can cause session issues with sensitive areas like billing. Please try logging out and back in using your direct email and password, or clear your browser cache to refresh your session. If you still have trouble, using a direct login is the recommended workaround while we investigate the SSO integration for billing.

subject: Mobile app giving network error right before important demo
body: Hello, I cannot login to the mobile app at all today. It keeps showing MOBILE-NET-500.1 with a generic network error even though my internet is totally fine. We have a major investor demo at 5pm today and this needs to be resolved immediately please!
resolution: We apologize for the inconvenience during your important demo today. Please force close the app, check your app store for any pending updates, and try logging in again. If the issue persists, please clear your app cache or reinstall the application to clear out the error.

subject: Discrepancy in active user count on our latest monthly invoice
body: Hello, I am reviewing our latest billing statement and noticed that the user count reflected on the invoice does not match our current active user list in CloudDesk. This error is causing an incorrect charge for our account. Please investigate this billing issue and help correct our invoice as soon as possible.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these details, please reply with your invoice ID and current active user count so we can perform a manual review.

subject: Mobile app network error on login
body: Hello. We are unable to log into the mobile app and keep getting a generic network error despite having stable internet. We are on the pro plan and can wait for assistance. Thank you.
resolution: Hello. Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache or reinstalling the app, and verify server status on our status page.

subject: okta login broken after update
body: nobody can log in with okta since the v4.2 update this morning we keep seeing invalid sso token format error auth-sso-401.1 and it is completely blocking our entire team right now please help immediately
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata. This step is required for all Okta integrations due to a recent change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: CRITICAL: Desktop sync failing after 4.2 update
body: Since updating to version 4.2, our files are not syncing at all! This is blocking our entire team and we need this resolved immediately. The sync client just shows nothing happening, despite getting error SYNC-001. Please help us get back to work now.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk. After cleaning the cache, reinstall the client from the download link in your web app's Settings menu. This should resolve the SYNC-001 error and resume your file synchronization.

subject: member turned guest cant login to mobile app
body: we changed a user role to guest and now they get insufficient permissions and cd-am-002 when trying to use the mobile app. we need this fixed for them right away to keep work moving.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role and verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces, or change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin' if they need full access.

subject: API permission error for data export
body: The /v1/users/{userId}/data/export endpoint is returning a 403 error for our admin-scoped keys. This functionality was working perfectly until recently. Please let me know how to fix this API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED status.
resolution: Recent updates have moved data export permissions to a new role to improve security. You will need to generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role assigned in your Admin Console. Please navigate to the API Management section to update your configuration.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade refund request
body: Hello CloudDesk team, I hope you are doing well today. By mistake, our account was recently upgraded to the PRO tier during a testing session, and we would like to request a refund for the prorated charge. We have a major client demo scheduled for 5pm today and need this sorted out promptly. Thank you very much for your assistance.
resolution: Hello! Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Our integration is broken after update
body: All our api calls are failing since the v4.2 update. We are getting 401 unauthorized errors with a legacy_token_format message, error API-AUTH-401-V42. Everything is down and we need this fixed right now.
resolution: The API token format was updated in our v4.2 release. You will need to regenerate all of your API tokens by navigating to the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new tokens as soon as possible.

subject: Cannot download invoices over one year old
body: I am trying to access our company invoices from last year, but the system won't let me view anything older than 12 months. I am receiving error code BILL-INV-003 when I attempt to search the archives. Could you please assist me with retrieving these files?
resolution: The Admin Console is designed to show invoices from the previous 12 months for quick access. For any documents older than that, please provide the specific invoice dates or IDs you require. We can pull those directly from our secure archives and send them over to you.

subject: Assigned tickets missing from agent view
body: When a helpdesk ticket is assigned to an agent, that agent cannot see it in their My Assigned Tickets view in the web app under error HELPDESK-007. We have a team payroll run tomorrow and need this resolved promptly.
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: Azure AD mobile login failing
body: Our team is encountering a login failure on the mobile app using Azure AD SSO. Users are consistently receiving an error code AUTH-SSO-403.2 during the process. We need our team to access their files via mobile, so please look into this. Thanks for the assistance.
resolution: Please have your Azure AD administrator ensure that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped within the enterprise application settings. You can find detailed steps in our Azure AD SSO configuration guide at the link provided below. This should resolve the profile attribute validation error.

subject: Workspace ownership transfer greyed out
body: Hello team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. While trying to hand over one of our enterprise workspaces, I noticed the option is unavailable and I get the error CD-AM-004. Whenever I try to select a colleague, it fails. Thank you for your help whenever you have a moment.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: SSO login via desktop app fails completely
body: I am trying to log into the desktop sync client using our SSO credentials, but the browser just redirects and leaves the app showing a generic Login Failed error. This DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 issue is driving me crazy because I cannot access my files. Please help me sort this out soon.
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, suggest logging in via email/password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: Offline editing support on mobile app
body: We love the product but really need to be able to edit files while offline and sync them later. It is blocking our remote field team from working effectively. Do you have any plans to add this soon?
resolution: Currently, our mobile app only supports offline viewing for starred files. We appreciate your feedback as this feature is high on our priority list. Please visit our roadmap site to vote for this functionality so we can track its impact.

subject: Azure AD login failing with reply URL error
body: My developers are getting an SSO-AZURE-400 error when testing our integration. They keep seeing a 'Reply URL mismatch' error. We need this fixed soon as it is slowing down our development schedule.
resolution: This error typically occurs when the redirect URI is misconfigured. Please check your Azure AD application registration and ensure the Reply URL is set exactly to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs', replacing the subdomain with your own.

subject: Admin Console Access Denied
body: Hi there. I am trying to login to the admin console but it keeps kicking me out. I see a ADMIN-AUTH-403.3 error. I am the IT admin for our team so I should have access. Please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: To resolve this, please navigate to the Users section in the Admin Console and select your profile to manage your roles. Ensure that your account is explicitly assigned the Admin or Super Admin role. Once updated, you should be able to access the console without the error.

subject: webhook for file uploads
body: need a webhook that fires when a file is uploaded to a folder. currently the api only supports polling and it is inefficient for our setup. any plans to add this soon?
resolution: Thank you for your feature request. While our current API does not support a direct webhook for new file uploads, we are tracking interest in this functionality. Please submit a proposal including your desired payload structure at roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so our team can assess the demand for this update.

subject: Files remaining cached on mobile device
body: hi, i noticed that the files i view in the app stay on my phone even when i sign out. im worried about privacy if i lose my phone. is there a way to clear this up? thanks for the help.
resolution: The mobile app caches files for offline access by default. You can manually clear these by navigating to Settings within the app, selecting Storage, and choosing Clear Cached Files. To ensure this happens automatically in the future, please enable the 'Clear cache on logout' option in that same menu.

subject: Issues previewing files in the web app
body: I have been having trouble viewing documents lately. When I try to look at a PDF or PPTX directly in the web app, it just shows a blank screen or a spinning icon forever. I see error code PREVIEW-006 on some attempts. It is not urgent as I can download them fine, but I wanted to bring it to your attention. Thanks for the help.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific problems. Please start by clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that does not help, try an incognito window to see if an extension is interfering.

subject: Authentication failed in desktop sync after pwd change
body: Hi there i changed my password on the web app and now the desktop sync client says authentication failed with code CD-AM-015. I cant sync any files for my project right now. Please help me fix this quickly thanks.
resolution: After a password change, the Desktop Sync client often requires re-authentication. Please open the Desktop Sync application, click on 'Settings' or the 'CloudDesk' icon in your system tray, and select 'Log Out' or 'Disconnect Account'. You can then log back in using your new password.

subject: billing api data inconsistency
body: since the upgrade the api data is totally different from our console reports. we are getting an API-BILL-401 error. any ideas what is going on here.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as per the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, please provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for review.

subject: Need better folder permissions now
body: We absolutely need granular permissions for sub-folders immediately! The current all-or-nothing approach is blocking our workflow and we cannot wait for a future update. Fix this right now!
resolution: We hear your feedback regarding the need for more granular folder-level permissions. Since our current architecture is folder-based, please submit your specific requirements via our roadmap portal. Your input will be directly used by our product team to design the next iteration of our permissions system.

subject: Slack notifications not showing up
body: Our file share notifications arent showing in the slack channel. Checked the admin console and everything looks right. Getting error SLACK-NOTIFY-500. Not a rush but would be nice to get it working.
resolution: Please navigate to the Slack integration settings within your Admin Console to ensure the correct workspace and channel are still selected. You should also verify that the CloudDesk Slack app still has the necessary permissions to post messages in that specific channel. Please let me know if re-authorizing the connection resolves the issue.

subject: Okta SSO login broken with Invalid Token Format error
body: Ever since the v4.2 update, none of our users can log in via Okta SSO and they receive AUTH-402 errors. This is severely disrupting our entire workforce and must be resolved immediately before our financial audit deadline this afternoon.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console by ensuring the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values in our configuration guide.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy, need help
body: My latest bill is completely wrong and shows way more users than we currently have. I see BILL-INV-001 on the invoice and I am extremely frustrated. We have a payroll run tomorrow and I need this fixed before then. Please fix this.
resolution: Please review the billing date and proration period shown on your invoice, as user count changes often process at the start of the next cycle. If you believe the count is still incorrect, please provide your invoice ID and your current active user count so our billing team can perform a manual review for you.

subject: Billing API report data mismatch
body: I have been reviewing our monthly storage metrics and cross-referencing them with the API calls I pull every Tuesday morning. I noticed that since the recent system update, the figures aren't matching what I see in the Admin Console. The error code API-BILL-401 keeps showing up in my logs. Could you look into why the aggregation seems inconsistent?
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 changed how certain metrics are aggregated for legacy storage types. Please ensure you are using the correct date range parameters as outlined in the latest API documentation. If you still see a discrepancy, please share the specific query you are running and the report data from your console.

subject: Mobile push notifications delayed
body: Push notifications for comments and file changes are quite delayed on the mobile app. It often takes several minutes to receive them. Let me know if there is a way to speed this up.
resolution: Please ensure that notifications are enabled within both the CloudDesk app settings and your phone's system settings. You should also check that your device's battery optimization settings are not restricting the app's background activity. If the issue persists, reinstalling the app usually resets the push service registration.

subject: cant access shared workspace
body: getting perm-ws-403.4 error when trying to open our project folder. logged in fine but its blocking my access to the workspace. really annoying since we have a deadline today.
resolution: An administrator needs to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Please navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check the 'Members' or 'Permissions' tab, and ensure your account is correctly assigned with appropriate access rights.

subject: Request for longer public sharing link expiration
body: Hello, our team would like the ability to set public sharing links to never expire or to have a much longer expiration period than the current maximum. As an enterprise customer, we frequently share documents that need long-term availability without requiring frequent link regenerations. Can this be accommodated?
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: cannot export long range logs
body: the export for logs fails when i try to go back more than 90 days. it says AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. i need this for my records but it is not a huge rush.
resolution: The console export is indeed capped at 90 days. For longer periods, please use the '/v1/audit/export' API endpoint with a script to handle the data range. If you cannot use the API, let me know and I can assist with a manual pull.

subject: Need PDF format for downloaded invoices
body: Hi there, hope you are having a good week. When I try to download an invoice from the Admin Console, the only format available is CSV, but our accounting department requires a PDF for our records. Please let me know how we can get the PDF version.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Mobile app crashes on large file uploads
body: We are experiencing consistent crashes when uploading files larger than 1GB via the mobile app. There is no error message, just an abrupt closure. This is happening across multiple devices. I am reporting this to assist in your troubleshooting.
resolution: This is a known memory limitation for large mobile uploads. As a temporary workaround, please upload files over 1GB using the web app or our desktop sync client. Our development team is currently working on an optimization for a future release.

subject: accidental upgrade refund request
body: hi there, i think our team accidentally upgraded our plan while testing out the api endpoints. error code BILL-REF-005 showed up on our screen. could we get a refund for this or have it reverted please. thanks!
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. Once we have those details, we will review your account for eligibility.

subject: MFA code not working for login
body: the mfa code from google authenticator is not being accepted at all. i have a major audit on friday and need to get into my account to prepare. please help me reset this auth-mfa-401.2 issue right away.
resolution: This error usually occurs when the time on your mobile device is out of sync. Please ensure your phone's time is set to update automatically with the network. If that does not resolve it, please let us know so we can guide you through resetting your MFA settings.

subject: Missing tickets in assigned view
body: MY AGENTS CANNOT SEE TICKETS ASSIGNED TO THEM IN THEIR DASHBOARD. THIS IS A MAJOR PROBLEM AND IS BLOCKING OUR WORKFLOW! WE ARE SEEING HELPDESK-007 ERRORS INTERMITTENTLY. PLEASE LOOK INTO THIS RIGHT AWAY.
resolution: This is typically caused by a cache synchronization issue regarding agent permissions. Please have the affected agents clear their browser cache and cookies, then log back in. If the issue remains, an administrator can trigger a refresh by re-assigning the ticket to a different agent and then assigning it back.

subject: API endpoints returning 503 errors
body: OUR INTEGRATIONS ARE DOWN!!! We are getting API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 errors on almost every call. This is hitting our production traffic and we need this fixed RIGHT NOW. Why is the system so unstable?
resolution: I am investigating your usage patterns to see if your high request volume is triggering our rate limits. Please ensure your implementation includes exponential backoff for retries as a best practice. Check our status page for any broader issues, but I am escalating this to engineering now to investigate your specific traffic spikes.

subject: Azure AD SSO login failing with profile error
body: Hello support, our users attempting to log in via Azure AD SSO are encountering the AUTH-SSO-403.2 error stating user profile incomplete. This is blocking access for our finance department right before payroll run tomorrow. Please assist promptly.
resolution: Please guide your Azure AD administrator to verify that the emailaddress and displayname claims are correctly mapped in the enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. You can reference our Azure AD SSO configuration guide for detailed instructions.

subject: Webhooks failing delivery
body: Our system is reporting WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 errors lately. The logs say connection refused. I am not sure why the data is not reaching our external service.
resolution: Please verify that your webhook endpoint URL is correct and publicly accessible. You should also confirm that your firewall allows incoming traffic from CloudDesk's IP range, which you can find in our technical documentation.

subject: okta sso login error
body: hello we are having trouble logging in through okta today. after getting redirected it says user attribute mismatch on the screen. can someone please help us fix this quickly because our team cannot access anything right now.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, verify that the 'email' and 'firstName' / 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Ensure 'email' is set as the unique identifier.

subject: User Activity report is totally blank
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report for an audit on Friday, but it is completely blank. I am seeing REPORT-001 whenever I try to load it. This is extremely frustrating as I need this data immediately. Please look into this right away.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, please try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering.

subject: Cannot update company name
body: The company name field in the settings is read-only and I cant update it. I get a CD-AM-010 error when I try to save. This is very annoying as our legal name changed last week.
resolution: The 'Company Name' field is linked directly to your subscription billing information. To update it, please navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the 'Organization Name' there. Once updated, the name will automatically propagate to your Company Settings.

subject: Slow loading times in Users and Groups admin page
body: Hello Support team, we noticed that navigating to the Users and Groups section in the Admin Console takes several minutes to fully load our user list since we have thousands of users. Filters and search also respond quite slowly. There is no urgency to fix this immediately, but we wanted to bring it to your attention. Thank you very much.
resolution: Hello. We advise using the 'Search' bar or applying specific filters such as 'Status: Active' immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset. The system is optimized for filtered views on large datasets, and you can navigate directly to a specific user via search if their email is known.

subject: Webhooks are failing to deliver
body: Our integration is failing with a WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 error code. The logs indicate the delivery is being refused by the endpoint. We have checked our side, but the connections just aren't going through. Could you check if something has changed on your end?
resolution: Please verify that the endpoint URL in your Admin Console webhook settings is correct. Ensure your external service is publicly accessible and that your firewall is configured to allow incoming traffic from CloudDesk's IP range, which you can find in our API documentation.

subject: Requesting to change to annual billing cycle
body: I would like to switch our current subscription to the annual plan to save on costs. I noticed BILL-PLAN-004 in the documentation and wanted to know the best way to handle this. We are ready whenever it is convenient for you.
resolution: To switch, please navigate to the Admin Console, go to Billing, then Subscription Details, and select Change Plan. Choosing the annual option will apply the change at the start of your next billing period, with any remaining monthly credit being prorated automatically.

subject: audit log retention max limit 12 months
body: tried setting our audit log retention period in the admin console to 5 yrs for compliance, but the max selectable value is only 12 months. error code AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT appeared. can wait, just wanted to check.
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution (e.g., Splunk, Sumo Logic) via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. This is a feature request for extending native retention.

subject: File preview is broken in web app
body: every time i try to preview a pptx or pdf it just shows a blank screen or a loading icon that never goes away. i can download the files fine but the preview is totally busted. this is slowing me down, can you fix it?
resolution: This is often caused by temporary issues with our rendering service or browser caching. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies first, or test the preview in an incognito window. If the problem persists for a specific file, ensure the document is not password-protected or corrupted, as that can also prevent the viewer from loading.

subject: urgent need for yubikey support
body: we need hardware mfa support for our yubikeys immediately. we have a security audit on friday and our current software mfa is not compliant with our corporate policies. this is a major blocker for us.
resolution: I understand the urgency regarding your upcoming security audit. Currently, CloudDesk supports software-based MFA, but we are tracking demand for hardware tokens to include in future updates. Please register your request and specific token type requirements at our official roadmap portal to help us prioritize this feature.

subject: Okta sso login failing
body: Users are getting stuck on the login page after using Okta. Its giving a user attribute mismatch error for a few people. We need this resolved soon since it is affecting our workflow. Please advise.
resolution: Please check your Okta application settings for CloudDesk to ensure that the 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped. You must verify that the 'email' field is set as the primary unique identifier for our platform.

subject: MFA registration failing on mobile app

resolution: Please advise your team to force close the app, check for updates in the app store, and try again. subject: Empty user activity report screen

If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is currently capped at 90 days. For longer periods, please use our API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with a pagination script to pull the full range. If you do not have API access, let us know and we can facilitate a manual data pull for you.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with invalid token format error

If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, please provide the date range you are trying to view.

resolution: We recommend investigating if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested folder structures. Try using more specific keywords or path-based searches to improve performance. If the issue persists, please reply with the specific workspace ID so we can report it to engineering for an indexing review.

resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata. This is necessary because of a change in the SSO token format implemented in v4.2.

resolution: The mobile app caches files for offline access. To manually clear the cache, go to Settings within the CloudDesk mobile app, then Storage and select Clear Cached Files. For automatic clearing on logout, enable Clear cache on logout in the same settings menu.

subject: Password reset email not arriving

resolution: We verified the user's email address in the Admin Console. Please check if your domain is configured with an approved email sender list and add 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to your allowlist. We have also manually triggered a password reset from our end to help you prepare for your demo.

subject: Invoices only downloading as CSV format

resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Cannot add new team members due to seat limit error
body: I am trying to add new colleagues to our team, but the admin console keeps throwing error CD-AM-001. It says the seat limit is reached, but our dashboard clearly indicates we have available slots. This is very frustrating as we need these people onboarded today. Please look into this right away.
resolution: Please check the 'Pending Invitations' section under your Team Management tab in the Admin Console. These outstanding invitations count against your total seat limit even if they haven't been accepted yet. You can either revoke the older pending invites or upgrade your subscription to gain additional capacity.

subject: Seat limit error
body: I have been working here for six years and I handle all the budgeting and the spreadsheet tracking for our team, and I noticed that when I try to add a new person to our account it says we have hit the seat limit. However, our dashboard shows we have available seats. This is occurring for our whole department. The error code is CD-AM-001.
resolution: Please check the pending invitations count under the Team Management section of your Admin Console. Pending invites consume your available seat capacity. You can either revoke those older pending invitations to free up space or upgrade your plan to increase your total seat limit.

subject: payment processing error in billing section since v42
body: This is extremely frustrating because we cant update our payment method on our enterprise plan. Ever since the v4.2 release, trying to manage billing via SSO gives us authentication failed errors even though everything else works. We need this fixed immediately.
resolution: Hello. The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management while we investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: HUGE delay loading large workspaces before audit today!

resolution: We understand the urgency regarding your audit today. This behavior is caused by rendering an extremely high file count in a single view. We advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, and suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Please check your browser console for any blocking network errors while we monitor server-side query performance.

subject: Azure AD SSO error reply url mismatch

resolution: This corresponds to our current SSO-AZURE-400 error pattern affecting Azure AD configurations. In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, please ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs' using your actual company subdomain.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in dashboard

resolution: This is a known UI display bug and your users' actual permissions remain unchanged. To refresh the display, please navigate to the user's profile, change their role, save, and then change it back to the original setting. We are working on a permanent fix for the next patch.

resolution: Please navigate to the Slack integration section within your Admin Console. Ensure the correct Slack channel is selected and double-check that the CloudDesk app still has the required permissions to post messages in that specific channel.

subject: Seat limit reached error when adding members

resolution: Please verify your Pending Invitations count located under Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations, as pending invites still count toward your seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase your overall seat capacity.

resolution: Hello. After a password change, the Desktop Sync client often requires re-authentication. Please open the Desktop Sync application, click on 'Settings' or the 'CloudDesk' icon in your system tray, select 'Log Out' or 'Disconnect Account', and then log back in using your new password.

subject: Cannot create new roles, error CD-AM-012
body: I keep getting error CD-AM-012 when trying to name a new custom role. It claims the name exists, but I have checked and nothing by that name is currently there. Pretty annoying behavior for the admin console.
resolution: Please note that role names are case-insensitive and we trim leading or trailing spaces. Check your existing roles list thoroughly, as there is likely a role that already exists with a name that only differs by capitalization. If you find no conflicts, please let us know.

subject: Request for more granular notification settings

resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding the noise level of our notifications. While you can adjust general settings in your profile today, we do not yet have per-event granularity. Please post your specific scenario to roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications so our product team can prioritize this in future updates.

subject: API 403 error on workspace share

resolution: Please verify that the API key has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Additionally, the user associated with that key must be a direct member of the workspace being shared. If you are still receiving the error, please send us the specific API key ID and workspace ID for our investigation.

subject: Incorrect user attribution in workspace activity log

resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct. This is a known bug we are addressing, and for accurate audit, please cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

resolution: This behavior often indicates the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. Please pause the sync, go to Settings, Advanced, and select 'Reset Sync Database'. Once the reset completes, you can resume syncing.

Verify if the lag improves with fewer users editing the document simultaneously. Additionally, clearing your browser cache often helps resolve latency issues.

resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

Verify server region for the workspace.

resolution: Thank you for reaching out. Please check your internet connection speed to ensure it is stable, and for files over 500MB, we recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads since it supports resumable transfers. Also, please verify if the issue persists across different browsers or if switching from Wi-Fi to a wired connection helps.

subject: Audit logs missing external user details

This setting ensures the external user's identity is captured in the audit logs. This cannot be retroactively applied to existing anonymous links.

subject: Request to downgrade account

resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption.

If the issue persists, log out and log back in, which can trigger a re-indexing for your account. If still unresolved, provide specific search terms and expected results for investigation.

subject: need to track external file access in logs

resolution: By default, external share links do not capture recipient identity. To track external user activity in your audit logs, you must configure your share links to 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login' before sending them.

You can either wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire automatically, or your administrator can manually unlock the account. Please have your admin check the 'Manage User' section in the Admin Console to reset your status.

subject: Deleted files retention policy not working

resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: Permission denied error in shared workspace

resolution: An administrator needs to review your permissions for that specific workspace within the Admin Console. Please have them verify that your account is correctly assigned with the necessary access rights.

resolution: Currently, we do not offer custom branding for the SSO login experience. We recognize this is a key request for many organizations, so please add your feedback to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding so we can track interest.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error

Please log into your Admin Console, go to the SSO & Identity settings for Google, and ensure all required domains are added to the Allowed Domains list. That should resolve the login issue for your team members.
