subject: Need hardware MFA support
body: we need yubikey support for our security. the current app based mfa is not enough for our policy. when will this be added? please let us know.
resolution: We understand the need for hardware-based MFA to meet high security standards. Please add your request for hardware token types on our official roadmap page. We use these requests to prioritize our security development roadmap.

subject: detailed user activity reports request
body: hello team, admins are asking for more detailed reports on user activity like file downloads and views beyond standard audit logs. let us know if this is planned. thanks.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: File previews not loading
body: PDF and PPTX files are not rendering in the web app. I see a blank page or a spinning loader, even though the files download fine. Error PREVIEW-006 is appearing. This is very frustrating for our team.
resolution: This behavior is often linked to browser-side rendering issues or cached data. Please try clearing your cache and cookies, or opening the file in an incognito window to see if an extension is interfering. If the issue remains isolated to specific files, please double-check that those documents are not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Okta SSO login broken after update
body: Ever since the v4.2 update rolled out, none of our users can log in via Okta SSO. They keep getting redirected back to the login page with an Invalid Token Format message. Email and password logins work fine, but we need our SSO fixed immediately to unblock everyone.
resolution: This authentication problem stems from a change in SSO token handling in version 4.2. Please update your CloudDesk application integration inside your Okta console by ensuring the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the updated values found in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: Expired session prompts on mobile app
body: Hi support, our team members using the mobile app are continuously getting logged out and seeing session expired messages ever since the latest update. It is not urgent since we mostly use desktop, but it would be nice to get it cleared up eventually. Thanks.
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to session management for improved security. Users should fully log out of the mobile app, clear their app cache/data (if on Android) or reinstall the app (if on iOS), and then log back in. This will force a new, compatible session token.

subject: User Activity report not showing any data
body: EVERY TIME I try to pull a user activity report it is just BLANK! This is so annoying. I do not have a deadline but I expect the tools I pay for to work properly. Error code REPORT-001.
resolution: This issue is often caused by cached browser data interfering with the report generation. Please try clearing your browser's cookies or testing the report in a different browser. If the page continues to load as blank, please reply with the specific date range you are trying to pull so we can investigate further.

subject: Requesting offline editing for mobile app
body: I am working on some mobile projects and really appreciate the CloudDesk tools. Would it be possible to edit documents while offline and have them sync up later? It would be a huge help for my workflow. Thank you for your time.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: Data retention policy not removing deleted files
body: We configured a 30-day retention policy for deleted files, but files remain visible and recoverable in the trash bin past 30 days with error RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED. This is blocking our workspace compliance cleanup and needs immediate attention.
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: new users not provisioning via sso
body: Hey support, new users logging in via SSO are not getting automatically provisioned in clouddesk even though Just-in-Time Provisioning is enabled. We are seeing error code CD-AM-009 on our pro account and it is getting pretty annoying. Can you look at this
resolution: First, verify that your SSO Identity Provider is correctly sending the required user attributes like email, first name, and last name in the SAML or OIDC assertion. Also, make sure there are available seats in your subscription and check 'Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings' for any recent configuration errors.

subject: unrecognized charge on account
body: hi there i noticed a charge on my credit card that i do not recognize. it is showing as error code BILL-CHG-010 when i check my statements. i really need to get this sorted out today as it is blocking our expense reconciliation process.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Mobile app push notifications lagging
body: We have noticed that notifications for file changes are not arriving on time, often appearing only after the app is opened. It seems to be a widespread issue with the MOBILE_NOTIFICATION_DELAY code popping up frequently. No rush on this, but we would appreciate a fix when possible. Thank you for your hard work.
resolution: Please verify that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk app settings and your device's system preferences. Often, battery optimization settings can restrict background activity, so please check those as well. If the issue persists, reinstalling the mobile app often clears up notification delivery synchronization.

subject: Incorrect user count on our recent PRO invoice
body: Hey there. I am looking at our latest invoice and the number of users listed is way higher than our actual active count. We have been overcharged and it says error code BILL-INV-001 at the bottom. Can you fix this soon please?
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice as changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle. If the discrepancy persists, please provide the invoice ID and your current user count for a manual review.

subject: Deleted users still appearing in workspace sharing
body: I deleted a user account yesterday, but their name is still popping up in my sharing dialogs. It is quite annoying to keep seeing them listed when they should be gone. Can you make sure they are completely removed?
resolution: Deleted users are removed from active access immediately but may remain as ghost entries in historical share lists until the system purges them within 24 to 48 hours. You can also explicitly remove them from a share via Workspace Settings > Members to clear the list sooner.

subject: Hardware MFA Tokens Support
body: We require hardware-based MFA tokens such as YubiKey for our admin accounts. Please advise when this feature will be available on our free tier. Many users are currently requesting this addition.
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Discrepancy in invoice user count
body: Hello team, we are reviewing our latest Enterprise invoice and noticed the user count reflects a higher number than our current active dashboard shows, causing an error code BILL-INV-001. We truly appreciate the platform's stability and just want to ensure our billing remains accurate. Could you please look into why the numbers do not align for this billing period? Thanks for your help.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: High CPU usage on desktop client
body: The CloudDesk app is using over 50% CPU even when idle, which is slowing my system down. I noticed a PERF-DSK-001 error in the debug logs. Can you please advise on how to stop this excessive resource usage?
resolution: It is likely that your client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. Please pause syncing via the tray icon, then navigate to Settings, click Advanced, and select 'Reset Sync Database'. Once the reset is complete, you can resume syncing, which should bring your CPU usage back to normal.

subject: Incorrect user roles in admin console
body: Several users are showing the wrong roles in the admin panel, showing Contributor instead of Manager. I have an internal audit coming up this Friday and need this display to be accurate. Please let me know how to fix this display issue.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and your actual permissions remain unchanged. You can force a refresh by navigating to the user profile, switching their role to something else, saving, and then switching it back to the original role.

subject: Deleted files visible beyond 30 day retention policy
body: Hello Support, We have configured our 30-day data retention policy in the admin console, but deleted files are still visible and recoverable in the Trash Bin past the 30-day limit. Please assist in ensuring this policy is properly enforced for our workspace.
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: cannot access workspace
body: getting a 403 error when trying to open a shared workspace. my users are seeing PERM-WS-403.4 and cannot get in to see their files. let me know when you can look at this.
resolution: An administrator needs to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace to resolve this access issue. Please navigate to the workspace in your Admin Console and confirm the user is assigned the appropriate access rights under the 'Members' or 'Permissions' tab. Let us know if they still encounter the 403 error after you verify those settings.

subject: Need longer expiration on public sharing links
body: I have been working with our team to organize our folder structures and we have noticed that the public links we generate keep expiring. We have several external partners who need access to these materials for ongoing projects, but the current link limits are quite short. I was wondering if we could have the option to set these to never expire or at least extend the limit significantly. I know we have been using the platform for a few years now, and the team really likes the interface, but this is causing some friction. Let me know what is possible.
resolution: We currently enforce expiration dates on public links to maintain security standards for all organizations. While we do not support 'never expire' links, we are looking into extending the maximum duration. Please submit your specific use case to our roadmap site at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration so our developers can review it.

subject: Request refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: Our account was accidentally upgraded to a paid plan and we need a refund for the charge under bill-ref-005. We are a free tier organization and did not mean to change plans. Please process this refund promptly as it blocks our internal accounting.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Billing section failing with error AUTH-BILL-402
body: Hello, since updating to the latest version, I am unable to access our billing details through our single sign-on credentials. Every time I try to view our invoices or update our payment method, I receive an authentication failed message with error code AUTH-BILL-402. This is blocking our administrative work on our Pro plan. Could you please look into this promptly so we can manage our account?
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password if enabled or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: SSO login failure after update
body: Since the recent v4.2 update, our staff cannot log in and are seeing an 'Invalid SSO Token Format' error code CD-AM-003. This is critical as it is preventing our entire department from accessing our workspace. Please advise on how we can restore access immediately.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated our SSO token requirements, which is likely why your logins are failing. Please update your SSO application configuration within your Identity Provider to match the new token schema. You can find all the necessary details in the CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide.

subject: mfa codes not working
body: our team is having trouble logging in because the google authenticator code is not being accepted. we are seeing error AUTH-MFA-401.2 and we have a major client presentation at 5pm today so we really need to get in.
resolution: Please ensure your phone's clock is set to sync with network time, as timing is critical for MFA. If that does not resolve it, please reset your MFA configuration through your account security settings. Let us know if you still have trouble before your meeting.

subject: Requesting PDF invoices from Admin Console
body: Hello! When trying to download an invoice from the Admin Console, the only available format is CSV, but our accounting department requires a PDF for our financial records. We appreciate your assistance with this matter.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Slow loading times in Users and Groups
body: Hello, I hope you are having a wonderful week so far. I wanted to reach out because yesterday my colleague asked me to check on some permissions, and when I went to the Admin Console and clicked on Users and Groups, it took several minutes to load our entire organization list. The search and filters also felt a bit sluggish while trying to find specific accounts. There is no major rush on this since we do not need it immediately, but I thought I would mention it.
resolution: Hello. We advise using the search bar or applying specific filters such as Status: Active immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset size. The system is heavily optimized for filtered views on large datasets, and you can also navigate directly to a specific user via search if their email is already known.

subject: Need to track external user activity on shared links
body: Hi, we are sharing files with external contractors, but the audit logs only show our internal user who created the link. We need to know exactly who accessed the file, but we keep seeing the AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS warning. Is there a way to track the identity of these external people?
resolution: By default, shared links are anonymous, which is why individual visitors aren't logged. To track specific external users, you must configure the link to 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login' before sending it out. Please note that this cannot be applied retroactively to links that are already active.

subject: SSO login failing on desktop sync client
body: Hello support team, thank you for your continued hard work on the platform. When I try to log into the desktop sync client using our free tier SSO, the browser redirects correctly but the application remains unauthenticated with a generic error code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. It appears several users are encountering this exact same synchronization hurdle at the moment. Please take a look when you have a moment, and thank you again for your help.
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, suggest logging in via email/password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: new user stuck in pending invitation status
body: We invited a critical team member via API, they clicked the link, but their status in the Admin Console remains pending and they can't access anything. We see error CD-AM-005. We have a hard deadline for project kickoff today at 3pm, so please help us resolve this right away.
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set (if any). If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and send a new one.

subject: Audit log retention limit increase
body: Admin attempting to set the audit log retention period in the Admin Console to more than 1 year finds the maximum selectable value is 12 months. AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT code appears. We need this for our audit on Friday.
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution such as Splunk or Sumo Logic via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. This is a feature request for extending native retention.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in admin console
body: The admin console is showing wrong roles for several users, like Contributors showing as Managers. This is very frustrating as it makes managing permissions difficult. When can this be fixed.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug that does not affect actual user permissions. You can refresh the display by navigating to the user's profile in the console, changing their role, saving, and then changing it back to the original setting. We are working on a permanent fix for a future patch.

subject: Okta SSO logins failing with token error
body: Our entire organization cannot log into CloudDesk using Okta SSO following the recent v4.2 update, receiving the AUTH-SSO-401.1 error. This is severely impacting our daily operations and blocking all staff members from accessing workspaces. We require an immediate fix for this critical authentication failure.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This step is required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2. Once the metadata is updated, your Okta SSO logins will function normally.

subject: okta sso login broken after update
body: everyone in the office is locked out of the app. sso is throwing AUTH-402 invalid token format errors since the v4.2 update. we need this fixed immediately as no one can get into their files this morning.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration'.

subject: Password reset email missing for pro user
body: Good afternoon to the support team at CloudDesk, as I was sitting at my desk reviewing our project timelines and waiting for a courier to deliver some hardware documents, I noticed that one of our team members on our pro plan requested a password reset but did not receive the email, despite checking their spam folder thoroughly while other notifications from your service come through just fine, and although we are not in a massive rush, we would like to get this sorted out soon.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and check if their domain is configured with an approved email sender list. If not, advise adding no-reply@cloudesk.com to their allowlist. You can also manually trigger a password reset from the Admin Console if necessary.

subject: API 401 Unauthorized errors after v4.2 update
body: Since the v4.2 update, our automated scripts are failing with a 401 Unauthorized error, specifically citing 'legacy_token_format'. We have a crucial audit occurring this Friday and these integrations are vital for our reporting. Could you help us resolve this issue immediately?
resolution: The API token format was updated in our recent v4.2 release. You will need to regenerate all your existing API tokens via the Admin Console under 'API & Integrations' and update your applications to use these new credentials.

subject: Too many email notifications, need to turn some off
body: I am getting flooded with emails every time someone leaves a comment. Its incredibly annoying and unproductive to sort through this noise. Can you please add an option to only alert me for @mentions? I really need this addressed soon as it is driving my team crazy.
resolution: We understand your frustration with the current notification volume. Currently, you can manage general alerts via your profile settings. For more granular control, please submit your specific requirements to our roadmap page so our team can prioritize these improvements.

subject: workspace taking forever to load with lots of files
body: Hello support team hope your week is going well. I wanted to reach out because my team has been trying to access our main marketing folder which has about fifteen thousand documents inside it and every time we click on it the page just hangs with a spinner and eventually throws error WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT. This has been happening all morning since our network update. Could someone take a look when you have a moment.
resolution: Hello! We are currently seeing an influx of reports regarding large workspaces taking a long time to load. Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace, and advise your team to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Additionally, we suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones, and verifying your browser console for any network errors.

subject: API ENDPOINTS ARE TOO SLOW AND BLOCKING US
body: LISTEN! Specific API endpoints like GET /files are consistently returning responses in over 500ms with API_RESPONSE_SLOW, severely impacting our integrations and causing downstream application delays for large datasets! Many users are hitting this at the same moment right now on our Pro plan. THIS IS BLOCKING OUR WORK COMPLETELY AND WE NEED PROMPT ASSISTANCE NOW!
resolution: Request specific API call examples (endpoint, request body, timestamps) from the customer. Advise optimizing API calls by using pagination and filtering parameters to reduce the dataset returned. Suggest caching frequently accessed data on their end. Escalate to engineering with provided logs for performance analysis.

subject: Users experiencing attribute mismatch errors on Okta SSO login
body: Hello CloudDesk Support, hope you are having a wonderful week. Several of our team members are unable to log in via Okta SSO following the recent updates, and they are encountering a 'User attribute mismatch' or 'Missing required attribute' error on the login page after being redirected. Could you kindly advise us on how to resolve this so our staff can resume their work promptly? Thank you so much for your assistance.
resolution: Hello. In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, please verify that the 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Additionally, ensure that 'email' is set as the unique identifier for successful authentication.

subject: API intermittent 429 errors during high load
body: We are getting 429 Too Many Requests errors frequently now during our peak hours. It is messing up our sync process and we have a major demo at 5pm today that requires this data to be live. Can you help us resolve this? Our current rate limits seem to be too low for our traffic.
resolution: We are seeing higher than normal API traffic which may be affecting your throughput. I recommend implementing exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client to handle these spikes more gracefully. If your traffic remains high, please provide some usage details so we can evaluate a potential rate limit increase for your account.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade refund request
body: Hello, our organization accidentally triggered a plan upgrade in the admin console earlier today. We would like to request a refund for the prorated charge or reverse the upgrade if possible. Let me know what details you need from our side to process this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Intermittent API 500 errors on file content
body: Why are our API calls failing with API-500 errors? This is completely blocking our ability to retrieve file content and it is unacceptable! We need this working reliably right now! Please explain why this is happening.
resolution: We are aware of an intermittent issue with distributed storage retrieval and are working on a fix. In the meantime, please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client to handle these temporary failures.

subject: Request for longer public sharing link expiration periods
body: Hello support team. Our administrators would like to know if we can set public sharing links to never expire or to have a much longer expiration period than the current maximum. This would help us streamline long-term document sharing with external stakeholders. Let us know if this is configurable.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Missing login logs for security review
body: We are concerned about a possible breach but your Login Activity log is empty for suspicious entries. I only see successful logins and nothing else. I need to see all attempts immediately.
resolution: Failed logins and unusual activity are recorded in the Security Events log rather than the standard Login Activity report. Please navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events to view these details. You may also want to enable Login Anomaly Detection for future alerts.

subject: API tokens broken and returning 401 errors after v4.2
body: We just noticed that all of our existing API tokens are returning 401 Unauthorized with a legacy_token_format error code API-AUTH-401-V42 since the v4.2 upgrade. This has completely broken our automated data pipelines right in the middle of the workday. We urgently need to know how to fix this token issue right now.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console and update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Branding missing on SSO login page
body: Why does my login page look like standard CloudDesk again? It was working fine yesterday but now everyone sees the default branding. I keep seeing SSO-UI-200.2 when checking the page source. This is incredibly frustrating for our users who expect to see our logo! Can you please look at this?
resolution: It looks like the custom branding configuration was briefly disconnected. Please navigate to the 'SSO & Branding' section in your Admin Console to verify that your logo and background image are still saved correctly. After confirming, ask your users to clear their browser cache, which should restore your company's custom branding.

subject: rate limit errors on api calls
body: hey team, our api calls keep giving us 429 too many requests during peak usage times. no huge rush on this since we can wait, just wanted to check if there is anything we should know about this. thanks!
resolution: We recommend implementing exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client to handle peak traffic gracefully. Please review your application's API usage patterns and consider optimizing calls or requesting a rate limit increase via support if justified by legitimate use cases.

subject: user activity report blank
body: the user activity report is returning no data for me even though other reports work fine. getting REPORT-001 error I think. can you check why its not loading
resolution: This is likely a temporary data retrieval error. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, then try loading the report again. If it is still blank, let us know which specific date range you are trying to view so we can investigate further.

subject: Unrecognized charge on our billing statement
body: Hi there, I was looking over our corporate finances and reviewing our server infrastructure costs, cloud provider vendor invoices, and various software subscriptions, when I noticed a line item from CloudDesk that I cannot reconcile with our expected monthly bill. We use the API extensively for our custom integrations and automated workflows, but this particular amount seemed unexpected given our current usage tiers. We are seeing error code BILL-CHG-010 on our recent statement. Whenever you have a chance, please let me know what this is for.
resolution: Hello. To help us investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, the date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. Once we have those details, we will cross-reference them with your account's billing history and provide a full breakdown.

subject: Account locked out unexpectedly
body: Hi there, I seem to be locked out of my account after entering my password a few times. I am seeing error AUTH-LOCK-429.1 and cant get in even though my credentials are correct. I have an important deliverable today so prompt help would be greatly appreciated. Thank you so much for your time!
resolution: Instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: Workspace loading issues with large files
body: Workspaces with over 10,000 files are hanging on a loading screen for over 30 seconds. This is significantly slowing down our team productivity. Is there a way to improve these load times?
resolution: Large workspaces can cause performance degradation; we recommend using our search filters to narrow your view. Alternatively, consider breaking the large workspace into smaller, modular ones to improve responsiveness.

subject: workspace loading issues
body: Large workspaces with thousands of files are hanging for over 30 seconds. We are receiving the WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error. Please address this performance issue.
resolution: This happens when workspaces exceed optimal file counts. We recommend splitting large workspaces into smaller groups or using search filters to improve load times. Please also check your browser console for any underlying network connectivity errors.

subject: Invitation emails not arriving for new workspace members
body: Greetings support team, we noticed that when we invite new colleagues, the status remains pending and they do not receive the email. There are no bounce-back errors on our side. Could you please advise on how to resolve this? Many thanks for your help.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Desktop sync client login failing with SSO
body: Our users are stuck unable to log into the desktop sync client because the browser redirect is failing. This is hitting us with the DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 error and is blocking our workflow. Please advise on how to resolve this authentication loop as soon as possible.
resolution: Please ensure that your desktop sync client is updated to version 4.2.1 or newer to support the latest token format. Additionally, verify that your default browser is configured correctly to handle SSO redirects. If you still encounter trouble, you may use email and password credentials as a temporary workaround.

subject: Automated data export to S3 failing
body: We have been using the automated export to our S3 bucket for a while now without any issues. Since the recent v4.2 update, the console is showing an Invalid Credentials error when attempting to push data. I see the code S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401 in the logs. Everything on the AWS side looks correct and nothing was changed on our end. Please let me know when you have a chance to look at this.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced stricter IAM policy requirements for S3 integrations. Please ensure your AWS IAM policy includes the new 's3:GetBucketLocation' permission. You can find the updated requirements in the v4.2 S3 Integration Guide on our help site.

subject: Refund request for accidental plan upgrade
body: hey we accidentally upgraded our plan and need a refund for the charge bill-ref-005. can you please process this for us?
resolution: We handle refund requests for accidental upgrades on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time the upgrade occurred and confirm that no features from the new plan have been utilized. Once confirmed, we will review your account to determine eligibility for a refund.

subject: Okta SSO Login Broken After v4.2 Update
body: Our entire team is currently unable to access the platform via Okta, receiving an AUTH-402 error every time we try. This is causing a massive bottleneck for our daily operations. Since the v4.2 update, nobody can log in. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: This issue relates to the new SSO token handling in v4.2. Please have your IT team log into the Okta console to verify that the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the values listed in our updated v4.2 configuration guide under your admin settings. Updating these settings should resolve the token mismatch error.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in admin console
body: Hi team, noticed that some users roles are showing up wrong in the admin panel like contributor instead of manager. Their actual workspace access seems fine though. No huge rush on this since permissions work, but wanted to report it.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug. The actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: Unable to log in via SSO

body: we changed a team member from member to guest and now they cant get into the mobile app at all error code cd-am-002 keeps showing up saying insufficient permissions they need access back right away
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Mobile app crashing on large file uploads
body: Hey there, were noticing that when our users try to upload files bigger than 1GB on the mobile app, it just shuts down entirely without any warning or message. It keeps hitting error CRASH-MOB-001 on both iOS and Android. Any help you can provide to get this stable would be greatly appreciated. Thanks for the support.
resolution: I am sorry for the trouble with large file uploads on mobile. This is a known memory limitation, so please use our web or desktop client for files over 1GB while our engineers work on an update. We appreciate your patience as we address this in a future release.

subject: Deleted user still visible in sharing dialogs
body: Hello, I recently removed several users from our account, but I noticed they are still appearing in the workspace sharing dropdowns. It is causing some confusion for our team. Is there a way to clear these names out immediately? Thank you for the assistance.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately restricted, though they may appear as ghost entries until the system performs a scheduled purge in 48 hours. Alternatively, a workspace owner can manually remove them from the list via the Workspace Settings menu. This is standard system behavior.

subject: Desktop client uploaded local folders without consent!
body: User reports that the desktop sync client automatically uploaded files from their local Documents folder to a CloudDesk workspace without explicit consent! We suspect a major privacy violation and need this resolved immediately to unblock our work.
resolution: The desktop sync client only syncs folders explicitly configured by the user or pre-configured by an admin. Check the sync client settings for 'Synced Folders' and verify no unintended folders were selected. Ensure 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is disabled if not desired. If an admin-mandated sync, contact your internal IT.

subject: SSO login completely broken for all users

resolution: The v4.2 release requires an update to your SSO integration due to the new token format. Please go to the CloudDesk Admin Console and either re-download the updated SAML metadata or re-generate your OIDC client secret to restore access. Detailed steps for this update are available in the v4.2 release notes.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA code not working
body: I am trying to log in but my MFA codes from Google Authenticator are being rejected. It happens every time I try to sign in. How can I get back into my account?
resolution: This usually happens if your phone's time is out of sync with network time. Please ensure your device's time is set to automatic, or you can reset your MFA settings through the security page in your web account.

subject: API Key suddenly returning 401 Unauthorized
body: My existing API key has stopped working completely and now I am getting 401 Unauthorized errors on my desktop sync tool. API-AUTH-401.4 keeps showing up! This is a disaster, we need this fixed now!
resolution: Please log into your Admin Console and check the status of your API key to ensure it hasn't expired or been accidentally revoked. If the key is valid but still failing, you may need to regenerate the key and update your client application.

subject: Blank page when loading User Activity reports

I've been with the company for five years now and I usually just click the report tab, but now I see error code REPORT-001. Could you check why this isn't showing any data?
resolution: This generally points to a temporary data retrieval issue during the report generation. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies or attempting the request in a different browser. If the page remains blank, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to pull.

subject: Cannot update company name
body: I am unable to change our company name in the admin console because the field is read-only. I am seeing the error code CD-AM-010 when I try to save my changes. This is becoming quite frustrating as we need our branding to be accurate. Please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: The company name field is linked to your billing details, which is why it appears as read-only. To update this, please navigate to Admin Console > Subscription & Billing and edit the Organization Name directly there. Once updated, the change will automatically propagate to your Company Settings.

subject: Lag during simultaneous document editing
body: Hello. When multiple team members work on the same CloudDesk Office document at the same time, we experience a noticeable delay of several seconds before typing and cursor movements show up for others.
resolution: To improve real-time collaboration, please check the network latency and internet stability of all participants. Having everyone close extra browser tabs or clearing their cache can also help reduce document editing lag.

subject: Detailed user activity reporting request

resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting, which will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Blank User Activity report page

resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: User login issues after role change

Please let me know how to fix this for them.
resolution: Guest users have restricted access and must be explicitly invited to specific workspaces. Please check the user's role in the Admin Console; if they require broader access, you should revert their role to 'Member' or 'Admin' to restore their original permissions.

subject: want to switch to annual billing

resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: invoice user count mismatch

resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to version v4.2.1 or newer, and check that your default web browser is correctly configured to handle custom protocol SSO redirects. As a temporary workaround, you can also log in via standard email and password if your organization allows it.

subject: External user details missing from audit logs

resolution: By default, external share links are anonymous. To track external user activity, the share link must be configured with Require Email Verification or Require CloudDesk Login, ensuring the external user identity is captured in the audit logs.

resolution: The v4.2 release requires an update to your SSO token configuration. Please follow the migration guide in our documentation to update your identity provider schema to match the new format.

For very large files, we recommend that recipients use a download manager, or that the sender shares files via the Desktop Sync client for more robust transfers. We can also verify your workspace server region if needed.

resolution: We recognize how critical granular controls are for complex folder structures. Currently, permissions are restricted to the top folder level. Please share your specific use cases on our roadmap page at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions so our engineering team can prioritize this correctly.

If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Downgrade request

resolution: To change your subscription, please navigate to the Billing section in your Admin Console and select the desired tier under Subscription Details. Note that downgrades will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle, and we are unable to issue prorated refunds for the remaining time.

subject: New user gets User Not Found error

resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Conflicting file duplicates appearing in sync folder
body: Hello support team, I noticed that the desktop sync client is frequently flagging my documents as a conflict even when nobody else has touched them. It keeps creating extra duplicate files with timestamps in the name. I am on the free plan and not in a huge rush to fix this, but it is a bit messy. Error code SYNC-003 appeared earlier today. resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: sso login fails on billing page

resolution: The v4.2 update changed how SSO tokens interact with sensitive billing sections. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or temporarily log in using your direct email and password to access the billing portal while we investigate this SSO issue.

resolution: Guide the customer's Azure AD administrator to verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped in the enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. Provide a link to our Azure AD SSO configuration guide.

subject: Unintentional plan upgrade refund request

resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

resolution: This behavior often occurs with very large or deeply nested folder structures within a specific workspace. Please try using more specific keywords or path-based queries, and let us know the workspace ID so our engineering team can review the index health.

resolution: With the release of v4.2, we have updated our API token format. You will need to regenerate your API tokens through the API & Integrations section of your Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new tokens to restore access.

subject: URGENT: Missing login audit logs for security review

We have a strict deadline and need to see all authentication events immediately. Error code is AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses or locations are recorded in the Security Events log rather than the standard Login Activity view. Please navigate immediately to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events to access this information. We also recommend enabling Login Anomaly Detection for future automated alerts.

subject: API broken, legacy_token_format error, API-AUTH-401-V42

resolution: With the v4.2 release, the API token format has been updated. You will need to regenerate all your existing API tokens via the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications to utilize these new tokens immediately.

subject: Slow download speeds for shared workspace files

resolution: Test download speeds using a different browser or network. Advise checking browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager if available or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Verify server region for the workspace.

subject: API tokens returning 401 error after v4.2 update

This is critical for our operations and completely halting our background integrations right now. We need an immediate fix to restore our API connectivity.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens to restore your integrations.

subject: Data retention policy not working
body: I set a 30-day retention policy but files in the trash are still there after 30 days. It seems like the policy isn't being enforced and I am worried about compliance. Error RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED keeps appearing in my logs.
resolution: Please double-check your settings under Security & Compliance. Note that data retention policies generally apply to permanently deleted files; files currently in the 'Trash Bin' are meant for user-initiated recovery and are not automatically purged by that specific policy unless explicitly configured to do so. Please verify your trash auto-purge settings.

subject: Need PDF format for admin console invoices
body: When I go to download our monthly invoice from the admin console, the system only offers a CSV export option. Our corporate tax audit is scheduled for this Friday and our accounting department strictly requires official PDF invoices for compliance records. Error code BILL-INV-009 is showing up on the billing page as well. Please ensure we get the proper PDF documents before the end of the week.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: User Activity report not loading data, REPORT-001
body: Hello, I am trying to pull a report for my team, but the User Activity report page is blank. I see error code REPORT-001 when I inspect the network tab. Everything else seems to be working perfectly. I would appreciate it if you could look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: This indicates a temporary data retrieval issue during page load. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or try accessing the report from a different browser to rule out extension conflicts. If the page remains blank, kindly provide the specific date range you are attempting to view so we can investigate further.

subject: Data retention policy not removing files from trash
body: We have configured a 30-day data retention policy for our company, but I see that files in the trash bin are still accessible long after the 30-day mark. It seems the policy is not being enforced as expected. Could you please clarify how this works? We would like this corrected soon.
resolution: Please note that retention policies are primarily designed to purge files that have reached the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Items remaining in your 'Trash Bin' are held for user-initiated recovery and are not automatically removed by the retention policy unless your specific settings include a rule to purge the trash folder after a certain period. Please review your Security & Compliance settings in the Admin Console to ensure those specific triggers are enabled.

subject: Workspace invitation emails not sending
body: New workspace member invites are stuck in pending and invitees are never receiving the email. There are no bounce-back errors shown anywhere. Please investigate this delivery issue.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: CRITICAL SSO LOGIN BROKEN

resolution: Because of the SSO token format change in our v4.2 update, you will need to re-upload your Identity Provider metadata in the CloudDesk Admin Console. This will synchronize your configuration with our new token standards and restore access for your users.

subject: Google SSO domain access issues

resolution: This occurs when a domain has not been explicitly permitted in your security settings. Please log into your CloudDesk Admin Console and navigate to the SSO & Identity settings. You will need to add the missing domain to the 'Allowed Domains' list to grant them access.

subject: CANNOT LOG IN WITH SSO

resolution: Please confirm that your desktop sync client is updated to at least version 4.2.1. Also, check that your default browser is correctly configured for SSO redirects. As an immediate workaround, you may try logging in using your standard email and password if your team has not enforced SSO.

subject: Data retention policy not working
body: I have been working here for six years and we have a very strict compliance protocol we must follow. I noticed our files in the trash bin are staying there longer than the 30-day window I set, and I am seeing the error RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED. This is a high priority as it puts our audit status at risk. Can you please check why our policy is failing to delete these items?
resolution: Please double-check your configuration under Admin Console, Security & Compliance, and Data Retention. Policies specifically govern files marked as 'Permanently Deleted,' whereas items in the 'Trash Bin' are reserved for user-initiated recovery. If you need the trash bin to be emptied automatically, please ensure you have also enabled the specific purge setting for the Trash Bin.

subject: Critical: SSO login failing with invalid token

resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token format, which requires an update to your integration. Please go to your CloudDesk Admin Console and re-download your SAML metadata or re-generate your OIDC client secret. Refer to the v4.2 release notes for the specific configuration steps.

subject: Seat limit error despite available seats
body: I AM TRYING TO ADD NEW TEAM MEMBERS BUT IT KEEPS SAYING SEAT LIMIT REACHED EVEN THOUGH I HAVE OPEN SEATS! I keep getting the error code CD-AM-001 and it is making my job very difficult. PLEASE FIX THIS IMMEDIATELY!
resolution: The seat limit error often occurs because pending invitations count against your total capacity. Please check the 'Pending Invitations' section in your Team Management console and revoke any old invites that have not been accepted. This will free up the seats you need to add your new users.

subject: Cannot remove user from workspace
body: I am trying to clean up our user list but I keep getting error CD-AM-014 when I try to remove someone. It says they are an owner, which is ridiculous! I need to remove this user immediately to manage our team access. Why is this happening now?
resolution: The error occurs because the user is currently the owner of that workspace. To proceed, you must first transfer the workspace ownership to another member via Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership. Once ownership is reassigned, you will be able to remove the user as expected.

subject: accidental plan upgrade refund request

resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: User cannot login after role change

resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Error removing workspace user

resolution: Hello! A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace. The ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error

resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, check the 'Allowed Domains' list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO to resolve this error.

subject: Critical failure: Okta SSO broken after v4.2 update

resolution: This issue is caused by the change in SSO token format introduced in version 4.2. Please log into your CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata under the SSO configuration settings to resolve the AUTH-SSO-401.1 error. This should restore access for your team immediately.

subject: google sso domain not allowed error

resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, please check the 'Allowed Domains' list. You will need to add any missing domains that should be permitted to authenticate via Google SSO.

subject: Cannot add new team members, getting seat limit error

resolution: Please check your 'Pending Invitations' in the Admin Console under Team Management. These outstanding invites count against your total seat limit even if the users haven't accepted yet. You can either revoke those older invites or upgrade your plan to free up the necessary capacity.

subject: API intermittent rate limiting

subject: High CPU usage on Desktop Sync

resolution: It sounds like your sync client might be stuck in a re-indexing loop. Please pause the sync process from your tray icon, then navigate to Settings, then Advanced, and select Reset Sync Database to clear the cycle. If you still see high CPU usage, please ensure you aren't syncing an unusually high volume of small files, which can occasionally trigger this behavior.

subject: Blank user activity report in admin console
body: When I open the User Activity report page, the layout loads but no data appears at all. We have an internal audit starting on Friday so I need this working promptly. Please let me know how to fix this.
