resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: I have requested a password reset multiple times for a user, but the email never arrives. I have checked all spam filters, and other system emails are coming through fine. Error code is AUTH-PR-200.1. This is very frustrating.
resolution: Please verify that your company's domain allows emails from our system by adding no-reply@cloudesk.com to your allowlist. If the issue persists, I can manually trigger a reset link from the admin console for you.

subject: Role creation error in console
body: Hey there, I am trying to setup a new custom role for our accounting team but the system says the name already exists. It definitely does not exist in our current list. The error code is CD-AM-012. No rush on this, just thought I would flag it when you have a chance.
resolution: Please note that role names are case-insensitive and leading or trailing spaces are automatically removed. It is possible there is a role that differs only by capitalization or hidden spaces. Please double-check your role list in the Admin Console for any existing matches.

subject: Okta SSO failing with Invalid SSO token format error
body: We are currently unable to authenticate users via Okta after our recent upgrade to v4.2. Every login attempt returns the AUTH-SSO-401.1 error code. This is preventing our entire team from accessing their workspaces. Please look into this as it is severely impacting our operations.
resolution: To resolve this, please update your SSO configuration within the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your Identity Provider metadata. This step is necessary due to the SSO token format changes introduced in version 4.2. Let us know if you continue to see the error after re-uploading.

subject: Mobile app network error on iOS and Android
body: Hey support, I am trying to access the mobile app on my phone but it keeps throwing a generic network error even though my connection is completely stable. It is not an urgent issue since I am mostly on my desktop, but figured I would let you know.
resolution: Please force close the app, check for app updates in your respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache or data on Android or reinstalling the app on iOS or Android, and verify server status on our status page.

subject: audit log missing login activity for suspicious ips
body: urgent audit breach concern admin suspects unusual logins from new countries but standard login activity log only shows successful logins and misses everything else we need the full security trail right now
resolution: Hello. Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses or locations are recorded in the 'Security Events' log, not the standard 'Login Activity' section. You can find this information by navigating to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events, and we recommend enabling 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic alerts.

subject: Desktop Sync SSO Login Failed DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3
body: When attempting to log into the desktop sync client using SSO, the browser redirects but the client remains unauthenticated or shows code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. We have an audit on Friday and need this resolved promptly.
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version v4.2.1 or newer. Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, suggest logging in via email/password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: Account locked out error
body: One of our primary system operators sees an account locked message after multiple login failures and cannot log in even with correct credentials. We are seeing error code AUTH-LOCK-429.1. Please unlock this account promptly so we can resume our operations.
resolution: Instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: SSO login failing on desktop client
body: Our users are unable to access the desktop sync client via SSO. It redirects through the browser but then fails to authenticate, showing DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. This is blocking our entire department from accessing their synced files.
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to version v4.2.1 or higher. Check that your default browser is correctly configured for SSO redirects, or try using standard email/password login as a temporary workaround if SSO is not strictly enforced.

subject: Unrecognized charge on my statement
body: I noticed a charge on my credit card statement from CloudDesk that I simply do not recognize. My account is on the free plan, so I should not be seeing any charges at all! I keep seeing an error code BILL-CHG-010 when I try to look at my billing history. Please explain this immediately.
resolution: To investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, the date of the transaction, and the last four digits of the credit card used. Once we have these details, we will cross-reference them with our billing logs and clarify the charge for you.

subject: Webhooks failing connection
body: Webhooks are not being received by the external service, showing connection refused in webhook logs. Please investigate.
resolution: Verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range (refer to documentation for current IPs).

subject: Requesting longer expiration for public shared links
body: We have been using CloudDesk to share project assets with our external vendors and it has been working wonderfully. However, our team would love the option to set public links to never expire or at least allow for a much longer window. We appreciate all the hard work your team puts into the platform.
resolution: Our current link expiration settings are in place to maintain security best practices across the platform. While we are not offering 'never expire' links, we are reviewing requests for longer durations. Please submit your specific business requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration, or consider adding your vendors as direct members to the workspaces for permanent access.

subject: Cannot access old invoices in admin console
body: I am trying to pull records for our financial audit, but I am unable to view any invoices older than one year in the admin console. I am seeing error code BILL-INV-003. Could you please assist in locating these documents?
resolution: Our admin console is currently limited to displaying the last 12 months of billing history. Please provide the specific invoice dates or IDs you need, and our billing team will be happy to pull those from our secure archives for you.

subject: Unrecognized charge on our corporate credit card
body: I am looking at our latest statement and noticed an unexpected charge from CloudDesk that I simply cannot reconcile. This is incredibly frustrating because it is blocking our current budget audit process. Please provide clarification on what this charge is for immediately. The transaction code associated with it is BILL-CHG-010.
resolution: To investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, the transaction date, and the last four digits of the card used. Once we have those details, we can cross-reference them with your account's billing history to identify the BILL-CHG-010 transaction.

subject: CRITICAL: Users cannot log in via Okta
body: Our users are unable to log in to CloudDesk using Okta SSO. They are receiving an 'Invalid SSO token format' error (AUTH-SSO-401.1). This started happening immediately after the v4.2 update. This is impacting our entire team's access and operations.
resolution: This issue with Okta SSO after the v4.2 update can be resolved by updating your SSO configuration. Please navigate to the CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata. This step is necessary due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in the latest release.

subject: Webhooks are not working
body: My setup is failing with WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500. I am not receiving any updates to my system. Why is this suddenly broken for us?
resolution: Please check your endpoint URL within the Admin Console's webhook settings. Ensure your service is publicly accessible and that your firewall allows connections from our specified IP ranges, which are listed in our documentation.

subject: Okta SSO failing after v4.2 update
body: Since the v4.2 update, our users are unable to access their accounts via Okta. They are redirected back to the login page with an AUTH-402 error. This is completely blocking our team from accessing their files. Please advise on how to resolve this as soon as possible.
resolution: This issue is caused by the change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console to match the new Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL found in our v4.2 configuration guide under Settings -> SSO & Authentication.

subject: cant login with sso on desktop app
body: Hey, I am trying to sign into the desktop sync client using our SSO configuration and it keeps failing! The browser redirects but the app just shows a generic login failed error and code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. Please get this sorted out soon so we can continue testing.
resolution: Hello. Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version, v4.2.1 or newer. Check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects properly. As a workaround, you can also log in using your standard email and password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: Some of our users are encountering a 'Domain not allowed' error when trying to sign in via Google. It seems to be isolated to specific domains within our organization, while others are still functioning fine. We would appreciate it if you could help us resolve this SSO-GOOGLE-403 error. Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: It looks like the affected domains need to be authorized within your account settings. Please go to the CloudDesk Admin Console, navigate to the SSO & Identity settings for Google, and add the missing domains to the Allowed Domains list. This should grant the necessary access to those users.

subject: Switching billing cycle to annual
body: Hi there, we would like to switch from monthly to annual billing for our account. We have been seeing error BILL-PLAN-004 when trying to update this in the console. Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please navigate to the Admin Console, then go to Billing and Subscription Details to select 'Change Plan'. From there, you can choose the annual option for your current subscription. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be automatically prorated.

subject: api tokens returning 401 after update
body: hi support, after updating to v4.2 our api integrations stopped working and now existing api tokens return 401 Unauthorized with legacy_token_format error. this is blocking our automation work right now and we need prompt help to get things running again. error code is API-AUTH-401-V42.
resolution: With the release of v4.2, the API token format was updated across the platform. You must regenerate all API tokens from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these newly generated tokens to restore connectivity.

subject: Failed to register MFA device in mobile app
body: Users attempting to set up MFA via the mobile app encounter an error after scanning the QR code with error code MFA-MOB-002. Email and password login works fine, but MFA cannot be configured. Thank you so much for your help with this when you have time.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Desktop Sync stuck on connecting indefinitely
body: Desktop Sync client icon shows Connecting or Indexing indefinitely. Files are not syncing to or from the local folder. SYNC_STATUS_STUCK is visible and this is critical for our entire team right now.
resolution: Instruct user to restart the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache by going to Settings > Advanced > Clear Cache. If still unresolved, suggest a full reinstall of the client after backing up local unsynced files.

subject: More granular notification controls
body: We are currently reviewing our webhook setup and would like to configure notifications more selectively. It would be helpful to receive alerts only for direct mentions rather than all comment activities. This is not urgent at all and can be reviewed whenever convenient.
resolution: We hear your feedback regarding notification preferences. Currently, you can adjust general notification settings in your profile. For more granular control, please outline your specific notification scenarios and preferences at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications. This helps us prioritize improvements.

subject: SSO login failing with token error after update
body: Good morning, as we handle our monthly billing reviews and manage subscriptions for our team, we noticed a sudden disruption following the recent v4.2 platform update. Our users logging in via Azure AD are getting an invalid sso token format error, specifically CD-AM-003, blocking their daily workspace access. We would appreciate your prompt help in getting this workflow restored so our finance team can proceed.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format that requires an update on your end. Please instruct your IT team to update the SSO application configuration in your IdP to use the new token schema, referencing the CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide for details.

subject: User count mismatch on our enterprise invoice
body: Hello support, I am looking over our latest enterprise bill and noticed that the active user count on invoice BILL-INV-001 does not match our current team size in the system. This is causing some discrepancy in our financial records. We are in no particular rush, but whenever you have a moment, could you please take a look? Thanks.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Desktop sync failing after v4.2 update
body: Files are not syncing to the desktop client since the v4.2 update, leading to error SYNC-001. We have a payroll run tomorrow morning and this is critical for our operations. Please help us fix this now.
resolution: Please uninstall the v4.2 client, delete the local sync cache folder, and reinstall the application from your web console. This should resolve the sync communication error for you.

subject: User Activity report page is blank
body: I am attempting to run the User Activity report in the admin console, but the page loads as a blank screen. I have tried this multiple times today and it continues to fail without any data. Could you please investigate why this is occurring?
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering.

subject: Unable to add new team members due to seat limit error
body: Hi Support. We are attempting to add three new colleagues to our Pro workspace today. However, the system is blocking the action with the CD-AM-001 error code and stating that our seat limit has been reached. When I check our subscription overview, it clearly indicates we have four open seats remaining. Could you please look into this discrepancy?
resolution: Verify the Pending Invitations count in Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: My team is getting the SSO-GOOGLE-403 error and cannot log in. We have a demo at 5pm today and this is stopping everyone. Please let me know what needs to be changed to fix this.
resolution: It looks like your domain needs to be added to your identity configuration. Please log into the Admin Console, go to the SSO & Identity settings, and verify your Google SSO settings. You will need to add the missing domain to the 'Allowed Domains' list to grant your users access.

subject: activity log user attribution
body: i noticed that some actions in the workspace log, like file edits, are being attributed to an admin when a regular user did them. error AUDIT-004. thanks for checking.
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. Please note the underlying audit trail is correct; you can cross-reference it with the global audit log in the admin console for accuracy. This is a known bug that we are currently addressing.

subject: Getting API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 errors during peak hours
body: Hello, we are seeing some HTTP 503 errors on our PRO plan integrations recently. It happens when requests get high. Can you take a look when you have a moment, thank you so much.
resolution: We will investigate your API usage patterns to identify if you are exceeding rate limits by checking the X-RateLimit-Remaining header. We advise implementing exponential backoff for retries and confirming if there are any ongoing platform incidents via our status page.

subject: Hardware MFA token support inquiry
body: Dear CloudDesk team, I hope this message finds you well. Our security department is currently reviewing our compliance posture and asked if there are any plans to support hardware-based multi-factor authentication tokens, such as YubiKeys, alongside the standard software options. We love using your Pro platform for our team collaboration and are very happy with the service overall. Thank you so much for your time and guidance on this security matter.
resolution: Hello! CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa, as we prioritize security features based on customer demand.

subject: API requests failing with 401 Unauthorized
body: Hello, our automated scripts started receiving API-AUTH-401 errors today when calling the public REST API. The response says invalid_token or expired_token. We need our integrations working promptly.
resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your requests.

subject: Cannot access Admin Console
body: I am trying to log into the Admin Console but keep getting sent back to the regular user dashboard. I think I might be seeing error code ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. Could someone check why I don't have access?
resolution: Please have another account holder verify your current permissions in the Admin Console under Users and Manage User. You must be assigned an Admin or Super Admin role to access these settings. Once your role is updated, you should be able to enter the console.

subject: Incorrect tax rate on recent invoice
body: Hello, I noticed that the VAT rate on our latest invoice seems to be calculated incorrectly based on our registered office location. I am seeing error code BILL-TAX-006 when I try to verify the settings in the dashboard. Could you please help us get this corrected whenever you have a moment?
resolution: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Please navigate to the Billing Information section of your Admin Console to confirm that your registered business address and tax ID are accurate. If the information there is correct, please reply with your company's legal details and tax exemption certificate so we can perform a manual review.

subject: Okta SSO broken with AUTH-SSO-401.1 after v4.2 update
body: Our entire enterprise user base is completely locked out of the platform following the v4.2 update deployed earlier today. Every login attempt via Okta SSO fails immediately with error AUTH-SSO-401.1 and an invalid token format message. We need this addressed immediately as business operations are halted.
resolution: We apologize for the disruption caused by this update. Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata, which is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Assigned tickets not showing in my view
body: I am having trouble seeing my assigned tasks in the web dashboard. Error code HELPDESK-007 keeps popping up for me and my team. This is blocking our support workflow. Please advise on a fix immediately.
resolution: This behavior is typically caused by a caching conflict with your permissions. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, then log back in to refresh your session. If the issue persists, have an administrator re-assign the ticket to another user and then back to you to force a sync.

subject: api key returning 401 unauthorized
body: existing api key returns 401 unauthorized or invalid api key error. it was working fine until today. we have a payroll run tomorrow so this is blocking us completely please help immediately error code API-AUTH-401.4
resolution: Verify the API key's status in the Admin Console ('API Keys' section). Check if it has expired or been revoked. Advise the user to regenerate a new API key if necessary and update their application.

subject: Slow download speeds for shared files
body: We have noticed that our users are experiencing very slow download speeds when accessing files through public links. This is happening regardless of file size or time of day. Are there any known server-side bottlenecks currently affecting the platform?
resolution: Test download speeds using a different browser or network. Advise checking browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager if available or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Verify server region for the workspace.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental upgrade
body: Our account was accidentally upgraded to a higher plan. I would like to request a refund for the error. The error code shown is BILL-REF-005. Please let me know the process for this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time the upgrade occurred and confirm that no features from the new plan have been utilized yet. Once confirmed, we will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Cannot view old invoices
body: Hi, I am trying to download some of our invoices from over a year ago but they are not appearing. I see error code BILL-INV-003. Let me know how I can access these older documents when you get a chance.
resolution: The Admin Console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months. For older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you are looking for, and we will retrieve it for you from our archives.

subject: Workspace invitation emails not being received
body: Good day to the support team, I hope you are doing well. We have recently invited several new colleagues to join our team workspace, but none of them have received their invitation emails, and the status remains permanently pending in our member list with code EMAIL-005. It seems that a number of other users are encountering this email delivery hiccup right now. There are no bounce-back notifications showing up on our end. We would greatly appreciate any guidance you can provide to get this sorted out.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: cant transfer workspace ownership
body: hey im trying to transfer workspace ownership to another colleague on our pro account but the button is totally greyed out and gives cd-am-004 error can you help
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a member or admin of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is already a member of the workspace, and if not, add them first before attempting the transfer via Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership.

subject: Okta SSO login failing for users
body: Our users are seeing an SSO-OKTA-403 error when trying to access the site. It seems like the attributes are not being passed correctly after the redirect. We would appreciate it if you could assist us with this.
resolution: Please check your Okta application settings for CloudDesk to ensure the email, firstName, and lastName attributes are mapped correctly. It is critical that the email field is configured as the unique identifier. Once those mappings are verified, the authentication handshake should succeed.

subject: slow download speeds for shared files
body: our team is experiencing very slow download speeds when retrieving files from public links. we are seeing DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW frequently today. it is impacting our workflow so we would appreciate a fix soon. thanks.
resolution: We recommend testing your connection with a different browser or network to rule out local interference. Please check your browser extensions as well, as some can occasionally throttle active downloads. For larger files, we suggest using a dedicated download manager or accessing the files directly through the Desktop Sync client for more reliable transfer speeds.

subject: Need external user details in audit logs
body: Hi, when our company users share files externally, audit logs only show the internal creator and not who actually accessed it. We are seeing AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS errors when trying to trace downloads for our enterprise audit. Please help us fix this promptly as it is blocking our compliance review.
resolution: By default, external share links are anonymous and do not capture specific viewer details. To track external user activity, ensure share links are configured with require email verification or require cloudesk login before sharing. Note that this cannot be retroactively applied to existing anonymous links.

subject: PAYMENT ERROR WHEN USING SSO
body: We updated to v4.2 and now whenever I log in via SSO to check the billing section I get a Authentication Failed message. All other admin pages work fine but I cannot manage our payment methods on our free account. We need this resolved promptly as it is blocking our financial review!
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Lag while editing shared documents
body: I am quite frustrated with the performance of your document editor. When multiple people work on a file, there is a severe lag of several seconds before changes appear for others, often accompanied by the COLLAB_LAG error. It is making it very difficult to maintain a steady flow during team sessions. Can you please address this?
resolution: Please have your team check their network stability and close any unnecessary browser tabs or background applications. We recommend verifying if the lag subsides with fewer concurrent editors. Additionally, clearing the browser cache can often improve the responsiveness of the document collaboration tools.

subject: GOOGLE SSO REDIRECT LOOP! CANNOT LOG IN!
body: I'm trying to log in using Google SSO and I'm stuck in an endless redirect loop after authenticating with Google! I NEVER REACH THE DASHBOARD! This is extremely frustrating. I need to get into my account. Please help!
resolution: Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies specifically for 'cloudesk.com'. If the redirect loop persists, try logging in using an incognito or private window, or a completely different browser. We also recommend verifying your Google SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console.

subject: Search spinner runs indefinitely in specific workspace
body: I am having trouble searching for files in our design workspace. The search spinner just runs forever and I cannot find my documents. I am seeing the error code WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG when this happens. Please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: It is possible that the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested folder structures. Please try using more specific keywords or path-based searches to improve performance. If the issue persists, please provide the specific workspace ID so our engineering team can perform an indexing review.

subject: PAYMENT CARD REJECTED INCORRECTLY
body: We cannot add our new corporate credit card because CloudDesk keeps throwing an invalid card details error! The card information is completely verified and valid, yet your system blocks it every time under error code BILL-PAY-012. We need this fixed right now as our account billing is blocked!
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again after 30 minutes. If the issue persists, try using a different card or contact your bank to ensure there are no blocks on transactions with CloudDesk. You may also try contacting us with the full error message for further investigation.

subject: Lag during simultaneous document editing
body: Document collaboration has severe lag right now. Multiple users editing the same file see a multi-second delay with cursor updates. Please advise.
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved. Advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and applications. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document and clear browser cache for all users.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA codes rejected
body: Our user is trying to log in, but the MFA code from their Google Authenticator app is not being accepted at all! We keep encountering the AUTH-MFA-401.2 error code during the authentication step. We need this sorted out soon so our team can access their workspaces without hassle.
resolution: Please ensure your phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, we recommend guiding the user through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app's Security Settings page.

subject: Unrecognized charge on billing statement
body: I am reviewing our monthly expenses and noticed a charge from CloudDesk that I cannot reconcile with our records. It is flagged with code BILL-CHG-010. Could you please help me clarify what this transaction refers to so I can close out our books?
resolution: To look into this for you, please provide the exact amount, the transaction date, and the last four digits of the credit card charged. Once we have that information, we can cross-reference it with our internal billing history to provide a detailed explanation for you.

subject: Webhooks failing with connection refused error
body: Our external service is not receiving webhooks from CloudDesk. The logs show WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 with delivery failed connection refused. Please assist in resolving this connectivity issue.
resolution: Verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range (refer to documentation for current IPs).

subject: Role change causing login issues for user
body: Good morning. As the person handling our billing and account details here at the company, I wanted to reach out regarding a team member whose role we recently updated. We changed their role from Member to Guest, but now they are reporting they cannot log in to the web application at all and see an insufficient permissions message along with code CD-AM-002. This is currently blocking their daily work tasks, so we would greatly appreciate some prompt help looking into this matter.
resolution: Hello! Guest users can only access shared workspaces they have been explicitly invited to. Please check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role and verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, please change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Requesting hardware-based MFA support like YubiKey
body: Hello. Our security-conscious organization is requesting support for hardware-based MFA tokens such as YubiKey, in addition to the existing software-based options. We appreciate all the hard work your team puts into CloudDesk and look forward to hearing from you.
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification, though we fully recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa, as we prioritize features based on customer demand.

subject: User cannot log in after role change
body: One of our team members had their role changed to Guest and now they cannot access the mobile app. They are receiving the error CD-AM-002 and cannot do their work. Please assist us in fixing their access immediately.
resolution: Guest users only have access to specific workspaces they are explicitly invited to. Please navigate to the Admin Console to check if the user has active invitations to the necessary workspaces. If they require full system access, you can revert their role to Member or Admin.

subject: Switching subscription to annual billing
body: We would like to switch our current Enterprise subscription from monthly to annual billing to take advantage of the discount. Please let us know the process for this change.
resolution: You can update your billing cycle directly by navigating to Admin Console, then Billing, and finally Subscription Details. From there, select 'Change Plan' and choose the annual option. Your account will automatically switch at the start of the next billing cycle, and any remaining credit will be prorated.

subject: Google Authenticator code rejected on mobile app
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a great week. I am currently unable to log in because my Google Authenticator code is not being accepted by the mobile app. Take your time with this, as I can still access things via desktop when needed. Thank you so much.
resolution: Advise the user to ensure their phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, guide them through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app's 'Security Settings' page.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Our users are not receiving password reset emails when requested. I see error code CD-AM-008. We need this fixed promptly as it is blocking several team members from working.
resolution: Please confirm the user's email is correct in the Admin Console and have them check their junk folders. We also suggest whitelisting 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to ensure delivery. If that fails, an admin can manually trigger a password reset for them through the User management menu.

subject: Unable to delete workspace due to integrations error
body: I am extremely annoyed that I cannot delete an old workspace because it keeps throwing the CD-AM-007 error about active integrations. Many admins are hitting this annoying workflow blocker right now. There is no rush on my end, but it would be great if this could be looked at eventually.
resolution: Before a workspace can be deleted, all active integrations (e.g., Slack, Jira, Zapier) linked to that specific workspace must be disconnected. Navigate to 'Workspace Settings > Integrations' for the affected workspace and disable/remove all listed integrations, then retry deletion.

subject: Webhook delivery issues
body: Hi, I have noticed our webhooks are failing with a Connection refused error. We are receiving logs mentioning WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500. Could you please look into this when you have a moment?
resolution: Please verify your webhook endpoint URL within the Admin Console settings. Additionally, ensure your external service is publicly accessible and that your firewall is configured to allow incoming traffic from CloudDesk's documented IP range.

subject: API integration failing after v4.2 upgrade
body: Our existing API tokens are returning 401 Unauthorized with a 'legacy_token_format' error. This is a critical issue for us as our automated sync processes are completely down. We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.
resolution: With the v4.2 release, the API token format was updated for improved security. You must regenerate your API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new credentials immediately.

subject: Workspace loading issues
body: When navigating to a workspace with many files, the page takes an excessive amount of time to load and shows a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error. It has been happening frequently today.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: USER ACTIVITY REPORT IS COMPLETELY BLANK
body: WHEN I TRY TO PULL THE USER ACTIVITY REPORT IN THE ADMIN CONSOLE IT LOADS A TOTALLY BLANK PAGE WITH ERROR REPORT-001. EVERY OTHER REPORT WORKS FINE EXCEPT THIS ONE WHICH IS DRIVING ME CRAZY.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering, and let us know the exact date range you are trying to view if it remains blank.

subject: API file content endpoint keeps throwing 500 errors
body: Hi team, our developers keep getting HTTP 500 errors from the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. It seems to happen randomly with distributed storage files. Please fix this soon!
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Critical issue: Users unable to login via SSO
body: Our entire team is currently unable to log in using Okta SSO, which is bringing our workflow to a complete standstill. Everyone is receiving an 'Invalid SSO token format' error message. Since we have a major client deadline today, we need this resolved immediately to restore access.
resolution: This issue is caused by the change in SSO token format introduced in v4.2. Please update your SSO configuration within the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your identity provider metadata. This step is required to restore access for your users.

subject: Session Expired loop blocking my enterprise access
body: Hello CloudDesk support, thank you for your hard work. I keep getting logged out immediately with session expired errors on our enterprise workspace. We have an audit on Friday and I am stuck with error AUTH-SESSION-401.5. Please help me fix this quickly.
resolution: Please clear your browser's cookies and local storage specifically for cloudesk.com. Additionally, check if any strict privacy settings or browser extensions are interfering with your session cookies and verify your device's system time.

subject: file preview not loading
body: my team cannot preview any pdfs or powerpoints in the browser. it just shows a blank page or a loader for the preview-006 error. downloads are fine but the viewer is broken.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our rendering service or your browser. Please try clearing your cache and cookies, or test the preview in an incognito window to rule out extension conflicts. Also, verify that the files are not password-protected.

subject: Workspace loading issues when viewing lots of files
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a pleasant morning so far. As I was reviewing our developer integrations and syncing up various API endpoints this Tuesday, I noticed a slight hitch in our web app. When navigating to our primary workspace which currently holds well over ten thousand items, the page takes an excessive amount of time to load and throws the WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error. I am just drinking my coffee and not in any major rush since we can wait a bit, but it would be nice to get this sorted out eventually.
resolution: We are aware that workspaces with massive file counts can trigger a timeout. Please use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, and consider breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones.

subject: Frequent SSO session expiration
body: Since the v4.2 update, our team is getting logged out of CloudDesk constantly. We see the SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 error and are forced to re-authenticate multiple times a day. We have a major demo at 5pm today and this is causing significant delays. Could you please look into this?
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to how SSO tokens are refreshed to improve security. Please ensure your Identity Provider settings for CloudDesk have the 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a duration of at least 8 to 24 hours. This adjustment should stabilize your sessions and prevent the frequent disconnects you are experiencing.

subject: Admin Console access denied
body: As an administrator, I am unable to access the Admin Console and keep getting redirected to the standard user dashboard with access denied errors.
resolution: Confirm the user's role in the Admin Console ('Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Roles'). Ensure they have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned. If not, update their role.

subject: File previews not loading
body: The preview viewer for PDFs just shows a spinning loader and never opens the file. I have to download everything just to see what it is, which is tedious. I am seeing PREVIEW-006 when I hover over the loader. Is there a fix for this?
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito window to rule out extensions.

subject: HOW DO I DOWNGRADE MY PLAN
body: I NEED TO LOWER MY SUBSCRIPTION TIER ON OUR FREE ACCOUNT BECAUSE OUR TEAM IS SHRINKING. BILL-PLAN-011 KEEPS POPPING UP OR I AM JUST BLIND. NO RUSH BUT FIX THIS SO I CAN CHANGER IT.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to the 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan' and select your desired lower tier. Please note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued.

subject: Critical need for offline document editing on mobile
body: Our team relies heavily on CloudDesk while traveling. It is critical that we have the ability to edit documents offline and sync them later. Currently, our productivity is significantly stalled without this function. Could you please let us know if this is on the roadmap? We truly appreciate your hard work on the platform.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: API pagination isnt working right
body: my script is getting fewer results than expected and seems to ignore the limit param. i am seeing API-PAGINATION-500 errors. i have a big data presentation on friday so if u could check this out i would be so greatful
resolution: Please double-check that your API request correctly uses the 'limit' and 'offset' query parameters. Note that there is a hard cap of 1000 items per request, which may explain why you aren't seeing all results. Please let us know if you still have issues after adjusting your parameters.

subject: Mobile app uploads timing out for large files
body: I am absolutely sick of these timeouts! Every time I try to upload a video for work, the progress bar just gets stuck and then I get the UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_504 error. It is taking forever and I am beyond frustrated that I can't get my files into the workspace. Fix this soon!
resolution: I understand how frustrating these interruptions are for large files. For uploads exceeding 500MB, we highly recommend using the Desktop Sync client, which manages large transfers much more reliably than the mobile app. Please ensure your internet connection is stable or try switching to a wired connection if you continue to experience stalls.

subject: Workspace invites stuck as pending
body: We have an important audit on Friday and invited our auditors to the workspace, but they never received their invitation emails. The status just says pending. Please investigate this issue immediately so we can get them access before our deadline.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam folders first. If they are not there, ensure your domain's SPF and DKIM records are properly configured to accept mail from CloudDesk. If the issue persists, provide the specific email addresses of the affected users.

subject: Delayed mobile push notifications for activity
body: Hello. We are experiencing issues where push notifications for file changes, comments, and mentions on the mobile app are arriving several minutes late or not at all unless the app is opened. We notice error code MOBILE_NOTIFICATION_DELAY occasionally. It appears that many customers are hitting this at the same moment right now. We can wait for a fix, but wanted to report it.
resolution: Hello. Thank you for reporting the notification delays. Please verify that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and your device's operating system settings. Check for any battery optimization settings on the device that might be restricting background app activity, and advise reinstalling the mobile app if the delay continues.

subject: Azure AD SSO authentication failing
body: We are seeing the SSO-AZURE-400 error when our users try to authenticate via Azure AD. They are hitting a reply URL mismatch on the Azure page and cannot reach our dashboard. This is a critical blocker for our daily operations, so please provide a resolution promptly.
resolution: This error occurs when the Reply URL in your Azure AD application registration does not match our requirements. Please ensure the Assertion Consumer Service URL is set precisely to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs', substituting your specific company subdomain. Updating this should immediately resolve the mismatch.

subject: Desktop client creating unnecessary conflict files
body: Hello, thank you for all the great work you do. Our desktop app keeps flagging files as conflicts even when nobody else is editing them, generating many duplicate files. We would appreciate it if you could look into this SYNC-003 issue when possible.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: Lag during collaborative document editing
body: When my team tries to edit documents together, there is a huge delay between typing and seeing changes. It makes collaboration almost impossible. It seems like the cursor position updates are really slow and laggy. Is there any way to fix this COLLAB_LAG issue?
resolution: This lag is often caused by network latency or high local resource usage. Please ensure all collaborators have a stable internet connection and try closing unnecessary browser tabs. If the problem continues, clearing the browser cache for all users can help improve performance.

subject: search results are incomplete
body: search is missing files that i know are there. error code search-002. i need this fixed.
resolution: Your search index may be slightly outdated. Try searching for an exact phrase in quotes; if that fails, log out and back in to force a re-index. If it still doesn't work, let us know exactly which files are missing.

subject: Mobile app network error
body: I am unable to access the mobile app despite having a perfect internet connection. It just shows a generic Network Error every time I try to open it. I am very frustrated because I need to check these files for a meeting in an hour. Please fix this.
resolution: Please try force closing the mobile app and checking your app store for any available updates. If the error continues, I recommend clearing the app's cache on Android or reinstalling the application on your device. You can also monitor our official status page to ensure all systems are running.

subject: Search spinning indefinitely in workspace
body: Search results for one of our main folders are taking forever to load, and often the spinner just runs forever. We are seeing a WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG error during these attempts. Can you look into this for us?
resolution: This lag often occurs in workspaces with extremely high file counts or deeply nested structures that exceed standard indexing performance. I suggest using more specific search terms to narrow the scope or attempting to reorganize the folder structure. Please provide the specific workspace ID so our engineering team can review the index status.

subject: password reset email not arriving
body: hi, i am trying to reset my password but the email never shows up. i have checked spam and all other platform emails are coming through fine. could you help me get back into my account?
resolution: I have verified that your email address is correct in our system. Please check with your IT team to ensure 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' is on your domain's allowlist. If you are still not receiving it, let me know and I can manually trigger a password reset for you.

subject: Security concern with API key scope
body: Hello, I notice that my read-only API key has more permissions than it should have. It seems to bypass restrictions, and I see API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS in the console. Could you please help us fix this security risk as soon as possible? Thank you.
resolution: Please revoke the affected API key immediately via the Admin Console. I am escalating this to our engineering team to investigate why the scope is being bypassed, as this is a high-priority security issue.

subject: Mobile app failing with SSO token error
body: Our users are totally blocked from the mobile app because of an Invalid Token Format error since the v4.2 update. It shows error code AUTH-402. We need this fixed ASAP as our field team cannot access their files.
resolution: This error occurs due to the SSO token changes in v4.2. Please have your IT administrator update your Okta integration by ensuring the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values found in your admin console configuration settings.

subject: SSO login broken after v4.2 update
body: We are getting an 'Invalid SSO Token Format' error (CD-AM-003) across our entire company. This is a critical issue as we have a major investor demo at 5pm today and nobody can access their files. We need an immediate fix for this access outage.
resolution: Our v4.2 update introduced a change to the SSO token format. Please update your SSO application configuration within your Identity Provider to reflect the new token schema. You can find the necessary instructions in the CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide.

subject: Document collaboration lag is terrible
body: We are experiencing severe typing lag and slow cursor updates during simultaneous document editing with collab_lag. This is blocking our work because we have a major client presentation at 5pm today. Please help us resolve this issue promptly.
resolution: Please check network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and clearing the browser cache to see if performance improves.

subject: Okta SSO login broken after update
body: WE CANNOT LOG IN! Since the v4.2 update, all our employees get an 'Invalid Token Format' error when using Okta. This is a total disaster for our morning operations and we need a fix NOW. My team is seeing AUTH-402 when they try to authenticate. Please help us fix this immediately as this is blocking all access.
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to our SSO token handling that require an update to your configuration. Your IT administrator must update the CloudDesk application integration within the Okta console to match the new Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL. You can find the updated configuration values under Settings in your Admin Console.

subject: api key scope bypass vulnerability
body: my read-only api key is somehow deleting users which is definitely not supposed to happen. i am seeing error code API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS and i am very worried about our security. please look into this immediately.
resolution: Please revoke that API key immediately within your Admin Console. This is a critical security concern, so please verify if the key was generated with incorrect permissions or if there is a configuration error; if the bypass continues after revocation, let us know so we can escalate this to engineering.

subject: search hanging in workspace
body: workspace search is totally frozen. spinner goes forever in one specific workspace. workspace_search_lag is driving me crazy. no rush though.
resolution: Investigate if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items (e.g., millions of files) or deeply nested folder structures. Advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches. Suggest optimizing the workspace structure if feasible. Report specific workspace ID to engineering for indexing review.

subject: Incorrect role display in admin console
body: In the Users & Permissions section, some users are shown as Contributors when they should be Managers. The actual workspace permissions seem correct, but the display is wrong. Is this a known glitch?
resolution: This is a known UI display bug. The actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: Desktop client not syncing files from web app
body: Hello, ever since updating to v4.2, files changed in the web app are completely missing from my desktop sync client. There are no error messages, but I see SYNC-001 in the diagnostics. This is really frustrating and I need it sorted out soon.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk (Windows) or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk (macOS). Reinstall the client from the download link in your web app's 'Settings' -> 'Desktop Sync' section.

subject: API share workspace returning 403 error
body: We are getting constant API-403 errors when using the POST /workspaces/{id}/share endpoint. We have a major demo at 5pm today and this is completely stalling our automation. Even though our user has manager permissions, the API rejects the calls. Please investigate this immediately.
resolution: Please verify that your API key has the Manage Workspaces scope enabled in your settings. Additionally, ensure the associated user is a direct member of the target workspace rather than gaining access through a group. If it still fails, please send over the specific API key ID and workspace ID for further investigation.

subject: Admin console audit log filters timing out
body: Good day, I wanted to check if there is a known performance issue with the audit logs section. Whenever I try to apply filters by date range or event type, the query takes an extremely long time and often times out completely. Thank you so much for any help you can provide.
resolution: Hello. Advise the administrator to narrow down the filter criteria as much as possible, starting with smaller date ranges. For specific user activity, use the 'User Activity' report in the 'Reports' section, which is optimized for single-user queries. If extensive historical data is needed, suggest exporting the full log and filtering locally.

subject: Files not previewing in web app
body: Hi, we are having trouble viewing PDFs and PPTX files. It just shows a blank screen and nothing loads. I saw the error code PREVIEW-006 earlier today. Downloading them works fine, but we really need the previewer to work again. Thanks.
resolution: This is likely caused by temporary rendering service issues or browser cache conflicts. Please clear your browser cookies and try viewing the file in an incognito window, ensuring the document isn't password-protected.

subject: Search spinning indefinitely in one workspace
body: Hi, I have noticed that when I try to search for files in our main project workspace, the spinner just runs forever. It does not happen in other areas of our account, just this one. I am getting the error code WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG. It is not a major issue right now, so please get to it when you can.
resolution: It appears this workspace contains a very high volume of files which is impacting search performance. Please try using more specific keywords or path-based searches to narrow the scope. I have forwarded your workspace ID to our engineering team to review the indexing.

subject: need pdf invoices

resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for older documents during a system migration. Please provide the specific invoice IDs you require, and we will manually generate those PDFs and email them to you. We apologize for the extra step.

subject: API integration failing with 403 error
body: We are attempting to connect a new integration to the REST API, but we keep receiving an API-AUTH-403.5 error. We have verified our key is correct. Could you please assist us in resolving this?
resolution: It looks like your API key may lack the required scopes. Please have your administrator review the key permissions in the Admin Console under the API Keys section to ensure all necessary access is granted.

subject: Activity log showing wrong user names
body: This is ridiculous, the workspace activity log keeps attributing normal file edits to the administrator instead of the actual contributor who did the work. We have an external compliance audit on Friday and this incorrect data is causing major issues for our free workspace. Fix this fast.
resolution: Hello. This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with Contributor roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct, and this is a known bug we are addressing. For accurate auditing, please cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: Password reset email not received
body: Hi, a user requested a password reset but never got the email, and it is not in spam. Other CloudDesk emails arrive fine. We have a payroll run tomorrow morning and this is blocking us, so we need prompt assistance with auth-pr-200.1.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Check if the user's domain is configured with an approved email sender list. If not, advise adding 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to their allowlist. Manually trigger a password reset from the Admin Console if necessary.

subject: Inconsistent billing API usage reports after v4.2 upgrade
body: Ever since we upgraded to v4.2, the billing API endpoint reports usage data that completely contradicts our Admin Console metrics. We are on the enterprise plan and need this data straightened out.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as per the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, please provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for review.

subject: API TOKENS BROKEN WITH 401 UNAUTHORIZED AFTER V4.2!
body: ALL OF OUR AUTOMATED PIPELINES ARE FAILING! Every single API request now returns a 401 Unauthorized with legacy_token_format since the v4.2 upgrade. This is completely blocking our operations and needs an immediate fix!
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Role change to Guest causes login error CD-AM-002
body: Hello there, we hope you are doing well today. Recently we changed a team member's role from Member to Guest, and now they report getting an Insufficient Permissions error when trying to use the web app. We appreciate your quick help in getting this sorted out for our billing department contact.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Issues previewing files in the web app
body: Hi there, I am having trouble seeing previews for .PDF and .PPTX files. When I click to open them I just see a spinning loader or a blank page. The download button still works fine so I can get the file but the preview viewer gives me error code PREVIEW-006. Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies first, or try using an incognito window to rule out any extension conflicts. If the issue persists with specific files, please ensure they are not password-protected.

subject: Need more folder permission controls
body: I am working on a project with a very large firm that requires strict document handling, and I noticed that the mobile app lacks the ability to restrict folders to upload-only or view-only with comments. This is creating a lot of back-and-forth between my team and the client. Can you please implement these granular controls quickly as it is blocking our current workflow?
resolution: We understand the need for more granular permission controls, though currently, our permissions are applied at the folder level. Please submit your specific requirements for advanced granular permissions at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions. This will help our team design the most effective solution for your needs.

subject: API returning 404 for valid file IDs
body: I am having trouble with the API-NOTFOUND-404 error when accessing existing folders. I am certain the IDs are correct because they were retrieved just seconds prior. This is making it very difficult to automate our file management.
resolution: Please verify your API endpoint path and HTTP method against our latest documentation. Also, ensure the resource ID is valid and that your API token has sufficient permissions to access that specific folder.

subject: MFA setup failing on mobile app
body: Hello Support. We are trying to secure our accounts, but users attempting to enable MFA via the mobile app encounter the error code mfa-mob-002 after scanning the QR code. Email and password logins are fine, but this extra security step is completely blocked. Please advise.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Payment Processing Error in Admin Console
body: Since upgrading to v4.2, we cannot manage our billing or view invoices while using SSO. We receive a message about an authentication failure or payment processing error. Can you help us with this as we need to update our card details?
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Suspicious logins not showing in audit logs
body: I have identified several unusual login patterns from locations we do not operate in, but they are missing from the standard Login Activity log. This is critical for our security compliance and needs immediate investigation. I am seeing error code AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN. We need to see the full list of attempts as soon as possible.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses are recorded specifically in the 'Security Events' log, rather than the general 'Login Activity' log. You can find this by navigating to Admin Console, Security & Compliance, and then Security Events. We also recommend enabling 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic alerts.

subject: API-500 errors on GET files endpoint
body: We are seeing API-500 errors on GET /files/{id}/content intermittently. This is blocking our integration work and we need prompt assistance.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Requesting plan downgrade
body: We need to move to a lower tier. Our current team size has shrunk significantly. Please let us know the steps to complete this.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: GDPR export missing user comments
body: Hello, we generated a GDPR data export for a departing employee today, but noticed that the package is missing all the comments they left on various files and tasks. We have a compliance audit on Friday and need to ensure all user data is fully accounted for. Please advise.
resolution: The GDPR data export primarily covers core files, folders, and direct user profile details, while comments are stored as activity metadata. To export comments, you will need to navigate to the specific items, open the Activity tab, and use the export option there since there is currently no bulk comment export.

subject: Billing authentication failing after v4.2 update

resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email and password, or clear your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists, consider using a direct login temporarily for billing management while we investigate the SSO integration.

subject: SSO login failure after v4.2
body: Our entire organization is unable to access CloudDesk via SSO following the v4.2 update, receiving an 'Invalid SSO Token' error. Direct email logins are working, but this is a significant blocker for our operations. Please address this promptly.
resolution: The v4.2 release required an update to the SSO token format. To resolve this, your administrators must re-configure the SSO integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or refreshing the OIDC client secret. Please see the v4.2 release notes for the full steps.

resolution: Hello. The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console, ensuring that the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: api key unauthorized error API-AUTH-403.5

resolution: Confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes/permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: workspace invite emails not received
