resolution: Please check your company's email spam and junk folders first. If the emails are not there, ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are properly configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains by following our delivery guide in the admin console.

subject: clouddesk sync using too much cpu
body: the sync client is using over 50% cpu all the time. it is making the computers run really slow and we are seeing sync_high_resource_usage. can you help fix this?
resolution: Check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed. Advise user to pause sync, restart their computer, then resume sync. If persistent, suggest disabling sync for non-critical folders or temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks. Check for conflicting antivirus software.

subject: PAYMENT FAILED ERROR
body: Our account is showing BILL-PAY-002 and our access is at risk! We need this resolved now. How do we fix this immediately?
resolution: Please navigate to the Billing section of the Admin Console and update your credit card information. Ensure the billing address matches your bank records, and then retry the payment from the Invoices tab. Please reach out if the charge continues to decline.

subject: Critical Okta SSO login failure after update
body: all our users are getting invalid token format errors when trying to sign in via okta since the v4.2 update. error code is auth-402. this is a huge problem for us, please fix it immediately.
resolution: This issue is a result of updated SSO token handling requirements in v4.2. Your IT administrator needs to update the CloudDesk application integration within your Okta console. Please ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' are updated to match the new values found in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: SSO login failing constantly after sync update
body: AFTER UPDATING TO THE NEW DESKTOP SYNC CLIENT, OUR USERS ARE CONSTANTLY BEING LOGGED OUT AND PROMPTED TO RE-AUTHENTICATE. WE ARE SEEING ERROR CODE SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 ACROSS MULTIPLE MACHINES. THIS IS BLOCKING OUR WORK COMPLETELY RIGHT NOW AND WE NEED A FIX IMMEDIATELY PLEASE ASSIST
resolution: the v4.2 release introduced changes to sso token handling. advise the user to perform a clean reinstall of the desktop sync client by uninstalling, restarting, and then reinstalling. if the issue persists, your sso administrator may need to review their idp's token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret in the clouddesk admin console.

subject: Getting API-500 error when trying to fetch file contents
body: Hello, why my code always receive API-500 error when I call get file content endpoint? This problem is happen very often now and block our development team completely. Other api works fine but not this one. Please help us fix quickly.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: roles showing wrong in admin console ui
body: hey team just letting you know i noticed in the users and permissions section that contributor roles are displaying as manager for a few accounts even though their workspace access is completely fine ui-admin-003, no rush on this at all since permissions work properly but thought i would flag it when you have a spare moment thanks
resolution: This is a known UI display bug that does not affect actual permissions. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be rolled out in our next patch.

subject: Desktop sync client creating unnecessary conflict files
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. Recently, our team has been noticing that the desktop sync client frequently flags files as conflict even when no concurrent edits have happened, resulting in duplicate files with error code SYNC-003. We have an important board presentation coming up at 5pm today and we want to ensure our shared folders stay clean. Thank you so much for your assistance with this matter, we really appreciate your hard work.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: Request for new webhook event on file uploads
body: Our development team urgently needs a webhook event that triggers whenever a new file is uploaded to a specific workspace or folder. Polling the REST API is inefficient for our internal synchronization pipelines. We find it frustrating that this is not natively supported yet in v4.2, and we would like this added to the platform soon.
resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including desired payload, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements. This helps us assess demand and design.

subject: Sync client not updating files
body: So I was working on my computer earlier, I have a Mac, and I noticed that the files I put into the CloudDesk folder on my web browser are not actually showing up in the local folder on my desktop. I updated to v4.2 recently and I think that might be when it started, and I also noticed an error code SYNC-001 at some point. I really need these files to sync so I can finish my project on time. Could you please help me figure out why the desktop client is being so difficult?
resolution: Please uninstall your current v4.2 desktop sync client and clear the local cache located at ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk on your Mac. After clearing the cache, reinstall the client using the download link found in the web app under Settings and Desktop Sync. This will re-establish the connection to your files.

subject: API tokens returning legacy token format 401 error after upgrade
body: After upgrading to v4.2, our existing API tokens that worked previously now return 401 Unauthorized with the legacy_token_format error code API-AUTH-401-V42. This is a critical issue affecting many users and our core integrations immediately.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: desktop sync sso login failing
body: our desktop sync client is not authenticating via sso. we keep getting DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 errors and the browser just hangs. we have a company-wide audit this friday and my team cannot sync files. this needs to be fixed immediately as it is blocking our progress.
resolution: Please ensure that your desktop sync client is updated to version v4.2.1 or newer, as this resolves known SSO redirection issues. Verify that your default browser is correctly configured to handle the SSO callback. If you still face trouble, you may temporarily log in using your standard email and password.

subject: SSO provisioning not working
body: I am very frustrated because our Just-in-Time provisioning is not working for new users, even though it is enabled in our settings. The CD-AM-009 error keeps popping up. Can you help us get this sorted out?
resolution: Please verify that your Identity Provider is correctly sending the required user attributes like email and name in the assertion. Ensure that your CloudDesk subscription has available seats and review your Security and SSO settings for any configuration mismatches. These checks should resolve the provisioning failures.

subject: Folder permissions and workspace configuration inquiry
body: Hello, as I was reconciling our account subscription and reviewing our workspace structure for next quarter, I started thinking about folder controls. Our department heads are asking for more granular permissions inside shared directories, such as view-only with commenting or upload-only for specific subfolders. While not an emergency, we would love to know how to achieve this soon as our team grows.
resolution: We understand the need for more granular permission controls, though permissions are currently applied at the folder level. Please submit your specific requirements for advanced granular settings on our feature request portal at roadmap.cloudesk.com to help us shape future updates.

subject: Blank user activity report in admin console
body: When an administrator tries to access the User Activity report in the admin console, the report page loads but no data is displayed, remaining completely blank. Other reports work fine. Please investigate.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering.

subject: API tokens breaking after platform update v4.2
body: Hi there, I am writing on behalf of our IT department because we ran into some strange behavior after applying the latest updates this morning. As you might know, our team handles multiple integrations across different departments, and we usually review our logs weekly to ensure everything is running smoothly. Following the deployment, all of our existing API tokens suddenly started throwing 401 Unauthorized errors with the legacy_token_format message. This is currently blocking our daily data pipeline, so could you please advise on how we can get this sorted out promptly?
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: wrong roles showing in admin ui UI-ADMIN-003

resolution: This is a known UI display bug. The actual permissions are not affected. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: Request for Microsoft Teams integration
body: Is there a way to integrate CloudDesk directly with Microsoft Teams? We really need this to keep our files synced and it is currently blocking our collaboration. We would appreciate any help you can provide.
resolution: While you can currently share links to your CloudDesk files within Teams, we do not yet have a native app integration. Please share your specific requirements on our roadmap page, as we prioritize new integrations based on direct customer demand. We will be sure to notify you if this feature moves into development.

subject: Need more granular folder permissions
body: Hi there, thank you for the wonderful platform. As an external contractor helping manage our shared workspaces, I would love to see more granular controls like view-only with comments for sub-folders. Many of us are hoping for this feature right now. Could you let me know if this is possible?
resolution: We understand the need for more granular permission controls. Currently, our permissions are applied at the folder level. Please submit your specific requirements for advanced granular permissions at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions. This will help us design the most effective solution.

subject: SSO login timeouts and loading delays on desktop sync
body: Since upgrading to version 4.2, our users are experiencing prolonged loading times when logging in through our IdP, frequently resulting in timeouts and failure to retrieve tokens. We are seeing SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2 errors across multiple systems. This is severely blocking our workflow and requires immediate attention.
resolution: This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. We advise your admin to re-save the SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the 'Application Sign On URL' format and clear browser cache and cookies for affected users.

subject: Unable to access private user workspace for audit
body: Hello, I am attempting to access a user's private workspace for a standard compliance audit, but I am receiving the PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED message. We need access to these files to complete our internal review process. Could you please advise how we can gain the necessary permissions to proceed?
resolution: By default, private workspaces are inaccessible even to administrators for enhanced privacy. An admin can gain temporary access by initiating a Workspace Access Request through the Admin Console under Users, selecting the profile, and choosing Workspaces. This generates an audit log and requires a compliance override if the user is inactive.

subject: External service rejecting webhooks with HMAC error
body: Dear CloudDesk support team, our external service is currently rejecting CloudDesk webhooks due to an invalid signature, reporting 'HMAC verification failed' with error code WEBHOOK-SIGN-403. We rely heavily on these webhooks for our integrations and would greatly appreciate your prompt help in sorting this out. Thank you so much!
resolution: Ensure the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the 'Webhook Secret' configured in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify your signature verification algorithm matches CloudDesk's HMAC-SHA256 standard.

subject: Assigned tickets not showing up
body: My team is having trouble seeing tickets in the My Assigned Tickets view. We have a huge queue for our payroll run tomorrow and this is making it hard to track our progress. It seems like the HELPDESK-007 error is affecting everyone right now. Please help us get this working today.
resolution: This is typically caused by a cache synchronization issue regarding agent permissions. Please ask the affected agent to clear their browser cache and cookies before logging in again. If that does not work, an administrator can trigger a refresh by re-assigning the ticket to another user and then assigning it back to the original agent.

subject: Google SSO login redirect loop issue
body: Dear support team, thank you for your great work. Users attempting to log in with Google SSO are stuck in a redirect loop after authenticating with Google, never reaching the CloudDesk dashboard. We have a major client demo at 5pm today so we really need this sorted out as soon as possible.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: error removing user cd-am-014
body: hey team iam trying to remove an ex employee from a workspace using the admin console and getting cd-am-014 error. need this sorted out quickly because we have our payroll and access review run tomorrow morning.
resolution: Hello. A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace, which triggers this error. The ownership must first be transferred to another member by navigating to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Custom branding missing on SSO page
body: I noticed that our custom logo and background are not showing up on the SSO login page. It just shows the default CloudDesk branding instead. Is there a way to fix this?
resolution: You can resolve this by navigating to the SSO and Branding section in your Admin Console. Please verify that your custom assets are uploaded and saved correctly, and ask your users to clear their browser cache to see the changes.

subject: api error on file content
body: getting api-500 errors on get files endpoint intermittently. please fix soon.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: User cannot login after role change
body: One of our employees had their role changed from Member to Guest and now they cannot access the web app. They are receiving an error regarding permissions. Could you please investigate why they are blocked?
resolution: Guest users have restricted access and must be specifically invited to individual workspaces. Please confirm in the Admin Console that this user still has active invitations to the workspaces they need. If they require broader access, you will need to change their role back to Member.

subject: okta sso login error
body: hi, we are getting a sso-okta-403 error when trying to login via okta. it says missing required attribute on the clouddesk page. i appreciate your help with this.
resolution: Please check your Okta application settings to ensure the email, firstName, and lastName attributes are correctly mapped to our profile fields. Make sure that the email attribute is specifically set as the unique identifier for the integration.

subject: Assigned tickets not showing for agents
body: Hello support team, we are facing a critical issue where tickets assigned to specific agents are completely missing from their assigned view. This is blocking our support workflow entirely and affecting our service level agreements. Thank you for your swift attention.
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: Google SSO login failing for specific domains
body: Users coming from our secondary corporate domain cannot log in using Google SSO and are getting a Domain not allowed error. We are currently on the free plan and would like this resolved soon so our team can access the workspace.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's SSO and Identity settings for Google SSO, check the Allowed Domains list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO so your users can authenticate successfully.

subject: Audit log visibility concerns
body: Hello, we have noticed some strange logins from overseas and I am concerned about a security breach. I checked the Login Activity log but I only see successful logins and nothing else. I am receiving the AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN error in my report view. Could you please help me find the failed attempt data?
resolution: Failed attempts and logins from new locations are recorded under 'Security Events' rather than the standard 'Login Activity' log. You can find this information by navigating to the Security & Compliance section in the Admin Console. I recommend enabling 'Login Anomaly Detection' to ensure you receive automatic alerts for such events in the future.

subject: user list loading slow
body: the user list page takes forever to load for our team. i keep getting ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT. is there any way to make this faster?
resolution: We advise using the search bar or applying specific filters like 'Status: Active' immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset size. The system is optimized for filtered views on large datasets. Alternatively, navigating directly to a specific user via search if you know their email address will be much faster.

subject: Workspace page taking forever to load
body: I have been trying to open a shared workspace all morning but the page just spins and then goes blank. It is definitely happening because of the sheer number of files we keep there, as I keep seeing the error WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT. This is making it very difficult for me to finish my contract work on time.
resolution: I apologize for the frustration with loading large workspaces. Please try using our filter options to narrow down your view, or consider splitting your content into smaller, more manageable workspaces. If you continue to see the timeout error, please let me know so we can investigate your network logs.

subject: Desktop client causing high CPU usage
body: I noticed that the CloudDesk desktop sync client is taking up a huge amount of my computer's resources, consistently showing over 50% CPU usage. It seems to be hitting the PERF-DSK-001 issue quite often. It is not an urgent matter, but it would be great if this could be optimized as it is slowing down my machine.
resolution: This behavior often indicates that the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. Please pause syncing, navigate to Settings, choose Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database before resuming; if it continues, check if your synced folders contain an excessive number of small files.

subject: New user stuck on Pending Invitation status
body: Hi there, I sent an invite to a new colleague yesterday and they clicked the link but their status in the Admin Console is still stuck as Pending Invitation with error CD-AM-005. They cannot log in at all and it's quite frustrating since we need them working today.
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set (if any). If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and send a new one.

subject: INCORRECT VAT RATE APPLIED TO OUR MONTHLY INVOICE

This is unacceptable and needs to be corrected as soon as possible so our accounting department can close out the books. Please get back to me with a fix.
resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID if applicable by navigating to the Admin Console, then Billing, and finally Billing Information. If those details are correct, please reply with your company's full legal name, registered address, and a valid tax exemption certificate so we can conduct a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: SSO login failing on desktop app

When users try to log into the sync client, the browser redirect happens but the app just shows DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 and fails to authenticate. We really need a fix for this to keep our team working.
resolution: Please ensure the sync client is updated to v4.2.1 or newer, as this resolves the SSO redirect issue. If the problem continues, check that your default browser is correctly configured for the authentication flow.

subject: User Activity report blank

resolution: This behavior often stems from a temporary data retrieval snag. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and refresh the report page. If the issue persists, test it in an alternative browser to rule out extension conflicts. If you still see a blank screen, please let me know the specific date range you are attempting to view.

subject: SSO loading timeout after v4.2 update

resolution: This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Advise the admin to re-save their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the Application Sign On URL format and clear browser cache and cookies for affected users.

subject: Mobile app crashes on large uploads
body: I have noticed the mobile app crashes every time I try to upload a file over 1GB. Smaller files work fine, but this is a consistent issue. I have tested this on both iOS and Android. Error code is CRASH-MOB-001.
resolution: This is a known limitation regarding memory management for large file uploads on our mobile application. As a workaround, please use the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client for files larger than 1GB. Our team is actively working on an optimization to improve this in a future update.

subject: Sync client login issues after v4.2
body: Ever since we updated to v4.2, our team is constantly asked to re-authenticate via SSO. The logs are showing SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 repeatedly. It is annoying for the team to type their credentials every single hour. Do you have a fix for this yet?
resolution: The v4.2 release updated how we handle SSO tokens, which may require a clean state for your client. Please perform a full uninstall and then reinstall the latest version of the Desktop Sync client. If the problem continues, your SSO administrator may need to verify the token lifetime settings in your IdP.

subject: Critical API key security vulnerability
body: We have identified that an API key with 'read-only' scope is currently capable of deleting users, which is a major security flaw for our organization. This is causing significant concern regarding our data integrity. We need this resolved immediately to avoid further risk. The error code API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS was noted during our audit.
resolution: This is a critical vulnerability, and I have escalated it to our engineering team for immediate review. In the meantime, please revoke the affected API key in your Admin Console to stop the unauthorized operations. We are investigating why the scope was bypassed and will provide an update shortly.

subject: API key scope bypass vulnerability
body: I found that my read-only API key is somehow deleting users! I keep seeing API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS in the logs. This is a HUGE security issue for us. Why is my limited key able to perform admin actions? You need to fix this right away.
resolution: Please revoke that API key immediately in the Admin Console under API Management to prevent further unauthorized actions. This appears to be a critical configuration issue, so I am escalating this to our engineering team to ensure the scope bypass is fully patched.

subject: Ghost user profiles remain in workspace sharing lists
body: We recently deleted a user account via the admin console, yet their name and email continue to populate within the sharing dialogs of several enterprise workspaces. While there is no immediate pressure, this leftover data is causing confusion among our staff. Please advise on how to clear these entries.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as 'ghost' entries in historical share lists until the system purges them, typically within 24 to 48 hours, or until a workspace owner explicitly removes them from a share via Workspace Settings > Members. This is expected behavior.

subject: audit log export failing for 90 days
body: trying to pull audit logs for the last six months in the admin console and getting error code AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. can you help me get this data soon please.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: billing api data wrong
body: hi we are getting errors when calling the billing api, code is API-BILL-401. the data does not match the dashboard at all since v4.2 update. please help.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as per the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, please provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for our review.

subject: Frequent expired session errors on mobile app
body: Our users are experiencing repeated session timeouts and CD-AM-011 errors on both iOS and Android devices since the v4.2 backend update. We need this addressed soon on our Pro account to keep remote teams functioning smoothly. Please let us know the appropriate next steps.
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to session management for improved security. Users should fully log out of the mobile app, clear their app cache or data on Android or reinstall the app on iOS, and then log back in. This will force a new, compatible session token.

subject: New hire login error regarding missing account

Whenever she attempts to log in using her assigned credentials, the system unfortunately displays an error stating that the user cannot be found, which might be related to error code AUTH-NF-404.1. While this is not blocking any immediate operations right now, it would be wonderful if someone could look into her account setup whenever convenient so she is ready for next week's onboarding sessions. Thank you very much for your time and assistance.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: Hello, we noticed today that users from our newly acquired subsidiary domain are unable to log in via Google SSO and receive a domain not allowed error. Please update our enterprise settings to accommodate them when you have a chance.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, check the 'Allowed Domains' list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: Seat limit reached error when adding team members
body: We are getting an error message saying seat limit reached despite available seats showing in subscription details. Error code CD-AM-001. Please resolve this when you have a moment today.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Assigned tickets missing from agent view
body: My team is having a hard time because assigned tickets are not showing up in the 'My Assigned Tickets' list for specific agents. Admins can see them fine, but the agents are reporting HELPDESK-007 errors. This is really impacting our support response times.
resolution: This is often caused by a browser cache conflict regarding user permissions. Please have the affected agents clear their cache and cookies before logging in again. If that does not work, an admin can re-assign the ticket to someone else and then back to the original agent to refresh the visibility.

subject: Security vulnerability with API key scope
body: I have discovered a massive security flaw where my read-only API keys are able to delete users! This is completely unacceptable and exposes our company to severe risk. We are seeing the API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS error consistently. This is a critical situation that requires immediate attention.
resolution: Please revoke this API key immediately via the Admin Console. Investigate if this key was generated with broader permissions or if there is a misconfiguration in your implementation. We are escalating this to our engineering team to ensure the scope bypass is fully resolved.

subject: Audit logs missing external user details
body: When we share files externally, our logs only show our own employees, not the people actually downloading the files. This is extremely frustrating for our security tracking. We need to see who accessed the data, but currently we are just seeing AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS in our logs.
resolution: By default, shared links are anonymous to ensure ease of access. To track individual external users, you must enable the 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login' setting when creating the share link. Please note this change is not retroactive, so it will only apply to new links created with that setting.

subject: Request for new file upload webhook
body: We are looking to build a more reactive integration between our internal database and your platform. Do you have a plan to add a webhook that triggers specifically when a new file is uploaded to a workspace? We need this to automate our downstream processing.
resolution: Thank you for sharing your interest in this functionality. While we currently only support polling for file changes, we are always looking for feedback; please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook on our roadmap site so our team can evaluate the demand.

subject: User Activity report page is completely blank
body: Hello, as an IT administrator for our company, I am reviewing our tools today. When I navigate to the User Activity report in the admin console, the page loads but remains entirely blank, while other reports function normally. Please let us know how to resolve this when you have time.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, please provide the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: SSO login failing with SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2 error
body: Since the update, SSO is broken. My users see SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2 constantly. We have production systems stalled. Fix this immediately.
resolution: This is related to the v4.2 SSO token changes. Please navigate to your Admin Console and re-save your current SSO configuration to regenerate the necessary certificates. If you are using Okta, please also verify that the Application Sign-On URL format is correct. Finally, ask your users to clear their browser cache and cookies to complete the refresh.

subject: Seat limit error
body: I am attempting to add new team members but I keep getting a 'Seat limit reached' error. When I check my subscription details, it clearly shows I have plenty of seats available. I would appreciate your help in resolving this discrepancy so we can get everyone added.
resolution: Please check the 'Pending Invitations' count in the Admin Console under Team Management. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit even if the user hasn't joined yet. You can either revoke those older invitations or upgrade your plan to increase total capacity.

subject: Okta SSO failing with attribute errors
body: Our team cannot log into the web app using Okta. Every time we try, we get an error about a missing attribute and the code SSO-OKTA-403. It is very frustrating to deal with this when we have work to finish.
resolution: Please double-check your Okta application settings to ensure that the email, firstName, and lastName attributes are mapped correctly to our profile fields. Also, verify that the email attribute is designated as the unique identifier for your users. Once these mappings are aligned, you should be able to log in successfully.

subject: Files added in web app not showing in desktop sync
body: Hello support, thank you for providing such a wonderful collaboration tool. Recently, after updating the desktop client, I noticed that files added or modified in the web application are not syncing over to my computer. There are no error messages shown in the client, and everything looks correct when I check mobile and web. Could you please guide me on how to fix this?
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk on Windows or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk on macOS. Afterward, reinstall the client using the download link found in your web app's 'Settings' under the 'Desktop Sync' section.

subject: Data retention policy not being enforced
body: We configured our policy to permanently delete files after 30 days, but files remain visible in the Trash Bin well beyond that window. The system is showing RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED during our audits. Is there a specific setting we are missing to enforce this?
resolution: Please verify your configuration under Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies for automatic purging generally apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state, while items in the Trash Bin remain available for user recovery. If you wish to purge the Trash Bin automatically, please ensure that specific policy toggle is enabled.

subject: Mobile app giving network error on login

resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. resolution: Hello. Please clear your browser's cache and cookies for cloudesk.com to resolve this issue. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito or private window or a different browser. Finally, verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Unintentional plan upgrade refund request
body: Hi support, our account was accidentally upgraded to the pro plan earlier today. We need a refund for the prorated difference before our company payroll run tomorrow. Error code BILL-REF-005 was noted by finance. Thank you.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: New user login failed
body: I invited a new staff member to our Pro workspace today. They attempted to log in but were met with an AUTH-NF-404.1 error code. Can you help us resolve this so they can access their files?
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console to ensure it was entered correctly. Confirm that the invitation was successfully sent and subsequently accepted by the user. If the issue remains, please try resending the invitation to their address.

subject: Cannot add credit card
body: Hi, I am trying to add a new card in the console but it keeps saying Invalid Card Details. The numbers are definitely right. I see error BILL-PAY-012. Seems like a glitch on your side.
resolution: This error can stem from transient payment gateway issues or specific card issuer restrictions. Please disable any active VPNs and attempt the transaction again in 30 minutes, or try an alternative card if the issue persists.

subject: Cannot remove a user from workspace
body: I am trying to offboard an employee but the admin console wont let me remove them from the workspace. It keeps showing error CD-AM-014 and says they are an owner. How do I fix this so I can remove them?
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace. You must first navigate to Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership to reassign the ownership to another member before removing the user.

subject: Invited user stuck on pending status
body: Hello, thank you for the wonderful software. One of our new team members received an invitation link and clicked it, but their status in the Admin Console remains Pending Invitation and they cannot log in. We hope you can assist us with this when you have time.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out. This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there is a delay in the invitation pipeline. Please ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set, and if the issue persists, revoke the invitation in Admin Console, Team Management, Invitations, and send a new one.

subject: Urgent: Team member access blocked with CD-AM-002 error
body: My team member suddenly cannot access our shared files after their role changed to Guest. They keep getting the error code CD-AM-002 and are completely unable to work. This is impacting our deliverables and I need this resolved immediately. Please fix their permissions so they can get back to their tasks.
resolution: Please note that Guest roles only grant access to specific workspaces they are invited to. You can resolve this by navigating to the Admin Console under Team Management to verify their current role and update it back to Member if they require full access. If they are intended to remain a Guest, please ensure they have active invitations to the necessary workspaces.

subject: mobile push notifications are delayed
body: push notifications for chat comments and file updates are coming in late on our enterprise mobile app or not showing up until we open it. no rush on this since we can still check manually.
resolution: Please verify that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and your device's operating system settings. Check for any battery optimization settings on the device that might be restricting background app activity. If the delay continues, we advise reinstalling the mobile app.

subject: Incorrect plan upgrade and billing issue
body: I am looking at our admin console and it seems our account was accidentally upgraded to a paid plan. I never authorized this change and I am seeing error code BILL-REF-005 in my account settings. I would like to get this reverted and receive a refund for the charge as soon as possible. This is very frustrating to deal with.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: URGENT: Cannot access billing after v4.2 update
body: I AM LOCKED OUT OF THE BILLING SECTION AFTER THE V4.2 UPDATE! WE HAVE PAYMENT DEADLINES AND THIS IS A MAJOR BLOCKER. I KEEP GETTING AUTH-BILL-402 AND I CANNOT UPDATE OUR RECORDS. FIX THIS IMMEDIATELY!
resolution: The v4.2 update updated the SSO token format, which is likely causing this session error in the billing module. Please try logging in with your direct email/password to manage these sensitive areas until we resolve the SSO conflict. I have escalated this to our engineering team for immediate review.

subject: cant change company name in admin settings
body: hey there i am trying to update our company name in the admin console under company settings but the field wont save or is locked. we are on the free tier and getting error cd-am-010. a lot of people seem to be having this happen right now. no rush though whenever you get a chance
resolution: The 'Company Name' is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the 'Organization Name' there. This change will propagate to the Company Settings.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: I accidentally clicked the upgrade button on our FREE plan. I would like to request a refund for this charge, as it was not intended. Error code BILL-REF-005 appeared during the process. Please let me know the steps to get this reversed.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are assessed on an individual basis. Please provide the exact date and time the charge occurred and confirm that you have not utilized any of the premium features. Once we verify this, we can review your account for a potential refund.

subject: Mobile app previews not loading
body: Im having trouble viewing documents on the app. It takes forever and then says MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL. Its happenin to everyone in the office today. Can you look into this when you can?
resolution: Please ensure your mobile app is updated to the latest version and verify your network connection. You may also want to clear the app cache via your device settings. If you are attempting to view very large files, downloading them directly to your device first should resolve the loading error.

subject: Blank user activity report page
body: When I try to access the User Activity report in the admin console, the page loads completely blank and throws a REPORT-001 error. This is very frustrating as we need to review these logs today.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: storage limit increase request
body: hey we are hitting our storage cap on the free tier and need more space asap. can you bump us up without making us pay, thanks.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out regarding our storage limits. Our current limits are set to provide a starter experience and we do not have plans to increase them for free accounts at this time. Please review our paid plans if you require additional storage for your team.

subject: Audit log export failing for ranges over 90 days
body: Hi team, we attempted to export audit logs from the Admin Console for a date range exceeding ninety days and the report failed to generate. The interface displayed the error message Export range limit exceeded (90 days maximum). It appears that several other administrators are experiencing this exact hurdle at the moment as well. Please advise on how we can retrieve these historical logs for our free tier account.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Mobile app document preview issues
body: I have been testing the mobile API integrations and I noticed some odd latency when loading assets, and quite frankly, the server-side infrastructure for our mobile deployment seems to be lagging behind our current traffic projections. Anyway, the mobile app is giving me a MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL when trying to open standard PDFs or DOCX files. It is not urgent but I wanted to document this for you.
resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version. Check the user's device storage and network connection. Advise clearing the mobile app's cache via device settings. For very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: Unrecognized charge on card
body: Hi there, I see a charge on my statement from your company but it dont match our bill. I see a BILL-CHG-010 error code in my account view too. Can you help me sort this out? Thanks.
resolution: To investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, the transaction date, and the last four digits of the card used. Once I have those details, I will cross-reference them with your billing history to clarify the charge for you.

subject: mobile app file previews failing
body: we are having trouble previewing docs on the mobile app. it says mobile_preview_fail when trying to open pdfs. can you check on this?
resolution: Please ensure your mobile app is fully updated to the latest version. You should also clear the app cache within your device settings and verify your current network connection. If you are dealing with very large files, we recommend downloading the document locally before attempting to view it.

subject: user cannot log in after role change
body: we changed a team member to a guest role and now they cant login at all getting cd-am-002 insufficient permissions error please help fix this quickly as they have a deadline today
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they have been explicitly invited to. Please check Admin Console > Team Management > Users to confirm their current role and verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces.

subject: Public sharing link expiration period too short
body: The current link expiration limits are problematic for our workflows. We need these to last much longer than currently allowed. Please advise on how to extend this.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we do not plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at our feature request portal, or consider inviting users directly to a workspace for permanent access.

subject: user activity report is blank
body: i am trying to pull the user activity report and it is just empty. i have tried a few times now and the REPORT-001 error keeps showing up. it is really annoying because i need these numbers for my weekly sync meeting.
resolution: Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or opening the report in a different browser. If the page remains blank, please provide the specific date range you are querying. We are happy to help you narrow down the cause if it continues to fail.

subject: GDPR export is missing comments
body: I ran a GDPR data export for a user, but it appears that the comments they left on various tasks are missing from the package. The file data is all there, but the activity history for comments is absent. Is there a way to include this in the export?
resolution: The standard GDPR export only covers profile data and files. To retrieve comments, please navigate to the specific task or file, open the 'Activity' tab, and use the 'Export Activity Log' option for that specific item, as there is no bulk export for comments.

subject: SSO login failing on mobile app
body: Mobile app users cannot login via SSO. Getting SSO_TOKEN_FORMAT_401 error. Blocking work. Fix needed.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Administrators must re-configure the SSO integration in the Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Detailed steps are available in our v4.2 release notes.

subject: API stopped working after v4.2
body: All of our API calls are failing with error API-AUTH-401-V42 since the update. This has broken our entire automation pipeline and we have a major client demo at 5pm today. We need this fixed immediately as it is a total emergency.
resolution: With the release of v4.2, the API token format has been updated. You must regenerate all of your existing API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new tokens to restore connectivity.

subject: Google login loop
body: Hi team when I try to sign in with google today it just keeps refreshing the page over and over. I am seeing error AUTH-SSO-302.1 on the screen. Could you please help when you have a moment.
resolution: Hi there. We are currently seeing similar reports from other users. Please clear your browser cache and cookies for cloudesk.com and try again. If the issue persists, please try using an incognito window or a different browser, and verify your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: audit logs not showing external user info
body: why are my audit logs missing external user details for shared files?! the AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS error makes it impossible to track who is downloading our assets. this is really annoying.
resolution: External share links are anonymous by default. To track specific users, you must enable the 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login' setting when creating the share link.

subject: Unable to export audit logs beyond 90 days
body: I am trying to pull audit logs for our annual report, but the console stops me when I select a date range over 90 days. It keeps throwing an AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED error. Could you please let me know how we can export a longer history?
resolution: The Admin Console export feature is limited to 90 days for performance reasons. To access longer periods, please use our API endpoint /v1/audit/export with your desired date range or reach out to us if you need a manual data pull.

subject: SSO login failing on desktop client
body: Our team is having trouble with the desktop sync client after trying to login with SSO. The browser redirects but the client just stays unauthenticated with a Login Failed error. I keep seeing DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. Any advice?
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to at least v4.2.1, as this version contains critical fixes for SSO authentication. Also, verify that your default browser is configured to handle the callback correctly. If you continue to see the DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 error, please try logging in using your standard email and password until the connection is stabilized.

subject: Wrong tax rate on mobile app invoice

resolution: Please double-check your billing address and tax ID under the Billing section of the Admin Console. If those details are accurate, please reply with your company's full legal name and your tax exemption certificate so we can perform a manual review of your account settings.

subject: user account locked out

resolution: Please have the user wait 15 minutes for the automated lockout to expire. Alternatively, you can manually unlock her account by going to the 'Users' section of your Admin Console, selecting her profile, and choosing 'Unlock Account'.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card bill

resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: zapier trigger not working
body: hey my zap isnt picking up new uploads to clouddesk. im getting error zapiertrigger404. any idea why this is happening today thanks.
resolution: Please navigate to your Zapier configuration and re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh the connection. It is possible your account permissions need re-authorization, so ensure the connected account has access to the events being monitored. You may also want to check the CloudDesk audit logs to verify the events are registering correctly.

subject: Incorrect VAT rate on our latest enterprise invoice

resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID (if applicable) under 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information'. If these details are correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate (if applicable) for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: cant log in to mobile app network error
body: hi there i keep getting network error when opening the mobile app even though my wifi is completely fine. i see code MOBILE-NET-500.1 on the screen. can someone help me out whenever you have a moment thanks
resolution: Please try force closing the app, checking for any available app updates in your app store, and trying again. If the issue persists, we suggest clearing the app's cache or data on Android, or reinstalling the app on iOS or Android, which should clear up the network error.

subject: UNACCEPTABLY SLOW DOWNLOAD SPEEDS FOR SHARED FILES
body: Why are shared workspace files downloading so slowly?! Our external clients are complaining constantly about the abysmal speeds using the public links. We need this DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW issue resolved on our Pro plan as soon as possible.
resolution: Please test download speeds using a different browser or network, and check for browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager or have the sender share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfers.

subject: Desktop Sync client stuck SYNC_STATUS_STUCK
body: Our Desktop Sync client is stuck in a 'Connecting' state, and files are not syncing. I've tried restarting my computer, but the issue persists. No files are uploading or downloading from the local folder. We need this working promptly for our team's workflow.
resolution: Please try restarting the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue remains, go to 'Settings' > 'Advanced' within the client and select 'Clear Cache'. If these steps don't resolve it, we recommend backing up any local unsynced files and then performing a full reinstall of the desktop client.

subject: Lag during simultaneous document editing
body: Hello support, when multiple users edit a CloudDesk Office document simultaneously, there is a severe lag of several seconds and cursor positions update slowly. We have a major client demo at 5pm today and this is blocking our final prep, so please help.
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved. Advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs/applications. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document. Clear browser cache for all users.

subject: Okta SSO failing after v4.2 update
body: Our Okta SSO is broken. We get error AUTH-402 since the v4.2 update. Please fix.
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to our SSO token handling that require an adjustment to your configuration. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk application integration in Okta to ensure the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values found in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: subscription renewal failed payment declined
body: Hi support our automatic subscription renewal failed because of a declined credit card. We got the email and see the payment failed status in the billing section now. Need help fixing this urgently as its blocking our pro account access.
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank, and you can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: Push notifications are delayed on the mobile app
body: Our team is experiencing significant delays with mobile notifications for file changes and mentions. They arrive several minutes late or only when opening the app. This is affecting our real-time collaboration right now.
resolution: Verify that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and the device's operating system settings. Check for any battery optimization settings on the device that might be restricting background app activity. Advise reinstalling the mobile app.

subject: Billing section inaccessible via SSO
body: Since the v4.2 update, our admins are unable to access billing. We receive an AUTH-BILL-402 error when trying to update our payment method. Everything else works, but we need this addressed to ensure our account remains active.
resolution: The v4.2 release included changes to the SSO token format that can interfere with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in using your direct email and password if that method is enabled for your account. If the problem persists, you may need to use a direct login for billing management while we investigate the SSO integration further.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with Invalid Token Format
body: Since the v4.2 update, our users are getting an AUTH-402 error when trying to log in via Okta. The system just loops them back to the login page. Can you please look into this as soon as possible?
resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token handling, which is likely the cause of this AUTH-402 error. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk integration settings in your Okta console to match the new Audience URI and Assertion Consumer Service URL found in our v4.2 configuration guide.

subject: Unable to add new team members
body: Im trying to add users but getting a 'Seat limit reached' error even though my dashboard says we have free seats. I think this might be related to error CD-AM-001. Please let me know how to fix this so I can finish onboarding.
resolution: Please check your 'Pending Invitations' list in the Team Management section of the Admin Console. Any pending invitations count against your total seat limit even if the user hasn't joined yet. You can revoke those old invitations to free up space or upgrade your plan to accommodate more users.

subject: assigned tickets not showing up for agents
body: hey team my agents are complaining they cant see tickets assigned to them in the web app view. it just says zero even though i assigned three high priority items over an hour ago. they can see everything fine if they are admins but regular agents are getting error HELPDESK-007 and nothing is loading right in their queues. please look into this soon as it is slowing down our triage workflow today.
resolution: Hello. This behavior is typically caused by a caching issue with agent permissions following recent updates. Please advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that does not resolve it, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save the changes, and then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: Account suspended after payment issue
body: Our entire account is currently suspended and we have a major deadline today. We see error code BILL-SUSP-007 in the console. This is absolutely unacceptable for our production team. Please restore our access immediately.
resolution: I apologize for the disruption to your team. Your account was suspended due to an overdue invoice; please navigate to Admin Console > Billing > Invoices to settle the outstanding balance. Your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes of payment confirmation.

subject: Slow workspace loading times for large file directories
body: Hello support team, we noticed that when navigating to workspaces containing over 10,000 items, the web app takes an excessive amount of time to load and shows a persistent spinner. We appreciate any guidance you can provide to help improve these load times for our pro workspace.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: Newly invited user gets User Not Found on web app login
body: A new user on our Pro plan attempts to log in with their email and password but receives an error stating the user is not found. We need this resolved so they can access their workspaces.
resolution: Hello. Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Critical API auth failure affecting our payroll run
body: Our API calls are failing with 401 Unauthorized errors and the system is down for our payroll run tomorrow. We are seeing API-AUTH-401 constantly and it is affecting all our users. We need to get this resolved urgently to avoid a massive disruption. Is there a fix for this?
resolution: This indicates that your current credentials are no longer accepted. Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' tab in the Admin Console. Once you have the new token, update your application headers to use the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' format to restore your connection.

subject: cant transfer workspace ownership in admin console
body: hello team Im trying to transfer a workspace owner but the option is greyed out and giving me error cd-am-004. we need this updated for our billing records when you get a chance thanks
resolution: Hello. Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a Member or Admin of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace, then attempt the transfer via Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership to new manager
body: Hello, I try to give my workspace to another person on our free plan, but system give error Cannot transfer ownership to non-owner and CD-AM-004. Please tell how to fix this soon.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is already a member of the workspace. Once you add them first, you can successfully complete the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Request for longer or permanent public sharing links
body: Hello, our team would like to know if it is possible to set public sharing links to never expire or at least last much longer than the current limit. Several of us are running into this limitation simultaneously today as we share documentation with external partners. Please let us know if this can be adjusted.
resolution: Hello. The current maximum expiration for public links is strictly enforced for security best practices. While we do not plan to offer a 'never expire' option, we are open to extending the maximum duration based on feedback. Please submit your specific use cases to roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration, and for permanent sharing needs, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Access denied when entering Admin Console
body: I have been trying to manage our billing today but keep getting redirected to the standard dashboard. I am receiving ADMIN-AUTH-403.3 errors whenever I try to reach the admin area. Could you please look into my permissions?
resolution: I have reviewed your account and it looks like you need your role updated to maintain access. Please have your current Super Admin confirm your permissions are set to 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' under the 'Manage User' section. Once that role is applied, you should regain access immediately.

subject: azure ad nested groups mapping feature request
body: hey team since updating to v4.2 some of us using azure ad sso really need the ability to map nested groups directly to workspaces for user provisioning. it would make managing permissions so much easier for our IT staff. just wanted to pass this along when you have a moment to review normal priorities.
resolution: Following the SSO token format change in v4.2, our current Azure AD SSO integration supports direct group mapping but not nested group resolution. We are aware of this limitation and are evaluating solutions. Please add your use case to roadmap.cloudesk.com/v4.2-enhancements/nested-azure-ad-groups. A potential workaround might involve flattening your Azure AD groups.

subject: Google SSO login redirect loop issue in web app
body: Our team members are unable to access the web app today because authenticating via Google SSO results in an endless redirect loop. Nobody can reach the dashboard and we are seeing code AUTH-SSO-302.1 across multiple browsers. Please help us get this sorted out quickly.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Cannot create custom roles
body: I am trying to add a new role for our team, but the system claims the name is taken even though it is unique. I saw an error code CD-AM-012 when attempting this. Could you look into why this is happening?
resolution: Please note that role names are case-insensitive and leading or trailing spaces are automatically trimmed. It is likely there is already a role with a similar name or one that differs only by capitalization. Please check the Team Management section for any existing conflicts.

subject: CRITICAL SECURITY ISSUE: API scope bypass detected
body: We are experiencing a major security vulnerability where our read-only API keys are able to delete users. This API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS error is preventing our team from operating securely and needs your immediate intervention. How is it possible for a scoped key to bypass these permissions? This is impacting our entire administrative workflow right now.
resolution: Please revoke the compromised API key immediately via the Admin Console under API Management. We are currently investigating why the scope bypass occurred, but revoking access is the immediate protective step. If you continue to see the API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS error after generating a new key, please let us know so we can escalate this to engineering.

subject: Intermittent API rate limits during peak hours
body: Our integration calls are intermittently returning API-RATE-429 Too Many Requests errors during peak usage times. We are on the PRO plan and wanted to check on best practices for handling this. No major rush on a reply, but some guidance would be appreciated when you have a moment.
resolution: Please implement exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client. Review your application's API usage patterns and consider optimizing calls or requesting a rate limit increase via support if justified by legitimate use cases.

subject: Blank User Activity report in admin console
body: Hello Support. When I try to access the User Activity report in the admin console, the report page loads but no data is displayed, remaining completely blank. Other reports are working fine. It appears many customers are hitting this at the same moment right now. Please let me know when you can look into this normal priority issue.
resolution: Hello. This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, please provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: I have a Zap set up to track file uploads, but it stopped working today. I see an error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 in my logs. My automation is not picking up any new files at all. Any help you can provide would be appreciated.
resolution: It looks like the connection between your Zap and CloudDesk needs a refresh. Please go into your Zapier dashboard, select your CloudDesk trigger step, and perform a re-test of the connection. Additionally, ensure your connected account has the appropriate permissions for the events you are monitoring.

subject: webhook signature verification error
body: our server is rejecting clouddesk webhooks with error code WEBHOOK-SIGN-403. it says hmac verification failed and its really annoying. can you look into this for me.
resolution: Please double-check that the secret token used for signature verification on your receiving service matches the 'Webhook Secret' currently saved in your Admin Console. Also, ensure your system is using the HMAC-SHA256 algorithm to validate the incoming payloads.

subject: Webhook HMAC verification failed error
body: Hello admin support, our external server is rejecting webhooks from the console because of invalid signature errors. The system reports HMAC verification failed with error code WEBHOOK-SIGN-403. We need prompt help to get this fixed because our free tier integrations are completely blocked right now.
resolution: Hello. Please ensure the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the Webhook Secret configured in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Also, verify your signature verification algorithm matches CloudDesk's HMAC-SHA256.

subject: Accidental subscription plan upgrade
body: Hello, I clicked the upgrade button by mistake when looking at the console settings. I do not need the extra features at this time. I am getting error code BILL-REF-005. Could you please reverse this charge and refund the amount to my card?
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are processed individually. Please share the specific date and time the change occurred, and confirm that no features from the new plan were used. We will verify your account status for a potential refund.

subject: Pending invitation status after clicking link
body: Hello, a new user clicked their invitation link, but their status in the Admin Console remains Pending Invitation and they cant log in. We noticed error code CD-AM-005 in the logs. Please advise on how to fix this user state.
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set (if any). If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and send a new one.

subject: SSO login broken after update
body: Our entire team is locked out! We have a critical project demo at 5pm today and nobody can sign in. We keep seeing AUTH-SSO-401.1 every time we try to use Okta. This needs to be fixed immediately.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your identity provider metadata. This step is necessary to align with the updated token format introduced in our v4.2 release.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file API
body: Our integration is failing with HTTP 500 errors when calling the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. This is happening randomly and is severely impacting our workflow. We see the code API-500 frequently. Please escalate this, as we need a fix to continue our development work.
resolution: We are currently investigating the root cause of these errors related to distributed storage retrieval and will release a hotfix shortly. In the meantime, you can resolve the intermittent failures by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. This should maintain stability while we deploy the fix.

subject: MFA code not working
body: I am unable to log in because the MFA code from Google Authenticator is not being accepted. I am seeing an AUTH-MFA-401.2 error. I would appreciate your assistance in resolving this.
resolution: This is almost always caused by a time mismatch between your phone and our servers. Please ensure that your phone's date and time settings are set to sync automatically with the network. If that does not work, you can reset your MFA settings by logging into the security section of the web app.

subject: Unable to update company name
body: hi, i am trying to change our company name in settings but the field is read-only. i am seeing a cd-am-010 error. thanks for your help.
resolution: The company name is currently linked directly to your billing profile. To update it, please navigate to Subscription & Billing and change the Organization Name there. This change will automatically propagate to your Company Settings.

subject: Blank report in admin console
body: The User Activity report is coming up completely blank when I try to run it. I've been trying to pull this for our billing review but it just won't load anything. There's no rush, but I would like to see this fixed when you have a moment.
resolution: This is often a result of cached browser data interfering with the report display. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, or try accessing the page in a different browser. If the issue persists, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: New member invitation emails not sending
body: Invite emails are failing to reach new users. The status remains pending. Please fix EMAIL-005.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam and junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured properly. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Mobile app crashes on files over 1GB
body: Hello CloudDesk team. Thank you for all your hard work on the platform. We have run into a roadblock where the mobile app crashes whenever we try uploading files larger than 1GB. Everything else works wonderfully, but this issue is currently blocking our mobile team. Could you please help us look into this as soon as possible? Thank you so much.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card statement

I am reviewing our company finances and spotted a charge from CloudDesk that we cannot reconcile with our free plan expectations. Could you please look into this promptly so we can clear our accounting records? Thank you so much for your assistance.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: Users from specific domains cannot log in via Google SSO, even if other domains work, or receive Domain not allowed error. SSO-GOOGLE-403 error code is displayed. This is not urgent and we can wait.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's SSO & Identity settings for Google SSO, check the Allowed Domains list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: incorrect vat on invoice
body: the tax rate on my last invoice is wrong. it shows bill-tax-006. please fix this when you have a moment.
resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID under Admin Console -> Billing -> Billing Information. If these details are correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: audit log retention limit
body: i need to set the audit log retention to 5 years for compliance, but the interface stops me at 12 months. is there a way to override this AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT?
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is currently 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution like Splunk or Sumo Logic via our API or SFTP export feature. We have logged this as a feature request for extending native retention periods.

subject: Account suspended unexpectedly
