resolution: Your account access was restricted due to an outstanding invoice. Please navigate to the Billing section of your Admin Console to settle the balance. Once the payment is processed, your service will automatically resume within 15 minutes.

subject: Terrible lag when editing shared docs
body: I am trying to work with a team, but the document editor is incredibly slow. Every time I type, it takes seconds for the text to appear. I keep seeing COLLAB_LAG errors constantly. It is impossible to get any work done.
resolution: Please check your network latency to ensure you have a stable connection. Try closing unnecessary browser tabs and clearing your browser cache. If the performance issues persist, please let us know how many users are collaborating in the document at the same time.

subject: Slow API response times on large datasets
body: We appreciate the tools CloudDesk provides, but we are seeing API_RESPONSE_SLOW metrics when requesting our file lists. Responses are taking well over 500ms, which is causing delays in our downstream app. Could you help us optimize this?
resolution: To investigate, please send us examples of the specific endpoints and timestamps causing the latency. In the meantime, ensure you are utilizing our pagination and filtering parameters to reduce payload size, and consider caching frequently requested data on your side. We can escalate this to engineering once we have the specific log data.

subject: sso login failing on desktop client
body: we are seeing error DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 when logging into the sync app. the browser redirect happens but the client just sits there. very frustrating for the staff, please fix.
resolution: Please update your desktop sync client to version 4.2.1 or newer, as this addresses the SSO redirect handshake. Also, ensure your default browser is configured correctly to handle the authentication tokens; otherwise, you can temporarily use email login.

subject: UNRECOGNIZED BILLING CHARGE ON OUR STATEMENT

resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Newly invited user getting User Not Found error
body: I AM TRYING TO ADD A NEW USER AND THEY CANNOT LOGIN. They keep getting an 'User Not Found' error when using their email and password. This is extremely frustrating for our onboarding process! Please check why this is happening with code AUTH-NF-404.1.
resolution: Please check your Admin Console to ensure the invitation was sent correctly and that the user has accepted it. It is also worth confirming that the user is attempting to log in via the correct instance URL if your organization maintains multiple accounts. If the invitation hasn't been accepted, try sending it again.

subject: Assigned tickets not showing up for agent
body: Hello, my agent is reporting that tickets are assigned to him but he cannot see them in his list. The tickets are visible to me as the administrator, but he sees nothing. It is very confusing for him and he cannot work. We are getting the HELPDESK-007 error when he tries to refresh. Please help us fix this.
resolution: This display issue is usually related to cached session permissions in the browser. Please have the agent clear their cache and cookies, then sign back in to refresh their view. If the ticket still does not appear, try having an admin re-assign it to another user and then back to the original agent to reset the link.

subject: API 403 Forbidden on Workspace Share Endpoint
body: Hello Support, our automated systems are encountering an HTTP 403 Forbidden error when making POST requests to /workspaces/{id}/share. The API key being utilized has the Manager role assigned and sufficient global permissions. Please look into this as soon as possible so we can resume normal operations.
resolution: Ensure the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Also, the user associated with the API key must be a direct member of the workspace being shared, not just via a group. If the issue persists, provide the API key ID and workspace ID for further review.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Users are not receiving password reset emails. Error CD-AM-008. Fix this.
resolution: First, confirm the user's email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Advise the user to check their spam/junk folders. If still not found, ask them to whitelist 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for them via 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password'.

subject: mobile app network error on ios and android
body: our team members trying to use the mobile app are getting a generic network error despite having stable wifi and cellular service. error code MOBILE-NET-500.1 is appearing for several folks across the board right now. not an emergency since everyone is at their desks, but would appreciate a fix when convenient.
resolution: Please advise the users to force close the app, check for any pending app updates in their respective app store, and try logging in again. If the issue persists, suggest clearing the app cache and data on Android devices or completely reinstalling the app on iOS and Android. You can also verify our server operational status on our official status page.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing

resolution: In Zapier, please re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. You can also check the CloudDesk audit logs to see if the expected event is being registered.

subject: Workspace loading issues

resolution: We are currently experiencing a surge of traffic causing slow workspace loads. Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace, and advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. We also suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones and verifying your browser console for any network errors.

subject: Need more file versions in desktop sync

resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding file versioning. The current limits are set to balance storage and performance. This helps our product team understand the demand.

subject: getting api-500 errors on file content endpoint

resolution: We are currently investigating a high volume of similar reports regarding large folder performance. Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace and advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. We suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones and verifying your browser console for any network errors.

subject: Lag while editing documents together
body: Good morning. Our team has been enjoying collaborating on documents in the web app, but recently we noticed some lag when multiple people are typing at the same time. It is not an emergency by any means, just wanted to report it when you have a moment.
resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and applications to free up resources. Let us know if the issue persists when fewer users are editing the document simultaneously.

resolution: Please revoke the compromised API key immediately in Admin Console > API Management. Our engineering team is aware of this critical security vulnerability and is investigating if the scope bypass persists. We apologize for the severity of this issue.

subject: API endpoints returning 503 errors
body: Our automated scripts are failing during high traffic because we keep getting 503 errors. We are seeing API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 frequently. This is blocking our integration work and we would appreciate a prompt resolution. Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: Please check the 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header in your API responses to see if you are hitting our usage caps. We recommend implementing exponential backoff in your scripts to handle these peak load periods. If your traffic remains well within limits, let us know and we will escalate this to our engineers.

subject: inquiry regarding invoice user count discrepancy
body: I hope you are having a pleasant week. I am reviewing our latest invoice and noticed that the billing user count does not match the active users on our dashboard. I believe this might be related to error code BILL-INV-001. We would appreciate a review of these figures when you have a moment.
resolution: Please verify the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' listed on your invoice, as user count adjustments often trigger at the start of your next billing cycle. If the numbers still do not align after your review, please forward the invoice ID and your current user count for a formal manual correction.

subject: New API integration receiving 403 Forbidden
body: I am trying to set up a new integration, but the API calls are failing with a 403 Forbidden error. I have a valid key, but it seems to have limited access. Please help me fix this quickly as we are on a schedule.
resolution: Confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes/permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: slack notifications failing for file shares
body: Our file share notifications are not showing up in slack anymore. We have a major client audit on Friday and need this fixed normal priority please.
resolution: Please check the Slack integration settings within your CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app still has the necessary permissions to post in that channel.

subject: API token failure legacy_token_format error
body: Our integration is throwing 401 Unauthorized with API-AUTH-401-V42 after the v4.2 upgrade. Existing tokens no longer work. We need this fixed immediately to unblock our deployment.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the API and Integrations section in the Admin Console. Please update your downstream applications to utilize these new tokens to resolve the 401 errors.

subject: API resource not found errors
body: My team is getting an API-NOTFOUND-404 error when hitting the folders endpoint. We have a major project delivery due tomorrow and this is blocking our automation. Why is this happening when the IDs are definitely correct?
resolution: Please double-check that your API endpoint path and HTTP method are correctly configured according to our latest API documentation. Verify that the folder ID is valid and that the specific API token being used has the necessary permissions to access that resource.

subject: New user getting user not found error
body: We just invited a new team member and they cannot log in at all because the system keeps throwing error code AUTH-NF-404.1. This is extremely frustrating since we need them onboarded immediately. Please help us fix this login issue today.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation, and check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if your company utilizes multiple accounts.

subject: Blank screen when previewing presentation files
body: Some pptx and pdf files just show a spinning loader or blank page when previewing in the web app. Downloading works fine though. We really need this fixed because we have an important client demo at 5pm today.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Missing file access events in audit logs
body: Hi, I am having some trouble finding specific access events in the audit log for one of our developers. Even when I search for 'File Access', the results seem incomplete and miss some downloads. I keep seeing AUDIT_LOG_MISSING_ACCESS_EVENT in the logs. Thank you for your time looking into this.
resolution: Please ensure you have selected the correct filters for 'File Access' and 'File Share' events. Note that 'View' events are only logged for public or external links; for internal workspace views, please check the file's individual activity feed directly.

subject: File preview viewer showing blank screens
body: Our enterprise team has noticed that previewing certain files like PDFs and PPTX formats directly within the web app is failing. The viewer either shows a blank page or spins indefinitely, and we are seeing error code PREVIEW-006. Downloading the files still works, but the online preview is currently broken. Kindly advise on a solution.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito or private browser window to rule out extension interference. Additionally, ensure the files are not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Slack notifications not working
body: Our file share updates are not posting to our Slack channel. We are seeing SLACK-NOTIFY-500 errors in the logs. Can you please advise on a fix?
resolution: Please check the Slack integration settings within your CloudDesk Admin Console. Ensure the selected channel is correct and that the CloudDesk Slack app still has the necessary permissions to post to that specific channel. If settings appear correct, please verify the authorization tokens are still active.

subject: API tokens stopped working after update

However, we have a critical deadline approaching, and our integration just failed with API-AUTH-401-V42 errors everywhere. We need this working right now as it is affecting all our automated revenue tracking.
resolution: Since the v4.2 release, the API token format has been updated. You will need to regenerate all your API tokens through the API & Integrations section of your Admin Console and update your applications to use these new credentials.

subject: Desktop sync app using high CPU and memory
body: Lately the CloudDesk sync client has been consuming over 50 percent of my CPU even when it is not syncing any files. This makes it difficult to work on my laptop. I have noticed the PERF-DSK-001 error code appearing in the logs. Is there a way to fix this?
resolution: This performance issue often happens if the client gets stuck in a re-indexing loop. Please pause syncing, navigate to Settings, select Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database. Once that is complete, you can resume syncing, and the resource usage should return to normal.

subject: Sudden API Authentication Failures on Free Plan
body: Hello support team, our automated scripts are suddenly failing with error API-AUTH-401.4 since this morning, even though our API key hasn't changed. This is currently blocking our team's daily data synchronization tasks. Could you please look into this promptly so we can resume our work? Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: Please verify your API key's status in the Admin Console under the API Keys section to check if it has expired or been revoked. If needed, please regenerate a new API key and update your application credentials accordingly.

subject: Workspace loading timeout on large folders

resolution: Hello. Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: webhooks failing connection refused

resolution: Hello. Please verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's Webhooks settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range by referring to our documentation for current IPs.

subject: Cannot update credit card details

resolution: This can sometimes be caused by temporary issues with our payment gateway or card issuer restrictions. Please disable any active VPNs and try again in 30 minutes. If the problem persists, please try a different card or contact your bank to ensure they aren't blocking transactions from us.

subject: Critical SSO authentication delays and failures

resolution: This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Advise the admin to re-save their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the 'Application Sign On URL' format. Clear browser cache and cookies for affected users.

subject: Webhook delivery failed errors

resolution: Verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range (refer to documentation for current IPs).

subject: BILL-PLAN-004 error when updating to annual
body: HELLO, I AM TRYING TO UPDATE TO ANNUAL PLAN TO GET THE DISCOUNT BUT I GET BILL-PLAN-004 ERROR! PLEASE HELP ME FIX THIS FAST.
resolution: To switch to an annual subscription, please navigate to the Admin Console, select Billing, then Subscription Details. Click Change Plan and select the annual option to proceed. The update will take effect during your next billing cycle, including a proration of your existing monthly credit.

subject: Billing sso login error in admin console
body: Hi support team, hope you are having a nice day. Since the recent v4.2 update, whenever our admins try to manage billing via SSO login, they run into an authentication failure specifically in the billing section. We love the platform, but would appreciate it if you could help us sort this out when possible. Thanks so much!
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Trash Bin files still visible after 30 days retention policy
body: Hi team, we set up a 30-day data retention policy for our PRO workspace, but deleted files are sticking around in the Trash Bin well past that timeframe. The policy does not seem to be enforced at all. Please help us get this sorted out.
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: cant access shared workspace 403 error
body: logged in fine but getting permission denied on a workspace i need for our audit on Friday. perm-ws-403.4 is showing up.
resolution: An administrator needs to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Simply navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check Members or Permissions, and ensure the user is correctly assigned with appropriate access rights.

subject: Need webhook for file uploads

resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including desired payload, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements. This helps us assess demand and design.

resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time. Please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

If it remains blank, please reply with the specific date range you are trying to view so we can investigate further.

resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. resolution: Please check the Billing Date and Proration Period on your invoice, as user count changes often apply at the start of the next cycle or are prorated. If the discrepancy remains after review, please provide your invoice ID and current user count so we can perform a manual check.

If they are listed as a Guest, verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces, or change their role back to Member or Admin if they require full access.

subject: Cannot log in with SSO after update

subject: Desktop sync client using high CPU

Please pause syncing via the tray icon, navigate to 'Settings' > 'Advanced', and select 'Reset Sync Database' before resuming. If the performance remains high, verify if your folders contain an excessive number of small files.

subject: Mobile app session expiry issues

resolution: The v4.2 update introduced stricter security protocols for session management. Please have your users perform a full logout, clear their app cache or reinstall the application, and then log back in to establish a new, compatible session token.

subject: New user unable to access account
body: Hello, a new team member is trying to log in but is receiving an 'User Not Found' error. We have a team demo at 5pm today and need them to have access by then. Could you please check why their credentials are not being recognized? Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in your Admin Console to ensure it matches their login. If the invitation was never accepted, you may need to resend it to them.

subject: plan downgrade request
body: Hi team, we need to reduce our subscription tier because our team size shrunk down. Can you let me know how to process BILL-PLAN-011 and move to the lower plan.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Okta SSO Login Error User Attribute Mismatch
body: Our team members are unable to log into the web app using Okta SSO today. When redirected back to CloudDesk, we receive an error stating missing required attribute or user attribute mismatch, code SSO-OKTA-403. This is blocking our entire staff from accessing their work tools. Please provide prompt assistance with this issue.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, verify that the email and firstName / lastName attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Ensure email is set as the unique identifier.

subject: Desktop Sync client is stuck on indexing forever
body: The CloudDesk sync client has been stuck on indexing for hours now and nothing is uploading. It shows the SYNC_STATUS_STUCK error in the logs. This is really frustrating as my team cannot access the files we need. I have tried waiting, but it never finishes. Do you have any suggestions to get this moving again?
resolution: Please try restarting your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client first. If the status remains stuck, go to Settings, then Advanced, and select Clear Cache. If those steps don't resolve the sync loop, I recommend performing a full reinstall of the application after backing up your unsynced local files.

subject: SSO login failing for all users
body: Our entire organization is currently locked out of CloudDesk after the v4.2 update. Users are receiving the error AUTH-SSO-401.1 when attempting to sign in via Okta. This is a critical blocker for our daily operations, and we require an immediate resolution.
resolution: We have updated the SSO token format in version 4.2, which requires a refresh of your configuration. Please log into your CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your Identity Provider metadata to resolve the authentication error.

subject: Missing comments in GDPR data export
body: Hello, we performed a GDPR data export for a departing user, but noticed that the generated package is missing some comments the user made on specific files and tasks. Other data looks complete, but we need those comments included for compliance purposes.
resolution: The GDPR data export primarily covers files, folders, and direct user profile data. Comments on files and tasks are stored as activity metadata. To export comments, navigate to the specific file/task, open the 'Activity' tab, and use the 'Export Activity Log' option for that item. There is no single bulk export for all user comments across the platform.

subject: Intermittent 429 API errors
body: We are getting frequent API-RATE-429 responses from your service during our busy hours. How can we prevent these errors?
resolution: Please implement exponential backoff and retry logic within your application's API client. You should also audit your usage patterns to ensure they are optimized; contact us if you believe your legitimate business use requires a rate limit increase.

subject: User login issues after role change to guest
body: Hello support team, we recently updated one of our team members' roles to a guest account, but now they are unable to log into the web application at all. Could you please help us resolve this issue promptly so they can resume their work? Thank you so much!
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: New employee receiving User Not Found error on login
body: Hello, I am writing to report an urgent issue regarding a new hire who cannot access their workspace. Every time they attempt to log into the web platform with their assigned credentials, the system blocks them with an error message stating that the user does not exist. This is completely halting their onboarding process right now, and I understand several other accounts are facing identical login roadblocks this morning. We kindly request prompt assistance to resolve this authentication failure so they can begin their training.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: External share logs do not show external user names
body: This is ridiculous. We share files externally with clients all the time, but the audit logs only show the internal employee who created the link instead of the actual external person who accessed it. We need to know who is downloading our files or this feature is useless for compliance. Please tell me how to fix this AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS issue.
resolution: By default, external share links are anonymous. To track external user activity, the share link must be configured with 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login'. This setting ensures the external user's identity is captured in the audit logs, though it cannot be retroactively applied to existing anonymous links.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed
body: The admin console shows the wrong roles for several users, like listing them as Contributors when they are Managers. This UI-ADMIN-003 is confusing my team. Please fix this soon.
resolution: This is a known cosmetic display bug and does not impact actual workspace permissions. To refresh the view, simply navigate to the user's profile, change their role to something else, save, and then switch it back to the correct role. We are working on a permanent patch for this display issue.

subject: Helpdesk tickets not showing for agent
body: One of our agents cannot see their assigned tickets in the web app, even though they show as assigned to them. We are seeing error HELPDESK-007. We need this fixed as soon as possible to manage our queue.
resolution: This usually stems from a browser caching issue, so please have the agent clear their cache and cookies. If the issue persists, an admin can remove and re-assign the ticket to force a refresh.

subject: Azure AD SSO authentication failing
body: Our IT team is encountering an error when testing Azure AD SSO, specifically seeing an SSO-AZURE-400 reply URL mismatch. Could you verify our configuration requirements? We need this resolved for our upcoming user migration.
resolution: To resolve the mismatch, please ensure the Reply URL in your Azure AD application registration is configured to match the specific ACS URL for your CloudDesk instance. It must be set exactly to https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs.

subject: Cannot access user workspace for audit
body: I need to get into a team members private workspace for a compliance review, but the system is blocking me and showing the PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED message. Its really frustrating that I cant do my job as an admin when I have a deadline. How do I bypass this?
resolution: For privacy reasons, you cannot directly enter a private workspace. You must initiate a 'Workspace Access Request' through the user's profile in the Admin Console, which will log the action and notify the necessary parties for compliance.

subject: Extremely slow download speeds on shared files
body: We are experiencing severe performance issues with the web app today where file downloads are crawling at a fraction of our normal speed. This is affecting our entire office right as we prepare for a major audit on Friday. Please look into this promptly so our team can access the necessary documentation.
resolution: We recommend testing your download speeds using a different browser or network, and checking for any browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, we suggest using a download manager or sharing via our Desktop Sync client, which offers more robust transfer capabilities. We are also verifying the server region for your workspace to ensure optimal routing.

subject: User Activity report blank
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report, but it is returning absolutely no data. I have an important internal audit due this Friday and I need these logs to be visible by then. I am seeing error code REPORT-001 when I try to run the report. Can you get this fixed?
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before attempting to access the report again. If the page is still blank, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to view for further troubleshooting.

subject: Failed to register MFA device error on mobile app
body: Hello support, thank you for your continued assistance. Whenever users try to set up Google Authenticator via the mobile app, they get an error saying Failed to register MFA device after scanning the QR code, with code MFA-MOB-002. We need this sorted because we have a company audit on Friday and need everyone compliant.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow affecting several accounts right now. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app by going to Settings, then Security, and Multi-Factor Authentication. Once set up there, it will work seamlessly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Newly Invited User Receives User Not Found Error
body: Hello, we recently invited a new team member to our CloudDesk workspace, but when they attempt to log in using their email and password, they receive a User Not Found error message. We appreciate your assistance with this matter whenever your team has a moment to look into it.
resolution: Please verify the user's exact email address inside the Admin Console to confirm the invitation was successfully sent and accepted. If necessary, resend the invitation and make sure the user is attempting to log into the correct company instance URL.

subject: Inquiring about plan downgrade options
body: Hello, we are writing to downgrade our subscription plan on our pro account due to a reduced team size. Many customers are hitting this at the same moment right now as budgets shift. Error code is BILL-PLAN-011. There is no particular urgency for this change, so we can wait until it is convenient.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Admin console access denied error
body: Hello, I am trying to access the Admin Console on our free workspace but getting redirected with ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. We have an important compliance audit on Friday and need this resolved soon.
resolution: Confirm the user's role in the Admin Console ('Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Roles'). Ensure they have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned. If not, update their role.

subject: Unable to delete workspace due to integrations
body: I am trying to delete an old workspace but the system says 'Active Integrations Detected'. I don't see any active ones. This is error CD-AM-007. Can you tell me how to clear this?
resolution: You must remove all linked integrations, such as Slack or Jira, from the specific workspace before deletion is permitted. Navigate to Workspace Settings and look under the Integrations tab to remove all active connections before trying again.

subject: API broken after v4.2 update
body: After the update to v4.2, all our API calls return 401 Unauthorized with API-AUTH-401-V42 error. This is critical because our entire production pipeline is down and we are losing time. Please help us fix this right away.
resolution: This error occurs because the API token format was updated in the v4.2 release. You will need to regenerate all your API tokens via the 'API & Integrations' section of the Admin Console. Please update your applications with these new tokens to restore your integration.

subject: Need PDF invoice for audit, CSV is not acceptable
body: I am trying to pull my invoice from the Admin Console but the system only gives me a CSV file! I need a PDF format for our audit this Friday. I am seeing error code BILL-INV-009 when I try to change export settings. This is blocking our financial reporting and I need a solution right now.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Frequent SSO re-authentication prompts in Desktop Sync client
body: Hello support team. Since our enterprise team updated to the v4.2 desktop sync client, many of our users are constantly being asked to re-authenticate via SSO throughout the day. We keep noticing the error code SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 in our local logs. We appreciate any help you can provide to get this sorted out soon.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to SSO token handling. Please perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client by uninstalling, restarting your machine, and then installing it again. If the issue persists, your company's SSO administrator may need to review their IdP's token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret in the CloudDesk Admin Console.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade refund request for our workspace
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a productive week so far over there. I am writing to you today from our finance department to talk about our current billing situation. Yesterday afternoon while I was looking at our account details to update our corporate credit card expiration date, I accidentally clicked the button to upgrade our PRO plan. I am writing to request a refund for the prorated difference since this was completely unintentional on our end. Please let me know what we need to do to get this sorted out.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Data retention policy not deleting files
body: I have set up our data retention policy for 30 days, but files are still sitting in the trash bin way past that deadline. We are seeing RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED errors in our logs. We really need this to work correctly for our compliance requirements. Can you check why the automatic purging is not triggering?
resolution: Please check your settings in the Admin Console under Security and Compliance to ensure the trash purge interval is explicitly defined. Note that standard retention policies apply to permanently deleted files, while files in the trash bin require a specific setting to be purged automatically. If you configure the purge-trash-after-X-days setting, the system will begin removing those items as expected.

subject: payment failed for renewal
body: my card was declined for the subscription renewal and i got a bill-pay-002 error. please help me get this resolved so we dont lose access.
resolution: Please navigate to the Billing section in your Admin Console and update your credit card information. Ensure the billing address matches exactly what your bank has on file for that card. After updating, you can manually retry the payment for your outstanding invoice.

subject: Request for more detailed user activity reports
body: Hello, our admins are currently asking for more detailed reports on things like file downloads and specific collaboration actions beyond the standard audit logs. We would love to see more granular metrics available in the admin console. Thank you for your assistance with this request.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: api error when trying to remove workspace owner
body: getting cd-am-014 when trying to delete a workspace member via api. turns out they are an owner. need to know how to bypass or clear this.
resolution: Hello. A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace. The ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign.

subject: Unable to remove user from workspace
body: I am trying to offboard a user, but it keeps failing with error CD-AM-014. It claims they are the owner and cannot be removed. I am not in a hurry to get this done, but it would be nice to have this cleared up when you have a moment.
resolution: A user cannot be removed while they are the workspace owner. You must first navigate to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign the workspace to another member. Once transferred, you will be able to remove the user.

subject: Error creating new custom role in admin console
body: This is ridiculous! I am trying to set up a brand new custom role for our department on our PRO plan, but every time I click save, it tells me the role name already exists even though I gave it a completely unique name. This CD-AM-012 error is driving me crazy and I want it fixed.
resolution: Role names in CloudDesk are case-insensitive and any leading or trailing spaces are automatically trimmed by the system. There might be an existing role with a similar name or one that differs only by capitalization. Please check Admin Console, Team Management, and Roles thoroughly for any hidden overlapping roles that might conflict.

subject: API permission denied error
body: Our integration is receiving an API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED error when calling the data export endpoint. This setup was working fine until recently. Could you please look into why the admin scope is no longer sufficient?
resolution: Effective immediately, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in Admin Console > API Management.

subject: Account suspended unexpectedly
body: My team is completely blocked because of the BILL-SUSP-007 error code showing up everywhere. We are in the middle of a critical API integration and cannot access our workspace. Please resolve this immediate suspension as soon as possible.
resolution: Your account access was restricted due to an overdue balance. Please settle your outstanding invoice in the Billing section of the Admin Console, and your service will be automatically restored within 15 minutes.

subject: Okta SSO token format error after v4.2 update
body: Hi there, thank you for your continued support. Ever since the v4.2 update rolled out, our users trying to log in via Okta SSO get redirected back to the login page with an 'Invalid Token Format' error, accompanied by AUTH-402. Email and password authentication is working correctly, but SSO is completely broken. Could you please help us fix this as soon as possible so our team can access their workspaces?
resolution: Hello. This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide (accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration').

subject: Login issues after SSO authentication
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a great week. Ever since the recent v4.2 update, our team members attempting to log in via our identity provider experience very long loading times that ultimately result in timeout errors. This is completely blocking our work right now, so any prompt help you can provide would be greatly appreciated. Thank you very much.
resolution: This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. We advise your administrator to re-save the SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. Please also ensure that browser cache and cookies are cleared for all affected users.

subject: api keys suddenly unauthorized
body: api calls are failing with api-auth-401.4 error. keys were working fine yesterday. please advise.
resolution: Please log into the Admin Console and check the status of your API keys under the API Keys section to see if they were revoked or have expired. If they appear valid and the error persists, please regenerate a new API key and update your application settings accordingly.

subject: Need API endpoint for programmatic workspace creation in v4.2
body: Hi, with the introduction of the new SSO token mechanics in v4.2, our engineering team is looking to automate our client onboarding workflow. We need to know if there is a new API endpoint available to programmatically create and configure workspaces. Please let us know as soon as possible so we can proceed with our integration planning.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to our SSO token handling, but an API endpoint for programmatic workspace creation is not yet available. You can currently manage workspaces via the Admin Console. Please submit your detailed requirements for this API endpoint to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements/workspace-creation-api. This helps us understand the demand for automation.

subject: Unable to edit Company Name in settings
body: I am attempting to update our company name in the admin console but the field is locked. We recently went through a rebrand and need this reflected for our API integrations. I keep getting error CD-AM-010 when trying to save changes.
resolution: The company name is tied directly to your billing profile, which is why it appears read-only. You must update your Organization Name within the 'Subscription & Billing' section first. This will propagate the update and resolve the CD-AM-010 error you are seeing.

subject: API pagination parameters not working as expected
body: I was working on our internal documentation and noticed that when I try to pull a list of files using the API, the offset and limit seem a bit off. I am not sure if it is a configuration issue on our end or a server issue, but it is returning fewer items than I requested. It is not a major issue but I would like to understand why this happens.
resolution: Please verify that your request is using the limit and offset parameters correctly as per our API documentation. Note that there is a hard cap on the maximum limit allowed per single request, which is 1000 items. If you are below that cap, please let us know.

subject: GET files endpoint returning HTTP 500 error
body: Our integration is encountering intermittent HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses when calling the file content endpoint. This primarily happens for files located in specific regions. We need this resolved to keep our workflow unblocked.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: new user cannot log in
body: hi team, a new user invited today keeps getting 'user not found' when trying to log in with their email and password. could you check this out? it's blocking them from starting their work. auth-nf-404.1
resolution: Please verify the invited user's email address in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Confirm that the invitation was successfully sent and accepted. If it wasn't, please resend the invitation. Also, ensure the user is attempting to log in at the correct CloudDesk instance URL.

subject: Feature request: Webhook for new file uploads
body: Hello, we are looking for a way to get a webhook event whenever a new file is uploaded to our workspace. This would greatly improve our internal automation and is currently a major blocker for our workflow. Thanks for your consideration.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out regarding this integration. We currently support polling for file changes, but a dedicated webhook for file uploads is not yet available in our API. Please submit a detailed proposal for this functionality, including your requirements for the payload, at roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so our engineering team can review the request.

subject: Okta SSO login issues
body: We are getting SSO-OKTA-403 after migrating to v4.2. Users are failing to log in due to attribute mismatch. This is blocking our entire team and we need this resolved immediately.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, please verify that the email, firstName, and lastName attributes are mapped correctly to the CloudDesk profile fields. Also, ensure that email is designated as the unique identifier.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: Hello, our latest invoice shows a user count that does not match our current active users in CloudDesk under BILL-INV-001. Please let us know how this can be reviewed when you have a moment.
resolution: Please check the Billing Date and Proration Period on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these details, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Requesting more granular user activity reporting
body: Our team has been looking for ways to track specific user interactions like file views and download timestamps within our Enterprise environment. The standard audit logs are helpful but lack the level of detail we need for our compliance workflows. We are not in a rush to implement this, but could you please point us in the right direction for future reporting enhancements?
resolution: Thank you for reaching out regarding enhanced user reporting. While our current logs provide basic tracking, our product team is actively collecting requirements for more advanced analytics. Please submit your specific reporting needs to our public roadmap page so our team can prioritize these features accordingly.

subject: Azure AD SSO error and reply url mismatch on login
body: Hello support, some users on our free account are hitting an Azure AD error page with a reply url mismatch when trying to sign in. Error code is sso-azure-400. Could someone check this when you have a moment?
resolution: In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs' (replace 'yourcompany' with your actual subdomain).

subject: Cannot update Company Name
body: I am trying to change our company name in the console but it won't save. I keep seeing error CD-AM-010. Please look into this.
resolution: The company name is locked to your billing profile. Please go to Admin Console > Subscription & Billing to update the Organization Name, and it will automatically update in your settings.

subject: Seat limit reached error when adding members
body: Hello support, I am trying to add new team members today and receiving a Seat limit reached error message, despite our subscription details showing we have available seats remaining. Everything else looks normal on our end.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Deleted files visible past thirty day retention policy
body: Hello, our Pro workspace has a 30-day data retention policy configured, but deleted files are still visible and recoverable past that timeframe. We are seeing RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED on the admin console. This is blocking our compliance review so please assist promptly.
resolution: Please verify your retention policy configuration under Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention to ensure it applies properly to 'Permanently Deleted' states. Note that files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery rather than automatic purging unless specifically configured to purge the trash after X days.

subject: API-500 errors during file download
body: My developers are seeing API-500 errors when calling the content endpoint. its blocking our work for a demo at 5pm today. can you please fix it asap?
resolution: We are currently investigating the root cause of these intermittent 500 errors related to distributed storage. In the meantime, implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your code should resolve the immediate blocking issue. We are working to deploy a hotfix as soon as possible.

subject: User invitation status remains pending
body: Hello, one of our new hires accepted their invitation link, but their status is still showing as pending in the console. They cannot log into their account at all. It is important that we get them onboarded today. Thank you for your help.
resolution: This can sometimes occur if there is a sync delay or a domain configuration mismatch. Please ask the user to attempt a direct login with their credentials; if that fails, revoke the current invitation in the Admin Console and send a fresh one.

subject: Admin redirected to standard user dashboard
body: Hello, an administrator-level user in our organization is trying to access the Admin Console but is consistently redirected to the standard user dashboard or receives an Access Denied message with code ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. Please assist in restoring their proper permissions.
resolution: Confirm the user's role in the Admin Console ('Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Roles'). Ensure they have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned. If not, update their role.

subject: Requesting longer expiration for shared public links
body: Hello team, I hope you are having a great week. Our marketing department frequently shares public assets with external partners, but the current link expiration is a bit too short for our campaign timelines. We would love it if public links could be set to never expire or have a much longer duration option. Thanks so much for your time and help with this!
resolution: Hi there! The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we do not plan to offer never expire options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: User activity report page is completely blank
body: Hello support team, I went to check the User Activity report in the admin console today but the page loads up entirely blank. All other reports seem to be working fine for us. Whenever you get a chance to look at this report-001 issue it would be greatly appreciated, thanks!
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Webhooks rejected due to invalid HMAC signature
body: Our external service is rejecting incoming CloudDesk webhooks with an invalid signature error reporting HMAC verification failed. We need this resolved promptly as our integration pipeline is currently blocked.
resolution: Please ensure that the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the 'Webhook Secret' configured in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Additionally, verify that your signature verification algorithm matches CloudDesk's standard HMAC-SHA256 implementation.

subject: AUDIT LOG EXPORT BROKEN 90 DAYS
body: I AM TRYING TO EXPORT AUDIT LOGS OVER 90 DAYS AND IT KEEPS FAILING WITH AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. THIS IS RIDICULOUS. PLEASE FIX IT WHENEVER YOU CAN.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Switch to annual billing
body: I am trying to switch our Enterprise account to annual billing to secure the discount, but the system is throwing error BILL-PLAN-004. This is very frustrating as we need to finalize our budget. Please fix this.
resolution: I apologize for the trouble with the plan change. Please head to the Admin Console, select Billing, and then Subscription Details to find the Change Plan button. Selecting the annual option there will apply the changes at the start of your next billing cycle.

subject: Getting 404 Not Found on specific folder API endpoints
body: Hello, we are seeing 404 Not Found responses when making API calls to specific resources like /folders/{id}/files, even though the ID is correct and verified. No real rush on this as we are just testing workflows in our PRO account, but whenever you have a chance to look it over that would be great.
resolution: Verify the API endpoint path and HTTP method against the latest CloudDesk API documentation. Ensure the resource ID, such as the folder ID, is valid and accessible to the API token's permissions.

subject: Desktop sync client uploaded documents without consent
body: the desktop sync client unexpectedly uploaded files from our local Documents folder to a workspace without asking us. we have a security audit on Friday and need this investigated immediately because of privacy concerns.
resolution: The desktop sync client only syncs folders explicitly configured by the user or pre-configured by an admin. Check the sync client settings for 'Synced Folders' and verify no unintended folders were selected. Ensure 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is disabled if not desired. If an admin-mandated sync, contact your internal IT.

subject: Desktop sync conflict issues
body: the desktop client is flagging files as conflict even when no one else is editing them. getting lots of duplicates. error sync-003. thanks for your help.
resolution: This generally happens when local security software like an antivirus or firewall interferes with our sync process. Could you please try temporarily disabling your security software to see if the conflicts stop? If that clears the issue, you should add CloudDesk to your security software's whitelist to prevent future interference.

subject: Assigned tickets missing from agent view
body: Good morning, I am writing to report an issue regarding our helpdesk module. When a ticket is assigned to an agent, they cannot see it in their 'My Assigned Tickets' view in the web app, though administrators can see it just fine. Please look into this when you have a chance.
resolution: This is a known permissions caching quirk currently affecting some accounts. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that does not resolve it, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, and then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: api token returns error after v42 upgrade
body: Hello finance team here we updated to v42 this morning and now all our automated scripts using our api tokens fail with 401 Unauthorized legacy_token_format error code API-AUTH-401-V42. This is halting our daily ledger exports so please assist promptly.
resolution: With the v4.2 update, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console and update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Invitation emails not arriving to new users
body: Hello, admin users report that when they invite new members to a workspace, the invitation emails are not being received by the invitees. The invite shows as Pending in the workspace member list. No bounce-back errors are reported. Take a look when you have time.
resolution: Please check your company email spam or junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain SPF and DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk sending domains. Refer to our Email Delivery Troubleshooting guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries.

subject: Cannot export audit logs for long periods
body: I am trying to export our company's audit logs for the last six months to satisfy our internal reporting requirements. Every time I set the date range, the console throws an error message AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED and stops the process. Is there a way to pull this data for a longer duration?
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is currently capped at 90 days. For longer periods, please use our API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with a pagination script to pull the data. Alternatively, if you cannot use the API, let us know and we can assist with a manual data extract.

subject: Slow loading in workspaces with many files
body: I am experiencing the WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error when opening workspaces that contain over 10,000 files. The page just spins forever and eventually stays blank. Can you look into why the load times are so excessive?
resolution: High file density can sometimes impact initial load speeds in the web app. I recommend using our filtering tools to narrow down your search or breaking larger workspaces into smaller, more granular ones to improve performance.

subject: accidental upgrade refund request
body: hi there we accidentally clicked the upgrade button earlier and need a refund for the prorated amount before our payroll run tomorrow morning thanks so much for your help
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: User Activity report is totally blank
body: I am trying to run a report but the User Activity page is just blank. I see REPORT-001 at the top of the screen. Its very frustrating because I have a deadline and cannot get the data I need right now.
resolution: This happens when there is a temporary failure in data retrieval for that specific report. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or try using a different web browser. If it remains blank, please let us know the specific date range you are attempting to view.

subject: Cannot remove user from workspace
body: I am trying to offboard a departing employee but keep hitting error CD-AM-014 when I attempt to remove them from our shared workspace. It claims they are an owner and cannot be deleted. This is quite frustrating as I need to keep our workspace management organized. How can I resolve this quickly?
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner. You must first transfer ownership to another member by navigating to Admin Console, selecting your Workspace, and using the Transfer Ownership option in settings. Once ownership is reassigned, you will be able to remove the user without the error.

subject: DESKTOP APP SSO LOGIN BROKEN
body: I am completely unable to log into the desktop sync client using our SSO credentials today. The browser redirects successfully, but the client just sits there unauthenticated with error code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. This is blocking our entire team from accessing our files and we need prompt help right now!
resolution: Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version v4.2.1 or newer. Check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a temporary workaround, you can log in via email/password if SSO is not strictly enforced for your account.

subject: Push notifications are severely delayed
body: We are noticing that push notifications on the mobile app are often arriving several minutes late or not appearing until the app is actively opened. This MOBILE_NOTIFICATION_DELAY is quite disruptive for our team collaboration. How can we fix this?
resolution: Please check that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk app settings and your device's system preferences. Often, battery optimization settings can delay background activity, so you may need to adjust those settings as well. If the problem persists, try a clean reinstall of the application.

subject: 403 Forbidden error with valid API key
body: Hi there, we just started using the API and are getting a API-AUTH-403.5 error. The key seems valid but none of our calls are working. We are blocked trying to finish our integration. Any ideas why this is happening?
resolution: Please confirm that your API key has the necessary scopes and permissions assigned for the specific endpoints you are targeting. An administrator can review and adjust these settings in the Admin Console under the API Keys section. Once the correct permissions are saved, your integration should function as expected.

subject: Request for longer expiration on public links
body: Hello, I am managing team files and we love your platform. Many of our shared documents need to be available for a long time. Is it possible to set links to never expire or just stay longer than the current limit? It is not super important but would be very helpful for our workflow.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set to adhere to our security best practices. While we do not plan to offer a 'never expire' option, we are open to considering extending the maximum duration. Please submit your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration, or consider inviting users directly to a workspace for permanent access.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: hey there, my zapier trigger for file uploads isnt working. i get a zapiertrigger-404 error when i try to test the connection. could you please look into why the events arent coming through? thanks.
resolution: Please try re-testing your CloudDesk trigger step within Zapier to refresh the API connection. Additionally, verify that the account credentials used for the integration have the required permissions for event monitoring. You may also want to check the audit logs to ensure the events are being triggered correctly.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental upgrade
body: I seem to have accidentally upgraded our account to the PRO plan. I did not mean to do this and would like a refund for the charge. Could you please process this for me? Thanks.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are reviewed individually. Please confirm the exact time of the upgrade and ensure that no PRO features have been accessed since that time. Once you provide those details, we will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Webhook HMAC verification failed
body: External service is rejecting our webhooks with WEBHOOK-SIGN-403 because the signature is invalid. This is blocking our integration work and we need prompt help.
resolution: Please ensure that the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the Webhook Secret configured in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Also verify that your signature verification algorithm strictly matches CloudDesk's HMAC-SHA256 implementation.

subject: MFA code not working on mobile
body: The Google Authenticator codes on my mobile app are not being accepted. I have tried multiple times and it keeps failing. Please advise on how to fix this.
resolution: This is usually caused by a time synchronization issue on the mobile device. Please ensure your phone is set to update its time automatically via the network. If the problem persists, please re-set up your MFA in the Security Settings page of your web account.

subject: Delay in mobile app push notifications
body: Hi there, we have been noticing that push notifications for file changes and @mentions are not arriving promptly on our mobile devices. Sometimes they arrive minutes late or not at all until we open the app, which is triggering the MOBILE_NOTIFICATION_DELAY error for our team. We really appreciate the work you do and look forward to a fix when you have a moment. Thanks!
resolution: Please check that push notifications are fully enabled within both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and your device's system preferences. We also recommend checking your device's battery optimization settings, as these can sometimes restrict background app activity. If the problem persists, please try reinstalling the mobile application.

subject: Credit card payment method failing with error
body: Hi support team, we are attempting to add a new credit card as a payment method, but the system returns an Invalid Card Details error, even though the card number, expiry, and CVV are confirmed to be correct. We see error BILL-PAY-012. Could you please assist us promptly with this?
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again after 30 minutes, or use a different card if the issue persists.

subject: Webhooks failing - Connection refused
body: Our webhooks are failing with a WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 error and we have an audit on Friday. This is very frustrating as we need these logs working. Can you look into this?
resolution: Please verify your webhook endpoint URL within the Admin Console to ensure it is configured correctly. Confirm that your external service is active and that your firewall is permitting incoming connections from our published IP range. This should clear the connection refused error and restore delivery before your deadline.

subject: Account locked and I have a demo today
body: My account is locked and I cannot log in even though I know my password is correct. I have an important demo at 5pm today and I really need access to those files. I keep getting error auth-lock-429.1 when I try. Can you please unlock this for me quickly?
resolution: You can either wait 15 minutes for the automated lockout to expire or have an administrator unlock your account immediately. An admin can perform this by navigating to the Admin Console and selecting the 'Unlock Account' option under your user profile settings.

subject: API 403 Forbidden when sharing workspace
body: Hi, why am I getting a 403 error when calling POST /workspaces/{id}/share via the API? Error code API-403 keeps showing up even though my API key user has Manager role. This is blocking our automation setup.
resolution: Ensure the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Also, the user associated with the API key must be a direct member of the workspace being shared, not just via a group. If the issue persists, provide the API key ID and workspace ID for further review.

subject: Okta SSO failing after v4.2 update
body: Our users cant log in via Okta anymore. We keep getting an 'Invalid SSO token format' error since the v4.2 update. This is critical as the whole team is locked out. We need a fix immediately.
resolution: You need to update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata. This step is required due to the change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: Cannot download PDF invoices
body: This is very frustrating, I can only download invoices as CSV but I need them in PDF format for my records. Error code BILL-INV-009. Please fix this soon.
resolution: PDF generation is currently limited for older invoices due to a recent migration. Please provide the specific invoice IDs you are looking for, and our team will manually generate and email the PDFs to you directly.

subject: sso azure ad error
body: we are getting an sso-azure-400 error and users are being sent to an error page. this is blocking our team from logging into the platform. please help us fix this as soon as you can.
resolution: This error typically occurs when the redirect configuration is misaligned. Please navigate to your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk and verify that the Reply URL is set exactly to https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs. Ensure you replace yourcompany with the correct subdomain for your organization.

subject: User cannot login after role change error CD-AM-002
body: we changed an employee role from member to guest yesterday and now they get insufficient permissions and account suspended errors when trying to log in. error code CD-AM-002 is showing up on their screen. this is urgent because we have our quarterly financial audit starting tomorrow morning at 8am and they need access immediately.
resolution: Hello. Guest users can only access shared workspaces they have been explicitly invited to. Please check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role is set correctly. If they are listed as a Guest, verify they have active invitations to the shared workspaces; if they require full platform access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Slow API responses on large datasets
body: Specific endpoints like GET /files are consistently returning responses in over 500ms, triggering the API_RESPONSE_SLOW warning. This is impacting our integrations and causing downstream application delays, particularly for large datasets. We require prompt assistance to resolve this performance bottleneck.
resolution: Please provide specific API call examples including the endpoint, request body, and timestamps for our investigation. We advise optimizing your API calls by using pagination and filtering parameters to reduce the dataset returned, as well as suggesting caching frequently accessed data on your end. We have also escalated this to engineering with your report for further performance analysis.

subject: Slow API response times
body: Our integrations are failing because the API is returning data way too slow. We are getting API_RESPONSE_SLOW errors on simple GET requests. It is basically unusable for our current project. Can you help us with this?
resolution: Please provide us with specific examples of the affected endpoints and timestamps so we can investigate the latency. In the meantime, try implementing pagination and filtering in your requests to minimize the data payload. We can also look into caching strategies to help improve your application's performance.

subject: sso login failing and hanging after v44.2 update
body: Ever since the recent update our team can't log in properly via sso because it hangs forever or throws token errors. Error code SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2 keeps appearing. We are totally blocked right now so please help asap.
resolution: This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Advise the admin to re-save their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the 'Application Sign On URL' format. Clear browser cache and cookies for affected users.

subject: Unrecognized charge on corporate credit card
body: We noticed a recent charge from CloudDesk on our billing statement that does not match our subscription details. This unexpected fee is holding up our internal reconciliation process and needs to be resolved quickly. Please investigate this transaction as soon as possible.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade and refund request
body: Hello support team, I hope you are all having a wonderful week so far over there. As you might know, our team has been using CloudDesk for a while now to manage our files, and we really love the platform's overall design and ease of use. However, while I was navigating through the admin console this morning to check our billing cycle dates and update some general profile settings, I accidentally clicked the button to upgrade our subscription plan. We are currently on the PRO tier and didn't mean to change anything right now, especially since we have an upcoming audit on Friday and things are quite busy. We received error code BILL-REF-005 right after the change went through. Could you please process a refund for this accidental charge? Let me know what you need from my end.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: API pagination parameters failing
body: I am trying to pull a list of users for our end-of-week report, but the pagination is completely ignoring my limit parameter. I am seeing error API-PAGINATION-500, and I need this fixed before my meeting on Friday. This is quite frustrating as it makes the API unusable for large datasets.
resolution: Please verify that your request is correctly structured using the 'limit' and 'offset' query parameters as defined in our API documentation. Additionally, please be aware that there is a hard cap on the maximum limit allowed per single request, typically set at 1000 items. If you are requesting more than this, please adjust your offset to retrieve the next page of results.

subject: API authentication failing after v4.2 update
body: Our automated workflows are all receiving API-AUTH-401-V42 errors since the update. This is a critical issue as it has completely halted our data pipelines. We have a hard audit deadline this Friday, so we need a fix immediately.
resolution: The v4.2 release included an update to our API token format. To resolve this, you must regenerate all your existing API tokens through the API & Integrations section of your Admin Console and update your applications with these new credentials.

subject: Workspace loading very slowly with many files

I am an external contractor working on this project, and I want it fixed soon but it is not pressing. Please let me know how to resolve this issue.
resolution: Please check for large file counts in the affected workspace. We advise you to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view and avoid performance bottlenecks. We also suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones, and verifying your browser console for any network errors.

subject: api workspace sharing returning 403 error

resolution: Please ensure the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Also, the user associated with the API key must be a direct member of the workspace being shared, rather than just accessing it via a group. If the issue persists, provide the API key ID and workspace ID for further review.

subject: Lag in document collaboration
body: We are experiencing significant delays when editing docs in the web app, getting COLLAB_LAG errors constantly. Cursor updates are taking forever and its making team work impossible. Can you check if something is wrong with the server?
resolution: Please ensure all collaborators have a stable network connection and try closing any unnecessary browser tabs. If the slowness persists, have your team clear their browser cache to help resolve the document sync latency.

subject: User locked out after role change
