resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role, and if they are a guest, verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces or change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin' for full access.

subject: Mobile app network error
body: I keep getting a network error when trying to log into the mobile app, even though my connection is solid. I am getting the MOBILE-NET-500.1 error code. I am not in a rush, but would like to know why this is happening.
resolution: Please force close the application and check your app store for any available updates. If that does not work, try clearing the app cache or reinstalling it entirely. You can also monitor our official status page to ensure all systems are operating normally.

subject: Hardware MFA token support request

resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Request for storage limit increase

resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams, and we do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time.

subject: CANNOT TRANSFER WORKSPACE OWNERSHIP!!! THIS IS RIDICULOUS

I click the button and it's greyed out or I get an error 'Cannot transfer ownership to non-owner' CD-AM-004. What is going on? This is a critical workspace and I need to delegate this ASAP.
resolution: To transfer workspace ownership, the recipient must be an existing member or administrator within that specific workspace. Please ensure Sarah is already a member of the 'Project Alpha' workspace. If she is not, kindly add her first, then proceed to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > Project Alpha > Settings' to complete the ownership transfer.

subject: User Activity report showing blank page

resolution: This usually stems from a temporary cache issue. Please clear your browser cookies and try again in an incognito window. If the report remains blank, please let us know the specific date range you are attempting to view.

subject: Desktop sync client login failed with SSO

subject: Azure AD SSO login failure error AUTH-SSO-403.2

resolution: Hello. Please guide your Azure AD administrator to verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped in the enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. You can find detailed instructions in our Azure AD SSO configuration guide at https://docs.cloudesk.com/sso/azure-ad.

resolution: This is likely a caching issue regarding agent permissions. Please have the affected agent clear their browser cache and cookies before logging back in. If the ticket still does not appear, an administrator should re-assign it to another user and then move it back to refresh the link.

If the problem persists, please use a local account for billing management while we address the SSO integration.

subject: Audit log missing login attempts
body: We suspect a security breach because of weird logins from new countries, but the audit log only shows successful ones and is missing data! We need this investigated immediately.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses/locations are recorded in the 'Security Events' log, not 'Login Activity'. Navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events for this information. Enable 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic alerts.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing for new file uploads
body: Hello, we have a Zap configured with a CloudDesk trigger for new file uploads, but it has stopped firing completely. We noticed error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 in our monitoring tools. Thank you for looking into this whenever you have some free time.
resolution: In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. Check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with invalid token format
body: Dear Support Team, our entire team using Okta SSO can no longer log in after the recent v4.2 update, receiving an invalid token format error. This is a critical issue halting our operations, and we would deeply appreciate your prompt assistance.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata. This step is required for all Okta integrations due to the updated SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: google sso domain login issues
body: our team is getting the sso-google-403 error when trying to sign in. some domains work but others seem to be blocked now. thanks for your help with this.
resolution: Please navigate to the SSO & Identity section in your Admin Console. Ensure the affected domains are correctly added to the 'Allowed Domains' list for Google SSO.

subject: api key broken suddenly
body: my api key stopped working and i get error api-auth-401.4 when calling endpoints. it was fine yesterday but now it just says unauthorized. please help.
resolution: Please check the API Keys section in your Admin Console to see if your key has been revoked or expired. You may need to generate a new key and update your application to resolve this authentication error.

subject: Public link expiration limits
body: The public links expire way to fast. We need them to stay active longer for our integration. Any way to make them last longer or never expire?
resolution: Our current expiration limits are in place to follow security best practices. While we do not offer a 'never expire' option, you can submit a feature request for longer durations at our roadmap portal. For more permanent sharing, we recommend inviting users directly into a workspace.

subject: Workspace invitation emails are not being delivered to new members
body: I am completely baffled as to why our new hires are not receiving their workspace invitation emails. Every single invite remains stuck as Pending in our member list, and yet there are no bounce-back errors reported anywhere in the system. This is causing significant onboarding delays for our department heads who need to start collaborating immediately. Please look into error EMAIL-005 right away and let me know why this is happening.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam and junk folders first. If the emails are not found there, ensure that your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are properly configured to allow messages sent from CloudDesk's domains. You can refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the precise DNS entries required. If the problem continues, please provide the specific email addresses of the affected users so we can investigate manually.

subject: Accidental subscription plan upgrade
body: We accidentally upgraded our account to the Enterprise tier earlier this morning. We would like to request a refund for this change as it was not intended. Please let us know the next steps for processing this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that no features from the new plan have been utilized so we can review your account for eligibility.

subject: Okta SSO login broken
body: Our users are reporting an 'Invalid SSO token format' error after the recent v4.2 update. This is a critical issue as no one can access their account right now. We see error AUTH-SSO-401.1.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token format. Please re-upload your IDP metadata within the SSO configuration section of the Admin Console to refresh your connection.

subject: WHERE ARE MY OLD INVOICES?!?!
body: Hey team, I was trying to pull some historical financial data for an audit today and realized I can't see any invoices older than 12 months in the admin console. Error code BILL-INV-003 keeps showing up when I try to dig deeper. It is not super urgent since we have some time before final tax filings, but it is super annoying. Please fix your UI so I can access my old bills.
resolution: The Admin Console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months. For older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you are looking for, and we will retrieve it for you from our archives.

subject: User login issue
body: One of our new team members is unable to log into their account after receiving an invitation. They are receiving a User Not Found error when attempting to sign in with their credentials. We have double-checked the email address used for the invitation. Could you please look into this for us?
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was successfully sent and accepted by the user. If they have not accepted it yet, please resend the invitation and ensure they are attempting to log into the correct instance URL.

subject: Okta login broken after update
body: Hello support team, since we updated to v4.2 yesterday morning, none of our staff can log in using Okta SSO. They keep seeing an Invalid SSO token format message and error code AUTH-SSO-401.1. This is halting our entire finance department today, so we really need a prompt fix for this issue.
resolution: This is due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in v4.2. Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata to restore access.

subject: Account Suspended error BILL-SUSP-007 locking out all users
body: Our entire PRO workspace is currently inaccessible because our CloudDesk account has been suspended. We received an email regarding an overdue payment, and an Account Suspended banner is visible in the Admin Console showing error BILL-SUSP-007. We need this resolved immediately to restore access for our staff.
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Invoices' and paying the overdue invoice. Once payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: Cannot log into mobile app with network error
body: Hello team, I am unable to log into the mobile app on my device. I keep receiving a generic network error even though my internet connection is completely stable. I am on the free plan and getting error code MOBILE-NET-500.1 whenever I attempt to sign in. Please advise on how to resolve this when you have a moment.
resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache/data (Android) or reinstalling the app (iOS/Android). Verify server status on our status page.

subject: Cannot export audit logs over 90 days
body: I am attempting to pull audit logs for our compliance review but the system blocks exports exceeding 90 days with error AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. We need a way to get the full historical data. How should we proceed?
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Notification settings are too noisy
body: We find the current notifications to be a bit overwhelming. It would be great if we could choose to be alerted only for mentions rather than every single comment left on a file. Do you have any plans to make this more granular in the near future?
resolution: We appreciate you sharing your thoughts on our notification system. While basic settings are available in your profile, we invite you to submit your specific requirements for granular control at roadmap.cloudesk.com. This allows our team to track demand and prioritize improvements based on user feedback.

subject: EXTREME EYE STRAIN WE DEMAND DARK MODE
body: Our users report severe eye strain during prolonged use, especially in low-light environments. They frequently request a dark mode option in the admin console. Please add this feature as soon as possible.
resolution: Thank you for your feature request! Dark Mode for the CloudDesk web app is a popular suggestion, though we currently do not have it available. Please vote for this feature on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/dark-mode to help us prioritize it.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content endpoint
body: Our developers are reporting intermittent API-500 errors when fetching file content, especially for files in remote regions. It is very frustrating to deal with these inconsistent failures during our production workflows. Could you please help us resolve this?
resolution: We are currently addressing a backend issue affecting distributed storage retrieval. In the meantime, please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client to mitigate these intermittent connection errors.

subject: Google SSO login failing for specific domains
body: Hello, we are noticing that our users from specific domains are unable to sign into the web app using Google SSO. They are receiving an error code SSO-GOOGLE-403 when they attempt to authenticate. Could you please investigate why these specific domains are suddenly being blocked?
resolution: To resolve this, please log into your CloudDesk Admin Console and navigate to the SSO & Identity settings for Google. Ensure that all the required domains are included in your 'Allowed Domains' list. Once you add the missing domains there, your users should be able to authenticate successfully.

subject: Azure AD nested groups failing to map after v4.2 update
body: Since the v4.2 update, we can no longer map our nested groups from Azure AD to our CloudDesk workspaces. This is causing a significant headache for our IT provisioning. We need a way to support these group structures as soon as possible. Why was this functionality removed?
resolution: Following the v4.2 update, our integration currently supports direct group mapping but not nested resolution. We are aware of this limitation and are working on improvements. For now, please consider flattening your Azure AD groups or logging your requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/v4.2-enhancements/nested-azure-ad-groups.

subject: Seat limit reached error despite available seats
body: hi support, we tried adding a new employee today and got the CD-AM-001 error saying our seat limit is reached. our dashboard says we have open seats available though. please check this when you can
resolution: Please check the Pending Invitations count in Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations, as outstanding invitations consume available seat slots. You can either revoke those unused pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase your total seat capacity.

subject: Frequent session expiration on dashboard
body: Hello support team! When I log in, I am immediately logged out with a Session Expired message and error code AUTH-SESSION-401.5. I am unable to navigate past the dashboard before being logged out. We have a major client audit on Friday, so your help is greatly appreciated.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cookies and local storage for 'cloudesk.com'. Check if the user has strict privacy settings or browser extensions that might be interfering with session cookies. Verify system time on user's device.

subject: Deleted user still visible in sharing dialogs before audit
body: Hi there, as you know we have our major financial audit on Friday and I was cleaning up users in the admin console, but even after deleting an account the old name still shows up in workspace sharing dialogs with error CD-AM-006. Many colleagues have noticed this anomaly today as well. Please look into this quickly.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as 'ghost' entries in historical share lists until the system purges them, typically within 24 to 48 hours, or until a workspace owner explicitly removes them from a share via Workspace Settings > Members. This is expected behavior.

subject: User Activity report page is blank
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report, but it stays blank. I see an error code REPORT-001. I need this to reconcile accounts before my payroll run tomorrow. Please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: This behavior is often a temporary glitch in data retrieval. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before reloading the report. If that does not work, could you try using a different browser or checking your extensions? If it remains blank, please share the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: Cannot remove user from workspace
body: I am trying to remove a user from one of our workspaces but the system won't let me. It keeps throwing error CD-AM-014 saying they are an owner. This is quite annoying as we need to clean up our workspace access. I look forward to your response whenever you have a moment.
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are the current owner. You must first transfer ownership to another member by navigating to the workspace settings in the Admin Console. Once the ownership is moved, you will be able to remove the user successfully.

subject: API endpoints returning HTTP 503 errors during peak hours
body: Hello, we are experiencing persistent HTTP 503 errors across multiple API endpoints during peak operational hours. This is currently blocking our automated scripts and integrations. Could you please provide prompt assistance and let us know if there is an underlying platform issue causing this service unavailability?
resolution: Hello. We have checked our systems regarding your API requests. Please investigate your usage patterns to see if you are exceeding rate limits by checking the 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header, and advise implementing exponential backoff for retries.

subject: Intermittent HTTP 500 on GET files content
body: Hello, our developers are noticing that calls to the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint intermittently return an HTTP 500 Internal Server Error. This mainly happens for files stored in geographically diverse regions. Other API endpoints are working fine. Please look into this.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: MFA registration failing in mobile app
body: Hello. Users attempting to enable or set up MFA like Google Authenticator via the mobile app encounter an error after scanning the QR code. Email and password login works fine, but MFA cannot be configured on mobile devices. Please provide guidance on how to resolve this.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: DESKTOP SYNC IS BROKEN PLEASE FIX
body: EVERYONE IS LOGGED OUT! WE ARE LOSING REVENUE BECAUSE OF THIS! WE SEE SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 IN EVERY LOG. WE NEED AN IMMEDIATE FIX NOW!
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to SSO token handling that requires attention. Please advise your users to perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client, and have your SSO administrator check the IdP token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: We are experiencing a redirect loop when using Google SSO. The authentication appears to complete, but the user is never forwarded to the dashboard. Please advise when you can.
resolution: Please have the affected users clear their browser cache and cookies for our domain. If that does not resolve the loop, try accessing the platform via an incognito window and verify your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Slow performance in collaborative docs
body: We are experiencing significant latency when editing documents with multiple users. It is quite noticeable and the COLLAB_LAG error appears frequently. No immediate rush, but could you advise on how to improve this?
resolution: To improve performance, please ensure all collaborators have a stable internet connection and close any high-bandwidth background applications. Clearing your browser cache can also help reduce latency during multi-user sessions. If the lag continues, try limiting the number of people editing a single document simultaneously.

subject: Need PDF invoice format instead of CSV
body: Hello support, when I try to download our account invoice from the Admin Console, the only available format is CSV. However, our accounting department requires a PDF format for our financial records. Please let me know how to download invoices as PDFs.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a recent system migration. For the specific invoice or invoices you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice IDs and our team will gladly generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Billing section failing with SSO login
body: Ever since the v4.2 release, I cannot access the billing settings while logged in with SSO. I keep getting an AUTH-BILL-402 error message in that specific tab. This is blocking us from updating our payment method and I would appreciate your help.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: desktop app stuck on connecting status
body: my desktop app is just stuck showing connecting or indexing forever. no files are syncing at all. i keep seeing the SYNC_STATUS_STUCK message in the logs. can you help me fix this soon please.
resolution: Please start by restarting your CloudDesk client. If the status remains stuck, navigate to Settings, choose Advanced, and select Clear Cache. If that does not resolve the issue, please back up any local changes and perform a fresh reinstall of the application.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing
body: Hello support, a Zap configured with a CloudDesk trigger like New File Uploaded is not firing properly. I noticed error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 during my checks. Could you please look into this whenever you have a chance?
resolution: In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. Check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: desktop sync client sso login fails
body: hi there when i try to log into the sync client using sso the browser redirects me properly but the app just shows login failed DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 thanks for any help
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version, v4.2.1 or newer, and check that your default browser handles SSO redirects correctly. As a temporary workaround, you can also log in via email and password if SSO is not strictly enforced.

subject: need to downgrade my subscription plan
body: hey team on our pro plan here but team size shrunk and we need to downgrade our subscription plan down to the lower tier. thanks for the help
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing for new uploads
body: Good morning. I am setting up our automation workflows today and wanted to mention that our Zapier integration with CloudDesk seems unresponsive. We have a workflow that is supposed to trigger whenever a new file is uploaded to a shared workspace, but it has not been executing all morning despite multiple test files being added by various team members. Our subscription is currently on the free tier, and we rely on this for syncing notifications to our project management tools. Please let us know how to fix this so we can resume our daily operations.
resolution: In Zapier, please re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure that the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events, and verify the expected event in your CloudDesk audit logs.

subject: slack notifications not working
body: hi there we use cloudesk on the free plan and our file share notifications are not showing up in slack. it keeps throwing error SLACK-NOTIFY-500. can you take a look when you have a spare moment
resolution: Please check the Slack integration settings in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app has the proper permissions to post in that channel.

subject: Google SSO domain errors blocking our team
body: We are getting constant 'Domain not allowed' errors when trying to sign in via Google SSO. This is extremely frustrating because we have an important client demo at 5pm today and half our team is locked out. We are receiving error code SSO-GOOGLE-403 consistently across our entire domain. Can you fix this right away?
resolution: This error occurs when a domain has not been explicitly white-listed in your SSO configuration. Please log into the Admin Console, navigate to 'SSO & Identity', and ensure your company domain is added to the 'Allowed Domains' list. Once added, your team should be able to authenticate through Google without further issues.

subject: Seat limit error despite available seats
body: Hello support team, I attempted to add new team members today and received the error message CD-AM-001 stating our seat limit is reached. However, our subscription details clearly show we still have available seats. Thank you so much for your assistance with this matter.
resolution: Please check the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations', as pending invitations still count toward your total seat limit. You can either revoke any old pending invitations to free up space or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Switching from monthly to annual billing
body: We would like to switch our current PRO subscription from monthly to annual billing. Please let us know how to apply the annual discount.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to Admin Console -> Billing -> Subscription Details -> Change Plan. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated automatically.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: The user count on our latest bill does not match the active users in our portal. I see error BILL-INV-001 in the billing logs. This is very annoying to have to manually audit.
resolution: Discrepancies often occur due to the proration period or the billing cycle start date. Please review your invoice's proration details to see if the change occurred mid-cycle. If the numbers still don't match, provide your invoice ID and current user count so we can investigate.

subject: API returning 404 for folder resources
body: We are consistently seeing API-NOTFOUND-404 when querying specific folder IDs that definitely exist in our account. We have verified the base URL and the endpoint structure. Please advise on why these valid IDs are failing.
resolution: Please double-check your API endpoint path and HTTP method against our latest documentation to ensure compatibility with the current version. Also, verify that the API token you are using has the appropriate scope and permissions to access those specific folder resources. If the path is correct, the resource might be restricted to a different user scope.

subject: Customize SSO login page branding
body: We need to add our company logo to the SSO login page. Are there any settings to change the colors or branding on that screen? We need this for a more professional look.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available. Please add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding. We will notify you if this feature becomes available.

subject: Cannot extend audit log retention
body: I need to set our audit logs to 5 years for compliance, but the UI limits me to 12 months. This AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT is a huge blocker for my project. Why is this not available?
resolution: The native retention limit is currently capped at 12 months in the Admin Console. For longer audit history, we suggest using our API or SFTP export to offload your logs to an external SIEM solution.

subject: API requests failing after v4.2 update
body: Since we updated to v4.2 our API integration is broken. Every request is returning a 401 Unauthorized error with the message legacy_token_format (API-AUTH-401-V42). We need this resolved immediately as it is stopping all our automated workflows.
resolution: The API token format was updated in version 4.2. You will need to regenerate all your API tokens from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new tokens to restore service.

subject: Incorrect tax application on invoice
body: So i was looking at my invoice and it seems like the tax rate is wrong, maybe because of my business location or something else idk. anyway, ive been having a long week and just noticed this now. its error BILL-TAX-006 i think. no rush on this, but could you look into it?
resolution: Please verify your company details and tax ID within the Billing Information section of your Admin Console. If everything is correct, send us your legal name and a valid tax exemption certificate so we can perform a manual audit of your account settings.

subject: webhooks failing with connection refused error
body: our automated finance system is not getting webhook events from the admin console anymore. it keeps throwing a connection refused error on our end. please look into this when you can.
resolution: Please verify your webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm that your external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range.

subject: Search results lag in specific workspace
body: When searching for files or folders within one of our specific workspaces, the results take an extremely long time to load or the search spinner runs indefinitely. This issue is isolated to just this workspace rather than our global searches. We would appreciate it if this could be looked into when possible.
resolution: Please investigate if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested folder structures. We advise users to utilize more specific keywords or path-based searches, and suggest optimizing the workspace structure if feasible. You can also report the specific workspace ID to our engineering team for an indexing review.

subject: API data export permission denied error
body: Our admin API key is getting a 403 permission denied error on the /v1/users/{userId}/data/export endpoint. It worked fine before today. Fix when you can.
resolution: Effective immediately, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in Admin Console > API Management.

subject: Users being logged out immediately
body: It is extremely frustrating that our team cannot stay logged into the web app today. Every time we try to access the dashboard, we get a session expired error or are kicked out entirely. We are seeing AUTH-SESSION-401.5 consistently. This needs a fix right away.
resolution: Please have the affected users clear their browser cookies and local storage for cloudesk.com, and verify that their device system time is accurate. Also, ensure there are no strict privacy settings or browser extensions active that might be dropping your session cookies.

subject: S3 data export failing with invalid credentials
body: Our automated tenant-wide data export to AWS S3 is failing with error S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401. This started occurring after the v4.2 upgrade. We have an audit on Friday and need this resolved promptly as it is currently blocking our operations.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated our S3 integration to enforce stricter IAM policy requirements. It is likely your IAM policy is missing the required s3:GetBucketLocation permission. Please update your AWS IAM policy to align with the requirements found in our v4.2 S3 Integration Guide.

subject: Need access to user private workspace for audit
body: Hello, I hope your day is going well. We are currently conducting a compliance review and need to access a specific user's private workspace, but the system blocks us with a 'Privacy Settings Enforced' message. Could you please let us know how we can proceed?
resolution: By default, private workspaces are inaccessible even to administrators for enhanced privacy. An admin can gain temporary access by initiating a 'Workspace Access Request' through Admin Console > Users > [User Profile] > Workspaces. Note that this action generates an audit log entry and requires proper notification or compliance oversight.

subject: Files remaining in trash after 30 days
body: I configured a 30-day retention policy but files in the trash are not being deleted. I can still see items from months ago. Is there something I missed in the settings?
resolution: It is important to note that your data retention policy applies to files that have been 'Permanently Deleted' from the system. Files currently residing in the 'Trash Bin' remain there for user-initiated recovery unless you have specifically configured the policy to purge the trash after a set number of days. Please check your settings under Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention to ensure that specific option is enabled.

subject: Requesting a refund for accidental upgrade
body: Hello, thank you for your help. I think I accidentally clicked the upgrade button while navigating the dashboard. Could you please help me reverse this charge? I am seeing error code BILL-REF-005 when checking my status. Thanks again for your time.
resolution: We can certainly look into this for you, as refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please verify the date of the upgrade and ensure no features from the new plan have been accessed. We will evaluate your request once you provide those details.

subject: Unable to stay logged into the dashboard
body: I am having trouble staying logged into my account today. Every time I sign in, I am almost immediately redirected to the login page with a 'Session Expired' message, showing error code AUTH-SESSION-401.5. It makes navigating the dashboard impossible. I appreciate your help in resolving this.
resolution: It looks like some users are currently experiencing intermittent session termination issues. Please try clearing your browser's cookies and local storage for 'cloudesk.com' to resolve the conflict. Also, please double-check that your device's system time is synced correctly, as that can often cause authentication timeouts.

subject: Terrible download speeds from shared links
body: Why are your download speeds so painfully slow right now? My collaborators cannot download anything from our workspaces without it taking hours. Fix this immediately.
resolution: Please test download speeds using a different browser or network, and check for extensions that might interfere. For very large files, recommend using the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfers.

subject: Workspace is not loading at all
body: My team's workspace has become completely unusable. Every time I try to open our main folder, I get a blank screen or a never-ending spinner for over 30 seconds. We are seeing WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT errors constantly. This is incredibly frustrating to deal with while trying to finish my daily work. Please look into this right away.
resolution: It appears your workspace contains a very high volume of items, which can impact performance. Please try using our search or filter tools to locate specific files instead of loading the entire directory at once. For better long-term stability, we recommend splitting this into several smaller workspaces.

subject: Unable to update billing credit card details
body: Good morning. While attempting to update our organization's payment method in the admin console today, I ran into an issue where the system rejects our new credit card. Even though the card number, expiration date, and CVV have all been triple-checked and verified as correct with our finance department, it keeps throwing error code BILL-PAY-012. Could you please investigate why this is happening so we can keep our subscription active?
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again after 30 minutes. If the issue persists, try using a different card or contact your bank to ensure there are no blocks on transactions with CloudDesk. You may also try contacting us with the full error message for further investigation.

subject: workspace invites not sending out
body: Hi support, when we invite new team members to our workspace the emails arent going through at all and they just stay pending with error EMAIL-005. we have a major client demo at 2pm today and new hires cant access anything please help us right away
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: desktop sync creating fake conflict files
body: desktop sync client keeps flagging normal files as Conflict even tho no one else touched them now we have tons of duplicate files everywhere. getting error SYNC-003. can u fix soon
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus or firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your security software and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your whitelist and ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop preventing dashboard access
body: I am working on integrating your API into our internal systems. While testing our login flow this morning, I noticed that our team members using Google SSO are getting trapped in a constant redirect loop after they finish the authentication on Google's side. We never actually land on the dashboard. I see an error code AUTH-SSO-302.1 popping up in my network logs. I hope you can help me sort this out soon.
resolution: Please clear your browser's cache and cookies for cloudesk.com to resolve the AUTH-SSO-302.1 loop. If the issue persists, try accessing your dashboard in an incognito window or using a different browser. We also suggest verifying your Google SSO configuration within the Admin Console.

subject: Azure SSO login failing with AUTH-SSO-403.2 error

subject: Seat limit reached error while adding team members

subject: Deleted user still visible in workspace sharing dialogs

Alternatively, a workspace owner can explicitly remove them from a share via Workspace Settings > Members. This is normal expected behavior.

resolution: The v4.2 release updated how we handle SSO tokens, so please perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, your SSO administrator may need to review the token lifetime settings in your identity provider. You might also try regenerating the application's client secret in the Admin Console.

This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito or private browser window to rule out extensions.

Please have your administrator re-save the SSO settings in the Admin Console to refresh internal certificates, and ensure your Okta 'Application Sign On URL' is formatted correctly. Finally, please have all users clear their browser cache and cookies.

subject: User Activity report is blank

subject: Audit log export failing for date ranges over 90 days

resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is restricted to a maximum of 90 days. For longer periods, please utilize the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' along with a pagination script to retrieve the full dataset. Alternatively, you can contact support for a manual data pull if direct API access is not feasible for your team.

If you have any trouble setting up a script to handle the pagination, let us know and we can provide guidance.

resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

User count changes often take effect at the start of your next billing cycle, or are calculated based on mid-cycle adjustments. If they are not on the list yet, simply add them first and the option should become available.

resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

resolution: Please verify that the secret token on your receiving service matches the Webhook Secret exactly as shown in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Additionally, ensure your verification algorithm is set to HMAC-SHA256 to match our implementation. Checking these alignment details should resolve the verification error.

subject: User data deletion request pending for long time

The error code shown is USER_DELETE_PENDING. Could you please check on the status of this request? Thank you.
resolution: For a user data deletion request to proceed, the user's status must first be 'Inactive'. If the user is currently active, the deletion will be queued until their status changes. If the user is already inactive and the request is still pending, please check our System Status page for any background job processing issues. If no issues are reported there, please provide the user's email and the deletion request ID so we can investigate further.
