body: We changed a user to guest status and now they are getting error CD-AM-002 upon login. They are completely locked out of their workspace. Please resolve this as it is urgent for their project.
resolution: Guest users are restricted and can only access specific shared workspaces they have been invited to. Please check the user's role in the Admin Console and verify if they have active workspace invitations. If they require full access to the platform, please change their role back to Member or Admin.

subject: Seat Limit Error When Adding Team Members!
body: Hello support, I am trying to add three new IT staff members to our PRO subscription, but the system keeps throwing error CD-AM-001 saying our seat limit is reached. However, our dashboard clearly shows we have five unused seats available. Please fix this discrepancy so we can onboard our staff.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out. Please verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations', as pending invitations count toward your seat limit. You can either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Cannot update company name in console
body: I am attempting to update our company name in the admin console settings, but the field appears to be read-only. I am seeing an error labeled CD-AM-010 when I try to save. Could you please let me know why I cannot edit this information?
resolution: The company name is currently linked to your official subscription and billing records. To change this, you must navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the 'Organization Name' field. Once saved there, the change will automatically reflect in your Company Settings.

subject: Need more detailed user activity reports
body: Our team needs much more granular reporting on specific file downloads and collaboration actions than what is currently available in the basic logs. The current data is insufficient for our internal compliance requirements. How can we get a more detailed view of what our users are doing in the platform?
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding enhanced reporting. Please post your specific use cases to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com so our analytics team can evaluate these requirements for future updates.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card
body: I was just going through our monthly accounting reconciliation process, looking at all our various SaaS subscriptions, and I noticed a transaction that I cannot seem to match. It is a bit confusing because we have multiple departments sharing budget codes. I see BILL-CHG-010 when checking my dashboard. Can you tell me what this charge is for?
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, the date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide full details on the charge. We appreciate your patience while we look into this for you.

subject: API permission denied for data export
body: We are getting an API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED error when calling the user export endpoint. This script has worked fine for months, but now it suddenly fails. Could you please look into this as it is holding up our reporting?
resolution: As of our recent update, the Admin API scope no longer covers data exports. You will need to generate a new API key assigned to the 'Data Steward' role within the Admin Console's API Management section to restore this access.

subject: Issue setting up MFA on mobile
body: I have been with the company for a while now and I really enjoy the features. I was trying to get our team to set up MFA via the mobile app so we are more secure, but when we scan the QR code we get an error, MFA-MOB-002. It seems like the mobile flow is having some trouble, but I just wanted to get this fixed so we can keep our accounts safe. Everything else is working fine.
resolution: There is a known issue with the MFA registration flow within the mobile app at this time. Please have your team members complete the MFA setup process through the CloudDesk web app under Settings and Security. Once configured via the web interface, it will function correctly for both mobile and web logins.

subject: Workspace loading timeout in admin console
body: When I open workspace with many files in admin console, page takes very long time to load and shows blank screen. Many users reporting this issue today.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: GET files content endpoint throwing 500 error
body: Calls to the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint intermittently return a HTTP 500 Internal Server Error for files stored in diverse regions with error API-500. We have an important audit on Friday and this is blocking our work.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Granular notification settings request
body: Hello, we love the platform but find the current notification alerts too broad. We would prefer to have granular control so we can toggle specific alerts like mentions versus general comments. Is there any plan to add this feature?
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding notification preferences. Currently, you can manage general settings in your profile, but we understand the need for more granular control. Please submit your specific notification requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications so our product team can prioritize this in future development.

subject: AUDIT LOG EXPORT IS BROKEN FOR OLDER DATA
body: I am trying to run an audit log export for the past 120 days and it keeps failing with the AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED error. This is unacceptable! I need this data for our internal compliance reporting, so please fix this functionality immediately.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use our API endpoint /v1/audit/export with your desired date parameters. If you have trouble setting up a pagination script for this, let us know.

subject: Request for new workspace file upload webhooks
body: Good afternoon, I am writing to you today regarding our ongoing integration work with the CloudDesk platform. Our development team has been exploring various ways to connect your file-sharing workspace with our internal automated systems. As part of our morning standup today, we discussed how useful it would be to have more automated event triggers. Specifically, we would like to request a new webhook event that triggers upon a new file upload to a specified workspace or folder. We hope this feature can be considered for a future release. Thank you for your time.
resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including desired payload, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements. This helps us assess demand and design.

subject: requesting hardware mfa support
body: our security team is asking for hardware-based mfa like yubikey. we want to keep our account secure but dont see an option for this in our settings. please let us know if this is coming soon.
resolution: We currently support authenticator apps and email verification, but we understand the value of hardware tokens for enterprise security. You can track our progress and register your specific token preferences at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Users are reporting that they are not receiving password reset emails, resulting in error CD-AM-008. This is preventing staff from accessing the workspace. Can you assist with this promptly?
resolution: Please verify that the user's email is correctly listed in the Team Management section and ask them to check their spam folder. You might also need to whitelist no-reply@cloudesk.com. If the email still doesn't arrive, you can manually trigger a reset via the Admin Console.

subject: accidental upgrade charge
body: i got charged for a plan i didnt mean to buy i think i hit the wrong button on the dashboard error code BILL-REF-005 can you help me get my money back thanks
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: API 401 error after v4.2 upgrade
body: Since the v4.2 release, all our automated integrations are failing with 401 Unauthorized errors and the message 'legacy_token_format'. We are receiving error code API-AUTH-401-V42 across our production environment. This is causing significant downtime for our services and requires an immediate fix.
resolution: With the v4.2 update, the API token format has been revised for enhanced security. You must regenerate all current API tokens within the 'API & Integrations' section of your Admin Console. Please update your applications to utilize these newly generated tokens to restore connectivity.

subject: accidental upgrade refund request
body: i upgraded my plan by mistake and want to get a refund for the charge. error code BILL-REF-005 is showing up on the billing page. please let me know if this can be reversed.
resolution: We can certainly look into this for you. Please confirm the exact time of the upgrade and verify that you have not accessed any of the Pro features since the change was made. We will then review your account and let you know if we can process the refund.

subject: Mobile app network error on login
body: Hello, our finance contact is unable to log into the mobile app today. They keep getting a generic network error even though their internet connection is completely stable. Please advise.
resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache or data on Android, or reinstalling the app on iOS, and verify server status on our status page.

subject: Trash Bin retention policy not working
body: The 30 day deletion policy is not working at all. I can still see files in the Trash from months ago and we have a security audit this Friday so this is a major problem. We are seeing error RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED constantly. This needs to be resolved immediately to avoid compliance issues.
resolution: Please verify your retention settings under Admin Console, Security & Compliance, then Data Retention. Note that policies apply to permanently deleted items, while files in the Trash Bin remain until specifically purged. Please ensure the Trash purge setting is configured to clear after your desired time frame.

subject: Files not syncing in desktop app after v42
body: Hello support team, ever since we updated our desktop sync client to v4.2, files modified in the web app are completely failing to appear locally. We are seeing error code SYNC-001 in our diagnostic logs. This is blocking our development team from pulling the latest assets, so we need a prompt resolution.
resolution: Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at your AppData or Library folder. Reinstall the client from the download link in your web app's 'Settings' -> 'Desktop Sync' section.

subject: API response times exceeding 500ms on GET and POST requests
body: Dear support team, specific API endpoints such as GET /files and POST /upload are consistently returning responses in over 500ms, impacting our integrations and causing downstream application delays. This is particularly noticeable for large datasets. Thank you for your continued support and assistance.
resolution: Request specific API call examples (endpoint, request body, timestamps) from the customer. Advise optimizing API calls by using pagination and filtering parameters to reduce the dataset returned. Suggest caching frequently accessed data on their end. Escalate to engineering with provided logs for performance analysis.

subject: Billing authentication error when logging in via SSO
body: Hello, administrators using SSO are encountering authentication errors specifically within the billing section since upgrading to v4.2. Other admin tools function normally. Please advise on how to resolve this payment management issue.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Need direct integration with Microsoft Teams
body: It is honestly quite frustrating that your platform lacks a direct integration with Microsoft Teams. Our entire company operates within Teams and the lack of native support for sharing and collaborating on CloudDesk files is causing a major workflow bottleneck. When can we expect this feature to be available for our enterprise account?
resolution: While we currently allow you to share file links in Microsoft Teams, we do not have a native integration yet. Please add your specific needs to our roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams so our team can evaluate this based on user demand.

subject: desktop app cpu usage is too high
body: hello support the cloudesk desktop sync client is taking up over 50 percent cpu and a lot of memory even when nothing is syncing. its slowing down our computers quite a bit. error PERF-DSK-001. let us know what to do.
resolution: Hi there. This high resource usage can happen if the client gets stuck in a re-indexing loop, which others have also reported today. Please pause syncing from the tray icon, go to Settings -> Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database. Once the reset is complete, resume syncing. If the issue continues, please check for an unusually large number of small files in your synced folders.

subject: deleted user still visible
body: i deleted a user but they still appear in my sharing lists. please remove them so there is no confusion.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as entries in historical share lists until the system purges them. This typically happens within 24-48 hours. Alternatively, a workspace owner can manually remove them from the share dialog in Workspace Settings.

subject: API key returning 401 errors
body: Our existing API key is returning API-AUTH-401.4 errors. It was working yesterday. Please advise.
resolution: Please log into the Admin Console and check the status of your API key under the API Keys section to see if it has been revoked or has expired. If it appears invalid, please generate a new key and update your integration with the new credentials.

subject: Invited user stuck on pending status
body: One of our team members received an invitation on the mobile app and clicked the link, but their status in the Admin Console remains Pending Invitation. They cannot log in yet. Could you please check this when possible?
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set. If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations and send a new one.

subject: search results missing files
body: my searches in the web app are not finding files that i know are there. it seems like the index is not working right. seeing error search-002 frequently today. can you take a look?
resolution: Your search index might be outdated. Please try using a more specific search term in quotes to force a direct match. If that does not work, logging out and back in often triggers an account re-indexing. If you still have trouble, please send us the search terms and the files you expected to see.

subject: Slack notifications not appearing
body: We noticed that our file share notifications are not posting to the Slack channel anymore. Everything was working fine until recently. There is no urgency to fix this, but please let me know what might be causing the SLACK-NOTIFY-500 error when you can.
resolution: Please check the Slack integration configuration in your Admin Console. Ensure the correct workspace and channel are selected, and verify that the CloudDesk Slack app has the required permissions to post messages in that specific channel.

subject: Advanced activity reports needed
body: We require detailed reporting on user file downloads and collaboration actions for our enterprise workspace. The current audit logs are insufficient. Please advise.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting.

subject: New employee cannot log in with password
body: Hello, we recently invited a new staff member to our enterprise workspace, but when they try to log in using their email and password, the system displays an error saying User Not Found with code AUTH-NF-404.1. We have our company-wide orientation scheduled for tomorrow morning so we would greatly appreciate your prompt help in resolving this. Thank you so much for your time and assistance.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Switching our monthly billing to annual
body: Hi team, I am writing to ask if we can switch our current monthly subscription to an annual billing cycle. We want to take advantage of the annual discounts moving forward. There is no rush on this at all, so whenever someone has time to process it would be fine.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: Account suspended - please help
body: Our entire team is currently locked out because our account was suspended due to an overdue invoice. We need this back online immediately to prevent any further revenue loss. Please let me know the fastest way to get this lifted once payment is processed.
resolution: To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance through the Invoices section of the Admin Console. Once the payment is confirmed, your account will automatically be restored within 15 minutes.

subject: Change billing cycle to annual
body: We need to switch our FREE plan subscription to annual billing. We are seeing error BILL-PLAN-004 when trying to update this in the console. Thanks.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: azure ad login failing
body: getting user profile incomplete error when trying to access cloudesk via azure ad. our team has a big audit this friday and this is critical. help us fix this now.
resolution: Please have your Azure AD administrator verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped within your enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. You can find detailed steps in our Azure AD SSO configuration guide.

subject: Seat limit reached error
body: We are receiving the CD-AM-001 error when attempting to add new team members, despite subscription details indicating available seats.
resolution: Hello. Please verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit, so you will need to either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Account access suspended
body: We are locked out of our workspace and seeing a banner about an account suspension. I am getting an error code BILL-SUSP-007 when I check the admin console. I am looking into our invoices right now to see if we missed a payment. Please let me know what we need to do to restore access immediately.
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. Please navigate to the Admin Console, click on Billing, and then Invoices to settle the outstanding balance. Once your payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: User Activity report page is blank
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report but the page loads and stays entirely empty. This is REPORT-001 and it is making it impossible for me to track team usage. It is incredibly frustrating that this one report is not working. Please fix this.
resolution: This behavior is often due to a temporary browser cache conflict. Please try clearing your cache and cookies, or attempt to open the report in a different browser. If the page remains blank, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to pull so we can investigate further.

subject: Workspace invitation emails not reaching new users
body: When we invite new members to join our workspaces, the invitation emails are never delivered to them, resulting in the status staying permanently stuck as 'Pending'. We do not see any bounce-back notifications in our server logs, indicating the issue originates on the platform side. Please look into this matter so our onboarding process is not disrupted.
resolution: Hello. Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains by referring to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Mobile app login network error
body: Hi team, I am testing our integration and noticed the mobile app shows a network error on login despite having a stable connection. Thanks for any help you can provide.
resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache/data (Android) or reinstalling the app (iOS/Android). Verify server status on our status page.

subject: unauthorized sync of local documents folder
body: our executive assistant noticed that the desktop sync client automatically uploaded local files from the Documents folder to a CloudDesk workspace without asking. this seems like a privacy violation and we need to know why it happened immediately.
resolution: The desktop sync client only syncs folders explicitly configured by the user or pre-configured by an admin. Check the sync client settings for 'Synced Folders' and verify no unintended folders were selected. Ensure 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is disabled if not desired. If an admin-mandated sync, contact your internal IT.

subject: SSO session expired errors in web app
body: Our team is being logged out repeatedly with SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 since this morning. Please fix this immediately as our executive staff cannot access anything.
resolution: Our recent v4.2 update changed some SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta or Azure AD users, please verify that your IdP application settings for CloudDesk have a proper Refresh Token policy enabled for a reasonable duration of 8 to 24 hours to stop premature session expiration.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: Users from our secondary domain can't log in through Google SSO and get blocked. It is pretty annoying, but we can wait for a fix.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's SSO & Identity settings for Google SSO, check the Allowed Domains list. Please add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: Critical Okta SSO failure before company audit
body: Hello CloudDesk team, our entire organization relies on Okta SSO, but since the v4.2 release, all users are redirected back to the login page with an invalid token format error. Email and password authentication works fine, but our policy requires SSO. We have a major company audit starting on Friday morning and cannot have users logging in manually. Please help us resolve this urgently.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console, ensuring the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration'.

subject: Need deeper user activity and file download reports
body: Good afternoon, I am checking in regarding our free account billing and workspace management tools. Our finance team requires much more detailed reports on user activity, specifically tracking file downloads, views, and granular collaboration events that go well beyond the basic audit logs. It is quite annoying that this data is hidden. There is no rush on this, but we would like an update eventually.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: API requests return 401 Unauthorized
body: my API calls are constantly failing with 401 Unauthorized errors and API-AUTH-401 code. this is blocking my work and i need it fixed now! why is my token being rejected?
resolution: Your token may have become invalid or expired. Please generate a fresh API token within the Admin Console's API & Integrations section and ensure it is passed correctly in your request headers.

subject: sso login broken on desktop sync
body: browser redirects during sso login but the app just shows login failed and error code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. this is blocking our team right now and we need it fixed immediately.
resolution: Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version v4.2.1 or newer. Check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects properly. As a workaround in the meantime, users can log in via email and password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: Mobile app file preview failure
body: Previews are failing with MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL.
resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version. Check the user's device storage and network connection. Advise clearing the mobile app's cache (via device settings). For very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: Account is locked out
body: I have been locked out of my account after trying to log in a few times. This is unacceptable and i need to get back into my files now. Please fix this account lock immediately!
resolution: I understand your frustration with the login lockout. You can wait 15 minutes for the system to automatically unlock your access, or your company administrator can manually unlock your account. They can do this for you via the Admin Console under the Manage User section.

subject: Assigned tickets missing from web view
body: Our helpdesk agents are reporting that assigned tickets are not showing up in their My Assigned Tickets dashboard. This is preventing them from responding to our users effectively. We keep seeing HELPDESK-007 when trying to load the view. Please help us resolve this quickly.
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions in our web app. Have the agent clear their browser cache and cookies before logging back in. Should that fail, an administrator can trigger a refresh by re-assigning the ticket to a different agent and then back to the original assignee.

subject: MFA registration failing with MFA-MOB-002
body: hey guys MFA-MOB-002 keeps popping up when scanning the QR code in the mobile app. users cant finish setting up google authenticator. whenever you get a chance let me know.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Public sharing link expiration extension request
body: We need to set our public sharing links to never expire or last much longer for our company audit on Friday. What is the procedure for extending these expiration dates?
resolution: Hello. The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we do not plan to offer 'never expire' options, please provide your specific use cases at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration, and for permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: PASSWORD RESET EMAIL NOT ARRIVING AT ALL
body: WE ARE TRYING TO TEST OUR API INTEGRATION AND ADMIN TOOLS BUT PASSWORD RESET EMAILS ARE NEVER RECEIVED. WE CHECKED SPAM FOLDERS AND OTHER EMAILS FROM CLOUDESK COME THROUGH FINE. FIX THIS NOW.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and check if their domain is configured with an approved email sender list. If necessary, advise your IT team to add 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to their mail allowlist, or you can manually trigger a password reset directly from the Admin Console.

subject: File preview failing
body: the previewer in the web app is just showing a blank screen for some files. we see PREVIEW-006 when it hangs. its not a big deal since we can download, but it is annoying.
resolution: This is often due to a temporary hiccup in our rendering service or a browser-side conflict. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies first, or test this in an incognito window to rule out extension interference. If the issue persists, ensure the specific file is not password-protected.

subject: Unrecognized charge on my statement
body: I see a charge on my credit card that I don't recognize. I need to reconcile this before our payroll run tomorrow. Can you tell me what this is for? I saw a code BILL-CHG-010.
resolution: To look into this for you, could you please provide the exact amount, the date of the charge, and the last four digits of the card used? I will then cross-reference this against our billing records to explain the transaction.

subject: Regarding Hardware MFA support
body: We would like to know if CloudDesk plans to support hardware-based MFA tokens like YubiKey in future. Our company security policy is asking for this kind of authentication method. We prefer not to use only software MFA. It is good if this feature could be available. No rush for now.
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports multi-factor authentication through authenticator apps and email verification. We understand the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. You can add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize new security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Payment Failed status in billing
body: Our sub renewal failed due to declined card. We got email and see Payment Failed status in admin console. Need this fixed quick so account isnt blocked.
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: URGENT SSO NOT WORKING AUTH-SSO-401.1
body: Hi there, I am the lead dev here and we have been using your system for ages now, but all of a sudden our morning is ruined because no one can sign in via Okta. It just shows error AUTH-SSO-401.1 every time. We are supposed to be onboarding 50 new people today and this is a total disaster. Please fix this immediately, we are completely blocked and losing valuable work time.
resolution: We apologize for the disruption. Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata, as this is required due to the change in SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: SSO login page not showing custom branding
body: When our users are redirected to the SSO login page, the custom company logo and background image we uploaded are not appearing. It's showing the default CloudDesk branding instead. This isn't urgent, but we'd appreciate it if you could let us know how to fix this at your convenience. Thank you!
resolution: Thank you for reaching out! To resolve the branding issue, please have your administrator go to the 'SSO & Branding' section in the Admin Console. There, verify that your custom logo and background image assets are correctly uploaded and saved. After confirming, please advise your users to clear their browser cache, as this often resolves display issues with updated branding.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: Hello support team, our pro account was accidentally upgraded to an unintended tier yesterday. We would love some assistance with getting a prorated refund or a full refund for this recent change if possible. Thank you so much for your time and help.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: GDPR export missing user comments
body: Hello, I just ran a GDPR data export but noticed some of the comments my user made on tasks are missing. It looks like I am hitting the GDPR_EXPORT_INCOMPLETE_COMMENTS issue. Could you help me make sure we get the full data set?
resolution: The automated GDPR export primarily captures core file and profile information. To retrieve specific comments, you will need to navigate to the 'Activity' tab on those particular files or tasks and use the 'Export Activity Log' function to gather that metadata.

subject: How to update PO number for billing
body: I need to add a purchase order number to our upcoming invoices. Every time I try to find the setting I see the error code BILL-PO-008 and get nowhere. Could you point me to where I can input this information? I would appreciate a quick response so we can stay on top of our accounting.
resolution: You can update your PO number by navigating to the 'Admin Console', selecting 'Billing', and then clicking 'Billing Information'. Simply enter the new number in the 'Purchase Order Number' field and save. Please note that this will apply to all future invoices but cannot be changed for ones already generated.

subject: invalid credit card error
body: We are trying to add a new card for billing but the system returns BILL-PAY-012 constantly. I have verified the numbers are correct. This is blocking our account setup, so please help.
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try the update again after 30 minutes. If the error persists, consider using a different card or contacting your bank to ensure they aren't blocking transactions from CloudDesk.

subject: requesting dark mode
body: my team is complaining about eye strain because the app is so bright. we really need a dark mode option to make this usable in our office. are you guys planning on adding this soon?
resolution: Thank you for your feature request! Dark Mode for the CloudDesk web app is a popular suggestion, though we do not have it available yet. Please vote for this feature on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/dark-mode to help us prioritize it.

subject: sso login page missing our custom branding
body: when our users hit the sso login page our custom company logo and background image arent showing up at all. its just showing standard cloudesk stuff which looks unprofessional. error code SSO-UI-200.2 popped up for one of us. no huge rush to fix this since it still works just looks ugly
resolution: Guide the admin to the 'SSO & Branding' section in the Admin Console. Check if the custom branding assets (logo, background) are uploaded and saved correctly. Advise clearing browser cache for affected users.

subject: Seat limit reached error on Pro plan
body: Getting error CD-AM-001 when trying to add users even though we have open seats. Please resolve.
resolution: Please verify the 'Pending Invitations' count under 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit, so you will need to either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase your seat capacity.

subject: cant find where to put company logo on sso page
body: Hi there, I am trying to customize our SSO login page with our company logo and branding colors for a more cohesive experience but I cant find the setting anywhere in the admin console. It is quite frustrating that this isnt straightforward. Please let me know how to update this branding as soon as possible.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available in the platform. We recognize this as a valuable feature and invite you to add your vote and specific requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding.

subject: Unrecognized charge on billing statement
body: Hello, thank you for your continued assistance. We noticed an unexpected charge on our credit card statement from CloudDesk that we cannot reconcile. Could you please help us investigate this as soon as possible so we can close our books?
resolution: To help us investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. Once we have those details, our billing team will cross-reference your account history.

subject: Okta login error after recent platform update
body: Hello, our team cannot log into CloudDesk today since the v4.2 platform update. Everyone trying to use Okta SSO gets kicked right back to the login page with an Invalid Token Format error. Email and password logins work fine, but our company policy requires SSO. Please help us fix this promptly so our staff can get back to work.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console, ensuring the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: critical sso login failure after update
body: all our users are locked out of the system after the update. they are getting invalid sso token error sso_token_format_401. this is a major issue for our production team. please help as soon as possible.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token format, which requires a quick re-configuration on your end. Please log into your Admin Console and either re-download the updated SAML metadata or regenerate your OIDC client secret to restore access.

subject: Accidental upgrade refund
body: We accidentally clicked upgrade on our account and were charged. I need to get this refunded asap because it is blocking our budget work. Getting code BILL-REF-005. Can you help?
resolution: We handle refund requests for accidental upgrades on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date of the upgrade and confirm that no features from the new plan have been utilized. We will review your account status to determine eligibility.

subject: wrong names in workspace activity log
body: hey we noticed some file edited and file moved actions are showing up under our admin name even when standard team members did them it gave us error code audit-004 today no rush at all just wanted to let you know
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct and our team is working on a fix. For accurate audit reporting in the meantime, please cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: New user login error AUTH-NF-404.1 before the big meeting
body: Hi there hope your day is going well. So we just hired a new assistant named sarah and shes trying to get into the system today before our big client demo at 5pm today. She keeps getting a weird auth nf 404.1 error when trying to use her password even though i just invited her this morning. It seems a bunch of folks in our department are hitting this snag right now too. Can someone take a quick look so we arent stuck during the presentation.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Seat limit reached error incorrectly blocking new users
body: We are attempting to add new team members to our account today, but the system keeps throwing the error code CD-AM-001 with the message 'Seat limit reached'. However, our subscription details clearly show we have several available seats remaining. Please resolve this promptly.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: invite emails not being sent, EMAIL-005
body: my team is trying to invite new users but no one is getting the emails. the status just says pending. we have a project kickoff tomorrow and need these people added asap. i keep seeing email-005 in our logs.
resolution: Please start by having your invitees check their spam and junk mail folders. Additionally, ensure your domain's SPF and DKIM records are correctly configured to authorize our sending domains. You can find the required DNS entries in our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide; if the issue remains, please send us the affected email addresses for further investigation.

subject: Critical billing error during SSO login
body: We are encountering an AUTH-BILL-402 payment processing error specifically in the billing section since the v4.2 release. We have a major financial audit on Friday and cannot update our payment methods. I need this resolved immediately.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Desktop client SSO login failed
body: Our users are stuck unable to sign into the desktop app via SSO. The browser redirects but the app shows a generic login failure. We have a major audit this Friday and need this fixed. Error code is DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. Any advice?
resolution: Please update your desktop sync client to version 4.2.1 or higher to resolve the SSO handshake issue. Ensure your default browser is configured correctly for redirects, or use the email login as a temporary workaround until the client is updated.

subject: Desktop sync not updating files after v4.2 update
body: Since upgrading to v4.2, my desktop sync client is not picking up new changes made in the web app. I have confirmed that the web and mobile interfaces are current, but the desktop application shows no updates. This is blocking our team's workflow and I see error SYNC-001 in the logs. Could you please provide a fix as soon as possible?
resolution: It appears there is a conflict following the v4.2 update. Please uninstall your current sync client and clear the local sync cache found in your AppData or Library folder depending on your OS. After clearing the cache, please download and install the latest version directly from the Settings menu in your web app.

subject: Account suspended error
body: My team cant log in today and we see a banner saying Account Suspended. I think we missed a payment but I need this fixed now. We are totally blocked. The error code is BILL-SUSP-007. Please help asap.
resolution: Your account was automatically suspended due to an overdue payment. Please navigate to the Billing section of your Admin Console to settle the outstanding invoice. Once the payment clears, your access will be restored within 15 minutes.

subject: Blank user activity report in admin console
body: As I was sitting down with my colleague Marcus from accounting, who was telling me all about his weekend hiking trip in the mountains near the regional park, I decided to pull up our administrative dashboard. While reviewing our monthly compliance documents and checking the printer toner levels, I navigated to the reporting section. When an administrator tries to access the 'User Activity' report in the admin console, the report page loads but no data is displayed, remaining completely blank. Other reports work fine.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Request for permanent public link expiration
body: THE CURRENT MAXIMUM EXPIRATION FOR PUBLIC LINKS IS ABSOLUTELY INSUFFICIENT FOR OUR WORKFLOW! WE NEED THE ABILITY TO SET LINKS TO NEVER EXPIRE OR AT LEAST EXTEND THE LIMITS SIGNIFICANTLY. THIS IS BLOCKING OUR ABILITY TO SHARE RESOURCES EFFECTIVELY. PLEASE ADDRESS THIS AT YOUR EARLIEST CONVENIENCE.
resolution: Our current expiration limits are in place to align with modern security best practices. While we cannot offer 'never expire' links, we are open to feedback regarding extending maximum durations. Please submit your specific use case to our roadmap page so our product team can review it.

subject: Cannot update Company Name in console
body: i am trying to change our company name in the admin console but the field is read only. i see the code CD-AM-010. can you help me update this.
resolution: The 'Company Name' field is synchronized with your subscription billing data, which is why it appears as read-only. To update it, please navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and change the 'Organization Name' field. This will automatically update your Company Settings.

subject: app crashes when uploading large files
body: hi, ive been trying to upload some big videos from my phone using the mobile app and the whole thing just crashes out of nowhere with no error message at all. smaller files work fine though. its happening on all our devices and i want it fixed soon please. error code CRASH-MOB-001 showed up once.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Custom SSO login branding not displaying
body: When our employees are redirected to the SSO login page, the custom company logo and background image are not appearing, showing default CloudDesk branding instead. This is error code SSO-UI-200.2. No major rush on this since functionality is intact, but we would like it corrected when convenient.
resolution: Hello. Please navigate to the 'SSO & Branding' section in your Admin Console to check if the custom branding assets, including your logo and background, are uploaded and saved correctly. Additionally, advise affected users to clear their browser cache.

subject: Invoice user count doesnt match active users
body: Hello team, looking at our latest pro invoice we noticed that the billable user count doesnt match our actual active users in CloudDesk. We are seeing error code BILL-INV-001 on the statement. Could someone take a look when you have a moment.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: getting api-500 errors on file content downloads
body: hey team, we keep getting api-500 errors when hitting the get /files/{id}/content endpoint, specifically for some of our international nodes. it is breaking our sync routine right now. please look into this quickly.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Missing comments in GDPR export
body: The GDPR export package is missing user comments. We received the error code GDPR_EXPORT_INCOMPLETE_COMMENTS. Please look into this.
resolution: The GDPR export currently covers files and profile data but excludes comments, which are stored as activity metadata. You can export those by navigating to the specific file and using the 'Export Activity Log' option. We apologize for the inconvenience.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card
body: I am reviewing our company finances and found a charge from CloudDesk that I cannot reconcile with our current subscription. I am seeing an BILL-CHG-010 reference in our records. Could you please clarify what this transaction is for?
resolution: To help us investigate this, please provide the exact amount, the transaction date, and the last four digits of the credit card used. Once we have that information, we can cross-reference it against your billing history and provide a full explanation for the charge.

subject: Unrecognized CloudDesk charge on card statement
body: Hi there, I noticed a charge on my credit card statement from CloudDesk for $19.99 on October 26th that I don't recognize. My account is a FREE plan, and I'm a developer integrating your API, so I'm not expecting any charges. This is critical for our audit on Friday. We received error code BILL-CHG-010. Could you please help me understand this charge quickly?
resolution: To investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this information with your account's billing history immediately to provide you with a detailed explanation.

subject: Billing api data inconsistencies
body: Hi there, I noticed some odd data in our usage reports since the v4.2 update. The API-BILL-401 error is showing up and the numbers dont match what I see in the Admin Console. Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 has updated how certain usage metrics are aggregated. Please ensure your queries are using the correct date range and parameters specified in the v4.2 API documentation. If the data remains inconsistent, please send us the exact API query and a screenshot of the conflicting report for further investigation.

subject: Repeated session expiry
body: Hi there, users are getting kicked out of the web app immediately after login. It shows a Session Expired message or they just can not reach the dashboard. We keep getting AUTH-SESSION-401.5. Could you check if something is wrong on your end?
resolution: This usually relates to browser cookie conflicts. Please clear your cookies and local storage for cloudesk.com, and double-check that your system time is correctly synchronized.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop blocking access
body: This is extremely frustrating! Every time our users try logging in via Google SSO, they get trapped in an endless redirect loop and never reach the dashboard. We are seeing error AUTH-SSO-302.1 and a bunch of other teams are dealing with this authentication mess right now too. We have a major client demo at 5 PM today and nobody can access their files!
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Okta SSO user attribute mismatch error
body: Hello, we are encountering SSO-OKTA-403 errors when users try to log into CloudDesk via Okta on our PRO plan. It says attribute mismatch after redirection. Please help us resolve this promptly.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, verify that the email, firstName, and lastName attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Ensure that email is set as the unique identifier.

subject: User Activity report not loading
body: I am trying to run the User Activity report, but the page just stays blank. I have been getting error REPORT-001 all morning. It is not a major blocker, but I would appreciate if you could look into it.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no extensions are interfering, and let us know the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Hello support team, I requested a password reset on our free plan account earlier today, but the email never arrived. I have thoroughly checked our spam and junk folders, and other standard notifications from CloudDesk are coming through normally. Could you please look into why this might be happening?
resolution: We have verified the user's email address in the Admin Console. Please check if your domain is configured with an approved email sender list, and if so, advise adding no-reply@cloudesk.com to your allowlist. I have also manually triggered a password reset for this account from our end so you can regain access promptly.

subject: Custom annual billing and invoicing request
body: We need annual invoicing instead of credit card payments. Please provide a custom billing arrangement and volume discount.
resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or via the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website. They will be happy to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on GET files endpoint
body: Hello, our developers are seeing API-500 errors intermittently when calling the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint for files in distributed regions. It happens a few times an hour. Please let us know if there is a known patch.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: S3 export failing after v4.2 update
body: My automated S3 data export is broken and returning S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401 since the v4.2 update! My AWS credentials have not changed at all, so this is definitely on your end. I need this working immediately as our data pipeline is completely blocked. Please fix this promptly.
resolution: The v4.2 release requires stricter IAM policy permissions for S3 integrations. Please ensure your AWS IAM policy includes the necessary 's3:GetBucketLocation' permission. You can find the updated policy requirements in our v4.2 S3 Integration Guide.

subject: Mobile app preview failing for docs and images
body: Hello, my name is Marcus from IT. On our mobile app, when we try to preview PDF files or DOCX and images, it takes very long or gives error MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL. This is very frustrating for users on the go. No big urgency, but please check when possible.
resolution: Hello Marcus. Please ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version and check the device storage and network connection. We advise clearing the mobile app cache via device settings. For very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: Unable to add team members due to seat error
body: I am trying to add new staff but I keep getting a 'Seat limit reached' error, which is incorrect because we have plenty of seats left. We are seeing code CD-AM-001 every time we try. This needs to be resolved so we can get our team onboarded.
resolution: Please check your pending invitations under Admin Console > Team Management. Unaccepted invitations still count toward your seat limit. You can revoke those old pending requests to free up space or upgrade your plan to increase your capacity.

subject: Role creation error regarding existing names
body: Dear support, as an IT administrator managing our company policies and various workspaces, I frequently review our access controls alongside our security team while auditing permissions. Today, while attempting to create a new custom role, I receive an error stating Role name already exists even though the name appears completely unique. There is no major rush for this, but please look into it when convenient.
resolution: Role names are case-insensitive and leading/trailing spaces are trimmed. There might be an existing role with a similar name or one that differs only by capitalization. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Roles' thoroughly for any roles that might conflict.

subject: password reset email not arriving error CD-AM-008
body: Hello i am trying to reset my password on the web app because I forgot it. However the reset link is not coming to my inbox or spam folder. This is error CD-AM-008 and it is blocking my work completely. Could you please help me fix this right away thanks so much.
resolution: First, confirm your email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Please also check your spam and junk folders carefully. If you still cannot locate the email, try whitelisting 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an administrator can force a password reset for you directly via the Admin Console.

subject: GET files endpoint returning intermittent 500 errors
body: Hi team, our developers keep getting random API-500 internal server errors when hitting GET /files/{id}/content today especially for files located in overseas regions. Its breaking our workflow right now and we really need this fixed quickly.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are also investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Desktop client uploaded local folder without consent
body: Good morning, thank you for your ongoing support. Our enterprise executive team discovered that the desktop sync client automatically uploaded our local Documents folder without any explicit permission. We have an executive board meeting demo at 5 PM today and cannot have unvetted files syncing. Please assist us immediately to resolve this privacy issue.
resolution: The desktop sync client only syncs folders explicitly configured by the user or pre-configured by an admin. Check the sync client settings for 'Synced Folders' and verify no unintended folders were selected. Ensure 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is disabled if not desired. If an admin-mandated sync, contact your internal IT.

subject: Search results are missing known documents
body: Hello. When I search keywords in the web app, files are not showing up at all. This is getting annoying. Please advise.
resolution: This can sometimes be due to an outdated search index. Please try performing a more specific search (e.g., exact phrase in quotes). If the issue persists, log out and log back in, which can trigger a re-indexing for your account. If still unresolved, provide specific search terms and expected results for investigation.

subject: Critical: Invalid SSO Token error breaking all logins after v4.2
body: Ever since the v4.2 update rolled out, none of our users can log in via Okta. Everyone is getting an Invalid SSO Token error with code SSO_TOKEN_FORMAT_401. This is completely blocking our entire engineering team and affecting all our active tenants right now. We need an immediate fix for this authentication failure.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Admins must re-configure their SSO integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Refer to the v4.2 release notes for detailed steps.

subject: Severe collaborative editing lag in documents
body: COLLAB_LAG IS RUINING OUR WORK! There is a multi-second delay when typing together and we have a major stakeholder demo at 5pm today. Fix this ASAP!
resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and applications to free up memory, and clearing the browser cache for all users experiencing the delay.

subject: Okta SSO logins failing with invalid token format error
body: Hello, ever since the recent v4.2 update, our enterprise users using Okta SSO are blocked from logging in and receive an invalid token format error. This is impacting our workspace operations and we would appreciate prompt assistance.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Unable to remove workspace user
body: I am trying to delete a user from our workspace but the system prevents it, stating they are an owner. I am encountering error CD-AM-014. Please advise on how to proceed.
resolution: You cannot remove a user who currently owns the workspace. Please go to Admin Console > Workspaces, select the workspace, and use the Transfer Ownership option to assign it to someone else first.

subject: mobile app network error
body: keeps saying network error on the mobile app even though my wifi is completely fine right now. getting error MOBILE-NET-500.1 every time i try to open it on my phone. hope this gets sorted out eventually.
resolution: Please try force closing the application and checking for any available updates in your app store. If the problem continues, clearing your app cache on Android or reinstalling the app on iOS or Android should resolve it. You can also monitor our official status page to verify current server health.

subject: Sync failures after v4.2 update
body: My team is suffering from major sync issues since the v4.2 update. Files edited in the web interface are not appearing on the desktop, and we are seeing SYNC-001 errors everywhere. We have an audit deadline this Friday and this is completely halting our progress. This needs to be resolved immediately as it is impacting our core revenue operations.
resolution: We apologize for the disruption caused by the latest update. Please uninstall your current client and clear the local sync cache found in your AppData or Library folder. After clearing the cache, reinstall the client using the download link provided in your web app settings.

subject: requesting dark mode for web app
body: hi team, our office staff is complaining about eye strain during prolonged use in low light. we would love a dark mode option for the web app whenever possible. no big rush on this.
resolution: Thank you for your feature request! Dark Mode for the CloudDesk web app is a popular suggestion. We currently do not have a dark mode available. Please vote for this feature on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/dark-mode to help us prioritize it.

subject: Helpdesk tickets not appearing for assigned agent
body: Our support team is having trouble seeing tickets assigned to them in the desktop sync client. Other agents can see them, but they remain hidden for the assigned staff. We are seeing error HELPDESK-007 repeatedly today. Could you please provide some assistance with this?
resolution: This is likely a caching issue with agent permissions. Please ask the affected agent to clear their browser cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If the issue persists, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to another agent and then back to the original person to reset the visibility.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: I noticed a charge on our recent bill that seems to be from an accidental plan upgrade. I did not intend to move us to the Pro plan, and we have not actually used any of the premium features. Could you please process a refund for this error BILL-REF-005? Thank you so much for your help with this matter.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility once we receive those details.

subject: Need offline document editing in mobile app
body: Why can't we edit documents offline in the mobile app yet? It is extremely frustrating when trying to work on the go without an internet connection, and changes should just sync later. Please add this feature already.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: Incorrect role display in admin console
body: Hello finance team. I was checking the users and permissions section on our pro plan admin console today and noticed that a few staff members are showing up with the wrong roles listed, such as contributor instead of manager. Their actual workspace access seems fine when they log in, but the dashboard text is off and we are seeing code UI-ADMIN-003. No rush on this since permissions work, but whenever you have a chance to look it would be great.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug affecting the admin console, and the actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix for error UI-ADMIN-003 will be released in the next patch.

subject: api returning 429 too many requests errors
body: our automated scripts are hitting api-rate-429 intermittently during peak hours. its not causing any major downtime right now since it recovers, but wanted to see if we should adjust anything on our end
resolution: Implement exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client. Additionally, review your application's API usage patterns and consider optimizing calls or requesting a rate limit increase via support if justified by legitimate use cases.

subject: Exporting audit logs exceeding 90 days fails
body: I am trying to run an audit for the last four months, but the system keeps throwing the error AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. It is very frustrating that I cannot pull this data directly from the console. I need this to be resolved so I can manage our compliance reporting. Please advise on how to proceed.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days due to performance constraints. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script. If you are unable to use the API, please contact our team for a manual data pull.

subject: Cant add new team members
body: Hey there. I keep getting a Seat limit reached error when adding users even though the subscription says we have space. Getting CD-AM-001 error. Can you help me fix this soon?
resolution: It looks like you have pending invitations that are counting against your total seat limit. Please check the Pending Invitations tab in your Team Management console to see if you can revoke any unused invites. Alternatively, you may choose to upgrade your subscription to increase your capacity.

subject: API endpoints returning 503 errors
body: Our integration is failing with API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 constantly. This is a critical situation as it is impacting our live production dashboard. We need a resolution immediately to restore service for our users.
resolution: Please check the 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header to ensure you aren't exceeding your API limits. We recommend implementing exponential backoff for your retries to handle peak traffic. If you are still seeing these errors after adjusting your request volume, please let us know so we can investigate further.

subject: Admin Console access redirected to user dashboard ADMIN-AUTH-403.3
body: When attempting to access the Admin Console through our API integration setup, I am redirected to the standard user dashboard or receive ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. Please look into this normal priority request.
resolution: Hello. To resolve this issue, please confirm the user's role in the Admin Console by going to 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Roles'. Ensure they have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned, and if not, update their role accordingly.

subject: Slow download speeds for shared files
body: We are experiencing consistently slow download speeds when our team retrieves files from shared links, marked with error code DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW. Our internal network is quite fast, so this seems to be an issue on the platform side. We would appreciate it if you could investigate this behavior.
resolution: I am sorry for the inconvenience with your transfer speeds. Please try testing with a different browser or network to rule out local interference, and ensure you are not using extensions that might throttle bandwidth. For the most robust experience with large files, I recommend using our Desktop Sync client.

subject: Document previews showing blank screen in web app
body: When attempting to preview PDF and PPTX files directly inside the web app, the preview viewer displays a blank page or spins indefinitely. Downloading the file works fine. There is no rush on this issue.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Missing entries in audit log
body: We have noticed unusual login patterns but cannot find them in the Login Activity logs. Are these being tracked under error code AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN? We need to verify these attempts urgently.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new locations are recorded in the Security Events log instead of the Login Activity log. You can access this information by navigating to Admin Console, then Security & Compliance, and finally Security Events. Additionally, please enable Login Anomaly Detection for automatic notification.

subject: Authentication errors after recent version update
body: Greetings. As a long-standing partner providing external contractor services, we frequently interface with your platform while coordinating with various project stakeholders across multiple time zones. Recently, after upgrading our environments to v4.2, our existing API tokens that worked previously now return 401 Unauthorized with legacy_token_format error. This is affecting our deployment pipelines so prompt assistance is requested.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Accidental enterprise plan upgrade billing inquiry
body: Dear CloudDesk team, we recently had an accidental upgrade on our enterprise tier due to a misclick by one of our managers. We are writing to request a refund for the prorated difference since it was very recent. We truly appreciate your great platform and assistance with this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Helpdesk tickets not appearing in assigned agents view
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. We are currently seeing this happen across our enterprise workspace. Could you please take a look when you have a moment? Thank you so much for your help.
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: API workspace sharing returns 403 Forbidden
body: API calls to share a workspace using POST /workspaces/{id}/share are returning a HTTP 403 Forbidden error. The API key user has a Manager role and sufficient global permissions. We would like this investigated soon.
resolution: Ensure that the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled in your settings. Additionally, verify that the user associated with the API key is a direct member of the workspace being shared rather than relying on group membership.

subject: Incorrect roles displayed in admin console
body: I noticed that some of our team members show the wrong roles in the admin dashboard. For example, it says contributor instead of manager. The permissions seem to work fine, but the UI is confusing. Error is UI-ADMIN-003.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and does not affect actual permissions. To refresh the display, navigate to the user's profile in the console, change their role to something else, save, and then change it back to the original role. A permanent fix is coming in our next patch.

subject: Custom SSO branding not appearing
body: hey, the logo and background we set for our login page arent showing up at all. its just showing the default branding. its really weird and showing error sso-ui-200.2 for some users. hope you can help thanks
resolution: Please check your SSO & Branding settings in the Admin Console to ensure all assets are saved correctly. It is also recommended to clear your browser cache, as this often resolves the display issue with cached assets.

subject: Okta login failing after v4.2 update
body: Our entire team is currently blocked from accessing CloudDesk through Okta. Every user is seeing an 'Invalid SSO token format' error. Please investigate this immediately as it is stopping all work. We need a resolution as soon as possible.
resolution: Due to the SSO token format change in v4.2, you need to update your configuration. Please re-upload your IDP metadata file within the CloudDesk Admin Console to restore access. This should resolve the error AUTH-SSO-401.1 immediately.

subject: NEED PDF INVOICE FORMAT IN ADMIN CONSOLE NOW

resolution: Hello. We apologize for the inconvenience with your invoice formats. PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Lag when multiple users edit office documents

resolution: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Please check network latency for all collaborators involved and advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs or applications, verifying if the issue persists if fewer users are editing, and clearing browser cache for all users.

subject: Okta login completely broken after v42 update

resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: Slow download speeds on shared public files

This occurs despite having robust internet connections on our end. Error code DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW was observed during our internal testing this morning. Please let us know how to optimize this.
resolution: Test download speeds using a different browser or network. Advise checking browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager if available or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Verify server region for the workspace.

subject: gdpr data export missing file comments
