resolution: The GDPR data export primarily covers files, folders, and direct user profile data. Comments on files and tasks are stored as activity metadata. To export comments, navigate to the specific file or task, open the activity tab, and use the export activity log option for that item. There is no single bulk export for all user comments across the platform.

subject: Webhook signature failures
body: Our production integration is down because your webhooks are failing with HMAC verification errors. We need this fixed ASAP as it is breaking our sync process. Is something wrong with the signature signing?
resolution: Please double-check that the secret token on your receiving server exactly matches the Webhook Secret found in your CloudDesk Admin Console. You must also ensure that your verification logic uses the HMAC-SHA256 algorithm to match our signature format. Verifying these two components should clear the 403 errors and resume your service.

subject: user activity report is completely blank help

resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop blocking demo

resolution: Please instruct the users to clear their browser cache and cookies for cloudesk.com. If the issue persists, try an incognito window or a different browser while we review your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

resolution: This intermittent issue is related to distributed storage retrieval. We recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client while we work on a permanent fix. We are actively investigating and will deploy a resolution in an upcoming hotfix.

resolution: The v4.2 release included an update to the SSO token format which can cause session issues with billing pages. We suggest logging out and signing back in using your direct email and password if possible. Clearing your browser cookies should also help, and we are working on a fix for this SSO integration.

subject: Large file upload timeout

resolution: Please advise the customer to check their internet connection speed and try a wired connection if they are on Wi-Fi. For files over 500MB, we strongly recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads, as it natively supports resumable transfers.

subject: azure ad login failing urgently

resolution: It looks like your Azure AD claim mapping needs an adjustment. Please have your Azure administrator verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are properly mapped to the CloudDesk application settings in Azure. You can find the step-by-step instructions in our Azure AD SSO configuration guide.

subject: API calls failing with 401 unauthorized

resolution: Please log into the Admin Console and check the 'API Keys' section to verify the status of your current key. It is possible the key has expired or was revoked during a recent update. If the key is invalid, simply regenerate a new one and update your application settings to restore connectivity.

subject: Unable to export audit logs older than 90 days

I keep seeing the code AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED when I try to pull the data. Is there a way to get this information? Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export feature is indeed limited to a 90-day window. For longer periods, you can use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' to pull the data. Please let me know if you need assistance with setting up a pagination script for this API call.

subject: Issues logging into mobile app with mfa

resolution: Please ensure your phone's time settings are synchronized automatically with the network. If the error continues to appear, please log into the web app's security settings to reset your MFA configuration.

subject: API tokens broken returning 401 after v42

resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console, and then update your external applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Mobile app MFA setup failing, error MFA-MOB-002

resolution: Thank you for reporting this issue. The 'Failed to register MFA device' error, often seen as MFA-MOB-002 on the mobile app, is a known issue. We recommend that your users complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app instead. They can do this by going to 'Settings' > 'Security' > 'Multi-Factor Authentication'. Once MFA is configured through the web app, it will function correctly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Okta login error User attribute mismatch
body: We are getting error SSO-OKTA-403 when trying to log in. We have a major demo at 5pm today and this is a disaster. Please look into this right now.
resolution: This error occurs when the user profile attributes are not correctly synced. Please check your Okta application settings and verify that 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' are correctly mapped. Make sure that the email field is configured as the unique identifier for the connection.

subject: Request for video conferencing integration
body: Our teams are really frustrated that they have to switch apps for video calls. We need direct integration with Zoom and Google Meet inside our CloudDesk workspaces. Why is this not a feature yet? We need this to improve our workflow.
resolution: CloudDesk currently focuses on file sharing and project collaboration. While we don't have built-in video conferencing, you can share meeting links within comments. Please submit your request at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing so we can assess the demand for future partnerships.

subject: CRITICAL SSO TOKEN REFRESH FAILURES AFTER V42 UPDATE

resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to SSO token handling that require a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client (uninstall, restart, then reinstall). If the issue persists, your company's SSO administrator will need to review the IdP token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret in the CloudDesk Admin Console.

resolution: Advise the user to ensure their phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, guide them through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app's 'Security Settings' page.

resolution: This usually stems from a temporary browser data conflict. Please try clearing your cache and cookies, or attempt to view the report in a different browser. If the page remains blank, kindly let me know the specific date range you are trying to pull.

resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise the customer's IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide (accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration').

resolution: This intermittent behavior is related to our distributed storage retrieval process. We recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client while we work on a permanent server-side fix.

resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one, ensuring the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment directly from the 'Invoices' section to restore full access before your audit.

subject: Search performance issues in specific workspaces

resolution: Slow search performance is often caused by workspaces containing an exceptionally high number of files. Try using more specific path-based search queries to narrow the scope. If the issue continues, please provide the specific Workspace ID so our engineering team can review the index.

subject: lag when editing documents

subject: User Activity report is blank

resolution: This is often a transient issue caused by browser cache conflicts. Please try clearing your cookies or accessing the report from a different browser to see if data populates. If the page remains blank, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to pull.

subject: Guest user unable to log in after role change

resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Hardware MFA support request

resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa.

subject: Issue with exporting audit logs over 90 days

resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is capped at 90 days for performance reasons. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with your specific date range using a pagination script. If you are unable to use the API, let us know and we can facilitate a manual data pull for you.

subject: API 403 error when sharing workspaces

resolution: Please ensure the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Additionally, the user associated with that key must be a direct member of the workspace, not just a member through a group. If the issue continues, please provide the API key ID and workspace ID for further review.

subject: Audit log retention limit issue

resolution: Currently, the native retention limit in the Admin Console is capped at 12 months. For longer compliance requirements, we suggest using our API or the SFTP export feature to move logs to an external SIEM provider like Splunk. I have noted this as a feature request for future updates.

resolution: Kindly have your users clear their browser cache and cookies for our domain. If they continue to experience the loop, please suggest they attempt a login via a private browser window. We are checking the Google SSO settings in your Admin Console to ensure there are no configuration mismatches.

subject: Switching subscription to annual billing

resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: Workspace loading slowly for large folders

resolution: Hello. This behavior is typically caused by large file counts in the affected workspace. We advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, and suggesting breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Additionally, please verify your browser console for any network errors.

resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon, then go to 'Settings', select 'Advanced', and click 'Reset Sync Database' before resuming syncing. If the issue persists, check if there are very large numbers of small files in your synced folders.

subject: payment error in admin billing after sso login

Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: sso just-in-time provisioning not working

subject: Request for custom branding on SSO login page

We will notify you if any updates regarding this feature are released.

body: Hello support. We noticed a charge on our credit card statement from CloudDesk that we do not recognize or cannot reconcile with our expected billing cycle. We are on the PRO plan and would like clarification on this billing item as soon as possible.
resolution: To help us investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. Once we have those details, we will cross-reference them with your account's billing history and provide a complete breakdown of the transaction.

subject: billing api data looks wrong
body: ever since the v4.2 update our usage reports via the billing api look inconsistent. some calls show api-bill-401 errors while others just return strange data compared to the console. could you please check this out when you have a moment.
resolution: The billing API was updated in v4.2 to change how usage metrics are aggregated. Please verify that you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as defined in the latest API documentation. If the discrepancies continue, please share the exact query you are running and a screenshot of the conflicting Admin Console report.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade refund request
body: Hello team, our workspace was accidentally upgraded to a paid tier during testing and we would like to request a refund for the prorated amount. Error code BILL-REF-005 was referenced in our notification. No paid features have been utilized since the change. Take your time getting back to us.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Billing SSO failure blocking urgent invoice review
body: We are completely blocked from accessing our billing settings via SSO since the v4.2 release, encountering error AUTH-BILL-402 and payment processing failures. This is a critical issue because our annual financial audit is starting on Friday and we must update our payment method immediately.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Duplicate role name error when creating custom role
body: When attempting to create a new unique custom role in the admin console, I receive an error stating that the role name already exists. There is no rush on this, but I wanted to report the unexpected behavior.
resolution: Role names are case-insensitive and leading or trailing spaces are automatically trimmed by the system. There might be an existing role with a similar name or one that differs only by capitalization, so please check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Roles' thoroughly for any conflicting entries.

subject: Okta login failure with invalid token error
body: Since the recent v4.2 update, all of our team members using Okta SSO are completely blocked from logging in. We keep receiving the AUTH-SSO-401.1 error message on the screen. This is halting our entire engineering department right now.
resolution: To resolve this, please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata. This step is required because of the recent change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: High CPU usage on Desktop Sync client
body: Hello CloudDesk team, thank you for building a great product. I am currently integrating your API and using the desktop sync client on the side. I noticed that CloudDeskSync.exe is running at over 50% CPU usage constantly, even when completely idle. Whenever you have a moment, could you let me know how to address this high resource consumption?
resolution: Check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed on your account. We recommend pausing sync, restarting your computer, and then resuming sync. If it remains persistent, try disabling sync for non-critical folders or temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks, and check for any conflicting antivirus software.

subject: Password reset emails not arriving
body: My team is stuck and cant access anything because they arent getting the password reset emails. We have checked spam and nothing is there. This is a critical issue for our morning start up and we are losing time. Please help asap.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and have them check their junk folder again. You should also ensure our domain is whitelisted to prevent delivery blocks. If that fails, as an Admin, you can manually trigger a password reset for them directly from the user management panel.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: The latest invoice we received reflects a user count that is completely wrong. It does not match our current active user count in the CloudDesk console. We are seeing error code BILL-INV-001. Please look into this whenever you are free to do so.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Lag when editing documents together
body: Hey team, we noticed some typing lag when multiple people are working on the same document. It takes a few seconds for changes and cursor updates to show up for others. No major rush on this since we can still work, just wanted to report it.
resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved in the session. We advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection and recommending closing unnecessary browser tabs or applications. You can also clear the browser cache for all users to see if performance improves.

subject: Mobile app preview failing
body: Docs dont load in the mobile app, getting MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL. Its taking forever or just erroring out. Not a huge deal but would be nice to have it working again, thanks.
resolution: Please ensure your mobile app is fully updated to the latest version. You can try clearing the app cache via your device settings to see if that resolves the loading error. For particularly large files, we recommend downloading the file directly to your device.

subject: API 403 error on workspace share
body: We are getting API-403 errors when trying to share workspaces via the API. Our keys have the correct permissions. Please look into this right away as it is blocking our deployment.
resolution: Please confirm that your API key includes the 'Manage Workspaces' scope and that the user associated with the key is a direct member of the target workspace. If those conditions are met, please send over the API key ID and the specific workspace ID for our technical team to investigate further.

subject: Audit log export failing
body: Hey team, we are trying to pull our audit logs for the last 4 months but it keeps failing with the AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED error. Its kind of annoying but no rush on this. Thanks for the help.
resolution: The direct export feature is restricted to 90-day increments. For longer date ranges, please utilize our API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with a pagination script to retrieve your data.

subject: Google SSO stuck in redirect loop
body: Hello, some of our users are reporting that they get stuck in a redirect loop after authenticating with Google, preventing them from reaching the dashboard. I see the error code AUTH-SSO-302.1. Could you please advise on how to fix this for them?
resolution: To resolve this, please instruct the affected users to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'clouddesk.com'. If that does not work, have them try an incognito window or a different browser to verify the connection. Please also verify that your Google SSO configuration is correctly set up in the Admin Console.

subject: Trash Bin files visible past 30-day retention policy
body: We set up a 30-day data retention policy for deleted files in our workspace, but files remain visible and recoverable in the Trash Bin well past that timeframe. Could you please look into why this rule is not enforcing correctly?
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: Retention policy settings not applying
body: I am working with your API to audit our security, and I noticed that files remain in the trash long after our 30-day policy window. We are seeing RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED in our tests. Is there a specific API call I should be using to enforce this?
resolution: Retention policies usually target permanently deleted items rather than items simply in the 'Trash Bin'. Please double-check your security settings to ensure you have specifically configured the 'Trash Bin' auto-purge interval, as standard policies treat these as recoverable user-initiated items.

subject: laggy typing in cloudesk office docs
body: When multiple people edit an office doc together there is a huge delay before others see the text. Cursors also jump around very slowly. We see COLLAB_LAG in the console. Take a look whenever you have time later this week no rush.
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved. Advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs/applications. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document. Clear browser cache for all users.

subject: User receiving 403 error on shared workspace
body: I have a user reporting that they cannot access a specific workspace despite having previously been granted access. They are seeing the PERM-WS-403.4 error when trying to open the link. Please let me know how to restore their access.
resolution: Please have an administrator navigate to the workspace settings within the Admin Console. Once there, check the Members list to ensure the user is still assigned the correct access rights. You may need to remove and re-add them to the workspace to refresh their permissions.

subject: Search results incomplete in web app
body: I have noticed that when I search for certain files, they aren't showing up in the results even though I know they exist. I am getting the SEARCH-002 error code occasionally. I have some time, but it would be great to get this resolved.
resolution: This issue is typically caused by the search index needing a refresh for your account. Please try logging out and back in, as this often triggers a re-index; you can also try using exact phrases in quotes to refine your search. If you still encounter missing files, feel free to send over a few examples so we can investigate further.

subject: Desktop Sync is stuck on Connecting and not syncing files
body: My desktop app has been stuck saying connecting for hours and none of my files are syncing. This is blocking my work completely and I need this fixed promptly. Please help me get this working again.
resolution: Instruct user to restart the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache: go to 'Settings' > 'Advanced' > 'Clear Cache'. If still unresolved, suggest a full reinstall of the client after backing up local unsynced files.

subject: assigned helpdesk ticket not showing in my view
body: Hello support team, when a helpdesk ticket gets assigned to me I cant see it in my My Assigned Tickets list inside the web app. It happens with error HELPDESK-007 and management can see it fine. Please take a look when you have a moment thanks.
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Please clear your browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, have your administrator re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to your account.

subject: Requesting support for hardware MFA tokens
body: Our security team is demanding support for hardware-based MFA like YubiKey. The current software-only options are not compliant with our new internal policies. When will you support physical security keys?
resolution: We understand the importance of hardware-based MFA for high-security environments. While we currently support authenticator apps, we are actively collecting feedback on this feature. Please visit roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa to vote for this and share your specific requirements.

subject: Role name already exists error
body: I am trying to create a custom role, but I get a CD-AM-012 error saying the name exists even though I have checked and it does not. I can wait for a fix as this is not a blocker, but please look into it.
resolution: Our system treats role names as case-insensitive and trims any leading or trailing spaces. Please review your existing roles in the Team Management section to see if a name exists that only differs by capitalization or spacing.

subject: Need to update purchase order number for invoices
body: Could you please advise on the best way to update our purchase order number for future billing? We want to make sure the next cycle includes the correct information for our accounting department. Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: You can update your PO number by navigating to the Billing section within the Admin Console. Once you update the field under Billing Information, the new number will be applied to all future invoices generated for your account.

subject: New user getting error on login
body: I added a new team member but they get an 'User Not Found' error when trying to log in! This is very frustrating as they need to start today. The error code is AUTH-NF-404.1. Please fix this soon.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console to ensure it matches exactly what the user is entering. Confirm that the invitation was successfully sent and accepted. If the user still cannot access the system, try resending the invitation to their email address.

subject: Desktop sync client SSO issue
body: My browser redirects but the desktop app won't authenticate. I am seeing the DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 error when I try to log in. Is there a known issue with the current client version?
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to at least version 4.2.1. If the problem continues, verify your default browser settings or attempt to log in using your email and password as a temporary workaround.

subject: Role name already exists error when creating custom role
body: When attempting to create a new custom role in the admin console, the system returns an error stating that the role name already exists, even though the name is completely unique. This is on our free plan workspace. There is no major rush on this as we are just organizing our permissions for next month.
resolution: Role names are case-insensitive and leading/trailing spaces are trimmed. There might be an existing role with a similar name or one that differs only by capitalization. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Roles' thoroughly for any roles that might conflict.

subject: Frustrated with lack of offline mobile editing
body: As the finance contact for our account, I rely heavily on reviewing documents while traveling. It is extremely frustrating that the mobile app still does not let us edit documents offline and sync them later. Our team wastes so much time waiting for connections. Please fix this soon.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature and invite you to vote for it at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade refund request
body: Dear team, our account was unintentionally upgraded to a higher tier plan and we would like to request a refund for the prorated difference. The error code BILL-REF-005 was shown on the invoice. Please assist when possible.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. Once received, we will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Custom enterprise billing request
body: Hello, we are interested in moving to an annual invoice payment structure with specific terms. Please let us know the process for this. No rush.
resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the Enterprise Inquiry form on our website. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: Switching billing to annual
body: Hi there, I would like to change my subsciption from monthly to annual billing to save some money for the firm. When I try to update this I keep getting a BILL-PLAN-004 error. Could you let me know how to fix this please? No rush.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: CloudDesk desktop app using too much CPU
body: The app is running at 60% cpu all the time. PERF-DSK-001 is making my machine very slow. Can you look into this?
resolution: It sounds like the client is stuck in an indexing loop. Please pause syncing via the tray icon, then go to 'Settings' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. Once the reset finishes, you can resume syncing.

subject: Session expired error blocking login
body: I am being kicked out of the platform immediately after logging in with an AUTH-SESSION-401.5 error. I have a major demo at 5pm today and this is preventing me from preparing my slides. This is extremely frustrating as I need access right now to get my work done.
resolution: Please clear your browser's cookies and local storage for 'cloudesk.com' to ensure a fresh session is initiated. Also, verify that the system time on your computer is accurate, as a clock mismatch can cause immediate session expiration. If the issue persists, ensure that no browser privacy extensions are blocking our session cookies.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: Good morning. Some users from specific domains cannot log in via Google SSO today, even if other domains work, and they receive a domain not allowed error. We are on the free plan and I am writing as the executive assistant to our director. I want this fixed soon but it is not pressing. Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's SSO and Identity settings for Google SSO, check the Allowed Domains list. Please add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO so your users can successfully authenticate.

subject: API tokens returning 401 Unauthorized after upgrade
body: Dear CloudDesk team, following our recent upgrade to v4.2, our existing API tokens are suddenly failing with a 401 Unauthorized response and a legacy_token_format error. This is breaking our primary production data pipeline and needs immediate intervention. Thank you for your swift help.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated for improved security. You must regenerate all of your API tokens from the API and Integrations section in the Admin Console. Please update your dependent applications to use these newly generated tokens right away.

subject: Blank user activity report
body: Hello. When I try to open the User Activity report in the admin console, the page loads completely blank. All other reports work fine. We are seeing REPORT-001. Please fix.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try using a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If the screen is still blank, please provide the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: pdf and pptx preview showing blank screen
body: hey team so we are working on integrating the api on our free workspace and noticed something weird. whenever we try to open pdf or pptx files inside the web app viewer it just shows a blank page or infinite loading spinner. download works fine though. error code PREVIEW-006 keeps showing up in our console logs. no real rush on this since we are just testing things out in our sandbox environment.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: User Activity report page is empty
body: Hello, I am trying to view User Activity report in admin console but page stay completely blank. Other reports work fine. We encounter error REPORT-001. Please help to fix this soon.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: laggy office docs collaboration
body: hi there, when multiple of us are editing a clouddesk office document at the same time, there is noticeable lag between typing and seeing changes. cursor positions update slowly too. thanks for any help.
resolution: Please check network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure all users have a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs or applications, and verifying if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document simultaneously.

subject: API 403 Forbidden error blocking integration setup
body: This is completely unacceptable! Our new integration using the REST API is failing to make any calls and keeps receiving a 403 Forbidden error with code API-AUTH-403.5, even though we are using a valid API key. We have a major company-wide demo at 5pm today and this is completely breaking our setup. We need this resolved immediately!
resolution: Confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes/permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: Mobile app network error
body: I cannot log into the mobile app and see a generic network error. I am on a stable connection. Error code is MOBILE-NET-500.1. No rush on this, but please look into it.
resolution: Please try to force close the application and check for any available updates in your app store. If the problem continues, try clearing the app's cache or reinstalling it entirely. You can also monitor our status page for any reported outages.

subject: Jira integration sync issues
body: Our Jira sync is failing with JIRA-SYNC-403 errors and we have a major demo at 5pm today. It says permission denied even though I am an admin. Please fix this asap.
resolution: Ensure the Jira API token or user configured for the CloudDesk integration has 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions for the relevant Jira projects within your Jira instance. This should resolve the permission error and allow your sync to proceed.

subject: Cannot add new users to team
body: I am trying to add new team members but I get a 'Seat limit reached' error. I checked the subscription details and we clearly have seats available. The error code is CD-AM-001. Please help when you can.
resolution: Please check your Pending Invitations list under Admin Console, Team Management, and Invitations. Pending invites count toward your total seat limit. You can either revoke those older pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase your capacity.

subject: Google SSO login failing
body: Our office staff is having trouble signing in using their Google accounts. They get stuck in a redirect loop after authenticating and never see the dashboard. I think the error is AUTH-SSO-302.1. Can you help us fix this?
resolution: Please instruct your users to clear their browser's cache and cookies for cloudesk.com. If the issue continues, please have them try an incognito window or a different browser. We also recommend verifying your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: New users not provisioning via SSO JIT settings
body: Good afternoon, I hope your week is going smoothly so far. We were reviewing our configuration because we have our quarterly audit coming up on Friday morning, and noticed that new users logging in via SSO are not being automatically provisioned in CloudDesk even though Just-in-Time Provisioning is fully enabled in our settings. We are seeing error CD-AM-009 pop up and need this resolved as soon as possible.
resolution: Hello. Verify that your SSO Identity Provider is correctly sending the required user attributes, such as email, first_name, and last_name, in the SAML or OIDC assertion. Also, ensure there are available seats in your CloudDesk subscription. Check Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings for any recent configuration changes or errors.

subject: Mobile app MFA registration failure
body: I AM TRYING TO SET UP MFA ON THE MOBILE APP BUT IT KEEPS FAILING AFTER I SCAN THE QR CODE! IT JUST SAYS FAILED TO REGISTER MFA DEVICE AND I KEEP SEEING CODE MFA-MOB-002. THIS IS VERY FRUSTRATING, PLEASE FIX THIS IMMEDIATELY!
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please have your users complete the MFA setup process through the CloudDesk web app under Settings, Security, and Multi-Factor Authentication. Once configured there, it will function correctly for both mobile and web logins.

subject: API data export returns 403
body: Our integration is failing with an API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED error when calling the export endpoint. This was working perfectly yesterday. Please check the permissions for the admin scope.
resolution: As of our latest update, the standard 'Admin' API scope no longer includes permissions for Data Export. You now need to generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role assigned to access this endpoint. Please update your integration in the Admin Console API Management section.

subject: SSO Login Broken: AUTH-SSO-401.1
body: OUR ENTIRE TEAM IS LOCKED OUT AFTER THE V4.2 UPDATE! We are getting an 'Invalid SSO token format' error (AUTH-SSO-401.1) and we have a major client presentation at 5 PM today. This is completely unacceptable. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: We sincerely apologize for the disruption caused by the recent v4.2 update. Because the SSO token format has changed, you need to log into your CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata to restore connectivity. This will resolve the AUTH-SSO-401.1 errors and allow your team to authenticate for your presentation.

subject: Workspace loading takes forever on large folders
body: Hello, whenever I click into our main project workspace which has more than 10,000 files in it, the page takes an excessive amount of time to load. It just displays a blank white screen or a spinning wheel for well over 30 seconds before finally rendering anything. We are not in a huge rush to get this fixed since we can work around it by going to older folders, but it is quite annoying.
resolution: Hi there. This performance delay happens when there are unusually large file counts in a single workspace. We advise encouraging your team to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view rather than loading everything at once. You might also want to consider breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones to improve loading times.

subject: Newly invited user getting User Not Found error
body: I am trying to integrate our systems with your API, but my team member cannot sign in. They keep receiving AUTH-NF-404.1 when trying to use their email. This is incredibly frustrating. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: Please check the Admin Console to verify the user's email address and confirm the invitation status. If the invitation wasn't accepted, please resend it. You should also ensure they are attempting to log in via the correct instance URL.

subject: Users constantly logged out after v4.2 update
body: THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE! Since the v4.2 upgrade, our developers using Okta and Azure AD SSO are being kicked out and forced to re-authenticate every ten minutes with SSO session expired errors. This is completely blocking our sprint work right now. Fix this bug immediately!
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta and Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration of 8 to 24 hours to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: Cached files remain on mobile device after logout
body: Files opened in the mobile app are persisting on the device storage even after logging out or closing the application. This poses a compliance and privacy risk if a company tablet or phone is lost. We noticed error code MOBILE_APP_CACHE_PERSISTENCE during our review. Please let us know how to remove these files.
resolution: The mobile app caches files for offline access. To manually clear the cache, go to Settings within the CloudDesk mobile app, then Storage and select Clear Cached Files. For automatic clearing on logout, enable Clear cache on logout in the same settings menu, as this setting is off by default.

subject: Need invoice as PDF not CSV
body: I am trying to pull our monthly invoices from the Admin Console, but the system only provides them as CSV files. I need the official PDF versions for my records. How can I get these?
resolution: PDF invoice generation is currently unavailable for older invoices due to a recent migration. Please provide the specific invoice IDs you require, and our team will manually generate and email the PDFs to you.

subject: Okta SSO login broken
body: our team cant login via okta, getting invalid sso token format error auth-sso-401.1. this started immediately after the 4.2 update and its really blocking our work. can you help fix this prompty pls?
resolution: The update to v4.2 changed our SSO token format, which requires a quick configuration refresh. Please go to your Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata to align with these new requirements. Doing so should immediately resolve the AUTH-SSO-401.1 error for your team.

subject: SSO login failure after recent update
body: Ever since the v4.2 update this morning, my entire team is locked out of CloudDesk. We use Azure AD for authentication, but everyone keeps getting an 'Invalid SSO Token Format' error when they try to sign in. I am getting swamped with messages from panicked employees. We have a major deadline today that we simply cannot meet if we do not have access to these files. Please escalate this immediately as we are seeing error code CD-AM-003.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced a new SSO token structure that requires an update to your identity provider settings. Please consult the CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide to update your application configuration in Azure AD. This change will align your token format with our current release and resolve the errors.

subject: Zapier trigger not working for file uploads
body: Hello, it appears our automated workflows are failing with error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404. Our file upload trigger is simply not firing, which is blocking our team processes. We have a major audit this Friday, so could you please help us resolve this promptly? We truly appreciate your assistance in getting this back on track.
resolution: In Zapier, please re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. You should also check the CloudDesk audit logs to confirm the event is being captured correctly.

subject: Deleted user still showing in sharing dialogs
body: Hi, I deleted a user account but they are still appearing in the file sharing lists. Its causing confusion for my staff. We are seeing error code CD-AM-006 when we try to remove them manually. Any ideas on how to fix this?
resolution: Deleted users are removed from access immediately, but they may remain in historical share lists as entries for up to 48 hours until the system purges them. If you need them removed immediately, you can explicitly remove them from the share via the Workspace Settings menu.

subject: Accidental Plan Upgrade Refund Request
body: Dear CloudDesk team, our account was recently upgraded to a higher tier unintentionally and we would like to request a refund for the prorated difference. Thank you so much for your assistance with this matter. We are in no rush and appreciate your help whenever you have a chance.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Unrecognized charge on our credit card statement
body: We have identified a recent credit card charge from CloudDesk that does not match our expected subscription tier or billing records. We are encountering error code bill-chg-010 when checking the invoice ledger. Please investigate this discrepancy promptly so we can reconcile our accounts.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Excessive load times in large workspaces
body: I am absolutely frustrated because my workspaces with over 10,000 files are completely unusable! The page just shows a loading spinner for over 30 seconds before failing with error code WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT. This is unacceptable performance for a professional platform. How do we fix this?
resolution: It appears the workspace contains too many items for the browser to render at once. I recommend using our search and filter tools to narrow your view, or splitting the content into smaller, more manageable workspaces. Please also check your browser console to ensure there are no underlying network errors preventing the load.

subject: Slack channel file share notifications missing
body: Hello support team, we noticed that our file share notifications are not showing up in our configured Slack channel. There is no rush on this, but we would love to get it working eventually. Thank you for your time!
resolution: Please check the Slack integration settings in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app has permission to post in that channel within Slack.

subject: Critical API permission error on data export endpoint
body: We are getting API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED when trying to hit the export endpoint. This was working fine yesterday and we have a major client audit at 5pm today. Please help us fix this immediately as our team is blocked.
resolution: The 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions as of our latest update. Please generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in the Admin Console under API Management. This should restore your access for the audit.

subject: Okta login error after update
body: Dear support, users with Okta SSO cannot login today after the v4.2 update, receiving the invalid token error AUTH-SSO-401.1. Many accounts are experiencing this exact same authentication block simultaneously right now. This is a critical issue for us because our payroll run is tomorrow and finance staff cannot access the workspace.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Mobile app crashes on large uploads
body: We have been testing the mobile app and it crashes every time we try to upload a file larger than 1GB. Smaller files work without any trouble. We see CRASH-MOB-001 during the attempt. This is blocking our field team's workflow, so please look into this quickly.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue regarding large file uploads on mobile devices. As a temporary workaround, please use the web app or desktop sync client for files over 1GB. Our team is currently working on an optimization for a future mobile update.

subject: Account suspension assistance
body: Hello, I noticed our account has been suspended with an 'Account Suspended' banner appearing in the console. I believe this is related to an unpaid invoice, code BILL-SUSP-007. I would be very grateful if you could guide me on how to resolve this, as we need access to our files today.
resolution: Your account access was restricted due to an overdue payment. Simply head over to the Invoices section in the Admin Console to settle the balance, and your service will be automatically reactivated within 15 minutes of payment confirmation.

subject: Azure AD SSO login failing
body: Our users cannot log in and are getting a message about missing required attributes. This is stopping our entire company from accessing their files. We need this resolved immediately to get back to work. The error code is AUTH-SSO-403.2.
resolution: Please have your Azure AD administrator verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped within the CloudDesk enterprise application settings. You can find detailed instructions on how to set these claims correctly in our Azure AD SSO configuration guide.

subject: assigned tickets missing from my view
body: im assigning tickets to myself but they dont show up in my queue. i see a HELPDESK-007 error code periodically. i need this working immediately as i cant do my job right now.
resolution: This is likely a temporary caching issue affecting your permissions. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, then sign back into the application. If that fails to resolve it, have an administrator re-assign the ticket to another user and then back to you, which will force a permission refresh.

subject: Retention policy not deleting old files
body: We set a 30-day retention policy, yet files in the trash are still recoverable long after that period. This is a critical compliance issue for our upcoming audit this Friday. The policy does not seem to be enforced at all.
resolution: Please verify your configuration under Admin Console, Security & Compliance, Data Retention. Note that policies for 'Permanently Deleted' files differ from the 'Trash Bin'; files in the trash remain recoverable unless you specifically enable the auto-purge setting for that folder.

subject: Downgrade subscription plan
body: Hello team, I need to downgrade our CloudDesk subscription plan to a lower tier because our team size has decreased. We are currently on the free tier and need to make adjustments accordingly. I encountered error code BILL-PLAN-011 when attempting this earlier. Please let me know how to proceed at your earliest convenience.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: High latency during simultaneous document editing
body: When multiple users are editing a CloudDesk Office document simultaneously, there is noticeable lag of several seconds between typing and seeing changes reflected for other collaborators. Cursor positions update slowly as well, showing the COLLAB_LAG error intermittently. Please look into this when possible.
resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs or applications, and verifying if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document.

subject: Large uploads timing out constantly
body: Hey support, why are large files over 1GB always timing out with upload_timeout_504 errors? The progress bar just stalls indefinitely and its extremely frustrating. Im trying to push API assets and this is getting ridiculous.
resolution: Advise customer to check their internet connection speed. For files over 500MB, recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads, as it supports resumable transfers. Verify if the issue persists across different browsers. If on Wi-Fi, suggest trying a wired connection.

subject: Billing section failing with SSO login issues
body: Dear support, I hope this message finds you well. As the team manager overseeing our department's software subscriptions, I wanted to reach out regarding a persistent issue we have been experiencing lately. Ever since the recent v4.2 platform update rolled out across our company workspace, whenever I try to manage our billing details or view recent invoices using our standard SSO login, I am met with an unexpected authentication failure message specific to that page, even though all other admin console functions work normally. This is blocking our upcoming budget review, so we would appreciate your prompt help.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email and password, or clearing your browser cache and cookies, while we investigate the SSO integration for billing.

subject: Audit log export failing for ranges over 90 days
body: When attempting to export audit logs from the Admin Console for ranges exceeding 90 days, the export fails. I received the error AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. What is the recommended way to retrieve this older data?
resolution: The Admin Console interface is limited to a 90-day export window. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with your specific date range. If you do not have API access, let us know and we can facilitate a manual data pull.

subject: Unable to edit company name
body: I am trying to update our company name in the settings, but the field is completely read-only. I have been going in circles in the Admin Console trying to save this, and it is honestly quite frustrating. I see error CD-AM-010 when I try to force the save.
resolution: The 'Company Name' field is linked to your formal subscription billing information. To make changes, please navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the 'Organization Name' there. Once that is updated, the change will automatically propagate to your Company Settings.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA code rejected on mobile app
body: Hello. One of our users is attempting to log in, but the MFA code generated from their Google Authenticator app is not being accepted by the system. We are on the PRO plan. Please investigate this AUTH-MFA-401.2 issue.
resolution: Please advise the user to ensure their phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time, as time drift often causes token rejections. If the issue persists, guide them through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app's Security Settings page.

subject: Data retention policy not working
body: Thank you for the help with our account setup. I noticed that our 30-day data retention policy does not seem to be deleting files from the Trash Bin as expected. We are still seeing files well past the 30-day mark and we are worried about compliance. Could you please help us ensure RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED is addressed?
resolution: Please verify your retention policy configuration in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Note that policies typically apply to permanently deleted files, while the Trash Bin is subject to user-initiated recovery; you may need to specifically configure a policy to purge the Trash after a set number of days.

subject: Data retention policy not working for trash bin
body: Hi there, I have configured our data retention to 30 days, but files are still sitting in the trash bin way longer then that. We are getting the RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED error in the admin console. Could you please take a look at this, as our internal audit is approaching soon and we need this to be compliant.
resolution: Please note that standard retention policies apply to files that have been permanently purged, rather than items just sitting in the trash. Files in the trash are recoverable by users; to have those items automatically purged, you must specifically configure the setting to empty the trash bin after your desired timeframe.

subject: accidental upgrade refund request
body: Hello, I think I accidentally upgraded our account to the PRO plan while clicking around the admin console earlier today. We did not mean to change our subscription and would love to request a refund for the prorated charge if possible. Thank you so much for your help with this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account for eligibility.

subject: Incorrect tax rate on monthly invoice
body: Hi there, I noticed that the tax rate on our latest invoice looks incorrect based on our registered business location. Could you please look into this when you have a moment? Thanks so much for your help.
resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID under Admin Console -> Billing -> Billing Information. If those details are correct, please reply with your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: request for new file upload webhook event in api
body: hello friends hope you are having a nice day. our dev team is wondering if you could add a webhook event that triggers whenever a new file is uploaded to a specific workspace so we can connect our internal apps. thank you so much for your hard work
resolution: Hello! Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including your desired payload structure, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so our product team can assess demand.

subject: AUDIT LOG EXPORT FAILS FOR 90 DAYS
body: WE ARE TRYING TO EXPORT OUR AUDIT LOGS FOR MORE THAN 90 DAYS AND IT KEEPS FAILING! ERROR CODE AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED SAYS EXPORT RANGE LIMIT EXCEEDED. THIS IS RIDICULOUS.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: need video conferencing integration inside workspaces
body: Hi team we are using clouddesk for enterprise file sharing and our developers keep asking for a built in video conferencing tool like zoom or google meet right inside the workspace. It would make collaboration much smoother since we wont have to switch tabs. Can you let me know if this is on the roadmap
resolution: Currently, CloudDesk focuses on file sharing and project collaboration. While we don't have built-in video conferencing, you can easily share meeting links within comments. For a direct integration with specific video conferencing platforms, please submit your request and preferred tools at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing. This helps us assess demand for future partnerships.

subject: high resource usage on sync client
body: my laptop is running very hot because the sync client is using 60% cpu. it shows the SYNC_HIGH_RESOURCE_USAGE error. i have a report to finish by end of day today, can you help me get this sorted?
resolution: High resource usage can occur if there are a large number of changes being processed at once. Please pause your sync, restart your computer, and then resume the sync process. If the issue remains, please check for any antivirus software that might be conflicting with our process.

subject: File previews not loading properly
body: Hello team, we noticed that previewing certain PDF and PPTX files directly within the web app shows a blank page or spinning loader, though downloading them works fine. We appreciate your help in looking into this.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Desktop Sync client failing after password change
body: I changed my password in the web app, and now the desktop app is stuck and giving me error CD-AM-015. I cannot access my files and this is blocking our entire finance team. Please fix this immediately so we can get back to work.
resolution: It appears the desktop application needs to be re-authenticated to recognize your new password. Please click the CloudDesk icon in your system tray, select 'Log Out', and then sign back in using your updated credentials. This should resolve the authentication error.

subject: desktop client running really hot
body: hey im seeing the sync client hogging tons of cpu and memory even when idle. i keep getting error PERF-DSK-001 pop ups. my machine is running slow as a result. let me know if there is a fix when you can.
resolution: This behavior often happens if the app gets caught in a re-indexing loop. Please pause syncing from the tray icon, go to Settings, then Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database. Once that is done, you can resume syncing.

subject: Need more detailed user activity reports
body: We find the current audit logs insufficient for our management needs. We would like to see more granular data on file downloads and specific collaboration actions. Could you point us toward any advanced reporting features?
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. As our current logs provide only basic tracking, please describe your specific reporting requirements on our public roadmap. This feedback helps our analytics team prioritize future development of more advanced reporting capabilities.

subject: Audit log export failing for ranges over ninety days
body: Hi support team. Tried exporting audit logs for the last 120 days from the admin console and the export failed. We are on the free plan right now. Error message says Export range limit exceeded (90 days maximum). Let us know when you can.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: Wrong user names showing in our workspace activity log
body: Hello support team. While reviewing our workspace activity log on our free plan, I noticed that several file actions like editing and moving are attributed to the wrong user and show an administrator instead, even though regular team members performed them. We are also seeing error code AUDIT-004 associated with these incorrect logs. This is quite frustrating when trying to track expenses and asset updates, though we can wait a bit for a fix since it is not blocking our daily work.
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct, and this is a known bug we are currently addressing. For an accurate audit right now, please cross-reference these events with the global audit log in your admin console.

subject: Users locked out after v4.2 update with CD-AM-003
body: Hello CloudDesk Support team, we hope you are having a wonderful week. Ever since the recent platform rollout, our employees attempting to log in via Okta and Azure AD are met with error CD-AM-003. This is causing significant disruption for our entire organization. We would be immensely grateful for your prompt assistance in resolving this critical access roadblock.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Please instruct the customer to update their SSO application configuration in their IdP (Okta/Azure AD) to use the new token schema. Refer to the 'CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide' for specific instructions.

subject: User activity report is blank
body: I tryed to run the User Activity report in the admin area, but it comes up totally blank. Everything else works fine, just this report. I think I see a REPORT-001 error. Can you help me fix this so I can see my data?
resolution: This behavior often stems from a temporary data retrieval error or browser interference. Please try clearing your browser's cache or using a different browser to see if the data populates. If the report remains blank, please provide the specific date range you are attempting to query.

subject: Cannot access shared workspace
body: One of our team members is encountering a permission denied error when trying to open a specific shared workspace. They are seeing code PERM-WS-403.4. We would appreciate it if you could help us resolve this when you have a moment.
resolution: An administrator will need to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Please navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check the members list, and ensure the user is correctly assigned with the appropriate access rights.

subject: Okta SSO failing with Invalid SSO token format
body: Our entire team is currently unable to access CloudDesk. We are seeing the error AUTH-SSO-401.1 every time we try to sign in. Please fix this immediately as work is halted.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata. This step is necessary following our v4.2 update, which changed the SSO token format. Let us know if you need any further assistance with this process.

subject: Slow download speeds for shared workspace files
body: Hello support team, we hope you are having a wonderful week. We noticed that downloading files from our enterprise workspaces has been running slower than usual recently. It is not an urgent matter by any means, but we wanted to bring it to your attention whenever convenient. Thank you so much for your ongoing assistance and hard work.
resolution: Test download speeds using a different browser or network. Advise checking browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager if available or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Verify server region for the workspace.

subject: Public link expiration limits are too short for our audit
body: Hello! We desperately need public sharing links to stay active indefinitely or at least much longer than the current maximum. Our external audit is happening on Friday and this short expiration window is causing massive headaches for our team. Please let us know how to bypass this restriction immediately.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: desktop sync client keeps asking for sso login
body: ever since the v4.2 sync client update our team members are constantly getting logged out with sso_token_refresh_fail_4_2. we have a major client presentation at 5pm today and need this stable so files sync correctly.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to SSO token handling. Please perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client by uninstalling it, restarting your machine, and then installing the latest version. If the issue persists, your company's SSO administrator may need to review their IdP's token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret in the CloudDesk Admin Console.

subject: MFA setup failing on mobile
body: hey there when i try to set up mfa on the mobile app it says failed to register mfa device after i scan the qr code. i keep getting mfa-mob-002. thanks for your help.
resolution: This is a known issue affecting the mobile registration flow. Please complete your MFA setup through the CloudDesk web app under 'Settings' > 'Security' > 'Multi-Factor Authentication'. Once configured there, your MFA will be active and functioning for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Custom annual invoicing and volume discount inquiry
body: Hello support team, I am writing to inquire about setting up an annual invoicing schedule for our PRO account. We are currently paying by credit card each month, but our finance department requires annual invoicing with Net 30 terms. Additionally, we would like to discuss a volume-based discount as we are planning to expand our user base soon. Please let me know what options are available.
resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: Webhooks failing to deliver to our service
body: Our system logs are showing WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500 errors for all incoming data from your platform. It seems like the connection is being refused or the endpoint is not recognized. I am just looking into why our integration is not receiving updates at the moment. Can you provide some guidance on what might be causing this?
resolution: Please verify that the webhook URL in the Admin Console is correct and currently active. Ensure your server firewall is configured to accept traffic from our IP range, as a blocking policy often causes these connection failures. You can find our current IP list in the developer documentation.

subject: CRITICAL: Limited scope API keys can perform admin actions
body: Hi support team, we noticed a major security flaw today where a restricted read-only api key is somehow executing full admin functions like deleting users. Error code API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS is appearing in our logs. This is a critical security vulnerability affecting our whole platform and we need it fixed instantly before our payroll run tomorrow.
resolution: Revoke the compromised API key immediately in Admin Console > API Management. Investigate if the key was mistakenly generated with broader permissions initially or if there's an internal process misconfiguration. Acknowledge this is a critical security vulnerability and escalate to engineering if revocation does not resolve the issue or if the scope bypass persists.

subject: Google SSO loop
body: Users are caught in a redirect loop after authenticating with Google SSO. They never reach the dashboard and see AUTH-SSO-302.1. Please advise.
resolution: Please have the affected users clear their browser cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, or test in an incognito window to rule out session conflicts. If the issue continues, please confirm that your Google SSO settings in the Admin Console are configured correctly and that the redirect URI is properly set.

subject: mobile preview broken
body: hey docs wont load in the mobile app error pops up saying MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL everytime. no rush on this just wanted to let you know when you get a sec thanks
resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version. Check the user's device storage and network connection. Advise clearing the mobile app's cache (via device settings). For very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: sluggish typing and lag in shared documents COLLAB_LAG
body: hi there when our team edits docs together there is terrible lag and cursor delay COLLAB_LAG happening right now no extreme hurry though thanks so much
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved. Advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs/applications. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document. Clear browser cache for all users.

subject: Switching enterprise subscription to annual billing
body: Hello Support Team. We would like to transition our current Enterprise subscription from monthly to annual billing. I tried locating the option in our admin console dashboard but could not find the direct switch button. Please let us know how we can proceed with this change.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to Admin Console, Billing, Subscription Details, and then Change Plan. Select the annual option for your current plan. The change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated.

subject: Previewer not working for our files
body: We are currently hitting an issue where the file previewer displays a blank page when opening PDFs, showing error code PREVIEW-006. This is blocking our team from reviewing assets before our client presentation tomorrow morning. We would be very grateful if you could help us resolve this promptly.
resolution: This issue often stems from temporary rendering service interruptions or local browser conflicts. I recommend clearing your cache and cookies as a first step. If the problem persists, please try viewing the file in an incognito window to confirm it isn't an extension-related issue.

subject: SEARCH IS NOT WORKING PROPERLY
body: I am trying to locate files in our web app, but the search results are missing half of our documents! It is incredibly frustrating when I know the file exists but the system refuses to show it. I have noticed the error code SEARCH-002 appearing occasionally. Can you fix this search function soon?
resolution: We understand your frustration with the search functionality. Please try searching using exact phrases in quotes, and if that fails, log out and back into the web app to trigger a re-indexing of your account. If the SEARCH-002 error persists, please send us specific search terms and the files you expect to see so we can investigate further.

subject: Desktop client SSO login redirect failure
body: Hello, I wanted to reach out regarding an authentication issue we are seeing. We use Okta for our identity provider across multiple internal tools, and yesterday we tried configuring the desktop sync client with our SSO credentials. The browser goes through the usual redirect flow successfully, but once it hands control back, the client stays unauthenticated and displays a generic login failed message with error DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. We would like to get this sorted out soon.
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, suggest logging in via email/password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: Payment failed for subscription renewal
body: Our account is showing a payment failed status for the recent renewal. I believe our credit card might have expired or there was a billing issue. This is blocking our team from accessing shared files, so please assist us in fixing this as soon as possible.
resolution: Please head to the 'Billing' tab in your admin console and update your credit card details under 'Payment Methods'. Once the information is updated, you can manually retry the payment in the 'Invoices' section. Ensure the billing address is accurate to avoid the BILL-PAY-002 error.

subject: Request for hardware security key support
body: Our security team has been reviewing our current software-based MFA tools. We have been discussing the pros and cons of various authentication methods and ultimately decided that hardware-based tokens like YubiKeys are the direction we want to go. I am writing to ask if CloudDesk has plans to support these.
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at our roadmap portal, as we prioritize features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Need to add PO number to invoices
body: We have a new purchase order number that needs to be added to our billing profile for future invoices. Let me know if you need any additional info from our side.
resolution: You can add your PO number by navigating to the Admin Console, then selecting Billing, and finally Billing Information. Once you save the number in that field, it will appear on all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied to invoices that have already been generated.

subject: Incorrect user attribution in activity logs
body: I am quite frustrated because our workspace activity logs are attributing file moves and edits to the wrong users. My administrators are being blamed for changes that regular team members clearly made. I noticed error AUDIT-004 appearing in the system logs. Can you please look into this so my audit reports are actually accurate? No rush on this, but it is annoying.
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace.
