The underlying audit trail remains correct and intact. You can view the accurate audit data by cross-referencing the global audit log in your admin console while we work on a fix.

subject: AWS S3 export failing
body: Our automated tenant-wide data export to S3 is failing with an 'Invalid Credentials' error. I have checked, and our AWS creds havent changed at all. Error code is S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401. This started right after the v4.2 update. No rush, but could you check this out.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced stricter IAM policy requirements for our S3 integrations. Your existing policy may be missing the 's3:GetBucketLocation' permission which is now required. Please update your AWS IAM policy to align with the requirements found in our v4.2 S3 Integration Guide.

subject: Switch billing to annual
body: Please change our subscription from monthly to annual billing to apply the yearly discount. Let us know when this is done.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please navigate to the Admin Console, go to Billing, Subscription Details, and click Change Plan. Select the annual option for your current plan so the change takes effect at your next billing period with any unused monthly credit prorated.

subject: User data deletion request stuck in Pending status
body: Hello Support, we initiated a user data deletion request from the Admin Console for a departing employee on our Pro plan, but the request status has remained 'Pending' for over 48 hours now. We also did not receive any confirmation email regarding the status. Error code shown is USER_DELETE_PENDING. Could you please investigate this promptly as it impacts our compliance workflow? Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: First, verify that the user's status is set to 'Inactive' before requesting deletion. If the user is still active, the deletion will remain queued. If they are inactive and the request is still pending, please check the System Status page for background job processing issues. If no issues are found, reply with the user's email and deletion request ID so we can investigate further.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: I am trying to run the User Activity report but it is completely empty. I've tried multiple times today and it just wont load. This is very frustrating as I need these logs for my daily work. Please look into this.
resolution: This behavior is often caused by a temporary data retrieval snag. Please try clearing your browser cookies and cache, then attempt to load the report again. If it is still blank, please let me know which date range you are attempting to view.

subject: Request for custom SSO branding
body: I am really disappointed that we cannot customize our login screen to match our company branding. It makes the platform look unprofessional when our clients are forced to use the generic CloudDesk login page. Are there any plans to allow us to upload a logo and apply custom CSS or colors? It is very frustrating that this simple feature is missing.
resolution: Currently, we do not offer native customization for the SSO login interface. We understand that this is an important request for maintaining brand identity, so please share your specific requirements on our public feature roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding. Your feedback helps us prioritize future platform updates.

subject: Slow API response times
body: Our integrations are lagging because the GET /files endpoint is taking over 500ms to respond. This is causing significant delays in our application processing. Please look into this.
resolution: Could you provide specific examples of the calls you are making, including timestamps and endpoints? We recommend using pagination and filtering parameters to reduce the dataset size, as this often resolves performance issues. I will also escalate this to our engineering team for further analysis.

subject: Payment Processing Error when accessing billing via SSO
body: Ever since the recent v4.2 update, whenever I try to manage our billing section using my SSO login, I am hit with an AUTH-BILL-402 error and authentication failed messages. All other admin functions work perfectly fine. A lot of our office staff are experiencing this exact roadblock right now and we need to handle invoices.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password if enabled or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Mobile app login error
body: I am trying to log in but I keep getting a network error. My internet is perfectly fine. The code is MOBILE-NET-500.1.
resolution: Please try force closing the app and checking for any available updates in the app store. If the issue remains, I recommend reinstalling the application to clear any corrupted data. You can also monitor our official status page for updates on service health.

subject: need to update purchase order number
body: hi there i need to update the po number for our billing please because we have a payroll run tomorrow and need it to show correctly. sorry for the trouble thanks.
resolution: You can update your PO number by navigating to the Billing section of the Admin Console and editing the Purchase Order Number field. Please note that this will apply to all future invoices, though it cannot change invoices that have already been generated.

subject: Can't view PDF files for our 5pm presentation
body: I am trying to preview our project files in the web app, but it just shows a blank screen. This is happening for all my PDFs and PPTX files. I am seeing error code PREVIEW-006 every time I try to load them. I need this working immediately because we have a demo at 5pm today. Please help me get this resolved.
resolution: This is likely a temporary issue with our preview rendering service or a browser conflict. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, or try opening the file in an incognito window to rule out extension interference. If the issue persists, ensure the files are not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Cannot access shared workspace
body: I am receiving a PERM-WS-403.4 error when trying to open a specific workspace. I am logged in, but the system denies me access. Could you please investigate why I am locked out?
resolution: An administrator will need to verify your permissions for that specific workspace. Please have them navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console and check the members section to ensure your account has the appropriate access rights assigned.

subject: Mobile app giving network error
body: I cannot get into the mobile app at all. It just says 'Network Error' and refuses to load, despite my internet being perfectly fine. I am seeing error code MOBILE-NET-500.1. Can you help me sort this out?
resolution: Please force close the application and check your app store for any available updates. If that does not help, try clearing the app's cache or reinstalling the app entirely. You might also want to check our status page to ensure all our systems are operational.

subject: New member invite emails failing to deliver
body: I am trying to onboard several new hires to our workspace, but the invitation emails are simply not reaching them. They show as 'Pending' in my dashboard, and I am seeing error code EMAIL-005 repeatedly. It is quite frustrating to deal with this when we are trying to get our team up and running. Please let me know how we can get these invites through promptly.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam or junk folders first. You should also ensure your email domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured to allow emails from our sending domains as described in our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide. If this does not resolve the issue, please provide the specific email addresses of the affected users so we can investigate further.

subject: API pagination parameters not working
body: I am trying to pull a list of users but the API is ignoring my limit parameter. It is really annoying because I keep getting way more results than I need. Is this a known bug?
resolution: Please double-check that your API request is correctly using the limit and offset query parameters as detailed in our documentation. Keep in mind that there is a hard cap on the maximum number of items allowed per request, typically 1000. Ensure your request stays within these bounds for successful execution.

subject: Webhooks are not firing
body: We have set up webhooks for our service, but they are not being delivered. The logs show a connection refused error, and we are not seeing any incoming traffic. Can you help us debug this?
resolution: Please verify your endpoint URL in the Webhooks settings and ensure your external firewall allows incoming traffic from CloudDesk's IP range. Check your server logs to ensure the service is active and reachable from the public internet.

subject: Security risk: read-only API key deletes users
body: We have discovered a critical security vulnerability where an API key generated with limited read-only scopes is successfully performing user deletions. This affects our entire production environment right now and requires immediate intervention. Please advise on this issue promptly.
resolution: Revoke the compromised API key immediately in Admin Console > API Management. Investigate if the key was mistakenly generated with broader permissions initially or if there's an internal process misconfiguration. Acknowledge this is a critical security vulnerability and escalate to engineering if revocation does not resolve the issue or if the scope bypass persists.

subject: Unable to remove user from workspace
body: I am trying to offboard a team member, but I get error CD-AM-014 when trying to remove them from a shared workspace. Can you assist me in removing this user so we can clean up our permissions? Thanks.
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the owner of that workspace. The ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace. Please navigate to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign it before attempting removal.

subject: Desktop app causing performance issues
body: The desktop sync client is consistently using over 50% CPU and huge amounts of memory. I keep seeing error PERF-DSK-001 repeatedly. It is really frustrating to have my system slowed down like this.
resolution: It appears the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. You can fix this by pausing sync, navigating to Settings, selecting Advanced, and choosing Reset Sync Database before resuming.

subject: Audit log retention limit set to 12 months
body: Hello, while attempting to set the audit log retention period in the Admin Console to more than 1 year for compliance purposes, I found the maximum selectable value is strictly 12 months with no option to extend. Many customers are hitting this at the same moment right now. Let us know if there's a workaround.
resolution: The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is indeed 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution such as Splunk or Sumo Logic via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. This is currently tracked as a feature request for extending native retention.

subject: Cannot remove user from workspace because of ownership
body: An admin attempted to remove a user from a workspace today but received an error stating that the user is an owner and cannot be removed. Please advise on how to proceed.
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently the designated owner of that workspace. The ownership must first be transferred to another member of that workspace by navigating to 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership' to reassign it.

subject: Switching to annual billing
body: I would like to update our company subscription to the annual billing option. I tried to do this earlier but it didn't seem to save correctly. Can you assist me with these changes?
resolution: To update your billing cycle, please log into your Admin Console and navigate to Billing, then Subscription Details. You can select Change Plan there to switch to the annual option. The system will automatically adjust your next billing period and credit any unused monthly fees.

subject: URGENT: Permission denied for shared workspace
body: I am being blocked from accessing the primary project workspace with a PERM-WS-403.4 error. This is completely unacceptable as I have a critical presentation at 5pm today that requires these files. Fix this immediately so I can actually do my job!
resolution: An administrator will need to verify your access rights for that specific workspace. Please have them navigate to the workspace settings within the Admin Console, check the member list, and ensure your account has the appropriate permissions assigned.

subject: Cant add users
body: error seat limit reached even tho we have room. fix this please.
resolution: Please check your Pending Invitations in the Admin Console, as these slots count against your total seat limit. You can revoke those old invitations to free up space or increase your plan capacity to add more users.

subject: high cpu usage on desktop client
body: our team is seeing high cpu usage from the desktop client lately even when idle. it seems like it might be the perf-dsk-001 error. can you help us reduce the resource impact on our workstations?
resolution: This often happens if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. Please pause syncing via the tray icon, then go to Settings, Advanced, and click 'Reset Sync Database'. If the high CPU usage continues after resuming, please check if there is an unusually large number of small files in your synced folders.

subject: getting permission denied error on workspace
body: hi there i logged in today on the pro plan but i keep getting a perm-ws-403.4 error when trying to open our shared workspace. i can see it in the list but cannot go inside. could someone take a look when you have a moment thanks
resolution: An administrator needs to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check 'Members' or 'Permissions' and ensure the user is correctly assigned with appropriate access rights.

subject: api key scope bypass security issue
body: Our read-only API keys are currently able to delete users which is a major security breach. This API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS is unacceptable and we need this fixed immediately as it is compromising our data.
resolution: Please revoke the affected API key immediately in the Admin Console. This is a critical security concern, and I have escalated this to our engineering team for investigation. We will update you as soon as we have determined why the scope was bypassed.

subject: Incorrect role names displayed in admin console
body: Hello, I am checking the users and permissions section and noticed some roles are displaying as contributor instead of manager. The actual workspace permissions seem correct so it is just a display glitch showing UI-ADMIN-003. There is no major urgency here and we can wait for a fix.
resolution: Hello. This is a known UI display bug where the actual permissions remain unaffected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again.

subject: High CPU usage from desktop sync client
body: Lately I have noticed that the CloudDesk desktop sync client is taking up over 50% CPU and a lot of memory constantly. No files are actually syncing right now so this seems unusual. Our team is on the enterprise plan and runs this on several machines. We see error PERF-DSK-001 on my machine. It can wait for a bit since it is not crashing anything, but please look into it.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After reset, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: need pdf invoice
body: i need a pdf version of my recent invoice but the admin console only lets me download csv. getting error bill-inv-009 when i try to find other options.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is currently limited during our migration for older billing records. If you provide the specific invoice IDs, we would be happy to generate those PDFs manually and email them to you.

subject: workspace taking too long to load
body: our workspace with over 10k items takes forever to load and shows a blank screen or spinner for ages error workspace_load_timeout appeared
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: API 500 error on GET files content endpoint
body: Hello support team. Our developers are reporting that calls to the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint intermittently return an HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, especially for files stored in geographically diverse regions. All other API endpoints are functioning normally on our free plan. We are seeing API-500 errors repeatedly and it is blocking our development work. Please help us resolve this promptly.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Session keeps expiring unexpectedly
body: Hi there, im having trouble staying logged in today. I log in, but as soon as I try to click on the dashboard it just kicks me out with a Session Expired error. It shows code AUTH-SESSION-401.5 on the screen. No rush on this, just thought I should report it.
resolution: Please try clearing your browser cookies and local storage specifically for cloudesk.com. It is also worth checking that your system time is accurate, as an offset can cause session validation errors. If the issue persists, please let us know if you are using any browser extensions that might block site data.

subject: Role change issues for my team member
body: I was organizing our workspace hierarchy this morning, setting up some new folders and adjusting the tagging system, when I moved a user from Member to Guest. Now they are reporting that they cannot log in to the web application at all and see error cd-am-002. Since I have a lot of other tasks to handle today, I am not in a huge rush to fix this, but it would be good to know what went wrong.
resolution: Guest users are restricted to accessing only the specific workspaces they have been explicitly invited to. Please visit the Admin Console under Team Management to verify if the user has active invitations to any shared workspaces. If they require broader access, you can change their role back to Member at any time.

subject: Unable to update Company Name in settings
body: Hi support, I am trying to update our company name in the Admin Console under Company Settings, but the field seems locked and nothing saves. Thank you for looking into this whenever you have a moment.
resolution: The Company Name is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the Organization Name there to propagate the change to your Company Settings.

subject: need better reports on user activity
body: hi team, we are on the pro plan and admins are asking for more detailed reports on user activity like file downloads views and specific collaboration actions beyond the current audit logs. no rush on this, just wanted to request it when you get a chance.
resolution: we appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking, but for more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting to help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: unrecognized charge on account
body: i see a charge on my credit card that i do not recognize. it says clouddesk but it doesnt match our invoice. need this checked asap. error code BILL-CHG-010.
resolution: I would be happy to investigate this for you. Please provide the exact amount of the charge, the transaction date, and the last four digits of the credit card used. Once I have those details, I can reconcile the transaction against your billing history and provide an explanation.

subject: Azure ad sso reply url mismatch error
body: Hi team our staff cannot sign in using azure ad and keep hitting an error page or reply url mismatch message. This is SSO-AZURE-400 and it is blocking our entire office from working today. Please help us fix this as soon as possible.
resolution: Hello. In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the Reply URL or Assertion Consumer Service URL is correctly configured to match your specific subdomain's ACS endpoint URL exactly.

subject: Requesting more detailed user activity reports
body: We are currently integrating the API and were wondering if there is a way to get more granular activity logs. Specifically, we need to track file downloads and view events beyond what is currently available. Do you have a roadmap for these features?
resolution: We appreciate your interest in expanded reporting. Since our current logs are limited to basic tracking, please post your specific requirements and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This feedback is essential for our team to prioritize these analytics features.

subject: Password reset email not received
body: Dear Support, one of our team members requested a password reset from the login page, but the reset email has not arrived in their inbox or spam folder. We are blocked on an important task and would appreciate your prompt assistance with this matter.
resolution: First, confirm the user's email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Advise the user to check their spam/junk folders. If still not found, ask them to whitelist 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for them via 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password'.

subject: Security concern: API key scope bypass
body: I have discovered that an API key with read-only scope is currently able to delete user accounts. This is a major security vulnerability that needs your immediate attention. We need this fixed promptly to keep our workspace secure.
resolution: Please revoke the affected API key immediately via the Admin Console's API Management section. We recommend reviewing your current permission configurations to ensure keys are generated with the correct scope. If the issue persists after creating a new key, let us know so we can escalate this to our security engineering team.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: I am writing to inquire about an accidental plan upgrade on our Enterprise account. We did not intend to move to the higher tier and noticed the charge this morning, error code BILL-REF-005. Could you please let us know the process for receiving a refund for this transaction? We appreciate your time and assistance in this matter.
resolution: We can certainly review your request for a refund. Please confirm the exact timestamp of the upgrade and verify that no premium features have been accessed since that time. Once provided, we will evaluate your account for a potential reversal of the charges.

subject: Unable to generate new API keys
body: I was just promoted to admin status, but I am unable to generate any new API keys. The option is greyed out and I keep getting CD-AM-013 whenever I navigate to the API access page. I would appreciate it if you could fix this so I can start working on our integrations.
resolution: API key generation requires the 'Super Admin' role rather than standard admin privileges. Please check your role under 'Team Management' in the Admin Console. If you are not listed as a Super Admin, please reach out to your primary account holder to have your role elevated or have them generate the keys for you.

subject: BILLING SSO BROKEN AFTER 4.2 RELEASE
body: WE CANNOT ACCESS OUR INVOICES OR UPDATE PAYMENT METHODS SINCE THE 4.2 UPGRADE! Logging in via SSO keeps throwing AUTH-BILL-402 errors specifically in the billing panel while everything else works. This is completely unacceptable and blocking our financial operations, please fix this right now!
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Desktop client v4.2 SSO token issues
body: Since updating the Desktop Sync client to v4.2, users are prompted to login again every few hours. The logs indicate SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2. Please advise on how to stop this.
resolution: Changes in v4.2 require a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client. Please uninstall the current version, restart your machine, and perform a fresh installation to resolve the token refresh issue.

subject: Audit log retention limit increase request
body: Hello Support, We are currently reviewing our compliance posture ahead of an upcoming audit on Friday. We need to set our audit log retention period in the Admin Console to 5 years, but the maximum selectable value is currently capped at 12 months with error AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT. Please advise on how we can extend this.
resolution: Hello. The maximum configurable audit log retention within the CloudDesk Admin Console is 12 months. For longer retention requirements, we recommend integrating with an external SIEM solution, such as Splunk or Sumo Logic, via our API or SFTP export feature to store logs externally. This is a feature request for extending native retention.

subject: Account suspension notice
body: Our CloudDesk account has been suspended with a BILL-SUSP-007 banner visible in the Admin Console due to an overdue payment notification. Please assist in restoring our service promptly as our team is blocked.
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Invoices' and paying the overdue invoice. Once payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: azure ad reply url mismatch error on login
body: hi team users keep getting redirected to an azure ad error page with reply url mismatch after trying to sign in. error code sso-azure-400 is showing up for everyone trying to access the web app. we have an executive board meeting starting in twenty minutes and need this fixed immediately.
resolution: Hello. In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs' where you replace 'yourcompany' with your actual subdomain.

subject: Missing login attempts in audit logs
body: Audit log incomplete login issue is hiding unusual login patterns. We cannot see failed attempts or new country logins in the standard audit log. Fix this now.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses or locations are actually recorded in the 'Security Events' log rather than the standard 'Login Activity' view. Please navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events to review this information. We also recommend enabling 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic proactive alerts.

subject: Billing payment failed error
body: My sub renewal failed because my card was declined by mistake. I got the email notification and see the payment failed status now. Pls help when you can.
resolution: Please navigate to Admin Console, then Billing, and then Payment Methods to update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank, and you can then retry the payment from the Invoices section.

subject: PREVIEW-006 error showing up for PDF and PPTX files
body: HEY TEAM, none of our pdf or pptx file previews are loading in the web app today. we keep getting stuck on a blank page or infinite spinner with code PREVIEW-006. downloading works fine, but we need the viewer fixed ASAP!!
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: API returning 404 for valid file IDs
body: I am encountering an API-NOTFOUND-404 error when hitting the file resource endpoint. The IDs I am using are definitely correct as they worked yesterday. I would appreciate it if you could investigate why these are failing now. Thank you for your help.
resolution: Please verify your API endpoint path and the HTTP method against our latest v4.2 CloudDesk API documentation. Also, ensure the resource ID is valid and that the API token you are using has the necessary permissions to access that specific folder.

subject: API RATE LIMITS KEEP FAILING US!
body: We are getting 429 Too Many Requests errors constantly during peak hours! API-RATE-429 is breaking our workflows. This is unacceptable!
resolution: Please implement exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client. Review your application's API usage patterns and consider optimizing calls or requesting a rate limit increase via support if justified by legitimate use cases.

subject: Permission denied accessing shared workspace
body: A user logs in successfully but encounters a PERM-WS-403.4 error when trying to open a specific shared workspace. We would like to get this resolved when convenient.
resolution: An administrator will need to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Please navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check the Members or Permissions tab, and ensure the user is correctly assigned with the appropriate access rights.

subject: 401 unauthorized on api tokens
body: After the recent update our custom scripts stopped working returning error API-AUTH-401-V42. Please advise on how to fix this as our integration is currently halted.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: webhooks not working
body: hi we are not getting any webhooks on our side. getting error WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500. could you please check what is happening. thanks.
resolution: Please verify that your webhook endpoint URL is set up correctly in the Admin Console. Ensure your external service is active, publicly accessible, and that your firewall is configured to allow incoming connections from our IP range. Let us know if the issue persists after checking your network settings.

subject: NEED CUSTOM ANNUAL INVOICING BILLING OPTIONS NOW
body: LISTEN TO ME, WE REQUIRE A CUSTOM BILLING ARRANGEMENT WITH ANNUAL INVOICING INSTEAD OF CREDIT CARDS AND A VOLUME DISCOUNT NOT AVAILABLE ON STANDARD PLANS! THIS BILL-FEAT-013 RIDICULOUSNESS IS UNACCEPTABLE FOR OUR ORGANIZATION AND WE DEMAND ANSWERS IMMEDIATELY EVEN THOUGH WE CAN WAIT A BIT FOR YOUR REPLY.
resolution: Hello. For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website. They will be happy to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: Tickets not appearing for assigned agent
body: Helpdesk tickets are not showing up for my agents after I assign them. This is critical as we have a major client deadline tomorrow morning and the team cannot see their tasks. I am getting error code HELPDESK-007 across several different accounts. Please assist immediately.
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: Retention policy not deleting trash bin items
body: I have been working here for years and we keep a lot of files. I set the policy to 30 days for deleted files, but they are still there months later. It is very annoying seeing the RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED error in the logs. Could you help me make sure the trash is actually clearing out?
resolution: Please double-check your security settings to ensure the policy is configured specifically for the Trash Bin. Note that our retention policies focus on permanently deleted files, while items in the Trash Bin remain available for manual recovery unless you specifically define a purge duration for that folder.

subject: Slow search results in specific workspaces
body: Hello CloudDesk Support, I hope you're having a good day. I've noticed that when I try to search for files or folders within a couple of our larger workspaces, the search results take a very long time to appear. Sometimes the spinner just runs indefinitely. It works fine in other workspaces. Any help would be greatly appreciated!
resolution: It sounds like you're experiencing a common issue with larger workspaces. We recommend investigating if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested folder structures. Try using more specific keywords or path-based searches. If feasible, optimizing the workspace structure can also help. Please report the specific workspace ID to us so our engineering team can review its indexing.

subject: API scope bypass issue
body: I noticed that my keys restricted to read-only access are currently able to perform administrative deletions. This is a serious security vulnerability. Thank you for looking into this for us; we need a fix as soon as possible.
resolution: We appreciate you reporting this vulnerability. Please revoke the affected API key immediately in the Admin Console. Our engineering team is currently investigating why the scope bypass is occurring to prevent further unauthorized access.

subject: Need PDF format for invoices
body: I am trying to download my invoices, but the system only provides CSV format. I need them in PDF for our accounting department. Is there an option for this?
resolution: While we are currently experiencing a temporary issue with automatic PDF generation for some older invoices, I can fix this for you. Just send me the invoice IDs you require, and I will manually generate the PDFs and email them over.

subject: Significant lag during collaborative editing
body: We are experiencing a several second delay when editing shared documents with multiple users. It is making it very difficult to coordinate our work. I see the code COLLAB_LAG in the logs. Any insight on how to fix this?
resolution: Please ensure all collaborators have a stable internet connection and try closing any unnecessary browser tabs to free up resources. If the lag persists with fewer active editors, please clear your browser cache to ensure you are running the most recent version of the editor.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in Admin Console
body: Hi team, I am seeing some strange behavior in the dashboard where the user roles do not match what I assigned. The permissions seem to be working fine in the workspace, but the display in the console is showing 'Contributor' instead of 'Manager' for several people. I keep seeing error UI-ADMIN-003 whenever I load the page. Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and your actual permissions remain secure. You can refresh the display by navigating to the user's profile, changing the role to something else, saving, and then switching it back to the correct role. We have a permanent fix arriving in the next patch.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: Hey why is the User Activity report not working? I keep seeing a blank page when I try to run it. I am getting an error REPORT-001. Very annoying please fix.
resolution: It looks like a temporary data retrieval glitch. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, then refresh the admin page to see if the data loads. If it remains blank, please let me know which specific date range you are attempting to view so we can investigate further.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing for new uploads
body: We have a Zap configured for new file uploads, but it stopped triggering entirely. We are receiving ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 errors in the logs. Please advise on how to get this working again.
resolution: Please navigate to your Zapier dashboard and re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh the connection. Ensure the account connected to Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the event stream. You may also want to verify the activity by checking your CloudDesk audit logs.

subject: desktop sync client sso login broken
body: When i try to log into the desktop sync client using sso the browser redirects fine but the app just stays unauthenticated or throws a generic login failed error. Im seeing error code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 on my end. This is getting pretty frustrating since i cant sync my local files properly now.
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to the latest version, specifically v4.2.1 or newer. Check that your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects, and as a temporary workaround, try logging in via email and password if your organization allows it.

subject: Account locked out unexpectedly
body: An account was locked out after standard API integration tests, showing error AUTH-LOCK-429.1. We need this unlocked immediately to unblock our deployment pipeline.
resolution: Instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: Lag while editing documents together
body: Hello support team, when multiple users are editing a CloudDesk Office document simultaneously, there is noticeable lag of several seconds between typing and seeing changes reflected for other collaborators. Cursor positions update very slowly. We are seeing error code COLLAB_LAG on our end. No rush on this since we can wait, just wanted to report it.
resolution: Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and applications to free up resources. Verify if the issue persists when fewer users are editing the document at the same time, and make sure to clear browser cache for all users.

subject: Desktop client causing high CPU and memory usage
body: I have noticed the desktop sync client is consistently running at over 50% CPU. Even when it is sitting idle, the memory consumption remains quite high. I keep seeing error code PERF-DSK-001 popping up in my logs. It is really slowing down my machine while I try to integrate the API. Could you please look into this whenever you have a moment?
resolution: It sounds like your client is caught in a re-indexing loop. Please pause syncing via the tray icon, navigate to Settings, then Advanced, and click Reset Sync Database. Once that is done, you can resume syncing, and it should stabilize.

subject: Credit card payment returning invalid details error
body: We are trying to add a new corporate credit card to our Pro plan billing profile in the admin console. The system keeps returning an Invalid Card Details error, even though the number, expiration date, and CVV have been verified multiple times. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: This issue can sometimes be caused by a temporary glitch with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active on your network and try submitting the card details again after 30 minutes. If the problem persists, try using a different card or contact your bank to ensure there are no blocks on transactions with CloudDesk.

subject: Requesting native Zoom integration for workspaces
body: Our team is constantly switching between CloudDesk and our video conferencing apps. It is very frustrating that we have to manually copy and paste meeting links into our workspace comments every single day. We need a native integration to streamline our workflow. Can you please add support for this?
resolution: While we currently focus on file collaboration, we understand how a video conferencing integration would improve your workflow. Please submit your request and indicate your preferred platforms at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing. This helps our product team prioritize new features based on demand.

subject: Okta SSO token format error in desktop sync client v4.2
body: Users authenticating via Okta SSO on the desktop sync client are encountering an Invalid Token Format error immediately following the v4.2 release. We are on the ENTERPRISE plan and this is currently blocking key engineering personnel. Please provide a fix promptly.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console. They must ensure the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values listed in the admin console under Settings > SSO & Authentication > Okta Configuration.

subject: Google SSO login redirect loop
body: Our team is stuck in a redirect loop when using Google SSO. We keep seeing AUTH-SSO-302.1 after signing in. Can you check on this before our end-of-month reporting deadline tomorrow?
resolution: Please have your users clear their browser cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, or try using an incognito window. If the loop continues, verify your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console. Let us know if you need further assistance with these settings.

subject: Okta SSO login failing across the entire company
