subject: Zapier triggers not firing
body: Our Zaps for file uploads are not triggering, which is causing delays for our 5pm demo today. I am seeing ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 in the console. Could you help us resolve this before our deadline?
resolution: Please try re-testing the CloudDesk trigger step within Zapier to refresh the connection. Ensure the account connected has the necessary permissions to access these events, and you can verify the activity in the CloudDesk audit logs.

subject: User Activity report page is completely blank
body: When I try to access the User Activity report in the admin console on our PRO plan, the page loads but no data is displayed, remaining completely blank. Other reports work fine. I noticed code REPORT-001 on the screen.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Okta login failure after v4.2 update error code AUTH-SSO-401.1
body: Good morning team, our entire company is currently unable to sign in via Okta this morning following the recent v4.2 update. Users are reporting an Invalid SSO token format message with error code AUTH-SSO-401.1. We need this resolved as soon as possible so our staff can access their workspaces. Thank you so much for your prompt assistance with this critical matter.
resolution: To resolve this, please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This step is required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2. Once uploaded, your users should be able to log in normally.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership
body: I am trying to transfer ownership of a workspace to a colleague, but the button is greyed out. I keep seeing an error saying I cannot transfer to a non-owner, which is confusing because they are on the team. I need this done soon, please.
resolution: The user must be an existing 'Member' or 'Admin' of the workspace before you can transfer ownership to them. Please add them to the workspace first, then attempt the transfer via the workspace settings.

subject: Prolonged SSO login loading times and token retrieval failures
body: Following the v4.2 release, our users attempting to log in via SSO experience extremely long loading times, frequently ending in a timeout or failed to retrieve token error. We are observing error code SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2. This issue is impacting multiple team members and we request prompt help to resolve it.
resolution: This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Advise the admin to re-save their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the 'Application Sign On URL' format. Clear browser cache and cookies for affected users.

subject: api rate limits hitting 429
body: hey support team, our integration keeps getting 429 too many requests errors during peak hours today. error code is api-rate-429. thanks so much for checking this out for us whenever you can!
resolution: Please implement exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client. We also advise reviewing your application's API usage patterns to optimize calls or requesting a rate limit increase via support if justified by legitimate use cases.

subject: Account locked out message after failed logins
body: Hello, thank you for your assistance. One of our staff members is seeing an account locked message after entering their password incorrectly a few times. Could someone please help us unlock their access so they can get back to work?
resolution: The account will automatically unlock after waiting fifteen minutes. Alternatively, an administrator can quickly restore access by going to the Admin Console, navigating to Users, selecting Manage User, and clicking Unlock Account.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: Hi there, it seems our team inadvertently upgraded our account to the Enterprise plan. We did not intend to make this change and I would appreciate it if you could look into a refund for the prorated amount. We have a budget review meeting tomorrow morning, so your assistance is much appreciated. We received error code BILL-REF-005 when checking our status.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are assessed on a case-by-case basis. Please confirm the exact date and time of the upgrade and ensure that no specific Enterprise features have been utilized by your team. We will review your account information once you provide those details to determine your eligibility.

subject: getting API 500 errors when fetching files
body: Calls to the get files content endpoint are returning intermittent HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses. This seems to happen mostly for files located in distant regions. Other endpoints are working normally, but we would appreciate it if this could be looked into soon.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Offline mobile editing needed
body: My team requires offline document editing on the mobile app. Currently, we can only view files, which is insufficient for our field operations. This is blocking our productivity and needs to be addressed immediately.
resolution: While the mobile app currently supports offline viewing, offline editing is not yet a supported feature. We acknowledge how important this is for your team's workflow. Please share your feedback or vote for this feature on our roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us push this up our development list.

subject: Audit log export failing for 90+ days
body: I AM TRYING TO EXPORT AUDIT LOGS FOR THE LAST YEAR AND IT KEEPS FAILING. I keep getting an AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED error. We have an external security audit this Friday and I need this data immediately. Please fix this bug right now.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script. Alternatively, please contact our support team for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: UNINTENTIONAL UPGRADE HELP
body: I logged into the admin console to check billing and somehow ended up upgraded to a new plan by mistake. This was not supposed to happen and now I see code BILL-REF-005 on the invoice. Can you reverse this please? I need this fixed soon thanks.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Request for more detailed user activity reports
body: Dear support team, thank you for the wonderful platform. We are currently looking for more detailed reports on user activity like file downloads and views beyond the standard audit logs. Is there any way to access more granular data for our team analytics?
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting, as our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting to help our analytics team.

subject: SSO JIT provisioning not working
body: Hi team, new users logging in via SSO are not being automatically provisioned in CloudDesk, despite Just-in-Time Provisioning being enabled in our settings. This is blocking our onboarding and we need prompt help please. We got error CD-AM-009.
resolution: Please verify that your SSO Identity Provider (IdP) is correctly sending the required user attributes like email, first_name, and last_name in the SAML or OIDC assertion. Also, ensure there are available seats in your CloudDesk subscription. Check 'Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings' for any recent configuration changes or errors.

subject: API returning 500 errors on file downloads!
body: Our development team is completely blocked right now because calls to the get files endpoint are intermittently failing with an internal server error, especially for files stored across different regions. Other endpoints work fine, but this is severely impacting our client deliverables today and we need prompt help! We keep seeing API-500 errors.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are currently investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a permanent fix in an upcoming hotflash.

subject: Issues logging into the web app using Google SSO
body: I have been working on integrating your API into our internal portal, and I noticed that while our team uses a variety of devices, we are consistently seeing the AUTH-SSO-302.1 error code. We try to click the login button, navigate to the Google prompt, and then the browser just keeps spinning. I have tried several times this morning, but I end up in a redirect loop. Could you help me look into this?
resolution: Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, or test this in an incognito window. If the loop continues, verify your Google SSO settings within the Admin Console. These steps should clear the AUTH-SSO-302.1 error and restore your access.

subject: Can't view PDF or PPTX files in web app!
body: Every time I try to preview a PDF or PowerPoint file on CloudDesk today, the screen just spins endlessly or shows a blank white page! We are on the PRO plan and this is completely blocking our team from reviewing documents today. Error code PREVIEW-006 keeps flashing on my screen. Please fix this promptly so we can get back to work!
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue persists, ensure the specific file is not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Users from specific domains cannot log in via Google SSO
body: Hi team, some of our team members are experiencing issues logging into the web app using Google SSO, getting a Domain not allowed message. This is happening for specific domains while others work fine, and we see error code SSO-GOOGLE-403. No real rush on this as we can wait, but please check when you have a moment.
resolution: Please navigate to the CloudDesk Admin Console, open the 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, and review the 'Allowed Domains' list. You will need to add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: API Client Not Authorized Error on REST Calls
body: Hello, our finance team is setting up a new internal integration using the CloudDesk REST API. However, all calls are currently failing with a 403 Forbidden error and the API-AUTH-403.5 code, despite using a valid API key. Please advise on how to resolve this authorization issue.
resolution: Confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes/permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: SSO login page shows default branding
body: We noticed our custom logo and background are missing from the SSO screen. Everything else works fine, but our users see the default branding instead. SSO-UI-200.2.
resolution: Please navigate to the 'SSO & Branding' section of your Admin Console to ensure your assets are still properly uploaded. Once you confirm they are saved, have your users clear their browser cache to see the changes.

subject: API workspace sharing returns 403 Forbidden error
body: Why are our API calls to share a workspace returning an HTTP 403 Forbidden error? Our API key user has the Manager role and all required permissions. This is blocking our deployment and needs immediate attention.
resolution: Ensure the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Also, verify that the user associated with the API key is a direct member of the workspace being shared, rather than only having access via a group. If the issue persists, provide your API key ID and workspace ID for further review.

subject: Assigned tickets not showing up
body: My agents cannot see tickets assigned to them in the My Assigned Tickets view! This is a massive problem for our support workflow. We are seeing helpdesk-007 errors. Fix this immediately!
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Please advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies and log back in. If that does not work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, and then assign it back to the original user.

subject: Unable to transfer workspace ownership in admin console
body: Hello support team. I am trying to reassign ownership of one of our company workspaces to another team lead, but the transfer option is greyed out. We are on the Pro plan and encountered error CD-AM-004 when attempting this action. Please advise on how to proceed.
resolution: Hello. Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a Member or Admin of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member, then attempt the transfer via Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade refund request
body: We accidentally upgraded our plan recently and would like to request a refund for the prorated difference. Thank you so much for your help with this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Nested Azure AD groups mapping request
body: Hello CloudDesk team, thank you for your ongoing support. After upgrading to v4.2, our engineering team is looking to map nested groups from Azure AD to our workspaces for provisioning. We want to know how to set this up as it is currently blocking our user rollout plan. Thank you!
resolution: Following the SSO token format change in v4.2, our current Azure AD SSO integration supports direct group mapping but not nested group resolution. We are aware of this limitation and are evaluating solutions on our roadmap. A potential workaround in the meantime involves flattening your Azure AD groups.

subject: Newly invited user getting User Not Found error
body: We have an urgent issue where a newly invited user attempts to log in with their email and password but encounters an AUTH-NF-404.1 error. This is completely blocking their onboarding and needs immediate resolution.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation, and check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if your company has multiple accounts.

subject: Downloads are extremely slow lately
body: Hi there, hope you are having a nice week. We noticed that when people download files shared via public links or workspace collaborators pull down assets, the speed is much slower than expected. It is not urgent at all, but would love any tips when you get a chance.
resolution: You can test download speeds using a different browser or network, and check if any active browser extensions might be interfering with downloads. For very large files, we recommend using a download manager or sharing via the Desktop Sync client for more robust transfers.

subject: we need more storage without paying
body: our team is hitting the storage limit way too fast on the free tier. we are a small non profit and cannot afford an enterprise subscription right now. please increase our storage limit immediately because this is ridiculous!
resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with invalid token error
body: Hello, we are seeing an AUTH-402 error when trying to log in via Okta after the v4.2 update. Our users are getting stuck in a loop on the login page. Could you please provide some guidance on this? We need this fixed soon as it is blocking our developers' workflows. Thank you for your time.
resolution: This stems from the SSO token handling changes in version 4.2. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk integration in your Okta console to ensure the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match our new v4.2 configuration guide values.

subject: API permission denied for data export
body: Our integration is failing with a 403 Permission Denied error when calling the /v1/users/{userId}/data/export endpoint. This was functioning correctly until recently. I see the error API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED in our logs. Please advise on how to restore access.
resolution: Effective recently, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions for security reasons. A 'Data Steward' API role is now required for this endpoint. Please generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in the Admin Console under API Management.

subject: New users cannot log in with password
body: We invited several employees today but they keep getting a User Not Found error when trying to access the web app. Some are getting the AUTH-NF-404.1 code. I am sure I sent the invites correctly but no one can get in.
resolution: Please verify the email addresses listed in the Admin Console to ensure they match what the users are entering. Check to see if the invitation was actually accepted, and if not, try resending it. Also, please confirm that your users are logging into the correct instance URL for your company account.

subject: MFA setup failing on mobile
body: We are trying to enable MFA for our staff via the mobile app but keep getting a 'Failed to register MFA device' error after scanning the QR code. This is a consistent issue for our users. We would appreciate a fix when possible.
resolution: This is a known issue regarding the MFA registration flow within the mobile application. As a solution, please have your users complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web application under 'Security' settings. Once configured there, the MFA will work seamlessly for both web and mobile logins.

subject: CloudDesk Sync is using way too much memory
body: the sync client is constantly spiking to 2gb of ram and making my pc crawl. i am seeing SYNC_HIGH_RESOURCE_USAGE in the logs. i need this fixed because its slowing down my work significantly.
resolution: Check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed. Advise user to pause sync, restart their computer, then resume sync. If persistent, suggest disabling sync for non-critical folders or temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks. Check for conflicting antivirus software.

subject: requesting refund for accidental upgrade
body: Hi, we accidentally upgraded our plan and would like to request a refund. We are seeing error bill-ref-005. Is it possible to get this reversed? Thanks for your help.
resolution: Refund requests for accidental upgrades are reviewed on an individual basis. Please provide the specific date and time the upgrade occurred and confirm that no features associated with the new plan have been used. We will examine your account activity to determine if a refund can be processed.

subject: Requesting a dark mode option for the web app
body: Our finance team spends long hours reviewing documents in CloudDesk. The current bright white theme is causing significant eye strain for everyone in the department. Is there a way to enable dark mode, or is this feature planned for a future update?
resolution: Thank you for reaching out about this. We currently do not offer a native dark mode in the web app, but we understand how important it is for comfort. Please cast your vote for this request on our roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/dark-mode so we can prioritize it accordingly.

subject: App crashes when uploading large files
body: Hello support team, whenever we try to upload files larger than 1GB from the mobile app, it instantly crashes without any error message. This is affecting our entire executive team right in the middle of our crucial investor presentation prep today at 5pm. We would greatly appreciate a prompt fix for this critical issue.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client while our development team works on a fix.

subject: Cannot find invoices older than 12 months
body: Hi there, I am trying to pull some tax documents and I cant seem to see any invoices from before last year. I keep getting a BILL-INV-003 message when I try to search the archives. Could you help me locate these records? Thanks for your time.
resolution: Our console currently shows invoices from the last 12 months by default. Please reply with the specific invoice IDs or the approximate dates you are looking for, and I will be happy to pull those from our secure archives for you.

subject: Adding new members on Enterprise plan showing seat limit error
body: Hope you are having a pleasant week so far. I was just reviewing our company subscription details over coffee while waiting for my team to arrive, and I noticed we still have several available seats left. However, when attempting to add new team members today on our enterprise account, I keep getting an error message saying that the seat limit has been reached, sometimes flashing error code CD-AM-001. There is no rush on this since we can wait until next week, but I wanted to mention it.
resolution: Please check your 'Pending Invitations' count by going to 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Keep in mind that pending invitations still count toward your total seat limit. You can either revoke any old pending invitations that are no longer needed or upgrade your enterprise plan to increase your overall seat capacity.

subject: Requesting hardware-based MFA support
body: Our security team is very frustrated that we cannot use hardware keys like YubiKey with CloudDesk. We need more than just software-based MFA to meet our compliance requirements. When will you support this?
resolution: We understand the importance of hardware-based MFA for your security needs. While we currently only support authenticator apps and email verification, you can submit a request and track status at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize these updates based on customer demand and industry security standards.

subject: Critical failure accessing custom OAuth 2.0 applications
body: We are currently experiencing a complete outage with our custom OAuth 2.0 applications, which are returning the OAUTH-AUTH-401 error. This is a critical issue as we have a major stakeholder demo at 5pm today and our entire pipeline is currently blocked. We need this resolved immediately to avoid significant disruption to our workflows.
resolution: Please double-check that the Client ID and Client Secret in your application configuration exactly match the values in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Watch for hidden spaces or incorrect character casing, as the OAUTH-AUTH-401 error is usually triggered by a credential mismatch.

subject: New user login failing
body: We invited a new team member and they get AUTH-NF-404.1 when trying to sign in. This is completely blocking them from working. Why is this happening?
resolution: I have looked into this for you. Please verify the email address used in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was successfully accepted. If the user is still having trouble, ensure they are logging into the correct instance URL for your account.

subject: Switching to annual billing
body: We would like to move our subscription to an annual billing plan. Could you let us know the steps to complete this change?
resolution: You can easily switch your billing cycle by heading to the Admin Console and selecting Subscription Details under the Billing menu. From there, choose the annual option for your current plan. The adjustment will take effect at the start of your next billing period, with any remaining monthly credits being prorated.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content endpoint
body: We are experiencing severe disruptions as GET files content calls are returning 500 Internal Server Errors intermittently across regions. This is affecting our production deployment scheduled for this afternoon.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Jira integration sync issues
body: We are seeing JIRA-SYNC-403 errors when attempting to sync our projects. It seems like the integration is failing to recognize our projects entirely. We have time to troubleshoot this later in the week, but please let us know what the fix is when you have a moment.
resolution: Please verify that the Jira API token or the specific user account configured for the CloudDesk integration has the 'Browse Projects' and 'Create Issues' permissions enabled. You may need to update these settings within your Jira instance to allow CloudDesk to access the required data.

subject: User Not Found error for new login
body: Greetings, thank you for your continued support with our Pro account. A newly invited user attempts to log in with their email and password on the desktop-sync client but receives an AUTH-NF-404.1 error stating User Not Found. Many of our new onboarding cohorts are hitting this at the same moment right now. We want this sorted out when convenient. Best regards.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Retention policy for trash bin not working
body: We set a 30-day retention policy, but the trash bin is still full of files from months ago. It seems like the system is completely ignoring the RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED error status we are seeing. It is frustrating to have to clear this manually. Could you please explain why this is happening?
resolution: Please note that policies apply primarily to files in a 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery unless you have specifically configured the settings to purge the Trash Bin after a certain number of days.

subject: MOBILE APP CRASHING ON UPLOADS
body: I am trying to upload 1GB+ files from my phone and the app crashes every time without any warning! This is causing major delays in our project timelines. I am seeing crash-mob-001 repeatedly. Please help me resolve this immediately as it is blocking our work.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue affecting large file uploads on the mobile app. As a workaround, please use the CloudDesk web application or the desktop sync client to upload these files. Our engineering team is currently working on an optimization for a future app release.

subject: search spinner hanging
body: searching in specific workspaces is just hanging and spinning forever. i am trying to find critical files and this is very frustrating. error WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG.
resolution: Please check if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested folder structures, as this impacts search performance. We advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches to improve speed. Please provide the specific workspace ID to our support team so we can perform an indexing review.

subject: Offline editing feature request for mobile
body: My team is struggling to keep up with work while traveling because they cannot edit documents offline. When will the mobile app support offline edits with a sync once a connection returns? We really need this capability added to our workflow.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: Switching enterprise billing cycle to annual
body: We would like to switch our current subscription from monthly billing to annual billing so we can get the discount. Please update our account whenever you get the chance.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, navigate to the Admin Console, go to Billing, open Subscription Details, and select Change Plan. Choose the annual option for your current tier, and the change will automatically apply at the start of your next billing period with any unused credit prorated.

subject: Accidental upgrade refund request
body: We accidentally upgraded our plan to a paid tier. I would like to request a refund for the charge since we did not mean to change our subscription. No rush on this.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account.

subject: New user cannot log in - User Not Found
body: I invited a new colleague this morning, but they keep getting a User Not Found error when they try to sign in with their password. They are quite frustrated that they cannot start their work. Is there something wrong with the system today?
resolution: Please check the Admin Console to verify that the email address was entered correctly and that the invitation was accepted. Sometimes users may accidentally attempt to log into a different instance URL if your organization has multiple accounts. If everything looks correct, try resending the invitation to their email address.

subject: Assigned tickets not showing in My Assigned Tickets view
body: Hi support, when tickets get assigned to a specific agent here, they cant see them in the My Assigned Tickets view inside the web app. Admin accounts can see everything fine though. Error code HELPDESK-007 was mentioned by one of our team leads. Could you help us look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: Slack channel notifications not showing up
body: Hello support team, I noticed that our file share notifications are not coming through to our designated Slack channel this morning. It is not a huge rush since we are managing fine, but I wanted to report it whenever you have a moment. Thank you so much for your help with this little matter.
resolution: Please check the Slack integration settings in your CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify that the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected, and ensure the CloudDesk Slack app has the proper permissions to post in that channel within Slack.

subject: Need advanced folder permissions
body: It is extremely frustrating that we cannot set granular permissions within shared folders. We desperately need options like view-only with the ability to comment, or upload-only for specific sub-folders, without giving full access. When will this be added?
resolution: We understand the need for more granular permission controls. Currently, our permissions are applied at the folder level. Please submit your specific requirements for advanced granular permissions at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions so our product team can design the most effective solution.

subject: Request for workspace creation API endpoint
body: With the move to the new SSO token format in v4.2, we are updating our scripts. We really need an API endpoint that allows us to programmatically create and configure workspaces for our automated client onboarding. Is this something you have on your roadmap?
resolution: While we updated our SSO handling in v4.2, an API endpoint for programmatic workspace creation is not currently available. You can continue to manage workspaces manually through the Admin Console for now. We encourage you to submit your detailed requirements for this functionality to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements/workspace-creation-api so our product team can review the request.

subject: Admin Console Users & Groups load time is slow
body: Hello CloudDesk team, thank you for providing such a wonderful Enterprise platform for our organization. We have noticed lately that navigating to 'Users & Groups' in the Admin Console takes several minutes to load the full user list, occasionally throwing the ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT error. Filters and search also respond rather slowly. Many of our administrators are hitting this at the same moment right now. There is no urgency on our end since it can wait, but we appreciate any assistance you can provide whenever you have time.
resolution: Advise using the 'Search' bar or applying specific filters (e.g., 'Status: Active') immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset. The system is optimized for filtered views on large datasets. Suggest navigating directly to a specific user via search if their email is known.

subject: Inconsistent billing data via API
body: Since upgrading to v4.2, the data returned by our API calls does not match the Admin Console reports. We are seeing the error code API-BILL-401 consistently. Please fix this soon as we rely on these metrics for our internal reporting.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated how certain usage metrics are aggregated. Please verify that your API queries align with the parameters outlined in our latest documentation. If you are still seeing discrepancies, please send us the exact API query and a screenshot of the conflicting report for review.

subject: Mobile document preview failing before audit
body: Hello support, we are experiencing MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL errors when trying to view PDF and DOCX attachments inside the mobile app. We have a major compliance audit on Friday morning, so we really need this preview issue resolved before then.
resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version. Check the user's device storage and network connection. Advise clearing the mobile app's cache (via device settings). For very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: Unrecognized charge on our account!
body: I am looking at our credit card statement and there is a charge from CloudDesk that I simply do not recognize. This is holding up our monthly reconciliation and I need this cleared up immediately. I am seeing the error code BILL-CHG-010. Please look into this right away.
resolution: I apologize for the confusion regarding this charge. To help me investigate, please provide the exact amount, the date of the charge, and the last four digits of the credit card used. Once I have those details, I will cross-reference them with your billing history and clarify the charge for you.

subject: nested groups not working in 4.2
body: since the update to 4.2 our azure ad group mapping is broken because it wont resolve nested groups. this is very frustrating for our admin team. how do we fix this mapping issue.
resolution: Following the SSO token format change in v4.2, our current Azure AD SSO integration supports direct group mapping but not nested group resolution. We are aware of this limitation and are evaluating solutions. Please add your use case to roadmap.cloudesk.com/v4.2-enhancements/nested-azure-ad-groups. A potential workaround might involve flattening your Azure AD groups.

subject: Password reset email not received
body: I am trying to reset my password on the desktop app but the email never arrives. I have checked my spam folder multiple times. My other email services are working fine, but I see error code AUTH-PR-200.1. Please assist.

subject: sync client stuck connecting
body: desktop app says connecting indefinitely and nothing is syncing. tried restarting twice. error code SYNC_STATUS_STUCK is visible in the logs. please check.
resolution: Instruct user to restart the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache: go to 'Settings' > 'Advanced' > 'Clear Cache'. If still unresolved, suggest a full reinstall of the client after backing up local unsynced files.

subject: Admin Console Access Denied Error Code ADMIN-AUTH-403.3
body: I am an administrator on our PRO plan and I cannot open the Admin Console. Every time I try to log in, it gives me error ADMIN-AUTH-403.3 or kicks me back to the standard user dashboard. I need this fixed soon please.
resolution: Please confirm the user's role in the Admin Console under Users, Manage User, and Roles to ensure they have an Admin or Super Admin role assigned. If not, update their role accordingly to restore access.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: Hi, our team is having some trouble logging in with Google. It just keeps looping back to the login page after we authenticate. We are seeing AUTH-SSO-302.1 when checking the console. Thanks for any advice.
resolution: This issue is often resolved by clearing your browser's cache and cookies specifically for 'cloudesk.com'. If the loop continues, please attempt to log in using an incognito window or a different web browser. Additionally, please double-check that your Google SSO settings in the Admin Console remain correctly configured.

subject: Slow workspace search results
body: The search function in a couple of our specific workspaces is either taking forever or just hanging indefinitely with the spinner. I noticed the error WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG keeps appearing. It is not urgent, but it would be nice to have it working properly when you have a moment.
resolution: This behavior often occurs in workspaces with an unusually high volume of files or deeply nested folder structures. Please try using more specific keywords or path-based searches to improve performance. If the issue continues, please provide the specific workspace ID so our engineering team can review the indexing status.

subject: New contractor getting user not found error
body: Hello support team, our newly invited contractor is trying to log in and seeing AUTH-NF-404.1. We would appreciate your prompt assistance when possible.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console to confirm if the invitation was sent and accepted. If it remains pending, please resend the invitation, and double-check that they are attempting to log into the correct instance URL.

subject: helpdesk ticket view broken

resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: api keys suddenly failing

resolution: I understand the impact this is having on your operations. Please check the status of your API keys in the Admin Console under the API Keys section to see if they were revoked or have expired. You may need to regenerate a new key and update your application to restore connectivity.

subject: Users keep getting logged out after v4.2 update
body: Hi, ever since the v4.2 update our team is getting hit with SSO-REFRESH-401-V42 errors constantly. users are being forced to re-auth every 30 minutes, its causing massive disruption to our workflow and we have a deadline today. we really need a solution now as productivity is basically at zero.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token refresh mechanisms. Please check your IdP application settings for CloudDesk to ensure a 'Refresh Token' policy is enabled and configured for a duration like 8 to 24 hours. This should prevent the premature session expiration you are experiencing.

subject: Mobile app cache not clearing on logout
body: Files stay on our mobile devices even after logging out. It says MOBILE_APP_CACHE_PERSISTENCE. Is there a way to force clear this as it is a security risk for us.
resolution: The mobile app caches files for offline access by design. You can manually clear this in the app settings under Storage, or enable 'Clear cache on logout' in the same menu. This setting is off by default, so please ensure it is toggled on for your users.

subject: Missing documents in search results for enterprise workspace
body: When searching for specific keywords within files or folder names in the web app, the search results are incomplete or missing relevant documents that are known to exist and accessible to our team. We are seeing error SEARCH-002 on some requests. We have a major client audit on Friday and need this resolved so we can locate compliance records. Please advise.
resolution: This can sometimes be due to an outdated search index. Please try performing a more specific search, such as using an exact phrase in quotes. If the issue persists, log out and log back in, which can trigger a re-indexing for your account. If still unresolved, provide specific search terms and expected results for investigation.

subject: Existing API key returning unauthorized error
body: Hello team. Our API calls using an existing API key are returning a 401 Unauthorized or Invalid API Key error. This key was working previously without any issues. We see error code API-AUTH-401.4 in our logs. It looks like many customers are hitting this at the same moment right now. There is no major urgency on this, as we can wait for a resolution.
resolution: Hello. Thank you for reaching out regarding the API authentication error. Please verify the API key's status in the Admin Console under the 'API Keys' section and check if it has expired or been revoked. We advise you to regenerate a new API key if necessary and update your application accordingly.

subject: Admin console users list loading very slowly
body: Navigating to Users and Groups in the Admin Console takes several minutes to load for our large company. We have a crucial payroll run tomorrow and need this fixed urgently. Thank you so much for your assistance.
resolution: We advise using the Search bar or applying specific filters like Status: Active immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset. The system is optimized for filtered views on large datasets.

subject: custom billing arrangement request

resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop

resolution: The redirect loop is likely caused by stale browser authentication data. Please clear your cache and cookies for our domain and try again in an incognito window. If that fails, an admin should verify your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: Public link expiration time is too short

resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we do not plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration in future updates. For permanent sharing right now, please consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Cannot find invoices older than a year
body: Hello, I am trying to export some old financial records from the Admin Console but I can only see the last 12 months. Is there any way to access older billing documents? Thanks for your time.
resolution: The Admin Console interface is designed to display invoices from the last 12 months for quick access. For any historical invoices older than that, please reply with the specific dates or IDs you require. We will then retrieve those documents from our archives for you.

subject: Critical Okta SSO login failure blocking finance team

resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: File preview viewer shows blank page

resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Users locked out due to SSO token format error
body: Since the v4.2 release, our employees are seeing CD-AM-003 errors when using their SSO credentials. Nobody can log in to do their work. Please fix this promptly as it is blocking our entire team.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced a new SSO token schema that requires configuration changes. Please update your SSO application settings in your identity provider to align with the requirements detailed in our CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide.

subject: Urgent audit log review missing recent login locations
body: We have an emergency security situation right now and need to check suspicious login patterns from new countries, but our standard Login Activity audit log only shows successful logins. We cannot see any of the failed attempts or unknown device locations, and this is critical for our PRO account compliance. We are heavily impacted by AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN right now and require immediate assistance to investigate this potential breach.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses or locations are actually recorded in the Security Events log rather than the Login Activity tab. Please navigate to Admin Console, then Security and Compliance, and open Security Events to find this information. We also strongly recommend enabling Login Anomaly Detection right away for automatic future alerts.

subject: Desktop Sync keeps asking for SSO re-auth

resolution: The v4.2 update changed how we handle tokens. Please perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client. If that doesn't help, your IdP administrator should review the token lifetime settings.

subject: Critical error with SSO after v4.2 update

resolution: We apologize for the disruption. Due to the SSO token format change in v4.2, you must update your configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Please re-upload your IDP metadata to ensure the platform recognizes the new token structure.

subject: Integration team SSO redirect loop issue

We are seeing AUTH-SSO-302.1 pop up occasionally. It is not urgent right now, but we wanted to report it for your tracking.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

We are not ready to upgrade to a higher tier yet, but we need more space immediately. Is there any way to increase our limit without moving to a paid plan?
resolution: Thank you for your feedback regarding our storage limits. Our current tiers are designed to provide a solid starter experience, and we do not have plans to increase storage on the free tier at this time. We encourage you to explore our paid plans for additional storage and enhanced team features.

subject: Missing comments in user data export

resolution: The standard GDPR export tool captures file and folder metadata but does not include task-level comments. To retrieve these, you will need to go to each specific task and use the 'Export Activity Log' button found in the activity tab. We apologize for any confusion regarding this workflow.

subject: audit log retention limit too short
body: hi i need to set our audit logs to 5 years for compliance but the admin console only lets me select 12 months. is there a way to extend this? getting an AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT error when i try to force it.
resolution: The current maximum native retention in the Admin Console is 12 months. For your 5-year compliance requirement, we recommend exporting logs via our API or SFTP to an external SIEM solution like Splunk. We have noted this as a feature request for future updates.

subject: Workspace loading times are too slow
body: One of our larger workspaces with over 10,000 files is failing to load properly. The screen stays blank for over 30 seconds and we are getting a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error. This is really slowing down our developers. Can you assist?
resolution: This is likely due to the high volume of files in that specific workspace. We suggest using the search functionality or filtering options to narrow down the view to improve performance. For long-term stability, consider breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones.

subject: User Activity report not loading in admin panel
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report, but it stays blank after I click load. I am getting a REPORT-001 error code. Please let me know how to get this data.
resolution: This is often caused by a temporary data retrieval snag. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, then try accessing the report again. If it remains blank, let me know the specific date range you are querying.

subject: User deletion request stuck on pending
body: Hello, I submitted a request to delete a user account from the Admin Console two days ago, but the status remains pending and no confirmation email has arrived. We are seeing error code USER_DELETE_PENDING on the screen. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: Verify the user's status is 'Inactive' before requesting deletion. If the user is active, the deletion will be queued. If inactive and still pending, check the System Status page for background job processing issues, and if no issues are found, provide the user's email and deletion request ID for investigation.

subject: Search function hanging in specific workspaces
body: The search bar in one of our main workspaces is stuck loading indefinitely. I am not seeing this in other areas, but it is currently preventing me from finding necessary project documents. Is there a way to force the index to update?
resolution: This behavior often occurs in workspaces with highly complex folder structures or a massive number of items. Please try using more specific search terms to narrow the results, and let us know the workspace ID so our engineering team can review the index status.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed in admin console
body: An administrator reported that some users' roles, such as Contributor instead of Manager, are incorrectly displayed in the Users and Permissions section of the admin console. The users' actual permissions in workspaces appear correct, but the display is wrong. This is a minor UI-ADMIN-003 glitch and we can wait for a fix.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug where the actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: Search function hanging in specific workspace
body: Hello, I am having trouble with the search feature in one of our project workspaces. Whenever I try to search for a file, the spinner just runs forever. It is showing the error WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG. Could you please look into this when you have a moment? Thanks for your help.
resolution: Thank you for the report. It appears this workspace may contain a high volume of items or deeply nested folders that are affecting query performance. Please try using more specific keywords for now, and I will escalate your workspace ID to our engineering team for an indexing review.

subject: Accidental upgrade refund request
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful week so far. While testing out our API integration today, I somehow accidentally clicked the button to upgrade our subscription tier. I wanted to see if it might be possible to get a refund for the prorated difference since we did not mean to change tiers. Thank you so much for your time and help with this matter.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: MFA setup error on mobile application
body: Users trying to setup Google Authenticator MFA via mobile app get failed to register mfa device error after scanning qr code. Email password login works fine. Please advise when possible.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Cannot generate API key in Admin Console
body: Hello, thank you for your assistance. I am a newly promoted administrator trying to generate an API key under security settings, but the option is greyed out with an insufficient permissions error. Could you please help look into this?
resolution: API Key generation requires the 'Super Admin' role. While the user may be an 'Admin', they might not have 'Super Admin' privileges. Confirm their role in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. If not 'Super Admin', the current Super Admin must generate the key for them or elevate their role.

subject: Billing card update failing
body: We receive BILL-PAY-012 when adding a new corporate card. All details are verified and correct. Please assist urgently.
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again after 30 minutes. If the issue persists, try using a different card or contact your bank to ensure there are no blocks on transactions with CloudDesk. You may also try contacting us with the full error message for further investigation.

subject: Frequent SSO re-authentication prompts in desktop client
body: Hello, our team recently updated to version 4.2 of the Desktop Sync client. We are noticing that users are getting kicked out and asked to log in again very often. The logs show SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 repeatedly. We would appreciate it if you could look into this for us, as it is becoming a minor distraction.
resolution: This stems from updated SSO token handling in v4.2. Please perform a clean reinstall of the desktop client by fully uninstalling, restarting your machine, and then installing the latest version. If you continue to see the error, your SSO administrator should review the IdP token lifetime settings or regenerate the client secret in the Admin Console.

subject: Critical API 500 errors breaking our production!
body: We are experiencing severe issues today where calls to the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint intermittently return a HTTP 500 Internal Server Error. This is happening mostly for files stored in geographically diverse regions and is blocking our daily operations. Please provide prompt assistance to resolve this API-500 problem immediately!
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. Please note that our team is currently investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: Hello. Users from our newly acquired subsidiary domain cannot log into the web app via Google SSO, receiving a domain not allowed error code SSO-GOOGLE-403. Other domains work fine, but this specific one is blocked. Please let us know how to resolve this so our developers can proceed.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, check the 'Allowed Domains' list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: Microsoft Teams integration request
body: Hi there. Thank you for providing such a great collaboration tool. Our team was wondering if there are any plans to add a direct integration with Microsoft Teams for sharing files. We currently use webhooks, but a native integration would be amazing. Thanks again for your help.
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper, direct integration is not yet available. Please vote for this integration or add your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams. We are constantly evaluating new integrations based on customer demand.

subject: issue with audit log export range
body: Hi im trying to export audit logs for the last 6 months but getting error AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. I need this for an audit on Friday. Can you please help me fix this quickly?
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is currently limited to 90 days. For longer date ranges, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script to retrieve your records. If API access is not feasible for your audit, please let us know so we can perform a manual data pull.

subject: billing error after sso login
body: ever since v4.2 update, admin users logging in via sso get authentication failed in billing section. error code AUTH-BILL-402. this is blocking our finance operations, please help promptly.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Switching subscription to annual billing

resolution: You can update your billing cycle by navigating to the Admin Console, selecting Billing, then Subscription Details, and finally Change Plan. Choosing the annual option will apply the change at the start of your next billing period, with any remaining credit prorated accordingly.

subject: Missing search results in web app
body: Hi team, I am having trouble finding documents I know are in our shared folders. The search bar isnt returning them, and I saw a SEARCH-002 error code yesterday. Could you please take a look when you have a moment?
resolution: This can happen when the search index gets outdated. Please try searching with the exact phrase in quotes, or log out and back in to trigger a re-index. Let us know if you still can't find your files after that.

subject: Account Locked error when logging in
body: I am unable to access my account because it says it is locked! I have not entered my password incorrectly enough times to warrant this. I keep seeing error AUTH-LOCK-429.1 and I am very frustrated. Please unlock my account immediately!
resolution: We apologize for the inconvenience. Your account will automatically unlock after 15 minutes have passed. Alternatively, one of your company's administrators can manually unlock your account right now via the Manage User section in the Admin Console.

subject: Mobile app crashes uploading large files

Smaller files go through just fine, but these larger uploads fail immediately without showing an error message. This is affecting multiple contractor devices on different networks and is blocking our current delivery timeline. Please look into this promptly. Reference code is CRASH-MOB-001.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Slack notifications not appearing in channel
body: Our file share notifications have completely stopped working and we are seeing SLACK-NOTIFY-500 errors in our admin console. This is incredibly frustrating as we rely on these alerts for our daily operations. Please fix this as soon as possible!
resolution: Please navigate to your Slack integration settings within the CloudDesk Admin Console to verify your workspace and channel selection. Ensure that the CloudDesk Slack app still has the necessary permissions to post to that specific channel. Testing the integration again after checking these settings should resolve the issue.

subject: Billing section failing after recent release
body: Good day. Since the recent v4.2 update, whenever our admins attempt to manage billing or update payment details via SSO login, they encounter a frustrating authentication issue. We appreciate any help you can provide to get our invoicing views working normally again.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email and password, or clear your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists, consider using a direct email login for billing management while we investigate the SSO integration.

subject: Accidental subscription plan upgrade

resolution: We understand this can happen and are happy to look into this for you. Please confirm the exact date and time of the upgrade and verify that none of the new features have been utilized by your team. We will then review your account to determine eligibility for a refund.

subject: Repeated session expiration on web app
body: Hello, I am experiencing frequent logouts while trying to use the web application on our Pro plan. Upon logging in, I immediately encounter a session expired message with code AUTH-SESSION-401.5, preventing me from staying on the dashboard. This is a minor inconvenience that we can look into whenever you have free time.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cookies and local storage for cloudesk.com. Check if the user has strict privacy settings or browser extensions that might be interfering with session cookies. Verify system time on user's device.

subject: Severe typing lag during simultaneous document editing
body: When multiple team members edit a CloudDesk Office document together, we experience several seconds of lag before changes appear. Cursor movements are also heavily delayed. Please let us know how to resolve this.
resolution: Hello. Please check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs, verifying if the issue persists with fewer concurrent editors, and clearing browser caches.

subject: Assigned helpdesk tickets missing from view
body: Hi team, when a helpdesk ticket is assigned to an agent, that agent cannot see the ticket in their 'My Assigned Tickets' view in the web app. The ticket is visible to administrators, but blocking our agents' workflow right now. Please provide prompt assistance with error HELPDESK-007.
resolution: Hello! This is typically caused by a permission caching issue. Please advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies and log back in. If that does not work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, and then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: Admin console access denied error
body: Hello support team, I am trying to access the Admin Console for our Pro account but keep getting redirected or seeing admin-auth-403.3. This is blocking our administrative tasks today, so your prompt help would be greatly appreciated. Thank you!
resolution: Please confirm the user's role in the Admin Console by going to Users, Manage User, and then Roles. Ensure they have an Admin or Super Admin role assigned, and update their permissions if necessary.

subject: OAuth 2.0 tokens failing with invalid_client
body: Our custom integration is currently failing to obtain access tokens and returns invalid_client or client_secret_mismatch errors. We are seeing OAUTH-AUTH-401 when testing endpoints. Please advise on how to resolve this.
resolution: Hello. Please verify that the 'Client ID' and 'Client Secret' used in your custom application exactly match the credentials generated in the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'API & Integrations' -> 'OAuth Clients'. Pay close attention to case sensitivity and any extra spaces.

subject: Locked out of my account
