resolution: Instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: Desktop sync client causing massive CPU usage
body: Good afternoon support team, thank you for all your help. The desktop sync client is currently causing high CPU usage above fifty percent and heavy memory consumption on my machine even when nothing is syncing. This is blocking my work because we have a major client demo at 5pm today and my laptop is freezing up. Could you please look into error PERF-DSK-001 right away.
resolution: Hello! This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon, then go to Settings, select Advanced, and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After the reset finishes, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: Desktop Sync reporting authentication error after password update
body: I recently updated my account password through the web interface, and now the desktop application is failing to sync files. It keeps showing the error code CD-AM-015 and will not connect to our server. This is currently blocking our team from accessing their local files. Could you please provide instructions on how to re-authenticate the sync client? Your assistance with this would be greatly appreciated.
resolution: Please open your Desktop Sync application and select the CloudDesk icon in your system tray to access the settings menu. From there, choose 'Log Out' to disconnect your current session. Once you log back in using your updated password, your files should begin syncing correctly again.

subject: Request for file upload webhooks
body: Our development team is looking for a way to get notified when files are uploaded to specific workspaces. Currently we are having to poll the API which is not ideal. Is there any way to implement a webhook for new file uploads? We really need this to improve our sync latency.
resolution: While we currently only support polling, we are interested in your use case. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including the desired payload, at our public roadmap site so our team can evaluate the request.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with invalid token format
body: Hello CloudDesk Support, ever since the recent v4.2 platform update, our team members trying to log in via Okta SSO are getting bounced back to the login page with an Auth-402 error. This is halting our entire workforce right now and we urgently need a fix to restore access as soon as possible. Thank you so much for your prompt help!
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise the customer's IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide (accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration').

subject: Workspace deletion failing with integration error
body: We are trying to delete a workspace in the admin console but it fails with CD-AM-007 active integrations detected. We have a major company audit starting on Friday so we need this cleaned up promptly.
resolution: Before a workspace can be deleted, all active integrations (e.g., Slack, Jira, Zapier) linked to that specific workspace must be disconnected. Navigate to 'Workspace Settings > Integrations' for the affected workspace and disable/remove all listed integrations, then retry deletion.

subject: Webhook delivery failures
body: Hi team, our webhooks arent reaching our external service right now and the logs show some delivery errors. We are on the free plan and can wait for a reply. Thank you so much for your help.
resolution: Hello. Please verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings. Confirm the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range.

subject: Account locked out
body: Hi, one of my users entered the wrong password and is now seeing an Account Locked message. They cannot get back in even with the right credentials. We see error code AUTH-LOCK-429.1. Is there a way to unlock this quickly?
resolution: The lockout will expire automatically after 15 minutes. Alternatively, an administrator can unlock the account immediately via the Admin Console under the Users menu.

subject: Mobile app crashes on large file uploads
body: The mobile app consistently crashes without any error message when trying to upload files larger than 1GB. Smaller files work fine. This is blocking our team's daily workflows completely. We need a prompt fix for crash-mob-001.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: SSO login failing on desktop sync client with error
body: When attempting to log into the desktop sync client using SSO, the browser successfully redirects, but the client remains unauthenticated or shows a generic login failed error with code DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. We have an executive board meeting starting in one hour and our team cannot access shared documents. We need this fixed immediately.
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer), as token formats changed in version 4.2. Additionally, check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As an immediate workaround, suggest logging in via email and password if SSO is currently causing blocks.

subject: Workspace member invitations not delivering
body: Good morning team, thank you for providing such a wonderful platform. We have been inviting several new team members to our workspace this morning, but none of them are receiving their invite emails, though the status shows as pending. There is no major rush since we are just testing things out, but we wanted to report it. Have a great day!
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: sync client eating all cpu and memory
body: clouddesksync exe is running over 50 cpu and taking more than 2gb memory even when nothing is happening. error code SYNC_HIGH_RESOURCE_USAGE. please fix this now because our whole team cannot work like this.
resolution: Please check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed by the client. We advise pausing sync, restarting your computer, and then resuming sync. If this is persistent, try disabling sync for non-critical folders or checking for any conflicting antivirus software.

subject: Okta SSO user attribute mismatch
body: We are getting a 'User attribute mismatch' error every time we try to log in via Okta. This is blocking our entire department from accessing their files. We need this solved now please. Error code is SSO-OKTA-403.
resolution: Please check your Okta application settings to ensure 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' are mapped correctly to the CloudDesk profile fields. Verify that 'email' is set as the unique identifier for the user account.

subject: Request for more storage space
body: Our team has hit the storage limit on our current plan and we need an increase immediately. We are currently using the free tier but require more capacity to continue our project work. Please increase our quota as soon as possible.
resolution: Thank you for your feedback regarding storage limits. The current capacity is designed for our starter tier, and we do not have plans to increase free storage at this time; please consider upgrading to one of our paid plans.

subject: File preview viewer not loading correctly
body: I was just organizing my desktop and drinking my coffee when I noticed my team reported trouble with file previews. Specifically, PDF and PPTX files just show a blank screen or a loading spinner that never goes away, citing error PREVIEW-006. It is a bit frustrating because the download button still works fine, but the preview is definitely broken. Could you take a look at this whenever you have a moment?
resolution: This behavior is often tied to temporary rendering service issues or local browser data. Please start by clearing your browser cache and cookies, or try opening the link in an incognito window to rule out browser extensions. If the problem persists for a specific file, please confirm it is not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: User cannot log into web app
body: One of our team members is unable to sign in to the web platform. They are getting an error stating insufficient permissions after their role was changed to Guest. Is there something we need to adjust for them to gain access again?
resolution: Guest users are restricted and can only access workspaces they have been explicitly invited to. Please check the Admin Console under Team Management to verify their current role and existing invitations. If they require broader access, you will need to change their status back to Member.

subject: New user receiving User Not Found on login
body: We invited a new team member today, but when they try to log in with their credentials, they get AUTH-NF-404.1 errors. We need this resolved so they can access files before the board meeting prep at 4pm.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm that the invitation was sent and accepted. If necessary, resend the invitation and check if they are logging into the correct instance URL for your company.

subject: Zapier trigger for new uploads not firing
body: Hi there, I was setting up some automations this morning while drinking my coffee and realized that our integration isn't working right. Specifically, the Zap configured with the CloudDesk new file uploaded trigger just sits there and is not firing properly. I think it might be throwing zapietr-trigger-404 or something similar. Could someone take a look at this connection issue when you get a chance.
resolution: In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events, and check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: api keys stopped working
body: api-auth-401.4 error on my end. my existing key just stopped authenticating. fix this please.
resolution: Please check your API key's status in the 'API Keys' section of the Admin Console. It is possible the key has expired or been revoked. You may need to regenerate a new key and update your application settings to restore access.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: After authenticating with Google SSO, users are stuck in a redirect loop and never reach the CloudDesk dashboard. We see error code AUTH-SSO-302.1 in the network logs. Please look into this when you have a chance.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cache and cookies for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise trying an incognito/private window or a different browser. Verify the Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console.

subject: we need dark mode pls
body: my eyes hurt from looking at this bright screen all day. when are you adding a dark mode option to the web app? we need this badly.
resolution: Thank you for your feature request! Dark Mode for the CloudDesk web app is a popular suggestion. We currently do not have a dark mode available. Please vote for this feature on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/dark-mode to help us prioritize it.

subject: deleted user still showing in shares
body: deleted a user account earlier on our free plan workspace but cd-am-006 shows their email is still appearing in sharing dialogs everywhere. can you look into this?
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as ghost entries in historical share lists until the system purges them or until a workspace owner explicitly removes them from a share via Workspace Settings > Members.

subject: Need direct Microsoft Teams integration urgently
body: Hi there, I am completely fed up with having to manually copy and paste file links back and forth into Microsoft Teams all day long. Our entire office on the free plan relies on Teams for daily communication and this missing native integration is seriously slowing down our entire project workflow right now. Please tell me when this will be added because we need it working today.
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper, direct integration is not yet available. Please vote for this integration or add your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams. We are constantly evaluating new integrations based on customer demand.

subject: API pagination limit parameter ignored
body: Hey, pagination on our free tier api calls is completely broken and ignoring limit parameters. This API-PAGINATION-500 issue is driving me crazy.
resolution: Ensure your API request correctly uses the 'limit' and 'offset' query parameters as specified in the CloudDesk API documentation. Note that there might be a hard cap on the maximum 'limit' allowed per request (e.g., 1000 items).

subject: Slack notifications not appearing
body: Our file share notifications are not coming through to our Slack channel. We are seeing SLACK-NOTIFY-500 errors in the logs. Could you check if there is an issue with the integration on your end?
resolution: Please navigate to the Slack integration settings within your Admin Console to verify that the correct workspace and channel are selected. Additionally, ensure that the CloudDesk Slack app has the necessary permissions to post to that specific channel from within the Slack application settings.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report but it just loads as a blank page! I cant see any data at all and it is really annoying. I am getting the error REPORT-001. Please fix this soon, I am not in a huge rush though.
resolution: It looks like you are hitting a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before refreshing the page. If that does not work, please try using a different browser, and let me know if the page remains blank.

subject: SSO Just-in-Time provisioning not working for new users
body: Hello support team, new users logging in via SSO are not being automatically provisioned in CloudDesk, despite Just-in-Time Provisioning being enabled in our settings. We are seeing error code CD-AM-009 intermittently. This is blocking our onboarding process for new hires this week, so we would appreciate prompt assistance.
resolution: Verify that your SSO Identity Provider is correctly sending the required user attributes like email, first_name, and last_name in the SAML or OIDC assertion. Also, ensure there are available seats in your CloudDesk subscription. Check Admin Console, Security, and SSO Settings for any recent configuration changes or errors.

subject: payment failed alert
body: we got an email saying our auto renewal failed with a BILL-PAY-002 error because of a declined card. please help us fix this when you get a chance.
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: API calls returning Client Not Authorized error
body: Hello team, we are trying to use the CloudDesk REST API for our integration, but every request getting rejected with 403 Forbidden. We see code API-AUTH-403.5 in our logs. This is blocking our integration work completely and we have a client presentation at 3pm today. Please help quickly.
resolution: Please confirm that the API key being used has the necessary scopes and permissions assigned for the specific API endpoints being called. An administrator can review and adjust API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: Zapier trigger not working
body: The CloudDesk trigger in Zapier is not firing anymore. I see the error code ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404. Please resolve this.
resolution: Please go into Zapier and re-test your CloudDesk trigger step to refresh the connection. You should also verify that the connected account has the correct permissions to view those specific events. Check your CloudDesk audit logs to confirm the event was triggered on our side as well.

subject: Account locked out
body: One of our developers is locked out of their account and we are on a strict deadline today. We keep seeing the Account Locked message. Can you please help us unlock this immediately?
resolution: The account lockout typically expires after 15 minutes of inactivity. Alternatively, you can resolve this immediately by having an administrator navigate to the Users section of the Admin Console and selecting the option to unlock the account for that specific user.

subject: GDPR export missing file comments
body: I performed a GDPR data export, but it seems the file comments are missing from the package with error GDPR_EXPORT_INCOMPLETE_COMMENTS. The rest of the data looks fine, but we need those comments. Any help would be appreciated.
resolution: The standard GDPR export covers file and profile data, while comments are stored as activity metadata. To retrieve those specific comments, please navigate to the file or task, open the Activity tab, and select the Export Activity Log option for that item. There is currently no bulk export tool for comments.

subject: User login failure: AUTH-NF-404.1
body: A new team member is unable to access their account after receiving an invite, receiving error AUTH-NF-404.1. This is currently affecting several of my team members who are trying to start their work. We have a company-wide audit this Friday, so I need this resolved as soon as possible. Could you please investigate why they are not being found?
resolution: Please verify that the user's email address is correctly entered in the Admin Console and that they have formally accepted the invitation. If the invite was missed, please resend it from the user management dashboard. Also, ensure they are attempting to log into the correct instance URL for your company.

subject: Requesting a plan downgrade
body: We would like to downgrade our subscription to a lower tier due to changes in our team size. Please let me know the steps to complete this process.
resolution: You can change your tier by navigating to Admin Console > Billing > Subscription Details > Change Plan. Keep in mind that the new plan will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: Hi, Im trying to pull a report for User Activity but the page loads and is just white. Nothing shows up. Im seeing error REPORT-001 in the console. Do you guys know why this is happening?
resolution: This issue is often caused by a temporary data retrieval snag within your browser's session. Please try clearing your cache and cookies, or opening the admin console in a different browser to see if that resolves the REPORT-001 error. If it remains blank, please provide the specific date range you are attempting to access so we can investigate further.

subject: zapier trigger not working
body: my zap isnt triggering when files are uploaded anymore. started noticing it after the update. getting ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 error. can you check it out?
resolution: In Zapier, please re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection to our platform. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. You can also check the CloudDesk audit logs to confirm if the expected event is being registered.

subject: Azure AD SSO login failing
body: Some of our staff are unable to sign in and are receiving an error about an incomplete user profile. It seems to be related to AUTH-SSO-403.2 and it is completely blocking our team from accessing their files today. I would appreciate your help in getting this resolved so we can get back to work.
resolution: It appears your Azure AD claims might not be mapped correctly to our system. Please have your IT administrator verify that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' attributes are correctly configured in your Azure enterprise application settings. You can find our detailed Azure AD setup guide in our help documentation.

subject: cant customize sso login branding colors
body: im trying to update our sso login page with our company logo and brand colors but i cant find the option anywhere. this is really frustrating because we need everything to match our corporate identity and its taking way too long to figure out. please tell me where this is.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available. We recognize this as a valuable feature for many enterprises. Please add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding. We will notify you of any updates.

subject: Critical delay loading user lists before payroll run tomorrow
body: Navigating to Users & Groups in the admin console is taking several minutes to load our employee roster, and error ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT is appearing. We need this working promptly for our payroll run tomorrow.
resolution: Hello. Please use the 'Search' bar or apply specific filters like 'Status: Active' immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset. The system is optimized for filtered views on large datasets, and you can navigate directly to specific users via search if their emails are known.

subject: Detailed usage telemetry and download reports integration
body: Hello, I am integrating the API and setting up our webhook listeners, which has been quite an interesting journey through various protocols, but it made me think about audit logging. We were wondering if we could get much more granular details on user activity like specific views and downloads beyond what is currently logged. Take your time getting back to us as there is no rush.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Request for Microsoft Teams integration
body: Our team would like to know if there is a direct integration available for Microsoft Teams. We need to share files directly into our channels to streamline our collaboration process. This is currently a blocker for our workflow. Please let us know if this is on the roadmap.
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper direct integration is not yet available. Please feel free to add your specific requirements to our roadmap page at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams. We prioritize new integrations based on direct customer demand.

subject: billing api data doesnt match console
body: ever since we upgraded to v4.2 the billing api endpoint is returning usage reports that completely disagree with our admin console and past data. error code api-bill-401 keeps showing up and its throwing off our internal tracking. please fix this soon.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as per the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, please provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for review.

subject: DESKTOP SYNC LOGIN FAILING WITH SSO ERROR
body: I am trying to log into the desktop sync client using our company SSO on my free account, but the browser just loops and the app shows error DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 with a generic login failed message! This is completely blocking our team from accessing shared files right before our critical investor presentation at 5 PM today. Please fix this immediately so we can get back to work.
resolution: Please make sure your desktop sync client is updated to the latest version v4.2.1 or newer. Also, check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects properly. As a temporary workaround if SSO continues to fail, you can try logging in via your standard email and password.

subject: Desktop Sync client is using over 2GB of memory while idle
body: Hello team, thank you for your hard work on CloudDesk. I noticed today that the CloudDesk Sync process is consuming a massive amount of memory, well over 2GB, even when nothing is being actively synchronized. This is causing significant slowdowns on my machine and blocking my daily work. Could you please help me look into this issue promptly?
resolution: Please check if there are a large number of pending changes or very large files being processed by the app. We advise you to pause sync, restart your computer, and then resume sync. If the issue is persistent, try disabling sync for non-critical folders or temporarily pausing sync during intensive tasks, and verify that your antivirus software is not conflicting with the client.

subject: invite emails not going out
body: Hello team, im trying to add new people to our workspace for our upcoming demo at 5pm today and the invites keep showing as pending without any emails arriving. We are getting error EMAIL-005 on our end. Thanks so much for taking a look at this when you can
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: Webhooks not being received
body: Hi, our webhooks are failing with WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500. It seems the connection is being refused. Can you look into this when you have a moment, its not a big rush.
resolution: Please verify your webhook endpoint URL within the Admin Console. Also, ensure your external service is reachable from the public internet and that your firewall allows incoming traffic from our IP range as listed in our documentation.

subject: API tokens failing with 401 after v4.2
body: Hello support, thank you for your continuous support. After upgrading to v4.2, our existing API tokens that worked previously are now returning 401 Unauthorized with a legacy token format error. This is currently blocking our automated integrations, so we would appreciate your prompt assistance.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Cannot downgrade subscription plan
body: I need to downgrade our account plan to a lower tier. The current settings are not allowing this change. Please fix this.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, please navigate to the Admin Console, then go to Billing, Subscription Details, and finally Change Plan. Please keep in mind that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle, and we do not issue prorated refunds for unused time.

subject: Unable to update payment method with valid credit card
body: We are currently unable to update our billing information in the admin console. Every time we submit our card details, we receive an 'Invalid Card Details' error despite verifying all information is correct. This is impacting our account status, and we require a prompt resolution. Please let us know if there is a known issue with the gateway.
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary communication issue with our payment processor or restrictions from your card issuer. Please ensure that you do not have an active VPN connection and wait about 30 minutes before trying again. If the problem persists, we recommend attempting a different payment method or contacting your bank to confirm they aren't blocking transactions from us.

subject: Slow API response times on GET files
body: Hello, endpoints like GET /files are taking over 500ms consistently today. This is delaying our client app and blocking our current sprint work. Please investigate promptly.
resolution: Please provide specific API call examples including endpoints, request bodies, and timestamps. We advise optimizing API calls by using pagination and filtering parameters to reduce the dataset returned, and suggesting caching frequently accessed data on your end.

subject: Too many unnecessary email notifications
body: I am very frustrated because I receive emails for every single comment. I only want to be notified when someone mentions me. There is no option to change this, and my inbox is always full. Can you fix this?
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding notification granularity. For now, you can manage basic settings in your profile, but please submit your specific requirements to our feature request board at roadmap.cloudesk.com so our product team can prioritize these updates.

subject: S3 export failing with invalid credentials
body: Our automated data export to S3 is broken since the v4.2 update. I keep seeing S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401 errors even though our keys have not changed. Please investigate this immediately as it is blocking our data pipeline.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced stricter IAM policy requirements for S3 integrations. Please review the updated integration guide and ensure your IAM role includes the new s3:GetBucketLocation permission. This should resolve the authentication issue you are experiencing.

subject: Google SSO login failing for specific domain
body: Users on our secondary domain are unable to log in via Google SSO. They keep getting a permission error code SSO-GOOGLE-403. Our primary domain works fine. Can you help?
resolution: It looks like the secondary domain has not been added to your permitted list yet. Please navigate to the 'SSO & Identity' section in the Admin Console and add the missing domain to the 'Allowed Domains' list to enable access.

subject: Severe lag during simultaneous document editing
body: We are experiencing terrible lag while multiple team members try to edit a document together. Cursors take forever to update and typing shows up seconds later for everyone else, throwing error COLLAB_LAG. This is completely unacceptable right now because we have an urgent company demo at 5pm today and need this fixed immediately.
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved. Advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs/applications. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document. Clear browser cache for all users.

subject: Audit log export failing for long date ranges
body: I am trying to pull audit logs for the last four months but the export keeps failing. I assume there is a limit, but I need this data for my records.
resolution: The Admin Console is currently limited to 90-day exports. For longer ranges, please use our API endpoint to pull the data or reach out to us if you need a manual report.

subject: Admin console User Activity report shows no data
body: Hello, I am reaching out because our administrator is trying to access the User Activity report in the admin console, but the page remains completely blank with no data displaying. All of our other administrative reports load and function properly. Thank you in advance for your help with this matter.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering, and please provide the date range you are trying to view if the page remains blank.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Hello, I am an external contractor working on this platform and I requested a password reset via the login page but the email has not arrived in my inbox or spam folder. This error code CD-AM-008 is blocking my work completely. Please look into this promptly so I can continue.
resolution: First, confirm the user's email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Advise the user to check their spam/junk folders. If still not found, ask them to whitelist 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for them via 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password'.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: I am unable to reset my password as I never receive the reset email, despite checking spam. I have received other notifications from CloudDesk today, so I know I am not blocked. I am seeing error code AUTH-PR-200.1 when I try. This is blocking my work and I would appreciate your prompt help.
resolution: Please check your organization's allowlist to ensure no-reply@cloudesk.com is permitted as an approved sender. I have verified your status and manually triggered a password reset for your account to resolve this immediately.

subject: API key generation option is greyed out
body: Hello there, I was just talking to our IT director about our upcoming systems integration project when I tried to generate an API key via Admin Console > Security > API Access for our newly promoted administrator, but the option is greyed out.
resolution: API Key generation requires the 'Super Admin' role. While the user may be an 'Admin', they might not have 'Super Admin' privileges. Confirm their role in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. If not 'Super Admin', the current Super Admin must generate the key for them or elevate their role.

subject: Deleted user still visible in workspace sharing
body: Hello CloudDesk team! I recently deleted a user account on our free plan, but their name and email are still showing up in the sharing dialogs for various workspaces. It is not an urgent matter at all, but I wanted to bring it to your attention. Thank you so much for your wonderful service and support!
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as ghost entries in historical share lists until the system purges them, typically within 24-48 hours, or until a workspace owner explicitly removes them from a share via Workspace Settings > Members. This is expected behavior.

subject: Missing audit log search results for file access
body: Hi there. As an external contractor helping with audits on our Free plan, I was searching for specific file access events in the log search interface, but some expected items are missing. It is not urgent at all, but I wanted to mention it. Appreciate any guidance you can provide whenever someone gets a chance.
resolution: Please ensure correct filters are applied for User Email, Event Type File Access, and File Share. Note that View events are only logged for public links or external shares, not internal workspace views. For internal views, check the file's individual activity feed.

subject: New user receiving User Not Found error
body: A newly invited team member is getting an AUTH-NF-404.1 user not found error when attempting to log into the web app with their credentials. Please investigate.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation and check if they are logging into the correct instance URL.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error
body: Hello Support, users from our specific domain cannot log in via Google SSO anymore and keep receiving a 'Domain not allowed' error message, even though other domains work fine. This is causing a lot of confusion in our office. Please let me know how we can resolve this issue whenever you have time.
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's 'SSO & Identity' settings for Google SSO, check the 'Allowed Domains' list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: Helpdesk ticket assignment view failing
body: My agents cannot see tickets assigned to them in the web view. The HELPDESK-007 error is constant. This is blocking our support capacity right now. Fix this now.
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Please advise your team to clear their browser's cache and cookies before logging back in. If the issue remains, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to another user and then back to the original agent to reset the view.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy - BILL-INV-001
body: This is ridiculous. My latest invoice shows 15 active users, but we only have 10 currently. This is leading to overcharges for services we aren't even using. I'm a developer and I know how to check active users in the admin console. Why is this so hard? Fix this now.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: cant transfer workspace ownership option greyed out
body: im trying to transfer ownership of a primary team workspace to a new lead, but the option is completely greyed out and giving error CD-AM-004. this is extremely annoying because we have a major client demo at 5pm today and need this permissions structure sorted out immediately.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already designated as a Member or Admin of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is already a member of the workspace. Once you add them, you can successfully complete the transfer via Admin Console, Workspaces, [Workspace Name], Settings, and Transfer Ownership.

subject: Slack channel notifications not triggering
body: We have noticed that our file share notifications are no longer appearing in the assigned Slack channel. I am seeing the error SLACK-NOTIFY-500 consistently today. It seems this is affecting our entire team's workflow. When you have a moment, could you look into this for us?
resolution: Please navigate to your Admin Console and re-verify your Slack integration settings to ensure the correct workspace and channel are linked. You should also check within Slack that the CloudDesk app still has the necessary permissions to post in that specific channel. These steps should restore your notifications.

subject: Cannot set audit log retention
body: I am extremely annoyed that I cannot set our audit log retention to 5 years. The system gives me error code AUDIT_RETENTION_LIMIT whenever I try to go beyond 12 months. This is a critical compliance requirement for our company.
resolution: Currently, the maximum native retention period in the CloudDesk Admin Console is limited to 12 months. For your compliance needs regarding multi-year storage, we suggest integrating with an external SIEM solution like Splunk or Sumo Logic using our API or SFTP export feature. This allows you to store your logs externally for as long as your policy requires.

subject: API File Content Endpoint Intermittent 500 Errors
body: Every time our systems call the GET files id content endpoint, it randomly crashes with a 500 Internal Server Error, especially for files stored across different global regions. It is driving us crazy because all other API endpoints work fine. We need this fixed right away because it is completely blocking our daily operations.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be effectively bypassed by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. Our engineering team is also actively investigating the underlying distributed storage retrieval root cause for a future hotfix.

resolution: Advise the administrator to narrow down the filter criteria as much as possible, starting with smaller date ranges. For specific user activity, use the 'User Activity' report in the 'Reports' section, which is optimized for single-user queries. If extensive historical data is needed, suggest exporting the full log and filtering locally.

subject: s3 export stopped working after update

Please review your AWS IAM policy and ensure it includes the 's3:GetBucketLocation' permission as detailed in our latest integration guide. Updating these permissions should resolve the S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401 error.

resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise the customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones and verify the browser console for any network errors.

subject: Seat limit reached error while adding users
body: I am trying to add team members to our account but the console says the seat limit is reached. My dashboard clearly shows we have open seats available. I am receiving the CD-AM-001 error code. Could you please resolve this so I can finish the onboarding process?
resolution: Please check your 'Pending Invitations' in the Team Management tab. These invitations count toward your seat limit even if they haven't been accepted yet, which is likely triggering the CD-AM-001 error. Revoking these pending invites should free up your capacity.

If they require full access, you will need to update their role back to Member.

You should also audit your usage patterns to see if calls can be consolidated. If you still require higher limits after optimizing, please contact us with your specific use case.

subject: Webhook hmac verification failing constantly
body: our automated billing integration is breaking because webhooks are returning hmac verification failed errors code WEBHOOK-SIGN-403 we need this sorted out immediately as its blocking our payment processing
resolution: Ensure the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the Webhook Secret configured in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify your signature verification algorithm matches CloudDesk's standard HMAC-SHA256.

subject: Wrong roles displayed in admin console
body: hi there, i noticed that some users show up as contributors in the user permissions page but they are actually managers. checked the workspaces and their access is fine, but the dashboard is showing the wrong role. im seeing UI-ADMIN-003 when i hover over some of them. no major rush, just wanted to flag it since it looks weird.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and your actual permissions are not affected. You can temporarily fix the display by navigating to the user's profile, changing their role to something else, saving, and then changing it back to the correct role. We are working on a permanent fix for a future release.

subject: Desktop sync client not updating files
body: Since the v4.2 update, my files are not syncing at all. The web app is fine but my desktop client is completely broken and shows error SYNC-001. This is very frustrating as I cannot access my files locally.
resolution: Please uninstall the v4.2 client and clear your local sync cache in the AppData or Application Support folders. Once done, reinstall the latest client from the download link in your web app settings.

subject: Pending Invitation status stuck for new user
body: Hello, a newly invited colleague clicked their email invitation link, but their status in the Admin Console remains as Pending Invitation. They are unable to log in to our PRO workspace. Thank you for your help.
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set (if any). If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and send a new one.

subject: JIT provisioning failing for new SSO logins
body: Hello Support, we rely on Just-in-Time provisioning for our identity provider integration, but new users logging in via SSO are not being automatically created in CloudDesk. This is causing significant administrative overhead and blocking our new team members from accessing their workspaces today. Many companies are experiencing this exact provisioning breakdown right now following recent token changes. Please investigate error code CD-AM-009 immediately as it is impacting our onboarding workflow.
resolution: Verify that your SSO Identity Provider (IdP) is correctly sending the required user attributes (email, first_name, last_name) in the SAML/OIDC assertion. Also, ensure there are available seats in your CloudDesk subscription. Check 'Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings' for any recent configuration changes or errors.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content endpoint
body: Hello Support, our development team is experiencing recurring HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors when calling the GET files content endpoint. This is heavily impacting our workflow across multiple regions and we need a prompt resolution. We look forward to your quick response on this matter.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Trouble with API key returning invalid error

It worked fine yesterday when we tested it before lunch. Whenever you have a spare moment, could someone take a look at this when it is convenient?
resolution: Please verify the API key's status in the Admin Console under the 'API Keys' section to check if it has expired or been revoked. You can regenerate a new API key if necessary and update your application accordingly.

subject: Data export failing with 403
body: Our automated data export scripts are suddenly failing with an API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED error today. We have used this Admin scope for months without issues. Why is this happening now?
resolution: As of our recent update, the 'Admin' scope no longer grants access to data exports. You will need to generate a new API key with the specific 'Data Steward' role assigned via the Admin Console to restore access.

subject: Need better folder permissions now

This lack of control is preventing us from organizing our project documents correctly. I need this functionality immediately because it is blocking my team's workflow. resolution: We understand the need for more granular permission controls. Currently, our permissions are applied at the folder level. Please submit your specific requirements for advanced granular permissions at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions to help our team design the most effective solution.

subject: User Activity report showing no data

resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, please provide the specific date range you are trying to view.

subject: Webhook delivery failure notifications
body: Hello CloudDesk support team, I hope you are having a wonderful day. resolution: Please verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's Webhooks settings. Confirm that the external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range.

subject: Multiple API endpoints returning HTTP 503 errors during peak hours

resolution: We are currently investigating your API usage patterns to determine if requests are exceeding established rate limits by checking the X-RateLimit-Remaining header. We strongly advise implementing exponential backoff protocols for your retry logic. Please check our CloudDesk status page for any broader platform incidents, and we will escalate this directly to engineering if limits are not being breached.

subject: Request for video conferencing integration

resolution: While we currently focus on file sharing and project collaboration, we understand how video integration would improve your workflow. You can easily share meeting links within comments for now. Please submit your specific platform requests at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing so our product team can assess demand for future partnerships.

subject: api error 403 sharing workspace

resolution: To resolve the API-403 error, please confirm that your API key includes the 'Manage Workspaces' scope and that the associated user is a direct member of the target workspace. If you continue to see issues, please provide the API key ID and the specific workspace ID so we can investigate further.

subject: Updating PO number for invoices
body: Hi, we need to add a new purchase order number for our upcoming invoices for accounting purposes. Please let us know how to update this when you have time.
resolution: You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: Request for new file upload webhook

resolution: Thank you for reaching out with this request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet available. Please submit your detailed proposal for this feature, including the desired payload structure, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so our engineering team can review it.

subject: API requests failing with 401 unauthorized
body: Dear support, our integration is suddenly throwing 401 Unauthorized errors with expired token messages. This is currently blocking our executive team's workflow, so we would deeply appreciate your prompt assistance with this matter.
resolution: Please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the authorization header of your requests.

subject: Mobile app offline editing request
body: I was just looking at our mobile workflow, and our team often finds themselves in transit or in areas with spotty Wi-Fi. resolution: Currently, our mobile app supports offline viewing for starred files, but full offline editing is not yet available. We understand this is a major productivity blocker for your team. Please add your vote to the feature request on our roadmap page so we can prioritize this development.

subject: preview viewer showing blank page for pdf and pptx files

resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: request for hardware mfa support

resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email, but we are actively tracking requests for hardware token support. Please add your vote and specify your hardware preferences at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We review these requests regularly to align our security features with customer requirements.

subject: Slow search performance in specific workspaces
body: We have noticed that searching for files in some of our larger workspaces is incredibly slow. The spinner just runs forever. It does not happen everywhere, just in a few high-activity workspaces. We have the error code WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG in our logs. Any help is appreciated.
resolution: Some workspaces with extremely deep folder structures or millions of files are experiencing temporary search indexing delays. Please try using more specific keywords or path-based searches to see if that helps narrow it down. If you can provide the specific Workspace ID, I will have our engineering team review the indexing for that location.

subject: Admin Console Access Issue
body: Hi there, I am trying to access the Admin Console to manage our team but I keep getting a redirect to the dashboard. The error code ADMIN-AUTH-403.3 keeps showing up on my screen. Thanks so much for your help with this, I hope to get it sorted soon.
resolution: Please navigate to the Users section in your Admin Console to review your current role settings. Ensure your profile is correctly assigned as an Admin or Super Admin, which should resolve the access error. If you are still seeing that code after verifying your permissions, please let us know.

subject: Files not syncing after v4.2 update
body: Our desktop sync client stopped showing updates from the web app after we updated to version 4.2. I am seeing SYNC-001 error and it is really blocking my team's workflow. We love the product, but could you please help us get this working again quickly? Thanks for your support.
resolution: It sounds like a cache conflict following the v4.2 update. Please uninstall your current desktop sync client and clear the local cache folder located in your AppData or Library support directory. After clearing the cache, please reinstall the client using the latest download link found in your web app's settings.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card statement

resolution: To investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide full details on the charge.

subject: Switching subscription from monthly to annual billing
body: Hello Support, I hope you are having a wonderful day. We would love to switch our subscription plan from monthly to annual billing to take advantage of your annual discounts. There is no rush on this request, as we are just planning ahead for next quarter. Thank you so much for your help.
resolution: Hello. To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan'. Select the annual option for your current plan, and the change will take effect at the start of your next billing period, with any unused monthly credit prorated.

subject: need more file versions

resolution: We understand your frustration regarding file versioning limits. Currently, those settings are in place to ensure optimal storage and system performance. Please visit our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com to submit your specific requirements for versioning so our product team can review the demand.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card statement

resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

If the invitation was never accepted, you should resend it to the contractor. Additionally, confirm they are using the correct company instance URL to log in.

subject: sync client creating duplicate conflict files everywhere

resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: Workspace loading times are too slow

We have an important compliance audit scheduled for this Friday where we must present these documents without delay. Please let us know how we can fix this loading issue as soon as possible.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. Advise customer to use the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view. Suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Verify browser console for any network errors.

subject: Collaboration lag in CloudDesk Office documents
body: Hello Support, when multiple administrators are editing a document simultaneously, we notice several seconds of lag between typing and seeing updates appear for other users. Cursor positions also lag behind significantly. We would appreciate it if this could be looked into soon.
resolution: Collaboration performance can be affected by network latency, so please ensure all collaborators have a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and clearing your browser cache if the issue persists.

subject: Slow downloads on enterprise workspace
body: Hi there. We are on the enterprise plan, but our external partners are complaining that file downloads from our public links are moving at a snail's pace, sometimes throwing DOWNLOAD_SPEED_LOW. No rush since we are just wrapping up for the week, but would love a fix eventually.
resolution: Test download speeds using a different browser or network. Advise checking browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, recommend the recipient use a download manager if available or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Verify server region for the workspace.

subject: Unable to download PDF invoices
body: I'm only seeing an option to download my invoices as CSV files, but our records require PDFs. I noticed the error BILL-INV-009 when attempting to export these. It is not urgent, but I would appreciate it if you could help me get these formatted correctly for our archives.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: SSO login failing for team
body: We are getting an SSO-AZURE-400 error when our users attempt to log in this morning. We need this resolved as soon as possible because our staff cannot access their workspaces to complete their tasks.
resolution: In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs' (replace 'yourcompany' with your actual subdomain).

subject: Request for video conferencing integration
body: We are trying to streamline our workspace and would love to see direct video conferencing integration. Right now we have to manually copy links into comments, which is inefficient. Is there any way to get Zoom or Meet connected?
resolution: While we currently focus on file sharing and project collaboration, we definitely hear your interest in video conferencing. For now, you can continue to post meeting links directly in your workspace comments. To help us prioritize this development, please submit your request and preferred tools at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing.

resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated for improved security. You must regenerate all API tokens from the API and Integrations section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new tokens to restore your service connectivity.

subject: API 500 errors failing our file requests

This should resolve the request failures you are experiencing until our upcoming hotfix is deployed.

If it still fails, please check your CloudDesk audit logs to see if the system is registering the event correctly.

resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: API 503 errors during high load

resolution: Please check your 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header to ensure your scripts are staying within the allowed thresholds. We recommend implementing exponential backoff logic for your retries to handle peak traffic more gracefully. If you continue to see errors while well within your limits, please let us know so we can escalate.

subject: Admin console access denied

resolution: Please check your user role settings under 'Manage User' in the Admin Console. It is possible your account is missing the specific 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' designation required to access those settings. Once your permissions are verified and updated, the access error should resolve.

subject: Incorrect user count on latest invoice

resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: Storage limit increase for small team

resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams, and we do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time. Please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

resolution: We are aware of this issue related to distributed storage and are working on a permanent fix. In the meantime, please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your application to handle these transient failures.

subject: Extreme lag when collaborating on documents

If the lag continues, try reducing the number of users editing the document simultaneously to see if performance improves.

resolution: I apologize for the performance issues you are experiencing. subject: WRONG USER ROLES DISPLAYED IN ADMIN CONSOLE

resolution: This is a known UI display bug and your actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again.

resolution: I am sorry for the trouble with your login page branding. Please head to the SSO & Branding section in your Admin Console to ensure your assets are saved correctly. If the files are present, try clearing your browser cache, as this often resolves the display issue.

If the user still does not receive the message, we can manually trigger a password reset for them from our end.
