subject: Can't view PDF files in the web app
body: I am having trouble looking at my documents directly in CloudDesk. When I click to view a PDF or a presentation, it just stays stuck on a spinning wheel or shows up blank. I am seeing error code PREVIEW-006. It is pretty annoying since I have to download everything just to see what it is. I hope you can look into this.
resolution: This behavior is often linked to temporary glitches in our preview service or local browser issues. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies to see if that resolves the rendering. If the issue persists, try opening the preview in an incognito window to determine if a browser extension is interfering.

subject: Seat limit error despite available spots
body: I am trying to add a new team member but I keep getting a seat limit reached error, code CD-AM-001. My subscription details clearly show we have 5 open seats. There is no rush on this, but please let me know when you have a moment.
resolution: Please check your pending invitations count under the Team Management tab in the Admin Console, as these still count toward your total capacity. You can resolve this by revoking any old pending invitations or by upgrading your plan if you require more seats.

subject: Cannot access specific shared workspace
body: Hello team, I am trying to open one of our shared enterprise workspaces on the web app today but I keep receiving error PERM-WS-403.4. My account has enterprise access, so I am not sure why this specific folder is blocked. Could someone take a look when you have a moment? Best regards.
resolution: An administrator needs to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check 'Members' or 'Permissions' and ensure the user is correctly assigned with appropriate access rights.

subject: Invitation emails not arriving to new members
body: We have sent several invitations to new team members, but they never receive the email. The status in the workspace console shows as Pending. I suspect an EMAIL-005 error is occurring somewhere. Could you please look into this as it is blocking our onboarding?
resolution: Please ask your users to check their spam or junk folders first. If they still have not received the invite, ensure that your domain's SPF and DKIM records are properly configured to trust our mailing services. You can find the specific DNS requirements in our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide.

subject: Custom OAuth 2.0 apps failing with OAUTH-AUTH-401
body: ATTENTION SUPPORT! Our custom OAuth 2.0 applications are completely failing to obtain access tokens via the API today, throwing OAUTH-AUTH-401 errors for every single request. This is completely halting our integration pipelines and our team cannot perform their duties. We need this fixed right now!
resolution: Hello. Please verify that the 'Client ID' and 'Client Secret' used in your custom application exactly match the credentials generated in the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'API & Integrations' -> 'OAuth Clients'. Please pay close attention to case sensitivity and any extra spaces.

subject: Cannot export audit logs over 90 days
body: Hi, I am trying to pull logs for the last 6 months but it says AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. Is there a way to get more than 90 days? Let me know when you get a chance.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script. Alternatively, let us know if you need us to perform a manual data pull.

subject: Desktop Sync files stuck on indexing
body: Hello support team, I noticed that my CloudDesk Desktop Sync client has been showing 'Connecting' or 'Indexing' continuously all morning, and none of my files are syncing to or from the local folder. I am seeing error code SYNC_STATUS_STUCK on my end. Could you please help me get this sorted out soon so I can resume my office work?
resolution: Hello! We apologize for the trouble; please try restarting your CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. If the issue persists, clear the application cache by navigating to 'Settings' > 'Advanced' > 'Clear Cache'. Should it still remain unresolved, we recommend performing a full reinstall of the client after backing up any local unsynced files.

subject: New user login error
body: our new hire tried logging in with their email and password but it says user not found. seeing error AUTH-NF-404.1. can you fix this?
resolution: Please verify that the user's email is correct in your Admin Console. You should also confirm that the invitation was properly sent and accepted by the user. If they still cannot log in, please try resending the invitation.

subject: Frequent 429 Too Many Requests errors
body: Our integration is receiving frequent 429 errors during high traffic periods. We need this addressed as it is impacting our synchronization speed. Please advise on how to resolve API-RATE-429.
resolution: You should implement exponential backoff logic within your application to handle these rate limits gracefully. We recommend reviewing your call frequency to ensure it stays within the current tier limits.

subject: new member invite emails not arriving
body: Hi team, when we invite new folks to our workspace they arent getting the email. It just stays pending in the member list with no bounce back. No major rush on this since we can resend later when convenient.
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our 'Email Delivery Troubleshooting' guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries. If the issue persists, provide the email addresses of affected users for manual investigation.

subject: SSO login failing with invalid format
body: Our team cannot log in through Okta and are receiving an error about the SSO token format. We have a major demo at 5pm today and this is completely blocking our ability to prepare. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: Due to the SSO token format change in v4.2, you will need to update your configuration. Please log in to the CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata to resolve the authentication error.

subject: Error when setting up MFA in mobile app
body: I am trying to secure my team's accounts by enabling MFA, but our users keep seeing error MFA-MOB-002 when scanning the QR code in the app. The email login works fine, but we cannot finish the setup. Any guidance would be greatly appreciated.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise your users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app in the Security settings. Once finished there, it will sync and work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Unauthorized sync of Documents folder
body: I am very frustrated to find that the desktop client has automatically uploaded my local 'Documents' folder to the workspace without my permission. This is a serious privacy concern. Please help us figure out why this happened and how to stop it immediately.
resolution: The desktop client only syncs folders that have been explicitly selected or pre-configured by an administrator. Please check your sync client settings under 'Synced Folders' to ensure no unintended paths were selected and confirm that 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is toggled off.

subject: Session expired error immediately after login
body: Good day, I am reaching out because every time I log into the web application, I am instantly met with a session expired message and kicked back to the login screen. Thank you for looking into this so we can resume our work.
resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cookies and local storage for 'cloudesk.com'. Check if the user has strict privacy settings or browser extensions that might be interfering with session cookies. Verify system time on user's device.

subject: User cannot log in and sees Insufficient Permissions
body: One of our team members is getting error code CD-AM-002 when trying to access the web application. We recently adjusted some permissions and now they cannot work at all. Please look into this right away.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Google SSO loop - please fix urgently
body: Our entire team is stuck in a google sso redirect loop and we have a major client demo at 5pm today. This is blocking all our work. I am seeing error AUTH-SSO-302.1. Please help us get back into our accounts immediately.
resolution: I apologize for the disruption ahead of your demo. Please have your team clear their browser cache and cookies for CloudDesk, or try accessing the portal via an incognito window. I will also double-check your Google SSO configuration in the Admin Console to ensure everything is correct on our end.

subject: API 403 error when sharing workspaces
body: We are getting an API-403 error when attempting to share a workspace via our integration. Our API key user definitely has the Manager role. Could you please look into this for us?
resolution: Please ensure the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope specifically enabled. Additionally, the user associated with that API key must be a direct member of the workspace you are attempting to share. If the issue persists, please send us the API key ID and the affected workspace ID for further investigation.

subject: new user getting user not found error auth-nf-404.1
body: hey there so we invited a new person and they are trying to log in with email and password but it keeps saying user not found with code auth-nf-404.1. no huge rush since we are just testing things out right now.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If it has not been accepted yet, please resend the invitation and check that the user is attempting to log into the correct instance URL if your company manages multiple accounts.

subject: Slack notifications not working
body: Our file share notifications are not reaching our Slack channel. We have a demo at 5pm today and need this fixed before then. We are getting error SLACK-NOTIFY-500. Please fix this now.
resolution: Please navigate to the Slack integration settings within your Admin Console to verify the setup. Ensure the correct Slack workspace and channel are selected for updates. Additionally, confirm that the CloudDesk app has the necessary permissions to post in that specific channel within Slack.

subject: API 403 error sharing workspace
body: We get API-403 when trying to share a workspace via API. My developer is stuck and we have an important internal audit on Friday. Please help us get this working today.
resolution: Please verify that your API key has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled and that the user is a direct member of the workspace. If the error persists, please send over the API key ID and the target workspace ID so we can investigate the permissions further.

subject: Zapier file upload trigger not working at all
body: Hi team, my Zap connected to the new file uploaded trigger is completely dead. Nothing is firing when new items go into the folder. I am seeing ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 in my test logs. Please let me know what is going on.
resolution: In Zapier, re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events. Check CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: seat limit error
body: trying to add users but getting error cd-am-001. we have seats left. fix this.
resolution: Please verify the Pending Invitations count in the Admin Console under Team Management and Invitations. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit, so you should revoke any old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: PERMISSION DENIED 403 error on shared workspace
body: My team cannot access our shared workspace and we keep getting PERM-WS-403.4 errors! This is completely blocking our workflow. I am the manager and I need to know why our permissions have suddenly been revoked without any warning.
resolution: It looks like your team's specific access rights for that workspace may need to be refreshed. Please have your administrator verify the user assignments under the 'Members' or 'Permissions' tab within that specific workspace in the Admin Console. Once the correct access level is re-applied, the 403 errors should clear.

subject: Permission denied on shared workspace
body: I am receiving a PERM-WS-403.4 error when trying to access a specific workspace. I need this fixed promptly as I am unable to view the files. Please advise.
resolution: Your workspace permissions likely need a quick adjustment. Please have an administrator navigate to the affected workspace in the Admin Console and check the members list to ensure your access rights are correctly assigned.

subject: Cannot find option to downgrade our subscription plan
body: I am trying to change our subscription because we need to scale down, but the interface is completely obtuse. I am getting error code BILL-PLAN-011 when I try to save any changes in the billing tab. This is incredibly frustrating. How do I actually reduce our tier?
resolution: To downgrade your plan, please navigate to the Admin Console, then Billing, and select Subscription Details followed by Change Plan. Once you select your desired tier, note that the downgrade will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle. No prorated refunds are issued for unused time.

subject: accidental upgrade refund request
body: hi there i think i clicked the wrong button and my pro account got upgraded through the api by mistake. id like a refund for this charge if possible. noticed a few others had this happen today too. please let me know.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Admin console loading very slowly
body: The Users & Groups page in the Admin Console is taking forever to load, and I am seeing ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT errors constantly. We have thousands of users, and this lag is preventing us from managing our team effectively. Can this be fixed?
resolution: To improve load times, we recommend using the search bar or applying specific filters like 'Status: Active' immediately when you access the page. This reduces the initial dataset the console needs to render. If you need to manage a specific user, searching for their email directly is the most efficient way to access their profile.

subject: Azure AD SSO users getting incomplete profile error
body: Our users are unable to access the web app using their Azure AD credentials. They are receiving an error stating that their user profile is incomplete or missing required attributes, specifically tagged as AUTH-SSO-403.2. Could you look into this for us?
resolution: Please have your Azure AD administrator confirm that the 'emailaddress' and 'displayname' claims are correctly mapped within your enterprise application settings for CloudDesk. You can follow the steps outlined in our official Azure AD SSO configuration guide for the specific mapping requirements.

subject: Account locked out after multiple login failures
body: Hello support team, one of our contractors received an account locked message after entering their credentials incorrectly a few times, referencing code AUTH-LOCK-429.1. They cannot log in even though they now have the correct password. Please help us get this unlocked at your earliest convenience.
resolution: Hello. You can instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the automated lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under Users, Manage User, and selecting Unlock Account.

subject: Google SSO redirect loop
body: Users authenticating with Google SSO are stuck in a redirect loop and never reach the dashboard. Please fix this.
resolution: Please instruct the affected users to clear their browser's cache and cookies specifically for 'cloudesk.com'. If the issue persists, advise them to try an incognito or private window or use a different browser. Additionally, you may want to verify the Google SSO configuration in your Admin Console.

subject: Transferring workspace ownership
body: I am unable to change the owner of a workspace. The option is greyed out in the interface, and when I try to force it, I get an error saying 'Cannot transfer ownership to non-owner'. We need to reassign this project today. Please advise on the correct procedure.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to a user who is already a member of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is added to the workspace first, then attempt the transfer via the Admin Console under the workspace settings.

subject: Mobile app failing to preview documents
body: I am trying to view some documents on my phone, but the mobile app keeps failing to load previews. It just shows an error saying it could not load the preview. It is quite frustrating when I am on the go and need to check these files. The code shown is MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL.
resolution: Please ensure your mobile app is fully updated and try clearing the app cache through your device settings. If you are dealing with very large files, it is best to download the file directly to your device rather than relying on the previewer. This should resolve the MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL issue.

subject: api error 500 when accessing file content
body: hi there. we keep getting api-500 errors when calling the get file content endpoint. it is very intermitent but it is stopping our production build. can you look into this? we really need a stable solution by tomorrow morning.
resolution: We are aware of this intermittent 500 error during file retrieval and recommend implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your code to handle these occurrences. We are actively investigating the root cause regarding distributed storage and expect to deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix soon.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error for specific domains
body: Hello, we have noticed that users coming from our newly acquired subsidiary domains are unable to authenticate via Google SSO. They keep hitting the SSO-GOOGLE-403 error message during login. Existing domains continue to work fine. Could you please assist us in resolving this access issue?
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console's SSO & Identity settings for Google SSO, check the Allowed Domains list. Add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: Need to downgrade subscription plan
body: Hello, we are writing to request a downgrade of our CloudDesk subscription plan to a lower tier due to a reduction in our team size. Please let us know how we can proceed with this change. We are not in a hurry and can wait for your instructions.
resolution: Hello. To downgrade your plan, please navigate to Admin Console > Billing > Subscription Details > Change Plan and select your desired lower tier. Note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle to avoid service disruption, and no prorated refunds are issued for unused time on the higher plan.

subject: Urgent: API-500 error blocking our Friday audit
body: We are getting intermittent API-500 errors on the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. It is absolutely unacceptable as we have an audit this Friday and our integration is failing. Why is this happening now? Please fix this immediately.
resolution: We are aware of the intermittent 500 errors occurring during file content retrieval in distributed regions and are working on a permanent fix. In the meantime, please implement a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client to bypass these errors. We appreciate your patience while we deploy a hotfix.

subject: Need to downgrade account plan
body: I am quite frustrated with how difficult it is to manage our subscription tier. We need to move to a lower plan immediately because we simply don't need these extra features anymore. I am seeing error BILL-PLAN-011 and it is very annoying to deal with. Please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: You can process your plan change by navigating to the Billing section within your Admin Console and selecting the desired tier. Please note that the downgrade will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle, as we do not offer prorated refunds for these changes.

subject: API tokens returning 401 Unauthorized after update
body: Hello support team, ever since the v4.2 update rolled out, our existing api tokens are throwing a 401 error with legacy_token_format. this is blocking our integration work today and we could really use some prompt guidance on how to fix it. thanks a lot!
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: assigned helpdesk tickets missing from view
body: hi there well i was just checking on our accounting ledger and looking over the latest office supply inventory while waiting for my coffee to brew when i noticed a strange thing with our helpdesk setup. when a helpdesk ticket is assigned to an agent, that agent cannot see the ticket in their 'my assigned tickets' view in the web app. the ticket is visible to administrators and other agents with broader permissions. can someone take a look when they get a chance thanks
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Advise the affected agent to clear their browser's cache and cookies, then log back into CloudDesk. If that doesn't work, an administrator should re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save, then re-assign it back to the original agent.

subject: Critical Okta login failures following version update
body: Since the recent v4.2 update, our team members attempting to authenticate via Okta SSO are completely blocked. They are greeted with the error code AUTH-SSO-401.1 and the message Invalid SSO token format. This is halting all of our operational workflows across the department. We need this resolved immediately to restore access for our PRO workspace.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This step is required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: Google SSO login failing with redirect loop
body: my users cant login with google sso because they get stuck in a loop. this is critical because we have a huge client demo at 5pm today and nobody can access their files. we are seeing the AUTH-SSO-302.1 error code. we need this fixed now.
resolution: I understand the urgency given your demo today. Please have your users clear their browser cache and cookies for our domain, or try using an incognito window. Additionally, please double-check your Google SSO configuration within the Admin Console to ensure all settings remain correct.

subject: API 404 Not Found error on folders endpoint
body: Hello support. Calls to the resource endpoint /folders/{id}/files are returning 404 Not Found even though the folder ID is completely correct. Please let us know when this can be looked into.
resolution: Verify the API endpoint path and HTTP method against the latest CloudDesk API documentation. Ensure the resource ID, such as the folder ID, is valid and fully accessible to the specific API token's permissions.

subject: Getting 401 Unauthorized after v4.2 update
body: Hello support team, hope you are having a good week. Since we updated to v4.2 this morning, all of our automated scripts are failing with an api-auth-401-v42 legacy token format error. We need this working ASAP for our payroll sync.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership option greyed out
body: I am trying to transfer workspace ownership to a colleague today, but the option is completely greyed out and I keep seeing CD-AM-004. This is really annoying me because I have other important tasks to finish. Please let me know how to fix this soon.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: API 500 errors on file content retrieval
body: Our integration is failing with an API-500 error when fetching files, which is currently blocking our deployment. This seems to be happening intermittently for remote storage locations. We would appreciate a prompt resolution to this connectivity issue.
resolution: This intermittent issue is related to our distributed storage retrieval process, and we are working on a fix for an upcoming hotfix release. In the meantime, implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client should effectively bypass these temporary errors.

subject: Requesting advanced granular permissions
body: I am working on an integration and our team really needs more granular control, such as view-only with comments or upload-only for sub-folders. Thank you for considering this request. It would greatly improve our current file management process.
resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding folder-level permissions. Please submit your specific requirements via our official feature request portal at roadmap.cloudesk.com, as this will help our product team prioritize your needs in future updates.

subject: Webhooks failing with invalid HMAC signature
body: Our external service is rejecting CloudDesk webhooks due to an invalid signature, reporting HMAC verification failed. Could you please look into this promptly so we can resume our workflows?
resolution: Ensure the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the 'Webhook Secret' configured in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify your signature verification algorithm matches CloudDesk's (HMAC-SHA256).

subject: Request for Microsoft Teams integration
body: Hello, our team relies heavily on Microsoft Teams for daily communication and we would love to have a direct integration with CloudDesk to share files more seamlessly. Many of our team members are asking for this feature to streamline our workflow. Let us know if anything like this is currently available or on the horizon.
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper, direct integration is not yet available. Please vote for this integration or add your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams. We are constantly evaluating new integrations based on customer demand.

subject: MFA code not working for login

resolution: I understand the urgency given your demo today. Please first ensure that the time settings on your phone are synchronized correctly with the network, as drift can cause MFA codes to fail. If that does not work, you can re-configure MFA for your account through the Security Settings page in the web app.

subject: Okta SSO login completely broken after v4.2 update!

Everyone is getting an invalid token message after your recent v4.2 update went live this morning. We have an executive meeting starting in twenty minutes and nobody can log in. Fix this immediately please!
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

Please try clearing your browser's cookies and cache as a first step, or use an incognito window to bypass potential extension issues. If the issue remains isolated to specific files, verify that those files are not corrupted or encrypted.

They receive an Insufficient Permissions error message when attempting authentication. This is blocking our active development cycle immediately and needs urgent resolution.

If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Public sharing link expiration time is much too short

We keep having to recreate them over and over again, which is quite frustrating for our daily workflow. Please let us know if there is a workaround for this.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Billing Access Error After v4.2 Upgrade

resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Invalid card details error on new payment method

resolution: Hello. Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, try resending the invitation. Additionally, check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if your company utilizes multiple accounts.

subject: Critical: SSO login failing with error SSO_TOKEN_FORMAT_401
body: Hi team, we are currently experiencing a major issue where none of our users can log in via our SSO provider. We keep seeing the SSO_TOKEN_FORMAT_401 error since the v4.2 update rolled out. This is causing significant disruption for our entire department. Could you please assist us in resolving this immediately? We truly appreciate your help.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token format, which is causing this authentication error. To resolve this, please go to your CloudDesk Admin Console and re-download the updated SAML metadata or re-generate your OIDC client secret. Detailed steps for this configuration can be found in our v4.2 release notes.

subject: Zapier New File Uploaded trigger not firing
body: Hello, our Zapier integration with the New File Uploaded trigger is not firing when new documents are added. We tried checking the webhook settings and error ZAPIER-TRIGGER-404 came up. Please assist when you have a chance as we would like this running smoothly soon.
resolution: Hello. In Zapier, please re-test the CloudDesk trigger step to refresh its connection. Ensure the CloudDesk account connected in Zapier has the necessary permissions to access the monitored events, and check your CloudDesk audit logs for the expected event.

subject: New user unable to log in with password
body: Good morning CloudDesk team. We recently added a new external contractor to our enterprise workspace, but when they try to log in with their email and temporary password, the system throws an User Not Found error code AUTH-NF-404.1. There is no major time pressure for this request since they do not start their main project until next week, but we wanted to get their account sorted out when convenient. Thank you so much for your assistance!
resolution: Hello. Please verify the user's email address in your Admin Console to ensure there were no typos. Confirm that the initial invitation was successfully sent and accepted by the user. If not, simply resend the invitation, and verify they are attempting to log into the correct instance URL if your organization utilizes multiple accounts.

subject: Legacy API tokens returning 401 Unauthorized
body: Following the v4.2 platform update, our automated integrations using existing API tokens are failing with a legacy token format error. Please provide instructions on how to resolve this for our development scripts.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Requesting a webhook for file uploads
body: I am working on setting up our file management flow. I was looking for a way to have the system notify our internal tools automatically whenever a new file is uploaded. Is there a webhook available for this?
resolution: Thank you for your interest in enhancing our API. While we currently support polling for updates, we do not yet have a direct webhook for new file uploads. Please submit a formal proposal including your desired payload structure to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so we can track this request.

subject: Mobile app network error
body: getting network error on ios app with mobile-net-500.1. connection is fine.
resolution: Hello. Please force close the app, check for app updates in your app store, and try again. If the issue persists, try reinstalling the app and check our status page.

subject: Workspace page hanging indefinitely on load
body: I am trying to access our primary workspace for the monthly finance report, but the page just spins and eventually goes blank. This is happening constantly for the whole team today. We have an important payroll run scheduled for tomorrow morning, so we really need access to these files right away. I am seeing a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error in the console. Please help us fix this by then.
resolution: It looks like the workspace has reached a high volume of files, which is causing the load timeout. I recommend using the search and filter functions to navigate the content more efficiently. To improve performance, we also suggest splitting the workspace into smaller, more manageable collections.

subject: Seat limit reached error despite open seats
body: Hello, thank you for your support. When our admin user tries to add new team members today, the system gives us a seat limit reached message, but subscription details show we have available seats. We appreciate your help to resolve this.
resolution: Please verify the Pending Invitations count under Admin Console, Team Management, and Invitations. Pending invitations still count towards your overall seat limit, so you should either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase capacity.

subject: Incorrect VAT rate on latest invoice
body: Our latest invoice shows an incorrect VAT rate despite our business being based in a region with different tax requirements. We are seeing error code BILL-TAX-006 on our dashboard. Could you please review our account settings and apply the correct tax rate for our location? Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID under Admin Console, Billing, Billing Information. If those details appear correct, kindly provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and your valid tax exemption certificate so we can perform a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: User deletion stuck in pending
body: We have an audit on Friday and I initiated a user data deletion request two days ago. The status is stuck as USER_DELETE_PENDING and I have not received a confirmation. This is critical for us to meet our compliance deadline. It seems the system is not processing these requests correctly at the moment.
resolution: Please ensure the user is set to 'Inactive' in the console before requesting deletion. If the user is already inactive and the job is still stuck, please provide the email address and the specific request ID so I can investigate the backend job queue for you.

subject: Unable to transfer workspace ownership to new manager
body: Hello Support, I am trying to transfer workspace ownership in the admin console to another user, but the option is greyed out. We keep seeing an error stating that we cannot transfer ownership to a non-owner. Could you please advise how to complete this action?
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Seat limit reached error when adding teammates
body: Hi there, I am trying to add a couple of new colleagues to our account but keep getting a seat limit reached message. When I look at the subscription details it says we still have open seats available. Could you please check this CD-AM-001 error for us when you have a moment? Thanks a lot.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: user activity report showing no data
body: I tried to pull the user activity report but it comes up completely blank. I am getting error REPORT-001. No hurry, but please check when you have a chance.
resolution: This is often caused by a temporary browser cache issue. Please clear your cache and cookies, or try accessing the report through a different browser to see if the data populates correctly.

subject: Request for extending public link expiration limits
body: Hi there, I was just talking to my colleague about how we organize our digital filing cabinets around the office, and it got me thinking about our workflows. While we love using the system for our day-to-day operations, we were wondering if it might be possible to adjust how long public links stay active. Currently, they seem to expire a bit too quickly for some of our archival sharing needs, and since we aren't in any huge hurry, I thought I would just drop a line to ask about the roadmap.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration.

subject: Critical failure: Invalid SSO Token Format error
body: Our entire team is currently locked out of the platform after the v4.2 update. We are seeing the Invalid SSO Token Format error, which is preventing all work. We need an immediate fix as this is stopping our operations. Error code is CD-AM-003.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format that requires an update to your integration. Please update your SSO application configuration in your Identity Provider to reflect the new token schema. You can find the specific instructions in the CloudDesk v4.2 SSO Migration Guide.

subject: Need to update our PO number for future billing
body: Hello, I am looking to add a purchase order number to our CloudDesk account for future billing cycles. I keep getting error BILL-PO-008 when trying to save my settings. Is there a specific place I should be inputting this? Thanks for the help.
resolution: You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field. Please note that changes made here will apply to all future invoices and cannot be applied retroactively to documents that have already been generated.

subject: MFA setup failing on mobile
body: My team is unable to set up MFA via the mobile app. After scanning the QR code, we get an error stating 'Failed to register MFA device'. Is there a known issue with this feature?
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please have your users complete the setup process via the CloudDesk web app under 'Settings' -> 'Security', which will successfully sync the configuration for both web and mobile access.

subject: Webhook delivery failed connection refused
body: Our webhook endpoints are completely failing with connection refused errors and we have a critical client demo at 5pm today. This is affecting our free account integrations and needs immediate fixing.
resolution: We are experiencing a high volume of webhook delivery failures due to temporary gateway constraints. Please verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's 'Webhooks' settings and confirm your external service is running and accessible from the public internet. Ensure its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range.

subject: Users receiving 403 errors on workspace access
body: We are getting PERM-WS-403.4 errors when trying to access shared folders. It seems like the permissions are not propagating correctly even after successful authentication. Please let me know how we can resolve this access issue.
resolution: An administrator will need to verify the user's specific access rights for that workspace. Please navigate to the workspace settings in the Admin Console and check the members list to ensure the user is assigned the correct permissions. Let me know if the issue persists after verifying those settings.

subject: Repeated expired session errors on mobile app
body: Since the recent v4.2 backend update, users on our mobile app are constantly being prompted to log back in and getting expired session errors. It is interrupting our team's workflow every single day.
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to session management for improved security. Users should fully log out of the mobile app, clear their app cache or reinstall it, and then log back in to force a new compatible session token.

subject: storage limit increase request for free tier
body: hey cloudesk team why are the free storage limits so tight now its frustrating. can we just get a limit increase without having to upgrade our enterprise account. heard a bunch of other folks are hitting this wall too today.
resolution: Thank you for your feedback on our free tier storage limits. The current limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience while encouraging upgrades for growing teams. We do not plan to increase the free tier storage at this time, but please consider our paid plans for expanded storage and additional features.

subject: Admin console reports are displaying as blank
body: I had a very busy morning clearing out my inbox and preparing for the quarterly review, and while trying to pull the user activity report, the page is completely blank. I am using the desktop sync client for some tasks, but this is happening in the web console. It shows error REPORT-001. Could you assist me with this when you have a moment?
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue during page loading. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before attempting to access the report again. If the issue persists, please try a different browser or confirm no extensions are interfering.

subject: Desktop sync keeps creating conflict files
body: The desktop sync client is frequently flagging files as conflict even when no concurrent edits have occurred. This leads to duplicate files like filename (Conflict 2023-10-27).docx being created unnecessarily. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: API returning 429 errors during peak hours
body: Hello support, our automated integrations keep getting blocked because API calls intermittently return 429 Too Many Requests during our busiest times of the day. This is very frustrating for our team. We do not need an immediate fix today, but it is becoming a nuisance.
resolution: Please implement exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client. Review your application's API usage patterns and consider optimizing calls or requesting a rate limit increase via support if justified by legitimate use cases.

subject: user not found error on web app login
body: Hi support a newly invited user tried to log in with email and password but got the User Not Found message. Error code AUTH-NF-404.1 appeared on their screen. Seems like a few others are seeing this behavior today too. Whenever you have a moment can you check it.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation and check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: hardware mfa support inquiry
body: hello, we are looking to enforce hardware-based mfa tokens like yubikey for our organization. do you currently support this in the admin console settings?
resolution: CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification. We recognize the importance of hardware token support for enhanced security. Please add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize security features based on industry standards and customer demand.

subject: Error removing user from workspace
body: I try to delete user but system say I cannot. Error CD-AM-014 appear on screen. Why I cannot remove this user? Please help.
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are currently designated as the owner. You must first transfer ownership to another member by navigating to the workspace settings in the admin console. Once ownership is reassigned, you will be able to remove the user.

subject: Pagination parameters ignored in API requests
body: The limit and offset query parameters in our API calls are being ignored and returning incorrect result counts. Please fix this.
resolution: Ensure your API request correctly uses the 'limit' and 'offset' query parameters as specified in the CloudDesk API documentation. Please note that there is a hard cap on the maximum 'limit' allowed per request, typically set to 1000 items.

subject: blank user activity report in admin console
body: Hi team when I try to access the User Activity report in the admin console the page loads but no data is displayed. It just stays completely blank. Other reports are working fine for me. No rush on this since I can wait.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering, and let us know the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Feature request: Dark mode option for web app
body: Dear CloudDesk team, our entire department has been loving the platform for our daily collaboration needs. However, several staff members have mentioned experiencing eye strain during evening work sessions and low-light environments. We wanted to inquire if a dark mode option might be on your upcoming product roadmap. Thank you so much for your wonderful service!
resolution: Thank you for your feature request! Dark Mode for the CloudDesk web app is a popular suggestion. We currently do not have a dark mode available. Please vote for this feature on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/dark-mode to help us prioritize it.

subject: Accidental subscription upgrade
body: I am very annoyed because our account was upgraded to a paid plan by mistake. I see the BILL-REF-005 error code associated with my account now. Can you please process a refund for this charge immediately?
resolution: We handle refund requests for accidental upgrades on a case-by-case basis. To proceed, please provide the exact date of the transaction and confirm that no features from the new plan have been used. Once confirmed, we will review the account for a full refund.

subject: Desktop app using too much CPU
body: The CloudDesk sync client is consistently showing over 50% CPU usage, even when it should be idle. I have checked my task manager and it is clearly marked with SYNC_HIGH_RESOURCE_USAGE. Can you tell me why it is acting this way? It is making the machines very slow.
resolution: High resource usage is typically triggered by a large queue of pending file changes or processing very large files in the background. Please try pausing your sync, restarting your system, and then resuming the sync process. If the issue persists, please ensure no antivirus software is actively scanning the sync directory, which can cause significant conflicts.

subject: Extremely slow download speeds on public links
body: We are experiencing significantly slower download speeds than expected when recipients download files shared via public links. This is blocking our work and we need prompt help as we have an audit on Friday. Please resolve this immediately.
resolution: We recommend testing download speeds using a different browser or network connection. Please check for browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, we recommend the recipient use a download manager or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer.

subject: Incorrect user count on our latest invoice
body: I am looking at our latest invoice and the user count is completely wrong compared to what we actually have in CloudDesk right now. This error BILL-INV-001 is causing a real headache with our accounting. Please fix this soon.
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: mobile app network error
body: hi, i cant login to the mobile app, i just get a network error even though my wifi is fine. not super urgent but annoying. thanks.
resolution: Please try force closing the application and checking your device's app store for any pending updates. If the issue persists, try clearing the app's cache or reinstalling it entirely. You may also want to verify our current server status on our official page.

subject: Request for more file versioning options
body: Our IT department is looking for ways to extend file versioning beyond the current 30-day/100-version limit. Is there a way to increase this for our account?
resolution: We appreciate you sharing your requirements for enhanced versioning. Please submit this request on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com, as this helps our product team prioritize features based on user demand.

subject: SSO Just-in-Time provisioning not functioning
body: We have Just-in-Time provisioning enabled, but new users are not being created in CloudDesk upon their first login. We are seeing error code CD-AM-009. Please investigate this as it is blocking our onboarding process.
resolution: Please check that your Identity Provider is correctly passing the mandatory user attributes like email and name in your SAML assertion. Also, verify that your subscription has available seats and review your SSO settings in the Admin Console for any recent configuration gaps.

subject: New user cannot log in
body: Our new hire is getting a User Not Found error when trying to login. This is ridiculous. Sort this out.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If the invitation is pending, please resend it. Additionally, ensure the user is trying to log into the correct company instance URL.

subject: Unable to update credit card details
body: Hello team, I am trying to add a new credit card for our monthly subscription, but the system keeps throwing an Invalid Card Details error bill-pay-012. We have double-checked all numbers and the expiry date, and everything is correct on our end. Could you please look into this when possible?
resolution: This behavior can occasionally stem from a temporary glitch with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure there are no active VPNs and try the transaction again after thirty minutes. If it continues to fail, we recommend using a different card or reaching out to your bank to verify there are no blocks on CloudDesk payments.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: Hello Support, I noticed that our latest Pro invoice reflects a user count that does not match our current active users in CloudDesk. We have our internal financial audit on Friday, so I would appreciate your prompt help with this. Could you please investigate error BILL-INV-001 so we can get our billing sorted out?
resolution: Please check the 'Billing Date' and 'Proration Period' on your invoice. User count changes are typically applied at the start of your next billing cycle, or prorated if a mid-cycle change was requested and processed. If the discrepancy persists after reviewing these, please provide the invoice ID and your current active user count for a manual review.

subject: API broken after v4.2 update
body: Since updating to v4.2, all our automated integrations are failing with 401 Unauthorized errors. The response specifically cites legacy_token_format and error code API-AUTH-401-V42. This has completely halted our production data sync. We need an urgent resolution to restore our services.
resolution: Due to changes in the v4.2 release, your existing API tokens are no longer valid. You will need to regenerate your tokens via the API & Integrations section of your Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new credentials immediately.

subject: Account locked during critical deadline
body: Our users are seeing 'Account Locked' despite using correct credentials after some failures. We are encountering error AUTH-LOCK-429.1 and are now completely blocked. We have a payroll run due tomorrow morning and this is stopping our team from accessing their files. Please unlock these accounts immediately.
resolution: For security reasons, accounts are temporarily locked after multiple failed login attempts. You can wait 15 minutes for the lockout to lift automatically, or an administrator can manually unlock the affected accounts via the 'Users' section in the Admin Console. Please check 'Manage User' to resolve this for your team.

subject: Cannot update company name in settings
body: Hello, I am trying to update the company name under Admin Console > Company Settings, but the changes do not save and I sometimes see error CD-AM-010. Please let me know how to resolve this.
resolution: The 'Company Name' is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the 'Organization Name' there. This change will propagate to the Company Settings.

subject: Mobile app keeps cached files after logout creating privacy risks
body: Hi team, noticed that files opened in the mobile app stay cached on the device even after logging out or closing the app. This creates privacy concerns if an ipad gets lost. There is no clear cache option visible in our enterprise setup. Please let us know how to fix this soon.
resolution: The mobile app caches files for offline access, which can lead to MOBILE_APP_CACHE_PERSISTENCE concerns if devices are misplaced. To manually clear the cache, go to 'Settings' within the CloudDesk mobile app, then 'Storage' and select 'Clear Cached Files'. For automatic clearing on logout, enable 'Clear cache on logout' in the same settings menu.

subject: user activity report blank
body: hey team, i am trying to view the user activity report in our admin console today and getting error report-001. the page is completely blank. can someone take a look when you get a moment.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Invoice user count discrepancy
body: Our latest invoice shows a higher number of users than we currently have active in our workspace. I checked the billing dashboard and it lists error code BILL-INV-001. We have an internal audit this Friday, so I would appreciate it if you could verify these numbers. Please let me know what steps I should take next.
resolution: Please double-check the proration period and billing date listed on your invoice, as user counts often adjust at the start of a new cycle. If the numbers still do not align with your current active users, please send me your invoice ID. We will be happy to perform a manual review to ensure your charges are accurate.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental account upgrade
body: I noticed our account was upgraded to the Enterprise tier by mistake yesterday. I am looking into the billing details and saw a BILL-REF-005 error, but the charges went through. Could you please process a refund for this accidental purchase? I am happy to wait for your review as it is not a rush.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will then review your account for eligibility.

subject: User login issue
