resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console to ensure it matches exactly. Confirm that the invitation was sent and has been accepted by the user. You may also want to check if they are trying to log into the correct instance URL if your company has multiple accounts.

subject: API key suddenly unauthorized
body: Hello there, I have been working as a contractor for this company for a few months now, and I generally handle the backend integrations for their CloudDesk account. Everything was running smoothly until I tried to run my script this morning and kept hitting the API-AUTH-401.4 error. I have checked my network settings and even restarted my router, but the key I have been using for weeks just stopped working. Could you please check why my key is rejecting my requests?
resolution: It appears your API key may have encountered an issue or reached its expiration. Please verify the status of your key within the API Keys section of the Admin Console to ensure it hasn't been revoked. If the key is still showing as active but failing, we recommend regenerating a new key and updating your application configuration to restore access.

subject: downgrade account
body: need to change our subscription plan to a lower tier. getting error bill-plan-011 when i try to do it. thanks.
resolution: You can downgrade your plan by going to the Admin Console, then Billing, and finally Subscription Details. Select your desired tier from the Change Plan menu. Please note that the change will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle.

subject: Search is not finding files
body: The search function is broken and isnt finding files I know are there. Its giving me error code SEARCH-002 and I have a big client demo at 5pm today. Can you fix this quickly? Im really blocked right now.
resolution: This issue is often caused by an outdated search index for your account. Please try using more specific search terms or putting your query in quotes to force a lookup. If that fails, logging out and back in should trigger a re-index; if you still have trouble, please send us the specific filenames you are searching for.

subject: External contractor locked out after role change
body: Hello, my role was recently changed to Guest, and now I can no longer access the web application at all, seeing an Insufficient Permissions error. I have urgent deliverables to submit today and need my login restored immediately.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card statement
body: We noticed a charge on our credit card statement from CloudDesk under bill-chg-010 that we cannot reconcile with our expected billing cycle. Please investigate this charge promptly and provide an itemized breakdown so we can update our financial records.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: User cannot login after role change
body: Hello, I recently updated a user to Guest status and now they are locked out of the mobile app. They are receiving a CD-AM-002 error message during the login process. This is currently blocking our mobile team from accessing necessary project files. We would greatly appreciate your prompt assistance with this.
resolution: Guest roles are restricted to specific shared workspaces, which often triggers a CD-AM-002 error if the account isn't correctly mapped to a workspace. Please check the Admin Console to ensure this user has an active invitation to at least one workspace. If they require broader access, you will need to revert their role to Member.

subject: Unable to transfer workspace ownership to a new admin
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a great week. We are currently trying to transition our workspace ownership to another colleague on our PRO plan, but the option is greyed out and we received error CD-AM-004. This is blocking our integration work today, so we would deeply appreciate your prompt assistance with this matter. Thank you so much for your help.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace; if not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Missing audit log details for shared files
body: I am beyond frustrated that our audit logs for shared files don't show WHO actually accessed them. We see AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS constantly, but it is useless for our reporting! We need to know who is downloading our data immediately. This lack of transparency is unacceptable for our internal tracking.
resolution: By default, shared links are set to anonymous access, which is why your logs reflect that. To capture specific user identities in your audit trails, you must toggle the 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login' setting when creating your share links. Please note that this change only applies to new links created after you adjust these settings.

subject: Wrong roles shown in admin console
body: Hi there, i noticed that some of our users have the wrong roles listed in the admin console, like showing Contributor instead of Manager. The permissions seem fine in the workspace, but the display is off. Its not an issue for us right now, just wanted to bring it to your attention.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug that does not affect actual user permissions. You can refresh the display by editing the user's role to something else, saving, and then changing it back to the original setting. We are working on a permanent fix for a future release.

subject: SSO login not working on desktop client
body: Hi there. I tried to log into the desktop app but it keeps failing with DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. The browser redirects but then nothing happens. We really need to get this working for the team today.
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to version 4.2.1 or newer. Check that your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects as well. If the problem continues, you may use your email and password as a temporary workaround if your company policy allows it.

subject: API tokens failing with 401 Unauthorized
body: Our integration is completely down since the v4.2 update and I am seeing API-AUTH-401-V42 errors everywhere. This is unacceptable as it is blocking our entire production pipeline. I need this resolved right now.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced a new security format for all API tokens, causing the API-AUTH-401-V42 error you are seeing. You must log into the Admin Console and regenerate your tokens from the API & Integrations section. Once updated in your application settings, the connectivity should be restored immediately.

subject: mobile notifications are totally broken
body: why do your push notifications take forever to arrive on my phone i keep missing important comments and file updates because of this MOBILE_NOTIFICATION_DELAY and its super annoying im on the free plan and just wanted to let you know whenever you get a chance to fix it
resolution: Please verify that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and your device's operating system settings. Check for any battery optimization features on your device that might be restricting background app activity, and reinstalling the mobile app often helps resolve this.

subject: audit log missing failed login attempts
body: Hi team, we noticed some weird login activity lately and checked the Login Activity audit log. However, we only see successful logins and nothing else. We really need to see all login attempts blocking our review right now.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses or locations are recorded in the Security Events log, not the Login Activity section. Please navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events for this information, and consider enabling Login Anomaly Detection for automatic alerts.

subject: Request for hardware MFA support
body: Our security policy requires YubiKey authentication for all internal tools. Currently, CloudDesk only allows software-based MFA, which is insufficient for our standards. Please let us know when you plan to implement support for hardware tokens.
resolution: We understand that hardware token support is a key security requirement for your organization. Please add your vote and specific hardware preferences to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We prioritize these developments based on direct customer demand and industry standards.

subject: Wrong roles shown in admin console
body: Hi support why are my users roles showing up as contributor instead of manager in the admin panel ui-admin-003 this is very frustrating and confusing for everyone can you please fix it when you have a moment
resolution: This is a known UI display bug, though your users' actual permissions remain completely unaffected. To refresh the displayed role immediately, please go to the user's profile inside the admin console, change their role to something else, save it, and then switch it back to the correct role. We are deploying a permanent patch for this display issue shortly.

subject: cant delete workspace error message
body: hello, im trying to remove an old workspace for a client but it wont let me finish. it keeps giving me cd-am-007 about active integrations detected. no huge rush on this since we have plenty of time.
resolution: Before a workspace can be deleted, all active integrations (e.g., Slack, Jira, Zapier) linked to that specific workspace must be disconnected. Navigate to 'Workspace Settings > Integrations' for the affected workspace and disable/remove all listed integrations, then retry deletion.

subject: password reset email not arriving
body: im trying to reset my password on the web app but the email never shows up in my inbox or spam folder. this is blocking me completely right now error code cd-am-008 please help quickly
resolution: First, confirm the user's email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Advise the user to check their spam/junk folders. If still not found, ask them to whitelist 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for them via 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password'.

subject: Requesting annual invoicing and volume discounts
body: I have been trying to adjust our billing to an annual cycle, but the system keeps throwing error BILL-FEAT-013. It is incredibly frustrating that there is no straightforward way to handle this in the console. Do you have an option for custom payment terms?
resolution: For custom enterprise billing arrangements and volume-based discounts, please reach out to our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com. Alternatively, you can complete the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website to receive a tailored proposal that meets your specific business requirements.

subject: Data export API returning permission denied
body: Hello, our admin scope API key is suddenly returning a 403 error with code API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED when calling the export endpoint. This was working fine last week, and now it is failing. Please look into this when you have time.
resolution: Effective recently, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes 'Data Export' permissions. A new 'Data Steward' API role is required for this endpoint. Please generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in Admin Console > API Management.

subject: Missing PDF invoice option in Admin Console
body: I am trying to download our monthly billing statement from the Admin Console to reconcile our accounts, but I only see an option to download a CSV file. We specifically require a PDF version for our tax records. I am seeing error code BILL-INV-009 on the screen. Please let me know when this format will be available.
resolution: We are currently undergoing a migration that has temporarily limited PDF invoice generation for some of our accounts. If you can provide the specific invoice IDs you require, our team will manually generate the PDFs and email them to you directly. We apologize for this inconvenience.

subject: new sso users not provisioning automatically
body: Hello, newly created users logging in through our sso integration are not being provisioned in clouddesk automatically. Just-in-Time Provisioning is definitely enabled on our end in the admin settings. getting error CD-AM-009 when testing. please help us resolve this quickly as our new hires cant access their workspaces.
resolution: Verify that your SSO Identity Provider (IdP) is correctly sending the required user attributes (email, first_name, last_name) in the SAML/OIDC assertion. Also, ensure there are available seats in your CloudDesk subscription. Check 'Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings' for any recent configuration changes or errors.

subject: New api integration receiving 403 client not authorized error
body: Hello, our new integration built on the CloudDesk REST API is receiving a 403 Forbidden error and failing to make any successful calls, despite us using a valid API key. This is currently blocking our development work and we would appreciate your prompt help in resolving it.
resolution: Please confirm that the API key being used currently has the necessary scopes and permissions assigned for the specific endpoints you are calling. An administrator can easily review and adjust these API key scopes in the Admin Console under 'API Keys' -> 'Manage Key Permissions'.

subject: Password reset email not arriving in inbox or spam
body: Good afternoon, I am writing to you because I tried to reset my password via the login page earlier this morning while juggling three different client calls and trying to prepare for our weekly sync, but the reset email simply has not arrived anywhere in my inbox or even in the spam folder, which is quite blocking for my work today since I am locked out of my account; I noticed code CD-AM-008 on the screen, and I would appreciate your prompt help with this matter.
resolution: First, confirm your email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. Please also check your spam or junk folders, and consider whitelisting 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. If you still cannot find it, an Administrator can force a password reset for you directly.

subject: Requesting ability to brand the SSO login page
body: We are looking to customize our SSO login page with our company logo and colors. Is this something that is currently supported? We appreciate your help with this request.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available, though we recognize this is a highly requested feature. Please feel free to add your specific requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding. We will notify you directly if this feature is updated.

subject: Unable to add new corporate credit card
body: Hello, I am attempting to update our payment method but keep receiving an 'Invalid Card Details' error despite verifying all information is correct. I see error code BILL-PAY-012. We appreciate your assistance with this.
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again after 30 minutes, or consider using a different card. If the issue persists, contact your bank to ensure there are no blocks on transactions with CloudDesk.

subject: sso login broken after update
body: everyone in the office is locked out of the web app. we keep getting error code auth-402 when trying to use okta. please fix this now as we cannot get any work done today.
resolution: This issue is caused by the SSO token format change in our v4.2 release. Please have your IT admin update the application integration in your Okta console using the new Audience URI and SAML ACS URL values found in our v4.2 configuration guide. You can locate these settings under the SSO & Authentication section of the Admin Console.

subject: Existing API key returning 401 unauthorized on desktop sync
body: Dear support team, we noticed that API calls using an existing API key are suddenly returning a 401 Unauthorized error on our enterprise desktop sync setup, even though the key was working perfectly until recently. We would be very grateful if you could look into this when you have some time. Thank you for your continued assistance.
resolution: To resolve the API-AUTH-401.4 error, please verify the API key's status in the Admin Console under the 'API Keys' section. Check if it has expired or been revoked recently. We advise generating a new API key if necessary and updating your application configuration.

subject: Offline mobile editing needed urgently
body: Hello I am writing to you from our office where we use the pro desktop sync and mobile apps for all our daily file sharing. My colleague Susan who sits by the window was trying to work on her spreadsheet yesterday while traveling on the train without Wi-Fi and she got very upset because she couldnt edit her documents offline and have them sync later when she got back online. This is really blocking our work right now because we travel so much and need this feature fixed immediately please help us out.
resolution: Currently, the CloudDesk mobile app supports offline viewing of starred files, but not offline editing. We understand the value of this feature for productivity on the go. Please submit your request or vote for an existing one at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/offline-editing-mobile to help us prioritize its development.

subject: URGENT: Unrecognized charge on our billing statement
body: I just saw an unauthorized charge from CloudDesk on our credit card statement, error code BILL-CHG-010! We need this cleared up immediately because our finance audit is tomorrow. This is unacceptable. Please explain this charge now!
resolution: I apologize for the concern this has caused. To investigate this, please provide the exact amount, the date of the charge, and the last four digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your billing history to provide you with the necessary details.

subject: need access to private user workspace
body: We have a compliance audit and need access to a specific user's private workspace. The system is blocking us with error PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED. Please help us bypass this for the audit.
resolution: For security reasons, administrators do not have default access to private workspaces. You must initiate a formal 'Workspace Access Request' through the Admin Console under the user's profile, which will generate an audit log and notify the relevant parties.

subject: User Activity report showing blank screen
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report, but the page is blank. This is throwing REPORT-001 in the console. Please fix this as soon as you can.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before attempting to access the report again. If the issue persists, try using a different browser or disabling any extensions that might interfere.

subject: user activity report page is completely blank
body: hi team, thanks for the great product. when i open report-001 in the admin console the user activity tab is totally empty. everything else works great, whenever you have a moment to check it out.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Seat limit error when adding teammates
body: Hello support, I am trying to add new team members to our account today, but the system keeps blocking me with error CD-AM-001 saying our seat limit is reached. However, our subscription details clearly show we have plenty of open seats left on our free tier. This is quite frustrating to deal with right now since we are trying to onboard new staff. Please let me know what is going on here.
resolution: Hello. Please check the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Mobile app failing to preview documents
body: I am beyond frustrated that I cannot open any attachments on my phone today. Every time I try to view a PDF or an image, I get the MOBILE_PREVIEW_FAIL error, and it just hangs indefinitely. My team is reporting the same issue across their mobile devices. I do not need this fixed today, but please let me know when you have a solution.
resolution: Please ensure your mobile app is updated to the latest version and try clearing the app's cache through your device settings. We also recommend checking your network connection or downloading the file directly if it is quite large. If the issue continues, please let us know your device model for further troubleshooting.

subject: Desktop sync high cpu and memory issue
body: The desktop sync client is causing consistently high CPU usage above 50% and memory consumption even when no syncing is happening. It is really slowing down my machine. Please check into this code PERF-DSK-001 when you get a chance.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After reset, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: Granular folder permissions needed
body: We need to restrict specific sub-folders to view-only access before our audit on Friday. Currently, our permissions are too broad. Is there a way to set granular controls at the sub-folder level?
resolution: We currently only support permissions at the top-level folder, which we understand is limiting for your audit. Please submit your specific permission requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/granular-folder-permissions so our team can review it. Unfortunately, this functionality is not currently available in the system.

subject: Need dark mode option
body: Users are complaining about eye strain in low light. Please add a dark mode option to the web app.
resolution: Thank you for your feature request! Dark Mode for the CloudDesk web app is a popular suggestion. We currently do not have a dark mode available, so please vote for this feature on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/dark-mode to help us prioritize it.

subject: desktop sync sso login failing
body: I am trying to log into the desktop sync client with SSO but it fails. The browser redirects but the client shows a generic error. We are hitting error DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3.
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to version 4.2.1 or higher to support the latest SSO token format. If the issue persists, please verify your default browser's redirect settings or attempt a login using your email and password as a temporary workaround.

subject: Role change locked user out of web app
body: This is ridiculous. We changed someone from member to guest and now they get an insufficient permissions error when trying to log in. Cd-am-002 is showing up and they cant do any of their work.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users' to confirm the user's current role. If 'Guest', verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to 'Member' or 'Admin'.

subject: Need direct Microsoft Teams integration
body: We need a direct MS Teams integration to work correctly. The current lack of this is blocking our team collaboration. Are you guys planning to add this soon?
resolution: While we currently support sharing links to CloudDesk files in Microsoft Teams, a deeper direct integration is not yet available. Please submit your specific requirements at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/microsoft-teams so our product team can review your feedback.

subject: Password reset emails not arriving
body: Users are not receiving password reset emails, and this includes the AUTH-PR-200.1 error on my end. I have checked the spam folder and everything else seems fine. We have an audit on Friday and need everyone to have access by then. Can you look into this right away?
resolution: Please check the user's email address in the Admin Console to ensure it is accurate. You may need to add no-reply@cloudesk.com to your domain's allowlist to ensure delivery. If that doesn't work, I can manually trigger a password reset for you from our backend.

subject: Updating our purchase order number for upcoming quarterly billing invoices
body: Good afternoon, I hope this message finds you well. As we look ahead to our accounting cycles and prepare our financial records for the upcoming quarter here at our office, I wanted to reach out regarding our PRO plan settings. We need to update our purchase order number for future invoices so that our finance department can process payments without any friction. Whenever you have a chance to look at this, please let us know how to proceed.
resolution: You can add or update your PO number by going to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information' and locating the 'Purchase Order Number' field to resolve BILL-PO-008. Changes made here will apply to all future invoices. Note that this cannot be applied retroactively to already generated invoices.

subject: Invited user stuck on pending status
body: Good afternoon, we encountered an issue while onboarding a new team member. A user received an invitation, clicked the link, but their status in the Admin Console remains Pending Invitation and they cannot log in. We are also seeing error code CD-AM-005 in the audit logs. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set (if any). If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations and send a new one.

subject: api broken need fix immediately
body: all my api calls are failing with legacy_token_format and code API-AUTH-401-V42. i have a massive audit on friday and this is completely blocking our workflow. please help us now as this is a disaster for our team.
resolution: We have updated the API token format in v4.2 for security purposes. Please log into your Admin Console, generate new API tokens, and update your application credentials immediately. This is required to restore access for your integration.

subject: Blank User Activity report in admin console
body: When attempting to access the User Activity report within the admin console on our Enterprise account, the page loads successfully but contains no data, remaining entirely blank. All other reporting modules are functioning correctly. There is no particular time pressure on this matter.
resolution: This behavior typically indicates a temporary data retrieval glitch. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempt to access the report again. If the problem persists, try using a different browser or verify that no local browser extensions are interfering with page scripts. If the report remains blank, please provide the specific date range you are trying to view so we can investigate further.

subject: Accidental Plan Upgrade Refund Request
body: Hello Support, it appears our account was upgraded to a higher tier unintentionally earlier today. We would like to request a refund for the prorated difference. Thank you for your assistance with this matter.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized so we can review your account for eligibility.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: I am trying to run the User Activity report in the admin console, but the page loads without any data. I am getting error REPORT-001. I have an internal audit this Friday and really need this report functioning before then.
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary data retrieval issue or browser caching. Please try clearing your cache and cookies, or try accessing the portal via a different browser. If it remains blank, let us know the specific date range so we can investigate further.

subject: Okta SSO broken after v4.2 update
body: Our team cannot log in through Okta since the v4.2 update. Users get redirected back to the login page with an invalid token format error. This is blocking our work and we need it fixed immediately.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console by ensuring the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: Unable to delete workspace due to active integrations
body: Hello! I am trying to clean up an old project workspace in our account today, but it keeps giving me error CD-AM-007 saying active integrations are detected. Whenever you have a chance, could you point me in the right direction to resolve this? Thank you for your wonderful support.
resolution: Before a workspace can be deleted, all active integrations (e.g., Slack, Jira, Zapier) linked to that specific workspace must be disconnected. Navigate to 'Workspace Settings > Integrations' for the affected workspace and disable/remove all listed integrations, then retry deletion.

subject: Mobile app notifications not appearing
body: The push notifications on the mobile app are extremely delayed. It makes it hard to keep up with team comments when they don't pop up until I open the app. Is there a fix for this?
resolution: Please verify that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and your phone's system settings. Additionally, check for any battery optimization features that might be restricting background activity. If the problem persists, please try reinstalling the mobile application.

subject: Audit logs missing suspicious login activity
body: We suspect a security breach, but our audit logs show nothing suspicious. I keep seeing AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN errors when trying to filter results. This is critical as we need to verify these logins before the end of the day.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses are recorded in the 'Security Events' log, not the standard 'Login Activity' tab. Please navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events to view this data. I also recommend enabling 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic future alerts.

subject: Frequent SSO session timeouts disrupting team workflow
body: Good morning support team. Ever since our environment was updated to version 4.2 last week, our staff members who authenticate via Okta and Azure AD have been experiencing constant disruptions. Users are repeatedly being booted out of their sessions and forced to sign in over and over throughout the day, often seeing an SSO session expired warning. This is severely blocking our workflow since everyone has to re-authenticate multiple times an hour, and we really need you to investigate this promptly.
resolution: v4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta/Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration (e.g., 8-24 hours) to prevent premature session expiration.

subject: Missing PDF invoice download option in admin console
body: We are on the enterprise plan and really need proper PDF invoices for our accounting department. Right now the admin console only lets me download a CSV file, which is useless for our records. Please fix this error BILL-INV-009 so we can get our documents properly.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a migration. For the specific invoice(s) you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice ID(s) and we will generate and email them to you manually.

subject: Inconsistent billing data in v4.2 API usage reports
body: Hello, we are seeing inconsistent data when fetching usage reports via the API since our v4.2 update. We are hitting error API-BILL-401 regularly and need this resolved before our payroll run tomorrow. Could you please investigate why these numbers do not match our Admin Console? Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as per the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, please provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for review.

subject: API key returning unauthorized errors suddenly
body: Hi support, our api calls are failing with a 401 Unauthorized error code API-AUTH-401.4 even though the key was working fine yesterday. This is completely blocking our current workflow so we need help right away please.
resolution: Please verify the API key's status in the Admin Console under the 'API Keys' section to check if it has expired or been revoked. We advise generating a new API key if necessary and updating your application immediately.

subject: account locked error again
body: hi, getting AUTH-LOCK-429.1 and my account is locked out after trying to sign in. please advise on how to reset it.
resolution: Instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: Unable to switch to annual billing
body: I am trying to move our Enterprise account to annual billing to save on costs, but the system keeps throwing error BILL-PLAN-004. This is highly inconvenient as I am just trying to manage our subscriptions correctly. Please fix this immediately so I can process the change.
resolution: To change your billing cycle, please go to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' and select the annual option for your current plan. This change will take effect at the start of your next period, and any unused monthly credit will be prorated automatically.

subject: api key generation option is greyed out
body: hi there i was just promoted to admin but i cant create an api key under security and api access. it keeps saying insufficient permissions and showing cd-am-013. can someone help me fix this soon
resolution: API Key generation requires the 'Super Admin' role. While the user may be an 'Admin', they might not have 'Super Admin' privileges. Confirm their role in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. If not 'Super Admin', the current Super Admin must generate the key for them or elevate their role.

subject: User cannot log in after role change
body: One of our users had their role changed from Member to Guest in the workspace. They are now receiving an error when trying to log in to the web application. The specific error code is CD-AM-002. Please help look into this right away as it is blocking their daily work tasks.
resolution: Guest users can only access shared workspaces they've been explicitly invited to. Check Admin Console > Team Management > Users to confirm the user's current role and verify they have active invitations to shared workspaces. If they need full access, change their role back to Member or Admin.

subject: Slow file download speeds
body: We are experiencing very slow download speeds when sharing files via public links. It seems to be happening across the board for our team. Is there anything we can do to improve this?
resolution: Please test your download speeds on a different network or browser to rule out local interference. For large file transfers, we recommend using the Desktop Sync client for more robust performance. You may also want to verify the server region settings for your workspace.

subject: Urgent: API authentication failing after v4.2 release
body: Hello support team, our financial systems integration stopped working immediately after the v4.2 upgrade, throwing 401 Unauthorized errors with the legacy_token_format message. This is currently blocking our billing runs and affecting revenue operations. We urgently request your prompt assistance in resolving this matter.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: files missing in desktop sync client v42
body: Hey support team, ever since we updated our desktop sync client to v4.2 on our enterprise workspace, files added in the web app arent showing up locally. No error codes are showing up anywhere, but everything looks fine in the mobile and web versions. Please look into this soon.
resolution: We are currently tracking a known issue with the v4.2 desktop sync update affecting several workspaces. Please uninstall the CloudDesk v4.2 desktop sync client, then clear the local sync cache located at C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\CloudDesk or ~/Library/Application Support/CloudDesk. Reinstall the client from the download link in your web app's 'Settings' -> 'Desktop Sync' section.

subject: Public link download speeds are too slow
body: When our external recipients download files shared via a public link or when team members download files from workspaces, the download speed is significantly slower than expected based on their actual internet connection. We are using the free tier and would like to understand if there is a bottleneck on the server side causing this issue.
resolution: We recommend testing download speeds using a different browser or network, and checking for browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, suggest that the recipient use a download manager if available, or have the sender share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer capabilities. We can also verify the server region for your workspace if the problem persists.

subject: Workspace activity log showing incorrect user attribution
body: I hope you are having a productive week so far. I was reviewing the workspace logs earlier today while sipping my coffee and noticed some odd entries. It seems that when my team members edit or move files, the activity log attributes the actions to me instead of them. I'm seeing error code AUDIT-004 intermittently when I refresh the page. This is quite confusing for my documentation. Do you have any insights on this?
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. Please rest assured the underlying audit trail is actually recorded correctly. For an accurate audit, you can cross-reference your findings with the global audit log located in the admin console.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental upgrade
body: I accidentally upgraded our account to the wrong plan tier. I would appreciate it if you could help us get a refund for this erroneous transaction. We have not used any of the new features yet. Thank you for your assistance with this matter.
resolution: Thank you for reaching out regarding the upgrade. Refunds for these situations are processed on a case-by-case basis. Please confirm the exact date and time of the transaction and ensure no premium features have been accessed, and we will review your request.

subject: Where are the detailed reports for user activity?
body: The current audit logs are useless and dont show me who downloaded what file or when. I really need to track collaboration actions properly for my team. Why is this so hard to find in the console? Please fix this soon, its very annoying.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content API
body: We keep getting random 500 errors when calling the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint. Its happenin more frequent now esp with files in other regions. Getting error code API-500. We need a fix soon as this is blocking our integration work.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Account suspended unexpectedly
body: Our account is showing an 'Account Suspended' banner and we are seeing BILL-SUSP-007 errors. We definitely intended to pay but it seems there was a mixup. Could you please help us restore access quickly as this is blocking our development team?
resolution: Your account was suspended due to an overdue payment. Please settle the balance by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Invoices' to pay the outstanding amount, and your service will be automatically restored within 15 minutes of payment confirmation.

subject: Cannot access Admin Console
body: I have been working on integrating your REST API with our internal dashboard for several weeks now, and while everything else is working perfectly, I find myself unable to access the Admin settings. I keep getting redirected to the standard user dashboard or seeing ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. I have tried clearing my cache and checking my credentials multiple times without success. Could you investigate why my access is being restricted?
resolution: It appears your account currently lacks the administrative privileges required to view that console. Please have a super administrator verify your account role by navigating to the user management section. Once your role is updated to 'Admin', you will regain access to those features.

subject: Admin report showing no data
body: I have been trying to pull our monthly activity report, but the page is just blank. We have a board meeting on Thursday and I really need this data for the presentation. Could you please help me get this resolved? Thank you.
resolution: This is often a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or try accessing the report through a different browser to rule out extension conflicts. If it remains blank, please provide the specific date range you are trying to view so we can investigate further.

subject: lag when editing docs together
body: Hi, when my team is editing documents at the same time, the cursors lag behind by several seconds and typing takes forever to show up. It is really annoying when trying to collaborate. Can someone check the collab lag issue please?
resolution: Please check network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure everyone has a stable internet connection. We also recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs or applications, and clearing your browser cache if the issue persists.

subject: Cannot update Company Name in settings
body: Good morning. I am trying to update our company name in the admin console settings, but the box is completely grayed out and wont let me save any changes. We recently rebranded and this is really frustrating. Is there a trick to unlocking this field so we can update our profile?
resolution: The 'Company Name' is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the 'Organization Name' there. This change will propagate to the Company Settings.

subject: Okta SSO login failing since v4.2 update
body: Our users cannot log in with Okta anymore. They are getting an Invalid Token Format error, which appears to be code AUTH-402. Email logins are working fine, but we need the SSO restored as soon as possible.
resolution: This is due to updated SSO token handling in v4.2. Please have your IT administrator update the CloudDesk integration in the Okta console to match the new 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' found in your Admin Console under 'SSO & Authentication'.

subject: ACCIDENTAL PLAN UPGRADE REFUND REQUEST
body: Our account was accidentally upgraded to a paid tier without our consent, and we are demanding a full refund for this charge immediately! We never intended to switch plans on our free workspace. Please reverse this transaction and issue our money back as soon as possible.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Lag during simultaneous document editing
body: Hello! We have noticed some noticeable lag of several seconds between typing and seeing changes reflected when multiple users are editing a CloudDesk Office document simultaneously on our free account. Cursors also seem to update rather slowly. We would love some advice on how to improve this experience when you have a chance.
resolution: Check the network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure that everyone has a stable internet connection. We recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs and heavy background applications to free up system resources. You should also verify if the performance improves when fewer users are editing the document simultaneously, and clear the browser cache for all affected users.

subject: Cannot create new roles in Admin Console
body: I am unable to create a new role because the system claims the name already exists, even though it does not. I have an audit scheduled for Friday and need these permissions configured before then. Please let me know how to resolve this naming conflict.
resolution: Role names are case-insensitive and leading or trailing spaces are automatically trimmed. Please review your existing roles for any entries that might match your desired name, even with slight differences in capitalization or spacing. If you still cannot find a match, please reach out so we can investigate further.

subject: Just-in-Time provisioning not working for SSO users
body: I have enabled JIT provisioning in our settings, but new users are not being created automatically. This is completely blocking our onboarding workflow and is very frustrating. We are seeing error CD-AM-009 constantly. I need a prompt resolution as this is impacting our team's productivity.
resolution: Please verify that your Identity Provider is correctly sending the required user attributes like email and name in the SAML assertion. Also, ensure there are available seats remaining in your subscription. You can check the Security section of your Admin Console for any recent configuration errors.

subject: custom branding for sso login page
body: we need to add our company logo and branding colors to the sso login page. a lot of users are asking for this cohesive look lately. let me know how to update it.
resolution: Custom branding options for the SSO login page are not currently available. We recognize this as a valuable feature for many enterprises. Please add your vote and specific branding requirements to our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-sso-branding, and we will notify you of any updates.

subject: GET /files/{id}/content failing
body: Calls to GET /files/{id}/content return HTTP 500 intermittently for regional files. Error is API-500. Fix this.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: API 403 error when sharing workspace
body: I am trying to share a workspace via the API, but I keep getting a 403 error, even though my key has manager access. Could you help me understand why this is happening?
resolution: Please confirm that your API key has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled. Additionally, the user associated with that API key must be a direct member of the workspace, rather than just belonging to a group. If it still fails, please send the key ID and workspace ID for review.

subject: cant log in with okta
body: getting invalid token format when trying to sign in through okta auth-402. this broke right after the update. fix this immediately.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide.

subject: Cannot export audit logs over 90 days
body: We have an audit on Friday and need logs for the last four months. The console is giving us AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. We appreciate your assistance in getting these reports.
resolution: The Admin Console limit for direct audit exports is 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export' with a pagination script to pull the full dataset. Please let us know if you require further assistance with the API implementation.

subject: SSO login failing after recent update
body: Hi support, our employees cannot sign into the web app using our identity provider. Users attempting to log in via SSO (Okta/Azure AD) after the v4.2 update receive an Invalid SSO Token error. Direct email/password login works fine. This is critical for our daily operations, so please investigate promptly.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new SSO token format. Admins must re-configure their SSO integration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-downloading the updated SAML metadata or re-generating the OIDC client secret. Refer to the v4.2 release notes for detailed steps.

subject: Unable to pull user activity report for audit
body: Hello support. As an external consultant handling our compliance audit this week, I really need to pull the User Activity report. However, every time I access the admin section, the page is completely blank. We have our final review meeting on Friday, so I would greatly appreciate a prompt response.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Slow workspace loading times
body: I was just grabbing a coffee earlier and thinking about our project organization, but I noticed our main workspace is acting up. It has a massive amount of documents, maybe ten thousand or more, and it just spins forever. I keep seeing WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT and I cannot access my files. It is not an emergency, but could you look into it?
resolution: The WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error is likely due to the high volume of files within that specific workspace. We recommend breaking your large workspace into several smaller ones to improve load times. You can also try using the search or filter features to locate files without loading the entire directory at once.

subject: PAYMENT PROCESSING ERROR IN ADMIN CONSOLE BILLING SECTION!
body: Hello Support, Ever since your v4.2 update, our billing management page throws an AUTH-BILL-402 payment processing error whenever we try to access it through our SSO login! This is completely blocking our ability to view invoices and update payment methods, and we need this fixed immediately. Please resolve this right away!
resolution: Hello. The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Activity log showing wrong users
body: The activity log for our workspace is showing incorrect data again, assigning actions to our IT manager that we definitely performed. We have an important audit on Friday and I need this fixed immediately. Getting the error AUDIT-004. Its very frustrating.
resolution: This is a known display glitch that occurs when contributors and administrators are active in the same workspace simultaneously. Please be assured the underlying audit trail remains accurate and can be verified via the global audit log in your Admin Console. We are working on a fix for this interface bug.

subject: Subscription renewal payment failed urgent
body: Hello, good day to you. Our automatic subscription renewal failed today because of a declined credit card, and we are seeing a payment failed status in the billing section. This is currently blocking our team from accessing essential features, so we would deeply appreciate your prompt help in getting this sorted out as soon as possible. Thank you very much!
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: Error adding new team members
body: We are attempting to add new team members but receive a 'Seat limit reached' error despite having available slots in our subscription. The error code is CD-AM-001. This is not urgent, just wanted to flag it as we onboard new staff.
resolution: Please check your 'Pending Invitations' count within the Admin Console. Even unaccepted invites count against your total seat limit, so you may need to revoke older ones. Alternatively, you can always upgrade your seat capacity if you need more space.

subject: User roles displayed incorrectly
body: Hello, I noticed that some of our staff are showing as Contributor instead of Manager in the admin console. Their access seems fine, but the label is wrong, and I keep seeing UI-ADMIN-003. Thank you for your help with this.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug, though your actual permissions remain correct. To refresh the display, go to the user's profile in the admin console, change their role to something else, save it, and then switch it back to the original role. A permanent fix for this display issue will be included in our next patch.

subject: User Activity report is showing blank
body: I am unable to view the User Activity report in the admin console. The page loads, but it is completely empty, which is a major problem as I have an audit on Friday. Please look into this REPORT-001 error so I can finish my reports.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, or test using a different browser. If the report remains blank, please provide the specific date range you are attempting to view so we can investigate further.

subject: Payment Processing Error when accessing billing
body: Hey there. I am trying to view my invoices in the admin console but I keep getting an AUTH-BILL-402 error. I usually log in using SSO but it stopped working for this section after the recent update. Any help would be great.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated our SSO token format, which can cause session issues with sensitive billing pages. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or temporarily log in using your direct email and password to manage billing. We are looking into a permanent fix for SSO access to the billing module.

subject: Account locked out error preventing urgent payroll work
body: This is completely unacceptable. I see an Account Locked message after multiple login failures and cannot log in even with correct credentials, displaying error code AUTH-LOCK-429.1. We have our payroll run tomorrow and this is blocking our work immediately. Fix this now.
resolution: Please wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or alternatively, an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: Cannot access billing section via SSO
body: Hello, I am having trouble accessing the billing portal since the v4.2 update. Everything else works fine, but when I try to view our invoices, I get an error saying AUTH-BILL-402. I would appreciate it if you could look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format, which can cause session issues with billing operations. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies, or temporarily log in using your direct email and password for billing management while we investigate further.

subject: Too many generic notifications
body: The current notification settings on our PRO plan are far too broad and noisy for our IT team. We keep getting pinged for every single comment instead of just direct mentions, which is driving everyone crazy. When will more granular controls be added?
resolution: We hear your feedback regarding notification preferences. Currently, you can adjust general notification settings in your profile. For more granular control, please outline your specific notification scenarios and preferences at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/custom-notifications. This helps us prioritize improvements.

subject: API endpoints failing constantly under load
body: Our automated scripts are completely broken right now because multiple API endpoints are returning HTTP 503 errors. We are on the PRO plan and this volume of failures is completely unacceptable for our operations. We see the API_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE_503 error code across our requests. This needs immediate investigation before our entire pipeline stalls out completely.
resolution: We are currently investigating your API usage patterns to identify if you are exceeding rate limits by checking the X-RateLimit-Remaining header. We advise implementing exponential backoff for your retries while we look into platform status. Please monitor the CloudDesk status page for ongoing incident updates.

subject: Cannot access invoices older than 12 months
body: I need to access invoices from 14 months ago for an audit on Friday, but they are missing from the console. I am seeing error BILL-INV-003 and it is extremely frustrating. Fix this immediately!
resolution: The Admin Console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months. For older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you are looking for, and we will retrieve it for you from our archives.

subject: Agent cannot see assigned tickets
body: One of our support agents is unable to see any tickets assigned to them in their personal view, even though administrators can see the assignments correctly. This is causing a major problem because we have a critical client demo at 5pm today and we need those tickets handled. Please resolve this HELPDESK-007 issue as soon as you can.
resolution: This display error is often caused by a browser cache conflict regarding user permissions. Please have the agent clear their browser's cache and cookies and log back into their account. If that does not resolve the issue, an administrator should re-assign the tickets to a different agent and then assign them back to refresh the link in the database.

subject: Audit log export limitation
body: Hello, I am trying to export our audit logs for the last six months, but the system stops me at 90 days. Is there a way to bypass this limit or get the full data? Thank you for your time.
resolution: The standard Admin Console export is capped at 90 days for performance reasons. For longer date ranges, please use our API endpoint /v1/audit/export with your desired start and end dates. If you are unable to use the API, let us know and we can look into a manual data pull.

subject: Newly invited staff member gets user not found error
body: Hello support team, I recently invited a new colleague to join our team workspace on the web app under our Pro plan. When they try to log in using their email and password, they keep getting an AUTH-NF-404.1 error saying the user is not found. We have checked the spelling multiple times and it is completely correct. Could you please look into this as soon as possible so they can start working?
resolution: To resolve this, please verify the user's email address in your Admin Console and confirm the invitation was successfully sent and accepted. If it shows pending, you can resend the invitation directly from that panel. Also, double-check that they are logging into the correct instance URL if your organization utilizes multiple accounts.

subject: invitation emails not going out to new users
body: hey support we invited a few new people to our workspace today but none of them are getting the emails. in the member list it just says pending for all of them. there are no bounce backs or anything weird showing up so we arent sure whats wrong. whenever you get a chance let us know what to check
resolution: Please check your company's email spam/junk folders first. If not found, ensure your email domain's SPF/DKIM records are configured to allow emails from CloudDesk's sending domains. Refer to our Email Delivery Troubleshooting guide in the admin console for the required DNS entries.

subject: Audit log export failing for ranges over 90 days
body: When attempting to export our audit logs from the Admin Console for a date range exceeding 90 days, the export fails and shows AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. It would be nice if this could handle longer spans eventually, though we are not in a rush.
resolution: The direct export feature in the Admin Console is indeed limited to a maximum of 90 days. For longer historical periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' along with a pagination script to retrieve the data.

subject: Missing login entries in audit logs
body: I am concerned about potential unauthorized access, but our audit logs only seem to show successful logins. I am looking for failed attempts or logins from unusual locations but I cannot find them anywhere. I keep getting error code AUDIT_LOG_INCOMPLETE_LOGIN. Please help us investigate this.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses/locations are recorded in the 'Security Events' log, not 'Login Activity'. Navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events for this information. Enable 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic alerts.

subject: SSO login page branding is missing
body: Our SSO loging page is just showing the standard cloud desk stuff instead of our company logo and colors. Its super annoying because we have a big presentation at 5pm today and we need our branding to look professional. I think the error is SSO-UI-200.2. Can you help us fix this before our meeting?
resolution: Please have your administrator navigate to the SSO & Branding section in the Admin Console to verify that your logo and background assets are still uploaded and saved correctly. After confirming the settings, please try clearing your browser cache to ensure the changes are reflected. If the branding still does not appear, let us know and we will investigate the asset server.

subject: Invalid credit card error when updating payment method
body: I am trying to update our payment method and keep receiving BILL-PAY-012. I verified the card details are correct, but the system rejects them. This is blocking our billing process. Please help immediately.
resolution: This error is sometimes triggered by security blocks or temporary issues with our payment gateway. Please ensure you do not have a VPN active, then wait 30 minutes before trying again. If it still fails, consider trying a different card or confirming with your bank that they are not blocking transactions from our platform.

subject: Blank User Activity report in admin console
body: When I try to view the User Activity report in the admin console for our PRO account, the page loads but stays completely blank. All other reports seem to be working normally. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Blank User Activity Report in Console
body: Hello, thank you for your continued support. When I attempt to open the User Activity report today, the page loads completely blank, and I see REPORT-001. We have an important compliance audit on Friday, so your prompt help with this would be greatly appreciated.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: WE NEED DARK MODE NOW
body: The bright white screen is causing horrible eye strain for my entire team! We work late hours and this is just unacceptible. Why is there no dark mode option yet? Fix this, we are tired of the glare!
resolution: Thank you for the feedback. We currently do not have a dark mode, but it is a popular request. Please vote for this feature on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com to help us prioritize it.

subject: billing api reports showing wrong data after upgrade
body: Hello support team, thanks for all your hard work. Ever since we moved to v4.2 our usage numbers from the billing endpoint have been mismatched compared to the console. Thanks so much for looking into this API-BILL-401 issue for us.
resolution: The billing API in v4.2 introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, particularly for legacy storage types. Ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters as per the v4.2 API documentation. If discrepancies persist, please provide the exact API query and the conflicting Admin Console report for review.

subject: Tickets not showing in assigned view
body: I am trying to manage helpdesk tickets, but they are not appearing in my assigned view. Other staff members can see them fine, but I am stuck. Is there a way to fix this HELPDESK-007 error? I would appreciate your help.
resolution: This is likely a temporary cache issue regarding your permissions. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and logging back in. If the issue persists, have an admin unassign the ticket and reassign it back to you to refresh your access.

subject: api tokens broken after upgrade urgent
body: we upgraded to v4.2 and now all our api tokens fail with 401 legacy_token_format error. this is extremely frustrating because we have a critical payroll run tomorrow and all our integrations are completely dead. please help right now.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console and update your applications to use these new tokens immediately.

subject: Custom branding not showing on SSO page
body: Our company logo and background image are not appearing on the SSO login page. It just shows the default CloudDesk branding instead. Is there a way to force our assets to load correctly?
resolution: Please navigate to the 'SSO & Branding' section in your Admin Console to ensure your assets were saved correctly. If everything looks right on our side, we recommend clearing your browser cache, as this often resolves display issues with cached branding images.

subject: Deleted files remaining in trash past 30 days
body: Dear support team, thank you for your continued help with our account. We noticed that our admin has configured a 30-day data retention policy for deleted files, but files in the Trash Bin are visible and recoverable beyond 30 days, meaning the policy appears not to be enforced. Could you kindly check this when it is convenient for you?
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for Deleted Files and Trash Bin in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the Permanently Deleted state. Files in the Trash Bin are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: Issue with Audit Log export length
body: I hope you are having a nice day. I was sitting here with my coffee trying to pull the audit logs for the last six months, because I have to prepare a report for the upcoming board meeting, and I noticed that the system cuts me off at 90 days. I have been trying to select a longer range, but the export fails every time. It seems like a lot of other people might be experiencing this as well, and I see the error AUDIT_EXPORT_RANGE_EXCEEDED. Do you think there is any way to get the data for the full six months?
resolution: The Admin Console's direct export tool is currently restricted to a 90-day window. To retrieve data for longer periods, please use our public API endpoint at '/v1/audit/export' with your desired start and end dates. If you are unable to use the API for this pull, please let us know so we can assist with a manual data export.

subject: CRITICAL: Okta SSO broken for all users

resolution: Because of the v4.2 update, your SSO configuration needs to be refreshed. Please ask your IT team to update the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' in the Okta integration settings to match the new requirements listed in our v4.2 configuration guide.

subject: Locked out of account urgently
body: Hello. I am seeing AUTH-LOCK-429.1 and cannot log in despite using the correct password. We need access immediately to process payroll today.
resolution: Instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: okta sso login error

resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, verify that the 'email' and 'firstName' / 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Ensure 'email' is set as the unique identifier.

subject: extremely slow download speeds
body: thanks for your help. we are having trouble with really slow downloads when sharing public links. we are seeing error download_speed_low. any suggestions on how to improve this
resolution: We recommend testing your connection with a different browser or disabling extensions that might interfere with file transfers. For larger files, the Desktop Sync client offers much more robust performance compared to browser-based downloads.

subject: Audit log export failing over 90 days
body: We are attempting to export audit logs via the Admin Console for a date range exceeding 90 days on our ENTERPRISE account, but the export consistently fails with the error message 'Export range limit exceeded (90 days maximum).' Please advise on how to pull historical logs.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint /v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE] with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: User Not Found error during web login
body: Hi Support, one of our newly invited users is attempting to log in to the web app with their email and password, but they receive an AUTH-NF-404.1 error stating the user is not found. Could you please let us know how to resolve this so they can access their account soon?
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, resend the invitation. Check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if the company has multiple accounts.

subject: Account suspended due to overdue payment
body: Good morning team, as you know we have been using your enterprise platform for quite some time now, and last week we moved our primary office coffee machine to the second floor breakroom which has drastically reduced morning wait times. Coming to the main issue, our entire CloudDesk account has suddenly been suspended and nobody on our team can log in. We saw an Account Suspended banner in the admin console and an email about an overdue payment with error BILL-SUSP-007. This is a critical emergency affecting all our users and halting our company revenue generation right before our board meeting, so we need this resolved immediately.
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Invoices' and paying the overdue invoice. Once payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: User activity report not showing data
body: I am trying to pull the user activity report, but it is coming up completely blank. Everything else in the admin console works fine, but this specific report is giving me nothing. This is quite frustrating as I need these logs for my records.
resolution: A blank report usually indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies before attempting to access the report again. If the issue persists, try using a different browser or disabling any active browser extensions, and let us know the specific date range you are attempting to view if it continues to fail.

subject: User cannot log in after role change
body: One of my users was changed to a Guest and now they cannot log in at all. They are seeing an error regarding permissions and this is urgent since we have a project deadline in one hour.
resolution: Guest users can only access workspaces they have been explicitly invited to. Check the User list in the Admin Console to confirm their current role and verify they have active invitations to the necessary workspaces. If they require full access to the platform, please change their role back to Member or Admin.

subject: New user getting User Not Found error on login
body: Good afternoon. We recently invited a new team member to our enterprise account and they are trying to log in using their email and password. However they are immediately met with an error message stating User Not Found. There is no major rush on this as they wont start working until next week.
resolution: Please verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If it was not accepted, you can resend the invitation. Also, double-check that the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if your company has multiple accounts.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade refund request
body: Hi support, someone on our team clicked upgrade by mistake. Need a refund for the charge under bill-ref-005. Thanks.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: DESKTOP SYNC BROKEN AFTER PASSWORD CHANGE
body: I changed my password in the web app and now the Desktop Sync client throws error CD-AM-015 saying authentication failed! It wont sync anything and my work is completely blocked right now. FIX THIS ASAP PLEASE!
resolution: After a password change, the Desktop Sync client often requires re-authentication. Please open the Desktop Sync application, click on 'Settings' or the 'CloudDesk' icon in the system tray, then select 'Log Out' or 'Disconnect Account' before logging back in with your new password.

subject: Automated data export issue to S3 bucket
body: Hello, I noticed our automated data export to S3 has stopped working since the latest update. We keep getting an error message S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401 even though we haven't touched our AWS credentials. Could you please help us look into this? We really appreciate your assistance with this matter.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced stricter IAM policy requirements for S3 integrations. Please update your AWS IAM role to include the 's3:GetBucketLocation' permission as detailed in our latest integration guide. This should resolve the authentication error you are seeing.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card

resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Frequent sync conflict errors
body: Hi, we are seeing a lot of files marked as Conflict even though no one else is editing them. It is creating many duplicate files in our folders. Does this have to do with SYNC-003?
resolution: These duplicate files are often caused by antivirus software or local firewalls interfering with the sync process. We recommend temporarily disabling your security software to see if the syncing stabilizes. If it does, please add CloudDesk to your whitelist to prevent future conflicts.

subject: Unrecognized charge on our billing statement
