It is extremely frustrating to deal with these discrepancies when we are trying to close our books. I need you to explain this BILL-CHG-010 charge immediately so I can resolve it.
resolution: I apologize for the confusion regarding this transaction. To investigate this further, please provide the exact amount, the date the charge appeared, and the last four digits of the card used. I will then cross-reference this against our billing logs to clarify the charge for you.

subject: SSO login failing after update
body: Ever since the latest platform update, our entire team is unable to log in via SSO. We receive an Invalid SSO Token error and it is completely blocking our ability to collaborate. We need this fixed immediately as it is affecting our workflow.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced a new SSO token format. To resolve this, please re-configure your SSO integration in the Admin Console by downloading the updated SAML metadata. You can find detailed instructions in our v4.2 release notes.

subject: Mobile app crashes on large file uploads
body: We are consistently seeing the app close immediately when uploading files over 1GB. We are hitting error CRASH-MOB-001 on multiple iOS and Android devices. This is a significant issue because we have a critical client demo at 5pm today and need these assets synced. Please let us know the status of this bug as soon as possible.
resolution: This behavior is a known memory management issue affecting large file uploads on our mobile client. As an immediate workaround, please use the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client to upload these files until we release a fix. Our engineering team is currently prioritizing an optimization for this in an upcoming app update.

subject: Workspace loading very slow
body: Hello support team, when I navigate to one of our larger workspaces containing over ten thousand items, the page takes a very long time to load and often shows a blank screen or spinner for more than thirty seconds. resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental plan upgrade
body: My team accidentally upgraded our subscription to a paid plan. We did not intend to do this and would like to request a refund. We have not used any of the premium features. Please let us know the process for this.
resolution: We can review your account for a potential refund on a case-by-case basis. Please confirm the date and time of the upgrade and verify that no premium features have been utilized since that time, and we will process your request.

subject: API tokens failing after v4.2 update
body: All of our existing API integrations are returning 401 unauthorized errors with the code API-AUTH-401-V42 since the update. This is critical as our automated payroll run is scheduled for tomorrow morning. Please assist.
resolution: The API token format was updated with the v4.2 release for security reasons. You must navigate to the 'API & Integrations' section in your Admin Console to regenerate your tokens. Please update your applications with these new credentials to restore connectivity.

subject: Public link expiration limits
body: Hello, our team would like to know if there is a way to set public sharing links to never expire. The current maximum duration is a bit too short for some of our archival sharing needs. No rush on this, just checking if it is possible.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration.

subject: Wrong user name appearing in workspace activity history
body: Good morning to you all, I hope my message finds you well as we are having a rather strange morning here in the office with our coffee machine acting up again, but more importantly, yesterday when we were looking at the workspace activity log, my colleague Sarah moved a document and edited another one, but the system says that our company administrator did it instead, which caused a bit of confusion during our meeting because everyone thought the boss was doing our filing for us, and I saw error code AUDIT-004 displayed on the bottom of the page, so I wanted to let you know about this peculiar display issue.
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct. For accurate audit, cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: Seat limit reached error despite available seats
body: We are trying to add new team members in the admin console but keep getting the error message CD-AM-001 stating that our seat limit has been reached. However, our subscription details clearly show we still have available seats left. Please look into this when you have a moment.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: SSO Just-in-Time Provisioning failing for new users
body: Hello, new users logging in via SSO are not being automatically provisioned in CloudDesk on our free account, despite Just-in-Time Provisioning being enabled in the settings. We received error code CD-AM-009. Please investigate promptly as this is currently blocking our user onboarding workflow.
resolution: We are receiving multiple reports regarding SSO provisioning delays at the moment. Please verify that your SSO Identity Provider is correctly sending the required user attributes in the SAML/OIDC assertion and ensure there are available seats in your subscription. Check Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings for any recent configuration changes or errors.

subject: Okta SSO broken with invalid token format
body: None of our users can log in with Okta SSO since the recent update, and they are getting an invalid SSO token format error. This is severely blocking our company operations today and we require immediate assistance to get everyone back online.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Slow workspace loading for large file counts
body: We have a workspace with over 10,000 files that is timing out. I am getting the WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error. I need this resolved before our audit on Friday. Please advise.
resolution: Large file counts can often lead to extended load times in the web interface. I recommend using our search or filter tools to narrow down the view, or breaking this large workspace into smaller, more manageable units. Please check your browser console for any specific network errors that might be occurring during the load.

subject: Workspace loading takes forever
body: Hi team, our dev department is trying to access workspaces with lots of items and the page just hangs on a spinner for over thirty seconds. we keep seeing error WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT and its really slowing down our workflow today. could you please check whats going on.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. We advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, and suggest breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Please also verify your browser console for any network errors.

subject: Need PDF invoice urgently for our upcoming audit
body: Hello support, I hope you are having a wonderful day. When I try to download our latest invoice from the Admin Console, the only format available is CSV, but we urgently need a PDF copy for our financial audit on Friday. Would you be able to assist us with this promptly?
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a recent system migration. If you provide the specific invoice ID you need, our team can manually generate and email the PDF format to you right away.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with invalid token format
body: Hello support team. After the recent v4.2 update, our employees using Okta SSO cannot log into the web application. They are encountering error code AUTH-SSO-401.1 regarding an invalid token structure. Please assist us promptly.
resolution: Advise customer to update their SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This is required due to a change in SSO token format in v4.2.

subject: Deleted users appearing in sharing dialogs
body: I deleted several users from my console but their names are still showing up in the workspace sharing dropdowns. This is incredibly confusing for my team and clutters the UI. Why does this CD-AM-006 error persist after the user is gone? Please look into this.
resolution: Deleted users are removed from access immediately but may linger as ghost entries in historical lists until the system purges them within 48 hours. Alternatively, the workspace owner can manually remove them from the share list under Workspace Settings. This is expected system behavior.

subject: Users locked out of accounts
body: Our users are seeing an 'Account Locked' message after login attempts, showing error AUTH-LOCK-429.1. We have a company-wide audit this Friday and need this resolved immediately to avoid delays. Please help.
resolution: Instruct the user to wait 15 minutes for the lockout to expire, or an administrator can manually unlock the account via the CloudDesk Admin Console under 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Unlock Account'.

subject: cant log into mobile app network error
body: hi getting a network error on the mobile app every time i try to sign in even though my wifi is completely fine no rush on this since i can use desktop for now
resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache/data (Android) or reinstalling the app (iOS/Android). Verify server status on our status page.

subject: Refund for accidental plan change
body: We upgraded our free account by accident. Need a refund immediately. Error BILL-REF-005.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: User Activity report blank
body: I am trying to pull the User Activity report, but it is returning no data, just a blank page. We have an internal audit on Friday, so I need this resolved. The error is REPORT-001. Please help.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies, or attempt to access the report using a different browser. If the page remains blank, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to view so we can investigate further.

subject: Desktop sync client uploaded local Documents without consent
body: Hello, our desktop sync client automatically uploaded files from the local Documents folder to a CloudDesk workspace without explicit consent. This raises privacy concerns and is blocking our workflow. Please provide prompt assistance.
resolution: The desktop sync client only syncs folders explicitly configured by the user or pre-configured by an admin. Please check the sync client settings for 'Synced Folders' and verify no unintended folders were selected. Ensure 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is disabled if not desired.

subject: Data retention policy not deleting trashed files
body: Hello. I am very frustrated to find that our 30-day file retention policy is completely ignored by the system, and trashed files remain visible past the threshold. This error RETENTION_POLICY_NOT_ENFORCED is causing a lot of confusion. Please fix this soon.
resolution: Verify the retention policy is correctly configured for 'Deleted Files' and 'Trash Bin' in Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Data Retention. Policies apply to files in the 'Permanently Deleted' state. Files in the 'Trash Bin' are subject to user-initiated recovery, not automatic purging by retention policies unless specifically configured to purge Trash after X days.

subject: Missing comments in GDPR export
body: We performed a GDPR data export for a departing user and noticed that specific file and task comments are completely missing from the package. Other profile data looks fine. Please advise.
resolution: The GDPR data export primarily covers files, folders, and direct user profile data. Comments on files and tasks are stored as activity metadata. To export comments, navigate to the specific file/task, open the 'Activity' tab, and use the 'Export Activity Log' option for that item. There is no single bulk export for all user comments across the platform.

subject: Unrecognized charge on company credit card
body: Hello, we found a charge on our credit card statement from CloudDesk that we do not recognize and cannot reconcile with our billing expectations. We need this investigated urgently as it is blocking our expense reporting.
resolution: To investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the transaction, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history right away.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful day. I attempted to request a password reset via the login page for our CloudDesk PRO account, but the reset email has not arrived in my inbox or spam folder. We are seeing error code CD-AM-008 on the screen. Thank you very much for your assistance with this matter.
resolution: First, we confirmed the user's email address is correct and active in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. We advised the user to check their spam and junk folders thoroughly. Since it was still not found, we asked them to whitelist 'no-reply@cloudesk.com'. As a last resort, an Admin can force a password reset for them directly via 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users > [User] > Reset Password'.

subject: Question regarding an unfamiliar billing charge
body: Hello, I noticed a recent charge on our company credit card from CloudDesk that doesn't seem to match our standard PRO plan billing cycle. Could you please look into this when you have a moment? Thank you for your assistance.
resolution: Hello! To help us investigate this unrecognized charge, please reply with the exact amount, the date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. Once we have those details, we will cross-reference them with your account's billing history and provide a full explanation.

subject: Unable to generate API key after promotion
body: Hello Support Team, I was recently promoted to administrator and am trying to set up our integrations. However, when I go to Admin Console > Security > API Access, the button to generate an API key is completely greyed out and I get the error CD-AM-013. Could you please help me figure out what permissions I might be missing? Thank you very much for your time.
resolution: Hello. API Key generation requires the 'Super Admin' role. While you may be an 'Admin', you might not have 'Super Admin' privileges. Please confirm your role in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Users'. If you are not a 'Super Admin', your current Super Admin must generate the key for you or elevate your role.

subject: SSO just-in-time provisioning failing with error CD-AM-009
body: our enterprise account is having major issues right now. new users logging in via sso are NOT being auto provisioned even though we turned on just in time provisioning. we keep seeing cd-am-009 in the logs and our new hires cant access anything. please fix this asap.
resolution: Verify that your SSO Identity Provider (IdP) is correctly sending the required user attributes (email, first_name, last_name) in the SAML/OIDC assertion. Also, ensure there are available seats in your CloudDesk subscription. Check 'Admin Console > Security > SSO Settings' for any recent configuration changes or errors.

subject: Cannot access Admin Console
body: I have user who cannot reach admin console for sync settings. She receive error ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. Can you please verify if her permissions are correct?
resolution: Please confirm the user's current role by navigating to the 'Users' then 'Manage User' then 'Roles' section in the Admin Console. You must ensure that the user has the 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned to access those configuration settings. If she is assigned to a standard user role, please update it accordingly.

subject: Admin console access denied
body: I am the IT admin, but I cannot access the Admin Console anymore. I am getting an error ADMIN-AUTH-403.3 every time I try to log in. This is causing significant delays in our workflow.
resolution: Please confirm the user's current role by navigating to the Admin Console through the 'Users' then 'Manage User' then 'Roles' menu. You should ensure that your account has the 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned. If it is set to a standard user, you will need to update the role to restore access.

subject: api broken after update
body: ever since the update today all our api integrations are throwing a 401 unauthorized with legacy_token_format and api-auth-401-v42 error code. this is completely blocking our workflow right now and we need someone to help us fix this immediately please.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Update your applications to use these new tokens.

subject: API keys returning 401 error
body: Our automated scripts are failing with an API-AUTH-401.4 error. These keys were functional yesterday. Please investigate why the authentication is failing.
resolution: Please check the status of your API keys within the Admin Console. It is possible the key has expired or was inadvertently revoked; if that is the case, simply generate a new key and update your application settings.

subject: Cannot add new team members for upcoming audit
body: I am trying to onboard new staff before our audit on Friday, but I am receiving error CD-AM-001. Our subscription details show we have available seats, yet I am blocked from adding anyone. Please assist as this is a high priority.
resolution: Please verify your 'Pending Invitations' count in the 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' section. Keep in mind that outstanding invitations still count towards your seat limit. You can resolve this by revoking those old pending invites or by upgrading your plan to increase your total seat capacity.

subject: Need to update PO number
body: I need to change the PO number on our account. Getting a BILL-PO-008 error when trying to edit the billing info. Please assist.
resolution: You can update your PO number by navigating to Admin Console > Billing > Billing Information. Locate the Purchase Order Number field to save your changes for future invoices. Please note that this cannot be applied retroactively to invoices already generated.

subject: Admin access needed for private workspace compliance
body: We need to access a specific user's private workspace for an urgent compliance audit, but the system denies access with PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED. This is blocking our internal review process and we need a way around this right away.
resolution: By default, private workspaces are inaccessible even to administrators for enhanced privacy. An admin can only gain temporary access by initiating a 'Workspace Access Request' through Admin Console > Users > [User Profile] > Workspaces. This action generates an audit log entry and requires the user to be notified (if active) or a compliance officer override (if inactive/terminated).

subject: Desktop sync keeps asking for SSO re-login
body: Hi there, since updating the desktop sync client to v4.2, our team keeps getting logged out and prompted for SSO again and again. The client logs show SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 repeatedly. This is slowing down our billing workflow today so any quick help is appreciated.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to SSO token handling. Advise the user to perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client (uninstall, restart, then install). If the issue persists, the company's SSO administrator may need to review their IdP's token lifetime settings or regenerate the application's client secret in CloudDesk Admin Console.

subject: Permission denied accessing shared workspace
body: I am getting a PERM-WS-403.4 error when trying to open a specific project folder. I have been able to access this for months without any issues. Could you help me gain access again so I can get back to work?
resolution: It looks like your access rights may have been modified. An administrator will need to navigate to the specific workspace in the Admin Console and verify your membership settings. They should ensure you are correctly assigned to the workspace with the appropriate access permissions.

subject: SSO login failing after update
body: Hello CloudDesk team, hope you are having a good week. Some of our employees are being redirected to an Azure AD error page after trying to log in today. We would love to get this sorted out soon when you have a brief moment. Thank you so much for your help!
resolution: In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs' (replace 'yourcompany' with your actual subdomain).

subject: okta sso login error
body: our team cannot log in via okta sso after the 4.2 update, getting invalid token format error, code auth-402. this is blocking everything, can you help us get back in?
resolution: The v4.2 update changed how we handle SSO tokens. Please have your IT team update the CloudDesk integration in Okta to match the new Audience URI and SAML values. These can be found in your admin console under the SSO configuration settings.

subject: wrong roles showing in users and permissions ui
body: hi some user roles like contributor are showing up wrong in the admin console ui even though workspace permissions are fine. error code UI-ADMIN-003 showed up. no rush on this whenever you get time thanks
resolution: Hello. This is a known UI display bug and your actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: Okta SSO invalid token format after v4.2 update
body: Dear support team, ever since our platform was updated to v4.2, all our attempts to log in via Okta SSO result in an invalid token format error. Standard email and password logins are working fine, but our PRO team relies heavily on SSO. Could you please help us resolve this blocking issue promptly?
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise the customer's IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in their Okta console. They need to ensure the 'Audience URI' and 'SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL' match the new values provided in our v4.2 SSO configuration guide (accessible in the admin console under 'Settings' -> 'SSO & Authentication' -> 'Okta Configuration').

subject: Files remain cached on mobile devices
body: I am furious that files are staying on mobile devices after users log out! This is a major security risk for our company data, especially if a phone is lost. We need a way to clear this cache immediately. Fix this MOBILE_APP_CACHE_PERSISTENCE problem!
resolution: The mobile app caches files by default for offline usage. You can manually clear this by going to the app Settings, selecting Storage, and choosing Clear Cached Files. For future security, you can enable the 'Clear cache on logout' toggle in that same menu.

subject: Seat limit error when adding users
body: I am trying to provision new seats for our team but am getting a CD-AM-001 error stating our limit has been reached. However, our subscription overview shows we have plenty of available capacity. Could you please check why this is happening?
resolution: This error often occurs because pending invitations count against your total seat limit. Please navigate to the 'Invitations' tab under Team Management to view and revoke any old, unclaimed invites. Freeing up these pending slots should allow you to add your new team members.

subject: New user login error
body: We invited a new team member and they are trying to log in with email and password but get an User Not Found error. Error code is AUTH-NF-404.1. Please advise when possible.
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm that the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, please resend the invitation. Additionally, check if the user is trying to log into the correct instance URL if your company has multiple accounts.

subject: Unrecognized charge on billing statement
body: Hello Support, I am reviewing our credit card statements for our free account and noticed a charge from CloudDesk that we do not recognize and cannot reconcile with our expected billing. We have our annual company audit on Friday so we need this resolved promptly. Could you please assist us with this as soon as possible?
resolution: We are aware that many customers are experiencing unexpected billing visibility issues right now. To investigate this unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Unable to edit Company Name in settings
body: The Company Name field is read-only and I cannot save any updates! This is very frustrating as we have a major audit on Friday and our documents need to be accurate. Please resolve this CD-AM-010 error promptly.
resolution: The Company Name is linked to your subscription billing information. To update it, you must navigate to Admin Console, then Subscription & Billing to update the Organization Name there. Once saved, this change will automatically propagate to your Company Settings.

subject: file version limits are too low

resolution: We appreciate your feedback regarding file versioning. The current limits are set to balance storage and performance. We recommend utilizing our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com to submit your specific requirements for enhanced versioning and vote on similar requests.

subject: Audit logs missing external user info
body: we noticed that when we share files with external people the audit logs only show our internal user name and not the external person who downloaded the file. this seems to be happening for everyone on our team. is there a way to see who actually accessed the document?
resolution: By default, external share links are anonymous, which is why individual access isn't logged. To track specific external user activity, you must configure your share links to require email verification or a CloudDesk login. Please note that this setting cannot be applied retroactively to links that have already been generated.

subject: High CPU usage from desktop sync client
body: Hello, we are noticing that the CloudDesk desktop sync client is consuming over 50% CPU and a significant amount of memory constantly, even when idle. This is severely slowing down our machines and blocking our daily workflow. Please investigate this perf-dsk-001 issue promptly.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After reset, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: large file uploads timing out
body: files over 1gb are taking forever to upload and keep timing out on the web app. upload_timeout_504 keeps popping up. no massive rush here since we can try again later when things are less busy
resolution: Advise customer to check their internet connection speed. For files over 500MB, recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client for more reliable uploads, as it supports resumable transfers. Verify if the issue persists across different browsers. If on Wi-Fi, suggest trying a wired connection.

subject: API calls failing with 401 Unauthorized
body: Since we moved to v4.2, our automated integrations have stopped working completely. We are receiving an API-AUTH-401-V42 error and 'legacy_token_format' messages. We need this resolved as soon as possible to resume our workflows.
resolution: With the v4.2 update, we have implemented a new, more secure API token format. You must head to the 'API & Integrations' section in your Admin Console to regenerate your tokens. Please update your integrations with these new credentials to restore connectivity.

subject: New user login failing with error

subject: New member invitation emails not arriving

resolution: Please have your IT team verify that your SPF and DKIM records are correctly configured to allow emails from our domain. You should also check the spam or junk folders of the affected users. If the issue continues, please send us the specific email addresses, and we will investigate further.

subject: BILLING PAGE IS BROKEN!!
body: I am trying to view our invoices but I keep getting a Payment Processing Error when I log in with SSO. This is ridiculous! I see error code AUTH-BILL-402 every single time. Fix this so I can pay our bill.
resolution: The v4.2 update changed our SSO token format, which is currently interfering with sensitive billing pages. Please try logging out and back in using your direct email and password if available, or clear your browser cache entirely. If that fails, please use a non-SSO login method temporarily while our engineers fix the integration.

subject: Webhooks failing to deliver
body: Webhooks arent working anymore. Keep gettin error WEBHOOK-DELIVERY-500. Everything was fine until yesterday. Fix this please.
resolution: Please verify that your webhook endpoint URL is entered correctly in the Admin Console. You should also confirm your external service is running and accessible from the public internet. Ensure your firewall is configured to allow incoming connections from the CloudDesk IP range listed in our documentation.

subject: cant seem to downgrade my plan
body: Hi there. I am trying to downgrade our free account but the button isnt doing anything. I keep seeing error BILL-PLAN-011 when I click it. Seems like the site is acting up today for everyone.
resolution: To downgrade your plan, navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Subscription Details' -> 'Change Plan' and select your desired tier. Please note that downgrades take effect at the end of your current cycle, and we do not provide prorated refunds for unused time on higher plans.

subject: API returning 429 Too Many Requests during peak hours

resolution: We recommend implementing exponential backoff and retry logic directly within your API client application. Additionally, please review your application's request patterns to optimize call frequency, or reach out to support to request a formal rate limit increase if your use case requires higher volumes.

resolution: Private workspaces are protected by default, so you must initiate a formal Workspace Access Request through the User Profile section in the Admin Console. This process will trigger an audit log and ensure the proper compliance procedures are followed.

resolution: Instruct the user to clear their browser's cookies and local storage for 'cloudesk.com'. Check if the user has strict privacy settings or browser extensions that might be interfering with session cookies and verify the system time on the user's device.

subject: Unable to add team members due to seat error
body: I am trying to add new hires to our account but keep getting CD-AM-001. It says seat limit reached but the subscription screen shows we have plenty of open seats left. Why is this happening? Its really frustrating to deal with when we are trying to onboard.
resolution: Please check the Pending Invitations count in Admin Console under Team Management. Any pending invitations count against your seat limit, which may be why you are hitting this cap. You can either revoke those older invites or upgrade your plan to increase your capacity.

subject: Cannot update Company Name in settings
body: Hello, I am trying to update our company name under Admin Console > Company Settings on our PRO plan, but the field appears to be read-only and my changes will not save. There is no major rush on this since it is just a minor label update, but I wanted to report it.
resolution: The Company Name is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details. Navigate to Admin Console > Subscription & Billing and update the Organization Name there. This change will propagate to the Company Settings.

subject: API rate limit errors during peak hours
body: Hello. Our automated scripts are receiving frequent API-RATE-429 responses during our busiest operational hours. Please let us know if there are any specific guidelines we should follow regarding this behavior.
resolution: Implement exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client. Review your application's API usage patterns and consider optimizing calls or requesting a rate limit increase via support if justified by legitimate use cases.

subject: Enterprise billing payment method update error
body: Good afternoon, I am writing to you today from our accounting department regarding our enterprise subscription. We were attempting to update our corporate credit card on file, and while navigating through the admin console pages, we encountered the BILL-PAY-012 error code stating that the details are invalid even though everything has been double-checked. This is somewhat important for our upcoming billing cycle, so your prompt help would be greatly appreciated.
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again after 30 minutes, or contact your bank to ensure there are no transaction blocks.

subject: Cannot login after role change
body: I was recently moved to a guest role and now I am completely blocked from the web application. I keep seeing error CD-AM-002 when I try to sign in. This is preventing me from finishing my current tasks. Please resolve this as soon as possible.
resolution: Guest users have restricted access and must be explicitly invited to specific shared workspaces. Please have your admin check your status in the Team Management console to ensure you have active invitations. If you require full access, they will need to update your role back to Member or Admin.

subject: Sync client high cpu usage before audit
body: Help! Your desktop sync client is causing insane cpu usage above 50% and memory consumption even when not syncing anything. Our big financial audit is starting on Friday and this is slowing down our computers so much we cant get our prep work done. Error code is PERF-DSK-001. Please fix this right now.
resolution: This can occur if the client is stuck in a re-indexing loop. First, pause syncing from the client's tray icon. Then, go to 'Settings' -> 'Advanced' and click 'Reset Sync Database'. After reset, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in synced folders.

subject: Search lag in specific workspace
body: When our team members search for files or folders within our main engineering workspace, the search spinner runs indefinitely or takes minutes to load. This issue only happens in this specific workspace and not globally across the platform. We noticed the WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG error during our tests.
resolution: Please investigate if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested folder structures. We advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches while considering optimizing the workspace structure if feasible. Feel free to report the specific workspace ID to our engineering team for a deeper indexing review.

subject: okta sso login broken after update
body: users trying to sign in using okta sso are getting an invalid sso token format message since the v4.2 update. this is blocking access for everyone on our pro team. please help resolve this immediately.
resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata file. This step is necessary due to the updated SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: Session Expired error on dashboard
body: Hello there! I hope youre having a wonderful day. I keep getting logged out of the web app with an AUTH-SESSION-401.5 error right after I sign in and cant even reach my billing info. Could you please help me sort this out when you have a moment? Thank you so much for your help!
resolution: Please clear your browser's cookies and local storage for 'cloudesk.com'. Check if you have strict privacy settings or browser extensions that might be interfering with session cookies, and verify the system time on your device.

subject: Invitation emails not arriving
body: New workspace members are not receiving their invitation emails, and they remain in 'Pending' status. We are seeing error code EMAIL-005. Can you please check why these are not being delivered?
resolution: Please check your spam or junk folders first to ensure the invites aren't being filtered. You should also verify that your domain's SPF and DKIM records are configured to allow emails from our sending domain, as detailed in our guide. If the issue persists, send us the affected email addresses and we will investigate.

subject: Audit log export range limit
body: We need to export audit logs for a period longer than 90 days, but the system is blocking the request. Is there a way to bypass this limitation or export a larger range?
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint /v1/audit/export with a pagination script to pull the data. If you are unable to use the API, please contact us for a manual data pull.

subject: Request for workspace creation API endpoint
body: We are looking for a way to programmatically create and configure workspaces for our automated client onboarding. We know there were changes to the SSO token in v4.2, but does the API support this yet? Please let us know if this is on the roadmap.
resolution: While we updated our SSO handling in v4.2, an API endpoint for programmatic workspace creation is not currently available. Please submit your detailed requirements to our dedicated roadmap portal. This feedback is essential for us to prioritize future development of this feature.

subject: API calls failing with 401 unauthorized error blocking deployment
body: Our integration API calls are currently returning 401 Unauthorized with expired token errors on our PRO account. We have a major client demo scheduled for 5 PM today and this is completely blocking our work. Please provide prompt support to help us get our API connection working again immediately.
resolution: To resolve the API-AUTH-401 error blocking your demo, please regenerate your API token from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console. Ensure the new token is correctly included in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header of your requests.

subject: User Activity report not loading
body: Hello, the User Activity report is appearing completely blank when I try to run it. I am seeing the error code REPORT-001. We have a compliance audit this Friday, so I really need this fixed as soon as possible. Thank you for your help.
resolution: This usually points to a temporary data retrieval snag. Please clear your browser cache and cookies, or try accessing the report through a different browser to rule out extension conflicts. If the page remains blank, please provide the specific date range you are trying to export.

subject: Permission Denied accessing shared workspace
body: Hello, one of our executives cannot open a critical shared workspace and receives a permission denied message. We have an important board audit on Friday and need this functional. Please advise on how to grant them access.
resolution: An administrator needs to verify the user's permissions for that specific workspace. Navigate to the workspace in the Admin Console, check 'Members' or 'Permissions' and ensure the user is correctly assigned with appropriate access rights.

subject: Account suspension notice and login block
body: Hello, thank you for your assistance. Our account has been suspended with a banner showing BILL-SUSP-007, and our users cannot log in. Could you please guide us on how to resolve this so normal operations can resume?
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Invoices' and paying the overdue invoice. Once payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: Search results hanging in specific workspace
body: I am having some trouble with the search feature in one of our main workspaces. It seems to hang indefinitely, giving us WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG. We have a presentation demo at 5pm today, so any tips to improve this would be greatly appreciated. Thank you for your help.
resolution: Please check if the affected workspace contains a very large number of files or deeply nested folder structures, as this can impact search performance. I recommend using more specific keywords or path-based searches to narrow down the results. Please provide the workspace ID if you would like us to review the indexing for you.

subject: Unable to transfer workspace ownership
body: We need to transfer ownership of a workspace to a new manager but the option is greyed out. We are seeing error CD-AM-004. This is blocking our internal handoff. Please assist ASAP.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to a user who is already a Member or Admin of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient has been added to the workspace first. Once they are a member, you will be able to perform the transfer via the Admin Console under the workspace settings.

subject: google sso redirect loop
body: when i try to use google sso i just get stuck in a redirect loop and never reach the dashboard. i am seeing error code auth-sso-302.1. no rush on this, just wanted to report it.
resolution: Please clear your browser's cache and cookies specifically for our domain to resolve the loop. If the problem persists, try using an incognito window or a different browser to verify if it is a local storage issue. We have also verified your Google SSO configuration on our end to ensure it is active.

subject: GET file content endpoint returning intermittent 500 errors
body: We are receiving api-500 errors on file content downloads intermittently. Other routes work fine.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Okta login not working after v4.2 update
body: Since the update to 4.2 our team cannot access the platform via Okta anymore. We keep getting AUTH-402 errors and it is redirecting us back to the login screen. Please fix this, we have important work pending.
resolution: This issue is due to a change in SSO token handling in v4.2. Please advise your IT administrator to update the CloudDesk application integration in your Okta console, ensuring the Audience URI and SAML Assertion Consumer Service URL match the new values found in our v4.2 configuration guide under Settings in the Admin Console.

subject: Request for longer public sharing link expiration times
body: Hello team, I am writing on behalf of our development team regarding public share links. Users want the ability to set public sharing links to never expire or to have a much longer expiration period than the current maximum. No rush on this, just wanted to submit the request for future consideration.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer never expire options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Invite link not working for new user
body: I sent an invite to a new contractor but they are stuck in 'Pending Invitation' status. They cant log in at all. Its causing a real headache for our onboarding process.
resolution: This status can occur if there is a delay or domain configuration issue. Please ask the user to attempt a direct login, or revoke the current invitation in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and send a fresh one.

subject: HOW TO SWITCH TO ANNUAL BILLING
body: I need to change our subscription plan from monthly to annual billing immediately using bill-plan-004. Where is the option located in the dashboard because I cannot find it anywhere and it is very annoying.
resolution: To update your billing cycle, simply navigate to the 'Admin Console', select 'Billing', then 'Subscription Details', and click on 'Change Plan'. From there, you can choose the annual option for your current subscription. The change will take effect at your next billing cycle, and any remaining monthly credit will be prorated automatically.

subject: Need longer or permanent public sharing link expirations
body: It is honestly ridiculous that we cannot set our public sharing links to never expire or at least last longer than the current maximum. Our team finds this limitation very annoying for long-term document sharing with external partners. Please let us know how to change this.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is enforced for security best practices, and we do not currently plan to offer a 'never expire' option. However, we welcome you to share your specific use cases for longer durations at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration, and for permanent sharing in the meantime, you can invite users directly to a workspace.

subject: User Activity report page is blank
body: I noticed the User Activity report in the admin console is loading completely blank. Other reports are working perfectly fine, so it seems isolated to this one. There is no urgency, but I would like to see this resolved when you have a moment.
resolution: This behavior often points to a minor browser rendering conflict. Please try clearing your cache or using a different browser to see if the data populates. If the screen remains blank, please let us know the specific date range you are trying to pull.

subject: Need more detailed user activity reports
body: Hello, the current audit logs do not give us enough detail on file downloads and specific collaboration actions. We need comprehensive reporting to track compliance properly. Please provide an update on when this feature will be available.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA code issue on mobile
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful day. Occasionally, my Google Authenticator code is not accepted on the mobile app, displaying AUTH-MFA-401.2. There is no rush on this, but I would appreciate any advice you might have.
resolution: Advise the user to ensure their phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, guide them through re-setting up MFA for their account via the web app's 'Security Settings' page.

subject: Unrecognized charge on credit card statement
body: Hello, our billing department found a charge from CloudDesk on our credit card statement that we cannot reconcile. This is blocking our financial reconciliation and we need you to look into it right away. Please help us trace this payment.
resolution: To investigate an unrecognized charge, please provide the exact amount, date of the charge, and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will cross-reference this with your account's billing history and provide details on the charge.

subject: Need access to private workspace
body: I am currently performing a compliance audit and need to access a specific user's private workspace. The system is blocking me with the error PRIVATE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED. Please advise on how to proceed as this is blocking our internal review.
resolution: By design, private workspaces are protected even from administrator accounts. To gain access, please initiate a Workspace Access Request via the user's profile in the Admin Console. This process will trigger an audit log entry and may require a compliance officer override if the user is inactive.

subject: Cant download invoices older than 12 months
body: Hello, I am trying to pull some older billing records from the admin console but anything past 12 months isnt showing up. No rush on this, just need it for our records eventually.
resolution: The Admin Console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months. For older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you are looking for, and we will retrieve it for you from our archives.

subject: SSO login issue in desktop sync client
body: Dear Support, we hope you are doing well. When attempting to log into the desktop sync client using our SSO provider, the browser successfully redirects, but the client remains unauthenticated and shows a generic login failed error. We would appreciate your guidance on this when your schedule permits. Thank you!
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Check if the user's default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, suggest logging in via email/password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: Need permanent public sharing links via API
body: Hey, we are currently integrating the public REST API into our workflow and want to know if there is a way to set public sharing links to never expire. The current maximum expiration is too short for our use case. No huge rush on this since we are still in early development.
resolution: The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer 'never expire' options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace.

subject: Invited user stuck as pending invitation
body: I sent an invite to a new contractor yesterday and clicked the link, but their status in the Admin Console remains 'Pending Invitation' and they keep getting CD-AM-005 when trying to log in. This is holding up our onboarding process so please help when you can.
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set. If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and send a new one.

subject: Desktop client showing conflict errors for unchanged documents
body: Hello team, I am writing from the finance department regarding our desktop app. The sync client frequently flags files as Conflict even when no concurrent edits have occurred. This leads to duplicate files being created unnecessarily. We are seeing error code SYNC-003 on several workstations. Please let us know how to resolve this soon.
resolution: This typically occurs due to network instability or aggressive antivirus/firewall software interfering with the sync process. Please temporarily disable your antivirus/firewall and try syncing again. If successful, add CloudDesk to your antivirus/firewall's whitelist. Also, ensure your network connection is stable.

subject: Need API endpoint for workspace creation
body: We need an API endpoint to programmatically create and configure workspaces for our automated client onboarding process. The current v4.2 SSO token changes have disrupted our workflow. When will this be added?
resolution: While we have updated our SSO handling in v4.2, we do not currently have a public API endpoint for automated workspace creation. Please submit your technical requirements to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements/workspace-creation-api so our team can prioritize this development. For now, workspace management must be handled directly through the Admin Console.

subject: Webhooks not reaching external service
body: Hello support, our Pro workspace webhooks stopped arriving at our external endpoint and show connection refused messages. We would appreciate your help to resolve this issue. Thank you for your support.
resolution: Verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console's webhooks settings. Confirm your external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range.

subject: Desktop client SSO login failed
body: SSO authentication fails when logging into the desktop sync client after redirecting from the browser. The client returns a generic login failed error. DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 is displayed. We need this resolved promptly as it is blocking team access.
resolution: Ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version. Check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects. As a workaround, you can log in via email and password if SSO enforcement allows.

subject: API connectivity issues after v4.2 update
body: We are extremely frustrated because our integration stopped working immediately after the v4.2 update. Everything is returning a 401 Unauthorized error with 'legacy_token_format'. We are seeing error code API-AUTH-401-V42 and need this resolved immediately to keep our workflows running.
resolution: With the release of v4.2, the API token format was updated for security reasons. You will need to regenerate all your existing API tokens from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console. Please update your applications to use these new tokens to restore connectivity.

subject: User Activity report is blank
body: I cannot view my User Activity report because the page is just completely blank! I need this data for my records and it is very annoying that it isn't working. It is showing REPORT-001 whenever I try to load it.
resolution: This usually points to a temporary data retrieval issue. Please try clearing your browser cache and cookies or testing the report in a different browser. If the page is still blank, please let us know the specific date range you are attempting to view so we can investigate further.

subject: workspace search taking too long
body: hi, when searching for files inside one specific workspace the search spinner just runs forever or takes ages to finish. it only happens in this one workspace not globally. no real rush on this just wanted to report it.
resolution: We have noted increased search latency in certain large workspaces across the platform. Please investigate if the affected workspace contains an unusually high number of items or deeply nested folder structures. We advise using more specific keywords or path-based searches, and you can report the specific workspace ID to engineering for an indexing review.

subject: Search not finding my files
body: Hey, the search feature is acting up today and not showing files i know are there. I keep getting missing results and seen the error SEARCH-002. its making it hard to finish my project. Can you fix this soon?
resolution: It sounds like your search index may need a refresh. Please try searching for the exact phrase in quotes first, or log out and back in to trigger a re-index. If you still have trouble, let us know the specific terms you were searching for.

subject: Requesting refund for accidental upgrade
body: I accidentally upgraded our plan and need a refund for this charge. I keep seeing BILL-REF-005 when I try to adjust the subscription settings. Can you please assist in reversing this payment? It was a simple mistake on my part.
resolution: We handle refund requests for accidental upgrades on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade and confirm that none of the premium features were utilized. Once verified, we will review your account eligibility for a reversal.

subject: API tokens broken with legacy_token_format error after v4.2
body: Our entire production pipeline is down right now because all API tokens are returning 401 Unauthorized with the legacy_token_format error after the v4.2 release. Many developers are hitting this exact roadblock simultaneously. We need an immediate fix or workaround for this critical deployment blocker!
resolution: Hello. With v4.2, the API token format was updated. You must regenerate all API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console, and then update your applications to use these new tokens immediately.

subject: Audit logs missing external user details for shared files
body: Hi support team, our company users are sharing files externally, but the audit logs do not show which specific external user accessed or downloaded the shared file. Only the internal user who created the share link is logged, showing AUDIT_EXTERNAL_SHARE_ANONYMOUS. Thank you so much for looking into this for us.
resolution: By default, external share links are anonymous. To track external user activity, the share link must be configured with 'Require Email Verification' or 'Require CloudDesk Login'. This setting ensures the external user's identity is captured in the audit logs. Note that this cannot be retroactively applied to existing anonymous links.

subject: company name wont save in settings
body: hey we cant update our company name in the admin console right now. it just errors out with CD-AM-010 every time we try. please look into this when you get a chance.
resolution: The 'Company Name' is tied to your subscription billing information. To change it, you must update your billing details. Navigate to 'Admin Console > Subscription & Billing' and update the 'Organization Name' there. This change will propagate to the Company Settings.

subject: Payment Processing Error in billing after update
body: Dear CloudDesk Support, Since the recent v4.2 release, our finance team has been encountering an Authentication Failed message specifically in the billing section when logging in via SSO. We need to update our payment methods urgently. Could you please assist us with this as soon as possible? Thank you for your continued help.
resolution: Hello. The v4.2 release updated the SSO token format which can sometimes cause session issues with sensitive billing operations. Please try logging out and logging back in directly using your email/password (if enabled) or clearing your browser cache and cookies. If the issue persists with SSO, consider temporarily using a direct email/password login for billing management, and we will investigate the SSO integration specifically for billing.

subject: Unable to add new team members
body: We are trying to scale our team today but we are unable to add new users because the system claims we have reached our seat limit. Our subscription details clearly show we have empty seats available. It seems like a system-wide glitch. Please look into this for us.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Cannot add new team members despite available seats
body: Hello, I am trying to add new team members in the Admin Console, but I receive an error message stating that the seat limit has been reached, even though our subscription details clearly show we still have available seats. We are on the ENTERPRISE plan. Please advise.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Subscription renewal payment failed notice
body: Dear support, we recently received a notification that our automatic subscription renewal failed due to a declined credit card. We would appreciate your prompt assistance in resolving this issue so that our account status returns to normal. Thank you very much for your help.
resolution: Please navigate to Admin Console -> Billing -> Payment Methods and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the Invoices section.

subject: Desktop sync client not updating files
body: Ever since the v4.2 update, our desktop sync client is failing to pull the latest changes from the web app. This is causing significant delays for our team, and we are seeing the SYNC-001 error consistently. Please advise on a fix as this is stopping our current project dead in its tracks.
resolution: Please uninstall the v4.2 desktop sync client and then clear the local sync cache at your specific file path for Windows or macOS. Once the cache is cleared, please perform a clean reinstall using the download link found in the Desktop Sync section of your web app settings. This should re-establish the connection to your files.

subject: API returning 401 legacy token errors
body: Critical issue after v4.2 update, our app is totally down. We receive API-AUTH-401-V42 error and legacy_token_format message. This is affecting all our users and we need a solution immediately. Why are our old tokens suddenly invalid?
resolution: The API token format was updated with our v4.2 release for security reasons. You must now regenerate all your access tokens via the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console. Please update your environment variables with these new keys to restore connectivity.

subject: missing search results in web app
body: Hi support, when searching for specific keywords inside files or folders, some known documents dont show up in the web app results. This is happening across multiple accounts right now with error code SEARCH-002. Please let us know how to resolve this.
resolution: This behavior can sometimes be due to an outdated search index affecting various accounts. Please try performing a more specific search, such as using an exact phrase in quotes. If the issue persists, log out and log back in, which can trigger a re-indexing for your account, and feel free to provide specific search terms if it remains unresolved.

subject: Audit log export failing for ranges over 90 days
body: Hello, I am attempting to export audit logs from the Admin Console for a date range exceeding 90 days on our Pro plan. The export consistently fails and returns an error message stating that the export range limit has been exceeded. Please let me know how we can retrieve this historical data.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: New user login issues
body: I recently invited a new team member, but they are unable to sign into their account. They keep receiving an User Not Found error when trying to access our workspace. I noticed error code AUTH-NF-404.1 in their screenshot. Could you please help us resolve this so they can start working?
resolution: Please verify that the user's email address is correctly spelled in the Admin Console. Check if the invitation status is still pending and try resending it if necessary. If they are still unable to log in, please ensure they are using the correct instance URL for your company's account.

subject: Request for longer public link expiration periods
body: We would like to request an option for public sharing links to never expire or at least have a much longer duration. The current limits make it difficult for our long-term project partners to access materials. We appreciate your hard work and would love to see this change in the future.
resolution: We keep expiration limits in place to adhere to security best practices, but we are open to feedback regarding longer durations. Please share your specific use cases on our feature request page at roadmap.cloudesk.com. In the meantime, inviting partners as direct members of a workspace is the best way to maintain permanent access.

subject: Frequent 500 errors on GET files content API
body: Our development team is encountering an API-500 error when calling the files content endpoint. This is happening intermittently for files hosted in different regions. We have an important partner demo at 5pm today, and this issue is disrupting our progress. Can you look into this immediately?
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are currently investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Cannot remove user from workspace
body: Hi, Im trying to remove a team member from one of our workspaces. Every time I hit delete it gives me error CD-AM-014. Is there a way to force this? Thanks.
resolution: A user cannot be removed from a workspace if they are the current owner. Please go to Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership to reassign the workspace to another member first. Once the transfer is complete, you will be able to remove the user as expected.

subject: Missing login records in audit log
body: Hello support team. While reviewing our recent account security, I noticed that we cannot find any entries for unusual login attempts or logins from new countries in our standard Login Activity audit log. It appears that only successful logins are currently visible to us. Please let us know how we can review these missing logs.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses/locations are actually recorded in the Security Events log rather than the Login Activity section. Please navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events to find this information. You can also enable Login Anomaly Detection for automatic alerts going forward.

subject: Billing page not loading after v4.2 update
body: I cannot access the billing section to update our payment method. I keep getting an authentication error, likely AUTH-BILL-402, and it is incredibly frustrating. We have a hard deadline to update our card for the next billing cycle by Friday. Please tell me how to access my invoices and billing settings.
resolution: The v4.2 update introduced a session handling change that can interfere with billing authentication via SSO. Please try logging out and signing back in using your direct email and password if available. If the issue persists, clearing your browser cookies or using a direct login method should allow you to manage your billing settings successfully.

subject: Payment failed notification and billing status
body: Dear support team, thank you for your continued assistance with our account. We received a notice that our automatic renewal failed due to a declined card, showing code BILL-PAY-002, and we would like to get this updated when convenient. We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank. You can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: Desktop Sync stuck indexing
body: The desktop sync client has been stuck on indexing for quite some time now. Files are not uploading or downloading to my local machine. Could you please provide instructions on how to resolve this SYNC_STATUS_STUCK error?
resolution: Please try restarting the Desktop Sync application first. If the status remains stuck, go to Settings > Advanced and clear the application cache. Should that not resolve the behavior, we recommend performing a full reinstall of the client after backing up any unsynced local files.

subject: Intermittent API Rate Limit Exceeded Errors
body: Our application is receiving intermittent 429 Too Many Requests responses from the API during peak hours. This is blocking our core workflows and needs your prompt attention.
resolution: Implement exponential backoff and retry logic in your API client. Review your application's API usage patterns and consider optimizing calls or requesting a rate limit increase via support if justified by legitimate use cases.

subject: password reset email not arriving
body: Hello i tried requesting a new password through the web app but the email is not coming through. I checked spam and other cloudesk messages are arriving fine. The error code shown is auth-pr-200.1. Can you help.
resolution: Let's verify the user's email address in the Admin Console. Check if the user's domain is configured with an approved email sender list, and if not, advise adding 'no-reply@cloudesk.com' to their allowlist. I can also manually trigger a password reset from the Admin Console if necessary.

subject: AWS S3 automated export failing with invalid credentials

If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.
