resolution: I am sorry for the trouble. Please uninstall your v4.2 desktop client, clear the local cache located in your user profile folder, and reinstall the application directly from the web app's settings menu.

subject: WHY IS NOTHING SYNCING???
body: I have an audit this Friday and my desktop files are completely frozen! I keep seeing SYNC-001 and I cannot get my work done at all. The web app is fine but my computer is not updating. This is completely unacceptable and needs to be resolved right now!
resolution: I apologize for the frustration. To resolve the SYNC-001 error, please uninstall the v4.2 client, clear your local sync cache folder, and reinstall a clean version of the software via the link found in your CloudDesk settings.

subject: Desktop sync issues after recent update
body: The latest v4.2 update for the desktop client has completely broken my sync functionality. Files I save to the cloud are not showing up on my machine at all. I have work that is currently blocked because I rely on the desktop sync for my daily tasks. Please help me get this sorted out.
resolution: We are aware of this issue following the update. Please uninstall the v4.2 client, clear the sync cache from your system directories, and perform a new installation using the link in your web app's Desktop Sync section.

subject: Desktop sync not reflecting changes
body: We have noticed that since the update to v4.2, the desktop client is not updating files correctly. Syncing works perfectly on the web and mobile interfaces, but the desktop version displays error SYNC-001. We need this resolved promptly as it is preventing our team from accessing the latest versions of their work.
resolution: This behavior is related to the v4.2 update path. Please uninstall the current desktop client, clear your local sync cache, and reinstall the client from the download link within your web app settings.

subject: invoice download only gives csv format
body: hi team, when i try to download a billing invoice from the admin console it only lets me get a csv file. we really need a pdf version for our accounting records. error is bill-inv-009. please let me know how to fix this.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to an ongoing system migration affecting multiple accounts. For the specific invoice or invoices you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice IDs and our team will generate and email them to you manually right away.

subject: SYNC-001 error breaking my workflow
body: My desktop app is totaly broken after the update and I have a deadline in two hours!! Keep getting SYNC-001 and nothing updates on my laptop. Everything is fine on web but I need the files locally for my presentation. Pls fix this fast
resolution: I understand the time pressure. Please uninstall the current client, remove the local sync cache from your hard drive, and reinstall the latest version from your web app settings.

subject: deleted user still showing in sharing dialogs
body: Hey support an admin deleted a user account recently, but their name and email still show up in sharing dialogs across our workspaces. It looks like many teams are noticing this caching quirk today. No major rush since we can wait for a fix.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as 'ghost' entries in historical share lists until the system purges them, typically within 24-48 hours, or until a workspace owner explicitly removes them from a share via 'Workspace Settings > Members'. This is expected behavior.

subject: API intermittent 500 errors
body: We are getting constant API-500 errors when hitting the /files/{id}/content endpoint. It is specifically happening for our files stored in international regions, which is stopping our production pipeline. I am tired of seeing these errors when everything else works fine. We need a resolution for this behavior as soon as possible.
resolution: We are aware of the issues affecting file retrieval in certain regions and are working on a permanent fix. In the meantime, implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your application code will successfully handle these intermittent errors. Our engineering team is prioritizing a hotfix for this behavior.

subject: gdpr export missing comments
body: hey there, i just ran a gdpr export for one of our users but all the comments are missing from the files and tasks. it says GDPR_EXPORT_INCOMPLETE_COMMENTS in the logs. the rest of the data looks fine though. thanks.
resolution: The current GDPR export tool is designed to capture file and folder data, but comments are processed as separate activity metadata. You can retrieve those comments by going to the specific file or task and using the 'Export Activity Log' button on the activity tab. We do not currently support a bulk export for all user comments combined.

subject: API 403 Forbidden error on workspace share
body: We are trying to automate workspace creation, but our integration is completely blocked by an API-403 error when calling the share endpoint. This is impacting our entire workflow right now and we need an immediate fix. Everything was working fine until today. Please help us resolve this blocker immediately!
resolution: Please verify that the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled in your settings. Additionally, the user associated with that key must be a direct member of the target workspace, rather than just having access via a group. If this persists, please provide your API key ID and the workspace ID so we can inspect the permissions.

subject: Need more detailed user activity reports
body: The current audit logs are completely inadequate for our IT department's compliance monitoring needs. We need granular tracking of file downloads, specific views, and collaboration actions that simply do not exist in the basic free tier console. It is extremely frustrating that we have to ask for such basic enterprise features.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting beyond our basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements for future updates.

subject: SSO login failing with errors after v4.2 update
body: I am writing to you because my team is having a very hard time getting into the system today. I spent a long time checking our internal network configurations and our firewall, and I even had a meeting with our IT lead about our current subscription billing cycle, but nothing seems to explain why we are stuck on the loading screen. After we authenticate with our identity provider, we get a timeout or the SSO_TOKEN_PARSE_DELAY_4_2 error. We have deadlines today and really need this working immediately.
resolution: This issue is related to the recent v4.2 SSO token format change. Please have your admin re-save the SSO configuration in the Admin Console to refresh the internal certificates. Also, ensure your browser cache and cookies are cleared, as this often resolves the token parsing delay.

subject: FILE PREVIEWS ARE COMPLETELY BROKEN
body: Hello, why are our file previews not working today? Whenever we try to preview PDFs or PPTXs directly in the web app, the viewer just shows a blank page or spins indefinitely with error PREVIEW-006. This is incredibly frustrating because our entire team relies on quick previews for daily reviews. Downloading the files still works, but the viewer is totally broken for everyone right now. Please fix this ASAP!
resolution: Hello. This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito or private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: api returning 500 error on get files
body: hey getting api-500 errors when hitting the get files content endpoint for some files in other regions. it is blocking our current development sprint. need someone to look into this asap please.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. Our engineering team is currently investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: Document collaboration lag on office files
body: Hello team, thank you for providing such a great tool on our free plan. We have noticed some latency when multiple users are editing a CloudDesk Office document simultaneously. The cursor positions and text changes take a few seconds to update across different screens. We appreciate your time and would love to see this improved soon.
resolution: Check network latency for all collaborators involved. Advise ensuring all users have a stable internet connection. Recommend closing unnecessary browser tabs/applications. Verify if the issue persists if fewer users are editing the document. Clear browser cache for all users.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on file content endpoint
body: The /files/{id}/content endpoint is throwing API-500 errors intermittently. This is blocking our primary production workflow. Please fix this.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are currently investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: API 403 Forbidden when sharing workspaces
body: We are encountering a 403 Forbidden error on our Enterprise account when making API calls to share a workspace with a new user via POST /workspaces/{id}/share. The API key in use has the Manager role assigned within the workspace and possesses all required global permissions. We need this resolved promptly as it is blocking our automated onboarding pipeline.
resolution: Please ensure that the API key being used has the 'Manage Workspaces' scope enabled in your settings. Additionally, verify that the user associated with that API key is a direct member of the workspace being shared, rather than only having access via a group membership. If the issue persists, please reply with your API key ID and the target workspace ID for further review.

subject: Inquiry regarding custom enterprise billing options
body: Hello, thank you for providing such a wonderful platform. Our finance team is currently exploring annual invoicing and volume discounts for our account. Please let us know the proper procedure to request this.
resolution: For custom enterprise billing solutions and quotes, please contact our sales team directly at sales@cloudesk.com or by filling out the 'Enterprise Inquiry' form on our website. They will be able to discuss your specific requirements and provide a tailored proposal.

subject: API breaking after update to v4.2
body: Our integration stopped working after the upgrade to v4.2, returning a legacy_token_format error. We have a major demo at 5pm today and this is blocking everything. We need this fixed immediately. Error code: API-AUTH-401-V42.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced a new token format, rendering previous legacy tokens incompatible. You must regenerate all your API tokens via the Admin Console under the API & Integrations section. Please update your application environment with these new tokens to restore your connection immediately.

subject: PDF and PPTX files failing to preview in web app
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a good week. When attempting to preview certain file types like PDF and PPTX directly within the web app, the preview viewer shows a blank page or spins indefinitely, though downloading the files still works fine. I noticed error code PREVIEW-006 on my screen. I am on our PRO plan and would appreciate it if this could be looked at soon.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions.

subject: Inconsistent billing data in API
body: Since we moved to version 4.2, the data we pull from the usage reports API is not matching what I see in the Admin Console. It is causing some confusion for our accounting team, though it is not an emergency. Is there a known issue with the v4.2 API reporting metrics?
resolution: The v4.2 billing API introduced changes to how certain usage metrics are aggregated, which may explain the discrepancy. Please ensure you are using the correct date range and aggregation parameters outlined in the v4.2 API documentation. If the data still looks off, please provide the specific API query you are running and a screenshot of the conflicting report for us to review.

subject: Api service unavailable 503 errors during peak hours
body: We are experiencing continuous HTTP 503 errors across multiple API endpoints during peak operating hours and high volume requests. This is breaking our automated scripts and production integrations right now. We need this addressed immediately as it is disrupting our core operations.
resolution: We have investigated your API usage patterns and advise checking your 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' header to ensure you are not exceeding rate limits. We strongly recommend implementing exponential backoff for your automated retries. You can also check our CloudDesk status page for any ongoing platform incidents, and let us know if the issue persists so we can escalate to engineering.

subject: Critical: SSO login failing for our entire company
body: Our team cannot log into CloudDesk and we have a hard project deadline in two hours. We are getting the AUTH-SSO-401.1 error across the board. This is affecting all users and our revenue-generating work. Please help us fix this now.
resolution: We understand the urgency. Because of the SSO token format changes in v4.2, you must update your configuration in the Admin Console. Please re-upload your IDP metadata to restore access immediately.

subject: Workspace loading is way too slow
body: My teams workspace is taking forever to load and it just sits there with a spinning icon. Im seeing a WORKSPACE_LOAD_TIMEOUT error constantly. Its been over 30 seconds every time we try to open it today.
resolution: This happens when a workspace contains a very large number of files. We recommend using the search or filter features to locate items instead of loading the full list, or consider splitting the workspace into smaller, more manageable collections.

subject: User Activity report showing blank screen
body: Dear support, I hope you are having a pleasant week. When I try to open the User Activity report in the admin console, it loads but displays no data at all. All other reports seem to be working perfectly. Is this a known issue? Thank you for your time.
resolution: This issue is usually caused by a temporary data retrieval error or a browser cache conflict. Please try clearing your browser's cookies or testing the report in an incognito window. If the report remains blank, please provide the specific date range you are attempting to query so we can investigate further.

subject: Missing failed login attempts in audit log
body: Hi team we suspect some weird login activity from other countries on our pro account today but when we check the Login Activity audit log we cant see any failed attempts or anything suspicious. Only successful logins are visible right now which makes it impossible to investigate. Please help us find where this data is before our audit.
resolution: Failed login attempts and logins from new IP addresses/locations are recorded in the 'Security Events' log, not 'Login Activity'. Navigate to Admin Console > Security & Compliance > Security Events for this information. Enable 'Login Anomaly Detection' for automatic alerts.

subject: Invited user stuck on pending status
body: Hello, we sent an invitation to a new team member and they clicked the link, but their status in the admin console remains pending invitation and they cannot log in. Please look into this when you have a chance.
resolution: This can happen if the user's email domain is not configured for auto-join, or if there's a delay. Ask the user to try logging in directly with their email and the password they set. If the issue persists, revoke the invitation in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations' and send a new one.

subject: Cannot add payment card due to billing error
body: We are trying to update our subscription payment details in the admin console, but the system keeps failing. When attempting to add a new credit card as a payment method, the system returns an Invalid Card Details error, even when the card number, expiry, and CVV are confirmed to be correct. This is throwing error code BILL-PAY-012 and completely blocking our finance workflow. We urgently need a fix for this right away!
resolution: This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again after 30 minutes. If the issue persists, try using a different card or contact your bank to ensure there are no blocks on transactions with CloudDesk. You may also try contacting us with the full error message for further investigation.

subject: Account suspended error message blocking access
body: our clouddesk account has been suspended suddenly and users cant log in anymore. i see an account suspended banner in the admin console and error bill-susp-007. please look into this right away so we can get back to work
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Invoices' and paying the overdue invoice. Once payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: Admin console access denied error for administrator
body: Hello, one of our administrators is unable to access the Admin Console and is being redirected to the standard user dashboard with error ADMIN-AUTH-403.3. We have our quarterly financial payroll run tomorrow and need this admin account fully functional immediately. Thank you.
resolution: Please confirm the user's role in the Admin Console by navigating to 'Users' -> 'Manage User' -> 'Roles'. Ensure they have an 'Admin' or 'Super Admin' role assigned, and update their permissions accordingly if they were modified.

subject: Critical: Okta SSO logins failing with invalid token error
body: All users attempting to log in via Okta SSO are currently failing with the invalid sso token format error auth-sso-401.1 following the v4.2 update. This is entirely blocking our morning shift operations and needs immediate attention.
resolution: We apologize for the disruption caused by the recent changes to the SSO token format in v4.2. Please update your SSO configuration inside the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your identity provider metadata file to restore normal login functionality.

subject: Accidental plan upgrade refund request
body: Hello, our finance team noticed we were accidentally upgraded to a higher tier and we need a refund urgently. We have a payroll run tomorrow and I need this sorted immediately to balance the accounts. The error code is BILL-REF-005. Please respond ASAP.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. Once provided, we will review your account for eligibility.

subject: API file content error 500
body: GET /files/{id}/content returns intermittent 500 errors on our pro plan.
resolution: We are currently seeing a surge in intermittent 500 errors for file content retrieval across multiple servers. This can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client while we investigate the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval.

subject: Admin console access issues
body: I am trying to get into the admin settings but it keeps redirecting me to the user dashboard. I got error code ADMIN-AUTH-403.3 once. Could you look into why my admin access is not working properly? Thanks.
resolution: It appears there may be a permission mismatch on your account profile. Please check the Users section in the Admin Console to verify your current role. Ensure that you have the Admin or Super Admin role assigned to your user account.

subject: Office doc collaboration lag
body: Hello, we noticed some typing lag when multiple users are editing a CloudDesk Office document simultaneously on the mobile app. There is a delay between typing and seeing changes for other collaborators, and cursor positions update slowly. There is no urgency on our end since we can wait for a fix whenever.
resolution: Many users are reporting similar collaboration delays at the moment. Please check network latency for all collaborators involved and ensure all users have a stable internet connection. We recommend closing unnecessary background applications and clearing the cache if the issue persists.

subject: Request for hardware MFA token support
body: Our security department is requesting information on whether CloudDesk supports hardware-based MFA tokens such as YubiKey. Please let us know if this is on your current roadmap.
resolution: While CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification, we completely understand the importance of hardware tokens for enhanced security compliance. You can add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types by visiting our feedback portal at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We continually evaluate and prioritize security features based on customer demand and industry standards.

subject: Cannot access invoices older than one year
body: I noticed that I cannot download any invoices older than 12 months in the admin console. I keep seeing BILL-INV-003. Let me know when this is resolved, no rush.
resolution: The Admin Console typically displays invoices for the last 12 months only. For older invoices, please reply with the specific invoice date or ID you need, and our team will retrieve them for you from our archives.

subject: Incorrect user attribution in workspace activity log
body: We noticed that certain file actions like File Edited and File Moved in the workspace activity log are attributed to an administrator instead of the regular user who performed the action. No urgency on this, just reporting it for your awareness.
resolution: This is a known display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. The underlying audit trail is correct and we are working on a fix. For accurate audit verification in the meantime, please cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: User Activity report page is totally blank
body: When I try to open the User Activity report in the admin console it just loads a completely blank page while every other report works fine. It is a bit annoying but no immediate rush to fix since we only check this occasionally.
resolution: This typically indicates a temporary data retrieval issue. Try clearing your browser's cache and cookies and then attempting to access the report again. If the problem persists, try a different browser or ensure no browser extensions are interfering. If still blank, provide the date range you are trying to view.

subject: Slow search results in specific workspace
body: Search functionality in one of our core workspaces has become incredibly slow, often hanging indefinitely. I am seeing the WORKSPACE_SEARCH_LAG error code when it fails to load. Can you look into this for us?
resolution: This behavior often occurs if a workspace contains a massive volume of files or deeply nested folders. We suggest using more specific search terms to help index performance. Please provide the affected workspace ID so our engineering team can perform a deeper investigation into your specific index.

subject: Inquiry regarding plan downgrade
body: Our team size has decreased recently and we would like to look into downgrading our subscription plan to a lower tier. I saw a BILL-PLAN-011 notification in the console. Let me know the process when you have a moment.
resolution: To downgrade your subscription, please navigate to the Admin Console, go to Billing, and select Subscription Details. You can choose to change your plan there. Please note that the transition will take effect at the end of your current billing cycle, as we do not offer prorated refunds.

subject: Google SSO domain not allowed error on mobile
body: Hi there. Some of our employees are trying to log into the mobile app using Google SSO, but they keep getting a domain not allowed error. Other email domains are working fine for some reason. Could you please check this?
resolution: In the CloudDesk Admin Console under your SSO & Identity settings for Google SSO, please check the Allowed Domains list. You just need to add any missing domains that should be permitted to log in via Google SSO.

subject: cant transfer workspace ownership option greyed out
body: im trying to hand off workspace ownership to another colleague but the option wont let me click it and gives me an error code CD-AM-004. no rush on this at all whenever you have a free moment thanks
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Incorrect user attribution in workspace activity log
body: Hello, we noticed that some file actions in our workspace log are attributed to an administrator instead of the actual user who performed them. Thank you for checking on this whenever you have time.
resolution: This is a display glitch primarily affecting actions performed by users with 'Contributor' roles when an administrator is also active in the same workspace. For an accurate audit trail, please cross-reference with the global audit log in the admin console.

subject: Mobile app crashes on large file uploads
body: When attempting to upload files larger than 1GB from the mobile app on iOS and Android, the application crashes without generating any error message. Smaller files upload successfully. This happens consistently across different devices and networks on our enterprise setup. Please advise on how to resolve this behavior.
resolution: This is a known memory management issue for very large file uploads on mobile. As a workaround, please upload files exceeding 1GB using the CloudDesk web app or desktop sync client. Our development team is working on an optimization for a future mobile app update.

subject: Legacy token format error 401 after v42 upgrade
body: after updating to v4.2 our api tokens fail with api-auth-401-v42 and legacy_token_format. we have a strict deployment deadline in two hours and our backend is blocked completely. need a fix asap
resolution: With the release of v4.2, the API token format was updated across the platform. You will need to regenerate all of your API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console and update your applications to use these new tokens immediately.

subject: Unable to add team members despite having seats
body: Hello, I am trying to add new team members but I keep getting an error saying the seat limit is reached. However, our subscription details clearly show we have plenty of open seats left. I would appreciate it if you could look into this whenever you are able. Thanks again for your assistance.
resolution: Please check your pending invitations list under Admin Console > Team Management. Unaccepted invitations count against your seat limit, which often causes this error. Simply revoking the old pending invites will free up those slots for your new team members.

subject: Critical security flaw: API scope bypass detected
body: We have discovered that our read-only API keys are currently able to delete entire user accounts, which is an unacceptable security risk for our company. We are seeing error code API_KEY_SCOPE_BYPASS whenever our automated scripts attempt to read data. This needs to be fixed immediately as it is compromising our entire user database. We expect a resolution as soon as possible.
resolution: Please revoke the affected API key immediately via the Admin Console under API Management. We have identified a systemic issue and our engineering team is actively working on a permanent patch for this vulnerability. In the meantime, please ensure your keys are strictly limited to the necessary scopes.

subject: Okta SSO login attribute mismatch error
body: Hi there, ever since the recent platform updates, some of our team members are unable to log in via Okta SSO. Upon being redirected back to CloudDesk, they receive a message about a user attribute mismatch or missing required attributes. We would greatly appreciate your prompt assistance in getting this sorted out so our workflow isn't disrupted further.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, verify that the 'email', 'firstName', and 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Additionally, please ensure that the 'email' attribute is set as the unique identifier.

subject: WEBHOOK SIGNATURE FAILING WITH ERROR 403
body: Our external service keeps rejecting your webhooks because of an invalid signature showing HMAC verification failed with error WEBHOOK-SIGN-403! This is totally blocking our integration work today and we need it sorted out right away.
resolution: Ensure the secret token used to verify the webhook signature on your receiving service exactly matches the 'Webhook Secret' configured in the CloudDesk Admin Console. Verify your signature verification algorithm matches CloudDesk's using HMAC-SHA256.

subject: Incorrect role labels in admin console
body: Hello. I noticed that some of our team members are showing incorrect roles like Contributor instead of Manager under Users and Permissions. Their actual access seems fine, but the UI is wrong. Please let me know when you can look into this.
resolution: This is a known UI display bug. The actual permissions are not affected. To temporarily refresh the displayed role, navigate to the user's profile within the admin console, change their role to a different one, save, then change it back to the correct role and save again. A permanent fix will be released in the next patch.

subject: Seat limit reached error when adding team members
body: Hello CloudDesk support. While attempting to add new external contractors to our PRO plan workspace, I received a seat limit reached notice, even though our subscription details indicate we have available seats. Many administrators are reporting this strange licensing behavior at the moment. Thank you for your help whenever you are free.
resolution: Verify the 'Pending Invitations' count in 'Admin Console > Team Management > Invitations'. Pending invitations count towards your seat limit. Either revoke old pending invitations or upgrade your plan to increase seat capacity.

subject: Existing API tokens returning 401 unauthorized legacy token format error
body: Hello, ever since the v4.2 upgrade, all of our previously functioning API tokens are now throwing a 401 Unauthorized response with a legacy_token_format error. This is a critical issue breaking our production integrations and halting our operations entirely. We urgently need a solution as soon as possible.
resolution: Due to the update in the API token format introduced in v4.2, all legacy tokens are no longer supported. You must regenerate your API tokens from the 'API & Integrations' section in the Admin Console and update your connected applications to use these new credentials immediately.

subject: Incorrect user roles displayed
body: Some of our users are showing the wrong role in the Admin Console, despite having the correct permissions in their workspaces. UI-ADMIN-003 is appearing on the dashboard. Is there a way to fix this display issue?
resolution: This is a known UI display bug and does not affect actual user permissions. You can refresh the display by navigating to the user's profile, changing their role to something else, saving, and then changing it back. A permanent fix will be included in our next patch.

subject: Pagination not working in API
body: The limit and offset parameters in the api seem to be ignored entirely. I am geting way fewer results then I expect from my queries. Its very annoying to have to manually fetch everything. Please fix this soon.
resolution: Ensure your API request correctly uses the 'limit' and 'offset' query parameters as specified in the CloudDesk API documentation. Note that there might be a hard cap on the maximum 'limit' allowed per request (e.g., 1000 items).

subject: Okta SSO login failing with error AUTH-SSO-401.1
body: Following the recent v4.2 update, none of our users can log in using Okta SSO. They are all encountering the AUTH-SSO-401.1 error code. This is currently blocking our entire company from accessing their workspaces.
resolution: We apologize for the disruption caused by this. Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This step is necessary due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in version 4.2.

subject: Mobile app document previews failing
body: Hello support, our team managers are extremely frustrated because mobile previews are completely broken. Files either take forever to load or show mobile_preview_fail. It is not urgent right now, but we would love a fix eventually.
resolution: Ensure the mobile app is updated to the latest version. Check the user's device storage and network connection. Advise clearing the mobile app's cache (via device settings). For very large files, suggest downloading the file first before attempting to preview.

subject: Admin Console Audit Logs filter timeout
body: Hello, applying filters in the Audit Logs section is currently taking a very long time and results in a timeout. We have an important compliance audit on Friday and need to pull these records. Thank you for looking into this.
resolution: We advise narrowing down your filter criteria as much as possible, starting with smaller date ranges. For specific user activity, please use the 'User Activity' report in the 'Reports' section, which is optimized for single-user queries.

subject: missing search results in web app
body: hey support team when we search for specific keywords inside folder names or files in the webapp the search results seem incomplete or missing files search-002 that we know are there and accessible pls advise
resolution: This discrepancy can occasionally happen if your account search index has fallen out of sync. Please try executing a more refined search using exact phrases in quotes. If the problem continues, logging out and logging back in will force a complete re-indexing for your account workspace.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with attribute mismatch
body: Hello, users on our free account are unable to log in via Okta SSO because they receive a user attribute mismatch error on the login page after redirection. Several organizations are running into this authentication hiccup right now. Please advise on how to fix this configuration.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, verify that the 'email' and 'firstName' / 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Ensure 'email' is set as the unique identifier.

subject: Large file upload issues
body: im having trouble uploading files over 1gb to the web app. it keeps getting stuck and i eventually get a upload_timeout_504 error. any help would be great thanks
resolution: Please check your network stability, and for files larger than 500MB, we highly recommend using the CloudDesk Desktop Sync client. The desktop client supports resumable transfers, which will prevent these timeout errors. If the issue continues on the web app, please verify if it occurs across different browsers or on a wired connection.

subject: AWS S3 automated export failing with invalid credentials
body: Automated tenant-wide data export to our AWS S3 bucket is failing with an Invalid Credentials error, code S3_EXPORT_CREDENTIALS_401, immediately following the v4.2 upgrade on our Pro plan. Our AWS credentials have not been modified on our end. This is blocking our daily compliance workflows and requires prompt help.
resolution: The v4.2 release updated the S3 integration to enforce stricter IAM policy requirements for enhanced security. Your existing IAM user or role policy is likely missing a required permission, such as s3:GetBucketLocation. Please submit a detailed proposal for this functionality to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements so we can assess demand.

subject: Locked out of my account, please help

resolution: Please wait 15 minutes for the automated lockout to expire. If you have an administrator on your team, they can also manually unlock your account through the Admin Console by selecting your user profile and choosing the Unlock Account option.

resolution: Please update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading the IDP metadata. This step is required due to a change in the SSO token format introduced in v4.2.

resolution: Currently, our mobile app only supports offline viewing for starred files rather than editing. We recognize how important this feature is for mobile productivity. Please visit our roadmap page at roadmap.cloudesk.com to submit a request or vote for this feature so we can prioritize it.

subject: Role creation error when naming a new internal team role

resolution: Role names are case-insensitive and leading/trailing spaces are trimmed, which can trigger error CD-AM-012 if a similar name exists. There might be an existing role that differs only by capitalization. Please check 'Admin Console > Team Management > Roles' thoroughly for any roles that might conflict.

subject: New admin cannot generate API key

resolution: API key generation requires the Super Admin role rather than standard admin privileges. Please confirm their role in the Admin Console under Team Management and Users. If they are not a Super Admin, the current Super Admin must generate the key for them or elevate their role.

subject: Delayed mobile app push notifications
body: Push notifications for file updates and mentions on our Enterprise mobile app are coming in several minutes late or only after opening the app.
resolution: Verify that push notifications are enabled in both the CloudDesk mobile app settings and your device's operating system settings. Please also check for any aggressive battery optimization settings on the device that might be restricting background app activity. We recommend reinstalling the mobile app if the delay continues.

resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

resolution: Advise the user to force close the app, check for app updates in their respective app store, and try again. If it persists, suggest clearing the app's cache/data (Android) or reinstalling the app (iOS/Android). Verify server status on our status page.

resolution: Thank you for your feedback regarding our free tier storage limits. These limits are designed to provide a robust starter experience, and we do not plan to increase them at this time. Please consider our paid plans if you require expanded storage and additional features.

If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

If it still fails, send us the key ID and workspace ID for a trace.

subject: Blank user activity report

resolution: We are currently investigating a widespread delivery issue affecting webhook notifications. Please verify the webhook endpoint URL in the Admin Console under your Webhooks settings. Confirm that your external service is running and accessible from the public internet, and ensure that its firewall allows incoming connections from CloudDesk's IP range as listed in our documentation.

resolution: Please ensure that your mobile phone's time is synchronized automatically with the network time, as any drift will invalidate the code. If the issue persists, please try re-setting up MFA for your account via the Security Settings page in the web app.

subject: User data deletion request stuck in pending

resolution: Verify the user's status is 'Inactive' before requesting deletion. If the user is active, the deletion will be queued. If inactive and still pending, check System Status page for background job processing issues. If no issues, provide the user's email and deletion request ID for investigation.

Please open your sync client settings, navigate to 'Synced Folders,' and verify if your Documents folder was accidentally checked. You may also want to ensure that 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is disabled if you want full control.

resolution: We handle accidental upgrade refunds on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time the upgrade occurred and confirm that no features from the new plan have been utilized by your team. Once we have this information, we will review your request for eligibility.

resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a Member or Admin of that specific workspace. Please ensure the intended recipient is already a member of the workspace, and if not, add them first. Then you can successfully attempt the transfer via Admin Console, Workspaces, [Workspace Name], Settings, and Transfer Ownership.

If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

After the reset is complete, resume syncing. If the issue persists, check for very large numbers of small files in your synced folders.

body: We received an automated notification stating that our automatic subscription renewal failed due to a declined credit card. When checking our account, we see BILL-PAY-002 in the billing section. Could you please assist us in resolving this payment issue so our team's access is not interrupted?
resolution: Please navigate to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Payment Methods' and update your credit card details or add a new one. Ensure the billing address matches the card on file with your bank, and you can then retry the payment from the 'Invoices' section.

subject: SSO login failure on desktop app
body: Hi there, I am having trouble with the desktop sync client. It redirects to the browser but the app just says Login Failed and shows error DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. Thanks for your help with this.
resolution: Please make sure your desktop sync client is updated to at least v4.2.1, as this version contains critical fixes for SSO handling. You should also verify that your default browser is correctly set to handle authentication redirects. If the problem continues, try logging in with your email and password as a temporary workaround.

subject: API 404 error when fetching files
body: Hello, I am trying to pull some folder information using your API, but I keep getting a 404 Not Found error. I have checked the ID multiple times and it seems correct. No rush on this, just wanted to report the issue.
resolution: Please verify that the API endpoint path and HTTP method match our latest documentation. Ensure the folder ID you are requesting is accessible given the specific permissions attached to your API token. If the path and permissions are confirmed, the resource may not be available to your current connection.

subject: Desktop client login broken
body: The sync client shows DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3 upon SSO login. It is not working. Please fix this.
resolution: This issue is resolved in our latest update, version 4.2.1. Please download and install the update to restore SSO functionality. Ensure your browser is configured to support the redirect flow, or use your account credentials directly in the app if you need immediate access.

subject: Critical Azure AD SSO login failure before board demo
body: Good afternoon, our executive team is completely locked out of the web application when trying to log in via Azure AD, getting a reply URL mismatch error instead. We have our company-wide quarterly earnings demo at 5 PM today and this SSO-AZURE-400 problem is causing massive panic across the leadership team. You must fix this urgently right now before our presentation starts.
resolution: In your Azure AD application registration for CloudDesk, ensure the 'Reply URL' (Assertion Consumer Service URL) is correctly set to 'https://yourcompany.cloud-desk.com/sso/acs' (replace 'yourcompany' with your actual subdomain).

subject: Missing API endpoint for workspace automation in v4.2
body: We are struggling to scale our client onboarding since the v4.2 update. We really need a way to programmatically create and configure workspaces via the API. Is this something you can provide immediately? We are losing a lot of engineering time doing this manually.
resolution: The v4.2 release introduced changes to our SSO token handling, but an API endpoint for programmatic workspace creation is not yet available. You can currently manage workspaces via the Admin Console. Please submit your detailed requirements for this API endpoint to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements/workspace-creation-api.

subject: User account is locked out
body: One of our accounts is currently showing an 'Account Locked' message after a few failed login attempts. We keep seeing AUTH-LOCK-429.1 when trying to access the site. Can you please restore access immediately?
resolution: The account will automatically unlock after a 15-minute cooling-off period. Alternatively, an administrator in your organization can manually unlock the account via the Users section in the Admin Console.

subject: Missing video conferencing integration in workspaces
body: We need direct video conferencing inside workspaces. Fix this now.
resolution: Currently, CloudDesk focuses on file sharing and project collaboration. While we don't have built-in video conferencing, you can easily share meeting links within comments. For a direct integration with specific video conferencing platforms, please submit your request and preferred tools at roadmap.cloudesk.com/integrations/video-conferencing. This helps us assess demand for future partnerships.

subject: Intermittent 500 errors on GET /files/{id}/content
body: Our development team is noticing that calls to the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint are intermittently returning an API-500 internal server error. This mostly happens for files stored in geographically diverse regions while other endpoints work fine. This is blocking our integration work and we request a prompt investigation.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: mobile app keeps logging me out
body: hi there im getting expired session errors constantly on the mobile app now. CD-AM-011 pops up every time i open it. thanks for any help you can provide.
resolution: The v4.2 update included changes to session management for improved security. Users should fully log out of the mobile app, clear their app cache or reinstall the app, and then log back in to force a new, compatible session token.

subject: mfa setup broken on mobile app
body: we cant set up google auth in mobile app error MFA-MOB-002 pops up every time. we have security audit on Friday please fix this immediately
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app by navigating to Settings, Security, and then Multi-Factor Authentication. Once configured there, it will work seamlessly for both your web and mobile logins.

subject: Desktop sync client SSO login failure
body: We are experiencing significant frustration with the desktop sync client when attempting to log in via SSO. The browser successfully redirects, but the client remains unauthenticated or displays a generic error message, throwing DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. We would appreciate your assistance in getting this resolved soon.
resolution: Please ensure the desktop sync client is updated to the latest version (v4.2.1 or newer). Check if your default browser is correctly configured to handle SSO redirects, or as a workaround, log in via email and password if SSO is not enforced.

subject: admin console user list failing to load
body: The users and groups page is timing out and failing to load for our organization. We see error ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT. This is critical as we have an urgent audit deadline on Friday and need to pull reports immediately.
resolution: The system is currently optimized for smaller query sets. Please use the search bar or apply specific status filters immediately upon loading the page to reduce the volume of data requested. This should allow you to access the necessary data for your audit on time.

subject: Frequent SSO re-authentication on desktop client
body: Ever since we updated to 4.2, the desktop app keeps asking for login constantly. The logs indicate an SSO_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAIL_4_2 error. We would like this addressed when possible.
resolution: The v4.2 release included changes to SSO token handling. Please perform a clean reinstall of the Desktop Sync client to resolve these refresh issues. If the problem continues, your SSO administrator should review the Identity Provider's token lifetime settings or regenerate the client secret in the Admin Console.

subject: Google SSO not working for some domains
body: Some of my users are receiving an error SSO-GOOGLE-403 when trying to log in with Google. It seems to be happening for specific email domains. No big rush, but please look into it when you can.
resolution: This is related to the domain allowlist configuration. Please navigate to the SSO & Identity section in your Admin Console and ensure all required domains are explicitly added to the 'Allowed Domains' list for Google SSO.

subject: MFA code not working on mobile
body: I am unable to log into the mobile app because my MFA code is not working. It either says invalid or does not refresh properly. I am seeing error AUTH-MFA-401.2. Please advise.
resolution: This issue is usually caused by the time on your phone being slightly out of sync with the network. Please ensure your device's time is set to update automatically. If the issue persists, you should reset your MFA settings through the Security section of your account on the web app.

subject: Cannot transfer workspace ownership error CD-AM-004
body: Hello Support, I am trying to transfer workspace ownership to another team member ahead of our product demo at 5pm today, but the option is grayed out and I get error CD-AM-004 stating that I cannot transfer ownership to a non-owner. The recipient is already in our organization. Please help us get this sorted out before our meeting.
resolution: Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a 'Member' or 'Admin' of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member of the workspace. If not, add them first, then attempt the transfer via 'Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership'.

subject: Cannot download invoices in PDF format
body: I am trying to download some invoices for our records but they only export as CSV. The system shows BILL-INV-009. We require these in PDF format, so please let me know how to proceed.
resolution: PDF invoice generation is temporarily unavailable for certain older invoices due to a recent migration. For any specific invoices you need in PDF format, please provide the invoice IDs and our team will manually generate and email them to you.

subject: Incorrect tax rate applied to enterprise invoice
body: I am writing because the tax rate applied to our latest enterprise invoice is completely wrong based on our registered business location and tax exemption status. This error needs to be corrected promptly so our finance department can process the payment correctly. Please review our account details as soon as possible.
resolution: Please verify your billing address and tax ID under 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Billing Information'. If these details are correct, please provide your company's full legal name, registered address, and valid tax exemption certificate for a manual review of your tax settings.

subject: mobile app cache concerns
body: The app keeps files on my device after logout. There is no clear cache option. This is a security risk. Fix this.
resolution: The mobile app caches files by default for offline access. You can clear these manually under Settings > Storage, or enable the 'Clear cache on logout' toggle in the same menu to ensure data is removed automatically when you sign out.

subject: accidental plan upgrade
body: i think i clicked upgrade by mistake on my account. can i get a refund for this charge? error code is BILL-REF-005. i havent used any of the new features yet.
resolution: We can certainly look into this for you. Please provide the exact date and time the upgrade occurred so we can verify your account. Once we confirm no premium features were utilized, we can process your request.

subject: SSO login failure after update
body: Our team cannot login with Okta today, getting 'Invalid SSO token format' error. This is a real problem because we have a demo at 5pm today and we are blocked. Please help us get this sorted.
resolution: This is likely due to the SSO token format change in v4.2. You will need to update your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console by re-uploading your IDP metadata. Once updated, your users should be able to log in normally.

subject: cant transfer workspace ownership
body: Hi there, I am trying to transfer ownership of a workspace in our enterprise account, but the option is greyed out and I get an error saying Cannot transfer ownership to non-owner with error code CD-AM-004. It isnt an emergency right now, but whenever you have time I would love some help sorting it out. Thanks!
resolution: We are aware that several administrators are encountering transfer restrictions right now. Workspace ownership can only be transferred to another user who is already a Member or Admin of that specific workspace. Ensure the intended recipient is a member, add them first if not, and then attempt the transfer via Admin Console > Workspaces > [Workspace Name] > Settings > Transfer Ownership.

subject: mfa code from google authenticator not working
body: hey team my google authenticator app code is not working at all when i try to login on mobile app. it keeps giving error AUTH-MFA-401.2 and the numbers dont seem to accept. can someone look at this whenever you get a chance
resolution: Please ensure your phone's time is synchronized automatically with network time. If the issue persists, you can re-set up MFA for your account via the web app's 'Security Settings' page.

subject: Okta SSO login failing with attribute error
body: Our team members cannot log in via Okta SSO today. Every time we try, we get thrown back to the CloudDesk login page with an error after redirection. We are really frustrated because this is stopping people from starting their work. Please fix this soon.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, verify that the email and firstName / lastName attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Ensure email is set as the unique identifier.

subject: SSO Just-in-Time provisioning failing
body: My team is struggling because new users are not being created automatically when they sign in via SSO. We have JIT provisioning enabled, yet we keep seeing CD-AM-009 errors. We really need this working immediately to onboard our new hires.
resolution: Please verify that your IdP is correctly passing required attributes like email and name in the assertion. Also, confirm you have available seats in your subscription to accommodate new users. You can check for configuration errors directly in the SSO settings within the Admin Console.

subject: Desktop sync client uploaded Documents folder without consent
body: We discovered that the desktop sync client automatically uploaded confidential files from our local Documents folder to a CloudDesk workspace without any explicit consent from us! This is a severe privacy violation and a massive security risk for our organization. We need prompt assistance to address this unauthorized behavior immediately.
resolution: The desktop sync client only syncs folders explicitly configured by the user or pre-configured by an admin. Check the sync client settings for 'Synced Folders' and verify no unintended folders were selected. Ensure 'Auto-sync new shared folders' is disabled if not desired.

subject: API tokens broken with legacy token format error
body: hello, after the v4.2 update, our automated scripts are failing because existing api tokens return 401 unauthorized with a legacy_token_format error code. we have a critical payroll run tomorrow morning and need this fixed immediately.
resolution: With v4.2, the API token format was updated for security reasons. You must regenerate all of your API tokens directly from the API & Integrations section in the Admin Console and update your applications to use these new tokens right away.

subject: Google Authenticator MFA codes not working
body: Some of our users are reporting that their Google Authenticator codes are being rejected during the mobile app login process. We are seeing the AUTH-MFA-401.2 error frequently today. Can you help us get this sorted out? Thanks.
resolution: This usually happens when the phone's system time is out of sync with the network. Please ensure the affected users have their devices set to automatic time synchronization. If the problem continues, they should reset their MFA settings by re-linking the app through the web portal's security section.

subject: WE NEED WEBHOOKS FOR NEW FILE UPLOADS IMMEDIATELY
body: WHY IS THERE STILL NO WEBHOOK EVENT FOR FILE UPLOADS IN A SPECIFIED FOLDER?! IT IS INCREDIBLY FRUSTRATING THAT WE CANNOT TRIGGER OUR INTERNAL SYSTEMS AUTOMATICALLY. EVERYONE IN OUR DEV COMMUNITY IS COMPLAINING ABOUT THIS EXACT LACK OF FEATURE. PLEASE ADD THIS FUNCTIONALITY SOON.
resolution: Thank you for your API enhancement request. While our API currently supports polling for file changes, a direct webhook for new file uploads is not yet implemented. Please submit a detailed proposal for this webhook functionality, including desired payload, to roadmap.cloudesk.com/api-enhancements. This helps us assess demand and design.

subject: API data export permission error
body: I have been working on our integration for quite some time now, and I was just trying to export user data via the API today as I usually do. Suddenly, I am getting an API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED error. It is quite strange because I haven't changed my code in weeks, and I have all the admin scopes enabled. Could you look into why this is failing?
resolution: Effective recently, the 'Admin' API scope no longer includes permissions for 'Data Export'. You will now need the 'Data Steward' API role to access this endpoint. Please generate a new API key with the 'Data Steward' role in the Admin Console under 'API Management' to restore functionality.

subject: Audit log export range limit issue
body: Hello, we are trying to export our enterprise audit logs for a period covering the last four months, but the export fails with a range limit message. Thank you for any guidance you can provide on pulling this data.
resolution: The Admin Console's direct audit log export is limited to 90 days. For longer periods, please use the API endpoint '/v1/audit/export?startDate=[ISO_DATE]&endDate=[ISO_DATE]' with a pagination script or contact support for a manual data pull if API access is not feasible.

subject: API 401 Unauthorized errors after v4.2 update
body: Since upgrading to v4.2, my automated scripts are failing with a 401 Unauthorized error. The API response explicitly mentions legacy_token_format and error code API-AUTH-401-V42. I have a production process that is currently blocked by this. Could you please provide instructions on how to resolve this immediately?
resolution: With the v4.2 release, our API authentication token format has been updated for improved security. You will need to regenerate your API tokens by navigating to the API & Integrations section within your Admin Console. Please update your existing applications to use these newly generated tokens to restore connectivity.

subject: Intermittent error when retrieving file content
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a wonderful week. We noticed that calls to the GET /files/{id}/content endpoint intermittently return an error, particularly for files stored in geographically diverse regions. All of our other endpoints function normally without any issues. Thank you so much for looking into this for us when you have a moment.
resolution: This intermittent 500 error for file content retrieval can be resolved by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff in your API client. We are investigating the root cause related to distributed storage retrieval and will deploy a fix in an upcoming hotfix.

subject: file previews showing blank page in web app
body: hey preview viewer is showing a blank page or infinite loader for pdf and pptx files inside the web app downloading works fine though whenever you get a chance to look at this
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering problems. First, try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out extensions. If the issue is specific to a file, ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Data export API endpoint returning 403 error
body: We are very angry that our automated data exports have stopped working today! We are getting API_403_PERMISSION_DENIED and our admin scope keys are being rejected. This is a critical workflow for us and we need a resolution immediately!
resolution: Effective recently, the Admin API scope no longer includes Data Export permissions. You now require a specific 'Data Steward' API role for this endpoint. Please generate a new API key with the Data Steward role assigned via the Admin Console's API Management section.

subject: Okta SSO error AUTH-SSO-401.1
body: My team is totally stuck, they cant get into CloudDesk and get error AUTH-SSO-401.1. We have an audit on Friday and we need to get back in immediately. Please fix this.
resolution: Due to the v4.2 update, you must update your SSO configuration to support the new token format. Please log into the CloudDesk Admin Console and re-upload your IDP metadata to restore access. This should resolve the authentication issue for your users.

subject: Desktop app SSO login failure
body: We are experiencing issues with the desktop sync client when using SSO. It keeps failing with DS-AUTH-SSO-401.3. Could you please provide guidance on how to fix this? This is blocking our team's access to files.
resolution: Please ensure your desktop sync client is updated to version 4.2.1 or newer to resolve SSO compatibility issues. Verify that your default web browser is correctly configured to handle redirects. If you still encounter issues, you may sign in with your email and password as a workaround.

subject: Missing file access events in audit log search
body: I am trying to find specific file access events for a user in the audit logs, but the results are incomplete. This is very frustrating as we need to track down a shared document. Please look into why entries are missing.
resolution: Ensure correct filters are applied (User Email, Event Type 'File Access', 'File Share'). Note that 'View' events are only logged for public links or external shares, not internal workspace views. For internal views, check the file's individual activity feed.

subject: Users and groups page extremely slow to load
body: As a PRO user managing thousands of accounts, navigating to Users and Groups takes several minutes and throws ADMIN_USERLIST_TIMEOUT errors. The search and filters are also lagging terribly. Please look into optimizing this whenever possible.
resolution: Advise using the 'Search' bar or applying specific filters (e.g., 'Status: Active') immediately upon loading the page to reduce the initial dataset. The system is optimized for filtered views on large datasets. Suggest navigating directly to a specific user via search if their email is known.

subject: File preview failing in web app
body: We are experiencing issues where certain files, specifically PDFs and PowerPoints, fail to load in the previewer and just show a spinning icon. This is happening for multiple users. We would appreciate it if this could be addressed.
resolution: This can be caused by temporary issues with our rendering service or browser-specific problems. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies first, or test in an incognito window to rule out extension conflicts. If the issue persists for specific files, ensure they are not password-protected or corrupted.

subject: Account suspended error blocking enterprise access
body: Hello Support, our enterprise account is currently displaying an account suspended banner and users cannot log in. We received an automated notice regarding billing, but we have our company-wide audit on Friday and desperately need this resolved immediately to avoid compliance issues. Thank you for your swift attention to this critical matter.
resolution: Your account has been suspended due to an overdue payment. To reactivate your service, please settle the outstanding balance by navigating to 'Admin Console' -> 'Billing' -> 'Invoices' and paying the overdue invoice. Once payment is confirmed, your service will be restored automatically within 15 minutes.

subject: ACCIDENTAL PLAN UPGRADE REFUND REQUEST
body: OUR ACCOUNT WAS ACCIDENTALLY UPGRADED TO A HIGHER TIER DUE TO A MISCLICK AND WE WANT A FULL REFUND IMMEDIATELY. THIS BILL-REF-005 SITUATION IS RIDICULOUS AND WE DID NOT MEAN TO CHANGE OUR PRO PLAN. FIX THIS AND REFUND US NOW.
resolution: Refunds for accidental upgrades are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please provide the exact date and time of the upgrade, and confirm that no features from the upgraded plan have been utilized. We will review your account for eligibility.

subject: Need to update PO number on invoices
body: Hello, I am updating our records and need to add a purchase order number to our future invoices. I see the code BILL-PO-008 when looking at the billing section. Please let me know the process whenever you have a moment.
resolution: You can update your PO number by navigating to Admin Console, then Billing, then Billing Information. Locate the Purchase Order Number field to enter your details, which will apply to all future invoices. Note that this change cannot be applied retroactively to invoices already generated.

subject: Mobile app network error
body: Getting a MOBILE-NET-500.1 error on the mobile app. I have a demo at 5pm and need to show this. Please advise.
resolution: Please force close the application and check your app store to ensure you are on the latest version. If the error continues, try clearing the app's cache or reinstalling it entirely. You can also check our status page to ensure all services are currently operational.

subject: new user cant log in user not found
body: hello we just invited a new team member to our pro workspace and they are getting an user not found error when trying to sign in with email and password error code AUTH-NF-404.1. we have an important client demo at 5pm today and really need this sorted out as soon as possible thank you so much for your help
resolution: Verify the user's email address in the Admin Console and confirm the invitation was sent and accepted. If not, please resend the invitation directly from your dashboard. Also, check if the user is attempting to log into the correct company instance URL if your organization maintains multiple accounts.

subject: Seat limit reached error
body: I am trying to add new team members but I get 'Seat limit reached' even though the dashboard shows we have open spots. This is causing CD-AM-001 error and it is stopping us from onboarding new hires. Can you look into this?
resolution: Please check the 'Pending Invitations' section within your Team Management dashboard. Invitations that have not yet been accepted still occupy a seat in your plan. You can revoke those pending invitations to free up space or upgrade your plan to increase your total seat capacity.

subject: Account access issue
body: A user was changed to Guest role and now cannot log in. They are receiving CD-AM-002. Please resolve this immediately.
resolution: Guest users are restricted to specific shared workspaces. Please check the 'Team Management' section in your Admin Console to verify the user's role and ensure they have active invitations to the necessary workspaces. You can promote them back to 'Member' if they require broader access.

subject: Okta SSO attribute mismatch errors
body: Users attempting to log in via Okta SSO are encountering user attribute mismatch errors on the login page after redirection. We need this resolved as soon as possible to restore access.
resolution: In your Okta application settings for CloudDesk, please verify that the 'email' and 'firstName' / 'lastName' attributes are correctly mapped to the corresponding CloudDesk user profile fields. Ensure 'email' is set as the unique identifier.

subject: Refund request for accidental upgrade
body: Our account was upgraded to the Enterprise plan by mistake earlier this week. I would like to request a refund for this charge, as it was not authorized. Our reference code for this issue is BILL-REF-005. Please let me know what steps are needed to process this.
resolution: I have logged your refund request and our billing team will review it shortly. Please confirm that you have not utilized any of the premium features associated with the new plan level. Once confirmed, we will determine if your account is eligible for a full or prorated refund.

subject: Assigned tickets missing from agent view
body: I am working on our helpdesk integration and noticed that tickets assigned to agents aren't appearing in their specific views. This is incredibly annoying as it breaks our support flow. We are getting error code HELPDESK-007 when checking the assignments. Can you look into this?
resolution: This is often a caching issue with agent permissions. Please have the affected agent clear their browser's cache and cookies before logging back into CloudDesk. If the problem continues, an administrator can re-assign the ticket to a different agent, save the change, and then re-assign it back to the original person.

subject: API rate limiting during peak hours
body: We seeing constant API-RATE-429 error when our application make big number of calls. It happen mainly in morning time when traffic is high. We need stable connection for our business operation.
resolution: To resolve these intermittent rate limit issues, please implement exponential backoff and retry logic within your API client. Additionally, we recommend reviewing your current application usage patterns to optimize unnecessary calls, or you may request a permanent rate limit increase by contacting our support team if your volume is justified.

subject: Workspace loading performance for large folders
body: Good morning, we love using CloudDesk for our workspace collaboration. However, when we navigate to workspaces containing over 10,000 files, the page experiences severe loading delays and often shows a blank screen. We would appreciate any advice on how to improve this experience for our team. Thank you.
resolution: Check for large file counts in the affected workspace. We advise using the search functionality or filter options to narrow down the view, and suggesting breaking up very large workspaces into smaller, more manageable ones. Please verify your browser console for any network errors if the problem persists.

subject: Deleted user still showing in share list
body: Hello, I delete a user account yesterday from our free account workspace, but the name and email still showing when I try to share file to other team members. We have a big company audit on Friday and I need everything clean. Please check code CD-AM-006 for this error. Thanks.
resolution: Deleted users are immediately removed from active access but may remain as ghost entries in historical share lists until the system purges them within 24-48 hours. Alternatively, a workspace owner can explicitly remove them from a share via Workspace Settings > Members. This is expected behavior and should not affect your audit.

subject: Trouble setting up Google Authenticator on my phone
body: Hello support team, I hope you are having a pleasant Tuesday. We had some great weather here this weekend and my dog chased a squirrel right into the pond, which was hilarious. Anyway, I am trying to set up my security settings on my mobile phone using the Google Authenticator app, but every time I scan the QR code it gives me an error code MFA-MOB-002 and says it failed to register my device. My email and password work just fine to log into the computer, but I really need this extra security working on my phone too when you get a chance.
resolution: This is a known issue with the mobile app's MFA registration flow. Please advise users to complete the MFA setup process via the CloudDesk web app ('Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Multi-Factor Authentication'). Once set up there, it will work for both web and mobile logins.

subject: Request for advanced user activity audit logs
body: We would like to request more detailed activity reporting for our PRO workspace, specifically tracking precise file downloads, views, and individual collaboration actions beyond standard logs. This is for internal compliance tracking, so there is no rush.
resolution: We appreciate your interest in enhanced user activity reporting. Our current audit logs provide basic activity tracking. For more advanced reporting capabilities, please describe your specific reporting needs and use cases on our public roadmap at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/advanced-reporting. This will help our analytics team understand your requirements.

subject: Google SSO loop
body: Our users are stuck in a redirect loop when trying to log in using Google SSO. They authenticate fine but never reach the dashboard. I think the error is AUTH-SSO-302.1. Any ideas on how to fix this? thanks
resolution: This is often caused by stale browser data. Please have the users clear their cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, or try using an incognito window. If the loop continues, please verify your Google SSO configuration within the Admin Console to ensure the redirect URIs are current.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
body: Hello, my team members are not receiving their password reset emails, and this is stopping them from completing their work. We are seeing error code CD-AM-008. Could you please look into this as soon as possible?
resolution: Please confirm the user's email address is correct in the Admin Console and advise them to check their spam folders. Ask them to whitelist no-reply@cloudesk.com to ensure delivery. As a last resort, you can manually trigger a password reset for them directly through the Team Management section.
